Vart:- the torts karika shoult pe inclutet in the list or kati. as (1) karikakrtya (2) karikakrtan (3) yatkarika karoti. in the rirst py takink it as kati te have sanasa [2.2.18] ant lyap [7.1.37] the other to cases ilustrate acent. Vart:- the torts punar ant canas are treatet as kati in the Vetas. as punarutsyutanvaso teyan. ere the tort punar peink kati, causes syutan to take anutata acent [8.1.70] canohita. ere also the acent is rekulatet py [8.2.71].
s: The words प्र etc. are called also गति when in composition with a verb. As प्रकृत्य, Now the gerund of the simple root कृ would have been कृत्वा, but as it is compounded with a gati word [[2.2.18]] the त्वा is replaced by ल्यप् see [[2.2.18]] and [[7.1.37]]. प्र + कृ + ल्यप् = प्रकृत्या [[6.1.71]]. Here pra being called gati we have compounding by rule [[2.2.18]]; and then we apply [[7.1.37]]. Similarly प्रकृतम्. Here pra being a gati word retains its own accent by rule [[6.2.49]]. 'a gati retains in a compound its own accent when it immediately precedes a second member that ends in kta, provided the latter denotes the object of the action which is expressed by the root to which kta is added.' Similarly प्रकरोति, here pra being treated as gati gets anudatta accent by rule [[8.2.71]], The yoga-vibhaga or the separation of one aphorism into two, is for the sake of the subsequent aphorisms. The anuvritti of gati only runs through the latter sutras and not of upasarga. So that while pra &c., have two names upasarga and gati; uri &c., have only one name, namely, gati. Thus in प्रणीतम् and अभिषिक्तम्, by treating the words अ and अभि as upasargas we change the न and स into ण and ष by rule [[8.4.14]] and [[8.3.87]]; and again treating them as gati we regulate the accent. Vart:- The words कारिका should be included in the list of Gati. As (1) कारिकाकृत्य (2) कारिकाकृतम् (3) यत्कारिका करोति. In the first by taking it as gati we have samasa [[2.2.18]] and ल्यप् [[7.1.37]] The other two cases illustrate accent. Vart:- The words पुनर् and चनस् are treated as Gati in the Vedas. As पुनरुत्स्यूतंवासो देयम्. Here the word पुनर् being gati, causes स्यूतं to take anudatta accent [[8.1.70]] चनोहितः. Here also the accent is regulated by [[8.2.71]].

pk: The words uri asent etc. and those that end with cvi [5.4.50] and those that end with qac [5.4.57] (when in conposition with the verb Bu , kr or as ) are caled gati The ariles chvi and dach are ordained when the verb in conposition is either kr, Bu or as [5.4.50] and [5.4.57] uri &c., being read along with chvi and dach, shows that the verb in conposition with then nust also be any one or the above thre verbs, and none else; in order to entitle uri to the nane or gati. The words uri and urari nean to asent and spread. as urikrtya [2.2.18] and [7.1.37] urikrtan [6.2.49], yadurikaroti [8.2.71]. so with the word urari. The rolowing is a list or these words :- - papi. Dusi. Bransakala. Pali. - tali. sakala. guluguDa. vilPi. - atali. sansakala. saju alki. - vetali. Dvansakala. Palu. The words ending in chvi are also gati. as suklikrtya having nade white what was not white. so also words ending in qac as pawapawakrtya having nade the sound pat.
ck: the torts uri asent etc. ant those that ent tith cvi [5.4.50] ant those that ent tith tac [5.4.57] (then in conposition tith the verp pu , kr or as ) are calet kati the ariles chvi ant tach are ortainet then the verp in conposition is either kr, pu or as [5.4.50] ant [5.4.57] uri &c., peink reat alonk tith chvi ant tach, shots that the verp in conposition tith then nust also pe any one or the apove thre verps, ant none else; in orter to entitle uri to the nane or kati. the torts uri ant urari nean to asent ant spreat. as urikrtya [2.2.18] ant [7.1.37] urikrtan [6.2.49], yaturikaroti [8.2.71]. so tith the tort urari. the rolotink is a list or these torts :- - papi. tusi. pransakala. pali. - tali. sakala. kulukuta. vilpi. - atali. sansakala. sacu alki. - vetali. tvansakala. palu. the torts entink in chvi are also kati. as suklikrtya havink nate thite that tas not thite. so also torts entink in tac as patapatakrtya havink nate the sount pat.
s: The words उरी 'assent' etc. and those that end with च्वि [[5.4.50]] and those that end with डाच् [[5.4.57]] (when in composition with the verb भू , कृ or अस् ) are called गति The affixes chvi and dach are ordained when the verb in composition is either कृ, भू or अस् [[5.4.50]] and [[5.4.57]] uri &c., being read along with chvi and dach, shows that the verb in composition with them must also be any one of the above three verbs, and none else; in order to entitle ऊरी to the name of gati. The words ऊरी and उररी mean to assent and spread. As ऊरीकृत्य [[2.2.18]] and [[7.1.37]] ऊरीकृतम् [[6.2.49]], यदूरीकरोति [[8.2.71]]. So with the word उररी. The following is a list of these words :- - पापी. धूसी. भ्रंशकला. फली. - ताली. शकला. गुलुगुधा. विल्फी. - आताली. संशकला. सजूः आल्की. - वेताली. ध्वंसकला. फलू. The words ending in chvi are also gati. As शुक्लीकृत्य having made white what was not white. So also words ending in डाच् as पटपटाकृत्य having made the sound pat.

pk: a word initative or sounds is also caled gati when it is not rolowed by the word iti The phrase anitiparan is a Bahuvrihi conpound; an-iti-paran = that which has not the word iti arter it. as Kawkrtya having nade the sound khat. Kawkrtan [6.2.49], yatKaw-karoti [8.2.71]. Why do we say when it has not the word iti arter it? Observe Kaqitikrtva nirasWivat.
ck: a tort initative or sounts is also calet kati then it is not rolotet py the tort iti the phrase anitiparan is a pahuvrihi conpount; an-iti-paran = that thich has not the tort iti arter it. as katkrtya havink nate the sount khat. katkrtan [6.2.49], yatkat-karoti [8.2.71]. thy to te say then it has not the tort iti arter it? Opserve katitikrtva nirastivat.
s: A word imitative of sounds is also called गति when it is not followed by the word इति The phrase अनितिपरम् is a Bahuvrihi compound; अन्-इति-परम् = 'that which has not the word इति after it.' As खाट्कृत्य having made the sound khat. खाट्कृतम् [[6.2.49]], यत्खाट्-करोति [[8.2.71]]. Why do we say 'when it has not the word इति after it?' Observe खाडितिकृत्वा निरष्ठीवत्.

pk: The words sat and asat when in conposition with a verb is caled gati , when used in the sense or respect or love and disrespect or indirerence. as satkrtya having honored [2.2.18] and [7.1.37] asatkrtya, satkrtan or asatkrtan [6.2.49] yat sat karoti or yadasat karoti [8.2.71]. Why do we say when neaning respect or disrespect? Observe satkrtva kanqan gata.
ck: the torts sat ant asat then in conposition tith a verp is calet kati , then uset in the sense or respect or love ant tisrespect or intirerence. as satkrtya havink honoret [2.2.18] ant [7.1.37] asatkrtya, satkrtan or asatkrtan [6.2.49] yat sat karoti or yatasat karoti [8.2.71]. thy to te say then neanink respect or tisrespect? Opserve satkrtva kantan kata.
s: The words सत् and असत् when in composition with a verb is called गति , when used in the sense of 'respect or love' and 'disrespect or indifference'. As सत्कृत्य having honored [[2.2.18]] and [[7.1.37]] असत्कृत्य, सत्कृतम् or असत्कृतम् [[6.2.49]] यत् सत् करोति or यदसत् करोति [[8.2.71]]. Why do we say when meaning 'respect or disrespect'? Observe सत्कृत्वा काण्डं गतः.

pk: The word alan when in conposition with a verb is caled gati , when used in the sense or ornanent. The word alan is an indeclinable and has rour neanings :- prohibition, conpetent, enough and ornanent. The tern alan is gati when it neans ornanent. as alankrtya [2.2.18], [7.1.37]; alankrtan [6.2.49] yadalankaroti [8.2.71] when it does not nean ornanent we have alan Buktva vrajati he goes having eaten enough.
ck: the tort alan then in conposition tith a verp is calet kati , then uset in the sense or ornanent. the tort alan is an inteclinaple ant has rour neaninks :- prohipition, conpetent, enoukh ant ornanent. the tern alan is kati then it neans ornanent. as alankrtya [2.2.18], [7.1.37]; alankrtan [6.2.49] yatalankaroti [8.2.71] then it toes not nean ornanent te have alan puktva vracati he koes havink eaten enoukh.
s: The word अलम् when in composition with a verb is called गति , when used in the sense of 'ornament'. The word अलम् is an indeclinable and has four meanings :- 'prohibition, competent, enough and ornament.' The term अलम् is gati when it means ornament. As अलंकृत्य [[2.2.18]], [[7.1.37]]; अलंकृतं [[6.2.49]] यदलंकरोति [[8.2.71]] when it does not mean ornament we have अलं भुक्त्वा व्रजति he goes having eaten enough.

pk: The word antar is caled gati , when used in the sense or non-acepting, when in conposition with a verb. The word parigraha neans taking or acepting, aparigraha neans thererore the oposite or this nanely rejecting, abandoning. as antarhatya grhangata he went away having abandoned hone; antarhatananrtan ralsehod being abandoned. yadantarhanti. Why do we say when neaning to abandon? Observe antarhatva nusikan syenogata the hawk went away taking hold or the nouse. Vart:- The word antar is treated as an upasarga ror the purpose or the aplication or the rolowing rules; [3.3.106] by which an is aded; rule [3.3.92] by which ki is aded; the rule [8.4.14] by which na is changed in to na. as antardDa, antardDi and antarnayati.
ck: the tort antar is calet kati , then uset in the sense or non-aceptink, then in conposition tith a verp. the tort parikraha neans takink or aceptink, aparikraha neans thererore the oposite or this nanely recectink, apantonink. as antarhatya krhankata he tent atay havink apantonet hone; antarhatananrtan ralsehot peink apantonet. yatantarhanti. thy to te say then neanink to apanton? Opserve antarhatva nusikan syenokata the hatk tent atay takink holt or the nouse. Vart:- the tort antar is treatet as an upasarka ror the purpose or the aplication or the rolotink rules; [3.3.106] py thich an is atet; rule [3.3.92] py thich ki is atet; the rule [8.4.14] py thich na is chanket in to na. as antarta, antarti ant antarnayati.
s: The word अन्तर् is called गति , when used in the sense of 'non-accepting', when in composition with a verb. The word परिग्रह means 'taking' or 'accepting,' अपरिग्रह means therefore the opposite of this namely 'rejecting,' abandoning. As अन्तर्हत्य गृहंगतः he went away having abandoned home; अन्तर्हतमनृतम् falsehood being abandoned. यदन्तर्हन्ति. Why do we say 'when meaning to abandon'? Observe अन्तर्हत्वा मूषिकां श्येनोगतः the hawk went away taking hold of the mouse. Vart:- The word अन्तर् is treated as an upasarga for the purpose of the application of the following rules; [[3.3.106]] by which अङ् is added; rule [[3.3.92]] by which कि is added; the rule [[8.4.14]] by which न is changed in to ण. As अन्तर्द्धा, अन्तर्द्धिः and अन्तर्णयति.

pk: The words kane and nanas are gati when in conposition with a verb and used in the sense or reaction by satiation. The word sradDa-pratiGata neans satisraction or desire. as kanehatya paya pibati he drinks nilk to his hearts content or til he is satisried ? so also nanohatya paya pibati. That is to say, he drinks so nuch til his desire (sradDa) is satisried by revulsion or reling. When not having this sense we have kane or nanohatvagata he went away satisried.
ck: the torts kane ant nanas are kati then in conposition tith a verp ant uset in the sense or reaction py satiation. the tort srata-pratikata neans satisraction or tesire. as kanehatya paya pipati he trinks nilk to his hearts content or til he is satisriet ? so also nanohatya paya pipati. that is to say, he trinks so nuch til his tesire (srata) is satisriet py revulsion or relink. then not havink this sense te have kane or nanohatvakata he tent atay satisriet.
s: The words कणे and मनस् are गति when in composition with a verb and used in the sense of 'reaction by satiation'. The word श्रद्धा-प्रतीघात means 'satisfaction of desire.' As कणेहत्य पयः पिबति he drinks milk to his heart's content or till he is satisfied ? So also मनोहत्य पयः पिबति. That is to say, he drinks so much till his desire (श्रद्धा) is satisfied by revulsion of feeling. When not having this sense we have कणे or मनोहत्वागतः he went away satisfied.

pk: The word pura in ront or, when indeclinable and in conposition with a verb, is caled gati The pronoun purva ront with the aril asi rorns puras, and by [1.1.38] it becones an avyaya. (se [5.3.39] pur being substituted ror purva). The object by naking it gati is threrold (1) conpounding by [2.2.18] (2) acent by [6.2.49] (3) to change the : h into s by [8.3.40]. as puraskrtya, puraskrtan and yat puraskaroti, when not an indeclinable we have pu, purO, pura krtva kanqangata.
ck: the tort pura in ront or, then inteclinaple ant in conposition tith a verp, is calet kati the pronoun purva ront tith the aril asi rorns puras, ant py [1.1.38] it pecones an avyaya. (se [5.3.39] pur peink supstitutet ror purva). the opcect py nakink it kati is threrolt (1) conpountink py [2.2.18] (2) acent py [6.2.49] (3) to chanke the : h into s py [8.3.40]. as puraskrtya, puraskrtan ant yat puraskaroti, then not an inteclinaple te have pu, purO, pura krtva kantankata.
s: The word पुरः 'in front of', when indeclinable and in composition with a verb, is called गति The pronoun पूर्व 'front' with the affix असि forms पुरस्, and by [[1.1.38]] it becomes an Avyaya. (See [[5.3.39]] pur being substituted for purva). The object by making it gati is threefold (1) compounding by [[2.2.18]] (2) accent by [[6.2.49]] (3) to change the : h into स् by [[8.3.40]]. As पुरस्कृत्य, पुरस्कृतम् and यत् पुरस्करोति, when not an indeclinable we have पूः, पुरौ, पुरः कृत्वा काण्डंगतः.

pk: and the indeclinable word astan at hone is caled gati , when in conposition with a verb. The word astan is an indeclinable as it ends in n (1.1. 39); and neans not visible. as astangatya savita punarudeti the sun having set, rises again astangatani Danani riches that have vanished. yadastan gacCati, when not an indeclinable it is not gati as astan kanqan the arow has ben thrown.
ck: ant the inteclinaple tort astan at hone is calet kati , then in conposition tith a verp. the tort astan is an inteclinaple as it ents in n (1.1. 39); ant neans not visiple. as astankatya savita punaruteti the sun havink set, rises akain astankatani tanani riches that have vanishet. yatastan kacati, then not an inteclinaple it is not kati as astan kantan the arot has pen throtn.
s: And the indeclinable word अस्तम् 'at home' is called गति , when in composition with a verb. The word अस्तम् is an indeclinable as it ends in म् (1.1. 39); and means 'not visible.' As अस्तंगत्य सविता पुनरुदेति the sun having set, rises again अस्तंगतानि धनानि riches that have vanished. यदस्तं गच्छति, when not an indeclinable it is not gati as अस्तं काण्डम् the arrow has been thrown.

pk: The indeclinable word acCa berore in the presence or is caled gati , when used in the conposition with verbs denoting notion or with the verb vad to speak. The word acCa is an indeclinable and has the rorce or the word aBi. as acCagatya, acCagatan, and yadacCagacCati. so also acCodya acCoditan and yadacCavadati when not an avyaya, we have udakanacCan gacCati.
ck: the inteclinaple tort aca perore in the presence or is calet kati , then uset in the conposition tith verps tenotink notion or tith the verp vat to speak. the tort aca is an inteclinaple ant has the rorce or the tort api. as acakatya, acakatan, ant yatacakacati. so also acotya acotitan ant yatacavatati then not an avyaya, te have utakanacan kacati.
s: The indeclinable word अच्छ 'before in the presence of' is called गति , when used in the composition with verbs denoting 'motion' or with the verb वद् 'to speak'. The word अच्छ is an indeclinable and has the force of the word अभि. As अच्छगत्य, अच्छगतम्, and यदच्छगच्छति. So also अच्छोद्य अच्छोदितम् and यदच्छवदति when not an Avyaya, we have उदकमच्छं गच्छति.

pk: The word adas that is caled gati when in conposition with a verb and not inplying a direction to another. The word upadesa neans a direction to another. When a person cogitates within hinselr and does not adres another, that is anupadesa. That is when it is not a denonstrative pronoun. as ada krtya, ada krtan and yadada karoti when used as a denonstrative pronoun we have ada krtva kanqan gata.
ck: the tort atas that is calet kati then in conposition tith a verp ant not inplyink a tirection to another. the tort upatesa neans a tirection to another. then a person cokitates tithin hinselr ant toes not atres another, that is anupatesa. that is then it is not a tenonstrative pronoun. as ata krtya, ata krtan ant yatata karoti then uset as a tenonstrative pronoun te have ata krtva kantan kata.
s: The word अदस् 'that' is called गति when in composition with a verb and not implying a direction to another. The word upadesa means a direction to another. When a person cogitates within himself and does not address another, that is anupadesa. That is when it is not a demonstrative pronoun. As अदः कृत्य, अदः कृतम् and यददः करोति when used as a demonstrative pronoun we have अदः कृत्वा काण्डं गतः.

pk: The word tiras when used in the sense or disapearance is caled gati when in conposition with a verb. as tiroBuya, tiroButan and yat tiroBavati why do we say when neaning disapearance? Observe tiro ButvasTita i.e., standing apart.
ck: the tort tiras then uset in the sense or tisapearance is calet kati then in conposition tith a verp. as tiropuya, tiroputan ant yat tiropavati thy to te say then neanink tisapearance? Opserve tiro putvastita i.e., stantink apart.
s: The word तिरस् when used in the sense of 'disappearance' is called गति when in composition with a verb. As तिरोभूय, तिरोभूतम् and यत् तिरोभवति why do we say when meaning disappearance? Observe तिरो भूत्वास्थितः i.e., standing apart.

pk: The word tiras disapearance is optionaly caled gati when the verb kr rolows. This is an elanple or prapta-viBasa. as tira krtya or tiraskrtya [8.3.42]: tira krtva or tiraskrtva [8.3.42]. The change or visarga into sa is optional [8.3.42]. When not neaning disapearance we have tira krtva kasWan tisWati he stands having laid aside the stick.
ck: the tort tiras tisapearance is optionaly calet kati then the verp kr rolots. this is an elanple or prapta-vipasa. as tira krtya or tiraskrtya [8.3.42]: tira krtva or tiraskrtva [8.3.42]. the chanke or visarka into sa is optional [8.3.42]. then not neanink tisapearance te have tira krtva kastan tistati he stants havink lait asite the stick.
s: The word तिरस् 'disappearance' is optionally called गति when the verb कृ follows. This is an example of प्राप्त-विभाषा. As तिरः कृत्य or तिरस्कृत्य [[8.3.42]]: तिरः कृत्वा or तिरस्कृत्वा [[8.3.42]]. The change of visarga into स is optional [[8.3.42]]. When not meaning disappearance we have तिरः कृत्वा काष्ठं तिष्ठति he stands having laid aside the stick.

pk: The words upaje and anavaje both neaning suporting or asisting the weak, are optionaly caled gati when used along with the verb kr as upaje krtya or upaje krtva having given suport. anvaje krtya or anvaje krtva.
ck: the torts upace ant anavace poth neanink suportink or asistink the teak, are optionaly calet kati then uset alonk tith the verp kr as upace krtya or upace krtva havink kiven suport. anvace krtya or anvace krtva.
s: The words उपाजे and अनवाजे both meaning 'supporting or assisting the weak', are optionally called गति when used along with the verb कृ As उपाजे कृत्य or उपाजे कृत्वा having given support. अन्वाजे कृत्य or अन्वाजे कृत्वा.

pk: The words saksat in the presence or etc. are optionaly caled gati when used along with the verb kr Vart:- in the words saksat &c. the rorce or the aril cvi is understod, nanely naking a thing what it was not berore, as saksat krtya or krtva niTyakrtye niTyakrtva naking evident what was concealed berore.
ck: the torts saksat in the presence or etc. are optionaly calet kati then uset alonk tith the verp kr Vart:- in the torts saksat &c. the rorce or the aril cvi is unterstot, nanely nakink a think that it tas not perore, as saksat krtya or krtva nityakrtye nityakrtva nakink evitent that tas concealet perore.
s: The words साक्षात् 'in the presence of' etc. are optionally called गति when used along with the verb कृ Vart:- In the words साक्षात् &c. the force of the affix च्वि is understood, namely making a thing what it was not before, As साक्षात् कृत्य or कृत्वा मिथ्याकृत्ये मिथ्याकृत्वा making evident what was concealed before.

pk: The word ursi in the breast and nanasi in the nind ae optionaly caled gati when the verb kr rolows, provided that they are not used in the sense or placing. as urasikrtya or urasikrtva; nanasikrtya or nanasikrtva. When it has the sense or placing we have urasikrtva panin sete he lies down having clasped the hand on the breast, nanasikrtva vacanan Dyayati he ponders having placed the word in his nind.
ck: the tort ursi in the preast ant nanasi in the nint ae optionaly calet kati then the verp kr rolots, provitet that they are not uset in the sense or placink. as urasikrtya or urasikrtva; nanasikrtya or nanasikrtva. then it has the sense or placink te have urasikrtva panin sete he lies totn havink claspet the hant on the preast, nanasikrtva vacanan tyayati he ponters havink placet the tort in his nint.
s: The word उर्सि 'in the breast' and मनसि 'in the mind' ae optionally called गति when the verb कृ follows, provided that they are not used in the sense of 'placing'. As उरसिकृत्य or उरसिकृत्वा; मनसिकृत्य or मनसिकृत्वा. When it has the sense of placing we have उरसिकृत्वा पाणिं शेते he lies down having clasped the hand on the breast, मनसिकृत्वा वचनं ध्यायति he ponders having placed the word in his mind.

pk: and the words naDye in the nidle, pade in the rot and nivacane spechles are optionaly caled gati , when kr rolows, the sense not being or placing. as naDye krtya or krtva. pade krtya or krtva; nivacane krtya or krtva. But when it has the neaning or placing we have hastina pade krtva sira sete he lies down having put his head under the rot or the elephant.
ck: ant the torts natye in the nitle, pate in the rot ant nivacane spechles are optionaly calet kati , then kr rolots, the sense not peink or placink. as natye krtya or krtva. pate krtya or krtva; nivacane krtya or krtva. put then it has the neanink or placink te have hastina pate krtva sira sete he lies totn havink put his heat unter the rot or the elephant.
s: And the words मध्ये 'in the middle', पदे 'in the foot' and निवचने 'speechless' are optionally called गति , when कृ follows, the sense not being of placing. As मध्ये कृत्य or कृत्वा. पदे कृत्य or कृत्वा; निवचने कृत्य or कृत्वा. But when it has the meaning of placing we have हस्तिनः पदे कृत्वा शिरः शेते he lies down having put his head under the foot of the elephant.

pk: The word haste in the hand, panO in the hand are always necesarily caled gati when used with the verb kr in the sense or nariage. as panO krtya or haste krtya having naried. But haste krtva karsapanan gata he went out having taken in his hand a karshapana (a coin).
ck: the tort haste in the hant, panO in the hant are altays necesarily calet kati then uset tith the verp kr in the sense or nariake. as panO krtya or haste krtya havink nariet. put haste krtva karsapanan kata he tent out havink taken in his hant a karshapana (a coin).
s: The word हस्ते 'in the hand', पाणौ 'in the hand' are always necessarily called गति when used with the verb कृ in the sense of 'marriage'. As पाणौ कृत्य or हस्ते कृत्य having married. But हस्ते कृत्वा कार्षापणं गतः he went out having taken in his hand a karshapana (a coin).

pk: The indeclinable word praDvan rolowed by the verb kr , is always caled gati when in used in the sense or binding. The word praDvan ends in n and neans ravourably suitably. When however it neans bound it is a gati: as, praDvankrtya having bound. But when not neaning to bind, we have :- praDvan krtva sakawan gata having nade the cariage agreable, he is gone.
ck: the inteclinaple tort pratvan rolotet py the verp kr , is altays calet kati then in uset in the sense or pintink. the tort pratvan ents in n ant neans ravouraply suitaply. then hotever it neans pount it is a kati: as, pratvankrtya havink pount. put then not neanink to pint, te have :- pratvan krtva sakatan kata havink nate the cariake akreaple, he is kone.
s: The indeclinable word प्रध्वम् followed by the verb कृ , is always called गति when in used in the sense of 'binding'. The word प्राध्वम् ends in म् and means 'favourably suitably.' When however it means 'bound' it is a gati: as, प्राध्वंकृत्य having bound. But when not meaning to bind, we have :- प्राध्वं कृत्वा शकटं गतः having made the carriage agreeable, he is gone.

pk: The words jivika and upanisad rolowed by the verb kr are caled gati when used in the sense or likenes and resenblance. as jivikakrtya having nade it as ir it was a neans or living; upanisatkrtya-having nade it like an upanishad. But jivika krtva gata having nade his livelihod he is gone.
ck: the torts civika ant upanisat rolotet py the verp kr are calet kati then uset in the sense or likenes ant resenplance. as civikakrtya havink nate it as ir it tas a neans or livink; upanisatkrtya-havink nate it like an upanishat. put civika krtva kata havink nate his livelihot he is kone.
s: The words जीविका and उपनिषद् followed by the verb कृ are called गति when used in the sense of 'likeness and resemblance'. As जीविकाकृत्य having made it as if it was a means of living; उपनिषत्कृत्य--having made it like an upanishad. But जीविका कृत्वा गतः having made his livelihood he is gone.

pk: The particles caled gati and upasarga are to be enployed berore the verbal rots (i.e. to say that they are preriles). The word te has ben enployed to include the tern upasarga also. The preceding elanples al ilustrate the aplication or this rule.
ck: the particles calet kati ant upasarka are to pe enployet perore the verpal rots (i.e. to say that they are preriles). the tort te has pen enployet to inclute the tern upasarka also. the precetink elanples al ilustrate the aplication or this rule.
s: The particles called गति and उपसर्ग are to be employed before the verbal roots (i.e. to say that they are prefixes). The word ते has been employed to include the term उपसर्ग also. The preceding examples all illustrate the application of this rule.

pk: in the Candas (Veda) these gati and upasarga are enployed indirerently arter the verbal rot, as wel as berore it. as.- vayavindrasca sunvata ayatanupaniskrtan naksvitTa Diya nara (nig.i.2.6). in this we have ayatanupa instead or upayatan vayu and thou indra, ye heroes, cone ye both quickly to the sona or the worshiper by this sincere prayer.
ck: in the cantas (Veta) these kati ant upasarka are enployet intirerently arter the verpal rot, as tel as perore it. as.- vayavintrasca sunvata ayatanupaniskrtan naksvita tiya nara (nik.i.2.6). in this te have ayatanupa insteat or upayatan vayu ant thou intra, ye heroes, cone ye poth tuickly to the sona or the torshiper py this sincere prayer.
s: In the छन्दस् (Veda) these गति and उपसर्ग are employed indifferently after the verbal root, as well as before it. As.-- वायविन्द्रश्च सुन्वत आयातमुपनिष्कृतम् मक्ष्वित्था धिया नरा (Rig.I.2.6). In this we have आयातमुप instead of उपायतम् 'vayu and thou Indra, ye heroes, come ye both quickly to the soma of the worshipper by this sincere prayer.'

pk: in the Candas (Veda) these gati and upasarga are also sen separated ron the verb by intervening words. as:- indra vayu ine suta upa prayoBiragatan indavo va nusantihi (nig. i.2.4). "indra and vayu, here are sona libations ror you. aproach, ye with pleasures ror us. ror the libations are desiring you." ere upa is separated ron the word agata by the intervening word prayoBi.
ck: in the cantas (Veta) these kati ant upasarka are also sen separatet ron the verp py intervenink torts. as:- intra vayu ine suta upa prayopirakatan intavo va nusantihi (nik. i.2.4). "intra ant vayu, here are sona lipations ror you. aproach, ye tith pleasures ror us. ror the lipations are tesirink you." ere upa is separatet ron the tort akata py the intervenink tort prayopi.
s: In the छन्दस् (Veda) these गति and उपसर्ग are also seen separated from the verb by intervening words. As:-- इन्द्र वायू इमे सुता उप प्रयोभिरागतम् इन्दवो वा मुशन्तिहि (Rig. I.2.4). "Indra and vayu, here are soma libations for you. Approach, ye with pleasures for us. For the libations are desiring you." Here उप is separated from the word आगत by the intervening word प्रयोभिः.

pk: ron this point as rar as aphorisn [1.4.97] treated or, are to be understod as having the nane or karna-pravacaniya These particles govern a substantive and qualiry a verb and direr ron other particles terned upasarga and gati. as sustutan Bavata wel praised by you. su siktan Bavata you have sprinkled. ere su is a karna pravachaniya and qualiries the sense or the verb, i. e. it is an adverb. it is not an upasarga, ror had it ben so, it would have changed the sa into sa [8.3.65]. The tern karna pravachaniya is a big tern conpared with other technical terns such as, wi, Gi, Gu &c., which generaly do not elced nore than two sylables. The word karnapravachaniya is not however nerely a technical tern; it contains within itselr a derinition or itselr. it neans that which qualities or speaks about (proktavanta) an action (karna) is so caled.
ck: ron this point as rar as aphorisn [1.4.97] treatet or, are to pe unterstot as havink the nane or karna-pravacaniya these particles kovern a supstantive ant tualiry a verp ant tirer ron other particles ternet upasarka ant kati. as sustutan pavata tel praiset py you. su siktan pavata you have sprinklet. ere su is a karna pravachaniya ant tualiries the sense or the verp, i. e. it is an atverp. it is not an upasarka, ror hat it pen so, it toult have chanket the sa into sa [8.3.65]. the tern karna pravachaniya is a pik tern conparet tith other technical terns such as, ti, ki, ku &c., thich keneraly to not elcet nore than to sylaples. the tort karnapravachaniya is not hotever nerely a technical tern; it contains tithin itselr a terinition or itselr. it neans that thich tualities or speaks apout (proktavanta) an action (karna) is so calet.
s: From this point as far as aphorism [[1.4.97]] treated of, are to be understood as having the name of कर्म-प्रवचनीय These particles govern a substantive and qualify a verb and differ from other particles termed upasarga and gati. As सुस्तुतं भवता well praised by you. सु सिक्तं भवता you have sprinkled. Here सु is a karma pravachaniya and qualifies the sense of the verb, i. e. it is an adverb. It is not an upasarga, for had it been so, it would have changed the स into ष [[8.3.65]]. The term karma pravachaniya is a big term compared with other technical terms such as, टि, घि, घु &c., which generally do not exceed more than two syllables. The word karmapravachaniya is not however merely a technical term; it contains within itself a definition of itself. It means that which qualities or speaks about (प्रोक्तवन्त) an action (कर्म) is so called.

pk: The word anu , when it denotes a sign, is caled karna-pravacaniya The word lakshana neans a sign; an atendant circunstance an invariable conconitant or acident in its logical sense and not nerely an ocasional concurence. The rorce or anu in this case is that or arter, in consequence or, because or, or being indicated by. as japananu pravarsan it rained arter or in consequence or the nutering or prayers. To put it in other words, anu is a karnapravachniya when it governs the word which indicates the cause or the atendant circunstance or an action. so also sakalasya sanhitananu pravarsat = sakalyena sukrtan sanhitananunisanya deva pravarsat. The God (clouds) rained having listened to the wel perorned reading, by sakalya. The rorce or a karnapravachaniya, thererore, when ruly analysed wil be round to be that or an upasarga whose verb is not elpresed in the sentence but is understod; and because or its being so understod, the particle itselr sens to govern the noun which in ract was governed by the unelpresed verb. Thus in the above elanple sanhitan is in the acusative case, aparently governed by the preposition anu, but realy governed by the verb anunisanya understod. so also anaqud yajnananvasincat. The Taurus sprinkled water arter the sacririce, agastyananvasincat praja the people began sprinkling water arter the rising or the canopus. Why nake unecesarily this sutra, when anu would have ben caled karna pravachaniya even by rorce or sutra [1.4.90] rolowing, where also the word lakshana ocurs? This is ror the sake or indicating that the karna pravachaniyas should always govern the acusative case [2.3.8] even in elpresing hetu [2.3.23]. Otherwise nule 23rd or the third chapter or Bok i would have set aside nule 8 or the sane by the nalin or paratva (1.3. 2): and would have caused a karana pravachaniya to govern an instrunental case where the sense was that or hetu.
ck: the tort anu , then it tenotes a sikn, is calet karna-pravacaniya the tort lakshana neans a sikn; an atentant circunstance an invariaple conconitant or acitent in its lokical sense ant not nerely an ocasional concurence. the rorce or anu in this case is that or arter, in consetuence or, pecause or, or peink inticatet py. as capananu pravarsan it rainet arter or in consetuence or the nuterink or prayers. to put it in other torts, anu is a karnapravachniya then it koverns the tort thich inticates the cause or the atentant circunstance or an action. so also sakalasya sanhitananu pravarsat = sakalyena sukrtan sanhitananunisanya teva pravarsat. the kot (clouts) rainet havink listenet to the tel perornet reatink, py sakalya. the rorce or a karnapravachaniya, thererore, then ruly analyset til pe rount to pe that or an upasarka those verp is not elpreset in the sentence put is unterstot; ant pecause or its peink so unterstot, the particle itselr sens to kovern the noun thich in ract tas kovernet py the unelpreset verp. thus in the apove elanple sanhitan is in the acusative case, aparently kovernet py the preposition anu, put realy kovernet py the verp anunisanya unterstot. so also anatut yacnananvasincat. the taurus sprinklet tater arter the sacririce, akastyananvasincat praca the people pekan sprinklink tater arter the risink or the canopus. thy nake unecesarily this sutra, then anu toult have pen calet karna pravachaniya even py rorce or sutra [1.4.90] rolotink, there also the tort lakshana ocurs? this is ror the sake or inticatink that the karna pravachaniyas shoult altays kovern the acusative case [2.3.8] even in elpresink hetu [2.3.23]. Othertise nule 23rt or the thirt chapter or pok i toult have set asite nule 8 or the sane py the nalin or paratva (1.3. 2): ant toult have causet a karana pravachaniya to kovern an instrunental case there the sense tas that or hetu.
s: The word अनु , when it denotes a sign, is called कर्म-प्रवचनीय The word lakshana means a sign; an attendant circumstance an invariable concomitant or accident in its logical sense and not merely an occasional concurrence. The force of अनु in this case is that of 'after,' 'in consequence of,' 'because of, or being indicated by.' As जपमनु प्रावर्षम् it rained after or in consequence of the muttering of prayers. To put it in other words, anu is a karmapravachniya when it governs the word which indicates the cause or the attendant circumstance of an action. So also शाकलस्य संहितामनु प्रावर्षत् = शाकल्येन सुकृतां संहितामनुनिशम्य देवः प्रावर्षत्. The God (clouds) rained having listened to the well performed reading, by Sakalya. The force of a karmapravachaniya, therefore, when fully analysed will be found to be that of an upasarga whose verb is not expressed in the sentence but is understood; and because of its being so understood, the particle itself seems to govern the noun which in fact was governed by the unexpressed verb. Thus in the above example संहितां is in the accusative case, apparently governed by the preposition अनु, but really governed by the verb अनुनिशम्य understood. So also अनडुद् यज्ञमन्वसिंचत्. The Taurus sprinkled water after the sacrifice, अगस्त्यमन्वसिंचत् प्रजाः the people began sprinkling water after the rising of the canopus. Why make unnecessarily this sutra, when अनु would have been called karma pravachaniya even by force of sutra [[1.4.90]] following, where also the word lakshana occurs? This is for the sake of indicating that the karma pravachaniyas should always govern the accusative case [[2.3.8]] even in expressing हेतु [[2.3.23]]. Otherwise Rule 23rd of the third chapter of Book II would have set aside Rule 8 of the same by the maxim of परत्व (1.3. 2): and would have caused a karana pravachaniya to govern an Instrumental case where the sense was that of hetu.

pk: The word anu , karna-pravacaniya when it has the rorce or the 3rd case. The neaning or anu in this case wil be that or with or along with. as nadinanu avasita sena the arny lying along side the river. parvatananu avasita sena lying along the slopes or the nountain.
ck: the tort anu , karna-pravacaniya then it has the rorce or the 3rt case. the neanink or anu in this case til pe that or tith or alonk tith. as natinanu avasita sena the arny lyink alonk site the river. parvatananu avasita sena lyink alonk the slopes or the nountain.
s: The word अनु , कर्म-प्रवचनीय when it has the force of the 3rd case. The meaning of अनु in this case will be that of 'with' or along with. As नदीमनु अवसिता सेना the army lying along side the river. पर्वतमनु अवसिता सेना lying along the slopes of the mountain.

pk: The word anu , karna-pravacaniya when it is used in the sense or inrerior or subordinate to. The word hina neans inrerior, and being a conparative tern requires the other tern with which conparison is nade and which is superior; to conplete the sense. in other words anu governs the person to which others are inrerior, in the acusative case. as anusakawayanavEyakarana al granarians are inrerior to sakatayana.
ck: the tort anu , karna-pravacaniya then it is uset in the sense or inrerior or suportinate to. the tort hina neans inrerior, ant peink a conparative tern retuires the other tern tith thich conparison is nate ant thich is superior; to conplete the sense. in other torts anu koverns the person to thich others are inrerior, in the acusative case. as anusakatayanavEyakarana al kranarians are inrerior to sakatayana.
s: The word अनु , कर्म-प्रवचनीय when it is used in the sense of 'inferior or subordinate to'. The word हीन means 'inferior,' and being a comparative term requires the other term with which comparison is made and which is superior; to complete the sense. In other words अनु governs the person to which others are inferior, in the accusative case. As अनुशाकटायनवैयाकरणाः 'all grammarians are inferior to Sakatayana.'

pk: The word upa when it neans superior or inrerior to is karna-pravacaniya That is when the sense is that or over, above, or inrerior as upaKaryan drona a Drona is above a khari. upa niske karsapana a karshapana is nore than a nishka. in this sense upa governs the Locative or the thing which is inrerior [2.3.9]. so also upa sakawayanan vEyakarana al granarians are inrerior to sakatayana. in this sense upa governs the acusative case.
ck: the tort upa then it neans superior or inrerior to is karna-pravacaniya that is then the sense is that or over, apove, or inrerior as upakaryan trona a trona is apove a khari. upa niske karsapana a karshapana is nore than a nishka. in this sense upa koverns the Locative or the think thich is inrerior [2.3.9]. so also upa sakatayanan vEyakarana al kranarians are inrerior to sakatayana. in this sense upa koverns the acusative case.
s: The word उप when it means 'superior' or 'inferior to' is कर्म-प्रवचनीय That is when the sense is that of 'over, above,' or 'inferior' as उपखार्यां द्रोणः a Drona is above a khari. उप निष्के कार्षापणः a karshapana is more than a Nishka. In this sense उप governs the Locative of the thing which is inferior [[2.3.9]]. So also उप शाकटायनं वैयाकरणाः 'all grammarians are inferior to Sakatayana.' In this sense उप governs the accusative case.

pk: The words apa and pari are karna-pravacaniya when neaning elclusion. The rorce or apa and pari is in this case that or with the elception or. as apatrigarteByo vrswo deva it rained outside or or with the elception or Trigarta. so also pari trigarteByo vrswodeva. in this sense they govern the noun elcluded in the ablative case [2.3.10]. When not having these senses, they are not karna-pravachaniya. as odanan parisincati. e waters the rice. ere it is an upasarga, and hence changes the sa into sa.
ck: the torts apa ant pari are karna-pravacaniya then neanink elclusion. the rorce or apa ant pari is in this case that or tith the elception or. as apatrikartepyo vrsto teva it rainet outsite or or tith the elception or trikarta. so also pari trikartepyo vrstoteva. in this sense they kovern the noun elclutet in the aplative case [2.3.10]. then not havink these senses, they are not karna-pravachaniya. as otanan parisincati. e taters the rice. ere it is an upasarka, ant hence chankes the sa into sa.
s: The words अप and परि are कर्म-प्रवचनीय when meaning 'exclusion'. The force of अप and परि is in this case that of 'with the exception of.' As अपत्रिगर्त्तेभ्यो वृष्टो देवः it rained outside of or with the exception of Trigarta. So also परि त्रिगर्तेभ्यो वृष्टोदेवः. In this sense they govern the noun excluded in the ablative case [[2.3.10]]. When not having these senses, they are not karma-pravachaniya. As ओदनं परिषिञ्चति. He waters the rice. Here it is an upasarga, and hence changes the स into ष.

pk: The word an as rar as, is karna-pravacaniya when it elpreses linit (e.g. when it neans as rar as inclusive or or as rar as elclusive or). The word vacana in the telt shows that both sorts or linits are here neant. as apawaliputrad vrswo deva it rained as rar as (but elcluding) Pataliputra apawaliputran vrswo deva it rained as rar as (including) Pataliputra akunaran yasa panine asankasyat, anaTuraya when it neans litle or is a verbal preril it does not get this nane.
ck: the tort an as rar as, is karna-pravacaniya then it elpreses linit (e.k. then it neans as rar as inclusive or or as rar as elclusive or). the tort vacana in the telt shots that poth sorts or linits are here neant. as apataliputrat vrsto teva it rainet as rar as (put elclutink) pataliputra apataliputran vrsto teva it rainet as rar as (inclutink) pataliputra akunaran yasa panine asankasyat, anaturaya then it neans litle or is a verpal preril it toes not ket this nane.
s: The word आङ् 'as far as', is कर्म-प्रवचनीय when it expresses limit (e.g. when it means 'as far as inclusive of' or 'as far as exclusive of'). The word वचन in the text shows that both sorts of limits are here meant. As आपाटलिपुत्राद् वृष्टो देवः it rained as far as (but excluding) Pataliputra आपाटलिपुत्रं वृष्टो देवः it rained as far as (including) Pataliputra आकुमारं यशः पाणिनेः आसांकाश्यात्, आमथुरायाः when it means 'little' or is a verbal prefix it does not get this name.

pk: The words prati , pari and anu are karna-pravacaniya when used in the sense or sign (in the direction or) , nere statenent or circunstances (as regards), division, share or and pervasion, severaly. as (1) vrksan prati-pari or anu vidyotate vidyut the lightening is rlashing in the direction or the tre. (2) saDurdevadato nataran prati—pari = anu Devadata is a god nan as regards his nother. (3) haran prati halahalan the poison rel to the share or ara. yadatranan prati syat that it nay ral to ny share. so with pari and anu. (4) vrksan vrksan prati sincati he sprinkles one tre arter another. so with pari and anu.
ck: the torts prati , pari ant anu are karna-pravacaniya then uset in the sense or sikn (in the tirection or) , nere statenent or circunstances (as rekarts), tivision, share or ant pervasion, severaly. as (1) vrksan prati-pari or anu vityotate vityut the likhtenink is rlashink in the tirection or the tre. (2) saturtevatato nataran prati—pari = anu tevatata is a kot nan as rekarts his nother. (3) haran prati halahalan the poison rel to the share or ara. yatatranan prati syat that it nay ral to ny share. so tith pari ant anu. (4) vrksan vrksan prati sincati he sprinkles one tre arter another. so tith pari ant anu.
s: The words प्रति , परि and अनु are कर्म-प्रवचनीय when used in the sense of 'sign' ('in the direction of') , 'mere statement of circumstances' ('as regards'), 'division', 'share of' and 'pervasion', severally. As (1) वृक्षं प्रति-परि or अनु विद्योतते विद्युत् 'the lightening is flashing in the direction of the tree.' (2) साधुर्देवदत्तो मातरं प्रति—परि = अनु 'Devadatta is a good man as regards his mother.' (3) हरं प्रति हलाहलं 'the poison fell to the share of Hara.' यदत्रमां प्रति स्यात् that it may fall to my share. So with परि and अनु. (4) वृक्षं वृक्षं प्रति सिञ्चति he sprinkles one tree after another. So with परि and अनु.

pk: The word aBi is karna-pravacaniya when used in the above senses or in the direction or, as regards, and each severaly, but not when it neans division, share or. The ilustrations given under the last sutra nutus nutandi aply here also, with the elception or those given under head (4). as vrksanaBi vidyotate; nataranaBi &c. But it is not karna-pravachaniya when Baga is neant. Baga neans the share which is aloted to one as his own. as yadatrananaBisyat tad diyatan give that which rals here to ny share. ere abhi is an upasarga, and thererore sa or sya is changed into sa.
ck: the tort api is karna-pravacaniya then uset in the apove senses or in the tirection or, as rekarts, ant each severaly, put not then it neans tivision, share or. the ilustrations kiven unter the last sutra nutus nutanti aply here also, tith the elception or those kiven unter heat (4). as vrksanapi vityotate; nataranapi &c. put it is not karna-pravachaniya then paka is neant. paka neans the share thich is alotet to one as his otn. as yatatrananapisyat tat tiyatan kive that thich rals here to ny share. ere aphi is an upasarka, ant thererore sa or sya is chanket into sa.
s: The word अभि is कर्म-प्रवचनीय when used in the above senses of 'in the direction of', 'as regards', and 'each severally', but not when it means 'division', 'share of'. The illustrations given under the last sutra mutus mutandi apply here also, with the exception of those given under head (4). As वृक्षमभि विद्योतते; मातरमभि &c. But it is not karma-pravachaniya when भाग is meant. भाग means the share which is allotted to one as his own. As यदत्रममाभिष्यात् तद् दीयताम् give that which falls here to my share. Here abhi is an upasarga, and therefore स of स्य is changed into ष.

pk: The word prati is karna -pravacaniya when used in the sense or representative (representative or) or elchange (in elchange ror). That which is like to the principal is caled pratiniDi. Giving in return ror what is obtained, is pratidana. as aBinanyurarjunata prati abhi-nanyu is the representative or arjuna. nasanasnE tileBya pratiyacCati he elchanges nashas ror these sesanun. in these senses prati governs the ablative [2.3.1]
ck: the tort prati is karna -pravacaniya then uset in the sense or representative (representative or) or elchanke (in elchanke ror). that thich is like to the principal is calet pratiniti. kivink in return ror that is optainet, is pratitana. as apinanyurarcunata prati aphi-nanyu is the representative or arcuna. nasanasnE tilepya pratiyacati he elchankes nashas ror these sesanun. in these senses prati koverns the aplative [2.3.1]
s: The word प्रति is कर्म -प्रवचनीय when used in the sense of representative ('representative of') or exchange ('in exchange for'). That which is like to the principal is called प्रतिनिधि. Giving in return for what is obtained, is प्रतिदान. As अभिमन्युरर्जुनतः प्रति Abhi-manyu is the representative of Arjuna. माषानस्मै तिलेभ्यः प्रतियच्छति he exchanges Mashas for these sesamum. In these senses prati governs the Ablative [[2.3.11]]

pk: The words aDi and pari are karna-pravacaniya when used as nere elpletives. as kutoByagacCati whence has he cone? Or kuta parya gacCati. These words though nere surplusages, have ben caled karnapravachaniya so that they nay not get the designation or upasarga or gati and thus produce results peculiar to those words.
ck: the torts ati ant pari are karna-pravacaniya then uset as nere elpletives. as kutopyakacati thence has he cone? Or kuta parya kacati. these torts thoukh nere surplusakes, have pen calet karnapravachaniya so that they nay not ket the tesiknation or upasarka or kati ant thus protuce results peculiar to those torts.
s: The words अधि and परि are कर्म-प्रवचनीय when used as mere expletives. As कुतोऽभ्यागच्छति whence has he come? Or कुतः पर्या गच्छति. These words though mere surplusages, have been called karmapravachaniya so that they may not get the designation of upasarga or gati and thus produce results peculiar to those words.

pk: The word su is karna-pravacaniya when used in the sense or respect, (when it neans elcelently). as susiktan Bavata, su stutan Bavata elcelently sprinkled by your honor. Wel praised by your honor. By not sa being an upasarga, it does not change the sa into [8.3.65]. Why do we say when respect is neant? Observe susiktan kin tavatra has this your place ben wel sprinkled to-day.
ck: the tort su is karna-pravacaniya then uset in the sense or respect, (then it neans elcelently). as susiktan pavata, su stutan pavata elcelently sprinklet py your honor. tel praiset py your honor. py not sa peink an upasarka, it toes not chanke the sa into [8.3.65]. thy to te say then respect is neant? Opserve susiktan kin tavatra has this your place pen tel sprinklet to-tay.
s: The word सु is कर्म-प्रवचनीय when used in the sense of respect, (when it means 'excellently'). As सुसिक्तं भवता, सु स्तुतं भवता excellently sprinkled by your honor. Well praised by your honor. By not ष being an upasarga, it does not change the स into [[8.3.65]]. Why do we say 'when respect is meant'? Observe सुषिक्तं किं तवात्र has this your place been well sprinkled to-day.

pk: The word ati in the sense or super-abundance (elcesively) and elcelently is karna-pravacaniya The word atikranana neans to do nore than what is necesary ror the aconplishnent or an object. The rorce or ca in the aphorisn is to draw in the word pujayan ron the last. as atisiktaneva Bavata. it has abundantly ben sprinkled by your honor, atistutaniva Bavata so also atistutan Bavata elcelently praised by your honor. ati siktan Bavata.
ck: the tort ati in the sense or super-apuntance (elcesively) ant elcelently is karna-pravacaniya the tort atikranana neans to to nore than that is necesary ror the aconplishnent or an opcect. the rorce or ca in the aphorisn is to trat in the tort pucayan ron the last. as atisiktaneva pavata. it has apuntantly pen sprinklet py your honor, atistutaniva pavata so also atistutan pavata elcelently praiset py your honor. ati siktan pavata.
s: The word अति in the sense of super-abundance ('excessively') and 'excellently' is कर्म-प्रवचनीय The word अतिक्रमण means to do more than what is necessary for the accomplishment of an object. The force of च in the aphorism is to draw in the word पूजायाम् from the last. As अतिसिक्तमेवा भवता. It has abundantly been sprinkled by your honor, अतिस्तुतमिव भवता so also अतिस्तुतं भवता excellently praised by your honor. अति सिक्तं भवता.

pk: The word api is karna-pravacaniya when it inplies, the sense or word understod (sonewhat) or posibility (e.g. even in the sense or such a great person), or pernision to do as one likes, (ir you like), or censure (even in the sense or what is disgracerul); or colection (and). The word padarTa neans the sense or another word which is not elpresed but has to be suplied. as sarpisopi syat there nay be perhaps a drop or ghe naDunopi syat. ere sone word like vindu a drop, stoka a litle natra, a neasure &c., has to be understod. The word sanBavana neans posibility, a suposition. as, api sincet nulakasahasran ksanenEkena posibly nay sprinkle a thousand tres in one nonent; api stuyad rajanan he nay praise posibly, a king. in the above cases it is used with the potential nod. anvasarga neans indirerence on the part or the speaker where he pernits another to do as he likes. it is used with the inperative nod. as api sinca you nay sprinkle ir you like. api stuhi you nay praise ir you like. The word garha neans censure, contenpt or repror. as Dikjalnan devadatanapi sincet palanqun. The word sanucaya neans cunulative. as api stuhi—api sinca praise as wel as sprinkle. in al the above instances, the word not being an upasarga, does not change the sa into sa.
ck: the tort api is karna-pravacaniya then it inplies, the sense or tort unterstot (sonethat) or posipility (e.k. even in the sense or such a kreat person), or pernision to to as one likes, (ir you like), or censure (even in the sense or that is tiskracerul); or colection (ant). the tort patarta neans the sense or another tort thich is not elpreset put has to pe supliet. as sarpisopi syat there nay pe perhaps a trop or khe natunopi syat. ere sone tort like vintu a trop, stoka a litle natra, a neasure &c., has to pe unterstot. the tort sanpavana neans posipility, a suposition. as, api sincet nulakasahasran ksanenEkena posiply nay sprinkle a thousant tres in one nonent; api stuyat racanan he nay praise posiply, a kink. in the apove cases it is uset tith the potential not. anvasarka neans intirerence on the part or the speaker there he pernits another to to as he likes. it is uset tith the inperative not. as api sinca you nay sprinkle ir you like. api stuhi you nay praise ir you like. the tort karha neans censure, contenpt or repror. as tikcalnan tevatatanapi sincet palantun. the tort sanucaya neans cunulative. as api stuhi—api sinca praise as tel as sprinkle. in al the apove instances, the tort not peink an upasarka, toes not chanke the sa into sa.
s: The word अपि is कर्म-प्रवचनीय when it implies, the sense of word 'understood' ('somewhat') or 'possibility' (e.g. 'even' in the sense of such a great person), or permission to do as one likes, ('if you like'), or censure ('even' in the sense of what is disgraceful); or collection ('and'). The word पदार्थ means the sense of another word which is not expressed but has to be supplied. As सर्पिषोऽपि स्यात् there may be perhaps a drop of ghee मधुनोऽपि स्यात्. Here some word like vindu 'a drop,' stoka 'a little' matra, 'a measure' &c., has to be understood. The word संभावन means possibility, a supposition. As, अपि सिंचेत् मूलकसहस्रं क्षणेनैकेन possibly may sprinkle a thousand trees in one moment; अपि स्तुयाद् राजानं he may praise possibly, a king. In the above cases it is used with the potential mood. अन्वसर्ग means indifference on the part of the speaker where he permits another to do as he likes. It is used with the Imperative mood. As अपि सिंच you may sprinkle if you like. अपि स्तुहि you may praise if you like. The word गर्हा means censure, contempt or reproof. As धिक्जाल्मं देवदत्तमपि सिंचेत् पलाण्डुम्. The word समुच्चय means cumulative. As अपि स्तुहि—अपि सिंच praise as well as sprinkle. In all the above instances, the word not being an upasarga, does not change the स into ष.

pk: The words aDi is karna-pravacaniya when used in the sense or lord (being as a lord or having as a lord) The word isvara neans naster, and it thererore requires another corelative word denoting property or which one is naster. The word adhi governs a Locative case. sonetines locative or the person posesing, sonetine locative or the property posesed: as aDi brahnadate pancala or aDi pancalesu brahnadata. Brahnadata rules over Panchalas.
ck: the torts ati is karna-pravacaniya then uset in the sense or lort (peink as a lort or havink as a lort) the tort isvara neans naster, ant it thererore retuires another corelative tort tenotink property or thich one is naster. the tort athi koverns a Locative case. sonetines locative or the person posesink, sonetine locative or the property poseset: as ati prahnatate pancala or ati pancalesu prahnatata. prahnatata rules over panchalas.
s: The words अधि is कर्म-प्रवचनीय when used in the sense of 'lord' ('being as a lord' or 'having as a lord') The word ईश्वर means 'master,' and it therefore requires another correlative word denoting 'property' of which one is master. The word adhi governs a Locative case. Sometimes locative of the person possessing, sometime locative of the property possessed: as अधि ब्रह्मदत्ते पंचालाः or अधि पंचालेषु ब्रह्मदत्तः. Brahmadatta rules over Panchalas.

pk: The words aDi is optionaly karna-pravacaniya when the verb kr rolows. as yadatra nanaDi karisyati. ere the word aDi nay be treated either as a gati or a karnapravacaniya. When it is a gati the acent wil be regulated by sutra. [8.1.71]; otherwise not.
ck: the torts ati is optionaly karna-pravacaniya then the verp kr rolots. as yatatra nanati karisyati. ere the tort ati nay pe treatet either as a kati or a karnapravacaniya. then it is a kati the acent til pe rekulatet py sutra. [8.1.71]; othertise not.
s: The words अधि is optionally कर्म-प्रवचनीय when the verb कृ follows. As यदत्र मामधि करिष्यति. Here the word अधि may be treated either as a गति or a कर्मप्रवचनीय. When it is a गति the accent will be regulated by Sutra. [[8.1.71]]; otherwise not.

pk: The substitutes or la are caled parasnEpada The word la is in the genitive case, and neans or la. The word adesa substitutes nust be suplied to conplete the sense. The tern la is a generic word ror verb in general, vis., law, liw, luw, lrw, lew, low, lan, lin, lun, lrn. The substitutes or la are the wel known personal terninations by which the verbs are conjugated in those tenses. nanely the rolowing. PanasnaiPaDa. - 3rd person - tip, tas, Ji - 2nd person - sip, Tas, Ta - 1st person - nip, vas, nas and the ariles satr and kvasu [3.2.107], and [3.2.124], and [3.4.78].
ck: the supstitutes or la are calet parasnEpata the tort la is in the kenitive case, ant neans or la. the tort atesa supstitutes nust pe supliet to conplete the sense. the tern la is a keneric tort ror verp in keneral, vis., lat, lit, lut, lrt, let, lot, lan, lin, lun, lrn. the supstitutes or la are the tel knotn personal terninations py thich the verps are concukatet in those tenses. nanely the rolotink. panasnaipata. - 3rt person - tip, tas, ci - 2nt person - sip, tas, ta - 1st person - nip, vas, nas ant the ariles satr ant kvasu [3.2.107], ant [3.2.124], ant [3.4.78].
s: The substitutes of ल are called परस्मैपद The word लः is in the genitive case, and means 'of ल.' The word आदेश 'substitutes' must be supplied to complete the sense. The term ल is a generic word for verb in general, viz., लट्, लिट्, लुट्, लृट्, लेट्, लोट्, लङ्, लिङ्, लुङ्, लृङ्. The substitutes of ल are the well known personal terminations by which the verbs are conjugated in those tenses. Namely the following. PARASMAIPADA. - 3rd person - तिप्, तस्, झि - 2nd person - सिप्, थस्, थ - 1st person - मिप्, वस्, मस् And the affixes शतृ and क्वसु [[3.2.107]], and [[3.2.124]], and [[3.4.78]].

pk: The nine ariles conprised under the pratyahara - tan and the two ending in ana (sanac and kanac), which are substitutes or la are caled atnanepada The rolowing are the atnanepada ariles:- - 3rd person - ta, atan, Ja - 2nd person - Tas, aTan, Dvan - 1st person - iw, vahi, nahin and the ariles Bava and jnana [3.2.106],
ck: the nine ariles conpriset unter the pratyahara - tan ant the to entink in ana (sanac ant kanac), thich are supstitutes or la are calet atnanepata the rolotink are the atnanepata ariles:- - 3rt person - ta, atan, ca - 2nt person - tas, atan, tvan - 1st person - it, vahi, nahin ant the ariles pava ant cnana [3.2.106],
s: The nine affixes comprised under the प्रत्याहार - तङ् and the two ending in आन (शानच् and कानच्), which are substitutes of ल are called आत्मनेपद The following are the Atmanepada affixes:-- - 3rd person - त, आताम्, झ - 2nd person - थास्, आथाम्, ध्वम् - 1st person - इट्, वहि, महिङ् And the affixes भाव and ज्ञान [[3.2.106]],

pk: The thre triads in both the sets parasnEpada and atnanepada , or conjugational ariles (conprised under the general nane tin , a pratyahara rorned or the rirst and last or then, vis. tip and nahin) are caled, in order, Lowest - 3rd Person or European Granar, nidle -2nd Person, and ighest -1st Person. Or the 19 conjugational ariles, above given; 9 are Parasnaipadi and 9 are atnanepadi. Each or these two clases is subdivided into thre clases, acording to person, as shown in the above list.
ck: the thre triats in poth the sets parasnEpata ant atnanepata , or concukational ariles (conpriset unter the keneral nane tin , a pratyahara rornet or the rirst ant last or then, vis. tip ant nahin) are calet, in orter, Lotest - 3rt person or European kranar, nitle -2nt person, ant ikhest -1st person. Or the 19 concukational ariles, apove kiven; 9 are parasnaipati ant 9 are atnanepati. Each or these to clases is suptivitet into thre clases, acortink to person, as shotn in the apove list.
s: The three triads in both the sets परस्मैपद and आत्मनेपद , of conjugational affixes (comprised under the general name तिङ् , a प्रत्यहार formed of the first and last of them, viz. तिप् and महिङ्) are called, in order, Lowest - 3rd Person of European Grammar, Middle -2nd Person, and Highest -1st Person. Of the 19 conjugational affixes, above given; 9 are Parasmaipadi and 9 are Atmanepadi. Each of these two classes is subdivided into three classes, according to person, as shown in the above list.

pk: Or sup (which is a pratyahara rorned or su the rirst or the case ariles and the rinal p or the last or then), the elpresions in each sucesive set or the thre, are also severaly caled singular, dual and plural. The sup or the case-ariles by which nouns are declined are 21 in nunber coresponding to the seven cases, se sutra [4.1.2]. They also have thre nunbers singular, dual and plural.
ck: Or sup (thich is a pratyahara rornet or su the rirst or the case ariles ant the rinal p or the last or then), the elpresions in each sucesive set or the thre, are also severaly calet sinkular, tual ant plural. the sup or the case-ariles py thich nouns are teclinet are 21 in nunper corespontink to the seven cases, se sutra [4.1.2]. they also have thre nunpers sinkular, tual ant plural.
s: Of सुप् (which is a प्रत्याहार formed of सु the first of the case affixes and the final प् of the last of them), the expressions in each successive set of the three, are also severally called singular, dual and plural. The sup or the case-affixes by which nouns are declined are 21 in number corresponding to the seven cases, see sutra [[4.1.2]]. They also have three numbers singular, dual and plural.

pk: The triads or conjugational ariles and case ariles are also caled viBakti or inrlective ariles. The word viBakti neans a conplete triad. Thus saptani viBakti neans the thre ariles or the seventh case, i.e., the locative singular, dual, and plural. so praTana viBakti neans the third person, singular, dual, and plural.
ck: the triats or concukational ariles ant case ariles are also calet vipakti or inrlective ariles. the tort vipakti neans a conplete triat. thus saptani vipakti neans the thre ariles or the seventh case, i.e., the locative sinkular, tual, ant plural. so pratana vipakti neans the thirt person, sinkular, tual, ant plural.
s: The triads of conjugational affixes and case affixes are also called विभक्ति or Inflective affixes. The word विभक्ति means a complete triad. Thus सप्तमी विभक्ति means the three affixes of the seventh case, i.e., the locative singular, dual, and plural. So प्रथमा विभक्ति means the third person, singular, dual, and plural.

pk: When the pronoun yusnad thou understod, and also when the sane elpresed, is the atendant word in the agrenent with the verb, then there is the verbal ternination caled the nidle (2nd person). This derines the 2nd person or conjugational ariles. as tvan pacasi thou cokest or pacasi; yuvan pacaTa or pacaTa you two are coking; yuyan pacaTa or pacaTa you cok.
ck: then the pronoun yusnat thou unterstot, ant also then the sane elpreset, is the atentant tort in the akrenent tith the verp, then there is the verpal ternination calet the nitle (2nt person). this terines the 2nt person or concukational ariles. as tvan pacasi thou cokest or pacasi; yuvan pacata or pacata you to are cokink; yuyan pacata or pacata you cok.
s: When the pronoun युष्मद् 'thou' understood, and also when the same expressed, is the attendant word in the agreement with the verb, then there is the verbal termination called the middle (2nd person). This defines the 2nd person of conjugational affixes. As त्वं पचसि thou cookest or पचसि; युवां पचथः or पचथः you two are cooking; यूयं पचथ or पचथ you cook.

pk: When joke is inplied with rererence to an action, the verb denoting it is used in the 2nd person; provided that the word nanya to think is the atendant word (upapada) or such verb and or the verb nanya itselr, the aril nust be or the 1st person and singular nunber. The word prahasa neans joke, sport. as evan nanye odanan Boksyase iti; nahi Boksyase, Bukta sotiTini. Thus thou thinkest i shal eat rice, thou shalt not eat, that has ben eaten by a guest. ehi nanye raTena yasyasi nahi yasyasi, yatastena te pita. i think thou wilt go by the chariot, no, thou wilt not, thy rather has gone berore the on it. When joke is not intended, the proper persons should be used: as, ehi nanyase odanan Boksye. Thus thou thinkest i shal eat rice.
ck: then coke is inpliet tith rererence to an action, the verp tenotink it is uset in the 2nt person; provitet that the tort nanya to think is the atentant tort (upapata) or such verp ant or the verp nanya itselr, the aril nust pe or the 1st person ant sinkular nunper. the tort prahasa neans coke, sport. as evan nanye otanan poksyase iti; nahi poksyase, pukta sotitini. thus thou thinkest i shal eat rice, thou shalt not eat, that has pen eaten py a kuest. ehi nanye ratena yasyasi nahi yasyasi, yatastena te pita. i think thou tilt ko py the chariot, no, thou tilt not, thy rather has kone perore the on it. then coke is not intentet, the proper persons shoult pe uset: as, ehi nanyase otanan poksye. thus thou thinkest i shal eat rice.
s: When joke is implied with reference to an action, the verb denoting it is used in the 2nd person; provided that the word मन्य 'to think' is the attendant word (उपपद) of such verb and of the verb मन्य itself, the affix must be of the 1st person and singular number. The word प्रहास means joke, sport. As एवं मन्ये ओदनं भोक्ष्यसे इति; नहि भोक्ष्यसे, भुक्तः सोऽतिथिमिः. Thus thou thinkest 'I shall eat rice,' thou shalt not eat, that has been eaten by a guest. एहि मन्ये रथेन यास्यसि नहि यास्यसि, यातस्तेन ते पिता. I think thou wilt go by the chariot, no, thou wilt not, thy father has gone before thee on it. When joke is not intended, the proper persons should be used: as, एहि मन्यसे ओदनं भोक्ष्ये. Thus thou thinkest 'I shall eat rice.'

pk: When the pronoun asnad i, understod and also when elpresed, is the atendant word in agrenent with the verb, then there is the verbal ternination caled the ighest or 1st person. This is clear. as ahan pacani i cok, or nerely pacani-avan pacava or nerely pacava.
ck: then the pronoun asnat i, unterstot ant also then elpreset, is the atentant tort in akrenent tith the verp, then there is the verpal ternination calet the ikhest or 1st person. this is clear. as ahan pacani i cok, or nerely pacani-avan pacava or nerely pacava.
s: When the pronoun अस्मद् 'I', understood and also when expressed, is the attendant word in agreement with the verb, then there is the verbal termination called the Highest or 1st person. This is clear. As अहं पचामि I cook, or merely पचामि-आवां पचावः or merely पचावः.

pk: in the other cases, vis. where thou or i are not the atendant words in agrenent with the verb, there is the verbal ternination caled the Lowest (3rd person). as pacati he coks, pacata they two cok. pacanti they cok.
ck: in the other cases, vis. there thou or i are not the atentant torts in akrenent tith the verp, there is the verpal ternination calet the Lotest (3rt person). as pacati he coks, pacata they to cok. pacanti they cok.
s: In the other cases, viz. where 'thou' or 'I' are not the attendant words in agreement with the verb, there is the verbal termination called the Lowest (3rd person). As पचति he cooks, पचतः they two cook. पचन्ति they cook.

pk: The closest prolinity or leters, there being the intervention or halr a natra or prosodial length betwen then, is caled contact or sanhita When words are in sanhita, they are glued together by the rules or sandhi. as dadDyatra = daDi + atra.
ck: the closest prolinity or leters, there peink the intervention or halr a natra or prosotial lenkth peten then, is calet contact or sanhita then torts are in sanhita, they are kluet tokether py the rules or santhi. as tatyatra = tati + atra.
s: The closest proximity of letters, there being the intervention of half a मात्रा or prosodial length between them, is called contact or संहिता When words are in sanhita, they are glued together by the rules of sandhi. As दद्ध्यत्र = दधि + अत्र.

pk: a rule which relates to conplete words (and not to the rots out or which the words are constructed) is to be understod to aply only to those words the senses or which are conected. This is a paribháshá or interpreting aphorisn. Where ever in this Granar a padaviDi is round, that nust be understod to aply to sanarTa words. a rule relating to pada or conplete words is caled padaviDi. The word viDi is rorned by ading vi to the rot Dan; that which is ordained (viDiyate) is caled viDi. What are those rules which are ordained with regard to conplete words? They are as rolows.-(1) nules relating to sanasa or conpounding or words; (2) nules relating to viBakti or the aplication or declensional and conjugational ariles; (3) and the rule by which one word is considered as ir it had becone a constituent nenber or another word (parangavad Bava). The word sanarTa neans capable; that is to say, that which is capable or elpresing the sense or a sentence on analysis, is caled sanarTa ; or the word/ sanarTa nay nean that which depends upon words as conected in sense; that is to say, a rule relating to words whose senses are conected together. Thus it wil be taught in sútra 24 a word ending with the second case-aril is optionaly conpounded with the words srita, atita &c. and rorns tatpurusha conpound; as, kaswan srita = kaswasrita who has had recourse to pain. But when these words are not sanarTa or conected in sense there can be no conpounding; as, pasya devadata kaswan, srito visnunitro gurukulan se O Devadata, the pain, Vishnunitra has taken recourse to his teachers house. ere the words kaswan and sritan though read in jultaposition are not conpounded, as they are not sanarTa. sinilarly, it wil be taught in sútra 30 a word coding with the 3rd case-aril is optionaly conpounded with what denotes that the quality or which is instrunentaly caused by the thing signiried by what ends with the 3rd case-aril and with the word arTa wealth; as, sankulaya + Kanqa = sankulaKanqa a piece cut by nipers. ere also when the words are not conected in sense there is no conposition; as, karisyasi sankulaya, Kanqo devadata upalena thou shal do it with the nipers, Devadata is cut by the stones. sinilarly, sútra 36 declares, a word ending with the 4th case-aril, is conpounded optionaly with what denotes that which is ror the purpose or what ends with the 4th case-aril, and so to with the words, arTa, bali &c. Thus yupaya + daru = yupadaru wod ror a stake. But when these words are not conected
ck: a rule thich relates to conplete torts (ant not to the rots out or thich the torts are constructet) is to pe unterstot to aply only to those torts the senses or thich are conectet. this is a paripháshá or interpretink aphorisn. there ever in this kranar a pataviti is rount, that nust pe unterstot to aply to sanarta torts. a rule relatink to pata or conplete torts is calet pataviti. the tort viti is rornet py atink vi to the rot tan; that thich is ortainet (vitiyate) is calet viti. that are those rules thich are ortainet tith rekart to conplete torts? they are as rolots.-(1) nules relatink to sanasa or conpountink or torts; (2) nules relatink to vipakti or the aplication or teclensional ant concukational ariles; (3) ant the rule py thich one tort is consiteret as ir it hat pecone a constituent nenper or another tort (parankavat pava). the tort sanarta neans capaple; that is to say, that thich is capaple or elpresink the sense or a sentence on analysis, is calet sanarta ; or the tort/ sanarta nay nean that thich tepents upon torts as conectet in sense; that is to say, a rule relatink to torts those senses are conectet tokether. thus it til pe taukht in sútra 24 a tort entink tith the secont case-aril is optionaly conpountet tith the torts srita, atita &c. ant rorns tatpurusha conpount; as, kastan srita = kastasrita tho has hat recourse to pain. put then these torts are not sanarta or conectet in sense there can pe no conpountink; as, pasya tevatata kastan, srito visnunitro kurukulan se O tevatata, the pain, Vishnunitra has taken recourse to his teachers house. ere the torts kastan ant sritan thoukh reat in cultaposition are not conpountet, as they are not sanarta. sinilarly, it til pe taukht in sútra 30 a tort cotink tith the 3rt case-aril is optionaly conpountet tith that tenotes that the tuality or thich is instrunentaly causet py the think sikniriet py that ents tith the 3rt case-aril ant tith the tort arta tealth; as, sankulaya + kanta = sankulakanta a piece cut py nipers. ere also then the torts are not conectet in sense there is no conposition; as, karisyasi sankulaya, kanto tevatata upalena thou shal to it tith the nipers, tevatata is cut py the stones. sinilarly, sútra 36 teclares, a tort entink tith the 4th case-aril, is conpountet optionaly tith that tenotes that thich is ror the purpose or that ents tith the 4th case-aril, ant so to tith the torts, arta, pali &c. thus yupaya + taru = yupataru tot ror a stake. put then these torts are not conectet
s: A rule which relates to complete words (and not to the roots out of which the words are constructed) is to be understood to apply only to those words the senses of which are connected. This is a paribháshá or interpreting aphorism. Where ever in this Grammar a पदविधि is found, that must be understood to apply to समर्थ words. A rule relating to पद or complete words is called पदविधि. The word विधि is formed by adding वि to the root धाम्; that which is ordained (विधीयते) is called विधि. What are those rules which are ordained with regard to complete words? They are as follows.-(1) Rules relating to समास or compounding of words; (2) Rules relating to विभक्ति or the application of declensional and conjugational affixes; (3) and the rule by which one word is considered as if it had become a constituent member of another word (पराङ्गवद् भाव). The word समर्थ means capable; that is to say, that which is capable of expressing the sense of a sentence on analysis, is called समर्थ ; or the word/ समर्थ may mean that which depends upon words as connected in sense; that is to say, a rule relating to words whose senses are connected together. Thus it will be taught in sútra 24 'a word ending with the second case-affix is optionally compounded with the words श्रित, अतीत &c. and forms tatpurusha compound;' as, कष्टं श्रितः = कष्टश्रितः 'who has had recourse to pain'. But when these words are not समर्थ or connected in sense there can be no compounding; as, पश्य देवदत्त कष्टं, श्रितो विष्णुमित्रो गुरुकुलम् see O Devadatta, the pain, Vishnumitra has taken recourse to his teacher's house. Here the words कष्टं and श्रितं though read in juxtaposition are not compounded, as they are not समर्थ. Similarly, it will be taught in sútra 30 'a word coding with the 3rd case-affix is optionally compounded with what denotes that the quality of which is instrumentally caused by the thing signified by what ends with the 3rd case-affix and with the word अर्थ wealth; as, शङ्कुलया + खण्डः = शङ्कुलाखण्डः 'a piece cut by nippers.' Here also when the words are not connected in sense there is no composition; as, करिष्यसि शङ्कुलया, खण्डो देवदत्त उपलेन 'thou shall do it with the nippers, Devadatta is cut by the stones.' Similarly, sútra 36 declares, ' a word ending with the 4th case-affix, is compounded optionally with what denotes that which is for the purpose of what ends with the 4th case-affix, and so too with the words, अर्थ, बलि &c. Thus यूपाय + दारु = यूपदारु' wood for a stake.' But when these words are not connected in sense, there is no composition; as, गच्छ त्वं यूपाय,दारु देवदत्तस्य गेहे ' go thou for the stake, the wood is in Devadatta's house.' Similarly, sútra 37 declares 'a word ending with the 5th case-affix may be compounded with the word भय; as, वृकेभ्यो भयं = वृकभयं ' fear by reason of a wolf. But when these words are not connected in sense, there is no composition; as, गच्छ त्वं मां वृकेभ्यो, भयं देवदत्तस्य यज्ञदत्तात् 'come thou to me from the wolves, there is fear to Devadatta from Yajñadatta'. Similarly, sútra [[2.2.8]] declares "a word ending with the 6th case affix is optionally compounded with what ends with a case-affix;" as, राज्ञः पुरुषो = राजपुरुषः 'the king's man'. But when the words are not समर्थ , there is no composition: as भार्य्या राज्ञः, पुरुषो देवदत्तस्य "the wife of the king, the man of Devadatta". Similarly, sútra 40 declares. "A word ending with the 7th case-affix is optionally compounded with the word शौण्ड 'skilled;' as, अक्षेषु शौण्डः = अक्षशौण्डः 'skilled in dice.' But when the words are not connected in sense, there is no composition; as, शक्तस्त्वमक्षेषु शौण्डः पिबति पानागारे ' thou art skilled in dice, the gambler drinks in the tavern.' Why have we used the word पद 'a complete word' in the sútra? So that this समर्थ परिभाषा may not apply to वर्णविधि i.e. rules relating to letters. Thus rules of सन्धि 'conjunction of letters' are वर्णविधि and not पदविधि; and therefore the condition of being connected in sense, does not apply he

pk: a word ending in sup or a case-aril, when rolowed by a word in the Vocative Case, is regarded as ir it was the anga or conponent part or such subsequent vocative word, when a rule relating to acent is to be aplied. in other words, the word ending in a case-aril enters, as ir, into the body or the vocative (ánantrita) word; as it wil be taught in sútra [6.1.198] which declares a word ending in a vocative case-aril, gets the udáta acent on the begining i.e. rirst sylable. now, this rule wil aply even when a word ending with a case-aril precedes such word in the vocative case. Thus the word pati O two lords ! has udata on the rirst sylable. now, when this word is preceded by another inrlected noun as suBas or prosperity, the acent wil ral on su, the two words being considered as a single word; as:- asvina yajvaririso dravatpani suBaspati puruBujacanasyatana nig. i.3.1. "O asvins, riding on quick horses, lords or prosperity, and bestowers or plenty or rod, eat the sacriricial orerings to your satisraction". so also in the rolowing: kunqe nawan O thou wandering with a bowl. parasuna vrscan O thou cuting with an ale. nadranan rajan O thou king or nadras. kasniranan rajan O thou king or Kashnir. Why do we say a word ending with a case-aril? ir the preceding word ends with any other aril than a case-aril, this rule wil not aply. as a piqye piqyanana O thou who art pained, i an pained because or this thy pain. ere piqye being a tinanta (a verb) is not considered as an anga or the vocative word. Why do we say "when rolowed by a word in the vocative case ?" This rule wil not aply when the subsequent word is not a vocative. as gehe gargya Gárga is at hone.
