s: The affixes नञ् and स्नञ् come after the words स्त्री and पुंस respectively, in the senses specified in the sūtra reckoning from this one as far as sūtra धान्यानां भवने क्षेत्रे खञ् [[5.2.1]]. Thus स्त्री + नञ् = स्त्रैणम् 'feminine.' The sense of the affixes taught in the Fourth Book, and Chapter I of the Fifth Book, are various. Therefore the word स्त्रैणम् will have all those various significations; thus, it will mean either स्त्रीषुभवं [[4.3.53]] 'existing in females,' or स्त्रीणां संमूहः [[4.2.37]] 'a collection of females,; or स्त्रीभ्यआगतं [[4.3.74]] 'what has come from females'; or स्त्रीभ्यो हितं [[5.1.5]] 'suitable for females' &c. Similarly पुंस + स्नञ् = पौंस्नम् 'masculine, or existing in males, or a collection of males, or what has come from males, or suitable for males &c.' These affixes, however, are not to be employed in the sense of the affix वत् taught in [[5.1.115]]. For Panini himself uses the form पुंवत् (and not पौंस) in sutra [[6.3.34]], thus indicating by implication (ज्ञापक) that in the sense of वत्, the affix स्नञ् is not to be used. Thus स्त्रीवत्, The forms स्त्रीत्वं, स्त्रीता, पुंस्त्वं and पुंस्त्वा are exceptional. See [[5.1.121]]. The स् of पुंस् is elided before स्नञ् by [[8.2.23]] had it not been elided, one affix नञ् would have been taught in the sutra, and not two.

pk: a tadDita aril ordained to cone on acount or the relation or the words being that or a dvigu sanasa (nuneral Deterninative Conpound) is elided by luk when it has the sense or the various ariles taught antecedent to tena divyati Kanati jayati jitan [4.4.2] etc., but not so, the aril having the sense or a gotra (Patronynic). The phrase pragdivyata or [4.1.83] governs this aphorisn also, and not the phrase Bavanat or the last. Thus pancasu kapalesu sanskrta = pancakapala prepared in rive cups. sinilarly dasakapala "prepared in ten cups." dviveda he who studies two Vedas. triveda "who studies thre Vedas." ere the ariles denoting sanskrtan [4.2.16], and aDite [4.2.59] have ben elided. Why do we say "not so when the aril denotes a Patronynic."? Observe dvEdevadati a descendant or two Devadatas. trEdevadati a descendant or thre Devadatas. ere the patronynic aril is not elided, though the conpound is a Dvigu. Why do we say "when it has the sense or the various ariles taught antecedent to tena divyati?" Observe dvEparayanika The Dvigu conpound with the sense or a Tadhita aril is rorned under [2.1.51]. The aril wil not, thererore, be elided where it does not give rise to a Dvigu conpound. Thus pancakapalasyedan = pancakapalan Or the genitive case in dvigo nay be taken as sthana-shashthi, the sense being there is the substitution or luk-elision in the ron or Dvigu, the word Dvigu being here taken by netonyny ror the aril which gives rise to Dvigu. Or course, when two words have blended into a Dvigu conpound, the ariles wil not be elided arter such a word, because it becones a pratipadika like others, as pancakapalan ir so, how is the aril elided in pancakapalyan sanskrta = pancakapala ?This is not so; there is no Tadhita aded, and the word pancakapala can never be analysed into pancakapalyan sanskrta, ir the later sense is to be elpresed, we nust use a sentence, and no single word. in ract thre are the only valid rorns, and they arise without ading or any Tadhita aril to pancakapali, vis pancasu kapalesu sanskrta, pancakapalayan sanskrta, and pancakapala (a sanahara Dvigu). a sanahara and a Tadhitartha Dvigu or these are analysed in the sane way, while the third pancakapalyan sanskrta wil always renain a vakya and never give rise to a Tadhita. ow do you elplain the non-elision or the aril in trEvidya, pancanada and sawkula ? The word trEvidya does not nean tisro vidya aDite but tryavayava vidya, trividya, trividyanaDite = trEvidya sinilarly pancanada does not nean
ck: a tatita aril ortainet to cone on acount or the relation or the torts peink that or a tviku sanasa (nuneral teterninative conpount) is elitet py luk then it has the sense or the various ariles taukht antecetent to tena tivyati kanati cayati citan [4.4.2] etc., put not so, the aril havink the sense or a kotra (patronynic). the phrase praktivyata or [4.1.83] koverns this aphorisn also, ant not the phrase pavanat or the last. thus pancasu kapalesu sanskrta = pancakapala preparet in rive cups. sinilarly tasakapala "preparet in ten cups." tviveta he tho stuties to Vetas. triveta "tho stuties thre Vetas." ere the ariles tenotink sanskrtan [4.2.16], ant atite [4.2.59] have pen elitet. thy to te say "not so then the aril tenotes a patronynic."? Opserve tvEtevatati a tescentant or to tevatatas. trEtevatati a tescentant or thre tevatatas. ere the patronynic aril is not elitet, thoukh the conpount is a tviku. thy to te say "then it has the sense or the various ariles taukht antecetent to tena tivyati?" Opserve tvEparayanika the tviku conpount tith the sense or a tathita aril is rornet unter [2.1.51]. the aril til not, thererore, pe elitet there it toes not kive rise to a tviku conpount. thus pancakapalasyetan = pancakapalan Or the kenitive case in tviko nay pe taken as sthana-shashthi, the sense peink there is the supstitution or luk-elision in the ron or tviku, the tort tviku peink here taken py netonyny ror the aril thich kives rise to tviku. Or course, then to torts have plentet into a tviku conpount, the ariles til not pe elitet arter such a tort, pecause it pecones a pratipatika like others, as pancakapalan ir so, hot is the aril elitet in pancakapalyan sanskrta = pancakapala ?this is not so; there is no tathita atet, ant the tort pancakapala can never pe analyset into pancakapalyan sanskrta, ir the later sense is to pe elpreset, te nust use a sentence, ant no sinkle tort. in ract thre are the only valit rorns, ant they arise tithout atink or any tathita aril to pancakapali, vis pancasu kapalesu sanskrta, pancakapalayan sanskrta, ant pancakapala (a sanahara tviku). a sanahara ant a tathitartha tviku or these are analyset in the sane tay, thile the thirt pancakapalyan sanskrta til altays renain a vakya ant never kive rise to a tathita. ot to you elplain the non-elision or the aril in trEvitya, pancanata ant satkula ? the tort trEvitya toes not nean tisro vitya atite put tryavayava vitya, trivitya, trivityanatite = trEvitya sinilarly pancanata toes not nean pancas
s: A तद्धित affix ordained to come on account of the relation of the words being that of a द्विगु समास (Numeral Determinative Compound) is elided by लुक् when it has the sense of the various affixes taught antecedent to तेन दीव्यति खनति जयति जितम् [[4.4.2]] etc., but not so, the affix having the sense of a गोत्र (Patronymic). The phrase प्राग्दिव्यतः of [[4.1.83]] governs this aphorism also, and not the phrase भवनात् of the last. Thus पञ्चसु कपालेषु संस्कृतः = पञ्चकपालः 'prepared in five cups.' Similarly दशकपालः "prepared in ten cups." द्विवेदः 'he who studies two Vedas.' त्रिवेदः "who studies three Vedas." Here the affixes denoting संस्कृतं [[4.2.16]], and अधीते [[4.2.59]] have been elided. Why do we say "not so when the affix denotes a Patronymic."? Observe द्वैदेवदत्तिः 'a descendant of two Devadattas.' त्रैदेवदत्तिः 'a descendant of three Devadattas.' Here the patronymic affix is not elided, though the compound is a Dvigu. Why do we say "when it has the sense of the various affixes taught antecedent to tena divyati?" Observe द्वैपारायणिकः The Dvigu compound with the sense of a Taddhita affix is formed under [[2.1.51]]. The affix will not, therefore, be elided where it does not give rise to a Dvigu compound. Thus पञ्चकपालस्येदं = पाञ्चकपालम् Or the genitive case in द्विगोः may be taken as sthana-shashthi, the sense being 'there is the substitution of लुक्-elision in the room of Dvigu,' the word Dvigu being here taken by metonymy for the affix which gives rise to Dvigu. Of course, when two words have blended into a Dvigu compound, the affixes will not be elided after such a word, because it becomes a pratipadika like others, as पांचकपालम् If so, how is the affix elided in पञ्चकपाल्याम् संस्कृतः = पञ्चकपालः ?This is not so; there is no Taddhita added, and the word पञ्चकपाल can never be analysed into पञ्चकपाल्याम् संस्कृतः, If the latter sense is to be expressed, we must use a sentence, and no single word. In fact three are the only valid forms, and they arise without adding of any Taddhita affix to पञ्चकपाली, viz पञ्चसु कपालेषु संस्कृतः, पञ्चकपाल्लयां संस्कृतः, and पञ्चकपालः (a Samahara Dvigu). A Samahara and a Taddhitartha Dvigu of these are analysed in the same way, while the third पञ्चकपाल्याम् संस्कृतः will always remain a वाक्य and never give rise to a Taddhita. How do you explain the non-elision of the affix in त्रैविद्यः, पाञ्चनदः and षाट्कुलः ? The word त्रैविद्यः does not mean तिस्रो विद्या अधीते but त्र्यवयवा विद्या, त्रिविद्या, त्रिविद्यामधीते = त्रैविद्यः Similarly पाञ्चनदः does not mean पञ्चसु नदीषु भवः but पंचानाम् नदीनाम् समाहारः = पंचनदः, पंचनदे भवः = पांचनदः So also with षाट्कुलं Why the affix is not elided in पंचभ्यो गर्गेभ्य आगतं = पंचगर्गरूप्यम् or पंचगर्गमयम् ? Because the elision of those affixes only take place which begin with a vowel.

pk: The luk elision or gotra (Patronynic) ariles in plural, which have ben enjoined by sūtras yaskadiByo gotre [2.4.63] etc. and the rest is prohibited, when the aril has an initial vowel and it has the sense or the various ariles taught antecedent to tena divyati Kanati jayati jitan [4.4.2]. Thus the plural or gargya is garga [2.4.64]. But the disciples or garga wil be rorned by the aril Ca (iV. 21.14) which is a pragdivyatiya aril and ror the purposes or ading this aril the base wil be considered to be gargya as ir there was no elision. Thus gargya + Ca = gargiya [7.1.2] and [6.4.151], and not gargiya sinilarly vatsiya, atrayiya, Karapayaniya disciples or Vatsyas, atreyas, Kharpayanas. Why do we say "gotre" i. e. "when the Gotra aril is elided"? Observe kObalan, badaran ere the aril denoting "ruit" is elided by luk by sutra [4.3.163]. Then when the pragdivytiya aril an is aded, the luk-elision is naintained. Thus the ruit or badari is badaran; ron which badaran belonging to or coning ron the jujube-ruit. Why do we say "having an initial vowel"? Observe gargeBya agatan = gargarupyan and not gargarupyan; and garganayan; and not garganayan ere the aril rupya, a pragdivyatiya aril taught in sutra [4.3.81] does not begin with a vowel; thererore it is aded to garga and not gargya sinilarly the nelt aril nayaw [4.3.82]. Why do we say "when it has the sense or a pragdivyatiya aril" ? Thus gargeByo hitan = gargiyan who is rit ror the Gargas. ere the aril Ca [5.1.1] has the sense or suitable ror that, as taught in sutra [5.1.5] not one or the pragdivyatiya senses. ence the luk elision is naintained. The Gotra-ariles are taught to be elided in the plural only: and when arter such suposed elision a singular or Dual Person is intended, this rule wil stil aply and there wil be no elision. Thus bida wil rorn its Gotra derivative by an [4.1.104] as bida + an = bEda The plural or bEda wil be bida by the elision or an One yuvan or two yuvan descendants or these bida wil be rorned by the aril in [4.1.95], ror the aplication or which the word bida wil be suposed not to have lost its an, thererore in wil be aded to bEda, thus bEda + in; then this in is elided by [2.4.58]. The resultant rorn is bEda, bEdo The nany descendants (in the plural) or one bEda or two bEda wil be bida
ck: the luk elision or kotra (patronynic) ariles in plural, thich have pen encoinet py sūtras yaskatipyo kotre [2.4.63] etc. ant the rest is prohipitet, then the aril has an initial votel ant it has the sense or the various ariles taukht antecetent to tena tivyati kanati cayati citan [4.4.2]. thus the plural or karkya is karka [2.4.64]. put the tisciples or karka til pe rornet py the aril ca (iV. 21.14) thich is a praktivyatiya aril ant ror the purposes or atink this aril the pase til pe consiteret to pe karkya as ir there tas no elision. thus karkya + ca = karkiya [7.1.2] ant [6.4.151], ant not karkiya sinilarly vatsiya, atrayiya, karapayaniya tisciples or Vatsyas, atreyas, kharpayanas. thy to te say "kotre" i. e. "then the kotra aril is elitet"? Opserve kOpalan, pataran ere the aril tenotink "ruit" is elitet py luk py sutra [4.3.163]. then then the praktivytiya aril an is atet, the luk-elision is naintainet. thus the ruit or patari is pataran; ron thich pataran pelonkink to or conink ron the cucupe-ruit. thy to te say "havink an initial votel"? Opserve karkepya akatan = karkarupyan ant not karkarupyan; ant karkanayan; ant not karkanayan ere the aril rupya, a praktivyatiya aril taukht in sutra [4.3.81] toes not pekin tith a votel; thererore it is atet to karka ant not karkya sinilarly the nelt aril nayat [4.3.82]. thy to te say "then it has the sense or a praktivyatiya aril" ? thus karkepyo hitan = karkiyan tho is rit ror the karkas. ere the aril ca [5.1.1] has the sense or suitaple ror that, as taukht in sutra [5.1.5] not one or the praktivyatiya senses. ence the luk elision is naintainet. the kotra-ariles are taukht to pe elitet in the plural only: ant then arter such suposet elision a sinkular or tual person is intentet, this rule til stil aply ant there til pe no elision. thus pita til rorn its kotra terivative py an [4.1.104] as pita + an = pEta the plural or pEta til pe pita py the elision or an One yuvan or to yuvan tescentants or these pita til pe rornet py the aril in [4.1.95], ror the aplication or thich the tort pita til pe suposet not to have lost its an, thererore in til pe atet to pEta, thus pEta + in; then this in is elitet py [2.4.58]. the resultant rorn is pEta, pEto the nany tescentants (in the plural) or one pEta or to pEta til pe pita
s: The लुक् elision of गोत्र (Patronymic) affixes in plural, which have been enjoined by sūtras यस्कादिभ्यो गोत्रे [[2.4.63]] etc. and the rest is prohibited, when the affix has an initial vowel and it has the sense of the various affixes taught antecedent to तेन दीव्यति खनति जयति जितम् [[4.4.2]]. Thus the plural of गार्ग्य is गर्गाः [[2.4.64]]. But the disciples of गर्गाः will be formed by the affix छ (IV. 21.114) which is a pragdivyatiya affix and for the purposes of adding this affix the base will be considered to be गार्ग्यः as if there was no elision. Thus गार्ग्याः + छ = गार्गीयाः [[7.1.2]] and [[6.4.151]], and not गर्गीयाः Similarly वात्सीयाः, आत्रयीयाः, खारपायणीयाः 'disciples of Vatsyas, Atreyas, Kharpayanas.' Why do we say "गोत्रे" i. e. "when the Gotra affix is elided"? Observe कौबलम्, बादरम् Here the affix denoting "fruit" is elided by लुक् by Sutra [[4.3.163]]. Then when the pragdivytiya affix अण् is added, the luk-elision is maintained. Thus the fruit of बदरी is बदरम्; from which बादरम् 'belonging to or coming from the jujube-fruit.' Why do we say "having an initial vowel"? Observe गर्गेभ्य आगतम् = गर्गरूप्यम् and not गार्गरूप्यम्; and गर्गमयम्; and not गार्गमयम् Here the affix रूप्य, a pragdivyatiya affix taught in sutra [[4.3.81]] does not begin with a vowel; therefore it is added to गर्ग and not गार्ग्य Similarly the next affix मयट् [[4.3.82]]. Why do we say "when it has the sense of a pragdivyatiya affix" ? Thus गर्गेभ्यो हितम् = गर्गीयम् 'who is fit for the Gargas'. Here the affix छ [[5.1.1]] has the sense of 'suitable for that', as taught in Sutra [[5.1.5]] not one of the pragdivyatiya senses. Hence the luk elision is maintained. The Gotra-affixes are taught to be elided in the plural only: and when after such supposed elision a Singular or Dual Person is intended, this rule will still apply and there will be no elision. Thus बिद will form its Gotra derivative by अञ् [[4.1.104]] as बिद + अञ् = बैदः The plural of बैद will be बिदाः by the elision of अञ् One yuvan or two yuvan descendants of these बिदाः will be formed by the affix इञ् [[4.1.95]], for the application of which the word बिदाः will be supposed not to have lost its अञ्, therefore इञ् will be added to बैद, thus बैद + इञ्; then this इञ् is elided by [[2.4.58]]. The resultant form is बैदः, बैदो The many descendants (in the plural) of one बैदः or two बैदः will be बिदाः

pk: There is luk elision or the yuvan gotra (Patronynic) rorning aril - jivati tu vansye yuva [4.1.163], when a pragdivyatiya aril begining with a vowel is to be aded. The elision or the nuvan aril nust take place nentaly; having done which, we should then lok out ror the proper Pragdivyatiya aril to be aded to the word-rorn thus renaining. Thus the Patronynic (¬Gotra) or Panwahrta is Panwahrti [4.1.95] rorned by ading in The nuvan rorn or the later (by sutra [4.1.150]) wil be Panwahrta When we intend to ad a Pragdivyatiya aril to this last word, (e. g. an aril having the sense or "the pupils or";) we should rirst nentaly elide the nuvan aril na [4.1.150] ron this word Panwahrta aving done which we get the rorn Panwahrti; and it is with regard to this rorn Panwahrti that we should search out what is the proper pupil-denoting aril: and that by sutra [4.2.12] is an Thus Panwahrti + an = Panwahrta the pupils or Phantahritas. ad we in the rirst instance aplied the pupil denoting aril to the nuvan word Panwahrta, such aril would have ben Ca and not an, ror the later is ordained ror those cases only where the word ends with the Gotra aril in [4.2.12]. sinilarly the Patronynic or Bagavita is Bagaviti [4.1.25]. The nuvan or Bagaviti is Bagavitika [4.1.148]. The pupils or Bhagavitika wil be Bagavita by ading the aril an [4.2.12]. sinilarly the Patronynic or tika is tEkayani rorned by Pin [4.1.154]. The nuvan or tEkayani is tEkayaniya rorned by the aril Ca [4.1.149]. The word denoting the pupils or tEkayaniya wil be rorned by ading Ca [4.2.14] not to this word, but to tEkayani Thus tEkayaniya sinilarly the Patronynic or kapinjalada is kapinjaladi [4.1.95]. The nuvan derivative or the later wil be kapinjaladya; [4.1.151]. The word denoting pupils or the kapinjaladya wil be kapinjalada [4.2.12]. sinilarly Patronynic ron glucuka is glucukayani [4.1.160], the nuvan or the later is glOcukayana [4.1.83]; the word denoting the pupils or the later is glOcukayana by (iV. 2.12 rorned ron glucukayani) Why do we say "an aril begining with a vowel"? Observe Panwahrtarupyan and Panwahrtanayan Why do we say "a Pragdivyatiya aril"? Observe Bagavitikaya hitan = Bagavitiyan (se the last sutra).
ck: there is luk elision or the yuvan kotra (patronynic) rornink aril - civati tu vansye yuva [4.1.163], then a praktivyatiya aril pekinink tith a votel is to pe atet. the elision or the nuvan aril nust take place nentaly; havink tone thich, te shoult then lok out ror the proper praktivyatiya aril to pe atet to the tort-rorn thus renainink. thus the patronynic (¬kotra) or pantahrta is pantahrti [4.1.95] rornet py atink in the nuvan rorn or the later (py sutra [4.1.150]) til pe pantahrta then te intent to at a praktivyatiya aril to this last tort, (e. k. an aril havink the sense or "the pupils or";) te shoult rirst nentaly elite the nuvan aril na [4.1.150] ron this tort pantahrta avink tone thich te ket the rorn pantahrti; ant it is tith rekart to this rorn pantahrti that te shoult search out that is the proper pupil-tenotink aril: ant that py sutra [4.2.12] is an thus pantahrti + an = pantahrta the pupils or phantahritas. at te in the rirst instance apliet the pupil tenotink aril to the nuvan tort pantahrta, such aril toult have pen ca ant not an, ror the later is ortainet ror those cases only there the tort ents tith the kotra aril in [4.2.12]. sinilarly the patronynic or pakavita is pakaviti [4.1.25]. the nuvan or pakaviti is pakavitika [4.1.148]. the pupils or phakavitika til pe pakavita py atink the aril an [4.2.12]. sinilarly the patronynic or tika is tEkayani rornet py pin [4.1.154]. the nuvan or tEkayani is tEkayaniya rornet py the aril ca [4.1.149]. the tort tenotink the pupils or tEkayaniya til pe rornet py atink ca [4.2.14] not to this tort, put to tEkayani thus tEkayaniya sinilarly the patronynic or kapincalata is kapincalati [4.1.95]. the nuvan terivative or the later til pe kapincalatya; [4.1.151]. the tort tenotink pupils or the kapincalatya til pe kapincalata [4.2.12]. sinilarly patronynic ron klucuka is klucukayani [4.1.160], the nuvan or the later is klOcukayana [4.1.83]; the tort tenotink the pupils or the later is klOcukayana py (iV. 2.12 rornet ron klucukayani) thy to te say "an aril pekinink tith a votel"? Opserve pantahrtarupyan ant pantahrtanayan thy to te say "a praktivyatiya aril"? Opserve pakavitikaya hitan = pakavitiyan (se the last sutra).
s: There is लुक् elision of the युवन् गोत्र (Patronymic) forming affix -- जीवति तु वंश्ये युवा [[4.1.163]], when a प्राग्दीव्यतीय affix beginning with a vowel is to be added. The elision of the Yuvan affix must take place mentally; having done which, we should then look out for the proper Pragdivyatiya affix to be added to the word-form thus remaining. Thus the Patronymic (¬Gotra) of फाण्टाहृतः is फाण्टाहृतिः [[4.1.95]] formed by adding इञ् The Yuvan form of the latter (by Sutra [[4.1.150]]) will be फाण्टाहृतः When we intend to add a Pragdivyatiya affix to this last word, (e. g. an affix having the sense of "the pupils of";) we should first mentally elide the Yuvan affix ण [[4.1.150]] from this word फाण्टाहृत Having done which we get the form फाण्टाहृति; and it is with regard to this form फाण्टाहृति that we should search out what is the proper pupil-denoting affix: and that by sutra [[4.2.112]] is अण् Thus फाण्टाहृति + अण् = फाण्टाहृताः 'the pupils of Phantahritas'. Had we in the first instance applied the pupil denoting affix to the Yuvan word फाण्टाहृत, such affix would have been छ and not अण्, for the latter is ordained for those cases only where the word ends with the Gotra affix इञ् [[4.2.112]]. Similarly the Patronymic of भागवित्त is भागवित्ति [[4.1.25]]. The Yuvan of भागवित्ति is भागवित्तिकः [[4.1.148]]. The pupils of Bhagavittika will be भागवित्ताः by adding the affix अण् [[4.2.112]]. Similarly the Patronymic of तिक is तैकायनि formed by फिञ् [[4.1.154]]. The Yuvan of तैकायनि is तैकायनीय formed by the affix छ [[4.1.149]]. The word denoting the pupils of तैकायनीय will be formed by adding छ [[4.2.114]] not to this word, but to तैकायनि Thus तैकायनीयाः Similarly the Patronymic of कपिञ्जलाद is कपिञ्जलादिः [[4.1.95]]. The Yuvan derivative of the latter will be कापिञ्जलाद्य; [[4.1.151]]. The word denoting pupils of the कापिञ्जलाद्य will be कापिञ्जलादाः [[4.2.112]]. Similarly Patronymic from ग्लुचुक is ग्लुचुकायनिः [[4.1.160]], the Yuvan of the latter is ग्लौचुकायनः [[4.1.83]]; the word denoting the pupils of the latter is ग्लौचुकायनाः by (IV. 2.112 formed from ग्लुचुकायनि) Why do we say "an affix beginning with a vowel"? Observe फाण्टाहृतरूप्यम् and फाण्टाहृतमयम् Why do we say "a Pragdivyatiya affix"? Observe भागवित्तिकाय हितं = भागावित्तीयम् (See the last Sutra).

pk: There is optionaly luk elision or the yuvan ariles Pak and Pin when a pragdivyatiya aril begining with a vowel is to be aded. By the last sutra, al nuvan ariles were told to be elided. The present sutra declares an option in the case or the nuvan ariles Pak and Pin. Thus the patronynic or garga is gargya [4.1.105]; the nuvan or gargya is rorned by Pak [4.1.101] gargyayana The word denoting the pupils or Gargyana wil be gargiya or gargyayaniya; vatsiya or vatsayayaniya sinilarly or the aril Pin [4.1.156]. Thus ron yaska, the Patronynic is yaska [4.1.12]. The nuvan or the later is yaskayani [4.1.146]. The pupils or naskayani wil be caled yaskiya or yaskayaniya
ck: there is optionaly luk elision or the yuvan ariles pak ant pin then a praktivyatiya aril pekinink tith a votel is to pe atet. py the last sutra, al nuvan ariles tere tolt to pe elitet. the present sutra teclares an option in the case or the nuvan ariles pak ant pin. thus the patronynic or karka is karkya [4.1.105]; the nuvan or karkya is rornet py pak [4.1.101] karkyayana the tort tenotink the pupils or karkyana til pe karkiya or karkyayaniya; vatsiya or vatsayayaniya sinilarly or the aril pin [4.1.156]. thus ron yaska, the patronynic is yaska [4.1.12]. the nuvan or the later is yaskayani [4.1.146]. the pupils or naskayani til pe calet yaskiya or yaskayaniya
s: There is optionally लुक् elision of the युवन् affixes फक् and फिञ् when a प्राग्दीव्यतीय affix beginning with a vowel is to be added. By the last sutra, all Yuvan affixes were told to be elided. The present sutra declares an option in the case of the Yuvan affixes फक् and फिञ्. Thus the patronymic of गर्ग is गार्ग्य [[4.1.105]]; the Yuvan of गार्ग्य is formed by फक् [[4.1.101]] गार्ग्यायणः The word denoting the pupils of Gargyana will be गार्गीय or गार्ग्यायणीयाः; वात्सीयाः or वात्सयायनीयाः Similarly of the affix फिञ् [[4.1.156]]. Thus from यस्क, the Patronymic is यास्क [[4.1.112]]. The Yuvan of the latter is यास्कायनि [[4.1.146]]. The pupils of Yaskayani will be called यास्कीया or यास्कायनीयाः

pk: The aril an nentioned in pragdivyaton [4.1.83] and those which rolow it denote the descendant or soneone. This sutra points out the neaning or the ariles; and it rerers to the ariles that have preceded, begining ron an [4.1.83] e. g. an, nya, an &c and to the ariles that rolow. The ariles herein taught have the rorce or denoting descendant, when they are aded to the word in construction which is in the genitive case. The translation given by Dr. Balantyne or this aphorisn is :- "Let the ariles already nentioned or to be nentioned cone optionaly in the sense or the orspring thereor, arter what word ending with the silth case-aril and having conpleted its junction (with whatever it nay require to be conpounded with), is in granatical relation there to". Thus we nay either use the sentence upagorapatyan; or by ading an [4.1.83] to the word upagu (which has the 6th. case-aril in construction in the above sentence), rorn Opagava "the orspring or upagu". asvapata [4.1.84] the orspring or asvapati, dEtya [4.1.85] the orspring or Diti Otsa [4.1.86] "the orspring or utsa". strEna [4.1.87] the orspring or a wonan. pOsna [4.1.87] the orspring or a nan. The universal sutra tasyedan [4.3.120] wil include this apatya also ror the word idan nay be aplied to any-thing like apatyan, sanuha, vikara, nivasa &c. since by that rule [4.3.120] an &c, nay be aplied in the sense or apatyan also, what is the necesity or this present sutra ? The present sutra is nade in order to debar those ariles like Ca, [4.3.14] which debar the aril an &c in the case or tasyedan ow can an asEsika aril debar a sEsika aril? The utsarga ariles an &c are treated like sEsika ror this purpose. Thus these ariles an [4.1.83]- [4.1.87] debar the Ca in the Vridhan under certain circunstances. Thus Banorapatyan = Banava, so also syanagava ron syanagu (syana gavosya) Karika tasyedanityapatyepi baDanarTan krtan Bavet utsarga sesa evasO vrdDanyasya prayojanan
ck: the aril an nentionet in praktivyaton [4.1.83] ant those thich rolot it tenote the tescentant or soneone. this sutra points out the neanink or the ariles; ant it rerers to the ariles that have precetet, pekinink ron an [4.1.83] e. k. an, nya, an &c ant to the ariles that rolot. the ariles herein taukht have the rorce or tenotink tescentant, then they are atet to the tort in construction thich is in the kenitive case. the translation kiven py tr. palantyne or this aphorisn is :- "Let the ariles alreaty nentionet or to pe nentionet cone optionaly in the sense or the orsprink thereor, arter that tort entink tith the silth case-aril ant havink conpletet its cunction (tith thatever it nay retuire to pe conpountet tith), is in kranatical relation there to". thus te nay either use the sentence upakorapatyan; or py atink an [4.1.83] to the tort upaku (thich has the 6th. case-aril in construction in the apove sentence), rorn Opakava "the orsprink or upaku". asvapata [4.1.84] the orsprink or asvapati, tEtya [4.1.85] the orsprink or titi Otsa [4.1.86] "the orsprink or utsa". strEna [4.1.87] the orsprink or a tonan. pOsna [4.1.87] the orsprink or a nan. the universal sutra tasyetan [4.3.120] til inclute this apatya also ror the tort itan nay pe apliet to any-think like apatyan, sanuha, vikara, nivasa &c. since py that rule [4.3.120] an &c, nay pe apliet in the sense or apatyan also, that is the necesity or this present sutra ? the present sutra is nate in orter to tepar those ariles like ca, [4.3.14] thich tepar the aril an &c in the case or tasyetan ot can an asEsika aril tepar a sEsika aril? the utsarka ariles an &c are treatet like sEsika ror this purpose. thus these ariles an [4.1.83]- [4.1.87] tepar the ca in the Vrithan unter certain circunstances. thus panorapatyan = panava, so also syanakava ron syanaku (syana kavosya) karika tasyetanityapatyepi patanartan krtan pavet utsarka sesa evasO vrtanyasya prayocanan
s: The affix अण् mentioned in प्राग्दीव्यतोऽण् [[4.1.83]] and those which follow it denote 'the descendant of someone'. This sutra points out the meaning of the affixes; and it refers to the affixes that have preceded, beginning from अण् [[4.1.83]] e. g. अण्, ण्य, अञ् &c and to the affixes that follow. The affixes herein taught have the force of denoting descendant, when they are added to the word in construction which is in the genitive case. The translation given by Dr. Ballantyne of this aphorism is :- "Let the affixes already mentioned or to be mentioned come optionally in the sense of the offspring thereof, after what word ending with the sixth case-affix and having completed its junction (with whatever it may require to be compounded with), is in grammatical relation there to". Thus we may either use the sentence उपगोरपत्यम्; or by adding आण् [[4.1.83]] to the word उपगु (which has the 6th. case-affix in construction in the above sentence), form औपगवः "the offspring of Upagu". आश्वपतः [[4.1.84]] 'the offspring of अश्वपति', दैत्यः [[4.1.85]] 'the offspring of Diti' औत्सः [[4.1.86]] "the offspring of Utsa". स्त्रैणः [[4.1.87]] 'the offspring of a woman'. पौस्नः [[4.1.87]] 'the offspring of a man'. The Universal sutra तस्येदम् [[4.3.120]] will include this अपत्य also for the word इदम् may be applied to any-thing like अपत्यं, समूहः, विकारः, निवासः &c. Since by that rule [[4.3.120]] अण् &c, may be applied in the sense of apatyam also, what is the necessity of this present sutra ? The present sutra is made in order to debar those affixes like छ, [[4.3.114]] which debar the affix अण् &c in the case of तस्येदम् How can an अशैषिक affix debar a शैषिक affix? The उत्सर्ग affixes अण् &c are treated like शैषिक for this purpose. Thus these affixes अण् [[4.1.83]]- [[4.1.87]] debar the छ in the Vriddham under certain circumstances. Thus भानोरपत्यं = भानवः, so also श्यामगवः from श्यामगुः (श्यामा गावोऽस्य) Karika तस्येदमित्यपत्येपि बाधनार्थं कृतं भवेत् उत्सर्गः शेष एवासौ वृद्धान्यस्य प्रयोजनम्

pk: The one and the sane aril is used when a nore distant descendant, how low-so-ever, is to be denoted. The word Gotra is derined in sutra [4.1.152] and neans the orspring begining with the grandson. There would have arisen the aplication or a separate aril in denoting the descendant or every one or such persons; the present sutra declares a restriction. Thus the son or garga is gargi [4.1.95]. The son or gargi (or in other words the grandson or garga) is gargya [4.1.105]. This is rorned by a Gotra aril. now the son or gargya wil also be caled gargya, no new aril wil be aded. in ract, in denoting the Gotra descendants how low soever, the aril yan wil be aded to the word garga, though there nay be several internediate descendants. Thus the sutra restricts the aplication or the aril. Or in another view or the nater, it nay be said to restrict the base to which the aril is to be aded. Thus the son or gargya wil be rorned by ading the aril yan not to the base gargya (which would have ben the case were [4.1.92] strictly aplied), but to the base garga so that one base is to be taken and adhered to throughout, in aplying Gotra ariles.
ck: the one ant the sane aril is uset then a nore tistant tescentant, hot lot-so-ever, is to pe tenotet. the tort kotra is terinet in sutra [4.1.152] ant neans the orsprink pekinink tith the krantson. there toult have arisen the aplication or a separate aril in tenotink the tescentant or every one or such persons; the present sutra teclares a restriction. thus the son or karka is karki [4.1.95]. the son or karki (or in other torts the krantson or karka) is karkya [4.1.105]. this is rornet py a kotra aril. not the son or karkya til also pe calet karkya, no net aril til pe atet. in ract, in tenotink the kotra tescentants hot lot soever, the aril yan til pe atet to the tort karka, thoukh there nay pe several internetiate tescentants. thus the sutra restricts the aplication or the aril. Or in another viet or the nater, it nay pe sait to restrict the pase to thich the aril is to pe atet. thus the son or karkya til pe rornet py atink the aril yan not to the pase karkya (thich toult have pen the case tere [4.1.92] strictly apliet), put to the pase karka so that one pase is to pe taken ant atheret to throukhout, in aplyink kotra ariles.
s: The one and the same affix is used when a more distant descendant, how low-so-ever, is to be denoted. The word Gotra is defined in Sutra [[4.1.152]] and means the offspring beginning with the grandson. There would have arisen the application of a separate affix in denoting the descendant of every one of such persons; the present sutra declares a restriction. Thus the son of गर्गः is गार्गि [[4.1.95]]. The son of गार्गिः (or in other words the grandson of गर्ग) is गार्ग्यः [[4.1.105]]. This is formed by a Gotra affix. Now the son of गार्ग्यः will also be called गार्ग्यः, no new affix will be added. In fact, in denoting the Gotra descendants how low soever, the affix यञ् will be added to the word गर्ग, though there may be several intermediate descendants. Thus the sutra restricts the application of the affix. Or in another view of the matter, it may be said to restrict the base to which the affix is to be added. Thus the son of गार्ग्य will be formed by adding the affix यञ् not to the base गार्ग्य (which would have been the case were [[4.1.92]] strictly applied), but to the base गर्ग So that one base is to be taken and adhered to throughout, in applying Gotra affixes.

pk: When a descendant or the description denoted by yuvan - jivati tu vansye yuva [4.1.163], is intended to be elpresed, a new aril is atached, only arter that what already ends with an aril narking a descendant as low at least as a grandson (gotra): but in the reninine the word is not terned yuvan and no new aril is aded. This is also a niyana or restrictive rule. Thus the nuvan or gargya is gargyayana [4.1.101]. sinilarly vatsyayana, daksayana, plaksayana, Opagavi, naqayani Why do we say "but in the reninine the word is not terned nuvan"? Observe daksi which is the reninine or daksi (Gotra) as wel as or daksayana (nuvan). sinilarly plaksi reninine or plaksi and plaksayana in short, nuvan ariles are not aded in the reninine. ir it is intended to denote a reninine descendant or the kind nuvan, the reninine word rorned by Gotra aril wil denote such a descendant also. What is here prohibited i. e. is the tern Gotra superseded by the tern nuvan? ir it is a niyana rule, there wil be no niyana with regard to the reninine, as the prohibition is contained in the sane sentence. Thererore in the reninine, the nuvan aril wil not get the designation or Gotra, because Gotra-nane is debared by nuvan nane. Thererore the sutra should be divided in two, e. g. gotrad yuni pratyayo Bavati (2) tatostriyan (1) arter a Gotra rorned word a new aril is aded in denoting a nuvan descendant, (2) but not so in the reninine. in ract the nane nuvan is prohibited in the reninine, thererore, the reninine wil be known Gotra always and never by nuvan.
ck: then a tescentant or the tescription tenotet py yuvan - civati tu vansye yuva [4.1.163], is intentet to pe elpreset, a net aril is atachet, only arter that that alreaty ents tith an aril narkink a tescentant as lot at least as a krantson (kotra): put in the reninine the tort is not ternet yuvan ant no net aril is atet. this is also a niyana or restrictive rule. thus the nuvan or karkya is karkyayana [4.1.101]. sinilarly vatsyayana, taksayana, plaksayana, Opakavi, natayani thy to te say "put in the reninine the tort is not ternet nuvan"? Opserve taksi thich is the reninine or taksi (kotra) as tel as or taksayana (nuvan). sinilarly plaksi reninine or plaksi ant plaksayana in short, nuvan ariles are not atet in the reninine. ir it is intentet to tenote a reninine tescentant or the kint nuvan, the reninine tort rornet py kotra aril til tenote such a tescentant also. that is here prohipitet i. e. is the tern kotra supersetet py the tern nuvan? ir it is a niyana rule, there til pe no niyana tith rekart to the reninine, as the prohipition is containet in the sane sentence. thererore in the reninine, the nuvan aril til not ket the tesiknation or kotra, pecause kotra-nane is teparet py nuvan nane. thererore the sutra shoult pe tivitet in to, e. k. kotrat yuni pratyayo pavati (2) tatostriyan (1) arter a kotra rornet tort a net aril is atet in tenotink a nuvan tescentant, (2) put not so in the reninine. in ract the nane nuvan is prohipitet in the reninine, thererore, the reninine til pe knotn kotra altays ant never py nuvan.
s: When a descendant of the description denoted by युवन् -- जीवति तु वंश्ये युवा [[4.1.163]], is intended to be expressed, a new affix is attached, only after that what already ends with an affix marking a descendant as low at least as a grandson (गोत्र): but in the feminine the word is not termed युवन् and no new affix is added. This is also a niyama or restrictive rule. Thus the Yuvan of गार्ग्य is गार्ग्यायणः [[4.1.101]]. Similarly वात्स्यायणः, दाक्षायणः, प्लाक्षायणः, औपगविः, नाडायनिः Why do we say "but in the Feminine the word is not termed Yuvan"? Observe दाक्षी which is the feminine of दाक्षिः (Gotra) as well as of दाक्षायणः (Yuvan). Similarly प्लाक्षी feminine of प्लाक्षिः and प्लाक्षायणः In short, Yuvan affixes are not added in the feminine. If it is intended to denote a feminine descendant of the kind Yuvan, the feminine word formed by Gotra affix will denote such a descendant also. What is here prohibited i. e. is the term Gotra superseded by the term Yuvan? If it is a niyama rule, there will be no niyama with regard to the feminine, as the prohibition is contained in the same sentence. Therefore in the feminine, the Yuvan affix will not get the designation of Gotra, because Gotra-name is debarred by Yuvan Name. Therefore the sutra should be divided in two, e. g. गोत्राद् यूनि प्रत्ययो भवति (2) ततोऽस्त्रियाम् (1) After a Gotra formed word a new affix is added in denoting a Yuvan descendant, (2) but not so in the feminine. In fact the name Yuvan is prohibited in the feminine, therefore, the feminine will be known Gotra always and never by Yuvan.

pk: The aril aril in arter a pratipadika (noninal sten) which ends in short a , in denoting a descendant. This debars an [4.1.83]. Thus daksasyapatyan = daksi descendant or Daksha. Why do we say short a (ror this is the rorce or the leter t aded to a, by [1.1.69] and [1.1.70]? The descendant or suBanya or kilalapa (words which end in long a) wil not be rorned by the aril in The descendant or dasaraTa by this sutra is dasaraTi, but the rorn dasaraTa rorned by an is also net with. as "pradiyatan dasaraTaya nETili" Give sita to the son or Dasaratha.
ck: the aril aril in arter a pratipatika (noninal sten) thich ents in short a , in tenotink a tescentant. this tepars an [4.1.83]. thus taksasyapatyan = taksi tescentant or taksha. thy to te say short a (ror this is the rorce or the leter t atet to a, py [1.1.69] ant [1.1.70]? the tescentant or supanya or kilalapa (torts thich ent in lonk a) til not pe rornet py the aril in the tescentant or tasarata py this sutra is tasarati, put the rorn tasarata rornet py an is also net tith. as "pratiyatan tasarataya nEtili" kive sita to the son or tasaratha.
s: The affix affix इञ् after a प्रातिपदिक (Nominal Stem) which ends in short अ , in denoting a descendant. This debars अण् [[4.1.83]]. Thus दक्षस्यापत्यं = दाक्षिः 'descendant of Daksha'. Why do we say short अ (for this is the force of the letter त् added to अ, by [[1.1.69]] and [[1.1.70]]? The descendant of शुभंयाः or कीलालपाः (words which end in long आ) will not be formed by the affix इञ् The descendant of दशरथ by this sutra is दाशरथिः, but the form दाशरथ formed by अण् is also met with. As "प्रदीयताम् दाशरथाय मैथिली" 'Give Sita to the son of Dasaratha.'

pk: The aril in is aded in the sense or a descendant arter the words bahu etc. Thus bahavi "a descendant or the clan or Bahu." The words Bahu &c, either do not end in short a, thus naking the last rule inaplicable; or ir they end in short a, then sone other rule would have prohibited the aplication or in. ence the necesity or the present sutra. This is a clas or words recognisable only by the rorn (akrtigana). 1 bahu, 2 upabahu, 3 upavaku, 4 nivaku, 5 sivaku, 6 vawaku, 7 upanindu (upabindu), 8 vrsali, 9 vrkala, 10 cuqa, 1 balaka, 12 nusika, 13 kusala, 14 Bagala (Cagala), 15 Druvaka, 16 Duvaka, 17 sunitra, 18 durnitra, 19 puskarasad, 20 anuharat, 21 devasarnan, 2 agnisarnan, 23 Badrasarnan, 24 susarnan, 25 kunanan, 26 sunanan, 27 pancan, 28 saptan, 29 aswan, 30 anitOjasa salopasca, 31 suDavat, 32 udancu, 3 siras, 34 nasa, 35 saravin, 36 narici, 37 ksenavadDin, 38 srnKalatodin, 39 Karanadin, 40 nagaranardin, 41 prakaranardin, 42 lonan, 43 ajigarta, 4 krsna, 45 yuDisWira, 46 arjuna, 47 sanba, 48 gada, 49 pradyuna, 50 rana, 51 udanka, 52 udaka sanjnayan, 53 sanBuyanBaso salopasca, 54 vrka, 5 cuqala, 56 salaka akrtiganoyan tena 57 satvaki 58 janGi 59 Endasarni 60 ajaDenavi ityadi Vart:- The words bahu &c nust be Proper nanes, being heads or Gotras ron whon clans take their nane: otherwise the aril in wil not be aplied. Thus the son or a private person caled bahu wil be bahava Vart:- The operations to be erected upon words denoting relation are prohibited with regard to the sane word-rorns when denoting Proper nanes. Thus the orspring or svasura neaning rather-in-law is svasurya, but when it neans a person caled svasura, then the derivative wil be svasuri The ca in the sutra indicates that other words not included in the list also take this aril. Thus janbi, Endasarni, ajaDenavi, ajabanDavi, Oquloni
ck: the aril in is atet in the sense or a tescentant arter the torts pahu etc. thus pahavi "a tescentant or the clan or pahu." the torts pahu &c, either to not ent in short a, thus nakink the last rule inaplicaple; or ir they ent in short a, then sone other rule toult have prohipitet the aplication or in. ence the necesity or the present sutra. this is a clas or torts recoknisaple only py the rorn (akrtikana). 1 pahu, 2 upapahu, 3 upavaku, 4 nivaku, 5 sivaku, 6 vataku, 7 upanintu (upapintu), 8 vrsali, 9 vrkala, 10 cuta, 1 palaka, 12 nusika, 13 kusala, 14 pakala (cakala), 15 truvaka, 16 tuvaka, 17 sunitra, 18 turnitra, 19 puskarasat, 20 anuharat, 21 tevasarnan, 2 aknisarnan, 23 patrasarnan, 24 susarnan, 25 kunanan, 26 sunanan, 27 pancan, 28 saptan, 29 astan, 30 anitOcasa salopasca, 31 sutavat, 32 utancu, 3 siras, 34 nasa, 35 saravin, 36 narici, 37 ksenavatin, 38 srnkalatotin, 39 karanatin, 40 nakaranartin, 41 prakaranartin, 42 lonan, 43 acikarta, 4 krsna, 45 yutistira, 46 arcuna, 47 sanpa, 48 kata, 49 pratyuna, 50 rana, 51 utanka, 52 utaka sancnayan, 53 sanpuyanpaso salopasca, 54 vrka, 5 cutala, 56 salaka akrtikanoyan tena 57 satvaki 58 canki 59 Entasarni 60 acatenavi ityati Vart:- the torts pahu &c nust pe proper nanes, peink heats or kotras ron thon clans take their nane: othertise the aril in til not pe apliet. thus the son or a private person calet pahu til pe pahava Vart:- the operations to pe erectet upon torts tenotink relation are prohipitet tith rekart to the sane tort-rorns then tenotink proper nanes. thus the orsprink or svasura neanink rather-in-lat is svasurya, put then it neans a person calet svasura, then the terivative til pe svasuri the ca in the sutra inticates that other torts not inclutet in the list also take this aril. thus canpi, Entasarni, acatenavi, acapantavi, Otuloni
s: The affix इञ् is added in the sense of a descendant after the words बहु etc. Thus बाहविः "a descendant of the clan of Bahu." The words 'Bahu' &c, either do not end in short अ, thus making the last rule inapplicable; or if they end in short अ, then some other rule would have prohibited the application of इञ्. Hence the necessity of the present sutra. This is a class of words recognizable only by the form (आकृतिगण). 1 बाहु, 2 उपबाहु, 3 उपवाकु, 4 निवाकु, 5 शिवाकु, 6 वटाकु, 7 उपनिन्दु (उपबिन्दु), 8 वृषली, 9 वृकला, 10 चूडा, 11 बलाका, 12 मूषिका, 13 कुशला, 14 भगला (छगला), 15 ध्रुवका, 16 धुवका, 17 सुमित्रा, 18 दुर्मित्रा, 19 पुष्करसद्, 20 अनुहरत्, 21 देवशर्मन्, 22 अग्निशर्मन्, 23 भद्रशर्मन्, 24 सुशर्मन्, 25 कुनामन्, 26 सुनामन्, 27 पञ्चन्, 28 सप्तन्, 29 अष्टन्, 30 अमितौजसः सलोपश्च, 31 सुधावत्, 32 उदञ्चु, 33 शिरस्, 34 माष, 35 शाराविन्, 36 मरीची, 37 क्षेमवद्धिन्, 38 शृङ्खलतोदिन्, 39 खरनादिन्, 40 नगरमर्दिन्, 41 प्राकारमर्दिन्, 42 लोमन्, 43 अजीगर्त, 44 कृष्ण, 45 युधिष्ठिर, 46 अर्जुन, 47 साम्ब, 48 गद, 49 प्रद्युम्न, 50 राम, 51 उदङ्क, 52 उदकः संज्ञायाम्, 53 संभूयाम्भसोः सलोपश्च, 54 वृक, 55 चूडाल, 56 सलक आकृतिगणोऽयम् तेन 57 सात्वकिः 58 जाङ्घिः 59 ऐन्दशर्मिः 60 आजधेनविः इत्यादि Vart:- The words बाहु &c must be Proper Names, being heads of Gotras from whom clans take their name: otherwise the affix इञ् will not be applied. Thus the son of a private person called बाहु will be बाहवः Vart:- The operations to be effected upon words denoting relation are prohibited with regard to the same word-forms when denoting Proper Names. Thus the offspring of श्वशुर meaning 'father-in-law' is श्वशुर्यः, but when it means a person called Svasura, then the derivative will be श्वाशुरिः The च in the sutra indicates that other words not included in the list also take this affix. Thus जाम्बिः, ऐन्दशर्मिः, आजधेनविः, आजबन्धविः, औडुलोमिः

pk: The aril in is placed arter the word suDatr in denoting the descendant and the r or suDatr is replaced by the substitute akan berore this aril. Thus suDaturapatyan = sODataki the descendant or sudhatri. Vart:- The substitute akan replaces the rinals or vyasa, varuqa, nisada, canqala and binba when the Patronynic in is to be aded. Thus, vEyasaki, varuqaki nEsadaki, canqalaki, bEnbaki
ck: the aril in is placet arter the tort sutatr in tenotink the tescentant ant the r or sutatr is replacet py the supstitute akan perore this aril. thus sutaturapatyan = sOtataki the tescentant or suthatri. Vart:- the supstitute akan replaces the rinals or vyasa, varuta, nisata, cantala ant pinpa then the patronynic in is to pe atet. thus, vEyasaki, varutaki nEsataki, cantalaki, pEnpaki
s: The affix इञ् is placed after the word सुधातृ in denoting the descendant and the ऋ of सुधातृ is replaced by the substitute अकङ् before this affix. Thus सुधातुरपत्यम् = सौधातकिः 'the descendant of Sudhatri.' Vart:- The substitute अकङ् replaces the finals of व्यास, वरुड, निषाद, चण्डाल and बिम्ब when the Patronymic इञ् is to be added. Thus, वैयासकिः, वारुडकिः नैषादकिः, चाण्डालकिः, बैम्बकिः

pk: The aril cPan cones arter the words kunca etc. when a renoter descendant (caled gotra) is to be denoted. This debars in Or the aril cPan the leter n is ror the sake or distinguishing this aril ron the aril Pan; such as in sutra [5.3.13], by which the words ending in aril cPan take the rurther aril ya (nya), in order to rorn a conplete word. The leter n or this aril causes Vridhi [7.2.17]. Then renains P which by sutra [7.1.2], is replaced by ayan Thus kunja + cPan = kOnja + ayan + a = kOnjayana. This is not a conplete word as yet. We nust ad ya by sutra [5.3.13]. Thus the rul word is kOnjayanya the grandson or a lower descendant or Kunja dual or it is kOnjayanyO, plural is kOnjayana; the aril nya being elided by [2.5.62], in the plural, it being an aril or the tadraja clas [4.1.174]. sinilarly braDrayanya, braDrayanyO, braDrayana Why do we say "when a Gotra descendant is to be denoted?" Observe kOnji "the son or Kunja". ere in is aded by [4.1.95] in denoting inediate descendant. There is direrence in the acent or these words, in the direrent nunbers. Thus in the singular and dual, the acent wil be regulated by the later n or the aril nya which is aded in those nunbers. But this aril being elided in the plural, the acent there wil be regulated by the leter ca or cPan That is to say, in the singular and dual, the udata wil ral on the rirst sylable [6.1.197]; in the plural, it wil ral on the last sylable [6.1.164]. The word gotre or this sutra governs the suceding sutras up to aphorisn [4.1.12]: so that al the ariles taught in these rirten sutras denote grandsons or descendants lower than that. 1 kunja, 2 braDra, 3 sanKa, 4 Basnan, 5 gana, 6 lonan, 7 sata, 8 saka, 9 sunqa, 10 suBa, 1 vipas, 12 skanda, 13 skanBa, 14 sakawa, 15 sunBa, 16 siva, 17 suBanyi
ck: the aril cpan cones arter the torts kunca etc. then a renoter tescentant (calet kotra) is to pe tenotet. this tepars in Or the aril cpan the leter n is ror the sake or tistinkuishink this aril ron the aril pan; such as in sutra [5.3.13], py thich the torts entink in aril cpan take the rurther aril ya (nya), in orter to rorn a conplete tort. the leter n or this aril causes Vrithi [7.2.17]. then renains p thich py sutra [7.1.2], is replacet py ayan thus kunca + cpan = kOnca + ayan + a = kOncayana. this is not a conplete tort as yet. te nust at ya py sutra [5.3.13]. thus the rul tort is kOncayanya the krantson or a loter tescentant or kunca tual or it is kOncayanyO, plural is kOncayana; the aril nya peink elitet py [2.5.62], in the plural, it peink an aril or the tatraca clas [4.1.174]. sinilarly pratrayanya, pratrayanyO, pratrayana thy to te say "then a kotra tescentant is to pe tenotet?" Opserve kOnci "the son or kunca". ere in is atet py [4.1.95] in tenotink inetiate tescentant. there is tirerence in the acent or these torts, in the tirerent nunpers. thus in the sinkular ant tual, the acent til pe rekulatet py the later n or the aril nya thich is atet in those nunpers. put this aril peink elitet in the plural, the acent there til pe rekulatet py the leter ca or cpan that is to say, in the sinkular ant tual, the utata til ral on the rirst sylaple [6.1.197]; in the plural, it til ral on the last sylaple [6.1.164]. the tort kotre or this sutra koverns the sucetink sutras up to aphorisn [4.1.12]: so that al the ariles taukht in these rirten sutras tenote krantsons or tescentants loter than that. 1 kunca, 2 pratra, 3 sanka, 4 pasnan, 5 kana, 6 lonan, 7 sata, 8 saka, 9 sunta, 10 supa, 1 vipas, 12 skanta, 13 skanpa, 14 sakata, 15 sunpa, 16 siva, 17 supanyi
s: The affix च्फञ् comes after the words कुञ्च etc. when a remoter descendant (called गोत्र) is to be denoted. This debars इञ् Of the affix च्फञ् the letter ञ् is for the sake of distinguishing this affix from the affix फञ्; such as in sutra [[5.3.113]], by which the words ending in affix च्फञ् take the further affix य (ञ्य), in order to form a complete word. The letter ञ् of this affix causes Vriddhi [[7.2.117]]. Then remains फ् which by sutra [[7.1.2]], is replaced by आयन् Thus कुञ्ज + च्फञ् = कौञ्ज + आयन् + अ = कौञ्जायन. This is not a complete word as yet. We must add य by sutra [[5.3.113]]. Thus the full word is कौञ्जायन्यः 'the grandson or a lower descendant of Kunja' dual of it is कौञ्जायन्यौ, plural is कौञ्जायनाः; the affix ञ्य being elided by [[2.5.62]], in the plural, it being an affix of the तद्राज class [[4.1.174]]. Similarly ब्राध्रायन्यः, ब्राध्रायन्यौ, ब्राध्रायनाः Why do we say "when a Gotra descendant is to be denoted?" Observe कौंजिः "the son of Kunja". Here इञ् is added by [[4.1.95]] in denoting immediate descendant. There is difference in the accent of these words, in the different numbers. Thus in the singular and dual, the accent will be regulated by the latter ञ् of the affix ञ्य which is added in those numbers. But this affix being elided in the plural, the accent there will be regulated by the letter च of च्फञ् That is to say, in the singular and dual, the udatta will fall on the first syllable [[6.1.197]]; in the plural, it will fall on the last syllable [[6.1.164]]. The word गोत्रे of this sutra governs the succeeding sutras up to aphorism [[4.1.112]]: so that all the affixes taught in these fifteen sutras denote grandsons or descendants lower than that. 1 कुञ्ज, 2 ब्रध्र, 3 शङ्ख, 4 भस्मन्, 5 गण, 6 लोमन्, 7 शत, 8 शाक, 9 शुण्डा, 10 शुभ, 11 विपाश्, 12 स्कन्द, 13 स्कम्भ, 14 शकट, 15 शुम्भा, 16 शिव, 17 शुभंयि

pk: The aril Pak cones, in denoting a gotra descendant arter the pratipadika (noninal stens) naqa etc. Thus naqayana (naqa + Pak = naqa + ayana [7.2.18] and [7.1.2]). sinilarly carayana "the grandson or a lower descendant or nada or Chara". But the son or naqa wil be naqi [4.1.95]. The word salanku is changed to salanka berore this aril. Thus salankayana The word salanki ocurs in pEladi clas [2.4.59], the nuvan aril is, thererore, elided arter it, thus salanki is a conon nane ror rather and son. it takes in by [4.1.96], as belonging to Bahvadi clas which is an akrti-gana. The word agnisarnan takes Pak when denoting the vrsagana gotra, e.g. agnisarnayana = varsyaganya; otherwise the rorn wil be agnisarna The word krsna wil rorn karsnayana when a Brahnana is neant; otherwise karsni, so also ranayana = vasisWa, otherwise rani The word kroswu is changed to kroswa as krOswayana 1 naqa, 2 cara, (vara) 3 baka, 4 nunja, 5 itika, 6 itisa, 7 upaka, 8 eka, 9 lanaka 10 salanku salankan ca 1 saptala, 12 vajapya, 13 tika 14 agnisarnanvrsagane 15 prana 16 nara, 17 sayaka, 18 dasa, 19 nitra, 20 dvipa, 21 pingara, 2 pingala, 23 kinkara, 24 kinkala, 25 katara, 26 katala, 27 kasyapa (kusyapa) 28 kasya, 29 kalya (kavya) 30 aja, 31 anusya (anusna) 32 krsnaranO brahnanavasisWe 3 anitra, 34 ligu, 35 citra, 36 kunara, 37 kroswu kroswan ca 38 lohan, 39 durga, 40 stanBa, 41 sinsaPa, 42 agra, 43 trna, 4 sakawa, 45 sunanasa, 46 sunata, 47 ninata, 48 rca, 49 jalanDara, 50 aDvara, 51 yuganDara, 52 hansaka, 53 danqin, 54 hastin, 5 pinqa, 56 pancala, 57 canasin, 58 sukrtya, 59 sTiraka, 60 brahnana, 61 cawaka, 62 badara, 63 asvala, 64 Karapa, 65 lanka, 6 inDa, 67 asra, 68 kanuka, 69 brahnadata, 70 udunbara, 71 sona, 72 aloha, 73 danqapa, 74 jat, 75 asvaka, 76 vanasya, 7 navya, 78 anvajata, 79 antajana, 80 itvara, 81 ansaka, 82 yana, 83 kana, 84 vata
ck: the aril pak cones, in tenotink a kotra tescentant arter the pratipatika (noninal stens) nata etc. thus natayana (nata + pak = nata + ayana [7.2.18] ant [7.1.2]). sinilarly carayana "the krantson or a loter tescentant or nata or chara". put the son or nata til pe nati [4.1.95]. the tort salanku is chanket to salanka perore this aril. thus salankayana the tort salanki ocurs in pElati clas [2.4.59], the nuvan aril is, thererore, elitet arter it, thus salanki is a conon nane ror rather ant son. it takes in py [4.1.96], as pelonkink to pahvati clas thich is an akrti-kana. the tort aknisarnan takes pak then tenotink the vrsakana kotra, e.k. aknisarnayana = varsyakanya; othertise the rorn til pe aknisarna the tort krsna til rorn karsnayana then a prahnana is neant; othertise karsni, so also ranayana = vasista, othertise rani the tort krostu is chanket to krosta as krOstayana 1 nata, 2 cara, (vara) 3 paka, 4 nunca, 5 itika, 6 itisa, 7 upaka, 8 eka, 9 lanaka 10 salanku salankan ca 1 saptala, 12 vacapya, 13 tika 14 aknisarnanvrsakane 15 prana 16 nara, 17 sayaka, 18 tasa, 19 nitra, 20 tvipa, 21 pinkara, 2 pinkala, 23 kinkara, 24 kinkala, 25 katara, 26 katala, 27 kasyapa (kusyapa) 28 kasya, 29 kalya (kavya) 30 aca, 31 anusya (anusna) 32 krsnaranO prahnanavasiste 3 anitra, 34 liku, 35 citra, 36 kunara, 37 krostu krostan ca 38 lohan, 39 turka, 40 stanpa, 41 sinsapa, 42 akra, 43 trna, 4 sakata, 45 sunanasa, 46 sunata, 47 ninata, 48 rca, 49 calantara, 50 atvara, 51 yukantara, 52 hansaka, 53 tantin, 54 hastin, 5 pinta, 56 pancala, 57 canasin, 58 sukrtya, 59 stiraka, 60 prahnana, 61 cataka, 62 patara, 63 asvala, 64 karapa, 65 lanka, 6 inta, 67 asra, 68 kanuka, 69 prahnatata, 70 utunpara, 71 sona, 72 aloha, 73 tantapa, 74 cat, 75 asvaka, 76 vanasya, 7 navya, 78 anvacata, 79 antacana, 80 itvara, 81 ansaka, 82 yana, 83 kana, 84 vata
s: The affix फक् comes, in denoting a गोत्र descendant after the प्रातिपदिक (Nominal Stems) नड etc. Thus नाडायनः (नड + फक् = नाड + आयन [[7.2.118]] and [[7.1.2]]). Similarly चारायणः "the grandson or a lower descendant of Nada or Chara". But the son of नड will be नाडिः [[4.1.95]]. The word शलंकु is changed to शलंक before this affix. Thus शालंकायनः The word शालंकिः occurs in पैलादि class [[2.4.59]], the Yuvan affix is, therefore, elided after it, thus शालंकिः is a common name for 'father' and 'son'. It takes इञ् by [[4.1.96]], as belonging to Bahvadi class which is an Akrti-gana. The word अग्निशर्मन् takes फक् when denoting the वृषगण gotra, e.g. आग्निशर्मायणः = वार्ष्यगण्यः; otherwise the form will be आग्निशर्मः The word कृष्ण will form कार्ष्णायनः when a Brahmana is meant; otherwise कार्ष्णिः, so also राणायनः = वासिष्ठः, otherwise राणिः The word क्रोष्टु is changed to क्रोष्ट as क्रौष्टायनः 1 नड, 2 चर, (वर) 3 बक, 4 मुंज, 5 इतिक, 6 इतिश, 7 उपक, 8 एक, 9 लमक 10 शलंकु शलङ्कं च 11 सप्तल, 12 वाजप्य, 13 तिक 14 अग्निशर्मन्वृषगणे 15 प्राण 16 नर, 17 सायक, 18 दास, 19 मित्र, 20 द्वीप, 21 पिङ्गर, 22 पिङ्गल, 23 किंकर, 24 किङ्कल, 25 कातर, 26 कातल, 27 काश्यप (कुश्यप) 28 काश्य, 29 काल्य (काव्य) 30 अज, 31 अमुष्य (अमुष्म) 32 कृष्णरणौ ब्राह्मणवासिष्ठे 33 अमित्र, 34 लिगु, 35 चित्र, 36 कुमार, 37 क्रोष्टु क्रोष्टं च 38 लोहं, 39 दुर्ग, 40 स्तम्भ, 41 शिंशफा, 42 अग्र, 43 तृण, 44 शकट, 45 सुमनस, 46 सुमत, 47 मिमत, 48 ऋच, 49 जलंधर, 50 अध्वर, 51 युगंधर, 52 हंसक, 53 दण्डिन्, 54 हस्तिन्, 55 पिण्ड, 56 पंचाल, 57 चमसिन्, 58 सुकृत्य, 59 स्थिरक, 60 ब्राह्मण, 61 चटक, 62 बदर, 63 अश्वल, 64 खरप, 65 लङ्क, 66 इन्ध, 67 अस्र, 68 कामुक, 69 ब्रह्मदत्त, 70 उदुम्बर, 71 शोण, 72 अलोह, 73 दण्डप, 74 जत्, 75 अश्वक, 76 वानष्य, 77 नाव्य, 78 अन्वजत, 79 अन्तजन, 80 इत्वरा, 81 अंशक, 82 याम, 83 काम, 84 वात

pk: The aril Pak cones arter the words harita etc. when they end in the aril an - anrsyanantarye bidadiByon [4.1.104] The words harita &c, rorn a subdivision or bida clas, which clas by [4.1.104] takes the aril an in rorning Gotra words. Thus the Gotra descendant or harita wil be harita (harita + an). The son or harita wil be rorned by this sutra and not by [4.1.95]. Thus harita + Pak = haritayana "the son or arita or the great-grandson or arita". in ract, the rorce or the aril Pak or this sutra is that or a nuvan aril, though it is taught in the chapter or Gotra ariles; because acording to the general rule [4.1.98] one Gotra aril can be only aded to a word, and the word harita that being already rorned by a Gotra aril an wil not take again another Gotra aril Pak Thererore, Pak as is here a nuvan-aril.
ck: the aril pak cones arter the torts harita etc. then they ent in the aril an - anrsyanantarye pitatipyon [4.1.104] the torts harita &c, rorn a suptivision or pita clas, thich clas py [4.1.104] takes the aril an in rornink kotra torts. thus the kotra tescentant or harita til pe harita (harita + an). the son or harita til pe rornet py this sutra ant not py [4.1.95]. thus harita + pak = haritayana "the son or arita or the kreat-krantson or arita". in ract, the rorce or the aril pak or this sutra is that or a nuvan aril, thoukh it is taukht in the chapter or kotra ariles; pecause acortink to the keneral rule [4.1.98] one kotra aril can pe only atet to a tort, ant the tort harita that peink alreaty rornet py a kotra aril an til not take akain another kotra aril pak thererore, pak as is here a nuvan-aril.
s: The affix फक् comes after the words हरित etc. when they end in the affix अञ् -- अनृष्यानन्तर्ये बिदादिभ्योऽञ् [[4.1.104]] The words हरित &c, form a subdivision of बिद class, which class by [[4.1.104]] takes the affix अञ् in forming Gotra words. Thus the Gotra descendant of हरित will be हारित (हरित + अञ्). The son of हारित will be formed by this sutra and not by [[4.1.95]]. Thus हारित + फक् = हारितायनः "the son of Harita or the great-grandson of Harita". In fact, the force of the affix फक् of this Sutra is that of a Yuvan affix, though it is taught in the chapter of Gotra affixes; because according to the general rule [[4.1.98]] one Gotra affix can be only added to a word, and the word हारित that being already formed by a Gotra affix अञ् will not take again another Gotra affix फक् Therefore, फक् as is here a Yuvan-affix.

pk: The aril Pak is aded in denoting a descendent arter a pratipadika (noninal sten) ending in the ariles yan or in The Pak or this sutra has, like that or the preceding sutra, the rorce or a nuvan aril, since it is to be aded to words rorned by the Gotra ariles yan and in Thus garga + yan [4.1.105] = gargya gargya + Pak = gargyayana daksa + in = daksi; daksi + Pak = daksayana it is not every word which ends in yan or in which takes the nuvan aril Pak; but only that word where the aril yan or in has the rorce or a Gotra aril. Thus the aril yan is aded by [4.3.10] to denote prolinity to a sea. as dvipa + yan = dvEpya This word wil not take the aril Pak sinilarly by [4.2.80] the aril in is aded to the words sutangana &c, the rorce or the aril being caturarTika Thus sOtangani. This word wil not take the aril Pak
ck: the aril pak is atet in tenotink a tescentent arter a pratipatika (noninal sten) entink in the ariles yan or in the pak or this sutra has, like that or the precetink sutra, the rorce or a nuvan aril, since it is to pe atet to torts rornet py the kotra ariles yan ant in thus karka + yan [4.1.105] = karkya karkya + pak = karkyayana taksa + in = taksi; taksi + pak = taksayana it is not every tort thich ents in yan or in thich takes the nuvan aril pak; put only that tort there the aril yan or in has the rorce or a kotra aril. thus the aril yan is atet py [4.3.10] to tenote prolinity to a sea. as tvipa + yan = tvEpya this tort til not take the aril pak sinilarly py [4.2.80] the aril in is atet to the torts sutankana &c, the rorce or the aril peink caturartika thus sOtankani. this tort til not take the aril pak
s: The affix फक् is added in denoting a descendent after a प्रातिपदिक (Nominal Stem) ending in the affixes यञ् or इञ् The फक् of this sutra has, like that of the preceding sutra, the force of a Yuvan affix, since it is to be added to words formed by the Gotra affixes यञ् and इञ् Thus गर्ग + यञ् [[4.1.105]] = गार्ग्यः गार्ग्य + फक् = गार्ग्यायणः दक्ष + इञ् = दाक्षिः; दाक्षि + फक् = दाक्षायणः It is not every word which ends in यञ् or इञ् which takes the Yuvan affix फक्; but only that word where the affix यञ् or इञ् has the force of a Gotra affix. Thus the affix यञ् is added by [[4.3.10]] to denote proximity to a sea. As द्वीप + यञ् = द्वैप्यः This word will not take the affix फक् Similarly by [[4.2.80]] the affix इञ् is added to the words सुतंगम &c, the force of the affix being चातुरर्थिक Thus सौतंगमिः. This word will not take the affix फक्

s: The affix फक् comes in denoting a गोत्र (Patronymic) descendant after the words 1. शरद्वत् 2. शुनक 3. दर्भा when they denote the descendants of भृगु , वत्स and अग्रायण , respectively. Thus शारद्वातायनः = भार्गवः otherwise शारद्वतः (formed by अञ्) शौनकायनः = वात्स्यः, otherwise शौनकः, दार्भायणः = आग्रायणः, otherwise दार्भिः, (formed by इञ् [[4.1.95]]). The words शरद्वत् and शुनक belonging to बिदादि class would by [[4.1.104]] have taken the affix अञ् in denoting Gotra, the present sutra prohibits that in certain cases and enjoins फक् instead.

s: The affix फक् comes in the sense of a गोत्र (Patronymic) descendant, optionally after the words 1. द्रोण 2. पर्वत and 3. जीवन्त This debars इञ् of [[4.1.95]]. Thus द्रौणायनः or द्रौणिः, पार्वतायनः or पार्वतिः जैवन्तायनः or जैवन्तिः The affix फक् is employed in denoting a remote (gotra) offspring and not an immediate descendant or son. How is then अश्वत्थामा the son of Drona, called द्रौणायनः and not द्रौणिः in the phrase "अश्वत्थामा द्रौणायनः"? The द्रोण here does not refer to the Drona of the Mahabharat, but to some ancient founder of a clan of that name, and his descendants were called द्रौणायनाः In modern times, by an easy error, Asvatthama was called Draunayana, owing to the similarity of sounds.

pk: The aril an cones arter the words bida etc. in denoting a renote (gotra) descendant, but arter those words or this clas which are not the nanes or ancient sages, the aril an has the rorce or denoting inediate descendant. This sutra consists or rour words: anrsi "non-nishi or not being the nane or a sage"; anantarye "in elpresing an inediate descendant." bidadiBya "arter Bidadi words" an "the aril an." Thus or the words raling in Bidadi clas, the words like putra son, duhitra daughter, nanandr sister-in-law are conon nouns and not nanes or nishis. When the aril an is aded to these words, it has the rorce or denoting inediate descendant. Thus putra + an = pOtra grand-son. duhitr + an = dOhitra daughters son. But when aded to other words which elpres the nanes or nishis, the aril an nakes the Gotra descendants. Thus bida + an = bEda the grandson or a descendant lower than that or Bida. ow in a contelt relating to Gotra ariles, we cone to this two rold neaning or this sutra? To this we reply, that the phrase anrsyanantarye should be thus construed. The word anrishi is in the ablative case, the case aril being elided. The word anantarya is the sane as anantara the aril syan being aded without change or signiricance. Thererore the words like pOtra &c. denote the inediate (anantara) descendant or putra &c, and do not denote a renote descendant (gotra), nor a descendant in general. Thererore, the above phrase neans :- arter a Bidadi word which is not the nane or a nishi, the aril an is aded in denoting an inediate descendant. Q. another way or elplaining the phrase is this, the word anantarya is equal tonairantarya = uninterupted sucesion. Thererore, where there is an uninterupted sucesion or nishis betwen the rirst nane and the person to be designated by a Patronynic, there the aril an wil not be aded. Thus the word kasyapa, belongs to the Bidadi clas. indrabhu a seventh descendant or Kasyapa, wil not be denoted by kasyapa rorned with an, because betwen indraBu and kasyapa, there is an unbroken series or nishis, but by an or [4.1.14]. Thererore the rolowing phrase wil be valid indraBu saptana kasyapanan ror an is elided in the plural by [2.4.64], but kasyapanan is plural or kasyapa rorned with the general patronynic an or [4.1.14] and hence not elided. a. This elplanation is not to be prerered, nerely in order to elplain the word kasyapanan in indraBu saptana kasyapanan The general Patronynic rsi aril an or [4.1.14] is not debared by this an Thererore kasyapa

s: The affix अञ् comes after the words बिद etc. in denoting a remote (गोत्र) descendant, but after those words of this class which are not the names of ancient sages, the affix अञ् has the force of denoting immediate descendant. This Sutra consists of four words: अनृषि "non-Rishi or not being the name of a sage"; आनन्तर्ये "in expressing an immediate descendant." बिदादिभ्य "after Bidadi words" अञ् "the affix अञ्." Thus of the words falling in Bidadi class, the words like पुत्र 'son,' दुहित्र 'daughter,' ननान्दृ 'sister-in-law' are common nouns and not names of Rishis. When the affix अञ् is added to these words, it has the force of denoting immediate descendant. Thus पुत्र + अञ् = पौत्रः 'grand-son.' दुहितृ + अञ् = दौहित्रः 'daughter's son.' But when added to other words which express the names of Rishis, the affix अञ् makes the Gotra descendants. Thus बिद + अञ् = बैदः 'the grandson or a descendant lower than that of Bida.' How in a context relating to Gotra affixes, we come to this two fold meaning of this sutra? To this we reply, that the phrase अनृष्यानन्तर्ये should be thus construed. The word 'anrishi' is in the ablative case, the case affix being elided. The word आनन्तर्य is the same as अनन्तर the affix ष्यङ् being added without change of significance. Therefore the words like पौत्र &c. denote the immediate (anantara) descendant of पुत्र &c, and do not denote a remote descendant (gotra), nor a descendant in general. Therefore, the above phrase means :- 'after a Bidadi word which is not the name of a Rishi, the affix 'an' is added in denoting an immediate descendant.' Q. Another way of explaining the phrase is this, the word 'anantarya' is equal to'nairantarya' = 'uninterrupted succession.' Therefore, where there is an uninterrupted succession of Rishis between the first name and the person to be designated by a Patronymic, there the affix 'an' will not be added. Thus the word कश्यप, belongs to the Bidadi class. 'Indrabhu' a seventh descendant of Kasyapa, will not be denoted by काश्यप formed with अञ्, because between इन्द्रभू and कश्यप, there is an unbroken series of Rishis, but by अण् of [[4.1.114]]. Therefore the following phrase will be valid इन्द्रभूः सप्तमः काश्यपानाम् For अञ् is elided in the plural by [[2.4.64]], but काश्यपानाम् is plural of काश्यप formed with the general patronymic अण् of [[4.1.114]] and hence not elided. A. This explanation is not to be preferred, merely in order to explain the word काश्यपानाम् in इन्द्रभूः सप्तमः काश्यपानाम् The general Patronymic ऋषि affix अण् of [[4.1.114]] is not debarred by this अञ् Therefore काश्यप with अञ् will denote इन्द्रभूः, which may also be denoted by काश्यप formed with अण् For had the above explanation been correct, then विश्वामित्र the grandson of Kusika could never be called कौशिकः (formed with अञ्), for both Gadhi the father of Visvamitra, and Kusika the grand-father were Rishis. In denoting an immediate descendant or a descendant in general, the Rishi words बिद &c, will take other appropriate affixes. Thus बिद forms बैदि 'a descendant of Bida' by [[4.1.96]] इञ् and not by ऋष्यण् of [[4.1.114]], because बिद is supposed to belong to the Akrtigana of Bahvadi. 1 बिद, 2 उर्व, 3 कश्यप, 4 कुशिक, 5 भरद्वाज, 6 उपमन्यु, 7 किलात, 8 कन्दर्प (किंदर्भ) 9 विश्वानर, 10 ऋषिषेण (ऋष्टिशेण) 11 ऋतभाग, 12 हर्यश्व, 13 प्रियक, 14 आपस्तम्ब, 15 कूचवार, 16 शरद्वत्, 17 शुनक (शुनक्), 18 धेनु, 19 गोपवन, 20 शिग्रु, 21 बिन्दु, 22 भोगक, 23 भाजन, 24 शमिक, 25 अश्वावतान, 26 श्यामाक, 27 श्यानक, 28 दयावलि, 29 श्यापर्ण, 30 हरित, 31 किंदास, 32 बह्यस्क, 33 अर्कजूष (अर्कलूक) 34 बध्योग, 35 विष्णु, 36 बुद्ध, 37 प्रतिबोध, 38 रचित, 39 रथीतर (रथन्तर) 40 गविष्ठिर, 41 निषाद, 42 शबर, 43 अलस, 44 मठर, 45 मृडाकु, 46 सृपाकु, 47 मृदु, 48 पुनर्भू, 49 पूत्र, 50 दुहितृ, 51 ननान्दृ, 52 परस्त्री परशुं च 53 किलालप, 54 सम्बक्, 55 श्यायक The word परस्त्री in the above list is replaced by परशु when taking the affix अञ् Thus परस्त्रिया अपत्यं = पारशवः (the son of a Brahmana begotten on a Sudra woman, who though married to the Bra

The affix यञ् comes in denoting a Gotra offspring, but in denoting a descendant in general, this affix will not come, and hence no shpha also. If so, then why the immediate descendant of जमदग्नि is called जामदग्न्यः which is a Name of Parasuram the son of Jamadagni, or why Vyasa the son of Parasara is called पाराशर्यः ? These are exceptions formed by गोत्र रुपाध्यारोपः i.e. by superimposing of Gotra-form on these. Their proper apatya forms are by ऋष्यण् [[4.1.114]] i. e. जामदग्नः and पाराशरः

pk: The aril yan cones, in the sense or a gotra (Patronynic) descendant arter the words 1. naDu and 2. baBru when the words so rorned nean brahnana and kOsika respectively. Thus naDavya = brahnana Brahnana. Otherwise naDava "son or nadhu." baBravya = kOsika Otherwise baBrava The word baBru belongs to the Gargadi clas, so it would have taken yan by the last sutra also. The present sutra declares a restriction, vis. baBru takes yan only then when kOsika is denoted. its being read in the Gargadi clas serves another purpose : as it belongs to the sub-clas lohitadi, the rule [4.1.18] becones aplicable to it; so that its reninine is rorned by sPa. Thus baBravyayani in ract, it would have ben beter, ir in the body or the Ganapatha, instead or writing baBru alone, there was baBru kOsike it would have saved the repetition or it in the present sutra.
ck: the aril yan cones, in the sense or a kotra (patronynic) tescentant arter the torts 1. natu ant 2. papru then the torts so rornet nean prahnana ant kOsika respectively. thus natavya = prahnana prahnana. Othertise natava "son or nathu." papravya = kOsika Othertise paprava the tort papru pelonks to the karkati clas, so it toult have taken yan py the last sutra also. the present sutra teclares a restriction, vis. papru takes yan only then then kOsika is tenotet. its peink reat in the karkati clas serves another purpose : as it pelonks to the sup-clas lohitati, the rule [4.1.18] pecones aplicaple to it; so that its reninine is rornet py spa. thus papravyayani in ract, it toult have pen peter, ir in the poty or the kanapatha, insteat or tritink papru alone, there tas papru kOsike it toult have savet the repetition or it in the present sutra.
s: The affix यञ् comes, in the sense of a गोत्र (Patronymic) descendant after the words 1. मधु and 2. बभ्रु when the words so formed mean ब्राह्मण and कौशिक respectively. Thus माधव्यः = ब्राह्मणः 'Brahmana.' Otherwise माधवः "son of Madhu." बाभ्रव्यः = कौशिकः Otherwise बाभ्रवः The word बभ्रु belongs to the Gargadi class, so it would have taken yan by the last sutra also. The present sutra declares a restriction, viz. बभ्रु takes यञ् only then when कौशिक is denoted. Its being read in the Gargadi class serves another purpose : as it belongs to the sub-class लोहितादि, the rule [[4.1.18]] becomes applicable to it; so that its feminine is formed by ष्फ. Thus बाभ्रव्यायणी In fact, it would have been better, if in the body of the Ganapatha, instead of writing बभ्रु alone, there was बभ्रु कौशिके It would have saved the repetition of it in the present sutra.

pk: The aril yan cones in the sense or a gotra (Patronynic) descendant arter the words 1. kapiand 2. boDa when the special descendants or the ranily or angirasa are neant. Thus kapi + yan = kapya the grand-son or a stil lower descendant or Kapi or the ranily or angiras. so also bODya Why do we say or the ranily or angiras ? Observe kapeya [4.1.12] "the gotra-descendant or Kapi" so also bODi rorned by in because it is a non-nishi word or because it belongs to Bahvadi [4.1.96] clas. The word kapi ocurs in Gargadi clas. The present sutra declares a restriction i. e. the yan is to be aplied only when angirasa descendant is neant. it is included in the Gargadi clas also ror the purpose or aplying [4.1.18]. Thus kapyayani "grand-daughter or a stil lower descendant or Kapi."
ck: the aril yan cones in the sense or a kotra (patronynic) tescentant arter the torts 1. kapiant 2. pota then the special tescentants or the ranily or ankirasa are neant. thus kapi + yan = kapya the krant-son or a stil loter tescentant or kapi or the ranily or ankiras. so also pOtya thy to te say or the ranily or ankiras ? Opserve kapeya [4.1.12] "the kotra-tescentant or kapi" so also pOti rornet py in pecause it is a non-nishi tort or pecause it pelonks to pahvati [4.1.96] clas. the tort kapi ocurs in karkati clas. the present sutra teclares a restriction i. e. the yan is to pe apliet only then ankirasa tescentant is neant. it is inclutet in the karkati clas also ror the purpose or aplyink [4.1.18]. thus kapyayani "krant-taukhter or a stil loter tescentant or kapi."
s: The affix यञ् comes in the sense of a गोत्र (Patronymic) descendant after the words 1. कपिand 2. बोध when the special descendants of the family of अङ्गिरस are meant. Thus कपि + यञ् = काप्यः 'the grand-son or a still lower descendant of 'Kapi' of the family of Angiras.' So also बौध्यः Why do we say of the family of Angiras ? Observe कापेयः [[4.1.122]] "the gotra-descendant of Kapi" so also बौधिः formed by इञ् because it is a Non-Rishi word or because it belongs to Bahvadi [[4.1.96]] class. The word कपि occurs in Gargadi class. The present sutra declares a restriction i. e. the 'yan' is to be applied only when Angirasa descendant is meant. It is included in the Gargadi class also for the purpose of applying [[4.1.18]]. Thus काप्यायनी "grand-daughter or a still lower descendant of Kapi."

pk: The aril yan cones in the sense or a gotra (Patronynic) descendant arter the word vatanqa when neaning a descendant or angirasa Thus vatanqya = angirasa, otherwise vatanqa The word vatanqa ocurs both in the Gargadi clas [4.1.105] and in the sivadi clas [4.1.12]. it would have taken both ariles an and an. The present sutra declares that when it neans an angirasa, then vatanqa wil not take an or the sivadi clas : and when it does not nean angirasa, then it takes both these ariles e. g. vatanqya and vatanqa any descendant or Vatanda.
ck: the aril yan cones in the sense or a kotra (patronynic) tescentant arter the tort vatanta then neanink a tescentant or ankirasa thus vatantya = ankirasa, othertise vatanta the tort vatanta ocurs poth in the karkati clas [4.1.105] ant in the sivati clas [4.1.12]. it toult have taken poth ariles an ant an. the present sutra teclares that then it neans an ankirasa, then vatanta til not take an or the sivati clas : ant then it toes not nean ankirasa, then it takes poth these ariles e. k. vatantya ant vatanta any tescentant or Vatanta.
s: The affix यञ् comes in the sense of a गोत्र (Patronymic) descendant after the word वतण्ड when meaning a descendant of अङ्गिरस Thus वातण्ड्यः = आंगिरसः, otherwise वातण्डः The word वतण्ड occurs both in the Gargadi class [[4.1.105]] and in the Sivadi class [[4.1.112]]. It would have taken both affixes अञ् and अण्. The present sutra declares that when it means an Angirasa, then वतण्ड will not take अण् of the शिवादि class : and when it does not mean Angirasa, then it takes both these affixes e. g. वातंड्यः and वातंडः any descendant of Vatanda.

pk: The aril yan is luk elided in the reninine arter the word vatanqi when neaning a renale descendant or angirasa Thus ron vatanqa we get vatanqya in the nasculine. in the reninine the yan is elided by luk, and we have vatanqya + nin [4.1.73] = vatanqi "a renale descendant or Vatanda or the clan angirasa." Why do we say "or angirasa?" Observe vatanqyayani rorned with shpha under lohitadi rule [5.1.18]. When vatanqa takes an under sivadi clas, its reninine is vatanqi Though the word is rorned with an yet in the reninine, there is not syan substitution [4.1.78], because Vatanda is a nishi-nane.
ck: the aril yan is luk elitet in the reninine arter the tort vatanti then neanink a renale tescentant or ankirasa thus ron vatanta te ket vatantya in the nasculine. in the reninine the yan is elitet py luk, ant te have vatantya + nin [4.1.73] = vatanti "a renale tescentant or Vatanta or the clan ankirasa." thy to te say "or ankirasa?" Opserve vatantyayani rornet tith shpha unter lohitati rule [5.1.18]. then vatanta takes an unter sivati clas, its reninine is vatanti thoukh the tort is rornet tith an yet in the reninine, there is not syan supstitution [4.1.78], pecause Vatanta is a nishi-nane.
s: The affix यञ् is लुक् elided in the feminine after the word वतण्डी when meaning a female descendant of अङ्गिरस Thus from वतण्डः we get वातण्ड्य in the masculine. In the feminine the यञ् is elided by luk, and we have वातण्ड्य + ङीन् [[4.1.73]] = वतण्डी "a female descendant of Vatanda of the clan Angirasa." Why do we say "of Angirasa?" Observe वातंड्यायनी formed with 'shpha' under lohitadi rule [[5.1.18]]. When वतण्ड takes अण् under Sivadi class, its feminine is वातण्डी Though the word is formed with अण् yet in the feminine, there is not ष्यङ् substitution [[4.1.78]], because Vatanda is a Rishi-Name.
