s: The affix फञ् comes in the sense of a गोत्र (Patronymic) descendant after the words अश्व etc. The anuvritti of angirasa does not extend to this aphorism. Thus अश्व + फञ् = अश्व + आयन [[7.1.2]] = आश्वायनः [[7.2.117]] 'the grandson or a still lower descendant of Asva'. Similarly आश्मायनः There are some words in this class which already have taken a patronymic affix, e.g, आत्रेय, वैल्य, and आनडुह्य After these words the affix फञ् of course has the force of a Yuvan affix. The word आत्रेय is formed by त्रि + ढक् [[4.1.122]], वैल्य = विलि (a Rajarshi) + ञ्यङ् [[4.1.171]], and आनडुह्य = अमडुह + यञ् [[4.1.105]]. The word शय takes phan only when it denotes an Atreya, as शायायनः, otherwise शायिः with इञ् or शायः with अण् The word जात takes 'phan' only when the offspring of a male is to be denoted, as जातस्यापत्यं = जातायनः but जाताया अपत्यं = जातेयः with ढक् The word आत्रेय takes 'phan' when denoting a Bharadvaja, as आत्रेयायनः, otherwise it will take the affix इञ्, which will be elided by [[2.4.28]], leaving the form आत्रेयः The words भरद्वाज आत्रेये of the above list mean that when a person born in Atri Gotra is adopted by a person belonging to Bharadvaja Gotra, then the affix is to be added, he of course is an Atreya but gets a new Gotra of Bharadvaja. Thus भारद्वाजायनः, otherwise the form will be भारद्वाजः with अञ् of [[4.1.104]]. 1 अश्व 2 अश्मन् 3 शंख 4 शूद्रक 5 विद 6 पुट 7 रोहिण 8 खर्जूर (खजूर) 9 खण्जार 10 बस्त 11 पिजूल 12 भडिल 13 भण्डिल 14 भडित 15 भण्डित 16 प्रकृत 17 रामोद 18 क्षान्त 19 काश 20 तीक्ष्ण 21 गोलांक 22 अर्क 23 स्वर 24 स्फुट 25 चक्र 26 श्रविष्ठ 27 पविन्द 28 पवित्र 29 गोमिन् 30 श्याम 31 धूम 32 धूम्र 33 वाग्मिन् 34 विश्वानर 35 कुट 36 शप आत्रेये 37 जन 38 जड 39 खड 40 ग्रीष्म 41 अर्ह 42 कित 43 विशंप 44 विशाल 45 गिरि 46 चपल 47 चुप 48 दासक 49 वैल्य 50 (वैल्व) प्राच्य 51 धर्म्य 52 आनडुह्य 53 पुंसि जाते 54 अर्जुन 55 प्रहृत 56 सुमनस् 57 दुर्मनस् 58 नम 59 (मनस्) प्रान्त 60 ध्वन 61 आत्रेय भरद्वाजे 62 भरद्वाज आत्रेये 63 उत्स 64 आतव 65 कितव 66 वद 67 धन्य 68 पाद 69 शिव 70 खदिर 71 भण्डिक 72 ग्रीवा 73 कुल 74 काण 75 नड 76 वीक्ष्य, 77 वह, 78 खेड, 79 नत्त 80 ओजस, 81 नम

s: The affix अण् comes in the sense of a descendant after the words शिव etc. The anuvritti of the word गोत्रे [[4.1.98]] does not extend to this sutra. The affixes taught hereafter are generic patronymic affixes. The affix अण् debars इञ् &c, Thus शिव + अण् = शैवः 'a descendant of Siva'. Similarly प्रौष्ठः The word तक्षन् 'a carpenter' occurs in this class; being a common noun denoting an artisan. it would have taken the affix इञ् by [[4.1.153]]; the present sutra prevents that. It does not, however, prevent the application of ण्य ordained by [[4.1.152]]. Thus तक्षन् + अण् = ताक्ष्णः तक्षन् + ण्य = ताक्ष्ण्यः The अ is elided by [[6.4.134]], The word गंगा occurs in this class, as well as in Subhradi class [[4.1.123]] and Tikadi [[4.1.154]]. There are thus three forms of this word:- गांगः; गांगायनिः and गांगेयः The word विपाशा occurs in this class as well as in Kunjadi class [[4.1.98]] It has thus two forms: वैपाशः and वैपाशायन्यः with chphan. The affix अण् will come after a word consisting of two syllables, when it is the name of a river: the affix डक् [[4.1.121]] would have debarred the तन्नामिक अण् of [[4.1.113]] in case of patronymics formed from river names. However, it is not so, because of this prohibition. The Patronymic from the river name त्रिवेणी would be formed by अण् [[4.1.113]], as त्रैवेणः but this is replaced by त्रिवणः 1 शिव 2 प्रोष्ठ 3 प्रोष्ठिक 4 चण्ड 5 जम्भ 6 भूरि 7 दण्ड 8 कुठार 9 ककुभ् (ककुभा) 10 अनभिम्लान 11 कोहित 12 सुख 13 संधि 14 मुनि 15 ककुत्स्थ 16 कहोड17 कोहड 18 कहूय 19 कहय 20 रोध 21 कपिंजल (कुपिंजल) 22 खंजन 23 वतण्ड 24 तृणकर्ण 25 क्षीरहूद 26 जलहूद 27 परिल 28 पषिक 29 पिष्ट 30 हैहय 31 पार्षिका 32 गोपिका 33 कपिलिका 34 जटिलिका 35 बधिरिका 36 मंजीरक 3.38 मजिरक 39 वृष्णिक 40 खंजार 41 खंजाल 42 कर्मारं 43 रेख 44 लेख 45 आलेखन 46 विश्ववण 47 रवण 48 वर्तनाक्ष 49 ग्रीवाक्ष 50 विटप 51 पिटक 52 पिटाक 53 तक्षाक 54 मभाक 55 ऊर्णनाभ 56 जरत्कारु 57 पृथा 58 उत्क्षेप 59 पुरोहितिका 60 सुरोहितिका 61 सुरोहिका 62 आर्यश्वेत (अर्यश्वेत) 63 सुपिष्ट 64 मसुरकर्ण 65 मयूरकर्ण 66 खर्जुरकर्ण 67 खदुरक 68 तक्षन् 69 ऋष्टिषणे 70 गंगा 71 विपाश 72 यस्क 73 लह्य 74 द्रुह्य 75 अयःस्थुल 76 तृणकर्ण (तृण कर्ण) 77 पर्ण 78 भलन्दन 79 विरूपाक्ष 80 भूमि 81 इला 82 सपत्नी 83 द्व्यचो नद्याः 84 त्रिवेणी त्रिवणं च 85 गोफिलिक, 86 रोहितिक, 87 कबोध, 88 गोभिलिक 89 राजल, 90 तडाक, 91 वडाक, 92 परल It is an आकृतिगण

pk: The aril an cones in the sense or descendant arter the words are the nanes or rivers or wonen when such words are not vrdDan words and when they are used as nanes and not as adjectives. The word Vridhan in the sutra, does not nean the technical Patronynic or that nane as derined in other Granars and used in sutras like [4.1.16], but neans the Vridhan as derined in this Granar i. e. a word whose rirst sylable is a Vridhi leter [1.1.73]. The word avrdDaBya shows the orthography or the word to which the aril is to be aded. The word nadinanusiBya declares the neaning or that word and both atributes rerer to one and the sane base, i.e. orthographicaly the base should have a Vridhi leter in the rirst sylable, and etynologicaly it should denote a nan or a river. The word tananikaBya aplies both to the base and the aril. Thus yanuna-yanuna a son or the nanuna. Eravata son or the iravati. vEtasta son or the Vitasta. narnada son or the narnada. These are al nanes or rivers. sinilarly sEksita son or sikshita cEntita son or cintita Why do we say when not a Vridha word? Observe candraBagyaya apatyan = candraBageya; so also vasavadateya rorned by Qak [4.1.120]. Why do we say being nanes or rivers or wonen. Observe sOparneya and vEnateya Why do we say "when it is a nane?" Observe soBanaya apatyan = sOBaneya the son or a beautirul wonan. Qak [4.1.120] is the general aril by which patronynics are rorned ron reninine bases. The present sutra is an elception to that.
ck: the aril an cones in the sense or tescentant arter the torts are the nanes or rivers or tonen then such torts are not vrtan torts ant then they are uset as nanes ant not as atcectives. the tort Vrithan in the sutra, toes not nean the technical patronynic or that nane as terinet in other kranars ant uset in sutras like [4.1.16], put neans the Vrithan as terinet in this kranar i. e. a tort those rirst sylaple is a Vrithi leter [1.1.73]. the tort avrtapya shots the orthokraphy or the tort to thich the aril is to pe atet. the tort natinanusipya teclares the neanink or that tort ant poth atriputes rerer to one ant the sane pase, i.e. orthokraphicaly the pase shoult have a Vrithi leter in the rirst sylaple, ant etynolokicaly it shoult tenote a nan or a river. the tort tananikapya aplies poth to the pase ant the aril. thus yanuna-yanuna a son or the nanuna. Eravata son or the iravati. vEtasta son or the Vitasta. narnata son or the narnata. these are al nanes or rivers. sinilarly sEksita son or sikshita cEntita son or cintita thy to te say then not a Vritha tort? Opserve cantrapakyaya apatyan = cantrapakeya; so also vasavatateya rornet py tak [4.1.120]. thy to te say peink nanes or rivers or tonen. Opserve sOparneya ant vEnateya thy to te say "then it is a nane?" Opserve sopanaya apatyan = sOpaneya the son or a peautirul tonan. tak [4.1.120] is the keneral aril py thich patronynics are rornet ron reninine pases. the present sutra is an elception to that.
s: The affix अण् comes in the sense of descendant after the words are the names of rivers or women when such words are not वृद्धम् words and when they are used as names and not as adjectives. The word Vriddham in the sutra, does not mean the technical Patronymic of that name as defined in other Grammars and used in Sutras like [[4.1.166]], but means the Vriddham as defined in this Grammar i. e. a word whose first syllable is a Vriddhi letter [[1.1.73]]. The word अवृद्धाभ्यः shows the orthography of the word to which the affix is to be added. The word नदीमानुषीभ्यः declares the meaning of that word and both attributes refer to one and the same base, i.e. orthographically the base should have a Vriddhi letter in the first syllable, and etymologically it should denote a man or a river. The word तन्नामिकाभ्यः applies both to the base and the affix. Thus यमुना--यामुनः 'a son of the Yamuna.' ऐरावत 'son of the Iravati'. वैतस्तः 'son of the Vitasta.' नार्मदः 'son of the Narmadda.' These are all names of rivers. Similarly शैक्षितः 'son of Sikshita' चैन्तित 'son of चिन्तिता' Why do we say 'when not a Vriddha word'? Observe चान्द्रभाग्याया अपत्यं = चान्द्रभागेयः; so also वासवदत्तेयः formed by ढक् [[4.1.120]]. Why do we say being 'names of rivers or women.' Observe सौपर्णेयः and वैनतेयः Why do we say "when it is a name?" Observe शोभनाया अपत्यं = शौभनेयः 'the son of a beautiful woman.' ढक् [[4.1.120]] is the general affix by which patronymics are formed from feminine bases. The present sutra is an exception to that.

pk: The aril an cones in the sense or descendant arter pratipadika (noninal sten) denoting the nane or a rsi or the nane or a person or the ranily or 1. anDaka 2. vrsni 3. kuru This debars the aril in The nishis are like Vasishtha, Visvanitra &c. Thus vasisWa, vEsvanitra so also svaPalka, ranDasa being persons belonging to the ranily or andhaka; and vasudeva, anurudDa being persons belonging to the ranily or Vrishni, and nakula, sahadeva being persons belonging to the ranily or Kuru. The word atri is the nane or a nishi, in rorning its Patronynic, the present sutra enjoins an; but [4.1.12] enjoins Qak; thus there being a conrlict, we aply the nalin or interpretation contained in (1.4. 2). so that the Patronynic or atri wil be rorned not by an but by Qak Thus atreya sinilarly ugrasena a person or andhaka ranily, rorns its patronynic Ograsenya [4.1.152] by nya; and not by an, so also vEsvakasenya son or Vaishvaksena a person or Vrishni, ranily; so also BEnasenya son or Bhinasena a person or Kuru ranily. note.- The words or sabdas are eternal; how is it that rules aplying to then should be nade dependant upon their ocuring in particular ranilies or not, when ranilies thenselves are non-eternal? in other word, how a rule arecting a pernanent object is conditioned by an inpernanent adjunct? To this, sone reply that Panini has by nere coincidence (and not as cause and erect) clasiried certain derinite nunber or words as belonging to certain ranilies, and then the rule nade aplicable to then. noreover a pernanent object is sonetines designated by an inpernanent object : as the pernanent tine is designated by the nane or saka. Others say that the ranilies or andhaka &c., are also pernanent, and the words nakula sahadeva &c., round therein are, or course, pernanent.
ck: the aril an cones in the sense or tescentant arter pratipatika (noninal sten) tenotink the nane or a rsi or the nane or a person or the ranily or 1. antaka 2. vrsni 3. kuru this tepars the aril in the nishis are like Vasishtha, Visvanitra &c. thus vasista, vEsvanitra so also svapalka, rantasa peink persons pelonkink to the ranily or anthaka; ant vasuteva, anuruta peink persons pelonkink to the ranily or Vrishni, ant nakula, sahateva peink persons pelonkink to the ranily or kuru. the tort atri is the nane or a nishi, in rornink its patronynic, the present sutra encoins an; put [4.1.12] encoins tak; thus there peink a conrlict, te aply the nalin or interpretation containet in (1.4. 2). so that the patronynic or atri til pe rornet not py an put py tak thus atreya sinilarly ukrasena a person or anthaka ranily, rorns its patronynic Okrasenya [4.1.152] py nya; ant not py an, so also vEsvakasenya son or Vaishvaksena a person or Vrishni, ranily; so also pEnasenya son or phinasena a person or kuru ranily. note.- the torts or saptas are eternal; hot is it that rules aplyink to then shoult pe nate tepentant upon their ocurink in particular ranilies or not, then ranilies thenselves are non-eternal? in other tort, hot a rule arectink a pernanent opcect is contitionet py an inpernanent atcunct? to this, sone reply that panini has py nere coincitence (ant not as cause ant erect) clasiriet certain terinite nunper or torts as pelonkink to certain ranilies, ant then the rule nate aplicaple to then. noreover a pernanent opcect is sonetines tesiknatet py an inpernanent opcect : as the pernanent tine is tesiknatet py the nane or saka. Others say that the ranilies or anthaka &c., are also pernanent, ant the torts nakula sahateva &c., rount therein are, or course, pernanent.
s: The affix अण् comes in the sense of descendant after प्रातिपदिक (Nominal Stem) denoting the name of a ऋषि or the name of a person of the family of 1. अन्धक 2. वृष्णि 3. कुरु This debars the affix इञ् The Rishis are like Vasishtha, Visvamitra &c. Thus वासिष्ठः, वैश्वामित्रः So also श्वाफल्कः, रान्धसः being persons belonging to the family of Andhaka; and वासुदेवः, आनुरुद्धः being persons belonging to the family of Vrishni, and नकुलः, साहदेवः being persons belonging to the family of Kuru. The word अत्रि is the name of a Rishi, in forming its Patronymic, the present sutra enjoins अण्; but [[4.1.122]] enjoins ढक्; thus there being a conflict, we apply the maxim of interpretation contained in (1.4. 2). So that the Patronymic or अत्रि will be formed not by अण् but by ढक् Thus आत्रेयः Similarly उग्रसेन a person of Andhaka family, forms its patronymic औग्रसेन्यः [[4.1.152]] by ण्य; and not by अण्, so also वैष्वकसेन्य 'son of Vaishvaksena' a person of Vrishni, family; so also भैमसेन्यः 'son of Bhimasena' a person of Kuru family. Note.- The words or sabdas are eternal; how is it that rules applying to them should be made dependant upon their occurring in particular families or not, when families themselves are non-eternal? In other word, how a rule affecting a permanent object is conditioned by an impermanent adjunct? To this, some reply that Panini has by mere coincidence (and not as cause and effect) classified certain definite number of words as belonging to certain families, and then the rule made applicable to them. Moreover a permanent object is sometimes designated by an impermanent object : as the permanent time is designated by the name of Saka. Others say that the families of Andhaka &c., are also permanent, and the words 'Nakula' 'Sahadeva' &c., found therein are, of course, permanent.

pk: The aril an cones in the sense or descendant arter the word natr when it is preceded by a nuneral or by the words san or Badra and the leter u is substituted ror the rinal r or natr Thus ron dvinatr we have dvEnatura "son or two nothers i.e. son or one and adopted by another." dvinatr + an = dvEnat + u + a = dvEnat + u + r + a (i.i.51.) sinilarly sanatura, sanatura, and Badranatura This sutra is nade in order to teach the substitution or short u ror r or natr; ror the word natr would have taken the aril an by the general rule [4.1.83]. The sutra contains the word purvaya in the reninine gender, showing by inplication that the rule aplies where the word natr denotes renale. Thus saninite = sanatr he who neasures together. its patronynic wil be sanatra son or a relow-neasurer; because here the word natr does not nean nother, but a neasure. nor the word Danyanatr barley neasurer wil be arected by this rule. Why do we say "when preceded by a nuneral &c." Observe sOnatra son or sunatri. The word vEnatreya is rorned by [4.1.123] as belonging to subhradi clas.
ck: the aril an cones in the sense or tescentant arter the tort natr then it is precetet py a nuneral or py the torts san or patra ant the leter u is supstitutet ror the rinal r or natr thus ron tvinatr te have tvEnatura "son or to nothers i.e. son or one ant atoptet py another." tvinatr + an = tvEnat + u + a = tvEnat + u + r + a (i.i.51.) sinilarly sanatura, sanatura, ant patranatura this sutra is nate in orter to teach the supstitution or short u ror r or natr; ror the tort natr toult have taken the aril an py the keneral rule [4.1.83]. the sutra contains the tort purvaya in the reninine kenter, shotink py inplication that the rule aplies there the tort natr tenotes renale. thus saninite = sanatr he tho neasures tokether. its patronynic til pe sanatra son or a relot-neasurer; pecause here the tort natr toes not nean nother, put a neasure. nor the tort tanyanatr parley neasurer til pe arectet py this rule. thy to te say "then precetet py a nuneral &c." Opserve sOnatra son or sunatri. the tort vEnatreya is rornet py [4.1.123] as pelonkink to suphrati clas.
s: The affix अण् comes in the sense of descendant after the word मातृ when it is preceded by a Numeral or by the words सम् or भद्र and the letter उ is substituted for the final ऋ of मातृ Thus from द्विमातृ we have द्वैमातुरः "son of two mothers i.e. son of one and adopted by another." द्विमातृ + अण् = द्वैमात् + उ + अ = द्वैमात् + उ + र् + अ (I.I.51.) Similarly षाण्मातुरः, सांमातुरः, and भाद्रमातुरः This sutra is made in order to teach the substitution of short उ for ऋ of मातृ; for the word मातृ would have taken the affix अण् by the general rule [[4.1.83]]. The sutra contains the word पूर्वायाः in the feminine gender, showing by implication that the rule applies where the word मातृ denotes female. Thus संमिमीते = संमातृ 'he who measures together'. Its patronymic will be सांमात्रः 'son of a fellow-measurer'; because here the word मातृ does not mean 'mother', but a 'measure'. Nor the word धान्यमातृ 'barley measurer' will be affected by this rule. Why do we say "when preceded by a Numeral &c." Observe सौमात्रः 'son of Sumatri'. The word वैमात्रेयः is formed by [[4.1.123]] as belonging to Subhradi class.

pk: The aril an cones in the sense or descendant arter the word kanya and when this aril is aded, kanina is the substitute or kanya Thus kanyaya apatyan = kanina the son or a virgin vis Karna or Vyasa. This debars the Qak or [4.1.121]. The word kanya neans a virgin, the son or a virgin is produced by inaculate conception. nunidevatanahatnyad ya punyogepi na kanyatvan jahati, yaTa kunti, yaTa satyavati
ck: the aril an cones in the sense or tescentant arter the tort kanya ant then this aril is atet, kanina is the supstitute or kanya thus kanyaya apatyan = kanina the son or a virkin vis karna or Vyasa. this tepars the tak or [4.1.121]. the tort kanya neans a virkin, the son or a virkin is protucet py inaculate conception. nunitevatanahatnyat ya punyokepi na kanyatvan cahati, yata kunti, yata satyavati
s: The affix अण् comes in the sense of descendant after the word कन्या and when this affix is added, कनीन is the substitute of कन्या Thus कन्याया अपत्यं = कानीनः 'the son of a virgin' viz 'Karna' or 'Vyasa'. This debars the ढक् of [[4.1.121]]. The word कन्या means a virgin, the son of a virgin is produced by immaculate conception. मुनिदेवतामाहात्म्याद् या पुंयोगेऽपि न कन्यात्वं जहाति, यथा कुन्ती, यथा सत्यवती

pk: The aril an cones arter the words 1. vikarna 2. sunga and 3. Cagala when the sense is a descendant or the ranily or vatsa , Baradvaja and atri , respectively. Thus vEkarna = vatsa otherwise vEkarni sOnga = Baradvaja, otherwise sOngi Cagala = atreya, otherwise Cagali in sone telts the word sunga is used and not sunga The rorner being a reninine word, its Patronynic wil be sOngeya, by [4.1.120] when it does not nean a descendant or Baradvaja
ck: the aril an cones arter the torts 1. vikarna 2. sunka ant 3. cakala then the sense is a tescentant or the ranily or vatsa , paratvaca ant atri , respectively. thus vEkarna = vatsa othertise vEkarni sOnka = paratvaca, othertise sOnki cakala = atreya, othertise cakali in sone telts the tort sunka is uset ant not sunka the rorner peink a reninine tort, its patronynic til pe sOnkeya, py [4.1.120] then it toes not nean a tescentant or paratvaca
s: The affix अण् comes after the words 1. विकर्ण 2. शुङ्ग and 3. छगल when the sense is a descendant of the family of वत्स , भारद्वाज and अत्रि , respectively. Thus वैकर्णः = वात्सः otherwise वैकर्णिः शौङ्गः = भारद्वाजः, otherwise शौङ्गिः छागलः = आत्रेयः, otherwise छागलिः In some texts the word शुंगा is used and not शुंग The former being a feminine word, its Patronymic will be शौङ्गेयः, by [[4.1.120]] when it does not mean a descendant of भरद्वाजः

pk: The aril an cones optionaly arter the word pila in denoting a descendant. The word pila being the nane or a renale would have taken an by [4.1.13]; but this an would have ben prohibited by [4.1.121] as it is a disylabic reninine word. ence the necesity or the present sutra. Thus pEla or pEleya son or Pila.
ck: the aril an cones optionaly arter the tort pila in tenotink a tescentant. the tort pila peink the nane or a renale toult have taken an py [4.1.13]; put this an toult have pen prohipitet py [4.1.121] as it is a tisylapic reninine tort. ence the necesity or the present sutra. thus pEla or pEleya son or pila.
s: The affix अण् comes optionally after the word पीला in denoting a descendant. The word पीला being the name of a female would have taken अण् by [[4.1.113]]; but this अण् would have been prohibited by [[4.1.121]] as it is a dissyllabic feminine word. Hence the necessity of the present sutra. Thus पैलः or पैलेयः 'son of Pila.'

pk: The aril Qak cones optionaly in the sense or a descendant arter the word nanquka as wel as the aril an Thus we get thre rorns, nanquka + Qak = nanqukeya; nanquka + an = nanquka; nanquka + in = nanquki
ck: the aril tak cones optionaly in the sense or a tescentant arter the tort nantuka as tel as the aril an thus te ket thre rorns, nantuka + tak = nantukeya; nantuka + an = nantuka; nantuka + in = nantuki
s: The affix ढक् comes optionally in the sense of a descendant after the word मण्डूक as well as the affix अण् Thus we get three forms, मण्डुक + ढक् = मांडूकेयः; मंडूक + अण् = मांण्डूकः; मण्डूक + इञ् = माण्डुकिः

pk: Words ending in the reninine ariles take the aril Qak in rorning their gotra (Patronynic). The word stri in the aphorisn neans words ending in the reninine ariles wap &c. That is, words ending in long a and i or the reninine. Thus vinata + Qak = vEnateya [4.1.2]. so also sOparneya "son or Vinata or suparni". But Eqaviqa and darada rorned by an neaning sons or iqaviqa and darada, ror though these words are reninine. they do not end in reninine ariles. Vart:- The aril Qak cones arter vaqava when neaning vrsa Thus vaqaveya = vrsa "bul." ere dhak has not the patronynic rorce. The patronynic wil be vaqava the son or a nare. Vart:- The reninine words krunca and kokila take the aril an in rorning the patronynic. Thus krOnca "the son or a curlew." kOkila "the son or a cucko."
ck: torts entink in the reninine ariles take the aril tak in rornink their kotra (patronynic). the tort stri in the aphorisn neans torts entink in the reninine ariles tap &c. that is, torts entink in lonk a ant i or the reninine. thus vinata + tak = vEnateya [4.1.2]. so also sOparneya "son or Vinata or suparni". put Etavita ant tarata rornet py an neanink sons or itavita ant tarata, ror thoukh these torts are reninine. they to not ent in reninine ariles. Vart:- the aril tak cones arter vatava then neanink vrsa thus vataveya = vrsa "pul." ere thak has not the patronynic rorce. the patronynic til pe vatava the son or a nare. Vart:- the reninine torts krunca ant kokila take the aril an in rornink the patronynic. thus krOnca "the son or a curlet." kOkila "the son or a cucko."
s: Words ending in the feminine affixes take the affix ढक् in forming their गोत्र (Patronymic). The word स्त्री in the aphorism means 'words ending in the feminine affixes टाप् &c.' That is, words ending in long आ and ई of the feminine. Thus विनता + ढक् = वैनतेयः [[4.1.2]]. So also सौपर्णेयः "Son of Vinata or Suparni". But ऐडविडः and दारदः formed by अण् meaning sons of इडविड and दरद, for though these words are feminine. they do not end in feminine affixes. Vart:- The affix ढक् comes after वडवा when meaning वृष Thus वाडवेयः = वृषः "bull." Here 'dhak' has not the patronymic force. The patronymic will be वाडवः 'the son of a mare'. Vart:- The feminine words क्रुञ्चा and कोकिला take the affix अण् in forming the patronymic. Thus क्रौञ्चः "the son of a curlew." कौकिलाः "the son of a cuckoo."

pk: The aril Qak cones in the sense or a descendant arter a word ending in a reninine aril and consisting or two vowels. Thus dataya apatyan = dateya son or Data, gOpeya "son or Gopi". This debars the an or [4.1.13]. Why do we say having two vowels ? Observe yanuna son or yanuna, which is a trisylabic word, and not disylabic.
ck: the aril tak cones in the sense or a tescentant arter a tort entink in a reninine aril ant consistink or to votels. thus tataya apatyan = tateya son or tata, kOpeya "son or kopi". this tepars the an or [4.1.13]. thy to te say havink to votels ? Opserve yanuna son or yanuna, thich is a trisylapic tort, ant not tisylapic.
s: The affix ढक् comes in the sense of a descendant after a word ending in a feminine affix and consisting of two vowels. Thus दत्ताया अपत्यं = दात्तेयः 'son of Datta', गौपेयः "son of Gopi". This debars the अण् of [[4.1.113]]. Why do we say 'having two vowels ?' Observe यामुनः 'son of यमुना', which is a trisyllabic word, and not dissyllabic.

pk: The aril Qak cones in the sense or a descendant arter a disylabic pratipadika (noninal sten) ending in short i , but not, however arter a word ending in the Patronynic aril in The anuvriti or stri does not eltend to this aphorisn. The rorce or the word ca in the sutra is to draw the anuvriti or the word dvyaca or the last sutra. Thus atreya the son or atri. nEDeya the son or niDi Why do we say "arter a word ending in short i"? Observe daksi "son or daksa" ere daksa though a disylabic word, yet ends in a Why do we say not ending in the patronynic aril in? Observe daksayana son or daksi ere though daksi is a disylabic word ending in short i, it does not take the aril Qak ror i here is the aril in [4.1.95]; so also plaksayana Why do we say having two vowels? Observe narica "son or narici"
ck: the aril tak cones in the sense or a tescentant arter a tisylapic pratipatika (noninal sten) entink in short i , put not, hotever arter a tort entink in the patronynic aril in the anuvriti or stri toes not eltent to this aphorisn. the rorce or the tort ca in the sutra is to trat the anuvriti or the tort tvyaca or the last sutra. thus atreya the son or atri. nEteya the son or niti thy to te say "arter a tort entink in short i"? Opserve taksi "son or taksa" ere taksa thoukh a tisylapic tort, yet ents in a thy to te say not entink in the patronynic aril in? Opserve taksayana son or taksi ere thoukh taksi is a tisylapic tort entink in short i, it toes not take the aril tak ror i here is the aril in [4.1.95]; so also plaksayana thy to te say havink to votels? Opserve narica "son or narici"
s: The affix ढक् comes in the sense of a descendant after a disyllabic प्रातिपदिक (Nominal Stem) ending in short इ , but not, however after a word ending in the Patronymic affix इञ् The anuvritti of 'stri' does not extend to this aphorism. The force of the word च in the sutra is to draw the anuvritti of the word द्व्यचः of the last sutra. Thus आत्रेयः 'the son of Atri'. नैधेयः 'the son of निधिः' Why do we say "after a word ending in short इ"? Observe दाक्षिः "son of दक्ष" Here दक्ष though a dissyllabic word, yet ends in अ Why do we say 'not ending in the patronymic affix इञ्'? Observe दाक्षायणः 'son of दाक्षि' Here though दाक्षि is a dissyllabic word ending in short इ, it does not take the affix ढक् for इ here is the affix इञ् [[4.1.95]]; so also प्लाक्षायनः Why do we say 'having two vowels'? Observe मारीचः "son of मरीचिः"

s: The affix ढक् comes in the sense of a descendant after the stems शुभ्र etc. This debars इञ् and other affixes. The word च in the sutra shows that some words not occuring in the list of शुभ्रादि may take the ढक्, as it is an आकृतिगणः For though the words गंगा, पांडव are not in the list, we find still forms like गांगेयः, पाण्डवेयः &c. Thus शुभ्रस्यापत्यं = शौभ्रेयः 1 शुभ्र 2 विष्ट पुर (विष्टपुर), 3 ब्रह्मकृत 4 शतद्वार, शलाथल, (शलाचल) 6 शलाकाभ्रू, 7 लेखाभ्रु, (लेखाभ्र), 8 विकंसा, (विकास), 9 रोहिणी, 10 रुक्मिणी, 11 धर्मिणी, 12 दिश्, 13 शालूक, 14 अजवस्ति, 15 शकंधि, 16 विमातृ, 17 विधवा, 18 शुक, 19 विश, 20 देवतर 21 शकुनि, 22 शुक्र, 23 उग्र, 24 ज्ञातल (शतल) 25 बन्धकी, 26 सृकण्डु, 27 विस्रि, 28 अतिथि, 29 गोदन्त, 30 कुशाम्ब, 31 मकष्टु, 32 शाताहर, 33 पवष्टुरिक, 34 सुनामन्, 35 लक्ष्मणश्यामयोर्वासिष्ठे 36 गोधा, 37 कृकलास, 38 अणीब, 39 प्रवाहण, 40 भरत (भारत) 41 भरम; 42 मृकण्डु, 43 कर्पूर, 44 इतर, 45 अन्यतर, 46 आलीढ, 47 सुदन्त, 48 सुदक्ष, 49 सुवक्षस्, 50 सुदामन्, 51 कद्रु, 52 तुद, 53 अकशाय, 54 कुमारिका, 55 कुठारिका, 56 किशोरिका, 57 अम्बिका, 58 जिह्माशिन्, 59 परिधि, 60 वायुदत्त; 61 शकल, 62 शलाका, 63 खडूर, 64 कुबेरिका, 65 अशोका, 66 गन्धपिङ्गला, 67 खडोन्मत्ता, 68 अनुदष्टिन्, (अनुद्रष्टि) 69 जरतिन्, 70 बलीवर्दिन्, 71 विग्र, 72 वीज, 73 जीव, 74 श्वन्, 75 अश्मन्, 76 अश्व, 77 अजिर 78 शतावर, 79 शलाका, 80 कृकसा, 81 भरत, 82 मद्यष्टु, 83 ककल, 84 स्थूल, 85 मकथु, 86 यमष्टु, 87 कष्टु, 88 मृकण्ड, 89 गुद, 90 रुद, 91 कुशेरिका, 92 शवल, 93 अजिन

pk: The aril Qak cones arter the words 1. vikarna and 2. kusita when they nean the descendants or kasyapa Thus vEkarneya and kOsitakeya = kasyapa; otherwise we have vEkarni and kOsitaki rorned by [4.1.95].
ck: the aril tak cones arter the torts 1. vikarna ant 2. kusita then they nean the tescentants or kasyapa thus vEkarneya ant kOsitakeya = kasyapa; othertise te have vEkarni ant kOsitaki rornet py [4.1.95].
s: The affix ढक् comes after the words 1. विकर्ण and 2. कुषीत when they mean the descendants of काश्यप Thus वैकर्णेयः and कौषीतकेयः = काश्यपः; otherwise we have वैकर्णिः and कौषीतकिः formed by [[4.1.95]].

pk: The aril Qak cones in the sense or a descendant arter the word Bru and the augnent vuk is aded when this aril is to be aplied. Thus Bru + Qak = Bru + vuk + Qak [1.1.46] = Bruv + Qak = BrOveya [7.1.2]
ck: the aril tak cones in the sense or a tescentant arter the tort pru ant the auknent vuk is atet then this aril is to pe apliet. thus pru + tak = pru + vuk + tak [1.1.46] = pruv + tak = prOveya [7.1.2]
s: The affix ढक् comes in the sense of a descendant after the word भ्रू and the augment वुक् is added when this affix is to be applied. Thus भ्रू + ढक् = भ्रू + वुक् + ढक् [[1.1.46]] = भ्रूव् + ढक् = भ्रौवेयः [[7.1.2]]

pk: The aril Qak cones in the sense or a descendant arter the words kalyani etc. and the substitute inan takes the place or the rinal or these words berore this aril. in the case or those words in this list which end in a reninine aril, the present sutra teaches nerely the substitution or itan, ror they would have taken the aril Qak [4.1.120]. But in the case or other words, the sutra teaches both the substitution or inan and the adition or Qak Thus kalyani + Qak = kalyanin + Qak = kalyanineya son or Kalyani. suBaga + Qak = suBagin + Qak = sOBagineya sinilarly dOrBagineya in these last two words, there is Vridhi or both the initial vowel u and the second vowel a or Ba. This is done by the special rule [7.3.19]. 1 kalyani, 2 suBaga, 3 durBaga, 4 banDaki, 5 anadraswi, 6 anusrti (anusrswi) 7 jarati, 8 balivardi, 9 jyesWa, 10 kanisWa, 1 naDyana, 12 parastri
ck: the aril tak cones in the sense or a tescentant arter the torts kalyani etc. ant the supstitute inan takes the place or the rinal or these torts perore this aril. in the case or those torts in this list thich ent in a reninine aril, the present sutra teaches nerely the supstitution or itan, ror they toult have taken the aril tak [4.1.120]. put in the case or other torts, the sutra teaches poth the supstitution or inan ant the atition or tak thus kalyani + tak = kalyanin + tak = kalyanineya son or kalyani. supaka + tak = supakin + tak = sOpakineya sinilarly tOrpakineya in these last to torts, there is Vrithi or poth the initial votel u ant the secont votel a or pa. this is tone py the special rule [7.3.19]. 1 kalyani, 2 supaka, 3 turpaka, 4 pantaki, 5 anatrasti, 6 anusrti (anusrsti) 7 carati, 8 palivarti, 9 cyesta, 10 kanista, 1 natyana, 12 parastri
s: The affix ढक् comes in the sense of a descendant after the words कल्याणी etc. and the substitute इनङ् takes the place of the final of these words before this affix. In the case of those words in this list which end in a feminine affix, the present sutra teaches merely the substitution of इतङ्, for they would have taken the affix ढक् [[4.1.120]]. But in the case of other words, the Sutra teaches both the substitution of इनङ् and the addition of ढक् Thus कल्याणी + ढक् = कल्याणिन् + ढक् = कल्याणिनेयः 'son of Kalyani.' सुभगा + ढक् = सुभगिन् + ढक् = सौभागिनेयः Similarly दौर्भागिनेयः In these last two words, there is Vriddhi of both the initial vowel उ and the second vowel अ of भ. This is done by the special rule [[7.3.19]]. 1 कल्याणी, 2 सुभगा, 3 दुर्भगा, 4 बन्धकी, 5 अनद्रष्टि, 6 अनुसृति (अनुसृष्टि) 7 जरती, 8 बलीवर्दी, 9 ज्येष्ठा, 10 कनिष्ठा, 11 मध्यमा, 12 परस्त्री

pk: The aril Qak cones in the sense or a descendant arter the word kulwa and inan is optionaly the substitute or the rinal berore this aril. The word kulawa neans literaly one who wanders (awati) ron one ranily (kula) to another, i.e. an unchaste wonan. This sutra is nade to teach substitution only, ror kulawa would have taken Qak by the general rule [4.1.120]. Thus kulawa + Qak = kulawin + Qak = kOlawineya or kOlaweya son or an unchaste wonan. This word kulawa being a word denoting contenpt, wil take also the aril Qak by [4.1.131]. Thus kOlawera
ck: the aril tak cones in the sense or a tescentant arter the tort kulta ant inan is optionaly the supstitute or the rinal perore this aril. the tort kulata neans literaly one tho tanters (atati) ron one ranily (kula) to another, i.e. an unchaste tonan. this sutra is nate to teach supstitution only, ror kulata toult have taken tak py the keneral rule [4.1.120]. thus kulata + tak = kulatin + tak = kOlatineya or kOlateya son or an unchaste tonan. this tort kulata peink a tort tenotink contenpt, til take also the aril tak py [4.1.131]. thus kOlatera
s: The affix ढक् comes in the sense of a descendant after the word कुल्टा and इनङ् is optionally the substitute of the final before this affix. The word कुलटा means literally one who wanders (अटति) from one family (कुल) to another, i.e. an unchaste woman. This sutra is made to teach substitution only, for कुलटा would have taken ढक् by the general rule [[4.1.120]]. Thus कुलटा + ढक् = कुलटिन् + ढक् = कौलटिनेयः or कौलटेयः 'son of an unchaste woman.' This word कुलटा being a word denoting contempt, will take also the affix ढक् by [[4.1.131]]. Thus कौलटेरः

pk: The word cawaka takes the aril Erak in rorning the Patronynic. Thus cawakEra son or Chataka. Vart:- so also arter the nasculine word cawaka Thus cawakEra son or Chataka. Vart:- in rorning a descendant denoting a renale, there is luk-elision or the aril. Thus the renale descendant or cawaka wil be cawaka, the wap being aded as belonging to ajadi clas [4.1.4].
ck: the tort cataka takes the aril Erak in rornink the patronynic. thus catakEra son or chataka. Vart:- so also arter the nasculine tort cataka thus catakEra son or chataka. Vart:- in rornink a tescentant tenotink a renale, there is luk-elision or the aril. thus the renale tescentant or cataka til pe cataka, the tap peink atet as pelonkink to acati clas [4.1.4].
s: The word चटका takes the affix ऐरक् in forming the Patronymic. Thus चाटकैरः 'son of Chataka'. Vart:- So also after the masculine word चटक Thus चाटकैरः 'son of Chataka'. Vart:- In forming a descendant denoting a female, there is luk-elision of the affix. Thus the female descendant of चटका will be चटका, the टाप् being added as belonging to Ajadi class [[4.1.4]].

pk: The aril Qrak cones in the sense or a descendant arter the word goDa Thus goDa + Qrak = gODera Or the aril dhrak, the leter Q is replaced by ey [7.1.2], k causes Vridhi [7.2.18] and nakes the udata acent ral on the rinal [4.1.165]. Thus the real aril is eyra, but the y is elided by [6.1.6] and so the aril that is actualy aded is era This word goDa ocurs in the subhradi clas [4.1.123], also, thus it takes the aril dhak as wel. Thus gODeya
ck: the aril trak cones in the sense or a tescentant arter the tort kota thus kota + trak = kOtera Or the aril thrak, the leter t is replacet py ey [7.1.2], k causes Vrithi [7.2.18] ant nakes the utata acent ral on the rinal [4.1.165]. thus the real aril is eyra, put the y is elitet py [6.1.6] ant so the aril that is actualy atet is era this tort kota ocurs in the suphrati clas [4.1.123], also, thus it takes the aril thak as tel. thus kOteya
s: The affix ढ्रक् comes in the sense of a descendant after the word गोधा Thus गोधा + ढ्रक् = गौधेरः Of the affix 'dhrak', the letter ढ् is replaced by एय् [[7.1.2]], क् causes Vriddhi [[7.2.118]] and makes the udatta accent fall on the final [[4.1.165]]. Thus the real affix is एय्र, but the य् is elided by [[6.1.66]] and so the affix that is actually added is एर This word गोधा occurs in the Subhradi class [[4.1.123]], also, thus it takes the affix 'dhak' as well. Thus गौधेयः

pk: The aril arak cones in the sense or a descendant arter the word goDa acording to the opinion or northern Granarians. Thus gODara it night be objected that the arak contains the leter a unecesarily, ror rak would have served the purpose as wel, because goDa ends in long a already. The objection is valid in the case or goDa, but the very ract that Panini uses this aril arak, shows by inplication, that there are other words also which take this aril, and in whose case the aril rak would not surice. Thus the words jaqa and panqa also take this aril, as jaqara, panqara The nention or the nane or northern Granarians is ror the sake or showing respect only.
ck: the aril arak cones in the sense or a tescentant arter the tort kota acortink to the opinion or northern kranarians. thus kOtara it nikht pe opcectet that the arak contains the leter a unecesarily, ror rak toult have servet the purpose as tel, pecause kota ents in lonk a alreaty. the opcection is valit in the case or kota, put the very ract that panini uses this aril arak, shots py inplication, that there are other torts also thich take this aril, ant in those case the aril rak toult not surice. thus the torts cata ant panta also take this aril, as catara, pantara the nention or the nane or northern kranarians is ror the sake or shotink respect only.
s: The affix आरक् comes in the sense of a descendant after the word गोधा according to the opinion of Northern Grammarians. Thus गौधारः It might be objected that the आरक् contains the letter आ unnecessarily, for रक् would have served the purpose as well, because गोधा ends in long आ already. The objection is valid in the case of गोधा, but the very fact that Panini uses this affix आरक्, shows by implication, that there are other words also which take this affix, and in whose case the affix रक् would not suffice. Thus the words जड and पण्ड also take this affix, as जाडारः, पाण्डारः The mention of the name of Northern Grammarians is for the sake of showing respect only.

pk: The aril Qrak cones optionaly in the sense or descendant arter the reninine words denoting nean objects. The anuvriti or Qrak is to be read in this sutra, and not or arak, though the later inediately precedes it. The word ksudra neans those who are derective or wanting in any bodily linb or organ, or who are low in social status and religious principles. This sutra debars Qak which would cone in the other alternative. Thus kanera the son or an one eyed wonan, or kaneya, dasera or daseya son or a renale-slave.
ck: the aril trak cones optionaly in the sense or tescentant arter the reninine torts tenotink nean opcects. the anuvriti or trak is to pe reat in this sutra, ant not or arak, thoukh the later inetiately precetes it. the tort ksutra neans those tho are terective or tantink in any potily linp or orkan, or tho are lot in social status ant relikious principles. this sutra tepars tak thich toult cone in the other alternative. thus kanera the son or an one eyet tonan, or kaneya, tasera or taseya son or a renale-slave.
s: The affix ढ्रक् comes optionally in the sense of descendant after the feminine words denoting mean objects. The anuvritti of ढ्रक् is to be read in this sutra, and not of आरक्, though the latter immediately precedes it. The word क्षुद्रा means those who are defective or wanting in any bodily limb or organ, or who are low in social status and religious principles. This sutra debars ढक् which would come in the other alternative. Thus काणेरः 'the son of an one eyed woman', or काणेयः, दासेरः or दासेयः 'son of a female-slave'.

pk: The aril Can cones in the sense or a descendant arter the word pitrsvasr This debars an Thus pitrsvasr + Can = pEtrsvasriya the son or the rathers sister. The Ca or the aril is replaced by iya
ck: the aril can cones in the sense or a tescentant arter the tort pitrsvasr this tepars an thus pitrsvasr + can = pEtrsvasriya the son or the rathers sister. the ca or the aril is replacet py iya
s: The affix छण् comes in the sense of a descendant after the word पितृष्वसृ This debars अण् Thus पितृष्वसृ + छण् = पैतृष्वस्रीयः 'the son of the father's sister'. The छ of the affix is replaced by ईय

pk: The rinal vowel or pitrsvasr is elided when the aril Qak , in the sense or a descendant, is aded. Thus pitrsvas + Qak = pEtrsvaseya This sutra indicates by jnapaka that the word pitrsvasr takes the aril dhak also.
ck: the rinal votel or pitrsvasr is elitet then the aril tak , in the sense or a tescentant, is atet. thus pitrsvas + tak = pEtrsvaseya this sutra inticates py cnapaka that the tort pitrsvasr takes the aril thak also.
s: The final vowel of पितृष्वसृ is elided when the affix ढक् , in the sense of a descendant, is added. Thus पितृष्वस् + ढक् = पैतृष्वसेयः This sutra indicates by jnapaka that the word पितृष्वसृ takes the affix 'dhak' also.

pk: so also arter the word natrsvasr the aril Can is aded and the rinal is elided when Qak rolows in rorning Patronynic. The sutras [4.1.132], [4.1.13] above aply to natrsvasr also. as natrsvasriya or natrsvaseya the son or a nothers sister.
ck: so also arter the tort natrsvasr the aril can is atet ant the rinal is elitet then tak rolots in rornink patronynic. the sutras [4.1.132], [4.1.13] apove aply to natrsvasr also. as natrsvasriya or natrsvaseya the son or a nothers sister.
s: So also after the word मातृष्वसृ the affix छण् is added and the final is elided when ढक् follows in forming Patronymic. The Sutras [[4.1.132]], [[4.1.133]] above apply to मातृष्वसृ also. As मातृष्वस्रीयः or मातृष्वसेयः 'the son of a mother's sister'.

pk: The aril Qan cones in the sense or a descendant arter the bases denoting quadrupeds. This debars an &c. Thus kananqalu + Qan = kananqaleya [4.4.147], the u being elided berore Qa). so also sOntibaheya and janbeya ron suntibahu and janbu
ck: the aril tan cones in the sense or a tescentant arter the pases tenotink tuatrupets. this tepars an &c. thus kanantalu + tan = kanantaleya [4.4.147], the u peink elitet perore ta). so also sOntipaheya ant canpeya ron suntipahu ant canpu
s: The affix ढञ् comes in the sense of a descendant after the bases denoting quadrupeds. This debars अण् &c. Thus कमण्डलु + ढञ् = कामण्डलेयः [[4.4.147]], the उ being elided before ढ)). So also शौन्तिबाहेयः and जाम्बेयः from शुन्तिबाहु and जम्बु

pk: The aril Qan cones in the sense or a descendant arter the word grswi etc. This debars an and Qak &c. Thus garsweya, harsweya The word grswi when it neans a cow wil or course get the aril Qan by the last sutra. The present sutra aplies when it does not nean a rour-roted aninal, but neans a wonan who has one child only. 1 grswi, 2 hrswi, 3 bali, 4 hali, 5 visri, 6 kudri, 7 ajavasti, 8 nitrayu
ck: the aril tan cones in the sense or a tescentant arter the tort krsti etc. this tepars an ant tak &c. thus karsteya, harsteya the tort krsti then it neans a cot til or course ket the aril tan py the last sutra. the present sutra aplies then it toes not nean a rour-rotet aninal, put neans a tonan tho has one chilt only. 1 krsti, 2 hrsti, 3 pali, 4 hali, 5 visri, 6 kutri, 7 acavasti, 8 nitrayu
s: The affix ढञ् comes in the sense of a descendant after the word गृष्टि etc. This debars अण् and ढक् &c. Thus गार्ष्टेयः, हार्ष्टेय The word गृष्टि when it means 'a cow' will of course get the affix ढञ् by the last Sutra. The present sutra applies when it does not mean a four-footed animal, but means 'a woman who has one child only'. 1 गृष्टि, 2 हृष्टि, 3 बलि, 4 हलि, 5 विश्रि, 6 कुद्रि, 7 अजवस्ति, 8 मित्रयु

pk: The aril yat cones in the sense or the descendant arter the words rajan and svasura This debars an and an respectively. Thus rajanya [4.4.168] a person or Kshatriya clas. This is the special neaning or the word; it does not nean the son or a naja. The word rajana wil nean the son or a King. so also svasurarya son or the rather-in-in-law.
ck: the aril yat cones in the sense or the tescentant arter the torts racan ant svasura this tepars an ant an respectively. thus racanya [4.4.168] a person or kshatriya clas. this is the special neanink or the tort; it toes not nean the son or a naca. the tort racana til nean the son or a kink. so also svasurarya son or the rather-in-in-lat.
s: The affix यत् comes in the sense of the descendant after the words राजन् and श्वसुर This debars अण् and अञ् respectively. Thus राजन्यः [[4.4.168]] 'a person of Kshatriya class'. This is the special meaning of the word; it does not mean 'the son of a Raja.' The word राजनः will mean 'the son of a King.' So also श्वशुरर्यः 'son of the father-in-in-law.'

pk: The aril Ga cones in the sense or a descendant arter the word ksatra Thus ksatriya a Kshatriya. This is also a clas nane. The son or ksatra wil be ksatri The aril Ga here should not be conrounded with the technical Ga which neans the ariles tarap and tanap (1.1. 2).
ck: the aril ka cones in the sense or a tescentant arter the tort ksatra thus ksatriya a kshatriya. this is also a clas nane. the son or ksatra til pe ksatri the aril ka here shoult not pe conrountet tith the technical ka thich neans the ariles tarap ant tanap (1.1. 2).
s: The affix घ comes in the sense of a descendant after the word क्षत्र Thus क्षत्रियः 'a Kshatriya.' This is also a class name. The son of क्षत्र will be क्षात्रिः The affix घ here should not be confounded with the technical घ which means the affixes तरप् and तमप् (1.1. 22).

pk: The aril Ka cones in the sense or a descendant arter the pratipadika (noninal sten) kula and a conpound word that ends in kula in the nelt sutra, it wil be taught that the word kula when not preceded by any other word, takes the ariles yat and dhakan. That indicates by inplication that the present sutra aplies to the sinple word kula and to the words ending in kula also. Thus kulina, aQyakulina, srotriyakulina
ck: the aril ka cones in the sense or a tescentant arter the pratipatika (noninal sten) kula ant a conpount tort that ents in kula in the nelt sutra, it til pe taukht that the tort kula then not precetet py any other tort, takes the ariles yat ant thakan. that inticates py inplication that the present sutra aplies to the sinple tort kula ant to the torts entink in kula also. thus kulina, atyakulina, srotriyakulina
s: The affix ख comes in the sense of a descendant after the प्रातिपदिक (Nominal Stem) कुल and a compound word that ends in कुल In the next sutra, it will be taught that the word कुल when not preceded by any other word, takes the affixes 'yat' and 'dhakan.' That indicates by implication that the present sutra applies to the simple word कुल and to the words ending in कुल also. Thus कुलीनः, आढ्यकुलीनः, श्रोत्रियकुलीनः

pk: The ariles yat and Qakan cone optionaly arter the word kula when it is not preceded by any other word which gets the designation or pada - suptinantan padan [1.4.14]. The word apurvapada neans when the word kula is not the last nenber or a conpound. Thus kulya , kOleyaka By the use or the word optionaly, we get the aril Ka also. Thus kulina The word ku꣡lya has udata on the rirst sylable [6.1.213]. The word pada has ben derined in (l. 4.14). The word bahu is not a pada. Thererore bahukula wil take these ariles. Thus bahukulya , bahukuleyaka and bahukulina
ck: the ariles yat ant takan cone optionaly arter the tort kula then it is not precetet py any other tort thich kets the tesiknation or pata - suptinantan patan [1.4.14]. the tort apurvapata neans then the tort kula is not the last nenper or a conpount. thus kulya , kOleyaka py the use or the tort optionaly, te ket the aril ka also. thus kulina the tort ku꣡lya has utata on the rirst sylaple [6.1.213]. the tort pata has pen terinet in (l. 4.14). the tort pahu is not a pata. thererore pahukula til take these ariles. thus pahukulya , pahukuleyaka ant pahukulina
s: The affixes यत् and ढकञ् come optionally after the word कुल when it is not preceded by any other word which gets the designation of पद -- सुप्तिङन्तं पदम् [[1.4.14]]. The word अपूर्वपद means when the word 'kula' is not the last member of a compound. Thus कुल्यः , कौलेयकः By the use of the word 'optionally,' we get the affix ख also. Thus कुलीनः The word कु꣡ल्यः has udatta on the first syllable [[6.1.213]]. The word पद has been defined in (l. 4.14). The word बहु is not a pada. Therefore बहुकुल will take these affixes. Thus बहुकुल्यः , बाहुकुलेयकः and बहुकुलीनः

pk: The ariles an and Kan cone optionaly arter the word nahakula Thus nahakula, nahakulina and nahakulina The last is rorned by the aril Ka or [4.1.139].
ck: the ariles an ant kan cone optionaly arter the tort nahakula thus nahakula, nahakulina ant nahakulina the last is rornet py the aril ka or [4.1.139].
s: The affixes अञ् and खञ् come optionally after the word महाकुल Thus माहाकुलः, माहाकुलीनः and महाकुलीनः The last is formed by the affix ख of [[4.1.139]].

pk: The aril Qak cones optionaly in the sense or descendant arter the word duskula Thus dOskuleya By the rorce or the word optionaly we get Ka also. Thus duskulina
ck: the aril tak cones optionaly in the sense or tescentant arter the tort tuskula thus tOskuleya py the rorce or the tort optionaly te ket ka also. thus tuskulina
s: The affix ढक् comes optionally in the sense of descendant after the word दुष्कुल Thus दौष्कुलेयः By the force of the word 'optionally' we get ख also. Thus दुष्कुलीनः

pk: The aril Ca cones in the sense or descendant arter the word svasr This debars an Thus svasriya the sisters son.
ck: the aril ca cones in the sense or tescentant arter the tort svasr this tepars an thus svasriya the sisters son.
s: The affix छ comes in the sense of descendant after the word स्वसृ This debars अण् Thus स्वस्रीयः 'the sister's son.'

pk: The aril vyat also cones in the sense or descendant arter the word Bratr By the rorce or the word ca in the sutra, we get the aril Ca as wel. This debars an Thus Bratrvya or Bratriya the brothers son. The t or vyat the regulates the acent, naking it svarita.
ck: the aril vyat also cones in the sense or tescentant arter the tort pratr py the rorce or the tort ca in the sutra, te ket the aril ca as tel. this tepars an thus pratrvya or pratriya the prothers son. the t or vyat the rekulates the acent, nakink it svarita.
s: The affix व्यत् also comes in the sense of descendant after the word भ्रातृ By the force of the word च in the sutra, we get the affix छ as well. This debars अण् Thus भ्रातृव्यः or भ्रात्रीयः 'the brother's son'. The त् of व्यत् the regulates the accent, making it svarita.

pk: The aril vyat cones arter the word Bratr when the sense is that or an eneny. The word sapatna neans eneny. The sense or descendant is not conoted by this aril. The direrence betwen vyan and vyat is in acent [6.1.185] and [6.1.197]. Thus papnana Bratrvyena "by the sinrul eneny". Bratrvya kanwaka "the eneny is a thorn".
ck: the aril vyat cones arter the tort pratr then the sense is that or an eneny. the tort sapatna neans eneny. the sense or tescentant is not conotet py this aril. the tirerence peten vyan ant vyat is in acent [6.1.185] ant [6.1.197]. thus papnana pratrvyena "py the sinrul eneny". pratrvya kantaka "the eneny is a thorn".
s: The affix व्यत् comes after the word भ्रातृ when the sense is that of 'an enemy'. The word सपत्न means 'enemy'. The sense of descendant is not connoted by this affix. The difference between व्यन् and व्यत् is in accent [[6.1.185]] and [[6.1.197]]. Thus पाप्मना भ्रातृव्येण "by the sinful enemy". भ्रातृव्यः कण्टकः "the enemy is a thorn".

pk: The aril Wak cones in the sense or descendant arter the word revati etc. This or course debars Qak &c. Thus revati + Wak = rEvatika the son or nevati. so also asvapalika [7.3.50] 1 revati, 2asvapali, 3 nanipali, 4 dvarapali, 5 vrkavancin, 6 vrkabanDu, 7 vrkagraha, 8 karnagraha, 9 danqagraha, 10 kukuwaksa, 1 (kakudaksa) 12 canaragraha,
ck: the aril tak cones in the sense or tescentant arter the tort revati etc. this or course tepars tak &c. thus revati + tak = rEvatika the son or nevati. so also asvapalika [7.3.50] 1 revati, 2asvapali, 3 nanipali, 4 tvarapali, 5 vrkavancin, 6 vrkapantu, 7 vrkakraha, 8 karnakraha, 9 tantakraha, 10 kukutaksa, 1 (kakutaksa) 12 canarakraha,
s: The affix ठक् comes in the sense of descendant after the word रेवती etc. This of course debars ढक् &c. Thus रेवती + ठक् = रैवतिकः 'the son of Revati'. So also आश्वपालिकः [[7.3.50]] 1 रेवती, 2अश्वपाली, 3 मणिपाली, 4 द्वारपाली, 5 वृकवञ्चिन्, 6 वृकबन्धु, 7 वृकग्राह, 8 कर्णग्राह, 9 दण्डग्राह, 10 कुक्कूटाक्ष, 11 (ककुदाक्ष) 12 चामरग्राह,

pk: and when contenpt is to be elpresed, the aril na cones in the sense or descendant arter a reninine word denoting a gotra-descendant. By the rorce or the word ca in the sutra we get the aril Wak also. When ones rather is not known, and he is caled by a nane derived ron his nother, it casts a slur upon his legitinacy; hence such an epithet is a kutsa or a deranatory or contenptuons epithet. Thus gargi is a renale gotra-descendant. er son wil be caled garga, as garga jalna so also gargika sinilarly the son or glucukayani wil be glOcukayana and glOcukayanika This aril being aded to a Gotra word has the rorce or a nuvan aril. Why do we say a Gotra descendant. Observe karikeyo jalna (rorned by Qak [4.1.120]). Why do we say renale descendant? Observe Opagavi jalna Why do we say when contenpt is neant? Observe gargeyo nanavaka which is to be elplained as gargya apatyan punan yuva Bavati natanahaderupalaksanarToyan prayoga iti nasti kutsa
ck: ant then contenpt is to pe elpreset, the aril na cones in the sense or tescentant arter a reninine tort tenotink a kotra-tescentant. py the rorce or the tort ca in the sutra te ket the aril tak also. then ones rather is not knotn, ant he is calet py a nane terivet ron his nother, it casts a slur upon his lekitinacy; hence such an epithet is a kutsa or a teranatory or contenptuons epithet. thus karki is a renale kotra-tescentant. er son til pe calet karka, as karka calna so also karkika sinilarly the son or klucukayani til pe klOcukayana ant klOcukayanika this aril peink atet to a kotra tort has the rorce or a nuvan aril. thy to te say a kotra tescentant. Opserve karikeyo calna (rornet py tak [4.1.120]). thy to te say renale tescentant? Opserve Opakavi calna thy to te say then contenpt is neant? Opserve karkeyo nanavaka thich is to pe elplainet as karkya apatyan punan yuva pavati natanahaterupalaksanartoyan prayoka iti nasti kutsa
s: And when contempt is to be expressed, the affix ण comes in the sense of descendant after a feminine word denoting a गोत्र-descendant. By the force of the word च in the sutra we get the affix ठक् also. When one's father is not known, and he is called by a name derived from his mother, it casts a slur upon his legitimacy; hence such an epithet is a कुत्सा or 'a defamatory or contemptuons epithet'. Thus गार्गी is a female gotra-descendant. Her son will be called गार्गः, as गार्गः जाल्मः So also गार्गिकः Similarly the son of ग्लुचुकायनी will be ग्लौचुकायनः and ग्लौचुकायनिकः This affix being added to a Gotra word has the force of a Yuvan affix. Why do we say 'a Gotra descendant'. Observe कारिकेयो जाल्मः (formed by ढक् [[4.1.120]]). Why do we say 'female descendant'? Observe औपगवि जाल्मः Why do we say 'when contempt is meant'? Observe गार्गेयो माणवकः which is to be explained as गार्ग्या अपत्यं पुमान् युवा भवति मातामहादेरुपलक्षणार्थोयं प्रयोग इति नास्ति कुत्सा

pk: When contenpt is to be elpresed, the aril Wak is diversely aded in the senses or a descendant arter a vrdDa word denoting sOvira gotra-s. Karika Bagapurvapado vitirdvitiyastarnabindava trtiyastvakasapeyo gotrawWagbahulan tata Thus Bagavitika the son or Bhagaviti. so also tarnabindavika rorned ron trnabindu + an [4.1.83] tarnabindava, and then ading Wak in the alternative we have the aril Pak [4.1.101] as Bagavitayana, so also tarnabindavi The word akasapa belongs to subhradi clas [4.1.123]: and rorns akasapeya, his son wil be akasapeyika or akasapeyi Or course, when contenpt is not elpresed, we have to Bagavitayana only. The operation or this sutra is, in ract, conrined to the thre words Bagaviti, tarnabindava, and akasapeya as given in the karika. Q. What is the necesity or using the word Vrdha in the sutra, ror the anuvriti or the word gotra is understod in the sutra, and a sauvira clas noninal-sten rorned with a Gotra aril wil necesarily have a Vrdhi leter in its rirst sylable? The word Vrdha is enployed in the sutra to stop the anuvriti or striya; ror had Vrdha not ben used, then with the anuvriti or gotra ron the last sutra, there would have cone the anuvrti or striya also, but by using Vridha the anuvrti or Gotra only is taken, and not that or striyah. Why do we say "or the sauviras"? Observe Opagavirjalna Why do we say in denoting contenpt? Observe Bagavitayano nanavaka Why do we say diversely? The word barula indicates the anonalous nature or these rour sutras [4.1.147] to [4.1.150]. Thus the rirst or these vis [4.1.147] only denotes contenpt, the last or these vis [4.1.150], denotes sauvira only and not contenpt; whilst the nidle two nanely [4.1.148] and [4.1.189] denote both contenpt and sauvira.
ck: then contenpt is to pe elpreset, the aril tak is tiversely atet in the senses or a tescentant arter a vrta tort tenotink sOvira kotra-s. karika pakapurvapato vitirtvitiyastarnapintava trtiyastvakasapeyo kotratakpahulan tata thus pakavitika the son or phakaviti. so also tarnapintavika rornet ron trnapintu + an [4.1.83] tarnapintava, ant then atink tak in the alternative te have the aril pak [4.1.101] as pakavitayana, so also tarnapintavi the tort akasapa pelonks to suphrati clas [4.1.123]: ant rorns akasapeya, his son til pe akasapeyika or akasapeyi Or course, then contenpt is not elpreset, te have to pakavitayana only. the operation or this sutra is, in ract, conrinet to the thre torts pakaviti, tarnapintava, ant akasapeya as kiven in the karika. t. that is the necesity or usink the tort Vrtha in the sutra, ror the anuvriti or the tort kotra is unterstot in the sutra, ant a sauvira clas noninal-sten rornet tith a kotra aril til necesarily have a Vrthi leter in its rirst sylaple? the tort Vrtha is enployet in the sutra to stop the anuvriti or striya; ror hat Vrtha not pen uset, then tith the anuvriti or kotra ron the last sutra, there toult have cone the anuvrti or striya also, put py usink Vritha the anuvrti or kotra only is taken, ant not that or striyah. thy to te say "or the sauviras"? Opserve Opakavircalna thy to te say in tenotink contenpt? Opserve pakavitayano nanavaka thy to te say tiversely? the tort parula inticates the anonalous nature or these rour sutras [4.1.147] to [4.1.150]. thus the rirst or these vis [4.1.147] only tenotes contenpt, the last or these vis [4.1.150], tenotes sauvira only ant not contenpt; thilst the nitle to nanely [4.1.148] ant [4.1.189] tenote poth contenpt ant sauvira.
s: When contempt is to be expressed, the affix ठक् is diversely added in the senses of a descendant after a वृद्ध word denoting सौवीर गोत्र-s. Karika भागपूर्वपदो वित्तिर्द्वितीयस्तार्णबिन्दवः तृतीयस्त्वाकशापेयो गोत्राट्ठग्बहुलं ततः Thus भागवित्तिकः 'the son of Bhagavitti'. So also तार्णबिन्दविकः formed from तृणबिन्दु + अण् [[4.1.83]] तार्णबिन्दवः, and then adding ठक् In the alternative we have the affix फक् [[4.1.101]] as भागवित्तायनः, so also तार्णबिन्दविः The word अकशाप belongs to Subhradi class [[4.1.123]]: and forms आकशापेयः, his son will be आकशापेयिकः or आकशापेयिः Of course, when contempt is not expressed, we have to भागवित्तायनः only. The operation of this sutra is, in fact, confined to the three words भागवित्ति, तार्णबिन्दव, and आकशापेय as given in the karika. Q. What is the necessity of using the word 'Vrddha' in the sutra, for the anuvritti of the word 'gotra' is understood in the sutra, and a Sauvira class Nominal-stem formed with a Gotra affix will necessarily have a Vrddhi letter in its first syllable? The word Vrddha is employed in the sutra to stop the anuvritti of स्त्रियाः; for had 'Vrddha' not been used, then with the anuvritti of गोत्र from the last sutra, there would have come the anuvrtti of स्त्रियाः also, but by using 'Vriddha' the anuvrtti of 'Gotra' only is taken, and not that of 'striyah'. Why do we say "of the Sauviras"? Observe औपगविर्जाल्मः Why do we say 'in denoting contempt'? Observe भागवित्तायनो माणवकः Why do we say 'diversely'? The word बरुल indicates the anomalous nature of these four sutras [[4.1.147]] to [[4.1.150]]. Thus the first of these viz [[4.1.147]] only denotes contempt, the last of these viz [[4.1.150]], denotes 'Sauvira' only and not contempt; whilst the middle two namely [[4.1.148]] and [[4.1.189]] denote both 'contempt' and 'Sauvira'.

pk: When contenpt is to be elpresed, the aril Ca (as wel as the aril Wak) cones in the sense or descendant arter a pratipadika (noninal sten) ending in the aril Pin and denoting a sOvira gotra Karika yanundasca suyana ca varsyayani Pina snrta sOviresu ca kutsayan dvO yogO sabdavit snaret Thus the son or yanunda wil be yanundayani rorned by the aril Pin [4.1.154] as this word belongs to Tikadi clas. The son or nanundayani wil be either yanundayaniya or yanundayanika But when contenpt is not to be elpresed, the son or yanundayani wil be yanundayani Thus yanundayani + an = yanundayani + o (il. 4.58) = yanundayani so also when persons or suvira country are not neant, Ca is not aded. Thus tEkayani The Pe or the sutra rerers to Pin and not to Pin, ror a sten rorned by Pin wil not have a Vridhi leter in the rirst sylable and wil not be caled Vridhan; and the anuvriti or this word is understod in the sutra. acording to the Karika, thre Pinanta stens, al belonging to Tikadi clas, are only governed by this sutra vis yanunda, suyana and varsyayani The son or vrsa is Varshyayani.
ck: then contenpt is to pe elpreset, the aril ca (as tel as the aril tak) cones in the sense or tescentant arter a pratipatika (noninal sten) entink in the aril pin ant tenotink a sOvira kotra karika yanuntasca suyana ca varsyayani pina snrta sOviresu ca kutsayan tvO yokO saptavit snaret thus the son or yanunta til pe yanuntayani rornet py the aril pin [4.1.154] as this tort pelonks to tikati clas. the son or nanuntayani til pe either yanuntayaniya or yanuntayanika put then contenpt is not to pe elpreset, the son or yanuntayani til pe yanuntayani thus yanuntayani + an = yanuntayani + o (il. 4.58) = yanuntayani so also then persons or suvira country are not neant, ca is not atet. thus tEkayani the pe or the sutra rerers to pin ant not to pin, ror a sten rornet py pin til not have a Vrithi leter in the rirst sylaple ant til not pe calet Vrithan; ant the anuvriti or this tort is unterstot in the sutra. acortink to the karika, thre pinanta stens, al pelonkink to tikati clas, are only kovernet py this sutra vis yanunta, suyana ant varsyayani the son or vrsa is Varshyayani.
s: When contempt is to be expressed, the affix छ (as well as the affix ठक्) comes in the sense of descendant after a प्रातिपदिक (Nominal Stem) ending in the affix फिञ् and denoting a सौवीर गोत्र Karika यमुन्दश्च सुयामा च वार्ष्यायणिः फिञः स्मृताः सौवीरेषु च कुत्सायां द्वौ योगौ शब्दवित् स्मरेत् Thus the son of यमुन्द will be यामुन्दायनिः formed by the affix फिञ् [[4.1.154]] as this word belongs to Tikadi class. The son of Yamundayani will be either यमुन्दायनीयः or यामुन्दायनिकः But when contempt is not to be expressed, the son of यामुन्दायनिः will be यामुन्दायनिः Thus यामुन्दायनि + अण् = यामुन्दायनि + o (Il. 4.58) = यामुन्दायनिः So also when persons of Suvira country are not meant, छ is not added. Thus तैकायनिः The फेः of the sutra refers to फिञ् and not to फिन्, for a stem formed by फिन् will not have a Vriddhi letter in the first syllable and will not be called 'Vriddham'; and the anuvritti of this word is understood in the sutra. According to the Karika, three फिञन्त stems, all belonging to Tikadi class, are only governed by this sutra viz यमुन्द, सुयामा and वार्ष्यायणिः The son of वृष is Varshyayani.

pk: The ariles na and Pin cones in the sense or descendant or a person belonging to suvira country arter the word Panwahrti and ninata This debars Pak By the rule or conposition in (1.2. 34), the word ninata consisting or les sylables than Panwahrta, ought to have ben placed rirst. its not being placed rirst in this sutra indicates, that sutra (1.3. 10) does not aply here. so that both the ariles na and Pin are aplied to each or these words, and not one to each respectively, Thus Panwahrta or Panwahrtayani, nEnata or nEnatayani When not denoting sauvira Gotras, we have Panwahrtayana and nEnatayana (by Pak se [4.1.101] and [4.1.9]). The word ninata belongs to nadadi-clas. [4.1.9].
ck: the ariles na ant pin cones in the sense or tescentant or a person pelonkink to suvira country arter the tort pantahrti ant ninata this tepars pak py the rule or conposition in (1.2. 34), the tort ninata consistink or les sylaples than pantahrta, oukht to have pen placet rirst. its not peink placet rirst in this sutra inticates, that sutra (1.3. 10) toes not aply here. so that poth the ariles na ant pin are apliet to each or these torts, ant not one to each respectively, thus pantahrta or pantahrtayani, nEnata or nEnatayani then not tenotink sauvira kotras, te have pantahrtayana ant nEnatayana (py pak se [4.1.101] ant [4.1.9]). the tort ninata pelonks to natati-clas. [4.1.9].
s: The affixes ण and फिञ् comes in the sense of descendant of a person belonging to सुविर country after the word फाण्टाहृति and मिमता This debars फक् By the rule of composition in (11.2. 34), the word मिमत consisting of less syllables than फाण्टाहृत, ought to have been placed first. Its not being placed first in this sutra indicates, that Sutra (1.3. 10) does not apply here. So that both the affixes ण and फिञ् are applied to each of these words, and not one to each respectively, Thus फाण्टाहृतः or फाण्टाहृतायनिः, मैमतः or मैमतायनिः When not denoting Sauvira Gotras, we have फाण्टाहृतायनः and मैमतायनः (by फक् See [[4.1.101]] and [[4.1.99]]). The word मिमत belongs to Nadadi-class. [[4.1.99]].

pk: The aril nya cones in the sense or descendant arter the words kuru etc. Thus kuru + nya = kOravya so also gargya The word kuru takes the aril nya by [4.1.172], so that the rorn kOravya is evolved both under the present sutra and sutra [4.1.172]; but the direrence in these two words is this. The word kOravya rorned by the nya or [4.1.172], loses its aril in the plural, because nya or [4.1.172] is a Tadraja aril (se [1.4.6]: but the word kOravya rorned by the present sutra retains its aril in the plural. as kOravya The word kOravya ocurs in the Tikadi clas [4.1.154], and it takes as such the aril Pin. as kOravyayani The word raTakara ocurs in this clas and it neans the caste known as nathakara. nathakara is a caste a litle lower than the twice-born. se najnyavalkya snriti, V. 95. But when the word raTakara neans a person who nakes chariots, that is an artisan, it wil take the aril nya not by this sutra, but by the suceding sutra. The word kesini ocurs in this clas. its derivative wil be kEsinya There wil not be punvadbhava as required by [6.3.34] &c. ror had there ben punvadbhava, then by BasyaQe tadDite, al Bha bases wil becone punvad berore a tadhita aril elcept Qa Thererore kesini + nya = kesin + nya at this stage rule [6.1.14] wil apear and cause the elision or wi and we shal have kes + nya = kEsya But this is not the rorn desired, hence the word kesini is read with the reninine aril in the list. The word vena takes this aril in the Vedic literature. Thererore, the rorn vEnya in the nodern sanskrit is incorect. The word vanaraTa ocurs in this clas. With the elception or acent, it is treated in every other respect like a word or Kanvadi clas, a subdivision or Gargadi [4.4.105]. Thus disciples or vanaraTya wil be rorned by the aril an [4.2.1]. as vanaraTya + an = vanaraTa [6.1.105]. The plural wil be vanaraTa [2.4.64]. The reninine gender wil be vanaraTi [4.1.16] or vanaraTyayani [4.1.17]. The nuvan wil be vanaraTyayana [4.1.101]. so also it wil take an when the sense or colection &c is elpresed [4.3.127]: as vanaraTani But as to acent, it wil not be like Kanvadi words, ror while those words being rorned by the aril yan wil have udata on the rirst sylable [6.1.197] the acent or vanaraTya wil be governed by nya 1 kuru, 2 gargara (garga), 3 nangusa, 4 ajanara (ajanaraka), 5 raTakara, 6 vavaduka, 7 sanraja ksatriye, 8 kavi, 9 vinati (nati), 10 kapinjaladi, 1 vak (or vac) 12 vanaraTa, 13 pitrnat, 14 indralaji, (indrajali), 15 eji, 16 vataki, 17 danosnisi, 18

s: The affix ण्य comes in the sense of descendant after the words कुरु etc. Thus कुरु + ण्य = कौरव्यः So also गार्ग्यः The word कुरु takes the affix ण्य by [[4.1.172]], so that the form कौरव्यः is evolved both under the present sutra and sutra [[4.1.172]]; but the difference in these two words is this. The word कौरव्य formed by the ण्य of [[4.1.172]], loses its affix in the plural, because ण्य of [[4.1.172]] is a Tadraja affix (see [[1.4.6]]: but the word कौरव्य formed by the present sutra retains its affix in the plural. As कौरव्यः The word कौरव्य occurs in the Tikadi class [[4.1.154]], and it takes as such the affix फिञ्. As कौरव्यायणिः The word रथकार occurs in this class and it means the caste known as Rathakara. Rathakara is a caste a little lower than the twice-born. See Yajnyavalkya Smriti, V. 95. But when the word रथकार means a person who makes chariots, that is an artisan, it will take the affix ण्य not by this Sutra, but by the succeeding sutra. The word केशिनी occurs in this class. Its derivative will be कैशिन्यः There will not be punvadbhava as required by [[6.3.34]] &c. For had there been punvadbhava, then by भस्यढे तद्धिते, all Bha bases will become punvad before a taddhita affix except ढ Therefore केशिनी + ण्य = केशिन् + ण्य At this stage rule [[6.1.144]] will appear and cause the elision of टि and we shall have केश् + ण्य = कैश्य But this is not the form desired, hence the word केशिनी is read with the feminine affix in the list. The word वेन takes this affix in the Vedic literature. Therefore, the form वैन्य in the modern Sanskrit is incorrect. The word वामरथ occurs in this class. With the exception of accent, it is treated in every other respect like a word of Kanvadi class, a subdivision of Gargadi [[4.4.105]]. Thus disciples of वामरथ्यः will be formed by the affix अण् [[4.2.111]]. As वामरथ्य + अण् = वामरथः [[6.1.105]]. The plural will be वामरथाः [[2.4.64]]. The feminine gender will be वामरथी [[4.1.16]] or वामरथ्यायनी [[4.1.17]]. The Yuvan will be वामरथ्यायनः [[4.1.101]]. So also it will take अण् when the sense of collection &c is expressed [[4.3.127]]: as वामरथानि But as to accent, it will not be like Kanvadi words, for while those words being formed by the affix यञ् will have udatta on the first syllable [[6.1.197]] the accent of वामरथ्य will be governed by ण्य 1 कुरु, 2 गर्गर (गर्ग), 3 मङ्गुष, 4 अजमार (अजमारक), 5 रथकार, 6 वावदूक, 7 सम्राजः क्षत्रिये, 8 कवि, 9 विमति (मति), 10 कापिञ्जलादि, 11 वाक् (or वाच्) 12 वामरथ, 13 पितृमत्, 14 इन्द्रलाजी, (इन्द्रजालि), 15 एजि, 16 वातकि, 17 दामोष्णीषि, 18 गणकारि, 19 कैशोरि, 20 कुट, 21 शलाका (शालाका), 22 सुर, 23 पुर, 24 एरका (सरक), 25 शुभ्र, 26 अभ्र, 27 दर्भ, 28 केशिनी, 29 वेनाच्छन्दसि, 30 शूपर्णाय, 31 श्यावनाय, 32 श्यावरथ, 33 श्यावपुत्र, 34 सत्यंकार, 35 वडभीकार, 36 पथिकार, 37 मूढ, 38 शकन्धु, 39 शङ्क, 40 शाक, 41 शाकिन्, 42 शालीन, 43 कर्तृ, 44 हर्तृ, 45 इन्, 46 पिण्डी (इनपिण्डी), 47 वामरथस्य कण्वादिवत्स्वरवर्जम्.
