s: After the word वृद्ध , the affix छ is added in the remaining senses. The word गोत्र does not govern this sutra. This is a general rule. The Vriddha is defined in (l. 1.73) &c. This debars अण् Thus from गार्ग्य we have गार्गीय [[6.4.148]] & [[6.4.152]]. So also वात्सीयः, शालीयः, मालीयः, This rule being a subsequent one, debars the following preceding rules, in case of conflict of rules [[1.4.2]] I.The rule relating to Indeclinables (104), 2. The rule relating to words ending in तीर and रूप्य (106.3. The rule relating to Villages of North-folk (109), 4. The rule relating to penultimate क (110). Thus. इह-इहत्य; but आरात्-आरातीयः करवतीर-कारवतीरम्; but वायसतीर-वायसतीरीयः चणाररूप्य-चाणाररूप्यम्; but माणिरूप्य-माणिरूप्यकः [[4.2.21]] शिवपुर-शैवपुरम्; but वाडवकर्ष-वाडवकर्षीय; निलीनक-नैलीनकः; but औलूक-औलूकीयः

pk: The ariles Wak and Cas cone arter vrdDa word Bavat , in the renaining senses. The word Bavat is a Vridha word because it belongs to tyadadi clas [1.1.74]. This rule debars Ca or the last aphorisn. in the aril, Cas, the rinal s is indicatory, showing that the word Bavat berore this aril gets the designation or Pada pada [1.4.16]. Thus Bavat + Wak = Bavatka; Bavat + Cas = Bavatiya But when the word Bavat is not treated as Vridha, then it takes the general aril an; as Bavata This is the case when Bavat is derived by ariling satr to Bu
ck: the ariles tak ant cas cone arter vrta tort pavat , in the renainink senses. the tort pavat is a Vritha tort pecause it pelonks to tyatati clas [1.1.74]. this rule tepars ca or the last aphorisn. in the aril, cas, the rinal s is inticatory, shotink that the tort pavat perore this aril kets the tesiknation or pata pata [1.4.16]. thus pavat + tak = pavatka; pavat + cas = pavatiya put then the tort pavat is not treatet as Vritha, then it takes the keneral aril an; as pavata this is the case then pavat is terivet py arilink satr to pu
s: The affixes ठक् and छस् come after वृद्ध word भवत् , in the remaining senses. The word भवत् is a Vriddha word because it belongs to tyadadi class [[1.1.74]]. This rule debars छ of the last aphorism. In the affix, छस्, the final स् is indicatory, showing that the word भवत् before this affix gets the designation of Pada पद [[1.4.16]]. Thus भवत् + ठक् = भावत्कः; भवत् + छस् = भवतीयः But when the word भवत् is not treated as Vriddha, then it takes the general affix अण्; as भावतः This is the case when भवत् is derived by affixing शतृ to भू

pk: The ariles Wan and niW cone in the renaining senses arter the words kasi etc. in the ariles Wan and niW, the W is replaced by ika, the other leters are anubandhas. The rorn in both cases wil be the sane, but there is a distinction in the reninine. Those rorned by Wan wil take nip [4.1.15], the others wil take wap [4.1.47]. Thus kasika or kasiki, bEdika or bEdiki The word vrdDat is to be read in to this sutra. Those words in the list which are not vrdDa wil take the ariles, by virtue or being so clasiried. The word devadata ocurs in the list or words. it gets the designation or vrdDa by [1.1.75]. Thas dEvadatika But when it is the nane or a Vahika vilage, it is not a Vridha word. The secondary derivative then wil be devadata Q. in the nahabhashya it is said that a Proper nane is optionaly treated as a Vridha, and it gives elanple or devadatiya or devadata so then devadata is a Vridha word and wil take these ariles. ans. no. in that very pasage or nahabhashya it is rurther stated that the option in the case or Proper nanes is alowed only ror the purposes or the aplication or the aril Ca [4.2.14] and not the aril Wan and niW Vart:- This aril cones arter conpound words ending in kala and preceded by apat, urDva and tada; as apatkaliki or ka, OrDakaliki or ka, tatkaliki or ka 1kasi, 2 cedi (vEdi ) 3 sanyati, 4 sanvaha, 5 acyuta, 6 nodanana (nohanana) 7 sakulada, 8,hastikarsu, 9 kunanan, (kudanan), 10 hiranya, 1 karana, 12 govasana (goDasana) 13 Barangi, 14 arindana, 15 aritra, 16 devadata, 17 dasagrana (dasagrana) 18 sOvavatana (sODavatana) 19 yuvaraja, 20 uparaja, 21 devaraja, 2 nodana, 23 sinDunitra, 24 dasanitra, 25 suDanitra, 26 sonanitra, 27 Caganitra, 28 saDanitra, 29 apadadipurvapadat (apad, urDva, tad) kalantat, 30 sanjna, 31 BOriki, 32 BOlingi, 3 sarvanitra, 34 saDunitra
ck: the ariles tan ant nit cone in the renainink senses arter the torts kasi etc. in the ariles tan ant nit, the t is replacet py ika, the other leters are anupanthas. the rorn in poth cases til pe the sane, put there is a tistinction in the reninine. those rornet py tan til take nip [4.1.15], the others til take tap [4.1.47]. thus kasika or kasiki, pEtika or pEtiki the tort vrtat is to pe reat in to this sutra. those torts in the list thich are not vrta til take the ariles, py virtue or peink so clasiriet. the tort tevatata ocurs in the list or torts. it kets the tesiknation or vrta py [1.1.75]. thas tEvatatika put then it is the nane or a Vahika vilake, it is not a Vritha tort. the secontary terivative then til pe tevatata t. in the nahaphashya it is sait that a proper nane is optionaly treatet as a Vritha, ant it kives elanple or tevatatiya or tevatata so then tevatata is a Vritha tort ant til take these ariles. ans. no. in that very pasake or nahaphashya it is rurther statet that the option in the case or proper nanes is alotet only ror the purposes or the aplication or the aril ca [4.2.14] ant not the aril tan ant nit Vart:- this aril cones arter conpount torts entink in kala ant precetet py apat, urtva ant tata; as apatkaliki or ka, Ortakaliki or ka, tatkaliki or ka 1kasi, 2 ceti (vEti ) 3 sanyati, 4 sanvaha, 5 acyuta, 6 notanana (nohanana) 7 sakulata, 8,hastikarsu, 9 kunanan, (kutanan), 10 hiranya, 1 karana, 12 kovasana (kotasana) 13 paranki, 14 arintana, 15 aritra, 16 tevatata, 17 tasakrana (tasakrana) 18 sOvavatana (sOtavatana) 19 yuvaraca, 20 uparaca, 21 tevaraca, 2 notana, 23 sintunitra, 24 tasanitra, 25 sutanitra, 26 sonanitra, 27 cakanitra, 28 satanitra, 29 apatatipurvapatat (apat, urtva, tat) kalantat, 30 sancna, 31 pOriki, 32 pOlinki, 3 sarvanitra, 34 satunitra
s: The affixes ठञ् and ञिठ् come in the remaining senses after the words काशि etc. In the affixes ठञ् and ञिठ्, the ठ् is replaced by इक, the other letters are anubandhas. The form in both cases will be the same, but there is a distinction in the feminine. Those formed by ठञ् will take ङीप् [[4.1.15]], the others will take टाप् [[4.1.47]]. Thus काशिका or काशिकी, बैदिका or बैदिकी The word वृद्धात् is to be read in to this sutra. Those words in the list which are not वृद्ध will take the affixes, by virtue of being so classified. The word देवदत्तः occurs in the list of words. It gets the designation of वृद्ध by [[1.1.75]]. Thas दैवदत्तिकः But when it is the name of a Vahika village, it is not a Vriddha word. The secondary derivative then will be देवदत्तः Q. In the Mahabhashya it is said that a Proper name is optionally treated as a Vriddha, and it gives example of देवदत्तीयाः or देवदत्ताः So then देवदत्तः is a Vriddha word and will take these affixes. Ans. No. In that very passage of Mahabhashya it is further stated that the option in the case of Proper Names is allowed only for the purposes of the application of the affix छ [[4.2.114]] and not the affix ठञ् and ञिठ् Vart:- This affix comes after compound words ending in काल and preceded by आपत्, ऊर्ध्व and तद; as आपत्कालिकी or का, और्धकलिकी or का, तात्कालिकी or का 1काशि, 2 चेदि (वैदी ) 3 सांयाति, 4 संवाह, 5 अच्युत, 6 मोदमान (मोहमान) 7 शकुलाद, 8,हस्तिकर्षू, 9 कुनामन्, (कुदामन्), 10 हिरण्य, 11 करण, 12 गोवासन (गोधाशम) 13 भारङ्गी, 14 अरिंदम, 15 अरित्र, 16 देवदत्त, 17 दशग्राम (दासग्राम) 18 शौवावतान (सौधावतान) 19 युवराज, 20 उपराज, 21 देवराज, 22 मोदन, 23 सिन्धुमित्र, 24 दासमित्र, 25 सुधामित्र, 26 सोममित्र, 27 छागमित्र, 28 सधमित्र, 29 आपदादिपूर्वपदात् (आपद्, ऊर्ध्व, तद्) कालान्तात्, 30 संज्ञा, 31 भौरिकि, 32 भौलिङ्गि, 33 सर्वमित्र, 34 साधुमित्र

pk: The ariles Wan and niW cone in the renaining senses arter the vrdDa words denoting the vilages or vahika The word vrdDat is to be read into this sutra. This debars the aril Ca [4.2.14]. Thus sakaliki or sakalika, nanTaviki or nanTavika
ck: the ariles tan ant nit cone in the renainink senses arter the vrta torts tenotink the vilakes or vahika the tort vrtat is to pe reat into this sutra. this tepars the aril ca [4.2.14]. thus sakaliki or sakalika, nantaviki or nantavika
s: The affixes ठञ् and ञिठ् come in the remaining senses after the वृद्ध words denoting the villages of वाहीक The word वृद्धात् is to be read into this sutra. This debars the affix छ [[4.2.114]]. Thus शाकलिकी or शाकलिका, मान्थविकी or मान्थविका

pk: The ariles Wan and niW cone optionaly in the renaining senses arter the vrdDa words denoting vahika vilages situated in usinara Thus ahvajaliki, lika and liya; so also sOdarsaniki, sOdarsanika and sOdarsaniya
ck: the ariles tan ant nit cone optionaly in the renainink senses arter the vrta torts tenotink vahika vilakes situatet in usinara thus ahvacaliki, lika ant liya; so also sOtarsaniki, sOtarsanika ant sOtarsaniya
s: The affixes ठञ् and ञिठ् come optionally in the remaining senses after the वृद्ध words denoting वाहीक villages situated in उशीनर Thus आह्वजालिकी, लिका and लीया; so also सौदर्शनिकी, सौदर्शनिका and सौदर्शनीया

pk: The ariles Wan cones in the renaining senses arter a pratipadika (noninal sten) denoting a locality and ending in u The phrase vrdDat does not govern this sutra. ror had it ben understod in this aphorisn, there would have ben no necesity or repeating it in the nelt. Thus tEsadakarsuka, sabarajanbuka Why do we say dese denoting a country? Observe pawava the pupils or pawu rorned by an in the previous sutras, the anuvriti or Wan and niW both were curent; hence the repetition or Wan in this sutra, because we could not take the anuvriti or Wan ron the last sutra without drawing the anuvriti or niW
ck: the ariles tan cones in the renainink senses arter a pratipatika (noninal sten) tenotink a locality ant entink in u the phrase vrtat toes not kovern this sutra. ror hat it pen unterstot in this aphorisn, there toult have pen no necesity or repeatink it in the nelt. thus tEsatakarsuka, saparacanpuka thy to te say tese tenotink a country? Opserve patava the pupils or patu rornet py an in the previous sutras, the anuvriti or tan ant nit poth tere curent; hence the repetition or tan in this sutra, pecause te coult not take the anuvriti or tan ron the last sutra tithout tratink the anuvriti or nit
s: The affixes ठञ् comes in the remaining senses after a प्रातिपदिक (Nominal Stem) denoting a locality and ending in उ The phrase 'वृद्धात्' does not govern this sutra. For had it been understood in this aphorism, there would have been no necessity of repeating it in the next. Thus तैषादकर्षुकः, शाबरजम्बुकः Why do we say देशे 'denoting a country'? Observe पाटवाः 'the pupils of पटु' formed by अण् In the previous sutras, the anuvritti of ठञ् and ञिठ् both were current; hence the repetition of ठञ् in this sutra, because we could not take the anuvritti of ठञ् from the last sutra without drawing the anuvritti of ञिठ्

pk: The ariles Wan cones in the renaining senses arter a vrdDa word ending in u and denoting a locality or East-rolks. The phrase ordesi is here understod. Thus aQakajanbuka, sakajanbuka napitavastuka The aril Wan would have ben valid by the last sutra also, the present sutra nakes a niyana or restriction, showing that in the case or words denoting places or East, the rule aplies to those words only, which are Vridha. Thererore it does not aply to nalavastu, ron which we have nalavastava
ck: the ariles tan cones in the renainink senses arter a vrta tort entink in u ant tenotink a locality or East-rolks. the phrase ortesi is here unterstot. thus atakacanpuka, sakacanpuka napitavastuka the aril tan toult have pen valit py the last sutra also, the present sutra nakes a niyana or restriction, shotink that in the case or torts tenotink places or East, the rule aplies to those torts only, thich are Vritha. thererore it toes not aply to nalavastu, ron thich te have nalavastava
s: The affixes ठञ् comes in the remaining senses after a वृद्ध word ending in उ and denoting a locality of East-folks. The phrase ओर्देशी is here understood. Thus आढकजम्बुकः, शाकजम्बुकः नापितवास्तुकः The affix ठञ् would have been valid by the last sutra also, the present sutra makes a नियम or restriction, showing that in the case of words denoting places of East, the rule applies to those words only, which are Vriddha. Therefore it does not apply to मल्लवास्तु, from which we have माल्लवास्तवः

pk: The aril vun cones in the renaining senses arter a vrdDa word denoting a locality which has the leter ya as its penultinate and arter a vrdDa place nane denoting a waste or desert place. The words vrdDat and dese are understod here. The word Danva neans a waste or desert. Thus pareDanvaka, Eravataka are elanples or Danva sinilarly sankasyaka and kanpilyaka are elanples or ya penultinate.
ck: the aril vun cones in the renainink senses arter a vrta tort tenotink a locality thich has the leter ya as its penultinate ant arter a vrta place nane tenotink a taste or tesert place. the torts vrtat ant tese are unterstot here. the tort tanva neans a taste or tesert. thus paretanvaka, Eravataka are elanples or tanva sinilarly sankasyaka ant kanpilyaka are elanples or ya penultinate.
s: The affix वुञ् comes in the remaining senses after a वृद्ध word denoting a locality which has the letter य as its penultimate and after a वृद्ध place name denoting a waste or desert place. The words वृद्धात् and देशे are understood here. The word धन्व means a waste or desert. Thus पारेधन्वकः, ऐरावतकः are examples of धन्व Similarly सांकाश्यकः and काम्पिल्यकः are examples of य penultimate.

pk: The aril vun cones in the renaining senses arter a vrdDa word denoting a locality and ending with 1. prasTa 2. pura or vaha This debars Ca [4.2.14]. Thus nalaprasTaka, nandipuraka, kantipuraka, pEluvahaka, Palgunivahaka The words ending in pura would have taken the aril vun by the nelt sutra also, but as that sutra is restricted to the countries or the East, this sutra is general in its scope.
ck: the aril vun cones in the renainink senses arter a vrta tort tenotink a locality ant entink tith 1. prasta 2. pura or vaha this tepars ca [4.2.14]. thus nalaprastaka, nantipuraka, kantipuraka, pEluvahaka, palkunivahaka the torts entink in pura toult have taken the aril vun py the nelt sutra also, put as that sutra is restrictet to the countries or the East, this sutra is keneral in its scope.
s: The affix वुञ् comes in the remaining senses after a वृद्ध word denoting a locality and ending with 1. प्रस्थ 2. पुर or वह This debars छ [[4.2.114]]. Thus मालाप्रस्थकः, नान्दीपुरकः, कान्तिपुरकः, पैलुवहकः, फाल्गुनीवहकः The words ending in पुर would have taken the affix वुञ् by the next sutra also, but as that sutra is restricted to the countries of the East, this sutra is general in its scope.

pk: The aril vun cones in the renaining senses arter a vrdDa word denoting a locality or the East-rolk, the word having penultinate ra or ending in i This debars Ca Thus pawaliputraka, Ekacakraka so also with words ending in i as, kakandi — kakandaka, nakandi — nakandaka [6.4.148]. Why do we say pracan or the East-rolk? Observe datanitriya rorned by Ca. The t in it in the sutra is ror the sake or distinctnes.
ck: the aril vun cones in the renainink senses arter a vrta tort tenotink a locality or the East-rolk, the tort havink penultinate ra or entink in i this tepars ca thus pataliputraka, Ekacakraka so also tith torts entink in i as, kakanti — kakantaka, nakanti — nakantaka [6.4.148]. thy to te say pracan or the East-rolk? Opserve tatanitriya rornet py ca. the t in it in the sutra is ror the sake or tistinctnes.
s: The affix वुञ् comes in the remaining senses after a वृद्ध word denoting a locality of the East-folk, the word having penultimate र or ending in ई This debars छ Thus पाटलिपुत्रकाः, ऐकचक्रकाः So also with words ending in ई As, काकन्दी — काकन्दकः, माकन्दी — माकन्दकः [[6.4.148]]. Why do we say प्राचाम् 'of the East-folk'? Observe दात्तामित्रीयः formed by छ. The त् in ईत् in the sutra is for the sake of distinctness.

pk: The aril vun cones in the renaining senses arter a vrdDa word denoting an inhabited kingdon or a linit or such kingdon The phrases vrdDat and dese are understod here, being qualiried by janapada and tadavaDi This debars the aril Ca Thus aBisaraka and adarsaka are elanples or janapada and Opuswaka and syanayanaka ron Opuswa and syanayana two uninhabited countries, are ilustrations or janapadavaDi The avaDi or linit or an inhabited country or janapada nust be a country and not a vilage. This is so, in order to prevent, by anticipation, the aplication or Ca by [4.2.137] to words like trigarta which is an arid desert: as trEgartaka The word tadavaDi neans either "the boundary or that (janapada)" or "that which itselr is a boundary".
ck: the aril vun cones in the renainink senses arter a vrta tort tenotink an inhapitet kinkton or a linit or such kinkton the phrases vrtat ant tese are unterstot here, peink tualiriet py canapata ant tatavati this tepars the aril ca thus apisaraka ant atarsaka are elanples or canapata ant Opustaka ant syanayanaka ron Opusta ant syanayana to uninhapitet countries, are ilustrations or canapatavati the avati or linit or an inhapitet country or canapata nust pe a country ant not a vilake. this is so, in orter to prevent, py anticipation, the aplication or ca py [4.2.137] to torts like trikarta thich is an arit tesert: as trEkartaka the tort tatavati neans either "the pountary or that (canapata)" or "that thich itselr is a pountary".
s: The affix वुञ् comes in the remaining senses after a वृद्ध word denoting an inhabited kingdom or a limit of such kingdom The phrases वृद्धात् and देशे are understood here, being qualified by जनपद and तदवधि This debars the affix छ Thus आभिसारकः and आदर्शकः are examples of जनपद And औपुष्टकः and श्यामायनकः from औपुष्ट and श्यामायन two uninhabited countries, are illustrations of जनपदावधि The अवधि or limit of an inhabited country or जनपद must be a country and not a village. This is so, in order to prevent, by anticipation, the application of छ by [[4.2.137]] to words like त्रिगर्त्त which is an arid desert: as त्रैगर्त्तकः The word तदवधि means either "the boundary of that (जनपद)" or "that which itself is a boundary".

pk: The aril vun cones in the renaining senses, even arter a word which is not a vrdDa which is always plural, when it denotes an inhabited country or a linit or such country, as wel as arter such vrdDa words. The words janapada and tadavaDi are to be read into the aphorisn. This debars Ca and an Thus ron anga, vanga and kalinga which are non-Vridha Kingdon denoting words, always having a plural rorn, we have ankaka, vangaka and kalingaka sinilarly ajaniQa and ajakranda are non-Vridha always plural words, denoting boundary or kingdon; we have ron then ajaniQaka and ajakrandaka The aril wil aply, or course to Vridha janapada word by the last sutra, though these be always plural in rorn. Thus davarka and janbaka ron darva and janba so also to Vridha words denoting linit or a Kingdon: kalanjara — kalanjaraka, vEkulisa - vEkulisaka The word visaya is used in the sutra to indicate that the word should be plural in esence, having no coresponding singular rorn. Thererore the rule wil not aply to vartanya plural or vartani The derivative ron it wil be vartana The word api is used in the sutra to indicate that Vridha-words which would have taken vun by the last sutra are not debared by this sutra, when they are plural in rorn. This debaring would have taken place, by the rule or interpretation known as takrakOnqinyanyaya; but ror the use or the word api This nalin or nyaya is thus elplained in Padananjari:- purvasutre hi janapadasananye vrdDat vun vihita, yaTa brahnanasananye daDidanan; iha tu bahuvacanavisayevisesevrdDad vun, yaTa kOnqinye takradanan, tatasca bahuvacanadapi vrdDad vuniprapte araByananovrdDad vun vrdDad vunobaDaka syadityapi sabdana sanuciyate ityarTa
ck: the aril vun cones in the renainink senses, even arter a tort thich is not a vrta thich is altays plural, then it tenotes an inhapitet country or a linit or such country, as tel as arter such vrta torts. the torts canapata ant tatavati are to pe reat into the aphorisn. this tepars ca ant an thus ron anka, vanka ant kalinka thich are non-Vritha kinkton tenotink torts, altays havink a plural rorn, te have ankaka, vankaka ant kalinkaka sinilarly acanita ant acakranta are non-Vritha altays plural torts, tenotink pountary or kinkton; te have ron then acanitaka ant acakrantaka the aril til aply, or course to Vritha canapata tort py the last sutra, thoukh these pe altays plural in rorn. thus tavarka ant canpaka ron tarva ant canpa so also to Vritha torts tenotink linit or a kinkton: kalancara — kalancaraka, vEkulisa - vEkulisaka the tort visaya is uset in the sutra to inticate that the tort shoult pe plural in esence, havink no corespontink sinkular rorn. thererore the rule til not aply to vartanya plural or vartani the terivative ron it til pe vartana the tort api is uset in the sutra to inticate that Vritha-torts thich toult have taken vun py the last sutra are not teparet py this sutra, then they are plural in rorn. this teparink toult have taken place, py the rule or interpretation knotn as takrakOntinyanyaya; put ror the use or the tort api this nalin or nyaya is thus elplainet in patanancari:- purvasutre hi canapatasananye vrtat vun vihita, yata prahnanasananye tatitanan; iha tu pahuvacanavisayevisesevrtat vun, yata kOntinye takratanan, tatasca pahuvacanatapi vrtat vuniprapte arapyananovrtat vun vrtat vunopataka syatityapi saptana sanuciyate ityarta
s: The affix वुञ् comes in the remaining senses, even after a word which is not a वृद्ध which is always plural, when it denotes an inhabited country or a limit of such country, as well as after such वृद्ध words. The words जनपद and तदवधि are to be read into the aphorism. This debars छ and अण् Thus from अङ्गाः, वङ्गाः and कलिङ्गाः which are non-Vriddha Kingdom denoting words, always having a plural form, we have आङ्ककः, वाङ्गकः and कालिंगकः Similarly अजमीढाः and अजक्रन्दाः are non-Vriddha always plural words, denoting boundary of kingdom; we have from them आजमीढकः and आजक्रन्दकः The affix will apply, of course to Vriddha जनपद word by the last sutra, though these be always plural in form. Thus दावर्कः and जाम्बकः from दार्वाः and जाम्बाः So also to Vriddha words denoting limit of a Kingdom: कालंजराः — कालंजरकः, वैकुलिशाः -- वैकुलिशकः The word विषय is used in the sutra to indicate that the word should be plural in essence, having no corresponding singular form. Therefore the rule will not apply to वर्तन्यः plural of वर्तनी The derivative from it will be वार्तनः The word अपि is used in the sutra to indicate that Vriddha-words which would have taken वुञ् by the last sutra are not debarred by this sutra, when they are plural in form. This debarring would have taken place, by the rule of interpretation known as तक्रकौण्डिन्यन्याय; but for the use of the word अपि This maxim or nyaya is thus explained in Padamanjari:-- पूर्वसूत्रे हि जनपदसामान्ये वृद्धात् वुञ् विहितः, यथा ब्राह्मणसामान्ये दधिदानं; इह तु बहुवचनविषयेविशेषेऽवृद्धाद् वुञ्, यथा कौण्डिन्ये तक्रदानं, ततश्च बहुवचनादपि वृद्धाद् वुञिप्राप्ते आरभ्यमाणोऽवृद्धाद् वुञ् वृद्धाद् वुञोबाधकः स्यादित्यपि शब्दन समुच्चीयते इत्यर्थः

pk: The aril vun cones in the renaining senses arter a word whether a vrdDa or not, denoting a locality and having its second tern the words 1. kacCa 2. agni 3. vaktra and 4. garta This debars Ca and an as darukacCaka, pEpalikacCaka, kanqagnaka, vEBujagnaka Endravaktraka, sEnDuvaktraka, bahugartaka and cakragartaka The word utarapada in the sutra should be read with every one or the words kacCa &c.
ck: the aril vun cones in the renainink senses arter a tort thether a vrta or not, tenotink a locality ant havink its secont tern the torts 1. kaca 2. akni 3. vaktra ant 4. karta this tepars ca ant an as tarukacaka, pEpalikacaka, kantaknaka, vEpucaknaka Entravaktraka, sEntuvaktraka, pahukartaka ant cakrakartaka the tort utarapata in the sutra shoult pe reat tith every one or the torts kaca &c.
s: The affix वुञ् comes in the remaining senses after a word whether a वृद्ध or not, denoting a locality and having its second term the words 1. कच्छ 2. अग्नि 3. वक्त्र and 4. गर्त This debars छ and अण् As दारुकच्छकः, पैप्पलीकच्छकः, काण्डाग्नकः, वैभुजाग्नकः ऐन्द्रवक्त्रकः, सैन्धुवक्त्रकः, बाहुगर्तकः and चाक्रगर्तकः The word उत्तरपद in the sutra should be read with every one of the words कच्छ &c.

The word paTeya ocurs in the list. it would have taken vun by [4.2.121] as it has ya as penultinate. its nention here shows that it ned not denote a locality ror the aplication or this aril. sinilarly the words videha and anarta being nanes or janapada would have taken vun by 124 ante; here in this list, thererore, they do not denote country. s: The affix वुञ् comes in the remaining senses after the words धूम etc. denoting country. This debars अण् &c. धौमकः खाण्डकः &c. The word पाथेय occurs in the list. It would have taken वुञ् by [[4.2.121]] as it has य as penultimate. Its mention here shows that it need not denote a locality for the application of this affix. Similarly the words विदेह and आनर्त being names of जनपद would have taken वुञ् by 124 ante; here in this list, therefore, they do not denote country. Thus विदेहानां क्षत्रियाणां स्वं = वैदेहकम् "the property of Videha Kshatriyas". So also आनर्तकम् The word समुद्र occurs in the list. It takes the affix when the derivative word means a 'ship' or a 'sailor'. Thus सामुद्रिका नौः and सामुद्रको मनुष्यः Otherwise not : सामुद्रम् "Oceanic water". 1 धूम, 2 षडण्ड (खडण्ड and खण्ड) 3 शशादन, 4 अर्जुनाव (आर्जुनाद) 5 माहकस्थली, 6 आनकस्थली, 7 माहिषस्थली, 8 मानस्थली (माषस्थली) 9 अदृस्थली, 10 मद्रुकस्थली, 11 समुद्रस्थली, 12 दाण्डायनस्थली, 13 राजस्थली, 14 विदेह, 15 राजगृह, 16 सात्रासाह, 17 शष्प, 18 (शिष्य) 18 मित्रवर्ध्र (मित्रवर्ध; मित्र, बल) 19 भक्षाली, 20 मद्रकूल, 21 आजीकूल (आञ्जीकूल) 22 द्व्याहाव, 23 त्र्याहाव, 24 संस्फीय (संहीय) 25 बर्बर, 26 वर्ज्य, 27 गर्त (वर्चगर्त) 28 आनर्त, 29 माठर, 30 पाथेय, 31 घोष, 32 पल्ली (वल्ली) 33 आराज्ञी, 34 धार्तराज्ञी, 35 आवय, 36 तीर्थ (अवयात तीर्थ) 37 कूलात्सौवीरेषु, 38 समुद्रान्नावि मनुष्ये च, 39 कुक्षि, 40 अन्तरीय (अन्तरीप) 41 द्वीप, 42 अरुण, 43 उज्जयनी, (उज्जयिनी) 44 पट्टार, 45 दक्षिणापथ, 46 साकेत, 47 घोषस्थली, 48 भक्षास्थली, 49 गर्तकूल, 50 मानवल्ली, 51 सुराज्ञी

pk: The aril vun cones arter the word nagara in the renaining senses, when censure or praise is inplied. The word kutsanan which is equivalent to nindanan or blane or censure; and pravinyan which neans nEpunya "delterity", qualiry the sense or the aril. Thus nagaraka, a knave, a cuning person, or a skilrul person. The word literaly neans a town-born, or town-bred, but by the usage or language, it always denotes a person having the vices or virtues or a town, such as a thier or an artist. Why do we say "when censure or delterity is inplied"? Observe nagara brahnana the nagara Brahnanas".
ck: the aril vun cones arter the tort nakara in the renainink senses, then censure or praise is inpliet. the tort kutsanan thich is etuivalent to nintanan or plane or censure; ant pravinyan thich neans nEpunya "telterity", tualiry the sense or the aril. thus nakaraka, a knave, a cunink person, or a skilrul person. the tort literaly neans a totn-porn, or totn-pret, put py the usake or lankuake, it altays tenotes a person havink the vices or virtues or a totn, such as a thier or an artist. thy to te say "then censure or telterity is inpliet"? Opserve nakara prahnana the nakara prahnanas".
s: The affix वुञ् comes after the word नगर in the remaining senses, when censure or praise is implied. The word कुत्सनं which is equivalent to निन्दनं or 'blame or censure'; and प्रावीण्यं which means नैपुण्य "dexterity", qualify the sense of the affix. Thus नागरकः, 'a knave, a cunning person, or a skillful person'. The word literally means 'a town-born, or town-bred', but by the usage of language, it always denotes a person having the vices or virtues of a town, such as a thief or an artist. Why do we say "when censure or dexterity is implied"? Observe नागराः ब्राह्मणाः 'the Nagara Brahmanas".

pk: The aril vun cones in the renaining senses arter the word aranya , in the sense or a nan. This debars the aril na. Thus aranyaka nanusya a rorester. Vart:- it should be stated rather that the aril vun is aded to aranya in the sense or a way a leson, or doctrine (upanishad) a nalin a play or gane a nan and an elephant. Thus aranyaka panTa , aDyaya, nyaya vihara, nanusya or hasti Vart:- Optionaly when the sense is that or a cow-dung as aranya or aranyaka gonaya Why do we say when having these senses? Otherwise the aril wil be an. as aranya pasava wild beasts.
ck: the aril vun cones in the renainink senses arter the tort aranya , in the sense or a nan. this tepars the aril na. thus aranyaka nanusya a rorester. Vart:- it shoult pe statet rather that the aril vun is atet to aranya in the sense or a tay a leson, or toctrine (upanishat) a nalin a play or kane a nan ant an elephant. thus aranyaka panta , atyaya, nyaya vihara, nanusya or hasti Vart:- Optionaly then the sense is that or a cot-tunk as aranya or aranyaka konaya thy to te say then havink these senses? Othertise the aril til pe an. as aranya pasava tilt peasts.
s: The affix वुञ् comes in the remaining senses after the word अरण्य , in the sense of 'a man'. This debars the affix ण. Thus आरण्यकः मनुष्यः 'a forester'. Vart:- It should be stated rather that the affix वुञ् is added to अरण्य in the sense of 'a way' 'a lesson, or doctrine (Upanishad)' 'a maxim' 'a play or game' 'a man' and 'an elephant'. Thus आरण्यकः पन्थाः , अध्यायः, न्यायः विहारः, मनुष्यः or हस्ती Vart:- Optionally when the sense is that of a cow-dung as आरण्याः or आरण्यका गोमयाः Why do we say 'when having these senses'? Otherwise the affix will be अण्. As आरण्याः पशवः 'wild beasts'.

pk: The aril vun cones optionaly in the renaining senses arter the words 1. kuru and 2. yuganDara Thus kOravaka or kOrava꣡, yOganDaraka or gOganDara꣡ These words denote janapada or inhabited countries, and thererore by sutra [4.2.125] they would always, have taken the aril vun. The present sutra nakes the aplication or vun optional and not obligatory. The word kuru ocurs in the list or kacCadi clas [4.2.13]. By virtue or its being so clasiried, it wil take an also. and when it neans nan or sonething round in nen, it wil take necesarily, not optionaly, the aril vun by virtue or sutra [4.2.134]. as kOravako nanusya, kOravakanasya hasitan This aphorisn thererore, teaches option regarding kuru with these restrictions, while it teaches option absolutely with regard to the word yuganDara
ck: the aril vun cones optionaly in the renainink senses arter the torts 1. kuru ant 2. yukantara thus kOravaka or kOrava꣡, yOkantaraka or kOkantara꣡ these torts tenote canapata or inhapitet countries, ant thererore py sutra [4.2.125] they toult altays, have taken the aril vun. the present sutra nakes the aplication or vun optional ant not oplikatory. the tort kuru ocurs in the list or kacati clas [4.2.13]. py virtue or its peink so clasiriet, it til take an also. ant then it neans nan or sonethink rount in nen, it til take necesarily, not optionaly, the aril vun py virtue or sutra [4.2.134]. as kOravako nanusya, kOravakanasya hasitan this aphorisn thererore, teaches option rekartink kuru tith these restrictions, thile it teaches option apsolutely tith rekart to the tort yukantara
s: The affix वुञ् comes optionally in the remaining senses after the words 1. कुरु and 2. युगन्धर Thus कौरवकः or कौरवः꣡, यौगन्धरकः or गौगन्धरः꣡ These words denote जनपद or inhabited countries, and therefore by sutra [[4.2.125]] they would always, have taken the affix वुञ्. The present sutra makes the application of वुञ् optional and not obligatory. The word कुरु occurs in the list of कच्छादि class [[4.2.133]]. By virtue of its being so classified, it will take अण् also. And when it means man or something found in men, it will take necessarily, not optionally, the affix वुञ् by virtue of sutra [[4.2.134]]. As कौरवको मनुष्यः, कौरवकमस्य हसितम् This aphorism therefore, teaches option regarding कुरु with these restrictions, while it teaches option absolutely with regard to the word युगन्धरः

pk: The aril kan cones in the renaining senses arter the words 1. nadra and 2. vrji This debars vun, though the words denote inhabited countries. Thus na꣡draka born in nadra, vr꣡jika

s: The affix कन् comes in the remaining senses after the words 1. मद्र and 2. वृजि This debars वुञ्, though the words denote inhabited countries. Thus म꣡द्रकः 'born in Madra', वृ꣡जिकः

pk: The aril an cones in the renaining senses arter a word denoting a place and having the leter ka as its penultinate. This debars vun in the case or words which denote janapada or inhabited countries. Or course the words which do not denote janapada, wil have taken an even without this rule. Thus arsika "born in rsika" so also nahisika The aril an wil aply even when the word ends in u, and would have otherwise taken Wan by [4.2.19]. Thus Eksvaka "born in iksvaku" The word dese is understod in this sutra.
ck: the aril an cones in the renainink senses arter a tort tenotink a place ant havink the leter ka as its penultinate. this tepars vun in the case or torts thich tenote canapata or inhapitet countries. Or course the torts thich to not tenote canapata, til have taken an even tithout this rule. thus arsika "porn in rsika" so also nahisika the aril an til aply even then the tort ents in u, ant toult have othertise taken tan py [4.2.19]. thus Eksvaka "porn in iksvaku" the tort tese is unterstot in this sutra.
s: The affix अण् comes in the remaining senses after a word denoting a place and having the letter क as its penultimate. This debars वुञ् in the case of words which denote जनपद or inhabited countries. Of course the words which do not denote जनपद, will have taken अण् even without this rule. Thus आर्षिकः "born in ऋषिकाः" So also माहिषिकः The affix अण् will apply even when the word ends in उ, and would have otherwise taken ठञ् by [[4.2.119]]. Thus ऐक्ष्वाकः "born in इक्ष्वाकु" The word देशे is understood in this sutra.

pk: The aril an cones in the renaining senses arter the words kacCa etc. denoting places. The word dese is understod here. This debars vun &c. Thus kacCa, sEnDava, varnava &c. The words kacCa &c. are not invariable plural words, because by the nelt sutra, it is shown that these words nay signiry nen and their habits &c. The word vijapaka ocurs in this list. it would have taken an by the last sutra also, because it has ka as its penultinate. its nention in the list is ror the sake or the subsequent sutra by which it takes vun also under certain conditions. 1 kacCa, 2 sinDu, 3 varnu, 4 ganDara, 5 naDunat, 6 kanboja, 7 kasnira, 8 salva, 9 kuru, 10 anusanqa (anu, anqa, Kanqa) 1 dvipa, 12 anupa, 13 ajavaha, 14 vijapaka, 15 kalutara (kuluna)16 ranku
ck: the aril an cones in the renainink senses arter the torts kaca etc. tenotink places. the tort tese is unterstot here. this tepars vun &c. thus kaca, sEntava, varnava &c. the torts kaca &c. are not invariaple plural torts, pecause py the nelt sutra, it is shotn that these torts nay sikniry nen ant their hapits &c. the tort vicapaka ocurs in this list. it toult have taken an py the last sutra also, pecause it has ka as its penultinate. its nention in the list is ror the sake or the supsetuent sutra py thich it takes vun also unter certain contitions. 1 kaca, 2 sintu, 3 varnu, 4 kantara, 5 natunat, 6 kanpoca, 7 kasnira, 8 salva, 9 kuru, 10 anusanta (anu, anta, kanta) 1 tvipa, 12 anupa, 13 acavaha, 14 vicapaka, 15 kalutara (kuluna)16 ranku
s: The affix अण् comes in the remaining senses after the words कच्छ etc. denoting places. The word देशे is understood here. This debars वुञ् &c. Thus काच्छः, सैन्धवः, वार्णवः &c. The words कच्छ &c. are not invariable plural words, because by the next sutra, it is shown that these words may signify men and their habits &c. The word विजापक occurs in this list. It would have taken अण् by the last sutra also, because it has क as its penultimate. Its mention in the list is for the sake of the subsequent sutra by which it takes वुञ् also under certain conditions. 1 कच्छ, 2 सिन्धु, 3 वर्णु, 4 गन्धार, 5 मधुमत्, 6 कम्बोज, 7 कश्मीर, 8 साल्व, 9 कुरु, 10 अनुषण्ड (अणु, अण्ड, खण्ड) 11 द्वीप, 12 अनूप, 13 अजवाह, 14 विजापक, 15 कलूतर (कुलून)16 रङ्कु

pk: The aril vun cones arter the words kacCa etc. in the senses or born etc. when the neaning is a nan or what elists in a nan. This debars an Thus kacCaka a nan born in Kutch, kacCakanasya hasitan jalpitan is joke or talk is or Kutch or a Kutch-laughter. kacCika cuqa sinilarly sEnDavako nanusya, sEnDavakanasya hasitan jalpitan, sEnDavika cuqa Why do we say "when neaning nan or what elists in nan?" Observe kanCo gO The cow or Kutch. sEnDavo varnava
ck: the aril vun cones arter the torts kaca etc. in the senses or porn etc. then the neanink is a nan or that elists in a nan. this tepars an thus kacaka a nan porn in kutch, kacakanasya hasitan calpitan is coke or talk is or kutch or a kutch-laukhter. kacika cuta sinilarly sEntavako nanusya, sEntavakanasya hasitan calpitan, sEntavika cuta thy to te say "then neanink nan or that elists in nan?" Opserve kanco kO the cot or kutch. sEntavo varnava
s: The affix वुञ् comes after the words कच्छ etc. in the senses of born etc. when the meaning is 'a man' or 'what exists in a man'. This debars अण् Thus काच्छकः 'a man born in Kutch', काच्छकमस्य हसितं जल्पितम् 'His joke or talk is of Kutch or a Kutch-laughter'. काच्छिका चूडा Similarly सैन्धवको मनुष्यः, सैन्धवकमस्य हसितं जल्पितम्, सैन्धविका चूडा Why do we say "when meaning man or what exists in man?" Observe कान्छो गौः 'The cow of Kutch'. सैन्धवो वार्णवः

pk: The aril vun cones arter the word salva in the senses or being born etc. when denoting a nan or what elists in a nan, provided that it does not nean a rot-soldier. The word salva which ocurs in the kacCadi clas, would have taken vun by the last sutra, when the sense was that or a nan or sone hunan atribute. The present sutra nakes a restriction. Thus salvako nanusya, salvakanasya hasitan jalpitan &c. But salva padati rvrajati the salva rot soldier goes.
ck: the aril vun cones arter the tort salva in the senses or peink porn etc. then tenotink a nan or that elists in a nan, provitet that it toes not nean a rot-soltier. the tort salva thich ocurs in the kacati clas, toult have taken vun py the last sutra, then the sense tas that or a nan or sone hunan atripute. the present sutra nakes a restriction. thus salvako nanusya, salvakanasya hasitan calpitan &c. put salva patati rvracati the salva rot soltier koes.
s: The affix वुञ् comes after the word साल्व in the senses of being born etc. when denoting 'a man 'or 'what exists in a man', provided that it does not mean a foot-soldier. The word साल्व which occurs in the कच्छादि class, would have taken वुञ् by the last sutra, when the sense was that of a man or some human attribute. The present sutra makes a restriction. Thus साल्वको मनुष्यः, साल्वकमस्य हसितं जल्पितं &c. But साल्वः पदाति र्व्रजति 'the Salva foot soldier goes.'

pk: The aril vun cones in the renaining senses or being born etc. arter the words salva etc. when the word signiries a cow or a barley gruel. This debars an or [4.2.13]. Thus salvako gO "the cows born in salva". salvika yavagu the barley gruel or salva. in other cases we have salvan

s: The affix वुञ् comes in the remaining senses of being born etc. after the words साल्व etc. when the word signifies 'a cow' or 'a barley gruel'. This debars अण् of [[4.2.133]]. Thus साल्वको गौः "the cows born in Salva". साल्विका यवागूः 'the barley gruel of Salva'. In other cases we have साल्वम्

pk: The aril Ca cones in the renaining senses arter a pratipadika (noninal sten) denoting a place and having the word garta as its second tern. This debars an The word dese is to be read into the sutra. This rule being a subsequent one debars the ariles Wan and niW or sutra 17 ante. Thus vrkagartiyan, srgalagartiyan, svavidgartiyan born in porcupines hole &c. The word utarapada is used in the sutra, so as to prevent the aplication or the rule to a word which ends in garta, but is preceded by the aril bahu, as bahugartan ere bahu is an aril [5.3.68] and not a pada.
ck: the aril ca cones in the renainink senses arter a pratipatika (noninal sten) tenotink a place ant havink the tort karta as its secont tern. this tepars an the tort tese is to pe reat into the sutra. this rule peink a supsetuent one tepars the ariles tan ant nit or sutra 17 ante. thus vrkakartiyan, srkalakartiyan, svavitkartiyan porn in porcupines hole &c. the tort utarapata is uset in the sutra, so as to prevent the aplication or the rule to a tort thich ents in karta, put is precetet py the aril pahu, as pahukartan ere pahu is an aril [5.3.68] ant not a pata.
s: The affix छ comes in the remaining senses after a प्रातिपदिक (Nominal Stem) denoting a place and having the word गर्त as its second term. This debars अण् The word देशे is to be read into the sutra. This rule being a subsequent one debars the affixes ठञ् and ञिठ् of sutra 117 ante. Thus वृकगर्तीयं, शृगालगर्तीयम्, श्वाविद्गर्तीयम् 'born in porcupine's hole &c'. The word उत्तरपद is used in the sutra, so as to prevent the application of the rule to a word which ends in गर्त, but is preceded by the affix बहु, as बाहुगर्तम् Here बहु is an affix [[5.3.68]] and not a pada.

pk: The aril Ca cones in the renaining senses arter the words gaha etc. This debars an &c. Thus gahiya, belonging to a cave. antasTiya &c. in the list or gahadi ocurs the rolowing "naDyanaDyanan can carane". it neans "The word naDya becones changed into naDyana when the aril Ca is to be aded. Thus naDyaniya But when the sense is that or a Veda-schol or Charana, the aril an is aded instead or Ca as naDyana" The word naDyana here has the restricted sense or the nidle or the earth, and not any nidle generaly. Thus naDyaniya neans prTivinaDye Bavo so also when the aril an is aplied in the case or carana, it has the sense or nivasa or sutra [4.3.89] and not al the other senses. Thus traya pracya, traya Odcya, trayo naDyana "thre Charanas dwel in the East, thre in the West, and thre in the nidle". The words nuKatas and parsvata ocur in the list. They have the aril tas, but berore the aril Ca the s or tas is elided. Thus nuKatiyan and parsvatiyan The augnent kuk is aded to jana and para berore the aril Ca as janakiyan, parakiyan The sane augnent is aded to the word deva also as, devakiyan The aril Can cones arter the words venu &c. no list or such words is given. it is an akrtigana Thus vEnakiyan, vEtrakiyan, atarapadakiyan, prasTakiyan, naDyanakiyan &c. 1 gaha, 2 antasTa, 3 sana, 4 visana, 5 naDyanaDyanan can carane, 6 utana, 7 anga, 8 vanga, 9 nagaDa, 10 purvapaksa, 1 aparapaksa, 12 aDanasaKa 13 utanasaKa,14 ekasaKa, 15 sananasaKa, 16 sananagrana, 17 ekagrana, 18 ekavrksa, 19 ekapalasa, 20 isvagra, 21 isvanika (isvani) 2 avasyandana (avasyandi and avaskanda) 23 kanaprasTa, 24 Kaqayana (saqikaqayani; Kaqayani and Kanqayani) 25 kaWerani (kaverani and kanaverani) 26 laverani, 27 sOnitri, 28 sEsiri, 29 asut, 30 dEvasarni (devasarnan ) 31 Oti, 32 arhisi, 3 anitri, 34 vyaqi, 35 bEji (vEdaji), 36 aDyasvi, 37 anrsansi, 38 sOngi, 39 agnisarni, (agnisarnan) 40 BOji, 41 varawaki (arawaki), 42 valniki, 43 ksEnavrdDi (ksenavrdDin) 4 asvatTi, 45 Odgrahanani, 46 Eka, 47 bindavi, 48 dantagra, 49 hansa, 50 tantvagra, 51 utara, 52 anantara (antara) 53 nuKaparsvatasorlopa (also nuKatiya and parsvatiya), 54 janaparayo kuk ca (also janakiya and parakiya), 5 devasya ca, 56 venukadiByasCan, 57 asuri, 58 sOvi, 59 paraki. it is an akrtigana
ck: the aril ca cones in the renainink senses arter the torts kaha etc. this tepars an &c. thus kahiya, pelonkink to a cave. antastiya &c. in the list or kahati ocurs the rolotink "natyanatyanan can carane". it neans "the tort natya pecones chanket into natyana then the aril ca is to pe atet. thus natyaniya put then the sense is that or a Veta-schol or charana, the aril an is atet insteat or ca as natyana" the tort natyana here has the restrictet sense or the nitle or the earth, ant not any nitle keneraly. thus natyaniya neans prtivinatye pavo so also then the aril an is apliet in the case or carana, it has the sense or nivasa or sutra [4.3.89] ant not al the other senses. thus traya pracya, traya Otcya, trayo natyana "thre charanas tel in the East, thre in the test, ant thre in the nitle". the torts nukatas ant parsvata ocur in the list. they have the aril tas, put perore the aril ca the s or tas is elitet. thus nukatiyan ant parsvatiyan the auknent kuk is atet to cana ant para perore the aril ca as canakiyan, parakiyan the sane auknent is atet to the tort teva also as, tevakiyan the aril can cones arter the torts venu &c. no list or such torts is kiven. it is an akrtikana thus vEnakiyan, vEtrakiyan, atarapatakiyan, prastakiyan, natyanakiyan &c. 1 kaha, 2 antasta, 3 sana, 4 visana, 5 natyanatyanan can carane, 6 utana, 7 anka, 8 vanka, 9 nakata, 10 purvapaksa, 1 aparapaksa, 12 atanasaka 13 utanasaka,14 ekasaka, 15 sananasaka, 16 sananakrana, 17 ekakrana, 18 ekavrksa, 19 ekapalasa, 20 isvakra, 21 isvanika (isvani) 2 avasyantana (avasyanti ant avaskanta) 23 kanaprasta, 24 katayana (satikatayani; katayani ant kantayani) 25 katerani (kaverani ant kanaverani) 26 laverani, 27 sOnitri, 28 sEsiri, 29 asut, 30 tEvasarni (tevasarnan ) 31 Oti, 32 arhisi, 3 anitri, 34 vyati, 35 pEci (vEtaci), 36 atyasvi, 37 anrsansi, 38 sOnki, 39 aknisarni, (aknisarnan) 40 pOci, 41 varataki (arataki), 42 valniki, 43 ksEnavrti (ksenavrtin) 4 asvati, 45 Otkrahanani, 46 Eka, 47 pintavi, 48 tantakra, 49 hansa, 50 tantvakra, 51 utara, 52 anantara (antara) 53 nukaparsvatasorlopa (also nukatiya ant parsvatiya), 54 canaparayo kuk ca (also canakiya ant parakiya), 5 tevasya ca, 56 venukatipyascan, 57 asuri, 58 sOvi, 59 paraki. it is an akrtikana
s: The affix छ comes in the remaining senses after the words गह etc. This debars अण् &c. Thus गहीयः, 'belonging to a cave'. अन्तःस्थीयः &c. In the list of गहादि occurs the following "मध्यमध्यमं चाण् चरणे". It means "The word मध्य becomes changed into मध्यम when the affix छ is to be added. Thus मध्यमीयाः But when the sense is that of a Veda-school or Charana, the affix अण् is added instead of छ as माध्यमाः" The word मध्यम here has the restricted sense of 'the middle of the earth', and not any middle generally. Thus मध्यमीयः means पृथिवीमध्ये भवो So also when the affix अण् is applied in the case of चरण, it has the sense of निवास of sutra [[4.3.89]] and not all the other senses. Thus त्रयः प्राच्याः, त्रय औद्च्याः, त्रयो माध्यमाः "three Charanas dwell in the East, three in the West, and three in the Middle". The words मुखतस् and पार्श्वतः occur in the list. They have the affix तस्, but before the affix छ the स् of तस् is elided. Thus मुखतीयम् and पार्श्वतीयम् The augment कुक् is added to जन and पर before the affix छ As जनकीयम्, परकीयम् The same augment is added to the word देव also as, देवकीयम् The affix छण् comes after the words वेणु &c. No list of such words is given. It is an आकृतिगणः Thus वैणकीयम्, वैत्रकीयम्, अत्तरपदकीयम्, प्रास्थकीयम्, माध्यमकीयम् &c. 1 गह, 2 अन्तःस्थ, 3 सम, 4 विषम, 5 मध्यमध्यमं चाण् चरणे, 6 उत्तम, 7 अङ्ग, 8 वङ्ग, 9 मगध, 10 पूर्वपक्ष, 11 अपरपक्ष, 12 अधमशाख 13 उत्तमशाख,14 एकशाख, 15 समानशाख, 16 समानग्राम, 17 एकग्राम, 18 एकवृक्ष, 19 एकपलाश, 20 इष्वग्र, 21 इष्वनीक (इष्वनी) 22 अवस्यन्दन (अवस्यन्दी and अवस्कन्द) 23 कामप्रस्थ, 24 खाडायन (शाडिकाडायनि; खाडायनि and खाण्डायनी) 25 काठेरणि (कावेरणि and कामवेरणि) 26 लावेरणि, 27 सौमित्रि, 28 शैशिरि, 29 आसुत्, 30 दैवशर्मि (देवशर्मन् ) 31 औति, 32 आर्हिसि, 33 आमित्रि, 34 व्याडि, 35 बैजि (वैदजि), 36 आध्यश्वि, 37 आनृशंशि, 38 शौङ्गि, 39 आग्निशर्मि, (अग्निशर्मन्) 40 भौजि, 41 वाराटकि (आराटकि), 42 वाल्मीकि, 43 क्षैमवृद्धि (क्षेमवृद्धिन्) 44 आश्वत्थि, 45 औद्ग्राहमानि, 46 ऐक, 47 बिन्दवि, 48 दन्ताग्र, 49 हंस, 50 तन्त्वग्र, 51 उत्तर, 52 अनन्तर (अन्तर) 53 मुखपार्श्वतसोर्लोपः (also मुखतीय and पार्श्वतीय), 54 जनपरयोः कुक् च (also जनकीय and परकीय), 55 देवस्य च, 56 वेणुकादिभ्यश्छण्, 57 आसुरि, 58 सौवि, 59 पारकि. It is an आकृतिगण

pk: The aril Ca cones in the renaining senses arter the words begining with kada denoting the places or the East-rolk. The word dese is understod here also. The word prak or the sutra qualiries dese This debars an Thus kawanagariyan, kawaGosiyan, kawapalvaliyan
ck: the aril ca cones in the renainink senses arter the torts pekinink tith kata tenotink the places or the East-rolk. the tort tese is unterstot here also. the tort prak or the sutra tualiries tese this tepars an thus katanakariyan, katakosiyan, katapalvaliyan

pk: The leter ka is the substitute or the rinal or the word rajan , when Ca is aded. This sutra only teaches substitution: ror rajan would have taken Ca by [4.2.14]. Thus rajakiyan The word dese does not govern this sutra, not being apropriate.

s: The letter क is the substitute of the final of the word राजन् , when छ is added. This sutra only teaches substitution: for राजन् would have taken छ by [[4.2.114]]. Thus राजकीयम् The word देशे does not govern this sutra, not being appropriate.

pk: The aril Ca cones in the renaining senses arter a vrdDa word denoting a place and ending with ak or ik or having Ka as its penultinate. The word dese nust be read into the sutra. This debars the an or sutra 132 ante: as wel as the ariles ordained by sutras 17 and 123. Thus aka — arohanakiyan, drOGanakiyan ika —asvapaTikiyan, salnalikiyan KopaDat :- kOwisiKiyan, ayonuKiyan Vart:- The words sOsuka &c. are also governed by this rule though they end in uka Thus sOsukiyan, nOsukiyan, Endravenukiyan
ck: the aril ca cones in the renainink senses arter a vrta tort tenotink a place ant entink tith ak or ik or havink ka as its penultinate. the tort tese nust pe reat into the sutra. this tepars the an or sutra 132 ante: as tel as the ariles ortainet py sutras 17 ant 123. thus aka — arohanakiyan, trOkanakiyan ika —asvapatikiyan, salnalikiyan kopatat :- kOtisikiyan, ayonukiyan Vart:- the torts sOsuka &c. are also kovernet py this rule thoukh they ent in uka thus sOsukiyan, nOsukiyan, Entravenukiyan
s: The affix छ comes in the remaining senses after a वृद्ध word denoting a place and ending with अक् or इक् or having ख as its penultimate. The word देशे must be read into the sutra. This debars the अण् of Sutra 132 ante: as well as the affixes ordained by Sutras 117 and 123. Thus अकः — आरोहणकीयम्, द्रौघणकीयम् इकः —आश्वपथिकीयम्, शाल्मलिकीयम् खोपधात् :-- कौटिशिखीयम्, आयोमुखीयम् Vart:- The words सौसुक &c. are also governed by this rule though they end in उक Thus सौसुकीयम्, मौसुकीयम्, ऐन्द्रवेणुकीयम्

s: The affix छ comes in the remaining senses after a वृद्ध words, having the words 1. कन्था 2. पलद 3. नगर 4. ग्राम and 5. हृद , as second terms. This debars the other affixes such as ठञ् and ञिठ् of 117 ante Thus दाक्षिकन्थीयम्, माहिकिकन्थीयम्, दाक्षिपलदीयम्, माहिकिपलदीयम्, दाक्षिनगरीयं, माहिकिनगरीयम्, दाक्षिग्रामीयम्, माहिकिग्रामीयम्, दाक्षिह्रदीयम्, माहिकिह्रदीयम्

pk: The aril Ca cones arter the word parvata in the renaining senses. This debars an Thus parvatiyo raja "the hil-king". parvatiya purusa the hil nan.
ck: the aril ca cones arter the tort parvata in the renainink senses. this tepars an thus parvatiyo raca "the hil-kink". parvatiya purusa the hil nan.
s: The affix छ comes after the word पर्वत in the remaining senses. This debars अण् Thus पर्वतीयो राजा "the hill-king". पर्वतीयः पुरुषः 'the hill man'.

pk: The aril Ca optionaly cones in the renaining senses arter the word parvata when it does not denote a nan. Thus parvatiyani or parvatani Palani hil ruits, parvatiyanudakan or parvatanudakan hil water. Why do we say ananusye not-hunan? Observe parvatiyo nanusya where there is no option alowed.
ck: the aril ca optionaly cones in the renainink senses arter the tort parvata then it toes not tenote a nan. thus parvatiyani or parvatani palani hil ruits, parvatiyanutakan or parvatanutakan hil tater. thy to te say ananusye not-hunan? Opserve parvatiyo nanusya there there is no option alotet.
s: The affix छ optionally comes in the remaining senses after the word पर्वत when it does not denote 'a man'. Thus पर्वतीयानि or पार्वतानि फलानि 'hill fruits', पर्वतीयमुदकम् or पार्वतमुदकम् 'hill water'. Why do we say अमनुष्ये 'not-human'? Observe पर्वतीयो मनुष्यः where there is no option allowed.

pk: The aril Kan also cones optionaly in the renaining senses arter the words 1. yusnad and 2. asnad The regulating power or the word dese ceases. The word ca indicates that the aril nay be Ca as wel. The word "optionaly" shows that the general aril an nay also be enployed. Thus there are thre ariles, Kan, ca and an, and hence there being no equal enuneration, the rule or nutual corespondence [1.3.10] does not aply. The words yusnad and asnad are Vridha, as they belong to Tyadadi clas [1.1.74], and would have taken Ca by [4.2.1]; the present sutra enjoins thre ariles ror each. Thus yusnad + an = yusnaka + an [4.3.2] = yOsnaka yusnad + Ca = yusnad + iya = yusnadiya [7.1.2]. yusnad + Kan = yusnaka + ina [4.3.2] = yOsnakina [7.1.2]; and [8.4.2]. so also asnaka, asnadiya; and asnakina
ck: the aril kan also cones optionaly in the renainink senses arter the torts 1. yusnat ant 2. asnat the rekulatink poter or the tort tese ceases. the tort ca inticates that the aril nay pe ca as tel. the tort "optionaly" shots that the keneral aril an nay also pe enployet. thus there are thre ariles, kan, ca ant an, ant hence there peink no etual enuneration, the rule or nutual corespontence [1.3.10] toes not aply. the torts yusnat ant asnat are Vritha, as they pelonk to tyatati clas [1.1.74], ant toult have taken ca py [4.2.1]; the present sutra encoins thre ariles ror each. thus yusnat + an = yusnaka + an [4.3.2] = yOsnaka yusnat + ca = yusnat + iya = yusnatiya [7.1.2]. yusnat + kan = yusnaka + ina [4.3.2] = yOsnakina [7.1.2]; ant [8.4.2]. so also asnaka, asnatiya; ant asnakina
s: The affix खञ् also comes optionally in the remaining senses after the words 1. युष्मद् and 2. अस्मद् The regulating power of the word देशे ceases. The word च indicates that the affix may be छ as well. The word "optionally" shows that the general affix अण् may also be employed. Thus there are three affixes, खञ्, च and अण्, and hence there being no equal enumeration, the rule of mutual correspondence [[1.3.10]] does not apply. The words युष्मद् and अस्मद् are Vriddha, as they belong to Tyadadi class [[1.1.74]], and would have taken छ by [[4.2.11]]; the present sutra enjoins three affixes for each. Thus युष्मद् + अण् = युष्माक + अण् [[4.3.2]] = यौष्माकः युष्मद् + छ = युष्मद् + ईय = युष्मदीयः [[7.1.2]]. युष्मद् + खञ् = युष्माक + ईन [[4.3.2]] = यौष्माकीणः [[7.1.2]]; and [[8.4.2]]. So also आस्माकः, अस्मदीय; and आस्माकीनः

pk: When the aril Kan is aded and when an is aded then 1. yusnaka and 2. asnaka are the substitutes or yusnad and asnad The pronoun tasnin rerers to the visible aril Kan, and not to the understod aril Ca which was drawn into the last sutra by the word ca Why does the rule or nutual corespondence [1.3.10] not aply here, there being two ariles, two words, and two substitutes? This, however, is not done, because the sutra can be divided into two separate aphorisns : as (1) tasnin Kani yusnadasnadoryusnakasnakO Bavata () tatoni ca i.e. (1). when Kan is aded, yusnaka and asnaka are the substitutes or yusnad and asnad respectively (2). so also when an rolows. as ror ilustrations, se the preceding sutra, e.g. yOsnakina, asnakina with Kan, and yOsnaka and asnaka with an This substitution does not take place when Ca is aded, as yusnadiya and asnadiya
ck: then the aril kan is atet ant then an is atet then 1. yusnaka ant 2. asnaka are the supstitutes or yusnat ant asnat the pronoun tasnin rerers to the visiple aril kan, ant not to the unterstot aril ca thich tas tratn into the last sutra py the tort ca thy toes the rule or nutual corespontence [1.3.10] not aply here, there peink to ariles, to torts, ant to supstitutes? this, hotever, is not tone, pecause the sutra can pe tivitet into to separate aphorisns : as (1) tasnin kani yusnatasnatoryusnakasnakO pavata () tatoni ca i.e. (1). then kan is atet, yusnaka ant asnaka are the supstitutes or yusnat ant asnat respectively (2). so also then an rolots. as ror ilustrations, se the precetink sutra, e.k. yOsnakina, asnakina tith kan, ant yOsnaka ant asnaka tith an this supstitution toes not take place then ca is atet, as yusnatiya ant asnatiya
s: When the affix खञ् is added and when अण् is added then 1. युष्माक and 2. अस्माक are the substitutes of युष्मद् and अस्मद् The pronoun तस्मिन् refers to the visible affix खञ्, and not to the understood affix छ which was drawn into the last sutra by the word च Why does the rule of mutual correspondence [[1.3.10]] not apply here, there being two affixes, two words, and two substitutes? This, however, is not done, because the sutra can be divided into two separate aphorisms : as (1) तस्मिन् खञि युष्मदस्मदोर्युष्माकास्माकौ भवतः (ऽ) ततोऽणि च i.e. (1). when खञ् is added, युष्माक and अस्माक are the substitutes of युष्मद् and अस्मद् respectively (2). So also when अण् follows. As for illustrations, see the preceding Sutra, e.g. यौष्माकीणः, आस्माकीनः with खञ्, and यौष्माकः and आस्माकः with अण् This substitution does not take place when छ is added, as युष्मदीयः and अस्मदीयः

pk: in elpresing one individual, tabaka and nanaka are the substitutes or yusnad and asnad respectively when Kan and an rolow. as tavakina belonging to the, nanakina "belonging to ne." tavaka and nanaka But when the aril is Ca, the rorn wil tvadiya, nadiya. The word ekavacane should not be construed as neaning the aril or the singular nunber, as the aril su Because the aril or the singular is always elided (luk) arter these words, and by rule [1.1.63], there wil not be the aplication or this rule. This diriculty is, however, got over by elplaining the word ekavacane as equal to ekarTe
ck: in elpresink one intivitual, tapaka ant nanaka are the supstitutes or yusnat ant asnat respectively then kan ant an rolot. as tavakina pelonkink to the, nanakina "pelonkink to ne." tavaka ant nanaka put then the aril is ca, the rorn til tvatiya, natiya. the tort ekavacane shoult not pe construet as neanink the aril or the sinkular nunper, as the aril su pecause the aril or the sinkular is altays elitet (luk) arter these torts, ant py rule [1.1.63], there til not pe the aplication or this rule. this tiriculty is, hotever, kot over py elplainink the tort ekavacane as etual to ekarte
s: In expressing one individual, तबक and ममक are the substitutes of युष्मद् and अस्मद् respectively when खञ् and अण् follow. As तावकीनः 'belonging to thee', मामकीनः "belonging to me." तावकः and मामकः But when the affix is छ, the form wil त्वदीयः, मदीयः. The word एकवचने should not be construed as meaning the affix of the singular number, as the affix सु Because the affix of the singular is always elided (लुक्) after these words, and by rule [[1.1.63]], there will not be the application of this rule. This difficulty is, however, got over by explaining the word एकवचने as equal to एकार्थे

pk: The aril yat cones arter the word ardDa in the renaining senses. This debars an Thus ardDyan belonging to halr. Vart:- When it has a prior tern the aril Wan is used. as baleyardDikan, (balyarTanvastu = baleyan) gOtanardDikan
ck: the aril yat cones arter the tort arta in the renainink senses. this tepars an thus artyan pelonkink to halr. Vart:- then it has a prior tern the aril tan is uset. as paleyartikan, (palyartanvastu = paleyan) kOtanartikan
s: The affix यत् comes after the word अर्द्ध in the remaining senses. This debars अण् Thus अर्द्ध्यम् 'belonging to half.' Vart:- When it has a prior term the affix ठञ् is used. As बालेयार्द्धिकम्, (बल्यर्थंवस्तु = बालेयं) गौतमार्द्धिकम्

pk: The aril yat cones in the renaining senses arter the word ardDa when preceded by 1. para 2. avara 3. aDana and 4. utana Thus parardDyan, avarardDyan, aDanardDyan, utanardDyan Q. Why do we say purvat preceded by ? its use sens to be superluous. ir the sutra stod as paravaraDanotaneBya, it would have given the sane sense. ror the arDat being suplied ron the last sutra, the whole sutra would have ben paravaraDanotaneByorDad yat which nust nean preceded by para &c. a. The words para and avara have neanings other than that or dik or direction. as paran suKan highest pleasure. avaran suKan lowest pleasure. Thererore, when these words para and avara denote direction, then by the subsequent rule, the aril would have ben always Wan and yat The enploynent or the tern purva in the sutra, prevents the aplication or the aril Wan even when the words denote direction. acording to the Vartika sapurvapadaw Wan given under the last sutra, the word arDa preceded by any word would have taken Wan, hence the necesity or this sutra ordaining yat, when the rirst terns are para &c.
ck: the aril yat cones in the renainink senses arter the tort arta then precetet py 1. para 2. avara 3. atana ant 4. utana thus parartyan, avarartyan, atanartyan, utanartyan t. thy to te say purvat precetet py ? its use sens to pe superluous. ir the sutra stot as paravaratanotanepya, it toult have kiven the sane sense. ror the artat peink supliet ron the last sutra, the thole sutra toult have pen paravaratanotanepyortat yat thich nust nean precetet py para &c. a. the torts para ant avara have neaninks other than that or tik or tirection. as paran sukan hikhest pleasure. avaran sukan lotest pleasure. thererore, then these torts para ant avara tenote tirection, then py the supsetuent rule, the aril toult have pen altays tan ant yat the enploynent or the tern purva in the sutra, prevents the aplication or the aril tan even then the torts tenote tirection. acortink to the Vartika sapurvapatat tan kiven unter the last sutra, the tort arta precetet py any tort toult have taken tan, hence the necesity or this sutra ortainink yat, then the rirst terns are para &c.
s: The affix यत् comes in the remaining senses after the word अर्द्ध when preceded by 1. पर 2. अवर 3. अधम and 4. उत्तम Thus परार्द्ध्यम्, अवरार्द्ध्यम्, अधमार्द्ध्यम्, उत्तमार्द्ध्यम् Q. Why do we say पूर्वात् 'preceded by' ? Its use seems to be superfluous. If the sutra stood as परावराधमोत्तमेभ्यः, it would have given the same sense. For the अर्धात् being supplied from the last sutra, the whole sutra would have been परावराधमोत्तमेभ्योऽर्धाद् यत् which must mean 'preceded by para &c.' A. The words पर and अवर have meanings other than that of दिक् or direction. As परं सुखं 'highest pleasure.' अवरं सुखं 'lowest pleasure.' Therefore, when these words पर and अवर denote direction, then by the subsequent rule, the affix would have been always ठञ् and यत् The employment of the term पूर्व in the sutra, prevents the application of the affix ठञ् even when the words denote direction. According to the Vartika सपूर्वपदाट् ठञ् given under the last sutra, the word अर्ध preceded by any word would have taken ठञ्, hence the necessity of this sutra ordaining यत्, when the first terms are पर &c.

pk: and the aril Wan also (as wel as yat) cones in the renaining senses arter the word ardDa when the prior tern denotes a direction. By ca, the aril yat is also used. This debars an Thus purvarDyan, pOrvarDikan, daksinarDyan or daksinardDikan The word pada is used in the sutra in order to prevent anbiguity. ad the sutra stod nerely as dikpurvaw Wanca, it night have neant [1.1.68], ardha preceded by the word dik takes Wan also, ror then svarupaviDi would have aplied, and digarDe jata would have taken the aril.
ck: ant the aril tan also (as tel as yat) cones in the renainink senses arter the tort arta then the prior tern tenotes a tirection. py ca, the aril yat is also uset. this tepars an thus purvartyan, pOrvartikan, taksinartyan or taksinartikan the tort pata is uset in the sutra in orter to prevent anpikuity. at the sutra stot nerely as tikpurvat tanca, it nikht have neant [1.1.68], artha precetet py the tort tik takes tan also, ror then svarupaviti toult have apliet, ant tikarte cata toult have taken the aril.
s: And the affix ठञ् also (as well as यत्) comes in the remaining senses after the word अर्द्ध when the prior term denotes a direction. By च, the affix यत् is also used. This debars अण् Thus पूर्वार्ध्यम्, पौर्वार्धिकम्, दक्षिणार्ध्यम् or दाक्षिणार्द्धिकम् The word पद is used in the sutra in order to prevent ambiguity. Had the sutra stood merely as दिक्पूर्वाट् ठञ्च, it might have meant [[1.1.68]], 'Ardha preceded by the word दिक् takes ठञ् also', for then स्वरूपविधि would have applied, and दिगर्धे जातः would have taken the affix.

pk: The ariles an and Wan cone in the renaining senses arter the word ardDa preceded by a word denoting direction when a particular portion or a vilage or an inhabited country. The phrase dikapurvapadat is to be read into the sutra. This debars yat Thus ine Kalvasnakan granasya janapadasya va pOrvarDa or pOrvarDika "Those verily belong to the eastern halr or our vilage or country". so also daksinarDa or daksinarDika The word pOrvardDa = granasya purvasninardDe Bava and is a Tadhitartha conpound.
ck: the ariles an ant tan cone in the renainink senses arter the tort arta precetet py a tort tenotink tirection then a particular portion or a vilake or an inhapitet country. the phrase tikapurvapatat is to pe reat into the sutra. this tepars yat thus ine kalvasnakan kranasya canapatasya va pOrvarta or pOrvartika "those verily pelonk to the eastern halr or our vilake or country". so also taksinarta or taksinartika the tort pOrvarta = kranasya purvasninarte pava ant is a tathitartha conpount.
s: The affixes अञ् and ठञ् come in the remaining senses after the word अर्द्ध preceded by a word denoting direction when a particular portion of a village or an inhabited country. The phrase दिकपूर्वपदात् is to be read into the sutra. This debars यत् Thus इमे खल्वस्माकं ग्रामस्य जनपदस्य वा पौर्वार्धाः or पौर्वार्धिकाः "Those verily belong to the eastern half of our village or country". So also दाक्षिणार्धाः or दाक्षिणार्धिकाः The word पौर्वार्द्धाः = ग्रामस्य पूर्वस्मिन्नर्द्धे भवाः and is a Taddhitartha compound.

pk: arter the word naDya there is the aril na in the renaining senses. This debars an as naDyana "nidlenost". Vart:- so also arter the word adi as adina "adan, or born in the begining". Vart:- so also arter the words avas and aDas, the rinal s being elided. as avanan, aDanan
ck: arter the tort natya there is the aril na in the renainink senses. this tepars an as natyana "nitlenost". Vart:- so also arter the tort ati as atina "atan, or porn in the pekinink". Vart:- so also arter the torts avas ant atas, the rinal s peink elitet. as avanan, atanan
s: After the word मध्य there is the affix म in the remaining senses. This debars अण् As मध्यमः "middlemost". Vart:- So also after the word आदि As आदिमः "Adam, or born in the beginning". Vart:- So also after the words अवस् and अधस्, the final स् being elided. As अवमम्, अधमम्

pk: The aril a cones in the renaining senses arter the word naDya , the neaning being rit or proper. The word sanpratika neans equity, propriety, right, rit. as natidirGan nati hrsvan naDyan kasWan "the proper piece or wod-neither to long nor to short". naDye vEyakarana "the rit Granarian, neither to rerined nor to dul". naDyastri "a proper wire".
ck: the aril a cones in the renainink senses arter the tort natya , the neanink peink rit or proper. the tort sanpratika neans etuity, propriety, rikht, rit. as natitirkan nati hrsvan natyan kastan "the proper piece or tot-neither to lonk nor to short". natye vEyakarana "the rit kranarian, neither to rerinet nor to tul". natyastri "a proper tire".
s: The affix अ comes in the remaining senses after the word मध्य , the meaning being 'fit' or 'proper'. The word सांप्रतिक means 'equity, propriety, right, fit'. As नातिदीर्घं नाति हृस्वं मध्यं काष्ठम् "the proper piece of wood--neither too long nor too short". मध्ये वैयाकरणः "the fit Grammarian, neither too refined nor too dull". मध्यास्त्री "a proper wife".

pk: The aril yan cones in the renaining senses arter the word dvipa , which is near the sea. The word dvipa ocurs in the list or Kachchadi [4.2.13], and would have taken an; and by sutra [4.2.134], it would have taken vun also. The present sutra debars both those ariles, when the word dvipa neans anusanudra or near the sea. Thus dvEpyan living on or relating to an island. as dvEpyan Bavantonucaranti cakran Why do we say anusanudran ? Observe dvEpakan or dvEpan [4.2.13] and [4.2.134]. The word anu-sanudra is an avyayibhava conpound [2.1.15].
ck: the aril yan cones in the renainink senses arter the tort tvipa , thich is near the sea. the tort tvipa ocurs in the list or kachchati [4.2.13], ant toult have taken an; ant py sutra [4.2.134], it toult have taken vun also. the present sutra tepars poth those ariles, then the tort tvipa neans anusanutra or near the sea. thus tvEpyan livink on or relatink to an islant. as tvEpyan pavantonucaranti cakran thy to te say anusanutran ? Opserve tvEpakan or tvEpan [4.2.13] ant [4.2.134]. the tort anu-sanutra is an avyayiphava conpount [2.1.15].
s: The affix यञ् comes in the remaining senses after the word द्वीप , which is near the sea. The word द्वीप occurs in the list of Kachchhadi [[4.2.133]], and would have taken अण्; and by sutra [[4.2.134]], it would have taken वुञ् also. The present sutra debars both those affixes, when the word द्वीप means अनुसमुद्र or 'near the sea'. Thus द्वैप्यम् 'living on or relating to an island'. As द्वैप्यं भवन्तोऽनुचरन्ति चक्रम् Why do we say अनुसमुद्रं ? Observe द्वैपकम् or द्वैपम् [[4.2.133]] and [[4.2.134]]. The word 'anu-samudra' is an Avyayibhava compound [[2.1.15]].

pk: The aril Wan cones in the renaining senses arter the words denoting tine. This debars an The aril Ca which cones arter Vridha words is prohibited by this sutra. Thus nasika nonthly ardDanasika bi-nonthly, sanvatsarika anual. The words which denote tine even indirectly, also take this aril. as kadanbapuspikan, vrEhipalalikan The word kala governs al the subsequent sutras upto 25. (tatra jata).
ck: the aril tan cones in the renainink senses arter the torts tenotink tine. this tepars an the aril ca thich cones arter Vritha torts is prohipitet py this sutra. thus nasika nonthly artanasika pi-nonthly, sanvatsarika anual. the torts thich tenote tine even intirectly, also take this aril. as katanpapuspikan, vrEhipalalikan the tort kala koverns al the supsetuent sutras upto 25. (tatra cata).
s: The affix ठञ् comes in the remaining senses after the words denoting time. This debars अण् The affix छ which comes after Vriddha words is prohibited by this sutra. Thus मासिकः 'monthly' आर्द्धमासिकः 'bi-monthly', सांवत्सरिकः 'annual'. The words which denote time even indirectly, also take this affix. As कादम्बपुष्पिकं, व्रैहिपलालिकम् The word काल governs all the subsequent sutras upto 25. (तत्र जातः).

pk: The aril Wan cones in the renaining senses arter the word sarad when elpresing sradDa This debars an [4.3.16]. The word sradDe neans the runeral oblation; and not sradDavan purusa a raithrul or believing person. Thus saradikan sradDan the autunal sradha. When not neaning sradha, it wil be saradan
ck: the aril tan cones in the renainink senses arter the tort sarat then elpresink srata this tepars an [4.3.16]. the tort srate neans the runeral oplation; ant not sratavan purusa a raithrul or pelievink person. thus saratikan sratan the autunal sratha. then not neanink sratha, it til pe saratan
s: The affix ठञ् comes in the remaining senses after the word शरद् when expressing श्राद्ध This debars अण् [[4.3.16]]. The word श्राद्धे means the 'funeral oblation'; and not श्रद्धावान् पुरुषः 'a faithful or believing person'. Thus शारदिकं श्राद्धं 'the autumnal Sraddha'. When not meaning 'Sraddha', it will be शारदम्

pk: The aril Wan cones optionaly cones in the renaining senses arter the word sarad when elpresing ilnes or heat. Thus saradiko roga the autunal disease, saradika atapa the autunal heat or sunshine. Why do we say "when denoting sicknes or heat"? Observe, saradan daDi the autunal curd. This Wan debars the rtu an [4.3.16].
ck: the aril tan cones optionaly cones in the renainink senses arter the tort sarat then elpresink ilnes or heat. thus saratiko roka the autunal tisease, saratika atapa the autunal heat or sunshine. thy to te say "then tenotink sicknes or heat"? Opserve, saratan tati the autunal curt. this tan tepars the rtu an [4.3.16].
s: The affix ठञ् comes optionally comes in the remaining senses after the word शरद् when expressing illness or heat. Thus शारदिको रोगः 'the autumnal disease', शारदिक आतपः 'the autumnal heat or sunshine'. Why do we say "when denoting sickness or heat"? Observe, शारदं दधि 'the autumnal curd'. This ठञ् debars the ऋतु अण् [[4.3.16]].

pk: The aril Wan cones optionaly cones in the renaining senses arter the words 1. nisa and 2. pradosa This nakes optional, where by sutra [4.3.1] ante, the Wan would have ben obligatory. Thus nEsan or nEsikan nocturnal. pradosan or pradosikan
ck: the aril tan cones optionaly cones in the renainink senses arter the torts 1. nisa ant 2. pratosa this nakes optional, there py sutra [4.3.1] ante, the tan toult have pen oplikatory. thus nEsan or nEsikan nocturnal. pratosan or pratosikan
s: The affix ठञ् comes optionally comes in the remaining senses after the words 1. निशा and 2. प्रदोष This makes optional, where by sutra [[4.3.11]] ante, the ठञ् would have been obligatory. Thus नैशम् or नैशिकम् 'nocturnal'. प्रादोषम् or प्रादोषिकम्

pk: The aril Wan cones optionaly cones in the renaining senses arter the word svas and it takes the augnent tuw The word svas takes the aril tyap by sutra [4.2.10]. This sutra ordains Wan When re ron the scope or these rules, it takes tyu and tyul ariles also by [4.3.23]. Thus svas + tuw + Wan = sOvas + t + ika [7.3.3] = sOvastika "belonging to to-norow or epheneral". Otherwise svastya and svastana
ck: the aril tan cones optionaly cones in the renainink senses arter the tort svas ant it takes the auknent tut the tort svas takes the aril tyap py sutra [4.2.10]. this sutra ortains tan then re ron the scope or these rules, it takes tyu ant tyul ariles also py [4.3.23]. thus svas + tut + tan = sOvas + t + ika [7.3.3] = sOvastika "pelonkink to to-norot or epheneral". Othertise svastya ant svastana
s: The affix ठञ् comes optionally comes in the remaining senses after the word श्वस् and it takes the augment तुट् The word श्वस् takes the affix त्यप् by sutra [[4.2.10]]. This sutra ordains ठञ् When free from the scope of these rules, it takes tyu and tyul affixes also by [[4.3.23]]. Thus श्वस् + तुट् + ठञ् = शौवस् + त् + इक [[7.3.3]] = शौवस्तिकः "belonging to to-morrow or ephemeral". Otherwise श्वस्त्यः and श्वस्तनः

pk: The aril an cones in the renaining senses arter the words sanDivela etc. and the words elpresing season and asterisn. The word kalat is to be read into the sutra. al the words nust be elpresive or tine. This debars Wan The repetition or an debars Ca also in the case or those words, which are Vridha in this list [4.2.14]. Thus (1) sanDivelan, sanDyan (2) grEsnan, sEsiran (3) tesan, pOsan are elanples or sandhivela season and asterisns respectively. The aril an is aded to sanvatsara when denoting ruit and restival, as sanvatsaran Palan or parva 1 sanDivela, 2 sanDya, 3 anavasya, 4 trayodasi, 5 caturdasi, 6 pancadasi, 7 pOrnanasi, 8 pratipad, 9 sanvatsaratPalaparvano
ck: the aril an cones in the renainink senses arter the torts santivela etc. ant the torts elpresink season ant asterisn. the tort kalat is to pe reat into the sutra. al the torts nust pe elpresive or tine. this tepars tan the repetition or an tepars ca also in the case or those torts, thich are Vritha in this list [4.2.14]. thus (1) santivelan, santyan (2) krEsnan, sEsiran (3) tesan, pOsan are elanples or santhivela season ant asterisns respectively. the aril an is atet to sanvatsara then tenotink ruit ant restival, as sanvatsaran palan or parva 1 santivela, 2 santya, 3 anavasya, 4 trayotasi, 5 caturtasi, 6 pancatasi, 7 pOrnanasi, 8 pratipat, 9 sanvatsaratpalaparvano
s: The affix अण् comes in the remaining senses after the words संधिवेला etc. and the words expressing 'season' and 'asterism'. The word कालात् is to be read into the sutra. All the words must be expressive of time. This debars ठञ् The repetition of अण् debars छ also in the case of those words, which are Vriddha in this list [[4.2.114]]. Thus (1) सान्धिवेलम्, सान्ध्यम् (2) ग्रैष्मम्, शैशिरम् (3) तेषम्, पौषम् are examples of sandhivela season and asterisms respectively. The affix अण् is added to संवत्सर when denoting 'fruit' and 'festival', as सांवत्सरं फलं or पर्व 1 संधिवेला, 2 संध्या, 3 अमावास्या, 4 त्रयोदशी, 5 चतुर्दशी, 6 पञ्चदशी, 7 पौर्णमासी, 8 प्रतिपद्, 9 संवत्सरात्फलपर्वणोः

pk: The aril enya cones in the renaining senses arter the word pravrsa This debars the an or the last sutra, though pravrish is a season-denoting word. Thus pravrsenyo balahaka "the belonging to the rainy season."
ck: the aril enya cones in the renainink senses arter the tort pravrsa this tepars the an or the last sutra, thoukh pravrish is a season-tenotink tort. thus pravrsenyo palahaka "the pelonkink to the rainy season."
s: The affix एण्य comes in the remaining senses after the word प्रावृष This debars the अण् of the last sutra, though 'pravrish' is a season-denoting word. Thus प्रावृषेण्यो बलाहकः "the belonging to the rainy season."

pk: The aril Wak cones in the renaining senses arter the word varsa This debars an or [4.3.16]. Thus varsikananulepanan The Wak has the rorce or saDu &c or [4.3.43] here.
ck: the aril tak cones in the renainink senses arter the tort varsa this tepars an or [4.3.16]. thus varsikananulepanan the tak has the rorce or satu &c or [4.3.43] here.
s: The affix ठक् comes in the remaining senses after the word वर्षा This debars अण् of [[4.3.16]]. Thus वार्षिकमनुलेपनम् The ठक् has the force of साधु &c of [[4.3.43]] here.

pk: in the Candas (Vedas), the word varsa takes the aril Wan , in the renaining senses. This debars Wak. The rorn wil be the sane, but there wil be direrence in acent. as naBasca naBasyasca varsikavrtu The word rtu here neans "nonth," i. e. nabha and navasya are two rainy nonths.
ck: in the cantas (Vetas), the tort varsa takes the aril tan , in the renainink senses. this tepars tak. the rorn til pe the sane, put there til pe tirerence in acent. as napasca napasyasca varsikavrtu the tort rtu here neans "nonth," i. e. napha ant navasya are to rainy nonths.
s: In the छन्दस् (Vedas), the word वर्षा takes the affix ठञ् , in the remaining senses. This debars ठक्. The form will be the same, but there will be difference in accent. As नभश्च नभस्यश्च वार्षिकावृतू The word ऋतु here means "month," i. e. Nabha and Navasya are two rainy months.

pk: in the Candas (Vedas), the aril Wan cones in the renaining senses arter the word vasanta This debars an [4.3.16]. Thus naDusca naDavasca vasantikavrtu
ck: in the cantas (Vetas), the aril tan cones in the renainink senses arter the tort vasanta this tepars an [4.3.16]. thus natusca natavasca vasantikavrtu
s: In the छन्दस् (Vedas), the affix ठञ् comes in the remaining senses after the word वसन्त This debars अण् [[4.3.16]]. Thus मधुश्च माधवश्च वासन्तिकावृतू

pk: in the Candas (Vedas), the aril Wan cones in the renaining senses arter the word henanta This debars an [4.3.16]. Thus sahasca sahasyasca hEna꣡ntikavrtu The naking or two separate sutras or 20 and 21, is ror the sake or the subsequent sutra, in which the anuvriti or word henanta only is taken.
