ck: in the cantas (Vetas), the aril tan cones in the renainink senses arter the tort henanta this tepars an [4.3.16]. thus sahasca sahasyasca hEna꣡ntikavrtu the nakink or to separate sutras or 20 ant 21, is ror the sake or the supsetuent sutra, in thich the anuvriti or tort henanta only is taken.
s: In the छन्दस् (Vedas), the affix ठञ् comes in the remaining senses after the word हेमन्त This debars अण् [[4.3.16]]. Thus सहश्च सहस्यश्च हैम꣡न्तिकावृतू The making of two separate Sutras of 20 and 21, is for the sake of the subsequent sutra, in which the anuvritti of word हेमन्त only is taken.

pk: The aril an cones always arter the word henanta and (berore this aril) the leter ta or henanta is elided. Thus hEnanan vasa wintery residence. hEnananupalepanan The word sarvatra is used to show that the sutra aplies in the Chandas as wel as in the secular literature. The word henanta wil take an by sutra [4.3.16] as hEnanti pankti but there is no elision or ta there. Thus there are thre rorns hEnanta [4.3.16], hEnantikan [4.3.21] and hEnanan
ck: the aril an cones altays arter the tort henanta ant (perore this aril) the leter ta or henanta is elitet. thus hEnanan vasa tintery resitence. hEnananupalepanan the tort sarvatra is uset to shot that the sutra aplies in the chantas as tel as in the secular literature. the tort henanta til take an py sutra [4.3.16] as hEnanti pankti put there is no elision or ta there. thus there are thre rorns hEnanta [4.3.16], hEnantikan [4.3.21] ant hEnanan
s: The affix अण् comes always after the word हेमन्त and (before this affix) the letter त of हेमन्त is elided. Thus हैमनम् वासः 'wintery residence.' हैमनमुपलेपनम् The word सर्वत्र is used to show that the sutra applies in the Chhandas as well as in the secular literature. The word हेमन्त will take अण् by sutra [[4.3.16]] as हैमन्ती पङ्क्तिः but there is no elision of त there. Thus there are three forms हैमन्तः [[4.3.16]], हैमन्तिकं [[4.3.21]] and हैमनम्

pk: arter the words 1. sayan at eve 2. ciran ror a long tine 3. prahne in the rorenon 4. prage at dawn and arter indeclinables elpresing tine, there are the ariles wyu and wyul and their augnent is tuw The word kalat is understod here also. Thus sayan + wyu = sayan + tuw + wyu = sayantanan [7.1.1] belonging to the evening. cirantanan, lasting, prahnetanan what is or the rorenon, pragetanan "what is or the early norn". The word sayan is a word ending in n and is an indeclinable. These ariles would also cone by virtue or its being an indeclinable, arter that sayan The present sayan is derived ron the rot se by ading the aril Gan it always ends in n when these ariles are aded. The word ciran always ends in n prahne and prage always end in e as regards indeclinables, the elanples are dosatanan belonging to the night. divatanan belonging to the day. Vart:- The aril tna cones arter the words cira, parut and parari as ciratnan, parutnan, and pararitnan Vart:- The ga or praga in elided in the Chandas berore this aril tna. as, pratnan Vart:- The aril qinac cones arter agra, adi and pascad; as, agrinan, adinan and pascinan Vart:- so also arter anta, as, antinan The dererence betwen tyu and tyul is in acent, Thus sayanta꣡na and saya꣡ntana, ciranta꣡na and cira꣡ntana, prahneta꣡na and prahne꣡tana, prageta꣡na, prage꣡tana, divata꣡na and diva꣡tana, dosata꣡na and dosa꣡tana
ck: arter the torts 1. sayan at eve 2. ciran ror a lonk tine 3. prahne in the rorenon 4. prake at tatn ant arter inteclinaples elpresink tine, there are the ariles tyu ant tyul ant their auknent is tut the tort kalat is unterstot here also. thus sayan + tyu = sayan + tut + tyu = sayantanan [7.1.1] pelonkink to the evenink. cirantanan, lastink, prahnetanan that is or the rorenon, praketanan "that is or the early norn". the tort sayan is a tort entink in n ant is an inteclinaple. these ariles toult also cone py virtue or its peink an inteclinaple, arter that sayan the present sayan is terivet ron the rot se py atink the aril kan it altays ents in n then these ariles are atet. the tort ciran altays ents in n prahne ant prake altays ent in e as rekarts inteclinaples, the elanples are tosatanan pelonkink to the nikht. tivatanan pelonkink to the tay. Vart:- the aril tna cones arter the torts cira, parut ant parari as ciratnan, parutnan, ant pararitnan Vart:- the ka or praka in elitet in the chantas perore this aril tna. as, pratnan Vart:- the aril tinac cones arter akra, ati ant pascat; as, akrinan, atinan ant pascinan Vart:- so also arter anta, as, antinan the tererence peten tyu ant tyul is in acent, thus sayanta꣡na ant saya꣡ntana, ciranta꣡na ant cira꣡ntana, prahneta꣡na ant prahne꣡tana, praketa꣡na, prake꣡tana, tivata꣡na ant tiva꣡tana, tosata꣡na ant tosa꣡tana
s: After the words 1. सायं 'at eve' 2. चिरम् 'for a long time' 3. प्राह्णे 'in the forenoon' 4. प्रगे 'at dawn' and after indeclinables expressing time, there are the affixes ट्यु and ट्युल् and their augment is तुट् The word कालात् is understood here also. Thus सायं + ट्यु = सायं + तुट् + ट्यु = सायंतनम् [[7.1.1]] 'belonging to the evening'. चिरंतनम्, 'lasting', प्राह्णेतनम् 'what is of the forenoon', प्रागेतनम् "what is of the early morn". The word सायं is a word ending in म् and is an Indeclinable. These affixes would also come by virtue of its being an indeclinable, after that सायं The present सायं is derived from the root से by adding the affix घञ् It always ends in म् when these affixes are added. The word चिरं always ends in म् प्राह्णे and प्रगे always end in ए As regards Indeclinables, the examples are दोषातनम् 'belonging to the night'. दिवातनम् 'belonging to the day'. Vart:- The affix त्न comes after the words चिर, परुत् and परारि As चिरत्नम्, परुत्नम्, and परारित्नम् Vart:- The ग of प्रग in elided in the Chhandas before this affix त्न. as, प्रत्नम् Vart:- The affix डिमच् comes after अग्र, आदि and पश्चाद्; as, अग्रिमम्, आदिमम् and पश्चिमम् Vart:- So also after अन्त, as, अन्तिमम् The defference between tyu and tyul is in accent, Thus सायन्त꣡न and साय꣡न्तन, चिरन्त꣡न and चिर꣡न्तन, प्राह्णेत꣡न and प्राह्णे꣡तन, प्रगेत꣡न, प्रगे꣡तन, दिवात꣡न and दिवा꣡तन, दोषात꣡न and दोषा꣡तन

pk: Optionaly arter the words 1. purvahna and 2. aparahna there are the ariles wyu and wyul and their augnent is tuw in the alternative Wan or [4.3.1] also ocurs. as purvahneta꣡nan, aparahne꣡tanan with tyu, or pO꣡rvahnikan a꣡parahnikan with than. With tyul, we have purvahneta꣡nan and aparahneta꣡nan The sign or the locative is not elided by rule [6.3.17]. When the word is taken as incapable or having the case-aril, we have, puvahnata꣡nan or purvahna꣡tana
ck: Optionaly arter the torts 1. purvahna ant 2. aparahna there are the ariles tyu ant tyul ant their auknent is tut in the alternative tan or [4.3.1] also ocurs. as purvahneta꣡nan, aparahne꣡tanan tith tyu, or pO꣡rvahnikan a꣡parahnikan tith than. tith tyul, te have purvahneta꣡nan ant aparahneta꣡nan the sikn or the locative is not elitet py rule [6.3.17]. then the tort is taken as incapaple or havink the case-aril, te have, puvahnata꣡nan or purvahna꣡tana
s: Optionally after the words 1. पूर्वाह्ण and 2. अपराह्ण there are the affixes ट्यु and ट्युल् and their augment is तुट् In the alternative ठञ् of [[4.3.11]] also occurs. As पूर्वाह्णेत꣡नम्, अपराह्णे꣡तनम् with tyu, or पौ꣡र्वाह्णिकम् आ꣡पराह्णिकम् with than. With tyul, we have पूर्वाह्णेत꣡नं and अपराह्णेत꣡नं The sign of the locative is not elided by rule [[6.3.17]]. When the word is taken as incapable of having the case-affix, we have, पूवाह्णत꣡नं or पूर्वाह्ण꣡तनः

pk: The ariles ordained above or herearter cone arter a word in the Locative -7th case in construction in the sense or born or grown or originated there or then. The ariles an &c. Ga &c. have ben taught, but no particular sense was asigned to then. se [4.2.92]. This sutra gives one or the senses, and also declares the particular case in which the sten nust be, to which the aril is to be aded. Thus sruGnejata = sruGna + an = srOGna born in srughna. so also naTura born in nathura, Otsa born in utsa, Odapana born in udapana. raswriya [4.2.93], avaraparina [4.2.93] sakalika [4.2.17], granya [4.2.94], granina [4.2.94], katreyaka [4.2.95] OnBeyaka [4.2.95].
ck: the ariles ortainet apove or herearter cone arter a tort in the Locative -7th case in construction in the sense or porn or krotn or orikinatet there or then. the ariles an &c. ka &c. have pen taukht, put no particular sense tas asiknet to then. se [4.2.92]. this sutra kives one or the senses, ant also teclares the particular case in thich the sten nust pe, to thich the aril is to pe atet. thus sruknecata = srukna + an = srOkna porn in srukhna. so also natura porn in nathura, Otsa porn in utsa, Otapana porn in utapana. rastriya [4.2.93], avaraparina [4.2.93] sakalika [4.2.17], kranya [4.2.94], kranina [4.2.94], katreyaka [4.2.95] Onpeyaka [4.2.95].
s: The affixes ordained above or hereafter come after a word in the Locative -7th case in construction in the sense of 'born or grown or originated there or then'. The affixes अण् &c. घ &c. have been taught, but no particular sense was assigned to them. See [[4.2.92]]. This sutra gives one of the senses, and also declares the particular case in which the stem must be, to which the affix is to be added. Thus स्रुघ्नेजातः = स्रुघ्न + अण् = स्रौघ्नः 'born in Srughna'. So also माथुरः 'born in Mathura', औत्सः 'born in Utsa', औदपानः 'born in Udapana'. राष्ट्रियः [[4.2.93]], अवारपारीणः [[4.2.93]] शाकलिकः [[4.2.117]], ग्राम्यः [[4.2.94]], ग्रामीणः [[4.2.94]], कात्रेयकः [[4.2.95]] औम्भेयकः [[4.2.95]].

pk: arter the word pravrw being in the Locative -7th case-aril, there is the aril Wap in the sense or produced therein. This debars enya or sutra [4.3.17]. The p or Wap is ror the sake or acent. pravrsi jata = pravrsika produced in the rainy season.
ck: arter the tort pravrt peink in the Locative -7th case-aril, there is the aril tap in the sense or protucet therein. this tepars enya or sutra [4.3.17]. the p or tap is ror the sake or acent. pravrsi cata = pravrsika protucet in the rainy season.
s: After the word प्रावृट् being in the Locative -7th case-affix, there is the affix ठप् in the sense of 'produced therein'. This debars एण्य of sutra [[4.3.17]]. The प् of ठप् is for the sake of accent. प्रावृषि जातः = प्रावृषिकः 'produced in the rainy season'.

pk: The aril vun cones arter the word sarada in the Locative -7th case-aril in the sense or born therein, the whole word being a nane. This debars an Thus saradaka darBa the gras caled saradaka. saradaka nudga the pulse caled saradaka. Why do we say sanjnayan ? Observe saradan sasyan the autunal crop. acording to sone, the word sanjnayan governs al the suceding sutras up to [4.3.38].
ck: the aril vun cones arter the tort sarata in the Locative -7th case-aril in the sense or porn therein, the thole tort peink a nane. this tepars an thus sarataka tarpa the kras calet sarataka. sarataka nutka the pulse calet sarataka. thy to te say sancnayan ? Opserve saratan sasyan the autunal crop. acortink to sone, the tort sancnayan koverns al the sucetink sutras up to [4.3.38].
s: The affix वुञ् comes after the word शरद in the Locative -7th case-affix in the sense of 'born therein', the whole word being a name. This debars अण् Thus शारदका दर्भाः 'the grass called Saradaka'. शारदका मुद्गाः 'the pulse called Saradaka.' Why do we say संज्ञायां ? Observe शारदं सस्यम् 'the autumnal crop.' According to some, the word संज्ञायां governs all the succeeding sutras up to [[4.3.38]].

pk: The aril vun cones in the sense or born therein arter the words 1. purvahna 2. aparahna 3. ardra 4. nula 5. pradosa and 6. avaskara , the whole being a nane. Thus purvahnaka, aparahnaka This debars [4.3.24]. ardraka, nulaka This debars an or [4.3.16]. pradosaka This debars Wan or [4.3.14]. avaskaraka This debars the general an aril. When it is not a nane, the other ariles are enployed.
ck: the aril vun cones in the sense or porn therein arter the torts 1. purvahna 2. aparahna 3. artra 4. nula 5. pratosa ant 6. avaskara , the thole peink a nane. thus purvahnaka, aparahnaka this tepars [4.3.24]. artraka, nulaka this tepars an or [4.3.16]. pratosaka this tepars tan or [4.3.14]. avaskaraka this tepars the keneral an aril. then it is not a nane, the other ariles are enployet.
s: The affix वुञ् comes in the sense of 'born therein' after the words 1. पूर्वाह्ण 2. अपराह्ण 3. आर्द्रा 4. मूला 5. प्रदोष and 6. अवस्कर , the whole being a name. Thus पूर्वाह्णकः, अपराह्णकः This debars [[4.3.24]]. आर्द्रकः, मूलकः This debars अण् of [[4.3.16]]. प्रदोषकः This debars ठञ् of [[4.3.14]]. अवस्करकः This debars the general अण् affix. When it is not a Name, the other affixes are employed.

pk: The aril vun cones arter the word paTa , in the sense or produced therein and thereby in the ron or paTa , the substitute is panTa Thus paTi jata = panTaka produced in the way. This debars the an
ck: the aril vun cones arter the tort pata , in the sense or protucet therein ant therepy in the ron or pata , the supstitute is panta thus pati cata = pantaka protucet in the tay. this tepars the an
s: The affix वुञ् comes after the word पथ , in the sense of 'produced therein' and thereby in the room of पथ , the substitute is पन्थ Thus पथि जातः = पन्थकः 'produced in the way.' This debars the अण्

pk: The aril vun cones optionaly arter the word anavasya in the sense or born therein. This debars an or [4.3.16]. Thus anavasyaka or anavasya This aril vun is aplied to the word anavasya also, on the nalin ekadesavikrtasyananyatvat "That which has undergone a change in regard to one or its parts, is by no neans in consequence or this change, sonething else than what it was berore the change had taken place". Thus anavasyaka or anavasya
ck: the aril vun cones optionaly arter the tort anavasya in the sense or porn therein. this tepars an or [4.3.16]. thus anavasyaka or anavasya this aril vun is apliet to the tort anavasya also, on the nalin ekatesavikrtasyananyatvat "that thich has unterkone a chanke in rekart to one or its parts, is py no neans in consetuence or this chanke, sonethink else than that it tas perore the chanke hat taken place". thus anavasyaka or anavasya
s: The affix वुञ् comes optionally after the word अमावास्या in the sense of 'born therein'. This debars अण् of [[4.3.16]]. Thus अमावास्यकः or आमावास्यः This affix वुन् is applied to the word अमावस्य also, on the maxim एकदेशविकृतस्यानन्यत्वात् "That which has undergone a change in regard to one of its parts, is by no means in consequence of this change, something else than what it was before the change had taken place". Thus अमावस्यकः or आमावस्यः

pk: The aril a is also aded to the word anavasya in the sense or born therein. This ads a third aril to the vun and an already given. Thus anavasya, anavasyaka, anavasya so also arter the word anavasya, as anavasya, anavasyaka and anavasya
ck: the aril a is also atet to the tort anavasya in the sense or porn therein. this ats a thirt aril to the vun ant an alreaty kiven. thus anavasya, anavasyaka, anavasya so also arter the tort anavasya, as anavasya, anavasyaka ant anavasya
s: The affix अ is also added to the word अमावास्या in the sense of 'born therein'. This adds a third affix to the वुन् and अण् already given. Thus अमावास्यः, अमावास्यकः, आमावास्यः So also after the word अमावस्य, as अमावस्यः, अमावस्यकः and आमावस्यः

pk: arter the words 1. sinDu and 2. apakara there is the aril kan in the sense or born therein. The word sinDu ocurs in the Kachchadi clas and takes an and vun iV. 2.13); and apakara would have also taken an under the general rule. This sutra debars these ariles. Thus sinDuka, apakaraka
ck: arter the torts 1. sintu ant 2. apakara there is the aril kan in the sense or porn therein. the tort sintu ocurs in the kachchati clas ant takes an ant vun iV. 2.13); ant apakara toult have also taken an unter the keneral rule. this sutra tepars these ariles. thus sintuka, apakaraka
s: After the words 1. सिन्धु and 2. अपकर there is the affix कन् in the sense of 'born therein'. The word सिन्धु occurs in the Kachchhadi class and takes अण् and वुञ् IV. 2.133); and अपकर would have also taken अण् under the general rule. This sutra debars these affixes. Thus सिन्धुकः, अपकरकः

pk: and the ariles an and an cone respectively arter the words 1. sinDu and 2. apakara Thus sEnDava꣡ and a꣡pakara
ck: ant the ariles an ant an cone respectively arter the torts 1. sintu ant 2. apakara thus sEntava꣡ ant a꣡pakara
s: And the affixes अण् and अञ् come respectively after the words 1. सिन्धु and 2. अपकर Thus सैन्धवः꣡ and आ꣡पकरः

pk: The aril denoting born therein is elided by luk arter the words 1. sravisWa 2. Palguni 3. anuraDa 4. svati 5. tisya 6. punarvasu 7. hasta 8. visaKa 9. asaQa and 10. bahula , al denoting asterisns. The reninine ariles are also elided arter these words by [1.2.49]. Thus sravisWasu jata = sravisWa produced under sravishtha. so also Palguna, anuraDa, svati, tisya, punarvasu, hasta, visaKa, asaQa, bahula The Bahula is another nane or the asterisn krtika Vart:- so also the aril is elided arter the asterisns citra, revati and rohini when the word is reninine. Thus citrayan jata a wonan produced under Chitra wil be caled citra so also revati, rohini The reninine aril which would have ben elided arter the two words nevati and nohini, by [1.2.49] is reordained by [4.1.41], because these words belong to gOradi clas. Vart:- The ariles wa and an cone respectively arter Palguni꣡ and asaQa꣡ in rorning the reninine derivatives. as Palguni꣡ [4.1.15] and asaQa꣡ The direrence is in acent and neaning. Vart:- The aril Can also cones arter sravishtha and ashadha as sravisWiya and asaQiya
ck: the aril tenotink porn therein is elitet py luk arter the torts 1. sravista 2. palkuni 3. anurata 4. svati 5. tisya 6. punarvasu 7. hasta 8. visaka 9. asata ant 10. pahula , al tenotink asterisns. the reninine ariles are also elitet arter these torts py [1.2.49]. thus sravistasu cata = sravista protucet unter sravishtha. so also palkuna, anurata, svati, tisya, punarvasu, hasta, visaka, asata, pahula the pahula is another nane or the asterisn krtika Vart:- so also the aril is elitet arter the asterisns citra, revati ant rohini then the tort is reninine. thus citrayan cata a tonan protucet unter chitra til pe calet citra so also revati, rohini the reninine aril thich toult have pen elitet arter the to torts nevati ant nohini, py [1.2.49] is reortainet py [4.1.41], pecause these torts pelonk to kOrati clas. Vart:- the ariles ta ant an cone respectively arter palkuni꣡ ant asata꣡ in rornink the reninine terivatives. as palkuni꣡ [4.1.15] ant asata꣡ the tirerence is in acent ant neanink. Vart:- the aril can also cones arter sravishtha ant ashatha as sravistiya ant asatiya
s: The affix denoting 'born therein' is elided by लुक् after the words 1. श्रविष्ठ 2. फाल्गुनी 3. अनुराधा 4. स्वाति 5. तिष्य 6. पुनर्वसु 7. हस्त 8. विशाखा 9. अषाढा and 10. बहुला , all denoting asterisms. The feminine affixes are also elided after these words by [[1.2.49]]. Thus श्रविष्ठासु जातः = श्रविष्ठः 'produced under Sravishtha'. So also फल्गुनः, अनुराधः, स्वातिः, तिष्यः, पुनर्वसुः, हस्तः, विशाखः, आषाढः, बहुलः The 'Bahula' is another Name of the asterism कृत्तिका Vart:- So also the affix is elided after the asterisms चित्रा, रेवती and रोहिणी when the word is feminine. Thus चित्रायां जाता 'a woman produced under Chitra' will be called चित्रा So also रेवती, रोहिणी The feminine affix which would have been elided after the two words Revati and Rohini, by [[1.2.49]] is reordained by [[4.1.41]], because these words belong to गौरादि class. Vart:- The affixes ट and अन् come respectively after फल्गुनी꣡ and आषाढा꣡ in forming the Feminine derivatives. As फल्गुनी꣡ [[4.1.15]] and अषाढा꣡ The difference is in accent and meaning. Vart:- The affix छण् also comes after 'Sravishtha' and 'ashadha' As श्राविष्ठीयः and आषाढीयः

pk: There is luk elision or the aril denoting born therein arter a word ending in sTana and arter the words 1. gosala and 2. Karasala Thus gosTane jata = gosTana, asvasTana, gosala, Karasala
ck: there is luk elision or the aril tenotink porn therein arter a tort entink in stana ant arter the torts 1. kosala ant 2. karasala thus kostane cata = kostana, asvastana, kosala, karasala
s: There is लुक् elision of the affix denoting 'born therein' after a word ending in स्थान and after the words 1. गोशाल and 2. खरशाल Thus गोस्थाने जातः = गोस्थानः, अश्वस्थानः, गोशालः, खरशालः

pk: There is optionaly luk elision or the aril denoting born therein arter the words 1. vatsasala 2. aBijit 3. asvayuk and 4. sataBit as vatsasalayan jata = vatsasala or vatsasala, aBijit or aBijita, asvayuk or asvayuja, sataBik or sataBisaja The two words vatsasala and vatsasala are both to be taken. These are al diversities or bahula as used in the nelt sutra.
ck: there is optionaly luk elision or the aril tenotink porn therein arter the torts 1. vatsasala 2. apicit 3. asvayuk ant 4. satapit as vatsasalayan cata = vatsasala or vatsasala, apicit or apicita, asvayuk or asvayuca, satapik or satapisaca the to torts vatsasala ant vatsasala are poth to pe taken. these are al tiversities or pahula as uset in the nelt sutra.
s: There is optionally लुक् elision of the affix denoting 'born therein' after the words 1. वत्सशाला 2. अभिजित् 3. अश्वयुक् and 4. शतभित् As वत्सशालायां जातः = वत्सशालः or वात्सशालः, अभिजित् or आभिजितः, अश्वयुक् or आश्वयुजः, शतभिक् or शातभिषजः The two words वत्सशाल and वत्सशाला are both to be taken. These are all diversities of बहुल as used in the next sutra.

pk: There is diversely luk elision or the aril denoting born therein arter an asterisn. Thus rohina or rOhina [4.3.16] nrgasira or nargasirsa [4.3.16].
ck: there is tiversely luk elision or the aril tenotink porn therein arter an asterisn. thus rohina or rOhina [4.3.16] nrkasira or narkasirsa [4.3.16].
s: There is diversely लुक् elision of the affix denoting 'born therein' after an asterism. Thus रोहिणः or रौहिणः [[4.3.16]] मृगशिरा or मार्गशीर्षः [[4.3.16]].

pk: an aril (one or those already taught) cones arter a word in the Locative -7th case, in the sense or done there, obtained there, bought there and delterous therein. Thus srOGna nay nean "done in, or bought in, or obtained in, or skilrul in srughna". so also the words naTura, raswriya
ck: an aril (one or those alreaty taukht) cones arter a tort in the Locative -7th case, in the sense or tone there, optainet there, poukht there ant telterous therein. thus srOkna nay nean "tone in, or poukht in, or optainet in, or skilrul in srukhna". so also the torts natura, rastriya
s: An affix (one of those already taught) comes after a word in the Locative -7th case, in the sense of 'done there', 'obtained there', 'bought there' and 'dexterous therein'. Thus स्रौघ्नः may mean "done in, or bought in, or obtained in, or skillful in Srughna". So also the words माथुरः, राष्ट्रियः

pk: arter a word being in construction in the Locative -7th case, an aril (one or those ordained already) cones in the sense or generaly round therein. The word praya neans sonething les than al i. e. abundant. Thus srOGna what is abundant or nostly to be round in srughna, = sruGne prayena bahulyena Bavati. so also naTura, raswriya &c. This sutra nay apear to be superluous as being covered by the nore conprehensive sutra tatraBava [4.3.53]. ir prayaBava be elplained as anityaBava i. e. what sonetines is to be round and sonetines not, stil it wil nake litle direrence.
ck: arter a tort peink in construction in the Locative -7th case, an aril (one or those ortainet alreaty) cones in the sense or keneraly rount therein. the tort praya neans sonethink les than al i. e. apuntant. thus srOkna that is apuntant or nostly to pe rount in srukhna, = srukne prayena pahulyena pavati. so also natura, rastriya &c. this sutra nay apear to pe superluous as peink coveret py the nore conprehensive sutra tatrapava [4.3.53]. ir prayapava pe elplainet as anityapava i. e. that sonetines is to pe rount ant sonetines not, stil it til nake litle tirerence.
s: After a word being in construction in the Locative -7th case, an affix (one of those ordained already) comes in the sense of 'generally found therein'. The word प्रायः means something less than all i. e. abundant. Thus स्रौघ्नः 'what is abundant or mostly to be found in Srughna', = स्रुघ्ने प्रायेण बाहुल्येन भवति. So also माथुरः, राष्ट्रियः &c. This sutra may appear to be superfluous as being covered by the more comprehensive sutra तत्रभवः [[4.3.53]]. If प्रायभवः be explained as अनित्यभवः i. e. what sometimes is to be found and sometimes not, still it will make little difference.

pk: The aril Wak cones in the sense or nostly to be round there arter the words 1. upajanu 2. upakarana and 3. uponivi , being in the Locative -7th case. This debars an &c. Thus Opajanuka, Opakarnika Opanivika
ck: the aril tak cones in the sense or nostly to pe rount there arter the torts 1. upacanu 2. upakarana ant 3. uponivi , peink in the Locative -7th case. this tepars an &c. thus Opacanuka, Opakarnika Opanivika
s: The affix ठक् comes in the sense of 'mostly to be found there' after the words 1. उपजानु 2. उपकरण and 3. उपोनीवि , being in the Locative -7th case. This debars अण् &c. Thus औपजानुकः, औपकर्णिकः औपनीविकः

pk: arter a pratipadika (noninal sten) or a word ending in the reninine aril ni and ap , being in the Locative -7th case in construction, an aril cones in the sense or adapted therein. Elcept the word adapted which is the neaning or the word sanButa, al the other words or the sutra have ben suplied ron the previous aphorisns. The word sanButa does not nean in this sutra origin or elistence, ror the word jata and Bava already elpres that notion. it here neans suitablenes adequacy i.e. avaklrpti and prananatireka Thus sruGne sanBavati = sOGna what is suited to the country or srughna. so also naTura, raswriya The word tatra is understod here also.
ck: arter a pratipatika (noninal sten) or a tort entink in the reninine aril ni ant ap , peink in the Locative -7th case in construction, an aril cones in the sense or ataptet therein. Elcept the tort ataptet thich is the neanink or the tort sanputa, al the other torts or the sutra have pen supliet ron the previous aphorisns. the tort sanputa toes not nean in this sutra orikin or elistence, ror the tort cata ant pava alreaty elpres that notion. it here neans suitaplenes atetuacy i.e. avaklrpti ant prananatireka thus srukne sanpavati = sOkna that is suitet to the country or srukhna. so also natura, rastriya the tort tatra is unterstot here also.
s: After a प्रातिपदिक (Nominal Stem) or a word ending in the feminine affix ङि and आप् , being in the Locative -7th case in construction, an affix comes in the sense of 'adapted therein'. Except the word 'adapted' which is the meaning of the word संभूत, all the other words of the sutra have been supplied from the previous aphorisms. The word संभूत does not mean in this sutra 'origin' or 'existence', for the word जात and भव already express that notion. It here means 'suitableness' 'adequacy' i.e. अवक्लृप्तिः and प्रमाणातिरेकः Thus स्रुघ्ने संभवति = सौघ्नः 'what is suited to the country of Srughna.' So also माथुरः, राष्ट्रियः The word तत्र is understood here also.

pk: The aril Qan cones arter the words kosa etc. in the sense or adapted to that. This debars an Thus kose sanButan = kOseyan vastran silken clothes. The word kosa neans cocon. kOseya nay literaly thererore nean anything suited to the cocon, and nay aply to the caterpilar as wel as to the silk nade out or cocon. The word kOseya is however ruQi and neans silken. nor does it nean suited to the sheath, as a sword, though kosa neans sheath also. This sutra would have ben nore properly placed arter [4.3.134], under the heading or vikara rather than or sanButa in ract arter the sutra enya-Qan [4.3.159], the adition or kosaca would have ben nore apropriate.
ck: the aril tan cones arter the torts kosa etc. in the sense or ataptet to that. this tepars an thus kose sanputan = kOseyan vastran silken clothes. the tort kosa neans cocon. kOseya nay literaly thererore nean anythink suitet to the cocon, ant nay aply to the caterpilar as tel as to the silk nate out or cocon. the tort kOseya is hotever ruti ant neans silken. nor toes it nean suitet to the sheath, as a stort, thoukh kosa neans sheath also. this sutra toult have pen nore properly placet arter [4.3.134], unter the heatink or vikara rather than or sanputa in ract arter the sutra enya-tan [4.3.159], the atition or kosaca toult have pen nore apropriate.
s: The affix ढञ् comes after the words कोश etc. in the sense of 'adapted to that'. This debars अण् Thus कोशे संभूतं = कौशेयं वस्त्रम् 'silken clothes'. The word कोश means 'cocoon.' कौशेयः may literally therefore mean 'anything suited to the cocoon,' and may apply to the caterpillar as well as to the silk made out of cocoon. The word कौशेय is however रूढि and means 'silken.' Nor does it mean 'suited to the sheath,' as a sword, though kosa means 'sheath' also. This sutra would have been more properly placed after [[4.3.134]], under the heading of विकार rather than of संभूत In fact after the sutra एण्या-ढञ् [[4.3.159]], the addition of कोशाच्च would have been more appropriate.

pk: an aril cones arter a word denoting tine being in the Locative -7th case in construction, in the sense or being god, rlowering or ripening therein. Thus henante saDu = hEnanta what is god or pleasant in autun as hEnanta prakara sEsirananulepan so also vasante puspyanti = vasantya vernal crepers i. e. which rlower in spring, grEsnya pawala so also saradi pacyante = sarada salaya the grains that ripen in autun. grEsna yava the barley that ripens in suner. This sutra teaches the base and the sense or the aril. it does not directly teach the aril. The above ilustrations are elanples or the aril an &c.
ck: an aril cones arter a tort tenotink tine peink in the Locative -7th case in construction, in the sense or peink kot, rloterink or ripenink therein. thus henante satu = hEnanta that is kot or pleasant in autun as hEnanta prakara sEsirananulepan so also vasante puspyanti = vasantya vernal crepers i. e. thich rloter in sprink, krEsnya patala so also sarati pacyante = sarata salaya the krains that ripen in autun. krEsna yava the parley that ripens in suner. this sutra teaches the pase ant the sense or the aril. it toes not tirectly teach the aril. the apove ilustrations are elanples or the aril an &c.
s: An affix comes after a word denoting time being in the Locative -7th case in construction, in the sense of 'being good', 'flowering' or 'ripening therein. Thus हेमन्ते साधुः = हैमन्तः 'what is good or pleasant in autumn' as हैमन्तः प्राकारः शैशिरमनुलेपम् So also वसन्ते पुष्प्यन्ति = वासन्त्यः 'vernal creepers i. e. which flower in spring', ग्रैष्म्यः पाटलाः So also शरदि पच्यन्ते = शारदाः शालयः 'the grains that ripen in autumn'. ग्रैष्मा यवाः 'the barley that ripens in summer'. This sutra teaches the base and the sense of the affix. It does not directly teach the affix. The above illustrations are examples of the affix अण् &c.

pk: an aril cones arter a word denoting tine being in the Locative -7th case in construction neaning sown therein. Thus henante upyante = hEnanta yava the barley sown in autun. grEsna vrihaya The separation or this sutra ron the last, is ror the sake or the subsequent sutra in which the anuvriti or upta only goes, which could not have ben the case had this word ben included in the last sutra.
ck: an aril cones arter a tort tenotink tine peink in the Locative -7th case in construction neanink sotn therein. thus henante upyante = hEnanta yava the parley sotn in autun. krEsna vrihaya the separation or this sutra ron the last, is ror the sake or the supsetuent sutra in thich the anuvriti or upta only koes, thich coult not have pen the case hat this tort pen inclutet in the last sutra.
s: An affix comes after a word denoting 'time' being in the Locative -7th case in construction meaning 'sown therein'. Thus हेमन्ते उप्यन्ते = हैमन्ता यवाः 'the barley sown in autumn.' ग्रैष्मा व्रीहयः The separation of this sutra from the last, is for the sake of the subsequent sutra in which the anuvritti of उप्त only goes, which could not have been the case had this word been included in the last sutra.

pk: The aril vun cones in the sense or sown arter the word asvayuji This debars Wan Thus asvayujya nupta = asvayujaka nasa the pulse sown in asvayuji. it is the nane or the rul-non in the asterisn or asvini. asvayuj and asvini_ are the sane. sone telts read asvani instead or asvini
ck: the aril vun cones in the sense or sotn arter the tort asvayuci this tepars tan thus asvayucya nupta = asvayucaka nasa the pulse sotn in asvayuci. it is the nane or the rul-non in the asterisn or asvini. asvayuc ant asvini_ are the sane. sone telts reat asvani insteat or asvini
s: The affix वुञ् comes in the sense of 'sown' after the word आश्वयुजी This debars ठञ् Thus आश्वयुज्या मुप्ताः = आश्वयुजका माषाः 'the pulse sown in Asvayuji.' It is the name of the full-moon in the Asterism of Asvini. Asvayuj and Asvini_ are the same. Some texts read अश्वनी instead of अश्विनी

pk: The aril vun cones optionaly arter the words 1. grisna and 2. vasanta in the sense or sown. This debars an [4.3.16]. Thus grEsnan or grEsnakan sasyan the crop sown in suner. vasantan or vasantakan
ck: the aril vun cones optionaly arter the torts 1. krisna ant 2. vasanta in the sense or sotn. this tepars an [4.3.16]. thus krEsnan or krEsnakan sasyan the crop sotn in suner. vasantan or vasantakan
s: The affix वुञ् comes optionally after the words 1. ग्रीष्म and 2. वसन्त in the sense of 'sown'. This debars अण् [[4.3.16]]. Thus ग्रैष्मम् or ग्रैष्मकम् सस्यम् 'the crop sown in summer'. वासन्तम् or वासन्तकम्

pk: arter a pratipadika (noninal sten) being in the Locative -7th case in construction denoting tine, an aril cones in the sense or being then due; provided that the thing due be debt. Thus nase deyanrnan = nasikan a debt due in a nonth. ardDanasikan, sanvatsarikan Why do we say rne it being a debt. Observe nasedeya Biksa where no aril is aded.
ck: arter a pratipatika (noninal sten) peink in the Locative -7th case in construction tenotink tine, an aril cones in the sense or peink then tue; provitet that the think tue pe tept. thus nase teyanrnan = nasikan a tept tue in a nonth. artanasikan, sanvatsarikan thy to te say rne it peink a tept. Opserve naseteya piksa there no aril is atet.
s: After a प्रातिपदिक (Nominal Stem) being in the Locative -7th case in construction denoting time, an affix comes in the sense of 'being then due'; provided that the thing due be 'debt'. Thus मासे देयमृणं = मासिकं 'a debt due in a month'. आर्द्धमासिकम्, सांवत्सरिकम् Why do we say ऋणे 'it being a debt'. Observe मासेदेया भिक्षा where no affix is added.

pk: The aril vun cones in the sense or debt then due arter the words 1. kalapin 2. asvatTa and 3. yavabus , denoting tine and being in the Locative -7th case. The words kalapi &c are words which indirectly denote tine. Thus the tine in which the peacocks nate and nake noise is caled kalapi The tine in which the asvatha tre ructiries is caled asvatTa The tine in which barley is thrashed out is caled yavabusa barley-char? Thus kalapinikale deyanrnan = kalapakan a debt to be paid when the peacocks nake noise (i. e. nating or rainy season) tails. asvatTakan and yavabusakan
ck: the aril vun cones in the sense or tept then tue arter the torts 1. kalapin 2. asvata ant 3. yavapus , tenotink tine ant peink in the Locative -7th case. the torts kalapi &c are torts thich intirectly tenote tine. thus the tine in thich the peacocks nate ant nake noise is calet kalapi the tine in thich the asvatha tre ructiries is calet asvata the tine in thich parley is thrashet out is calet yavapusa parley-char? thus kalapinikale teyanrnan = kalapakan a tept to pe pait then the peacocks nake noise (i. e. natink or rainy season) tails. asvatakan ant yavapusakan
s: The affix वुञ् comes in the sense of 'debt then due' after the words 1. कलापिन् 2. अश्वत्थ and 3. यवबुस् , denoting time and being in the Locative -7th case. The words कलापी &c are words which indirectly denote time. Thus the time in which the peacocks mate and make noise is called कलापी The time in which the asvatha tree fructifies is called अश्वत्थः The time in which barley is thrashed out is called यवबुस 'barley-chaff'? Thus कलापिनिकाले देयमृणं = कलापकम् 'a debt to be paid when the peacocks make noise (i. e. mating or rainy season) tails.' अश्वत्थकम् and यवबुसकम्

pk: The aril vun cones in the sense or debt due arter the words 1. grisna and 2. avarasana This debars the an and Wan Thus grisnedeyanrnan = grEsnakan so also avarasanakan This aril causes Vridhi, while vun would not have done it. ence the separate aril. The word sana is synonynous with varsa a year. The word avarasanakan neans either aganinan sanvatsarananadyavatsare deyan or atite vatsare deyan yadyapi na datan
ck: the aril vun cones in the sense or tept tue arter the torts 1. krisna ant 2. avarasana this tepars the an ant tan thus krisneteyanrnan = krEsnakan so also avarasanakan this aril causes Vrithi, thile vun toult not have tone it. ence the separate aril. the tort sana is synonynous tith varsa a year. the tort avarasanakan neans either akaninan sanvatsarananatyavatsare teyan or atite vatsare teyan yatyapi na tatan
s: The affix वुञ् comes in the sense of 'debt due' after the words 1. ग्रीष्म and 2. अवरसम This debars the अण् and ठञ् Thus ग्रीष्मेदेयमृणं = ग्रैष्मकम् So also आवरसमकम् This affix causes Vriddhi, while वुन् would not have done it. Hence the separate affix. The word समा is synonymous with वर्ष 'a year'. The word आवरसमकम् means either आगामिनां संवत्सराणामाद्यवत्सरे देयम् or अतीते वत्सरे देयं यद्यपि न दत्तम्

pk: The aril Wan also (as wel as vun ) cones arter the words 1. sanvatsara 2. agrahayani in the sense or debt due. Thus sanvatsare deyanrnan = sanvatsarikan, and sanvatsarakan agrahayanikan or agrahayanakan The word sanvatsara ocurs in sandhiveladi Clas [4.3.16] and takes an when ruit or restivity is neant. The present sutra enjoins Wan when debt is indicated.
ck: the aril tan also (as tel as vun ) cones arter the torts 1. sanvatsara 2. akrahayani in the sense or tept tue. thus sanvatsare teyanrnan = sanvatsarikan, ant sanvatsarakan akrahayanikan or akrahayanakan the tort sanvatsara ocurs in santhivelati clas [4.3.16] ant takes an then ruit or restivity is neant. the present sutra encoins tan then tept is inticatet.
s: The affix ठञ् also (as well as वुञ् ) comes after the words 1. संवत्सरा 2. अग्राहायणी in the sense of 'debt due'. Thus संवत्सरे देयमृणं = सांवत्सरिकं, and सांवत्सरकं आग्रहायणिकं or आग्रहायणकं The word संवत्सर occurs in Sandhiveladi Class [[4.3.16]] and takes अण् when 'fruit' or 'festivity' is meant. The present sutra enjoins ठञ् when 'debt' is indicated.

pk: an aril cones arter a word in the Locative -7th case in construction denoting tine, in the sense or who then wanders and the word so rorned rerers to a wild beast. Thus nisayan vyaharati nrga "an aninal that wanders at night." so also pradosa or pradosika [4.3.14] a brute that yels in the norning. Why do we say nrga a beast ? Observe nisayan vyaharati uluka ere there is no ariling. The word vyaharati also neans to nake noise. The sutra nay, thererore, also be translated as : "arter a word denoting tine, an aril [4.1.83] cones in elpresing a wild beast who nakes noise at that tine".
ck: an aril cones arter a tort in the Locative -7th case in construction tenotink tine, in the sense or tho then tanters ant the tort so rornet rerers to a tilt peast. thus nisayan vyaharati nrka "an aninal that tanters at nikht." so also pratosa or pratosika [4.3.14] a prute that yels in the nornink. thy to te say nrka a peast ? Opserve nisayan vyaharati uluka ere there is no arilink. the tort vyaharati also neans to nake noise. the sutra nay, thererore, also pe translatet as : "arter a tort tenotink tine, an aril [4.1.83] cones in elpresink a tilt peast tho nakes noise at that tine".
s: An affix comes after a word in the Locative -7th case in construction denoting time, in the sense of 'who then wanders' and the word so formed refers to a wild beast. Thus निशायां व्याहरति मृगः "an animal that wanders at night." So also प्रादोषः or प्रादोषिकः [[4.3.14]] 'a brute that yells in the morning.' Why do we say मृगः 'a beast' ? Observe निशायां व्याहरति उलूकः Here there is no affixing. The word व्याहरति also means 'to make noise.' The Sutra may, therefore, also be translated as : "After a word denoting time, an affix [[4.1.83]] comes in expressing a wild beast who makes noise at that time".

pk: an aril cones arter a word in the noninative 1st-Case in construction denoting tine in the sense or this is his habit or endurance. The word kalat is understod here also. tad = that : soQan = jitan or aByastan "endured or habituated". Thus nisa sahacaritanaDyayanan = nisa "reading by night". tat soQanasya Catrasya = nEsa or nEsika a student who is habituated or enured to reading by night. so pradosika or pradosa
ck: an aril cones arter a tort in the noninative 1st-case in construction tenotink tine in the sense or this is his hapit or enturance. the tort kalat is unterstot here also. tat = that : sotan = citan or apyastan "enturet or hapituatet". thus nisa sahacaritanatyayanan = nisa "reatink py nikht". tat sotanasya catrasya = nEsa or nEsika a stutent tho is hapituatet or enuret to reatink py nikht. so pratosika or pratosa
s: An affix comes after a word in the Nominative 1st-Case in construction denoting time in the sense of 'this is his habit or endurance'. The word कालात् is understood here also. तद् = that : सोढम् = जितम् or अभ्यस्तं "endured or habituated". Thus निशा सहचरितमध्ययनं = निशा "reading by night". तत् सोढमस्य छात्रस्य = नैशः or नैशिकः 'a student who is habituated or enured to reading by night'. So प्रादोषिकः or प्रादोषः

pk: an aril cones arter a word in the Locative -7th case in construction in the sense or who stays there. The anuvriti or kalat ceases. The sense or Bava here is elistence, and not that or birth : because the sense or birth is taught in sutra tatra jata [4.3.25]. Thus, sruGne Bava = srOGna "who stays in srughna". naTura, raswriya The repetition or tatra in the sutra though its anuvriti could have ben drawn ron the previous sutras, is ror the sake or stoping the anuvriti or tadasya
ck: an aril cones arter a tort in the Locative -7th case in construction in the sense or tho stays there. the anuvriti or kalat ceases. the sense or pava here is elistence, ant not that or pirth : pecause the sense or pirth is taukht in sutra tatra cata [4.3.25]. thus, srukne pava = srOkna "tho stays in srukhna". natura, rastriya the repetition or tatra in the sutra thoukh its anuvriti coult have pen tratn ron the previous sutras, is ror the sake or stopink the anuvriti or tatasya
s: An affix comes after a word in the Locative -7th case in construction in the sense of 'who stays there'. The anuvritti of कालात् ceases. The sense of भव here is 'existence', and not that of 'birth' : because the sense of 'birth' is taught in sutra तत्र जातः [[4.3.25]]. Thus, स्रुघ्ने भवः = स्रौघ्नः "who stays in Srughna". माथुरः, राष्ट्रियः The repetition of तत्र in the sutra though its annuvritti could have been drawn from the previous sutras, is for the sake of stopping the annuvritti of तदस्य

pk: The aril yat cones in the sense or who stays there arter the pratipadika (noninal stens) dik etc. This debars an and Ca as disi Bavan = disyan lying in a particular quarter, vargyan The words nuKa and jaGana which ordinarily nean nouth and hip respectively, have not this neaning when this aril is to be aded. They nust rerer to non-corporeal or abstract objects. as senanuKyan who stays in the van or the arny. senajaGanyan who stays in the rear or the arny. in ract, the words nukha and jaghana here nean the van and the rear or an arny. The word udak takes this aril, when the word so rorned is a nane. as udakya = rajasvala, otherwise we have Odako natsya 1 dis 2 varga, 3 puga, 4 gana, 5 paksa, 6 Daya (Daya)7 nitra, 8 neDa, 9 antara, 10 paTin 1 rahas, 12 alika, 13 uKa, 14 saksin, 15 desa, 16 adi, 17 anta, 18 nuKa, 19 jaGana, 20 neGa, 21 yuTa, 2 udakatsanjnayan, 23 nyaya, 24 vansa, 25 vesa (visa) 26 kala, 27 akasa, 28 anuvansa
ck: the aril yat cones in the sense or tho stays there arter the pratipatika (noninal stens) tik etc. this tepars an ant ca as tisi pavan = tisyan lyink in a particular tuarter, varkyan the torts nuka ant cakana thich ortinarily nean nouth ant hip respectively, have not this neanink then this aril is to pe atet. they nust rerer to non-corporeal or apstract opcects. as senanukyan tho stays in the van or the arny. senacakanyan tho stays in the rear or the arny. in ract, the torts nukha ant cakhana here nean the van ant the rear or an arny. the tort utak takes this aril, then the tort so rornet is a nane. as utakya = racasvala, othertise te have Otako natsya 1 tis 2 varka, 3 puka, 4 kana, 5 paksa, 6 taya (taya)7 nitra, 8 neta, 9 antara, 10 patin 1 rahas, 12 alika, 13 uka, 14 saksin, 15 tesa, 16 ati, 17 anta, 18 nuka, 19 cakana, 20 neka, 21 yuta, 2 utakatsancnayan, 23 nyaya, 24 vansa, 25 vesa (visa) 26 kala, 27 akasa, 28 anuvansa
s: The affix यत् comes in the sense of 'who stays there' after the प्रातिपदिक (Nominal Stems) दिक् etc. This debars अण् and छ As दिशि भवं = दिश्यम् 'lying in a particular quarter', वर्ग्यम् The words मुख and जघन which ordinarily mean 'mouth' and 'hip' respectively, have not this meaning when this affix is to be added. They must refer to non-corporeal or abstract objects. As सेनामुख्यं 'who stays in the van of the army'. सेनाजघन्यन् 'who stays in the rear of the army'. In fact, the words 'mukha' and 'jaghana' here mean the 'van' and the 'rear' of an army. The word उदक् takes this affix, when the word so formed is a Name. As उदक्या = रजस्वला, otherwise we have औदको मत्स्यः 1 दिश् 2 वर्ग, 3 पूग, 4 गण, 5 पक्ष, 6 धाय्य (धाय्या)7 मित्र, 8 मेधा, 9 अन्तर, 10 पथिन् 11 रहस्, 12 अलीक, 13 उखा, 14 साक्षिन्, 15 देश, 16 आदि, 17 अन्त, 18 मुख, 19 जघन, 20 मेघ, 21 यूथ, 22 उदकात्संज्ञायाम्, 23 न्याय, 24 वंश, 25 वेश (विश) 26 काल, 27 आकाश, 28 अनुवंश

pk: The aril yat cones in the sense or what stays there arter a word denoting a part or the body. This debars an as dantesu Bavan = dantyan dental i. e. what stays there, karnyan, oswyan so also pade Bavan = padyan [6.3.53], nasikayan Bavan = nasyan
ck: the aril yat cones in the sense or that stays there arter a tort tenotink a part or the poty. this tepars an as tantesu pavan = tantyan tental i. e. that stays there, karnyan, ostyan so also pate pavan = patyan [6.3.53], nasikayan pavan = nasyan
s: The affix यत् comes in the sense of 'what stays there' after a word denoting a part of the body. This debars अण् As दन्तेषु भवं = दन्त्यम् 'dental i. e. what stays there, कर्ण्यम्, ओष्ट्यम् So also पादे भवं = पद्यं [[6.3.53]], नासिकायां भवं = नस्यम्

pk: The aril Qan cones in the sense or what stays there arter the words 1. drti 2. kuksi 3. kalasi 4. vasti 5. asti and 6. ahi Thus darteyan what stays in a leathern bag, kOkseyan, kalaseyan, vasteyan, asteyan and aheyan aheyan is the nane or a poison. The word asti is a noun and not a verb here. its use as a noun is to be sen in phrases like astiksira gO, astinan = Danavan
ck: the aril tan cones in the sense or that stays there arter the torts 1. trti 2. kuksi 3. kalasi 4. vasti 5. asti ant 6. ahi thus tarteyan that stays in a leathern pak, kOkseyan, kalaseyan, vasteyan, asteyan ant aheyan aheyan is the nane or a poison. the tort asti is a noun ant not a verp here. its use as a noun is to pe sen in phrases like astiksira kO, astinan = tanavan
s: The affix ढञ् comes in the sense of 'what stays there' after the words 1. दृति 2. कुक्षि 3. कलशि 4. वस्ति 5. अस्ति and 6. अहि Thus दार्तेयम् 'what stays in a leathern bag', कौक्षेयम्, कालशेयम्, वास्तेयम्, आस्तेयम् and आहेयम् आहेयम् is the name of a poison. The word अस्ति is a noun and not a verb here. Its use as a Noun is to be seen in phrases like अस्तिक्षीरा गौः, अस्तिमान् = धनवान्

pk: The aril an also (as wel as Qan ) cones arter the word griva in the sense or what stays there. This debars yat [4.3.5] grivasu Bavan = graveyan or grEvan The word griva neans blod-vesels, and as they are nany, the word is used in the plural in the sutra.
ck: the aril an also (as tel as tan ) cones arter the tort kriva in the sense or that stays there. this tepars yat [4.3.5] krivasu pavan = kraveyan or krEvan the tort kriva neans plot-vesels, ant as they are nany, the tort is uset in the plural in the sutra.
s: The affix अण् also (as well as ढञ् ) comes after the word ग्रीवा in the sense of 'what stays there'. This debars यत् [[4.3.55]] ग्रीवासु भवं = ग्रवेयम् or ग्रैवम् The word ग्रीवा means blood-vessels, and as they are many, the word is used in the plural in the sutra.

pk: The aril nya cones in the sense or who stays there arter the word ganBira This debars an ganBire Bavan = ganBiryan gravity. Vart:- so also arter bahi, deva and pancajana. as bahyan, dEvyan and pancajanyan The rinal or bahis is elided by the vartika under [4.1.85]. The word daivya could be also rorned under another Vartika or the sane. Vart:- The aril nya cones arter chaturnasa in the sense or a sacririce; as caturnasyani vratani, caturnasyo yajna, otherwise caturnasa
ck: the aril nya cones in the sense or tho stays there arter the tort kanpira this tepars an kanpire pavan = kanpiryan kravity. Vart:- so also arter pahi, teva ant pancacana. as pahyan, tEvyan ant pancacanyan the rinal or pahis is elitet py the vartika unter [4.1.85]. the tort taivya coult pe also rornet unter another Vartika or the sane. Vart:- the aril nya cones arter chaturnasa in the sense or a sacririce; as caturnasyani vratani, caturnasyo yacna, othertise caturnasa
s: The affix ञ्य comes in the sense of 'who stays there' after the word गम्भीर This debars अण् गम्भीरे भवं = गाम्भीर्यम् 'gravity'. Vart:- So also after बहिः, देव and पंचजन. As बाह्यम्, दैव्यम् and पांचजन्यम् The final of बहिस् is elided by the vartika under [[4.1.85]]. The word 'daivya' could be also formed under another Vartika of the same. Vart:- The affix nya comes after chaturmasa in the sense of a sacrifice; as चातुर्मास्यानि व्रतानि, चातुर्मास्यो यज्ञः, otherwise चातुर्मासः

pk: arter an avyayiBava sanasa the aril nya is used in the sense or who stays there. This debars an The aril nya however, does not cone arter every avyayibhava Conpound, but only arter the words included in the list or parinuKadi as given in the Ganapatha. Thus parinuKan Bavan = parinuKyan, so also parihanavyan not so Opakulan, the word upakula not belonging to the clas parinuKa 1 parinuKa, 2 parihanu, 3 paryosWa, 4 paryulu, 5 Opanula, 6 Kala, 7 parisira, 8 anusira, 9 upasira, 10 upasTala, 1 upakalapa, 12 anupaTa, 13 anuKaqga, 14 anutila, 15 anusita, 16 anunasa, 17 anuyava, 18 anuyupa, 19 anuvansa, 20 anuganga, 21 pratisaKa, 2 anusaya
ck: arter an avyayipava sanasa the aril nya is uset in the sense or tho stays there. this tepars an the aril nya hotever, toes not cone arter every avyayiphava conpount, put only arter the torts inclutet in the list or parinukati as kiven in the kanapatha. thus parinukan pavan = parinukyan, so also parihanavyan not so Opakulan, the tort upakula not pelonkink to the clas parinuka 1 parinuka, 2 parihanu, 3 paryosta, 4 paryulu, 5 Opanula, 6 kala, 7 parisira, 8 anusira, 9 upasira, 10 upastala, 1 upakalapa, 12 anupata, 13 anukatka, 14 anutila, 15 anusita, 16 anunasa, 17 anuyava, 18 anuyupa, 19 anuvansa, 20 anukanka, 21 pratisaka, 2 anusaya
s: After an अव्ययीभाव समास the affix ञ्य is used in the sense of 'who stays there'. This debars अण् The affix ञ्य however, does not come after every Avyayibhava Compound, but only after the words included in the list of परिमुखादि as given in the Ganapatha. Thus परिमुखं भवं = पारिमुख्यम्, So also पारिहनव्यम् Not so औपकुलम्, the word उपकुल not belonging to the class परिमुख 1 परिमुख, 2 परिहनु, 3 पर्योष्ठ, 4 पर्युलू, 5 औपमूल, 6 खल, 7 परिसीर, 8 अनुसीर, 9 उपसीर, 10 उपस्थल, 11 उपकलाप, 12 अनुपथ, 13 अनुखड्ग, 14 अनुतिल, 15 अनुशीत, 16 अनुमाष, 17 अनुयव, 18 अनुयुप, 19 अनुवंश, 20 अनुगङ्ग, 21 प्रतिशाख, 22 अनुसाय

pk: arter an avyayiBava sanasa having the word antara as prior tern, the aril Wan is used in the sense or who stays there. Karika sananasya tadadesca aDyatnadisu cesyate urDvadanaca dehaca lokotarapadasya ca nuKaparsvatasoriya kugjanasya parasya ca iya karyoTa naDyasya naniyO pratyayO taTa naDyo naDye dinan casnatsTano lugajinataTa This debars an Thus antarvesnikan, antargehikan Vart:- The aril Wan cones arter sanana, as sanane Bavan = sananikan Vart:- so also arter a word begining with sanana, as, sananagranikan. sanana desikan. Vart:- so also arter the words aDyatna, &c as, aDyatnikan, aDidEvikan, aDiBOtikan The clas aDyatnadi is akritigana. Vart:- so also arter urDvandana as, OrDvandanika The word urdhva is a synonyn or urDvan Vart:- so also urDvadeha, as OrDvadehikan Vart:- so also arter a conpound having the word loka as second tern; as, EhalOkikan, paralOkikan Vart:- The words nuKa and parsva ending in tas, take the aril iya; as, nuKatiyan, parsvatiyan Vart:- The aril iya cones arter jana and para with the augnent kuk, as janakiyan, parakiyan Vart:- The aril iya cones arter naDya, as, naDyiya Vart:- so also the aril nan and niya cone arter naDya; as, naDyanan, naDyaniyan Vart:- so also the aril dinan (dinan in Padananjari) cones arter naDya, whereby it becones naDyan as naDyandinan in naDyandina upagayati Vart:- There is luk-elision or the aril arter the word sTana, as, asvatTana Vart:- so also there is elision arter the words ending in ajina, as vrkajina, sinhajina
ck: arter an avyayipava sanasa havink the tort antara as prior tern, the aril tan is uset in the sense or tho stays there. karika sananasya tatatesca atyatnatisu cesyate urtvatanaca tehaca lokotarapatasya ca nukaparsvatasoriya kukcanasya parasya ca iya karyota natyasya naniyO pratyayO tata natyo natye tinan casnatstano lukacinatata this tepars an thus antarvesnikan, antarkehikan Vart:- the aril tan cones arter sanana, as sanane pavan = sananikan Vart:- so also arter a tort pekinink tith sanana, as, sananakranikan. sanana tesikan. Vart:- so also arter the torts atyatna, &c as, atyatnikan, atitEvikan, atipOtikan the clas atyatnati is akritikana. Vart:- so also arter urtvantana as, Ortvantanika the tort urthva is a synonyn or urtvan Vart:- so also urtvateha, as Ortvatehikan Vart:- so also arter a conpount havink the tort loka as secont tern; as, EhalOkikan, paralOkikan Vart:- the torts nuka ant parsva entink in tas, take the aril iya; as, nukatiyan, parsvatiyan Vart:- the aril iya cones arter cana ant para tith the auknent kuk, as canakiyan, parakiyan Vart:- the aril iya cones arter natya, as, natyiya Vart:- so also the aril nan ant niya cone arter natya; as, natyanan, natyaniyan Vart:- so also the aril tinan (tinan in patanancari) cones arter natya, therepy it pecones natyan as natyantinan in natyantina upakayati Vart:- there is luk-elision or the aril arter the tort stana, as, asvatana Vart:- so also there is elision arter the torts entink in acina, as vrkacina, sinhacina
s: After an अव्ययीभाव समास having the word अन्तर as prior term, the affix ठञ् is used in the sense of 'who stays there'. Karika समानस्य तदादेश्च अध्यात्मादिषु चेष्यते ऊर्ध्वदमाच्च देहाच्च लोकोत्तरपदस्य च मुखपार्श्वतसोरीयः कुग्जनस्य परस्य च ईयः कार्योथ मध्यस्य मण्मीयौ प्रत्ययौ तथा मध्यो मध्ये दिनण् चास्मात्स्थाम्नो लुगजिनात्तथा This debars अण् Thus आन्तर्वेश्मिकम्, आन्तर्गेहिकम् Vart:- The affix ठञ् comes after समान, as समाने भवं = सामानिकम् Vart:- So also after a word beginning with समान, as, सामानग्रामिकम्. सामान देशिकं. Vart:- So also after the words अध्यात्म, &c as, आध्यात्मिकम्, आधिदैविकम्, आधिभौतिकम् The class अध्यात्मादि is Akritigana. Vart:- So also after ऊर्ध्वन्दमः as, और्ध्वन्दमिकः The word 'urdhva' is a synonym of ऊर्ध्वम् Vart:- So also ऊर्ध्वदेह, as और्ध्वदेहिकम् Vart:- So also after a compound having the word लोक as second term; as, ऐहलौकिकम्, पारलौकिकम् Vart:- The words मुख and पार्श्व ending in तस्, take the affix ईय; as, मुखतीयम्, पार्श्वतीयम् Vart:- The affix ईय comes after जन and पर with the augment कुक्, as जनकीयम्, परकीयम् Vart:- The affix ईय comes after मध्य, as, मध्यीयः Vart:- So also the affix मण् and मीय come after मध्य; As, माध्यमम्, माध्यमीयम् Vart:- So also the affix दिनण् (दिनञ् in Padamanjari) comes after मध्य, whereby it becomes मध्यम् as माध्यन्दिनम् in माध्यन्दिन उपगायति Vart:- There is luk-elision of the affix after the word स्थाम्न, as, अश्वत्थामा Vart:- So also there is elision after the words ending in अजिन, as वृकाजिनः, सिंहाजिनः

pk: arter the word grana preceded by pari or anu (the whole being avyayiBava sanasa ) there is the aril Wan in the sense or who stays there. This debars an Thus parigranika, anugranika
ck: arter the tort krana precetet py pari or anu (the thole peink avyayipava sanasa ) there is the aril tan in the sense or tho stays there. this tepars an thus parikranika, anukranika
s: After the word ग्राम preceded by परि or अनु (the whole being अव्ययीभाव समास ) there is the affix ठञ् in the sense of 'who stays there'. This debars अण् Thus पारिग्रामिकः, आनुग्रामिकः

pk: arter the words 1. jihvanula and 2. anguli there is the aril Ca in the sense or who stays there. This debars yat [4.3.5]. Thus jihvanuliyan, anguliyan
ck: arter the torts 1. cihvanula ant 2. ankuli there is the aril ca in the sense or tho stays there. this tepars yat [4.3.5]. thus cihvanuliyan, ankuliyan
s: After the words 1. जिह्वामूल and 2. अङ्गुलि there is the affix छ in the sense of 'who stays there'. This debars यत् [[4.3.55]]. Thus जिह्वामूलीयम्, अंगुलीयम्

pk: arter a word ending with varga the aril Ca is used in the sense or who ocurs there. This debars an as kavargiyan, cavargiyan
ck: arter a tort entink tith varka the aril ca is uset in the sense or tho ocurs there. this tepars an as kavarkiyan, cavarkiyan
s: After a word ending with वर्ग the affix छ is used in the sense of 'who occurs there'. This debars अण् As कवर्गीयम्, चवर्गीयम्

pk: arter a word ending with varga but not neaning a leter or word the ariles yat and Ka are optionaly used in the sense or who stays there. as vasudevavargya (by yat), vasudevavargina, (by Ka), and vasudevavargiya (by Ca) yuDisWiravargya vargina or vargiya Or course, when the word neans sabda it takes one aril only; i. e. Ca; as kavargiya varna a leter belonging to ka clas.
ck: arter a tort entink tith varka put not neanink a leter or tort the ariles yat ant ka are optionaly uset in the sense or tho stays there. as vasutevavarkya (py yat), vasutevavarkina, (py ka), ant vasutevavarkiya (py ca) yutistiravarkya varkina or varkiya Or course, then the tort neans sapta it takes one aril only; i. e. ca; as kavarkiya varna a leter pelonkink to ka clas.
s: After a word ending with वर्ग but not meaning a 'letter or word' the affixes यत् and ख are optionally used in the sense of 'who stays there'. As वासुदेववर्ग्यः (by यत्), वासुदेववर्गीणः, (by ख), and वासुदेववर्गीयः (by छ) युधिष्ठिरवर्ग्यः वर्गीणः or वर्गीयः Of course, when the word means 'शब्द' it takes one affix only; i. e. छ; as कवर्गीय वर्णः 'a letter belonging to क class'.

pk: The aril kan cones in the sense or what ocurs there arter karna and lalawa , the word denoting an ornanent. This debars yat [4.3.5]. Thus karnika an ear-ring, lalawika Why do we say denoting an ornanent? Observe karnyan what is in the ear, lalawyan
ck: the aril kan cones in the sense or that ocurs there arter karna ant lalata , the tort tenotink an ornanent. this tepars yat [4.3.5]. thus karnika an ear-rink, lalatika thy to te say tenotink an ornanent? Opserve karnyan that is in the ear, lalatyan
s: The affix कन् comes in the sense of 'what occurs there' after कर्ण and ललाट , the word denoting 'an ornament'. This debars यत् [[4.3.55]]. Thus कर्णिका 'an ear-ring', ललाटिका Why do we say 'denoting an ornament'? Observe कर्ण्यम् 'what is in the ear', ललाट्यम्

pk: arter the nane or a subject or conentary an aril cones in the sense or its conentary, as wel as in the sense or what ocurs there. That by which a thing is elplained is caled vyaKyana or conentary. The nane or a thing elplainable is caled vyaKyatavyanana arter such a nane, being in the 6th case in construction, the aril is aded. The aril neans tasyavyaKyanan as wel as tatraBava, the later being read into the sutra by virtue or ca Thus supan vyaKyana = sOpo granTa saupa, a bok on the elplanation or case-ariles. so also Tainga- a Conentary on Verbal ariles karta Karta- a Conentary on krit ariles. sOpa &c. nay also nean supsu Bavan &c. Why do we say vyaKyatavyanana arter the nane or the thing elplainable? The thing to be elplained nust be a Bok, thererore, the aril wil not aply to the nane or a city &c. ror elanple, ir a nodel be nade to describe the city or Pataliputra, such a nodel wil not be naned arter Pataliputra by the adition or aril. Thus sukosala is a nodal giving a description or Pataliputra. This wil not be caled Pataliputran. The anuvriti or Bava and vyaKyana runs sinultaneosly in al the subsequent apavada sutras, and hence we have read the anuvriti or Bava into this sutra also.
ck: arter the nane or a supcect or conentary an aril cones in the sense or its conentary, as tel as in the sense or that ocurs there. that py thich a think is elplainet is calet vyakyana or conentary. the nane or a think elplainaple is calet vyakyatavyanana arter such a nane, peink in the 6th case in construction, the aril is atet. the aril neans tasyavyakyanan as tel as tatrapava, the later peink reat into the sutra py virtue or ca thus supan vyakyana = sOpo kranta saupa, a pok on the elplanation or case-ariles. so also tainka- a conentary on Verpal ariles karta karta- a conentary on krit ariles. sOpa &c. nay also nean supsu pavan &c. thy to te say vyakyatavyanana arter the nane or the think elplainaple? the think to pe elplainet nust pe a pok, thererore, the aril til not aply to the nane or a city &c. ror elanple, ir a notel pe nate to tescripe the city or pataliputra, such a notel til not pe nanet arter pataliputra py the atition or aril. thus sukosala is a notal kivink a tescription or pataliputra. this til not pe calet pataliputran. the anuvriti or pava ant vyakyana runs sinultaneosly in al the supsetuent apavata sutras, ant hence te have reat the anuvriti or pava into this sutra also.
s: After the name of a subject of commentary an affix comes in the sense of 'its commentary', as well as in the sense of 'what occurs there'. That by which a thing is explained is called व्याख्यान or 'commentary'. The name of a thing explainable is called व्याख्यातव्यनाम After such a name, being in the 6th case in construction, the affix is added. The affix means तस्यव्याख्यानं as well as तत्रभव, the latter being read into the sutra by virtue of च Thus सुपां व्याख्यानः = सौपो ग्रन्थः 'Saupa, a book on the explanation of case-affixes'. So also 'Tainga-- a Commentary on Verbal affixes' कार्तः 'Karta-- a Commentary on krit affixes'. सौप &c. may also mean सुप्सु भवं &c. Why do we say व्याख्यातव्यनाम्नः 'after the name of the thing explainable'? The thing to be explained must be a Book, therefore, the affix will not apply to the name of a city &c. For example, if a model be made to describe the city of Pataliputra, such a model will not be named after Pataliputra by the addition of affix. Thus सुकोशला is a modal giving a description of Pataliputra. This will not be called Pataliputram. The anuvritti of भव and व्याख्यान runs simultaneosly in all the subsequent apavada sutras, and hence we have read the anuvritti of भव into this sutra also.

pk: The aril Wan cones in the sense or staying and a conentary arter a polysylabic word having udata on the rinal (the word being the nane or a thing to be elplained). This debars an Thus satvanatvikan a conentary or the rules or changes or sa and na into sa and na natanatikan a conentary on (anata) udata and anudata (nata) The radicals satvanatva and natanata are acutely acented on the rinal by the rule or a conpound having acent on the rinal [6.1.169] Why do we say bahvaca polysylabic? Observe sOpan, tEnan &c. a word or two sylables wil take Wak [4.3.72]. so the counter elanple nust be or words or one sylable. Why do we say having acute acent on the rinal? Observe sanhitan ron sanhita This word has acute acent on the initial by the rule or Gati-acent [6.2.49]
ck: the aril tan cones in the sense or stayink ant a conentary arter a polysylapic tort havink utata on the rinal (the tort peink the nane or a think to pe elplainet). this tepars an thus satvanatvikan a conentary or the rules or chankes or sa ant na into sa ant na natanatikan a conentary on (anata) utata ant anutata (nata) the raticals satvanatva ant natanata are acutely acentet on the rinal py the rule or a conpount havink acent on the rinal [6.1.169] thy to te say pahvaca polysylapic? Opserve sOpan, tEnan &c. a tort or to sylaples til take tak [4.3.72]. so the counter elanple nust pe or torts or one sylaple. thy to te say havink acute acent on the rinal? Opserve sanhitan ron sanhita this tort has acute acent on the initial py the rule or kati-acent [6.2.49]
s: The affix ठञ् comes in the sense of 'staying' and 'a commentary' after a polysyllabic word having उदात्त on the final (the word being the name of a thing to be explained). This debars अण् Thus षात्वणत्विकम् 'a commentary of the rules of changes of स and न into ष and ण' नातानतिकम् 'a commentary on (अनत) udatta and anudatta (नत)' The radicals षत्वणत्व and नतानत are acutely accented on the final by the rule of a compound having accent on the final [[6.1.169]] Why do we say बह्वचः 'polysyllabic'? Observe सौपम्, तैङम् &c. A word of two syllables will take ठक् [[4.3.72]]. So the counter example must be of words of one syllable. Why do we say 'having acute accent on the final'? Observe सांहितम् from संहिता This word has acute accent on the initial by the rule of Gati-accent [[6.2.49]]

pk: The aril Wan cones in the sense or ocuring and a conentary arter the nane or a work to be elplained provided that such work relates to a kratu or a yajna This debars an Kratu :- agniswonika a conentary on a work on aginshtona sacririces? vajapeyika, rajasuyika yajna:- pakayajnika, navayajnika This sutra rerers to words which are not antodata. The words vajapeya and rajasuya are acute in the nidle. The words kratu and yajna nean generaly the sane thing i.e. a sacririce, but the separate nention or yajna inplies that the rule aplies to yajnas other than sona-yajnas because the word kratu is technicaly aplied to sona-, sacririces only. Thus pancOdanika, dasOdanika The sutra is in the plural to prevent the aplication or the aril to the word-rorns kratu and yajna [1.1.68].
ck: the aril tan cones in the sense or ocurink ant a conentary arter the nane or a tork to pe elplainet provitet that such tork relates to a kratu or a yacna this tepars an kratu :- aknistonika a conentary on a tork on akinshtona sacririces? vacapeyika, racasuyika yacna:- pakayacnika, navayacnika this sutra rerers to torts thich are not antotata. the torts vacapeya ant racasuya are acute in the nitle. the torts kratu ant yacna nean keneraly the sane think i.e. a sacririce, put the separate nention or yacna inplies that the rule aplies to yacnas other than sona-yacnas pecause the tort kratu is technicaly apliet to sona-, sacririces only. thus pancOtanika, tasOtanika the sutra is in the plural to prevent the aplication or the aril to the tort-rorns kratu ant yacna [1.1.68].
s: The affix ठञ् comes in the sense of 'occurring' and 'a commentary' after the name of a work to be explained provided that such work relates to a क्रतु or a यज्ञ This debars अण् Kratu :- अग्निष्टोमिकः 'a commentary on a work on Aginshtoma sacrifices? वाजपेयिकः, राजसूयिकः yajna:- पाकयज्ञिकः, नावयज्ञिकः This sutra refers to words which are not antodatta. The words 'vajapeya' and 'rajasuya' are acute in the middle. The words क्रतु and यज्ञ mean generally the same thing i.e. 'a sacrifice', but the separate mention of यज्ञ implies that the rule applies to yajnas other than Soma-yajnas because the word 'kratu' is technically applied to Soma-, sacrifices only. Thus पाञ्चौदनिकः, दाशौदनिकः The sutra is in the plural to prevent the application of the affix to the word-forms 'kratu' and 'yajna' [[1.1.68]].

pk: The aril Wan cones arter the nane or an elplainable work caled arter a rsi in the senses or ocuring therein or conentary thereon when it rerers to an aDyaya only. The word rsi is the nane or pravara and those nishis are only neant whose nanes are in the Pravara list. The word so rorned neans always an adhyaya or Chapter or the work. The phrase vyaKyatavyanana is understod in this sutra, hence the word rsi neans "a work the author or which is a nishi". Thus vasisWasya vyaKyanastatra Bavo va = vasisWikoDyaya "Vasishthika- a chapter containing conentary on Vashishtha". vEsvanitrika a chapter or conentary on Visvanitra. Why do we say neaning chapter? Observe vasisWiki rk
ck: the aril tan cones arter the nane or an elplainaple tork calet arter a rsi in the senses or ocurink therein or conentary thereon then it rerers to an atyaya only. the tort rsi is the nane or pravara ant those nishis are only neant those nanes are in the pravara list. the tort so rornet neans altays an athyaya or chapter or the tork. the phrase vyakyatavyanana is unterstot in this sutra, hence the tort rsi neans "a tork the author or thich is a nishi". thus vasistasya vyakyanastatra pavo va = vasistikotyaya "Vasishthika- a chapter containink conentary on Vashishtha". vEsvanitrika a chapter or conentary on Visvanitra. thy to te say neanink chapter? Opserve vasistiki rk
s: The affix ठञ् comes after the name of an explainable work called after a ऋषि in the senses of 'occurring therein' or 'commentary thereon' when it refers to an अध्याय only. The word ऋषि is the name of प्रवर and those Rishis are only meant whose names are in the Pravara list. The word so formed means always an Adhyaya or Chapter of the work. The phrase व्याख्यातव्यनाम्नः is understood in this sutra, hence the word ऋषि means "a work the author of which is a Rishi". Thus वसिष्ठस्य व्याख्यानस्तत्र भवो वा = वासिष्ठिकोऽध्यायः "Vasishthika- a chapter containing commentary on Vashishtha". वैश्वामित्रिकः 'a chapter of commentary on Visvamitra'. Why do we say meaning 'chapter'? Observe वासिष्ठिकी ऋक्

pk: The aril sWan cones in the sense or ocuring therein and conentary thereon arter the words 1. pOroqasa and 2. puroqasa The verses on the purirication &c or Purodasa a sacred cake, are caled pOroqasa, the conentary on such paurodasa nantras wil be caled pOroqasika. its reninine wil be pOroqasiki [4.1.41]. a bok on Purodasa cake is caled puroqasa; a conentary there on wil be puroqasika r. puroqasiki [4.1.41] The sa or the aril indicates that the reninine is rorned by nis [4.1.41]. The conentary here rerers to the nantras or verses relating to Purodasa, and not to the sacririce.
ck: the aril stan cones in the sense or ocurink therein ant conentary thereon arter the torts 1. pOrotasa ant 2. purotasa the verses on the purirication &c or purotasa a sacret cake, are calet pOrotasa, the conentary on such paurotasa nantras til pe calet pOrotasika. its reninine til pe pOrotasiki [4.1.41]. a pok on purotasa cake is calet purotasa; a conentary there on til pe purotasika r. purotasiki [4.1.41] the sa or the aril inticates that the reninine is rornet py nis [4.1.41]. the conentary here rerers to the nantras or verses relatink to purotasa, ant not to the sacririce.
s: The affix ष्ठन् comes in the sense of 'occurring therein' and 'commentary thereon' after the words 1. पौरोडाश and 2. पुरोडाश The verses on the purification &c of Purodasa 'a sacred cake', are called पौरोडाश, the commentary on such paurodasa mantras will be called पौरोडाशिकः. Its feminine will be पौरोडाशिकी [[4.1.41]]. A book on Purodasa cake is called पुरोडाश; a commentary there on will be पुरोडाशिकः f. पुरोडाशिकी [[4.1.41]] The ष of the affix indicates that the feminine is formed by ङीष् [[4.1.41]]. The commentary here refers to the 'mantras' or verses relating to Purodasa, and not to the sacrifice.

pk: The ariles yat and an cones in the sense or ocuring therein or conentary thereon arter the word Candas This debars Wak or the rolowing sutra. as Candasya or Candasa
ck: the ariles yat ant an cones in the sense or ocurink therein or conentary thereon arter the tort cantas this tepars tak or the rolotink sutra. as cantasya or cantasa
s: The affixes यत् and अण् comes in the sense of 'occurring therein' or 'commentary thereon' after the word छन्दस् This debars ठक् of the following sutra. As छन्दस्यः or छान्दसः

pk: The aril Wak cones in the sense or ocuring therein or conentary thereon arter a word or two sylables and a word ending in short r and the words 1. brahnana 2. rk 3. praTana 4. purascarana 5. nana 6. aKyata and 7. nanaKyata being the nanes or elplainable works. This debars an and Wan i.Disylabic:- Eswika, pasuka 2. Ending in r :- caturhotrka, pancahotrka so also brahnanika, arcika, praTanika, aDvarika, pOrascaranika, nanika, aKyatika, nanaKyatika
ck: the aril tak cones in the sense or ocurink therein or conentary thereon arter a tort or to sylaples ant a tort entink in short r ant the torts 1. prahnana 2. rk 3. pratana 4. purascarana 5. nana 6. akyata ant 7. nanakyata peink the nanes or elplainaple torks. this tepars an ant tan i.tisylapic:- Estika, pasuka 2. Entink in r :- caturhotrka, pancahotrka so also prahnanika, arcika, pratanika, atvarika, pOrascaranika, nanika, akyatika, nanakyatika
s: The affix ठक् comes in the sense of 'occurring therein' or 'commentary thereon' after a word of two syllables and a word ending in short ऋ and the words 1. ब्राह्मण 2. ऋक् 3. प्रथम 4. पुरश्चरण 5. नाम 6. आख्यात and 7. नामाख्यात being the names of explainable works. This debars अण् and ठञ् I.Dissyllabic:- ऐष्टिकः, पाशुकः 2. Ending in ऋ :- चातुर्होतृकः, पांचहोतृकः So also ब्राह्मणिकः, आर्चिकः, प्राथमिकः, आध्वरिकः, पौरश्चरणिकः, नामिकः, आख्यातिकः, नामाख्यातिकः

pk: The aril an cones in the senses or ocuring therein and conentary thereon arter the words rgayana etc. This debars Wan, Wak and Ca argayana, padavyaKyana The repetition or an in the sutra, though the anuvriti or this aril was coning ron berore, is ror the sake or preventing the aplication or any subsequent apavada rule to the words in this list. Thus vastuvidya 1 rgayana, 2 padavyaKyana, 3 Candonana, 4 CandoBasa, 5 Candoviciti, 6 nyaya, 7 punarukta, 8 nirukta, 9 vyakarana, 10 nigana, 1 vastuvidya, 12 ksatravidya, 13 angavidya, 14 vidya, 15 utpata, 16 utpada, 17 udyava, 18 sanvatsara, 19 nuhurta, 20 upanisad 21 ninita, 2 siksa, 23 Biksa, 24 CandoviCiti 25 vyaya
ck: the aril an cones in the senses or ocurink therein ant conentary thereon arter the torts rkayana etc. this tepars tan, tak ant ca arkayana, patavyakyana the repetition or an in the sutra, thoukh the anuvriti or this aril tas conink ron perore, is ror the sake or preventink the aplication or any supsetuent apavata rule to the torts in this list. thus vastuvitya 1 rkayana, 2 patavyakyana, 3 cantonana, 4 cantopasa, 5 cantoviciti, 6 nyaya, 7 punarukta, 8 nirukta, 9 vyakarana, 10 nikana, 1 vastuvitya, 12 ksatravitya, 13 ankavitya, 14 vitya, 15 utpata, 16 utpata, 17 utyava, 18 sanvatsara, 19 nuhurta, 20 upanisat 21 ninita, 2 siksa, 23 piksa, 24 cantoviciti 25 vyaya
s: The affix अण् comes in the senses of 'occurring therein' and 'commentary thereon' after the words ऋगयन etc. This debars ठञ्, ठक् and छ आर्गयनः, पादव्याख्यानः The repetition of अण् in the sutra, though the anuvritti of this affix was coming from before, is for the sake of preventing the application of any subsequent apavada rule to the words in this list. Thus वास्तुविद्यः 1 ऋगयन, 2 पदव्याख्यान, 3 छन्दोमान, 4 छन्दोभाषा, 5 छन्दोविचिति, 6 न्याय, 7 पुनरुक्त, 8 निरुक्त, 9 व्याकारण, 10 निगम, 11 वास्तुविद्या, 12 क्षत्रविद्या, 13 अङ्गविद्या, 14 विद्या, 15 उत्पात, 16 उत्पाद, 17 उद्याव, 18 संवत्सर, 19 मुहूर्त, 20 उपनिषद् 21 निमित्त, 22 शिक्षा, 23 भिक्षा, 24 छन्दोविछिती 25 व्याय

pk: The aril - pragdivyaton [4.1.83] etc. cones in the sense or what has cone thence. Thus sruGnadagata srOGna what has cone ron srughna. naTura, raswriya
ck: the aril - praktivyaton [4.1.83] etc. cones in the sense or that has cone thence. thus sruknatakata srOkna that has cone ron srukhna. natura, rastriya
s: The affix -- प्राग्दीव्यतोऽण् [[4.1.83]] etc. comes in the sense of 'what has come thence'. Thus स्रुघ्नादागतः स्रौघ्नः 'what has come from Srughna'. माथुरः, राष्ट्रियः

pk: arter a word denoting sources or revenue there is the aril Wak in the sense or cone thence. The word aya neans what is the share apropriated by the lord. The source or aya is caled ayasTana This debars an and Ca Thus sOlkasalika what is derived ron custon house. akarikan revenue derived ron nines. The plural in the sutra prevents svarupavidhi [1.1.68].
ck: arter a tort tenotink sources or revenue there is the aril tak in the sense or cone thence. the tort aya neans that is the share apropriatet py the lort. the source or aya is calet ayastana this tepars an ant ca thus sOlkasalika that is terivet ron custon house. akarikan revenue terivet ron nines. the plural in the sutra prevents svarupavithi [1.1.68].
s: After a word denoting sources of revenue there is the affix ठक् in the sense of 'come thence'. The word आय means what is the share appropriated by the lord. The source of आय is called आयस्थान This debars अण् and छ Thus शौल्कशालिकः 'what is derived from custom house'. आकरिकम् 'revenue derived from mines'. The plural in the sutra prevents Svarupavidhi [[1.1.68]].

pk: The aril an cones in the sense or thence cone arter the words sunqika etc. This debars Wak Thus sOnqika elcise-revenue. karkana The repetition or an serves the sane purpose as in [4.3.73], baDakabaDanarTan as Odapana 1 sunqika, 2 krkana, 3 sTanqila, 4 udapana, 5 upala, 6 tirTa, 7 Buni, 8 trna, 9 parna
ck: the aril an cones in the sense or thence cone arter the torts suntika etc. this tepars tak thus sOntika elcise-revenue. karkana the repetition or an serves the sane purpose as in [4.3.73], patakapatanartan as Otapana 1 suntika, 2 krkana, 3 stantila, 4 utapana, 5 upala, 6 tirta, 7 puni, 8 trna, 9 parna
s: The affix अण् comes in the sense of 'thence come' after the words शुण्डिक etc. This debars ठक् Thus शौण्डिकः 'excise-revenue'. कार्कणः The repetition of अण् serves the same purpose as in [[4.3.73]], बाधकबाधनार्थम् As औदपानः 1 शुण्डिक, 2 कृकण, 3 स्थण्डिल, 4 उदपान, 5 उपल, 6 तीर्थ, 7 भूमि, 8 तृण, 9 पर्ण

pk: The aril vun cones in the sense or thence cone arter a word denoting a person conected through the relationship or ranily origin. Persons related (sanbandha) through learning (such as teacher and pupil), or through blod (yoni, e. g. rather and son) are caled vidyayonisanbanDa Words denoting such persons take the aril vun. This debars an and Ca. Thus upaDyayadagatan = OpaDyayakan knowledge derived ron a spiritual teacher. sEsyakan, acaryakan so also yonisanbanDa as natanahaka wealth derived ron a naternal grand-rather. pitanahaka, natulaka
ck: the aril vun cones in the sense or thence cone arter a tort tenotink a person conectet throukh the relationship or ranily orikin. persons relatet (sanpantha) throukh learnink (such as teacher ant pupil), or throukh plot (yoni, e. k. rather ant son) are calet vityayonisanpanta torts tenotink such persons take the aril vun. this tepars an ant ca. thus upatyayatakatan = Opatyayakan knotletke terivet ron a spiritual teacher. sEsyakan, acaryakan so also yonisanpanta as natanahaka tealth terivet ron a naternal krant-rather. pitanahaka, natulaka
s: The affix वुञ् comes in the sense of 'thence come' after a word denoting a person connected through the relationship or family origin.
