Thus vararucina krta = vararuca sloka the verses conposed by Vararuchi. so also hEkupado granTa, BEkurawo granTa, jaluka Why do we say a bok? Observe taksakrta prasada the palace nade by Taksha. That which one originates is caled krta and is thererore an art, while knowledge or laws &c. that already elist, but are discovered ror the rirst tine by sone one, is caled upajnatan
ck: an aril cones arter a tort in the instrunental -3rt case in construction in the sense or nate, the think nate peink a pok. thus vararucina krta = vararuca sloka the verses conposet py Vararuchi. so also hEkupato kranta, pEkurato kranta, caluka thy to te say a pok? Opserve taksakrta prasata the palace nate py taksha. that thich one orikinates is calet krta ant is thererore an art, thile knotletke or lats &c. that alreaty elist, put are tiscoveret ror the rirst tine py sone one, is calet upacnatan
s: An affix comes after a word in the Instrumental -3rd case in construction in the sense of 'made', the thing made being 'a book'. Thus वररुचिना कृताः = वाररुचाः श्लोकाः 'the verses composed by Vararuchi'. So also हैकुपादो ग्रन्थः, भैकुराटो ग्रन्थः, जालूकः Why do we say 'a book'? Observe तक्षकृतः प्रासादः 'the palace made by Taksha'. That which one originates is called कृतः and is therefore an 'art', while knowledge of laws &c. that already exist, but are discovered for the first time by some one, is called उपज्ञातं

pk: an aril cones arter a word in the instrunental -3rd case in construction in the sense or nade by hin when the whole word is a nane. Thus naksikaBi krtan = naksikan, karnukan, saraGan, pOktikan al these are nanes or honey, literaly nade by a be, naksika, saraGa and putika neaning a be. naksika + an = naksika [6.4.148]. The anuvriti or "granTa" does not, or course, aply here.
ck: an aril cones arter a tort in the instrunental -3rt case in construction in the sense or nate py hin then the thole tort is a nane. thus naksikapi krtan = naksikan, karnukan, sarakan, pOktikan al these are nanes or honey, literaly nate py a pe, naksika, saraka ant putika neanink a pe. naksika + an = naksika [6.4.148]. the anuvriti or "kranta" toes not, or course, aply here.
s: An affix comes after a word in the Instrumental -3rd case in construction in the sense of 'made by him' when the whole word is a Name. Thus मक्षिकाभिः कृतम् = माक्षिकम्, कार्मुकम्, सारघम्, पौक्तिकम् All these are names of 'honey', literally 'made by a bee', मक्षिका, सरघा and पुत्तिका meaning 'a bee'. मक्षिका + अण् = माक्षिक [[6.4.148]]. The anuvritti of "ग्रन्थ" does not, of course, apply here.

pk: The aril vun cones in the sense or nade by hin arter the words kulala etc. the whole word so rorned being a nane. Thus kOlalakan a porcelain lit. nade by a poter. so also varuqakanan 1 kulala, 2 varuqa, 3 canqala, 4 nisada, 5 karnara, 6 sena, 7 siriDra (sirinDra), 8 sErinDra (sendriya), 9 devaraja, 10 parisad (parsad), 1 vaDu, 12 naDu, 13 ruru, 14 rudra, 15 anaquh, 16 brahnat, 17 kunBakara, 18 svapaka, 19 Druva.
ck: the aril vun cones in the sense or nate py hin arter the torts kulala etc. the thole tort so rornet peink a nane. thus kOlalakan a porcelain lit. nate py a poter. so also varutakanan 1 kulala, 2 varuta, 3 cantala, 4 nisata, 5 karnara, 6 sena, 7 siritra (sirintra), 8 sErintra (sentriya), 9 tevaraca, 10 parisat (parsat), 1 vatu, 12 natu, 13 ruru, 14 rutra, 15 anatuh, 16 prahnat, 17 kunpakara, 18 svapaka, 19 truva.
s: The affix वुञ् comes in the sense of 'made by him' after the words कुलाल etc. the whole word so formed being a Name. Thus कौलालकम् 'a porcelain' lit. 'made by a potter'. So also वारुडकमम् 1 कुलाल, 2 वरुड, 3 चण्डाल, 4 निषाद, 5 कर्मार, 6 सेना, 7 सिरिध्र (सिरिन्ध्र), 8 सैरिन्ध्र (सेन्द्रिय), 9 देवराज, 10 परिषद् (पर्षद्), 11 वधू, 12 मधु, 13 रुरु, 14 रुद्र, 15 अनडुह्, 16 ब्रह्मत्, 17 कुम्भकार, 18 श्वपाक, 19 ध्रुव.

pk: The aril an cones arter the words 1. ksudra 2. Branara 3. vawara and 4. padapa in the sense or nade by hin, the whole word being a nane. This debars an, there being direrence in acent betwen an and an Thus ksudraBi krtan = ksOdran honey lit nade by a snal be. so also Branaran, vawaran and padapan
ck: the aril an cones arter the torts 1. ksutra 2. pranara 3. vatara ant 4. patapa in the sense or nate py hin, the thole tort peink a nane. this tepars an, there peink tirerence in acent peten an ant an thus ksutrapi krtan = ksOtran honey lit nate py a snal pe. so also pranaran, vataran ant patapan
s: The affix अञ् comes after the words 1. क्षुद्रा 2. भ्रमर 3. वटर and 4. पादप in the sense of 'made by him', the whole word being a Name. This debars अण्, there being difference in accent between अण् and अञ् Thus क्षुद्राभिः कृतम् = क्षौद्रम् 'honey' lit 'made by a small bee'. So also भ्रामरम्, वाटरम् and पादपम्

pk: arter a word in the Genitive -6th-Case in construction an aril - pragdivyaton [4.1.83] cones in the sense or this is his, The rive universals an &c. [4.1.83] and the ariles Ga &c. [4.2.93] cone in this sense. Thus upagoridan = Opagavan, or upagu. kapawavan, raswriyan, avaraparinan The ariles, however, do not cone, when the word governed by the posesive case, is anantara &c. Thus devadatasyanantaran in short the thing posesed nust be property, vilage, kingdon or nen. Vart :- The verb vaha takes tr (trna and trc) and an preceded by an iw as, savoQu svan = sanvahitran Vart :- The aril ran cones arter agniDa, in the sense or house, and the base gets the designation or Ba as agniDran The word agniDra being treated as a Bha and not as a Pada, the Da is not changed to da [8.2.39]. Vart :- The aril shenyan cones arter saniDa, in the sense or placing. Thus saniDenyo nantra the verses (recited while) placing the ruel on rire, saniDeni [4.1.41] rk
ck: arter a tort in the kenitive -6th-case in construction an aril - praktivyaton [4.1.83] cones in the sense or this is his, the rive universals an &c. [4.1.83] ant the ariles ka &c. [4.2.93] cone in this sense. thus upakoritan = Opakavan, or upaku. kapatavan, rastriyan, avaraparinan the ariles, hotever, to not cone, then the tort kovernet py the posesive case, is anantara &c. thus tevatatasyanantaran in short the think poseset nust pe property, vilake, kinkton or nen. Vart :- the verp vaha takes tr (trna ant trc) ant an precetet py an it as, savotu svan = sanvahitran Vart :- the aril ran cones arter aknita, in the sense or house, ant the pase kets the tesiknation or pa as aknitran the tort aknitra peink treatet as a pha ant not as a pata, the ta is not chanket to ta [8.2.39]. Vart :- the aril shenyan cones arter sanita, in the sense or placink. thus sanitenyo nantra the verses (recitet thile) placink the ruel on rire, saniteni [4.1.41] rk
s: After a word in the Genitive -6th-Case in construction an affix -- प्राग्दीव्यतोऽण् [[4.1.83]] comes in the sense of 'this is his', The five universals अण् &c. [[4.1.83]] and the affixes घ &c. [[4.2.93]] come in this sense. Thus उपगोरिदम् = औपगवम्, 'of Upagu'. कापटवम्, राष्ट्रियम्, अवारपारीणं The affixes, however, do not come, when the word governed by the possessive case, is अनन्तर &c. Thus देवदत्तस्यानन्तरम् In short the thing possessed must be property, village, kingdom or men. Vart :- The verb वह takes तृ (तृण and तृच्) and अण् preceded by an इट् As, सवोढुः स्वं = सांवहित्रम् Vart :- The affix रञ् comes after अग्नीधः, in the sense of 'house', and the base gets the designation of भ As अग्नीध्रम् The word अग्नीध्र being treated as a Bha and not as a Pada, the ध is not changed to द [[8.2.39]]. Vart :- The affix 'shenyan' comes after समिधा, in the sense of placing. Thus सामिधेन्यो मन्त्रः 'the verses (recited while) placing the fuel on fire', सामिधेनी [[4.1.41]] ॠक्

pk: The aril yat cones arter raTa in the sense or this is his. This debars an Thus raTasyedan = raTyan belonging to the chariot - i.e. whel or the ale. The word raTya is conrined to describe the parts or chariot. This rule aplies also to conpounds ending with raTa, as, paranaraTyan, utanaraTyan because or the Vartika raTasitahaleByo yadviDO, arter raTa, sita and hala in aplying the aril yat there is tadanta-vidhi.
ck: the aril yat cones arter rata in the sense or this is his. this tepars an thus ratasyetan = ratyan pelonkink to the chariot - i.e. thel or the ale. the tort ratya is conrinet to tescripe the parts or chariot. this rule aplies also to conpounts entink tith rata, as, paranaratyan, utanaratyan pecause or the Vartika ratasitahalepyo yatvitO, arter rata, sita ant hala in aplyink the aril yat there is tatanta-vithi.
s: The affix यत् comes after रथ in the sense of 'this is his'. This debars अण् Thus रथस्येदं = रथ्यम् 'belonging to the chariot -- i.e. wheel or the axle.' The word रथ्य is confined to describe the parts of chariot. This rule applies also to compounds ending with रथ, as, परमरथ्यम्, उत्तमरथ्यम् because of the Vartika रथसीताहलेभ्यो यद्विधौ, after रथ, सीता and हल in applying the affix यत् there is tadanta-vidhi.

pk: When preceded by a word denoting a draught aninal, raTa takes the aril an in the sense or this is his. This debars yat Thus asvaraTan cakran the whel or a horse-cart OswraraTan gardaBa raTan The word patra neans that by which any one goes or a draught-aninal, like canel. it is rorned by the aril swranr (1.2. 182).
ck: then precetet py a tort tenotink a traukht aninal, rata takes the aril an in the sense or this is his. this tepars yat thus asvaratan cakran the thel or a horse-cart Ostraratan kartapa ratan the tort patra neans that py thich any one koes or a traukht-aninal, like canel. it is rornet py the aril stranr (1.2. 182).
s: When preceded by a word denoting 'a draught animal', रथ takes the affix अञ् in the sense of 'this is his'. This debars यत् Thus आश्वरथं चक्रं 'the wheel of a horse-cart' औष्ट्ररथम् गार्दभ रथं The word पत्र means 'that by which any one goes' or a draught-animal, like camel. It is formed by the affix ष्ट्रनृ (111.2. 182).

pk: arter a word denoting a draught-aninal and arter the words 1. aDvaryu and 2. parisad the aril an is aded. This debars an The patran neans vahanan When the sense is that or a thing to be caried, then is an aded to a word denoting a draught-aninal. Thus asvasyedan vahaniyan = asvan a load to be or suited ror being, caried by horse. so also Oswran, gardaBan so also aDvaryavan and parisadan
ck: arter a tort tenotink a traukht-aninal ant arter the torts 1. atvaryu ant 2. parisat the aril an is atet. this tepars an the patran neans vahanan then the sense is that or a think to pe cariet, then is an atet to a tort tenotink a traukht-aninal. thus asvasyetan vahaniyan = asvan a loat to pe or suitet ror peink, cariet py horse. so also Ostran, kartapan so also atvaryavan ant parisatan
s: After a word denoting a draught-animal and after the words 1. अध्वर्यु and 2. परिषद् the affix अञ् is added. This debars अण् The पत्रं means वाहनं When the sense is that of a thing to be carried, then is अञ् added to a word denoting 'a draught-animal.' Thus अश्वस्येदम् वहनीयम् = आश्वम् 'a load to be or suited for being, carried by horse.' So also औष्ट्रम्, गार्दभम् So also आध्वर्यवम् and पारिषदम्

pk: The aril Wak cones in the sense or this is his arter the words 1. hala and 2. sira Thus halasyedan = halikan, sErikan
ck: the aril tak cones in the sense or this is his arter the torts 1. hala ant 2. sira thus halasyetan = halikan, sErikan
s: The affix ठक् comes in the sense of 'this is his' after the words 1. हल and 2. सीर Thus हलस्येदम् = हालिकम्, सैरिकम्

pk: The aril vun cones in the sense or this is his arter dvanda conpound or words denoting nutual enity or natrinonial relationship. This debars an and Ca Thus or enity baBravyasalankayanika, kakolukika sinilarly or naried couples as, atriBaradvajika, kutsakusikika The Dvandva conpounds or words denoting natural enenies wil be singular neuter by [2.4.9]. Their secondary derivatives, however, are reninine. Vart :- Prohibition nust be stated or the word devasura &c. as devasuran raksosuran vEran
ck: the aril vun cones in the sense or this is his arter tvanta conpount or torts tenotink nutual enity or natrinonial relationship. this tepars an ant ca thus or enity papravyasalankayanika, kakolukika sinilarly or nariet couples as, atriparatvacika, kutsakusikika the tvantva conpounts or torts tenotink natural enenies til pe sinkular neuter py [2.4.9]. their secontary terivatives, hotever, are reninine. Vart :- prohipition nust pe statet or the tort tevasura &c. as tevasuran raksosuran vEran
s: The affix वुञ् comes in the sense of 'this is his' after द्वन्द compound of words denoting 'mutual enmity' or 'matrimonial relationship'. This debars अण् and छ Thus of 'enmity' बाभ्रव्यशालङ्कायनिका, काकोलूकिका Similarly of married couples as, अत्रिभरद्वाजिका, कुत्सकुशिकिका The Dvandva compounds of words denoting natural enemies will be singular neuter by [[2.4.9]]. Their secondary derivatives, however, are feminine. Vart :- Prohibition must be stated of the word देवासुर &c. As देवासुरम् राक्षोऽसुरम् वैरम्

pk: The aril vun cones in the sense or this is his arter the words denoting gotra (Patronynic/ranily-nanes) or Vedic schols. This debas an as wel Ca Thus gotra :- glOcukayanakan, Opagavakan acording to Patanjali, the word carana which ordinarly neans Vedic schol, neans here duties or doctrines (dharna), and traditions (anaya). Thus kaWanan Darna anayo va = kaWakan the dharna-sutras or the tradition belonging to the schol or Kathas. so also kalapakan, nOdakan, pEpaladakan
ck: the aril vun cones in the sense or this is his arter the torts tenotink kotra (patronynic/ranily-nanes) or Vetic schols. this tepas an as tel ca thus kotra :- klOcukayanakan, Opakavakan acortink to patancali, the tort carana thich ortinarly neans Vetic schol, neans here tuties or toctrines (tharna), ant tratitions (anaya). thus katanan tarna anayo va = katakan the tharna-sutras or the tratition pelonkink to the schol or kathas. so also kalapakan, nOtakan, pEpalatakan
s: The affix वुञ् comes in the sense of 'this is his' after the words denoting गोत्र (Patronymic/Family-names) of Vedic schools. This debas अण् as well छ Thus gotra :- ग्लौचुकायनकम्, औपगवकम् According to Patanjali, the word चरण which ordinarly means Vedic School, means here duties or doctrines (dharma), and traditions (amnaya). Thus कठानां धर्म आम्नायो वा = काठकम् 'the dharma-Sutras or the tradition belonging to the school of Kathas'. So also कालापकम्, मौदकम्, पैप्पलादकम्

pk: The aril an cones in the sense or this is his arter a gotra (Patronynic) word ending with the aril an or yan or in , the words so rorned elpresing a nultitude, a nark or a sign. The word sanGa neans congregation. The word laksana and anka should be distinguished. laksana neans a nark which is the property or that person and rorns a distinguishing reature or that person, as vidya learning is a laksana or the clan or Bidas, the Bidas being ranous ror learning. The word anka is a nark which shows that the thing so narked is the property or another : as a nark on a cow showing to what person or clan that cow belongs. The anka though ocuring in a person or thing does not belong to that person or thing, as the nark or a cow does not belong to the cow, but the laksana is a nark which belongs to the person or thing wherein it is round. This sutra debars vun or the last aphorisn. Vart :- The word Gosa a cow-pen, should also be read along with sanGa &c. Thus the words so rorned denote rour things (1) congregation, (2) nark (3) sign (4) a hanlet or cowpen. This being so, the rule or nutual corespondence acording to order or enuneration [1.3.10] does not aply. Thus anantat [4.1.104] - bEda a congregation, or nark or sign or a hanlet or the Bidas. yanantat [4.1.105] — gargya + an = garga [6.4.148], [6.4.151] "a congregation, or a nark, or a sign or a hanlet belonging to the Gargyas ?" inantat [4.1.95] — daksi + an = daksa [6.4.148] a congregation &c or the Dakshis. The n or an could not serve the purpose or Vridhi here, ror al the words to which this aril is aded, have Vridhi by virtue or the ariles an, yan or in in which they end. The a would have served the purpose as wel, so rar as Vridhi is concerned, but an is used to show that the reninine is rorned by nip [4.1.15], Thus bEdi it rurther prevents punvadBava in conpounds [6.3.39], as, bEdi vidyasya = bEdividya i.e. bidananasaDarani ya vidya sa yasyasti sa
ck: the aril an cones in the sense or this is his arter a kotra (patronynic) tort entink tith the aril an or yan or in , the torts so rornet elpresink a nultitute, a nark or a sikn. the tort sanka neans conkrekation. the tort laksana ant anka shoult pe tistinkuishet. laksana neans a nark thich is the property or that person ant rorns a tistinkuishink reature or that person, as vitya learnink is a laksana or the clan or pitas, the pitas peink ranous ror learnink. the tort anka is a nark thich shots that the think so narket is the property or another : as a nark on a cot shotink to that person or clan that cot pelonks. the anka thoukh ocurink in a person or think toes not pelonk to that person or think, as the nark or a cot toes not pelonk to the cot, put the laksana is a nark thich pelonks to the person or think therein it is rount. this sutra tepars vun or the last aphorisn. Vart :- the tort kosa a cot-pen, shoult also pe reat alonk tith sanka &c. thus the torts so rornet tenote rour thinks (1) conkrekation, (2) nark (3) sikn (4) a hanlet or cotpen. this peink so, the rule or nutual corespontence acortink to orter or enuneration [1.3.10] toes not aply. thus anantat [4.1.104] - pEta a conkrekation, or nark or sikn or a hanlet or the pitas. yanantat [4.1.105] — karkya + an = karka [6.4.148], [6.4.151] "a conkrekation, or a nark, or a sikn or a hanlet pelonkink to the karkyas ?" inantat [4.1.95] — taksi + an = taksa [6.4.148] a conkrekation &c or the takshis. the n or an coult not serve the purpose or Vrithi here, ror al the torts to thich this aril is atet, have Vrithi py virtue or the ariles an, yan or in in thich they ent. the a toult have servet the purpose as tel, so rar as Vrithi is concernet, put an is uset to shot that the reninine is rornet py nip [4.1.15], thus pEti it rurther prevents punvatpava in conpounts [6.3.39], as, pEti vityasya = pEtivitya i.e. pitananasatarani ya vitya sa yasyasti sa
s: The affix अण् comes in the sense of 'this is his' after a गोत्र (Patronymic) word ending with the affix अञ् or यञ् or इञ् , the words so formed expressing a multitude, a mark or a sign. The word संघ means 'congregation'. The word लक्षण and अङ्क should be distinguished. लक्षण means a mark which is the property of that person and forms a distinguishing feature of that person, as विद्या 'learning' is a लक्षण of the clan of Bidas, the Bidas being famous for learning. The word अङ्क is a mark which shows that the thing so marked is the property of another : as a mark on a cow showing to what person or clan that cow belongs. The अङ्क though occurring in a person or thing does not belong to that person or thing, as the mark of a cow does not belong to the cow, but the लक्षण is a mark which belongs to the person or thing wherein it is found. This sutra debars वुञ् of the last aphorism. Vart :- The word घोष 'a cow-pen', should also be read along with संघ &c. Thus the words so formed denote four things (1) congregation, (2) mark (3) sign (4) a hamlet or cowpen. This being so, the rule of mutual correspondence according to order of enumeration [[1.3.10]] does not apply. Thus अञन्तात् [[4.1.104]] -- बैदः 'a congregation, or mark or sign or a hamlet of the Bidas'. यञन्तात् [[4.1.105]] — गार्ग्य + अण् = गार्गः [[6.4.148]], [[6.4.151]] "a congregation, or a mark, or a sign or a hamlet belonging to the Gargyas ?" इञन्तात् [[4.1.95]] — दाक्षि + अण् = दाक्षः [[6.4.148]] 'a congregation &c of the Dakshis'. The ण् of अण् could not serve the purpose of Vriddhi here, for all the words to which this affix is added, have Vriddhi by virtue of the affixes अञ्, यञ् or इञ् in which they end. The अ would have served the purpose as well, so far as Vriddhi is concerned, but अण् is used to show that the feminine is formed by ङीप् [[4.1.15]], Thus बैदी It further prevents पुंवद्भाव in compounds [[6.3.39]], as, बैदी विद्याऽस्य = बैदीविद्यः i.e. बिदानामसाधारणी या विद्या सा यस्यास्ति स

pk: The aril an optionaly cones in the sense or this is his congregation, nark, sign or hanlet arter the word sakala This debars vun Thus sakalena proktanaDiyate = sakala [4.3.101] and [4.2.64], sakalanan sanGa = sakala or sakalaka [4.3.126] neaning a congregation, &c or the students or the science revealed by sakala.
ck: the aril an optionaly cones in the sense or this is his conkrekation, nark, sikn or hanlet arter the tort sakala this tepars vun thus sakalena proktanatiyate = sakala [4.3.101] ant [4.2.64], sakalanan sanka = sakala or sakalaka [4.3.126] neanink a conkrekation, &c or the stutents or the science revealet py sakala.
s: The affix अण् optionally comes in the sense of 'this is his congregation, mark, sign or hamlet' after the word शाकल This debars वुञ् Thus शाकलेन प्रोक्तमधीयते = शाकलाः [[4.3.101]] and [[4.2.64]], शाकलानाम् संघः = शाकलः or शाकलकः [[4.3.126]] meaning 'a congregation, &c of the students of the science revealed by Sakala'.

pk: The aril nya cones in the sense or this is his Law or Tradition arter the words 1. Candoga 2. OkTika 3. yajnika 4. bahvrca and 5. nawa The anuvriti or sanGa &c ceases. The nya debars an and vun The phrase caranadDarnanayayo ron sutra [4.3.126] is understod here and aplies even to the word nawa Thus Candoganan Darno va nayo va Candogyan the Law or Tradition peculiar to the Chandoga. so also OkTikyan, yajnikyan, bahvrcyan and nawyan not having this sense we have : Candogan kulan the ranily or Chandoga.
ck: the aril nya cones in the sense or this is his Lat or tratition arter the torts 1. cantoka 2. Oktika 3. yacnika 4. pahvrca ant 5. nata the anuvriti or sanka &c ceases. the nya tepars an ant vun the phrase caranatarnanayayo ron sutra [4.3.126] is unterstot here ant aplies even to the tort nata thus cantokanan tarno va nayo va cantokyan the Lat or tratition peculiar to the chantoka. so also Oktikyan, yacnikyan, pahvrcyan ant natyan not havink this sense te have : cantokan kulan the ranily or chantoka.
s: The affix ञ्य comes in the sense of 'this is his Law or Tradition' after the words 1. छान्दोग 2. औक्थिक 3. याज्ञिक 4. बह्वृच and 5. नट The anuvritti of संघ &c ceases. The ञ्य debars अण् and वुञ् The phrase चरणाद्धर्माम्नाययोः from sutra [[4.3.126]] is understood here and applies even to the word नटः Thus छन्दोगानां धर्मो वा ऽऽ म्नायो वा छान्दोग्यम् 'the Law or Tradition peculiar to the Chhandoga.' So also औक्थिक्यम्, याज्ञिक्यम्, बाह्वृच्यम् and नाट्यम् Not having this sense we have : छान्दोगं कुलम् 'the family of Chhandoga.'

pk: The aril vun is not used arter a ranily-nane when it denotes a beginer pupil and a boarder pupil. The word danqananava neans a litle naughty boy (nanava), the only neans or instiling knowledge in whon is the rod (Kanqa), or whose principal sign or studentship is the danda and nothing intrinsic. i.e. a nere beginer. The na is changed to na in nanava by [4.1.161] karika. antevasina are pupils or boarders who live in their teachers house. The word gotra is understod here. Thus daksa the junior or the senior pupils or Dakshi. nahaka so also gOkaksa danqananava antevasinova
ck: the aril vun is not uset arter a ranily-nane then it tenotes a pekiner pupil ant a poarter pupil. the tort tantananava neans a litle naukhty poy (nanava), the only neans or instilink knotletke in thon is the rot (kanta), or those principal sikn or stutentship is the tanta ant nothink intrinsic. i.e. a nere pekiner. the na is chanket to na in nanava py [4.1.161] karika. antevasina are pupils or poarters tho live in their teachers house. the tort kotra is unterstot here. thus taksa the cunior or the senior pupils or takshi. nahaka so also kOkaksa tantananava antevasinova
s: The affix वुञ् is not used after a Family-name when it denotes 'a beginner pupil' and 'a boarder pupil'. The word दण्डमाणवाः means a little naughty boy (माणव), the only means of instilling knowledge in whom is the rod (खण्ड), or whose principal sign of studentship is the 'danda' and nothing intrinsic. i.e. a mere beginner. The न is changed to ण in माणव by [[4.1.161]] karika. अन्तेवासिनः are pupils or boarders who live in their teacher's house. The word 'gotra' is understood here. Thus दाक्षाः 'the junior or the senior pupils of Dakshi.' माहकाः So also गौकक्षा दण्डमाणवा अन्तेवासिनोवा

pk: The aril Ca cones in the sense or this is his arter the words rEvatika etc. al these words end with Gotra ariles, and require vun [4.3.126], is ordains Ca instead. Thus rEvatikiya, svapisiya &c. 1 rEvatika, 2 svapisi, 3 ksEnavrdDi, 4 gOragrivi (gOragriva), 5 OdaneGi (Odaneyi), 6 Odavapi (Odavahi) 7 bEjavapi.
ck: the aril ca cones in the sense or this is his arter the torts rEvatika etc. al these torts ent tith kotra ariles, ant retuire vun [4.3.126], is ortains ca insteat. thus rEvatikiya, svapisiya &c. 1 rEvatika, 2 svapisi, 3 ksEnavrti, 4 kOrakrivi (kOrakriva), 5 Otaneki (Otaneyi), 6 Otavapi (Otavahi) 7 pEcavapi.
s: The affix छ comes in the sense of 'this is his' after the words रैवतिक etc. All these words end with Gotra affixes, and require वुञ् [[4.3.126]], is ordains छ instead. Thus रैवतिकीयः, स्वापिशीयः &c. 1 रैवतिक, 2 स्वापिशि, 3 क्षैमवृद्धि, 4 गौरग्रीवि (गौरग्रीव), 5 औदमेघि (औदमेयि), 6 औदवापि (औदवाहि) 7 बैजवापि.

pk: The aril an cones in the sense or this is his arter the words 1. kOpinjala 2. hastipada This debars vun [4.3.126]. Thus kOpinjala, hastipada This sutra is realy a Vartika.
ck: the aril an cones in the sense or this is his arter the torts 1. kOpincala 2. hastipata this tepars vun [4.3.126]. thus kOpincala, hastipata this sutra is realy a Vartika.
s: The affix अण् comes in the sense of 'this is his' after the words 1. कौपिञ्जल 2. हास्तिपद This debars वुञ् [[4.3.126]]. Thus कौपिञ्जलः, हास्तिपदः This sutra is really a Vartika.

pk: The aril an cones in the sense or this is his arter the word aTarvanika and the penultinate ik is elided. This debars vun [4.3.126]. Thus aTarvanikasyayan = aTarvano Darna anaTova "the atharvana i. e. the Law or the Tradition or the atharvanikas". The phrase caranad Darnanayayo is understod here. This sutra is also a vartika.
ck: the aril an cones in the sense or this is his arter the tort atarvanika ant the penultinate ik is elitet. this tepars vun [4.3.126]. thus atarvanikasyayan = atarvano tarna anatova "the atharvana i. e. the Lat or the tratition or the atharvanikas". the phrase caranat tarnanayayo is unterstot here. this sutra is also a vartika.
s: The affix अण् comes in the sense of 'this is his' after the word आथर्वणिक and the penultimate इक् is elided. This debars वुञ् [[4.3.126]]. Thus आथर्वणिकस्यायम् = आथर्वणो धर्म आम्नाथोवा "the Atharvana i. e. the Law or the Tradition of the Atharvanikas". The phrase चरणाद् धर्माम्नाययोः is understood here. This sutra is also a vartika.

pk: an aril - pragdivyaton [4.1.83] etc., cones arter a word in the Genitive -6th-Case in construction in the sense or a nodirication thereor. The word vikara neans the change or condition or the original. The word tasya, though its anuvriti could have ben suplied ron the previous sutras, has ben repeated here, in order to show that the governing rorce or sese [4.2.92] does not eltend rurther. The ariles taught, thererore, under sese ([4.2.92] &c), such as Ga, Ka &c. have not the sense or tasya vikara no aril has ben taught here in this sutra: the general aril an [4.1.83] thererore wil cone in this sense, as wel as the ariles to be taught herearter. To give an elanple under this sutra, we nust take such a word which is not governed or provided ror, by the subsequent sutras. That is the word nust not denote a living aninal ror to it an [4.3.154] aplies; it nust have udata on the rirst sylable, ror an anudatadi wil have an [4.3.140]; it nust not have a Vridhi vowel a, E, or O in the rirst sylable, to which nayaw [4.3.14] aplies; and it nust not be a word speciricaly nentioned in any one or the rolowing aphorisns. Thus it aplies to the words asnan and Basnan rorned by nanin (uniV. 146,145) and to nrtika rorned by tikan [5.4.39] which are adyudata owing to nit acent. Thus asnano vikara = asnana The wi is sonetines elided. ([6.4.14] Vart) as asna so also Basnana and nartika
ck: an aril - praktivyaton [4.1.83] etc., cones arter a tort in the kenitive -6th-case in construction in the sense or a notirication thereor. the tort vikara neans the chanke or contition or the orikinal. the tort tasya, thoukh its anuvriti coult have pen supliet ron the previous sutras, has pen repeatet here, in orter to shot that the kovernink rorce or sese [4.2.92] toes not eltent rurther. the ariles taukht, thererore, unter sese ([4.2.92] &c), such as ka, ka &c. have not the sense or tasya vikara no aril has pen taukht here in this sutra: the keneral aril an [4.1.83] thererore til cone in this sense, as tel as the ariles to pe taukht herearter. to kive an elanple unter this sutra, te nust take such a tort thich is not kovernet or provitet ror, py the supsetuent sutras. that is the tort nust not tenote a livink aninal ror to it an [4.3.154] aplies; it nust have utata on the rirst sylaple, ror an anutatati til have an [4.3.140]; it nust not have a Vrithi votel a, E, or O in the rirst sylaple, to thich nayat [4.3.14] aplies; ant it nust not pe a tort speciricaly nentionet in any one or the rolotink aphorisns. thus it aplies to the torts asnan ant pasnan rornet py nanin (uniV. 146,145) ant to nrtika rornet py tikan [5.4.39] thich are atyutata otink to nit acent. thus asnano vikara = asnana the ti is sonetines elitet. ([6.4.14] Vart) as asna so also pasnana ant nartika
s: An affix -- प्राग्दीव्यतोऽण् [[4.1.83]] etc., comes after a word in the Genitive -6th-Case in construction in the sense of 'a modification thereof'. The word विकार means the change of condition of the original. The word तस्य, though its anuvritti could have been supplied from the previous sutras, has been repeated here, in order to show that the governing force of शेषे [[4.2.92]] does not extend further. The affixes taught, therefore, under शेषे ([[4.2.92]] &c), such as घ, ख &c. have not the sense of तस्य विकार No affix has been taught here in this sutra: the general affix अण् [[4.1.83]] therefore will come in this sense, as well as the affixes to be taught hereafter. To give an example under this sutra, we must take such a word which is not governed or provided for, by the subsequent sutras. That is the word must not denote a living animal for to it अञ् [[4.3.154]] applies; it must have udatta on the first syllable, for an anudattadi will have अञ् [[4.3.140]]; it must not have a Vriddhi vowel आ, ऐ, or औ in the first syllable, to which मयट् [[4.3.144]] applies; and it must not be a word specifically mentioned in any one of the following aphorisms. Thus it applies to the words अश्मन् and भस्मन् formed by मनिन् (UnIV. 146,145) and to मृतिका formed by तिकन् [[5.4.39]] which are adyudatta owing to नित् accent. Thus अश्मनो विकारः = आश्मनः The टि is sometimes elided. ([[6.4.144]] Vart) As आश्मः So also भास्मनः and मार्तिकः

pk: an aril cones arter a word denoting an aninal, a herb and a tre in Genitive -6th-Case in construction in the sense this is its part (as wel as this is its nodirication). By the word ca in the sutra, the phrase tasya vikara is also read into the sutra. Thus kapotasya vikarovayavo va = kapota [4.3.154] so also nayura, tEtira a nodirication, product or part or a peacock &c - vis a ran &c. so also osaDi as, nOrvan product or nurva i.e. ashes or the stalk or nurva. so also vrksa, as, kariran neaning "the stalk or the ashes or Karira tre". in the subsequent sutras, both the words vikara and avayava have governing rorce. But arter words which denote non-aninals, non-plants or non-tres, the ariles have only the sense or vikara This is a rather unique case or double anuvriti, not co-eltensive in every respect.
ck: an aril cones arter a tort tenotink an aninal, a herp ant a tre in kenitive -6th-case in construction in the sense this is its part (as tel as this is its notirication). py the tort ca in the sutra, the phrase tasya vikara is also reat into the sutra. thus kapotasya vikarovayavo va = kapota [4.3.154] so also nayura, tEtira a notirication, protuct or part or a peacock &c - vis a ran &c. so also osati as, nOrvan protuct or nurva i.e. ashes or the stalk or nurva. so also vrksa, as, kariran neanink "the stalk or the ashes or karira tre". in the supsetuent sutras, poth the torts vikara ant avayava have kovernink rorce. put arter torts thich tenote non-aninals, non-plants or non-tres, the ariles have only the sense or vikara this is a rather unitue case or touple anuvriti, not co-eltensive in every respect.
s: An affix comes after a word denoting an animal, a herb and a tree in Genitive -6th-Case in construction in the sense 'this is its part' (as well as 'this is its modification'). By the word च in the sutra, the phrase तस्य विकारः is also read into the sutra. Thus कपोतस्य विकारोऽवयवो वा = कापोतः [[4.3.154]] So also मायूरः, तैत्तिरः 'a modification, product or part of a peacock &c -- viz a fan &c.' So also ओषधिः as, मौर्वम् 'product of Murva i.e. ashes or the stalk of Murva'. So also वृक्ष, as, कारीरं meaning "the stalk or the ashes of Karira tree". In the subsequent sutras, both the words विकार and अवयव have governing force. But after words which denote non-animals, non-plants or non-trees, the affixes have only the sense of विकार This is a rather unique case of double anuvritti, not co-extensive in every respect.

pk: The aril an cones in the sense or its nodirication or its part arter the words bilva etc. This debars an and nayaw Thus bElva the nodirication or part or Bilwa. The word gaveDuka ocurs in this list. it would have taken an by the nelt sutra also; its inclusion in the clas or Bilwadi is ror the sake or preventing the aplication or nayaw to this word. i, bilva, 2 vrihi, 3 kanqa, 4 nudga, 5 nasura, 6 goDuna, 7 iksu, 8 venu, 9 gaveDuka, 10 karpasi 1 pawali; 12 karkanDu, 13 kuwira.
ck: the aril an cones in the sense or its notirication or its part arter the torts pilva etc. this tepars an ant nayat thus pElva the notirication or part or pilta. the tort kavetuka ocurs in this list. it toult have taken an py the nelt sutra also; its inclusion in the clas or piltati is ror the sake or preventink the aplication or nayat to this tort. i, pilva, 2 vrihi, 3 kanta, 4 nutka, 5 nasura, 6 kotuna, 7 iksu, 8 venu, 9 kavetuka, 10 karpasi 1 patali; 12 karkantu, 13 kutira.
s: The affix अण् comes in the sense of 'its modification or its part' after the words बिल्व etc. This debars अञ् and मयट् Thus बैल्वः 'the modification or part of Bilwa'. The word गवेधूकाः occurs in this list. It would have taken 'an' by the next sutra also; its inclusion in the class of Bilwadi is for the sake of preventing the application of मयट् to this word. I, बिल्व, 2 व्रीहि, 3 काण्ड, 4 मुद्ग, 5 मसूर, 6 गोधूम, 7 इक्षु, 8 वेणु, 9 गवेधुका, 10 कर्पासी 11 पाटली; 12 कर्कन्धू, 13 कुटीर.

pk: arter a word having k as its penultinate, the aril an cones in the sense or nodirication or a part or both, as apropriate. This debars an. Thus; tarku tarkavan, titiqika, tEtiqikan; nanqukan, dardurukan naDukan The word titiqika &c have acute on the nidle (Phit su. i.16).
ck: arter a tort havink k as its penultinate, the aril an cones in the sense or notirication or a part or poth, as apropriate. this tepars an. thus; tarku tarkavan, tititika, tEtitikan; nantukan, tarturukan natukan the tort tititika &c have acute on the nitle (phit su. i.16).
s: After a word having क् as its penultimate, the affix अण् comes in the sense of modification or a part or both, as appropriate. This debars अञ्. Thus; तर्कु तार्क्कवम्, तित्तिडीक, तैत्तिडीकं; माण्डूकम्, दार्दुरूकम् माधूकम् The word तित्तिडीक &c have acute on the middle (Phit Su. II.16).

pk: The aril an with the augnent suk cones in the sense or its nodirication arter the words trapun and jatun This debars an [4.3.139]. as, trapuno vikara = trapusan; jatusan nodirication or tin and lac. in these words denoting non-organic beings, the sense or avayava is not denoted by the aril.
ck: the aril an tith the auknent suk cones in the sense or its notirication arter the torts trapun ant catun this tepars an [4.3.139]. as, trapuno vikara = trapusan; catusan notirication or tin ant lac. in these torts tenotink non-orkanic peinks, the sense or avayava is not tenotet py the aril.
s: The affix अण् with the augment षुक् comes in the sense of 'its modification' after the words त्रपुन् and जतुन् This debars अञ् [[4.3.139]]. As, त्रपुणो विकारः = त्रापुषम्; जातुषम् 'modification of tin and lac.' In these words denoting non-organic beings, the sense of अवयव is not denoted by the affix.

pk: The aril an cones in the sense or nodirication or part (provided that the word has not the anudata - grave acent on the rirst sylable). Thus devadaravan, Badravaravan The words devadaru and Badradaru are ady-udata owing to Phit su. i.14 (pitadrvarTanan - the tres denoting sort tinber tres have acute on the rirst).
ck: the aril an cones in the sense or notirication or part (provitet that the tort has not the anutata - krave acent on the rirst sylaple). thus tevataravan, patravaravan the torts tevataru ant patrataru are aty-utata otink to phit su. i.14 (pitatrvartanan - the tres tenotink sort tinper tres have acute on the rirst).
s: The affix अण् comes in the sense of 'modification or part' (provided that the word has not the अनुदात्त - grave accent on the first syllable). Thus देवदारवम्, भाद्रवारवम् The words देवदारु and भद्रदारु are ady-udatta owing to Phit Su. II.14 (पीतद्र्वर्थानाम् -- the trees denoting soft timber trees have acute on the first).

pk: The aril an cones in the sense or nodirication or part arter a word having anudata - grave acent on the rirst sylable. This debars an Thus daDitTan, kapitTan, nahitTan The word daDitTan is an upapada-sanasa or daDi + sTa, the sa being changed to ta; and it is rinaly acute by krdutarapada prakrtiKara
ck: the aril an cones in the sense or notirication or part arter a tort havink anutata - krave acent on the rirst sylaple. this tepars an thus tatitan, kapitan, nahitan the tort tatitan is an upapata-sanasa or tati + sta, the sa peink chanket to ta; ant it is rinaly acute py krtutarapata prakrtikara
s: The affix अञ् comes in the sense of 'modification or part' after a word having अनुदात्त - grave accent on the first syllable. This debars अण् Thus दाधित्थम्, कापित्थम्, माहित्थम् The word दधित्थम् is an upapada-samasa of दधि + स्थ, the स being changed to त; and it is finally acute by कृदुत्तरपद प्रकृतिखर

pk: The aril an cones optionaly in the sense or nodirication or part arter the words palasa etc. Thus palasan or palasan so also Kadiran or Kadiran, yavasan or yavasan This sutra is an elanple or prapta and aprapta vibhasha. The words palasa, Kadira, sinsapa and syandana being gravely acented on the rirst sylable, the aril an was obligatory by the last aphorisn. This nakes it optional, and is prapta-vibhasha. in the case or others it is aprapta-vibhasha. 1 palasa, 2 Kadira, 3 sinsapa, 4 syandana (spandana), 5 pulaka, 6 karira, 7 sirisa, 8 yavasa, 9 vikankata.
ck: the aril an cones optionaly in the sense or notirication or part arter the torts palasa etc. thus palasan or palasan so also katiran or katiran, yavasan or yavasan this sutra is an elanple or prapta ant aprapta viphasha. the torts palasa, katira, sinsapa ant syantana peink kravely acentet on the rirst sylaple, the aril an tas oplikatory py the last aphorisn. this nakes it optional, ant is prapta-viphasha. in the case or others it is aprapta-viphasha. 1 palasa, 2 katira, 3 sinsapa, 4 syantana (spantana), 5 pulaka, 6 karira, 7 sirisa, 8 yavasa, 9 vikankata.
s: The affix अञ् comes optionally in the sense of 'modification or part' after the words पलाश etc. Thus पालाशम् or पालाशम् so also खादिरम् or खादिरम्, यावासम् or यावासम् This sutra is an example of prapta and aprapta vibhasha. The words पलाश, खदिर, शिंशपा and स्यन्दन being gravely accented on the first syllable, the affix अञ् was obligatory by the last aphorism. This makes it optional, and is prapta-vibhasha. In the case of others it is aprapta-vibhasha. 1 पलाश, 2 खदिर, 3 शिंशपा, 4 स्यन्दन (स्पन्दन), 5 पूलाक, 6 करीर, 7 शिरीष, 8 यवास, 9 विकङ्कत.

pk: The aril wlan cones in the sense or nodirication or part arter the word sani This debars an Thus sanilan Basna, sanili sruk [4.1.60].
ck: the aril tlan cones in the sense or notirication or part arter the tort sani this tepars an thus sanilan pasna, sanili sruk [4.1.60].
s: The affix ट्लञ् comes in the sense of 'modification or part' after the word शमी This debars अञ् Thus शामीलं भस्म, शामीली स्रुक् [[4.1.60]].

pk: The aril nayaw cones optionaly arter any base, in these two neanings or product and part in secular language when neither rod nor clothing is spoken or. Thus asnanayan or asnanan [4.3.134] or nurvanayan or nOrvan [4.3.135]. Why do we say Basayan in secular language? Witnes bElva Kadiro va yupa syat Why do we say when neither rod nor clothing is spoken or ? Observe nOdga supa a soup nade or kidney beans. karpasan acCadanan Why the word etayo in those two neanings is used in the sutra, when by contelt, the words vikara and avayava were to be read into the sutras ? its use indicates that the special ariles, such as taught in [4.3.135], [4.3.136] &c are replaced also by nayaw Thus kapotanayan or kapotan [4.3.135], lohanayan or lOhan
ck: the aril nayat cones optionaly arter any pase, in these to neaninks or protuct ant part in secular lankuake then neither rot nor clothink is spoken or. thus asnanayan or asnanan [4.3.134] or nurvanayan or nOrvan [4.3.135]. thy to te say pasayan in secular lankuake? titnes pElva katiro va yupa syat thy to te say then neither rot nor clothink is spoken or ? Opserve nOtka supa a soup nate or kitney peans. karpasan acatanan thy the tort etayo in those to neaninks is uset in the sutra, then py contelt, the torts vikara ant avayava tere to pe reat into the sutras ? its use inticates that the special ariles, such as taukht in [4.3.135], [4.3.136] &c are replacet also py nayat thus kapotanayan or kapotan [4.3.135], lohanayan or lOhan
s: The affix मयट् comes optionally after any base, in these two meanings of 'product' and 'part' in secular language when neither food nor clothing is spoken of. Thus आश्ममयम् or आश्मनम् '[[4.3.134]]' or मूर्वामयं or मौर्वम् [[4.3.135]]. Why do we say भाषायाम् 'in secular language'? Witness बैल्वः खादिरो वा यूपः स्यात् Why do we say 'when neither food nor clothing is spoken of '? Observe मौद्गः सूपः 'a soup made of kidney beans'. कार्पासम् आच्छादनम् Why the word एतयोः 'in those two meanings' is used in the sutra, when by context, the words विकार and अवयव were to be read into the sutras ? Its use indicates that the special affixes, such as taught in [[4.3.135]], [[4.3.136]] &c are replaced also by मयट् Thus कपोतमयम् or कापोतम् [[4.3.135]], लोहमयम् or लौहम्

pk: The aril nayaw cones in the sense or product and part when neither rod nor clothing is spoken or, invariably arter vrdDa words and sara etc. Thus arter Vridha- anranayan, salanayan, sakanayan arter saradi words:- saranayan,harnanayan, nrnayan Why do we use the word nitya invariably in the sutra, when by the nere ract or naking a separate sutra, the aril would be obligatory.? The aril nayaw, acording to Patanjali cones invariably arter words or one sylable. That is done by using the word nitya in the sutra. Thus, tvan nayan, sran nayan, van nayan 1 sara, 2 darBa, 3 nrd, 4 kuwi, 5 trna, 6 sona, 7 balvaja (valvaja).
ck: the aril nayat cones in the sense or protuct ant part then neither rot nor clothink is spoken or, invariaply arter vrta torts ant sara etc. thus arter Vritha- anranayan, salanayan, sakanayan arter sarati torts:- saranayan,harnanayan, nrnayan thy to te use the tort nitya invariaply in the sutra, then py the nere ract or nakink a separate sutra, the aril toult pe oplikatory.? the aril nayat, acortink to patancali cones invariaply arter torts or one sylaple. that is tone py usink the tort nitya in the sutra. thus, tvan nayan, sran nayan, van nayan 1 sara, 2 tarpa, 3 nrt, 4 kuti, 5 trna, 6 sona, 7 palvaca (valvaca).
s: The affix मयट् comes in the sense of 'product' and 'part' when neither food nor clothing is spoken of, invariably after वृद्ध words and शर etc. Thus after Vriddha-- आम्रमयम्, शालमयम्, शाकमयम् After शरादि words:-- शरमयम्,हर्ममयम्, मृन्मयम् Why do we use the word नित्य 'invariably' in the sutra, when by the mere fact of making a separate sutra, the affix would be obligatory.? The affix मयट्, according to Patanjali comes invariably after words of one syllable. That is done by using the word नित्य in the sutra. Thus, त्वङ् मयम्, स्रङ् मयम्, वाङ् मयम् 1 शर, 2 दर्भ, 3 मृद्, 4 कुटी, 5 तृण, 6 सोम, 7 बल्वज (वल्वज).

pk: The aril nayaw cones arter the word go in the sense or its dung. Thus gonayan cow dung. Dung is neither a nodirication nor a part or cow. Thererore this separate sutra ror go Why do we say neaning its dung? Observe gavyan = nilk. The aril yat here cones in the sense or product or part. [4.3.160], though strictly speaking nilk also is not an avayava or a vikara or go
ck: the aril nayat cones arter the tort ko in the sense or its tunk. thus konayan cot tunk. tunk is neither a notirication nor a part or cot. thererore this separate sutra ror ko thy to te say neanink its tunk? Opserve kavyan = nilk. the aril yat here cones in the sense or protuct or part. [4.3.160], thoukh strictly speakink nilk also is not an avayava or a vikara or ko
s: The affix मयट् comes after the word गो in the sense of 'its dung'. Thus गोमयम् 'cow dung'. 'Dung' is neither a modification nor a part of cow. Therefore this separate sutra for गो Why do we say meaning 'its dung'? Observe गव्यं = milk. The affix यत् here comes in the sense of product or part. [[4.3.160]], though strictly speaking 'milk' also is not an 'avayava' or a 'vikara' of गो

pk: The aril nayaw invariably cones in the sense or its product or part arter the word piswa This debars an Thus piswanayan Basna Otherwise an, as pEswi sura in the sense or tasyedan
ck: the aril nayat invariaply cones in the sense or its protuct or part arter the tort pista this tepars an thus pistanayan pasna Othertise an, as pEsti sura in the sense or tasyetan
s: The affix मयट् invariably comes in the sense of 'its product or part' after the word पिष्ट This debars अण् Thus पिष्टमयं भस्म Otherwise अण्, as पैष्टी सुरा in the sense of तस्येदम्

pk: The aril kan cones in the sense or product arter the word piswa , the whole word being a nane. This debars nayaw as piswaka
ck: the aril kan cones in the sense or protuct arter the tort pista , the thole tort peink a nane. this tepars nayat as pistaka
s: The affix कन् comes in the sense of 'product' after the word पिष्ट , the whole word being a Name. This debars मयट् As पिष्टकः

pk: The aril nayaw cones arter the word vrihi in the sense or a puroqasa This debars an [4.3.136]. Thus vrihinaya puroqasa a sacred cake nade or barley. Otherwise vrEhan
ck: the aril nayat cones arter the tort vrihi in the sense or a purotasa this tepars an [4.3.136]. thus vrihinaya purotasa a sacret cake nate or parley. Othertise vrEhan
s: The affix मयट् comes after the word व्रीहि in the sense of a पुरोडाश This debars अण् [[4.3.136]]. Thus व्रीहिमयः पुरोडाशः 'a sacred cake made of barley.' Otherwise व्रैहम्

pk: The aril nayaw cones in the sense or product arter the words tila and yava - the whole not being a nane. Thus tilanayan, yavanayan, Why do we say asanjnayan "it not being a nane?" Observe tElan oil, yavaka rorned with kan (yavadiBya kan [5.4.29])
ck: the aril nayat cones in the sense or protuct arter the torts tila ant yava - the thole not peink a nane. thus tilanayan, yavanayan, thy to te say asancnayan "it not peink a nane?" Opserve tElan oil, yavaka rornet tith kan (yavatipya kan [5.4.29])
s: The affix मयट् comes in the sense of 'product' after the words तिल and यवा - the whole not being a name. Thus तिलमयम्, यवमयम्, Why do we say असंज्ञायाम् "it not being a Name?" Observe तैलम् 'oil,' यावकः formed with कन् (यावादिभ्यः कन् [[5.4.29]])

pk: in the Candas (Vedas) arter a disylabic word the aril nayaw cones in the sense or product or part. This ordains nayaw in the sacred literature also, secular literature being dealt with in [4.3.143]. Thus parnanaya, darBanaya, saranaya in the rolowing yasya parnanayi juhurBavati, darBanayan vaso Bavati, saranayan barhi rBavati
ck: in the cantas (Vetas) arter a tisylapic tort the aril nayat cones in the sense or protuct or part. this ortains nayat in the sacret literature also, secular literature peink tealt tith in [4.3.143]. thus parnanaya, tarpanaya, saranaya in the rolotink yasya parnanayi cuhurpavati, tarpanayan vaso pavati, saranayan parhi rpavati
s: In the छन्दस् (Vedas) after a disyllabic word the affix मयट् comes in the sense of 'product or part'. This ordains मयट् in the sacred literature also, secular literature being dealt with in [[4.3.143]]. Thus पर्णमयः, दर्भमयः, शरमयः in the following यस्य पर्णमयी जुहूर्भवति, दर्भमयम् वासो भवति, शरमयम् बर्हि र्भवति

pk: The aril nayaw does not cone in the Candas (Vedas) arter the disylabic words having a short vowel u in then, nor arter the words 1. varDra and 2. bilva Thus nOnjan sikyan ron nunja by an garnutan cakran, varDri balapragraTita Bavati; bElvo brahnavarcasakanena karya The word utvat neans having ut or short u [1.1.70] The rule does not aply to words containing long u, as BunanayanyaBrani The vat in utvat shows that the rule aplies not only to words ending in u, but also to words having u. ad vat not ben used, the tadanta-vidhi would require the aplication or the rule to words ending in u, but not to those which had u in any other part or their rorn. so that the prohibition aplies to venu also, as vEnavi yaswi [4.3.136]. The word nunja is ady-udata by trnaDanyanan (Phit i.4): and thererore it takes the universal an [4.3.134]. The word garnut is rorned by the aril ut plus the augnent nuw (nrgroruti, gronuwca un i.94 and 95), and is rinaly acute, and thererore it takes an by [4.3.140], and rorns garnuta This word has acute on the rinal also, as tasya etan garnutan carun nirvayet The word varDra is ady-udata by Phit i.19. and thererore takes an, the reninine being rorned by nip [4.1.15].
ck: the aril nayat toes not cone in the cantas (Vetas) arter the tisylapic torts havink a short votel u in then, nor arter the torts 1. vartra ant 2. pilva thus nOncan sikyan ron nunca py an karnutan cakran, vartri palaprakratita pavati; pElvo prahnavarcasakanena karya the tort utvat neans havink ut or short u [1.1.70] the rule toes not aply to torts containink lonk u, as punanayanyaprani the vat in utvat shots that the rule aplies not only to torts entink in u, put also to torts havink u. at vat not pen uset, the tatanta-vithi toult retuire the aplication or the rule to torts entink in u, put not to those thich hat u in any other part or their rorn. so that the prohipition aplies to venu also, as vEnavi yasti [4.3.136]. the tort nunca is aty-utata py trnatanyanan (phit i.4): ant thererore it takes the universal an [4.3.134]. the tort karnut is rornet py the aril ut plus the auknent nut (nrkroruti, kronutca un i.94 ant 95), ant is rinaly acute, ant thererore it takes an py [4.3.140], ant rorns karnuta this tort has acute on the rinal also, as tasya etan karnutan carun nirvayet the tort vartra is aty-utata py phit i.19. ant thererore takes an, the reninine peink rornet py nip [4.1.15].
s: The affix मयट् does not come in the छन्दस् (Vedas) after the disyllabic words having a short vowel उ in them, nor after the words 1. वर्ध्र and 2. बिल्वा Thus मौञ्जं शिक्यम् from मुञ्ज by अण् गार्मुतं चक्रम्, वार्ध्री बालप्रग्रथिता भवति; बैल्वो ब्रह्मवर्चसकामेन कार्यः The word उत्वत् means 'having उत् or short u [[1.1.70]]' The rule does not apply to words containing long ऊ, as भूममयान्यभ्राणि The वत् in उत्वत् shows that the rule applies not only to words ending in उ, but also to words having उ. Had वत् not been used, the tadanta-vidhi would require the application of the rule to words ending in उ, but not to those which had उ in any other part of their form. So that the prohibition applies to वेणु also, as वैणवी यष्टिः [[4.3.136]]. The word मुञ्ज is ady-udatta by तृणधान्यानां (Phit II.4): and therefore it takes the universal अण् [[4.3.134]]. The word गर्मुत् is formed by the affix उत् plus the augment मुट् (मृग्रोरुतिः, ग्रोमुट्च Un I.94 and 95), and is finally acute, and therefore it takes अञ् by [[4.3.140]], and forms गार्मुत This word has acute on the final also, as तस्या एतं गार्मुतं चरुं निर्वयेत् The word वर्ध्र is ady-udatta by Phit II.19. And therefore takes अण्, the feminine being formed by ङीप् [[4.1.15]].

pk: The aril an cones in the sense or its product or part arter the words tala etc. This debars nayaw &c. Thus talan Danu, barhinan, Endralisan 1 taladDanusi, 2 barhina, 3 indralisa, 4 indradrsa, 5 indrayuDa, 6 caya (capa, carga), 7 syanaka, 8 piyuksa.
ck: the aril an cones in the sense or its protuct or part arter the torts tala etc. this tepars nayat &c. thus talan tanu, parhinan, Entralisan 1 talatanusi, 2 parhina, 3 intralisa, 4 intratrsa, 5 intrayuta, 6 caya (capa, carka), 7 syanaka, 8 piyuksa.
s: The affix अण् comes in the sense of 'its product or part' after the words ताला etc. This debars मयट् &c. Thus तालं धनुः, बार्हिणम्, ऐन्द्रालिशम् 1 तालाद्धनुषि, 2 बार्हिण, 3 इन्द्रालिश, 4 इन्द्रादृश, 5 इन्द्रायुध, 6 चय (चाप, चर्ग), 7 श्यामाक, 8 पीयूक्षा.

pk: The aril an cones arter a word denoting gold when the sense is a weight or neasure. The word jatarupa neans gold. it is used in the plural in the sutra, indicating that al words synonynous with gold are to be taken. This debars nayaw &c. Thus hawako niska, hawakan karsapanan, jatarupan, tapaniyan Why do we say neaning a neasure. Observe yaswiriyan hawakanayi
ck: the aril an cones arter a tort tenotink kolt then the sense is a teikht or neasure. the tort catarupa neans kolt. it is uset in the plural in the sutra, inticatink that al torts synonynous tith kolt are to pe taken. this tepars nayat &c. thus hatako niska, hatakan karsapanan, catarupan, tapaniyan thy to te say neanink a neasure. Opserve yastiriyan hatakanayi
s: The affix अण् comes after a word denoting 'gold' when the sense is a weight or measure. The word जातरूप means 'gold'. It is used in the plural in the sutra, indicating that all words synonymous with gold are to be taken. This debars मयट् &c. Thus हाटको निष्कः, हाटकं कार्षापणम्, जातरूपम्, तापमीयम् Why do we say 'meaning a measure'. Observe यष्टिरियं हाटकमयी

pk: The aril an cones in the sense or product or part arter the words elpresing living beings and arter rajata etc. This debars an &c. The aril an has ben ordained to cone arter those words that have anudata in the begining. This sutra aplies to words other than those having anudata in the begining. Thus:- kapotan , nayuran, tEtiran; rajatan, sEsan; lOhan, &c. in the clas rajatadi those words like rajata, kanwakara &c, which have anudata on the begining and would have taken an by [4.3.140], have ben enunerated to prevent the aplication or nayaw to then. 1 rajata, 2 sisa, 3 loha, 4 udunbara, 5 nipa (nica, nila), 6 daru, 7 rohitaka (rohitaka), 8 viBitaka, 9 pitadaru (kapita, daru), 10 tivradaru, 1 trikanwaka, 12 kanwakara.
ck: the aril an cones in the sense or protuct or part arter the torts elpresink livink peinks ant arter racata etc. this tepars an &c. the aril an has pen ortainet to cone arter those torts that have anutata in the pekinink. this sutra aplies to torts other than those havink anutata in the pekinink. thus:- kapotan , nayuran, tEtiran; racatan, sEsan; lOhan, &c. in the clas racatati those torts like racata, kantakara &c, thich have anutata on the pekinink ant toult have taken an py [4.3.140], have pen enuneratet to prevent the aplication or nayat to then. 1 racata, 2 sisa, 3 loha, 4 utunpara, 5 nipa (nica, nila), 6 taru, 7 rohitaka (rohitaka), 8 vipitaka, 9 pitataru (kapita, taru), 10 tivrataru, 1 trikantaka, 12 kantakara.
s: The affix अञ् comes in the sense of 'product or part' after the words expressing living beings and after रजत etc. This debars अण् &c. The affix अञ् has been ordained to come after those words that have anudatta in the beginning. This sutra applies to words other than those having anudatta in the beginning. Thus:-- कापोतम् , मायूरम्, तैत्तिरम्; राजतम्, सैसम्; लौहम्, &c. In the class रजतादि those words like रजत, कण्टकार &c, which have anudatta on the beginning and would have taken अञ् by [[4.3.140]], have been enumerated to prevent the application of मयट् to them. 1 रजत, 2 सीस, 3 लोह, 4 उदुम्बर, 5 नीप (नीच, नील), 6 दारु, 7 रोहीतक (रोहितक), 8 विभीतक, 9 पीतदारु (कपीत, दारु), 10 तीव्रदारु, 11 त्रिकण्टक, 12 कण्टकार.

pk: The aril an cones in the sense or product or part arter a word which ends in an aril having an indicatory n , such aril denoting its product or part. The ariles having indicatory na denoting product or part, are an [4.3.139], walan [4.3.142], an [4.3.154] vun [4.3.157], Qan [4.3.159], an, yan [4.5.168]. When a tertiary derivative or a word ending with these ariles is to be nade, the aril an is used. Thus dEvadaravasya vikarovayavo va = dEvadaravan; so also daDitTan, palasan, sanilan, kapotan Oswrakan, Eneyan, kansyan, parasavan Why do we say nita ? Witnes bElvanayan. ere nayaw is used arter bElva and the derivative is rorned by an or [4.3.136]. so also bEdanayan
ck: the aril an cones in the sense or protuct or part arter a tort thich ents in an aril havink an inticatory n , such aril tenotink its protuct or part. the ariles havink inticatory na tenotink protuct or part, are an [4.3.139], talan [4.3.142], an [4.3.154] vun [4.3.157], tan [4.3.159], an, yan [4.5.168]. then a tertiary terivative or a tort entink tith these ariles is to pe nate, the aril an is uset. thus tEvataravasya vikarovayavo va = tEvataravan; so also tatitan, palasan, sanilan, kapotan Ostrakan, Eneyan, kansyan, parasavan thy to te say nita ? titnes pElvanayan. ere nayat is uset arter pElva ant the terivative is rornet py an or [4.3.136]. so also pEtanayan
s: The affix अञ् comes in the sense of 'product or part' after a word which ends in an affix having an indicatory ञ् , such affix denoting 'its product or part'. The affixes having indicatory ञ denoting product or part, are अञ् [[4.3.139]], टलञ् [[4.3.142]], अञ् [[4.3.154]] वुञ् [[4.3.157]], ढञ् [[4.3.159]], अञ्, यञ् [[4.5.168]]. When a tertiary derivative of a word ending with these affixes is to be made, the affix अञ् is used. Thus दैवदारवस्य विकारोऽवयवो वा = दैवदारवम्; so also दाधित्थम्, पालाशम्, शामीलम्, कापोतम् औष्ट्रकम्, ऐणेयम्, कांस्यम्, पारशवम् Why do we say ञितः ? Witness बैल्वमयं. Here मयट् is used after बैल्व and the derivative is formed by अण् of [[4.3.136]]. So also बैदमयम्

pk: arter a word denoting a neasure the aril elpresing its product or part is the sane as the aril having the sense or purchased. The ariles taught in [5.1.18] &c are the ariles that have the rorce or krita [5.1.37]. These ariles cone also arter words denoting neasure [5.1.19]. The sane ariles are enployed to denote vikara, arter words denoting parinana This debars an &c. Thus niskena kritan = nEskikan [5.1.20]; it wil denote vikara also, niskasya vikara = nEskika rorned by Wak [5.1.20]. as satenakritan = satyan or satikan [5.1.21], so satasya vikara = satya or satika by Wan and yat [5.1.21], sahasrenakritan = sahasran [5.1.27] so sahasrasya vikara = sahasra (V. i.27 by an) The word vat in kritavat indicates that the sinilarity is conplete throughout. Thus sutra [5.1.28] also aplies, by which the aril is elided. as dvisahasra or dvisahasra [5.1.29], dviniska or dvinEskika The word parinana in this sutra includes sanKya the, nunerals also; while the technical word parinana does not include sankhya. se [4.1.2] and [5.1.19] &c. The sinilarity eltends even to the elision or aril [5.1.28] as, dvisahasra, dvisahasra &c.
ck: arter a tort tenotink a neasure the aril elpresink its protuct or part is the sane as the aril havink the sense or purchaset. the ariles taukht in [5.1.18] &c are the ariles that have the rorce or krita [5.1.37]. these ariles cone also arter torts tenotink neasure [5.1.19]. the sane ariles are enployet to tenote vikara, arter torts tenotink parinana this tepars an &c. thus niskena kritan = nEskikan [5.1.20]; it til tenote vikara also, niskasya vikara = nEskika rornet py tak [5.1.20]. as satenakritan = satyan or satikan [5.1.21], so satasya vikara = satya or satika py tan ant yat [5.1.21], sahasrenakritan = sahasran [5.1.27] so sahasrasya vikara = sahasra (V. i.27 py an) the tort vat in kritavat inticates that the sinilarity is conplete throukhout. thus sutra [5.1.28] also aplies, py thich the aril is elitet. as tvisahasra or tvisahasra [5.1.29], tviniska or tvinEskika the tort parinana in this sutra inclutes sankya the, nunerals also; thile the technical tort parinana toes not inclute sankhya. se [4.1.2] ant [5.1.19] &c. the sinilarity eltents even to the elision or aril [5.1.28] as, tvisahasra, tvisahasra &c.
s: After a word denoting 'a measure' the affix expressing 'its product or part' is the same as the affix having the sense of 'purchased'. The affixes taught in [[5.1.18]] &c are the affixes that have the force of क्रीत [[5.1.37]]. These affixes come also after words denoting measure [[5.1.19]]. The same affixes are employed to denote विकार, after words denoting परिमाण This debars अण् &c. Thus निष्केन क्रीतम् = नैष्किकम् [[5.1.20]]; It will denote vikara also, निष्कस्य विकारः = नैष्किकः formed by ठक् [[5.1.20]]. As शतेनक्रीतं = शत्यं or शतिकम् [[5.1.21]], so शतस्य विकारः = शत्यः or शतिकः by ठन् and यत् [[5.1.21]], सहस्रेणक्रीतं = साहस्रम् [[5.1.27]] so सहस्रस्य विकारः = साहस्रः (V. I.27 by अण्) The word वत् in क्रीतवत् indicates that the similarity is complete throughout. Thus Sutra [[5.1.28]] also applies, by which the affix is elided. As द्विसहस्रः or द्विसाहस्रः [[5.1.29]], द्विनिष्कः or द्विनैष्किकः The word परिमाण in this sutra includes संख्या 'the, numerals' also; while the technical word परिमाण does not include sankhya. See [[4.1.22]] and [[5.1.19]] &c. The similarity extends even to the elision of affix [[5.1.28]] as, द्विसहस्रः, द्विसाहस्रः &c.

pk: The aril vun cones in the sense or product or part arter the word uswra This debars an [4.3.154]. uswrasya vikarovayavo va = Oswraka
ck: the aril vun cones in the sense or protuct or part arter the tort ustra this tepars an [4.3.154]. ustrasya vikarovayavo va = Ostraka
s: The affix वुञ् comes in the sense of 'product or part' after the word उष्ट्र This debars अञ् [[4.3.154]]. उष्ट्रस्य विकारोऽवयवो वा = औष्ट्रकः

pk: The aril vun cones optionaly in the sense or product or part arter the words 1. una and 2. urna Thus Onan or Onakan, Ornan or Ornakan
ck: the aril vun cones optionaly in the sense or protuct or part arter the torts 1. una ant 2. urna thus Onan or Onakan, Ornan or Ornakan
s: The affix वुञ् comes optionally in the sense of 'product or part' after the words 1. उमा and 2. ऊर्णा Thus औमम् or औमकम्, और्णम् or और्णकम्

pk: The aril Qan cones optionaly in the sense or product or part arter the reninine word eni Thus Eneyan nansan the rlesh or a renale black der. But enasya nansan = Enan the rlesh or a nale der, rorned by an
ck: the aril tan cones optionaly in the sense or protuct or part arter the reninine tort eni thus Eneyan nansan the rlesh or a renale plack ter. put enasya nansan = Enan the rlesh or a nale ter, rornet py an
s: The affix ढञ् comes optionally in the sense of 'product or part' after the feminine word एणी Thus ऐणेयं मांसम् 'the flesh of a female black deer.' But एणस्य मांसम् = ऐणम् 'the flesh of a male deer', formed by अञ्

pk: The aril yat cones in the sense or product or part arter the words 1. go and 2. payas Thus gavyan [6.1.79], payasyan
ck: the aril yat cones in the sense or protuct or part arter the torts 1. ko ant 2. payas thus kavyan [6.1.79], payasyan
s: The affix यत् comes in the sense of 'product or part' after the words 1. गो and 2. पयस् Thus गव्यम् [[6.1.79]], पयस्यम्

pk: The aril yat cones in the sense or product or part arter the word dru This debars an [4.3.139]. Thus dru + yat = dravyan [6.1.79].
ck: the aril yat cones in the sense or protuct or part arter the tort tru this tepars an [4.3.139]. thus tru + yat = travyan [6.1.79].
s: The affix यत् comes in the sense of 'product or part' after the word द्रु This debars अञ् [[4.3.139]]. Thus द्रु + यत् = द्रव्यम् [[6.1.79]].

pk: The aril vaya cones in the sense or product arter the word dru , the word neaning a neasure. This debars yat as druvayan a neasure.
ck: the aril vaya cones in the sense or protuct arter the tort tru , the tort neanink a neasure. this tepars yat as truvayan a neasure.
s: The affix वय comes in the sense of 'product' after the word द्रु , the word meaning 'a measure'. This debars यत् As द्रुवयम् 'a measure.'

pk: The aril denoting product or part is luk elided when such a product or part is a ruit. Thus analakya Palan = analaki + nayaw luk = analakan the ruit or nyrobolans. so also vadaran The ruit is a "product" as wel as a "part" or a ruit-bearing tre.
ck: the aril tenotink protuct or part is luk elitet then such a protuct or part is a ruit. thus analakya palan = analaki + nayat luk = analakan the ruit or nyropolans. so also vataran the ruit is a "protuct" as tel as a "part" or a ruit-pearink tre.
s: The affix denoting 'product or part' is लुक् elided when such a product or part is 'a fruit'. Thus आमलक्याः फलं = आमलकी + मयट् लुक् = आमलकं 'the fruit of Myrobolans.' So also वदरम् The fruit is a "product" as well as a "part" of a fruit-bearing tree.

pk: The aril an cones in the sense or product or part, it being a ruit arter the words plaksa etc. This debars an Thus plaksan, nEyagroDan 1 plaksa 2 nyagroDa, 3 asvatTa, 4 ingudi, 5 sigru, 6 ruru, 7 kaksatu ( karkanDu, karkantu rkratu) 8 brhati.
ck: the aril an cones in the sense or protuct or part, it peink a ruit arter the torts plaksa etc. this tepars an thus plaksan, nEyakrotan 1 plaksa 2 nyakrota, 3 asvata, 4 inkuti, 5 sikru, 6 ruru, 7 kaksatu ( karkantu, karkantu rkratu) 8 prhati.
s: The affix अण् comes in the sense of 'product or part, it being a fruit' after the words प्लक्ष etc. This debars अञ् Thus प्लाक्षम्, नैयग्रोधम् 1 प्लक्ष 2 न्यग्रोध, 3 अश्वत्थ, 4 इङ्गुदी, 5 शिग्रु, 6 रुरु, 7 कक्षतु ( कर्कन्धु, कर्कन्तु ऋक्रतु) 8 बृहती.

pk: The aril an optionaly cones in denoting a ruit arter the word janbu This debars an Thus janbu + an = janbavan as janbavani Palani But when the general aril an is aded, it is elided by [4.3.163]. as janbu + an [4.3.139] = janbu, as janbuni Palani [6.4.8]
ck: the aril an optionaly cones in tenotink a ruit arter the tort canpu this tepars an thus canpu + an = canpavan as canpavani palani put then the keneral aril an is atet, it is elitet py [4.3.163]. as canpu + an [4.3.139] = canpu, as canpuni palani [6.4.8]
s: The affix अण् optionally comes in denoting a fruit after the word जम्बु This debars अञ् Thus जम्बु + अण् = जाम्बवं as जाम्बवानि फलानि But when the general affix अञ् is added, it is elided by [[4.3.163]]. As जम्बू + अञ् [[4.3.139]] = जम्बु, as जम्बूनि फलानि [[6.4.8]]

pk: The aril denoting ruit is optionaly elided by lup arter the word janbu The word va is understod here. The direrence betwen luk and lup elision is that in the case or lup, there is concordance or gender and nunber. se sutra [1.2.5]. Thus janbu + anlup = janbu, as, janbu Palan Optionaly janbva Palan = janbu Palan, or janbavan Vart:- There is lup-elision or the aril denoting ruit, arter the words elpresing deciduous plants which wither away as son as the ruit ripens: Thus vrihi-vrihaya, yava, nasa, nudga, tila Vart:- Diversely so when the aril denotes rlowers and rots : as, nalikayan puspan = nalika, navanalika jati; so also vidarya nulan = vidari asunati brhati in the above elanple there is concordance. By using diversely, this concordance does not sonetine take place. as pawalani puspani, salvani nulani so kadanban puspan, asokan, karaviran, bElvani Palani &c.
ck: the aril tenotink ruit is optionaly elitet py lup arter the tort canpu the tort va is unterstot here. the tirerence peten luk ant lup elision is that in the case or lup, there is concortance or kenter ant nunper. se sutra [1.2.5]. thus canpu + anlup = canpu, as, canpu palan Optionaly canpva palan = canpu palan, or canpavan Vart:- there is lup-elision or the aril tenotink ruit, arter the torts elpresink tecituous plants thich tither atay as son as the ruit ripens: thus vrihi-vrihaya, yava, nasa, nutka, tila Vart:- tiversely so then the aril tenotes rloters ant rots : as, nalikayan puspan = nalika, navanalika cati; so also vitarya nulan = vitari asunati prhati in the apove elanple there is concortance. py usink tiversely, this concortance toes not sonetine take place. as patalani puspani, salvani nulani so katanpan puspan, asokan, karaviran, pElvani palani &c.
s: The affix denoting 'fruit' is optionally elided by लुप् after the word जम्बु The word वा is understood here. The difference between 'luk' and 'lup' elision is that in the case of 'lup', there is concordance of gender and number. See sutra [[1.2.5]]. Thus जम्बू + अञ्लुप् = जम्बूः, as, जम्बूः फलं Optionally जम्ब्वाः फलं = जम्बु फलं, or जाम्बवं Vart:- There is lup-elision of the affix denoting fruit, after the words expressing deciduous plants which wither away as soon as the fruit ripens: Thus व्रीहिः-व्रीहयः, यवाः, माषाः, मुद्गाः, तिलाः Vart:- Diversely so when the affix denotes flowers and roots : as, मल्लिकायां पुष्पं = मल्लिका, नवमल्लिका जातिः; so also विदार्या मूलं = विदारी अशुमती बृहती In the above example there is concordance. By using 'diversely', this concordance does not sometime take place. As पाटलानि पुष्पाणि, शाल्वानि मूलानि So कदम्बं पुष्पं, अशोकम्, करवीरम्, बैल्वानि फलानि &c.

pk: The aril Wak cones as a governing aril in the senses enunerated herearter up to sūtra [4.4.76]. This is an adhikara sutra. The aril Wak bears rule ron this one rorward to the sutra tadvahati &c. Thus in the nelt sutra it is said; "arter a word in the third case in construction", in the sense or "who plays, digs, conquers, or is conquered." now this sutra is inconplete. We nust read the word Wak into it. Thus aksE rdivyati = aksika "who plays with aksha-a dicer." aksa + Wak = aksika [7.3.50]. Vart:- arter the words nasabda &c, the aril thak cones in the sense he said that. Thus nasabda ityaha = nasabdika who says dont nake noise, karyasabdika This is the case or an aril aded to a sentence. Vart:- so also arter praButa &c in the sense he said: as praButanaha = praButika, paryaptika These are elanples or ariles aded to an adverb. Vart:- so also arter susnata &c in the sense he asks, as, susnatan prcCati = sOsnatika "Who asks, have you bathed wel". sOKarajika, sOKasayanika Vart:- so also arter paradara &c in the sense or he goes to, or conits adultery with: as paradaran gacCati = paradarika, gOrutalpika The word talpa here rerers to "wire".
ck: the aril tak cones as a kovernink aril in the senses enuneratet herearter up to sūtra [4.4.76]. this is an athikara sutra. the aril tak pears rule ron this one rortart to the sutra tatvahati &c. thus in the nelt sutra it is sait; "arter a tort in the thirt case in construction", in the sense or "tho plays, tiks, contuers, or is contueret." not this sutra is inconplete. te nust reat the tort tak into it. thus aksE rtivyati = aksika "tho plays tith aksha-a ticer." aksa + tak = aksika [7.3.50]. Vart:- arter the torts nasapta &c, the aril thak cones in the sense he sait that. thus nasapta ityaha = nasaptika tho says tont nake noise, karyasaptika this is the case or an aril atet to a sentence. Vart:- so also arter praputa &c in the sense he sait: as praputanaha = praputika, paryaptika these are elanples or ariles atet to an atverp. Vart:- so also arter susnata &c in the sense he asks, as, susnatan prcati = sOsnatika "tho asks, have you pathet tel". sOkaracika, sOkasayanika Vart:- so also arter paratara &c in the sense or he koes to, or conits atultery tith: as parataran kacati = paratarika, kOrutalpika the tort talpa here rerers to "tire".
s: The affix ठक् comes as a governing affix in the senses enumerated hereafter up to sūtra [[4.4.76]]. This is an adhikara sutra. The affix ठक् bears rule from this one forward to the sutra तद्वहति &c. Thus in the next sutra it is said; "After a word in the third case in construction", in the sense of "who plays, digs, conquers, or is conquered." Now this sutra is incomplete. We must read the word ठक् into it. Thus अक्षै र्दीव्यति = आक्षिकः "who plays with aksha--a dicer." अक्ष + ठक् = आक्षिकः [[7.3.50]]. Vart:- After the words माशब्द &c, the affix 'thak' comes in the sense 'he said that.' Thus माशब्द इत्याह = माशब्दिकः who says 'don't make noise,' कार्यशब्दिकः This is the case of an affix added to a sentence. Vart:- So also after प्रभूत &c in the sense 'he said': as प्रभूतमाह = प्राभूतिकः, पार्याप्तिकः These are examples of affixes added to an adverb. Vart:- So also after सुस्नात &c in the sense 'he asks,' as, सुस्नातं पृच्छति = सौस्नातिकः "Who asks, have you bathed well". सौखराजिकः, सौखशायनिकः Vart:- So also after परदारा &c in the sense of 'he goes to, or commits adultery with': as परदारान् गच्छति = पारदारिकः, गौरुतल्पिकः The word तल्प here refers to "wife".

pk: The aril Wak cones arter a word in the instrunental -3rd case in construction in the sense or he plays, he digs, he conquers or he is conquered. Thus aksErdivyati = aksika who plays with dice - a dicer. salakika aBrya Kanati = aBrika, kOdalika, aksErjayati = aksika, aksErjitan = aksikan salakikan Though the rule is couched in universal terns, yet the aril does not cone arter every instrunental case. Thus devadatena jitan wil not give rise to any aril, ror the word dEvadaktika is not round in usage having this sense. so also angulya Kanati gives rise to no aril. Though the verbs divyati &c, are in the 3rd Person Present Tense, singular nunber, the derivative is not linited by these conditions. Thus aksikO and aksika what are also valid, and so also aksEradivyat wil give also aksika; so also aksikastvan aksakohan Though in a sentence the verb is generaly the principal word (kriyapraDana), here owing to the Tadhita aril, the instrunent is taken as the principal.
ck: the aril tak cones arter a tort in the instrunental -3rt case in construction in the sense or he plays, he tiks, he contuers or he is contueret. thus aksErtivyati = aksika tho plays tith tice - a ticer. salakika aprya kanati = aprika, kOtalika, aksErcayati = aksika, aksErcitan = aksikan salakikan thoukh the rule is couchet in universal terns, yet the aril toes not cone arter every instrunental case. thus tevatatena citan til not kive rise to any aril, ror the tort tEvataktika is not rount in usake havink this sense. so also ankulya kanati kives rise to no aril. thoukh the verps tivyati &c, are in the 3rt person present tense, sinkular nunper, the terivative is not linitet py these contitions. thus aksikO ant aksika that are also valit, ant so also aksErativyat til kive also aksika; so also aksikastvan aksakohan thoukh in a sentence the verp is keneraly the principal tort (kriyapratana), here otink to the tathita aril, the instrunent is taken as the principal.
s: The affix ठक् comes after a word in the Instrumental -3rd case in construction in the sense of 'he plays', 'he digs', 'he conquers' or 'he is conquered'. Thus अक्षैर्दीव्यति = आक्षिकः 'who plays with dice -- a dicer'. शालाकिकः अभ्र्या खनति = आभ्रिकः, कौद्दालिकः, अक्षैर्जयति = आक्षिकः, अक्षैर्जितं = आक्षिकम् शालाकिकम् Though the rule is couched in universal terms, yet the affix does not come after every instrumental case. Thus देवदत्तेन जितम् will not give rise to any affix, for the word दैवदक्तिकः is not found in usage having this sense. So also अंगुल्या खनति gives rise to no affix. Though the verbs 'divyati' &c, are in the 3rd Person Present Tense, Singular number, the derivative is not limited by these conditions. Thus आक्षिकौ and आक्षिकाः what are also valid, and so also अक्षैरदीव्यत् will give also आक्षिकः; so also आक्षिकस्त्वम् आक्षकोहम् Though in a sentence the verb is generally the principal word (क्रियाप्रधान), here owing to the Taddhita affix, the instrument is taken as the principal.

pk: The aril Wak cones arter a word in the instrunental -3rd case in construction, in the sense or rerined thereby. The word sanskrtan neans rerining or enhancing the quality or a thing. Thus daDna sanskrtan = daDikan rerined or nade tasterul by curd. so also sarngaverikan, naricikan The separation or this sutra ron the last, is ror sake or the nelt sutra, in which the anuvriti or sanskrtan only runs,
ck: the aril tak cones arter a tort in the instrunental -3rt case in construction, in the sense or rerinet therepy. the tort sanskrtan neans rerinink or enhancink the tuality or a think. thus tatna sanskrtan = tatikan rerinet or nate tasterul py curt. so also sarnkaverikan, naricikan the separation or this sutra ron the last, is ror sake or the nelt sutra, in thich the anuvriti or sanskrtan only runs,
s: The affix ठक् comes after a word in the Instrumental -3rd case in construction, in the sense of 'refined thereby'. The word संस्कृतम् means 'refining or enhancing the quality of a thing'. Thus दध्ना संस्कृतं = दाधिकम् 'refined or made tasteful by curd'. So also शार्ङ्गवेरिकम्, मारीचिकम् The separation of this sutra from the last, is for sake of the next sutra, in which the anuvritti of संस्कृतं only runs,

pk: arter the word kulatTa and arter the words having a penultinate k , the aril an is aded in the sense or rerined or prepared therewith. This debars Wak Thus kOlatyan, tEtiqikan, dardaBakan, the two later being elanples or words ending in ka
ck: arter the tort kulata ant arter the torts havink a penultinate k , the aril an is atet in the sense or rerinet or preparet theretith. this tepars tak thus kOlatyan, tEtitikan, tartapakan, the to later peink elanples or torts entink in ka
s: After the word कुलत्थ and after the words having a penultimate क् , the affix अण् is added in the sense of 'refined or prepared therewith'. This debars ठक् Thus कौलत्यम्, तैत्तिडीकम्, दार्दभकम्, the two latter being examples of words ending in क

pk: The aril Wak cones arter a word in the instrunental -3rd case in construction, in the sense or he croses thereby over the waters. Thus kanqaplavenatarati = kanqaplavika, Oqupika who croses with a rart.
ck: the aril tak cones arter a tort in the instrunental -3rt case in construction, in the sense or he croses therepy over the taters. thus kantaplavenatarati = kantaplavika, Otupika tho croses tith a rart.
s: The affix ठक् comes after a word in the Instrumental -3rd case in construction, in the sense of 'he crosses thereby over the waters'. Thus काण्डप्लवेनतरति = काण्डप्लविकः, औडुपिकः 'who crosses with a raft'.

pk: The aril Wan cones arter the word gopucCa in the sense or he croses thereby. The direrence betwen Wak and Wan is in the acent. Thus gOpucCika
ck: the aril tan cones arter the tort kopuca in the sense or he croses therepy. the tirerence peten tak ant tan is in the acent. thus kOpucika
s: The affix ठञ् comes after the word गोपुच्छ in the sense of 'he crosses thereby'. The difference between ठक् and ठञ् is in the accent. Thus गौपुच्छिकः

pk: The aril Wan cones arter the word nO and arter bases having two sylables in the sense or he croses therewith. Karika akarsatparpadaBerstradiBya kusidasutraca avasaTatkisarade sita saqete WagaDikare This debars Wak Thus nava tarati = navika a sailor. so also arter disylabic words: as, Gawika, plavika, bahuka The sa in sWan in the sutra is not part or the aril, but cones through sandhi rules.
