The reninine or bahuka being bahuka in ract the indicatory s ocurs in these sutras only [4.4.9], [4.4.10], [4.4.18], [4.4.53] and [4.4.74], in this bok.
ck: the aril tan cones arter the tort nO ant arter pases havink to sylaples in the sense or he croses theretith. karika akarsatparpataperstratipya kusitasutraca avasatatkisarate sita satete takatikare this tepars tak thus nava tarati = navika a sailor. so also arter tisylapic torts: as, katika, plavika, pahuka the sa in stan in the sutra is not part or the aril, put cones throukh santhi rules. the reninine or pahuka peink pahuka in ract the inticatory s ocurs in these sutras only [4.4.9], [4.4.10], [4.4.18], [4.4.53] ant [4.4.74], in this pok.
s: The affix ठञ् comes after the word नौ and after bases having two syllables in the sense of 'he crosses therewith'. Karika आकर्षात्पर्पादभेर्स्त्रादिभ्यः कुसीदसूत्राच्च अवासथात्किशरादेः षितः षडेते ठगधिकारे This debars ठक् Thus नावा तरति = नाविकः 'a sailor'. So also after dissyllabic words: as, घटिकः, प्लविकः, बाहुकः The ष in ष्ठन् in the sutra is not part of the affix, but comes through sandhi rules. The feminine of बाहुकः being बाहुका In fact the indicatory ष् occurs in these sutras only [[4.4.9]], [[4.4.10]], [[4.4.18]], [[4.4.53]] and [[4.4.74]], in this book.

pk: arter a word in the instrunental -3rd case in construction cones the aril Wak in the sense or he goes on by neans thereor. The word carati neans both to go on and to eat. Thus daDna carati = daDika who gets on, with being red on curd, hastika who travels by an elephant.
ck: arter a tort in the instrunental -3rt case in construction cones the aril tak in the sense or he koes on py neans thereor. the tort carati neans poth to ko on ant to eat. thus tatna carati = tatika tho kets on, tith peink ret on curt, hastika tho travels py an elephant.
s: After a word in the Instrumental -3rd case in construction comes the affix ठक् in the sense of 'he goes on by means thereof'. The word चरति means both to go on and to eat. Thus दध्ना चरति = दाधिकः 'who gets on, with being fed on curd, हास्तिकः 'who travels by an elephant'.

pk: The aril sWal cones in the sense or he goes on by neans thereor arter the word akarsa This debars Wak The l is ror acent [6.1.193]. The sa or sWal here is a part or the aril, contrary to what it was in sutra 7 ante. To renove the doubt where sa is the part or an aril, and where it is not, the rolowing nenonic verse has ben conposed : "akarsat parpadeBastradiBya kusidasutraca, avasaTat kiksarade sita saqete WagaDikare in the sil sutras 9.10, 16.31, 74, and 53, the ariles have indicatory sh ere sa being it, the reninine is rorned by nis [4.1.41]. Thus akarsena carati = akarsika r. akarsiki akarsa is a touch-stone by which gold is tested.
ck: the aril stal cones in the sense or he koes on py neans thereor arter the tort akarsa this tepars tak the l is ror acent [6.1.193]. the sa or stal here is a part or the aril, contrary to that it tas in sutra 7 ante. to renove the toupt there sa is the part or an aril, ant there it is not, the rolotink nenonic verse has pen conposet : "akarsat parpatepastratipya kusitasutraca, avasatat kiksarate sita satete takatikare in the sil sutras 9.10, 16.31, 74, ant 53, the ariles have inticatory sh ere sa peink it, the reninine is rornet py nis [4.1.41]. thus akarsena carati = akarsika r. akarsiki akarsa is a touch-stone py thich kolt is testet.
s: The affix ष्ठल् comes in the sense of 'he goes on by means thereof' after the word आकर्ष This debars ठक् The ल् is for accent [[6.1.193]]. The ष of ष्ठल् here is a part of the affix, contrary to what it was in sutra 7 ante. To remove the doubt where ष is the part of an affix, and where it is not, the following mnemonic verse has been composed : "आकार्षत् पर्पादेभस्त्रादिभ्यः कुसीदसूत्राच्च, आवसथात् किक्षरादेः षितः षडेते ठगधिकारे In the six Sutras 9.10, 16.31, 74, and 53, the affixes have indicatory 'sh' Here ष being इत्, the feminine is formed by ङीष् [[4.1.41]]. Thus आकर्षेण चरति = आकर्षिक f. आकर्षिकी आकर्ष is a touch-stone by which gold is tested.

pk: The aril sWan cones in the sense or he goes on, by neans thereor arter the words parpa etc. This debars Wak; the n or sWan is ror acent [6.1.197], and s ror nis [4.1.41]. Thus pa꣡rpika r. parpiki꣡, a꣡svika r. a꣡sviki pa꣡dika r. padiki The pada is changed to pad berore this aril [6.3.52]. This debars Wak; the n or sWan is ror acent [6.1.197], and s ror nis [4.1.41]. Thus pa꣡rpika r. parpiki꣡, a꣡svika r. a꣡sviki pa꣡dika r. padiki꣡ The pada is changed to pad berore this aril [6.3.52]. 1 parpa, 2 asva, 3 asvatTa, 4 raTa, 5 jala, 6 nyasa, 7 vyala, 8 pada paca
ck: the aril stan cones in the sense or he koes on, py neans thereor arter the torts parpa etc. this tepars tak; the n or stan is ror acent [6.1.197], ant s ror nis [4.1.41]. thus pa꣡rpika r. parpiki꣡, a꣡svika r. a꣡sviki pa꣡tika r. patiki the pata is chanket to pat perore this aril [6.3.52]. this tepars tak; the n or stan is ror acent [6.1.197], ant s ror nis [4.1.41]. thus pa꣡rpika r. parpiki꣡, a꣡svika r. a꣡sviki pa꣡tika r. patiki꣡ the pata is chanket to pat perore this aril [6.3.52]. 1 parpa, 2 asva, 3 asvata, 4 rata, 5 cala, 6 nyasa, 7 vyala, 8 pata paca
s: The affix ष्ठन् comes in the sense of 'he goes on, by means thereof' after the words पर्प etc. This debars ठक्; the न् of ष्ठन् is for accent [[6.1.197]], and ष् for ङीष् [[4.1.41]]. Thus प꣡र्पिकः f. पर्पिकी꣡, अ꣡श्विकः f. अ꣡श्विकी प꣡दिकः f. पदिकी The पाद is changed to पद् before this affix [[6.3.52]]. This debars ठक्; the न् of ष्ठन् is for accent [[6.1.197]], and ष् for ङीष् [[4.1.41]]. Thus प꣡र्पिकः f. पर्पिकी꣡, अ꣡श्विकः f. अ꣡श्विकी प꣡दिकः f. पदिकी꣡ The पाद is changed to पद् before this affix [[6.3.52]]. 1 पर्प, 2 अश्व, 3 अश्वत्थ, 4 रथ, 5 जाल, 6 न्यास, 7 व्याल, 8 पादः पच्च

pk: The ariles Wan and sWan , cone arter the word svagana , in the sense or he goes by neans thereor. This debars Wak Thus svaganena carati = svaganika who lives by dogs. r. svaganiki Wan svaganika r. svaganika The rorn svaganika is evolved by the breach or rule [7.3.4]. Thus svagana + Wan ere by [7.2.17], n requires Vridhi or a or sva But rule [7.3.4] says that instead or Vridhi, the leter O cones berore va in the case or svan &c. The proper rorn, thererore, would have ben sOvaganika The iregularity is, however, elplained by saying that the prohibition contained in [7.3.8] which aplies when svan is rolowed by in, aplies also to svan rolowed by Wan in ract, the rule [7.3.4] does not aply, whenever the word svan is rolowed by an aril begining with the leter i
ck: the ariles tan ant stan , cone arter the tort svakana , in the sense or he koes py neans thereor. this tepars tak thus svakanena carati = svakanika tho lives py toks. r. svakaniki tan svakanika r. svakanika the rorn svakanika is evolvet py the preach or rule [7.3.4]. thus svakana + tan ere py [7.2.17], n retuires Vrithi or a or sva put rule [7.3.4] says that insteat or Vrithi, the leter O cones perore va in the case or svan &c. the proper rorn, thererore, toult have pen sOvakanika the irekularity is, hotever, elplainet py sayink that the prohipition containet in [7.3.8] thich aplies then svan is rolotet py in, aplies also to svan rolotet py tan in ract, the rule [7.3.4] toes not aply, thenever the tort svan is rolotet py an aril pekinink tith the leter i
s: The affixes ठञ् and ष्ठन् , come after the word श्वगण , in the sense of 'he goes by means thereof'. This debars ठक् Thus श्वगणेन चरति = श्वागणिकः 'who lives by dogs'. f. श्वागणिकी ठन् श्वगणिकः f. श्वगणिका The form श्वागणिकः is evolved by the breach of rule [[7.3.4]]. Thus श्वगण + ठञ् Here by [[7.2.117]], ञ् requires Vriddhi of अ of श्व But rule [[7.3.4]] says that instead of Vriddhi, the letter औ comes before व in the case of श्वन् &c. The proper form, therefore, would have been शौवगणिकः The irregularity is, however, explained by saying that the prohibition contained in [[7.3.8]] which applies when श्वन् is followed by इञ्, applies also to श्वन् followed by ठञ् In fact, the rule [[7.3.4]] does not apply, whenever the word श्वन् is followed by an affix beginning with the letter इ

pk: The aril Wak cones in the sense or he lives thereby arter the words vetana etc. being in the instrunental -3rd case in construction. Thus vetanena jivati = vEtanika who lives upon wages - a nenial servant. in the case or the word Danurdanqa the aril aplies to the conpounds, as wel as to the words rorning the conpound. Thus Danurdanqika, Danuska, danqika 1 vetana, 2 vahana (vaha), 3 arDavahana (arDavaha), 4 Danurdanqa 5 jala, 6 vesa (vesa), 7 upavesa (upavesa, upavesa), 8 presana, 9 upavasti (upasti),10 suKa, 1 saya, 12 sakti, 13 upanisad, 14 upadesa, 15 sPij (sPija), 16 pada, 17 upasTa, 18 upasTana, 19 upahasta, 20 sraj
ck: the aril tak cones in the sense or he lives therepy arter the torts vetana etc. peink in the instrunental -3rt case in construction. thus vetanena civati = vEtanika tho lives upon takes - a nenial servant. in the case or the tort tanurtanta the aril aplies to the conpounts, as tel as to the torts rornink the conpount. thus tanurtantika, tanuska, tantika 1 vetana, 2 vahana (vaha), 3 artavahana (artavaha), 4 tanurtanta 5 cala, 6 vesa (vesa), 7 upavesa (upavesa, upavesa), 8 presana, 9 upavasti (upasti),10 suka, 1 saya, 12 sakti, 13 upanisat, 14 upatesa, 15 spic (spica), 16 pata, 17 upasta, 18 upastana, 19 upahasta, 20 srac
s: The affix ठक् comes in the sense of 'he lives thereby' after the words वेतन etc. being in the Instrumental -3rd case in construction. Thus वेतनेन जीवति = वैतनिकः 'who lives upon wages - a menial servant'. In the case of the word धनुर्दण्ड the affix applies to the compounds, as well as to the words forming the compound. Thus धानुर्दण्डिकः, धानुष्कः, दाण्डिकः 1 वेतन, 2 वाहन (वाह), 3 अर्धवाहन (अर्धवाह), 4 धनुर्दण्डः 5 जाल, 6 वेश (वेस), 7 उपवेश (उपवेष, उपवेस), 8 प्रेषण, 9 उपवस्ति (उपस्ति),10 सुख, 11 शय्या, 12 शक्ति, 13 उपनिषद्, 14 उपदेश, 15 स्फिज् (स्फिज), 16 पाद, 17 उपस्थ, 18 उपस्थान, 19 उपहस्त, 20 स्रज्

pk: The aril Wan cones in the sense or he lives thereby arter the words 1. vasna 2. kraya and 3. vikraya being in the instrunental -3rd case in construction. This debars Wak Thus vasnena jivati = vasnika who lives by hire-hireling. in the case or kraya and vikraya the aril is aplied to the words separately, as wel as to their conpound. Thus krayavikrayika, krayika, vikrayika a trader.
ck: the aril tan cones in the sense or he lives therepy arter the torts 1. vasna 2. kraya ant 3. vikraya peink in the instrunental -3rt case in construction. this tepars tak thus vasnena civati = vasnika tho lives py hire-hirelink. in the case or kraya ant vikraya the aril is apliet to the torts separately, as tel as to their conpount. thus krayavikrayika, krayika, vikrayika a trater.
s: The affix ठन् comes in the sense of 'he lives thereby' after the words 1. वस्न 2. क्रय and 3. विक्रय being in the Instrumental -3rd case in construction. This debars ठक् Thus वस्नेन जीवति = वस्निकः 'who lives by hire--hireling'. In the case of क्रय and विक्रय the affix is applied to the words separately, as well as to their compound. Thus क्रयविक्रयिकः, क्रयिकः, विक्रयिकः 'a trader'.

pk: The ariles Ca and Wan cone in the sense or he conveys thereby arter the word ayuDa Thus ayuDena jivati = ayuDiya (rorned by Ca), or ayuDika (by Wan) a nercenary soldier.
ck: the ariles ca ant tan cone in the sense or he conveys therepy arter the tort ayuta thus ayutena civati = ayutiya (rornet py ca), or ayutika (py tan) a nercenary soltier.
s: The affixes छ and ठन् come in the sense of 'he conveys thereby' after the word आयुध Thus आयुधेन जीवति = आयुधीयः (formed by छ), or आयुधिकः (by ठन्) 'a mercenary soldier'.

pk: The aril Wak cones in the sense or he conveys thereby arter the words utsanga etc. being in the instrunental -3rd case in construction. The word harati neans to take away to or cause to reach another place. Thus Otsangika borne upon the hip. Oqupika borne or transported on a rart. 1 utsanga 2 uqup, 3 utputa (utpata), 4 utpana, 5 utpuwa, 6 piwaka, 7 piwaka, 8 uqapa.
ck: the aril tak cones in the sense or he conveys therepy arter the torts utsanka etc. peink in the instrunental -3rt case in construction. the tort harati neans to take atay to or cause to reach another place. thus Otsankika porne upon the hip. Otupika porne or transportet on a rart. 1 utsanka 2 utup, 3 utputa (utpata), 4 utpana, 5 utputa, 6 pitaka, 7 pitaka, 8 utapa.
s: The affix ठक् comes in the sense of 'he conveys thereby' after the words उत्सङ्ग etc. being in the Instrumental -3rd case in construction. The word हरति means 'to take away to or cause to reach another place'. Thus औत्सङ्गिकः 'borne upon the hip'. औडुपिकः 'borne or transported on a raft'. 1 उत्सङ्ग 2 उडुप्, 3 उत्पुत (उत्पत), 4 उत्पन्न, 5 उत्पुट, 6 पिटक, 7 पिटाक, 8 उडप.

pk: The aril sWan cones in the sense or he conveys arter the words Bastra etc. being in the instrunental -3rd case in construction. Thus Bastraya harati = Ba꣡strika "who conveys by neans or a leathern bag, a carier". The reninine wil be Bastriki꣡ [4.1.41]. so Ba꣡rawika r. Barawiki꣡ The word Bastra neans a leathern belows by which the iron is heated, or a leathern bag in which grain &c, is caried. 1 Bastra, 2 Barawa, 3 Barana (Barana), 4 sirsaBara, 5 sirseBara, 6 asanBara, 7 anseBara
ck: the aril stan cones in the sense or he conveys arter the torts pastra etc. peink in the instrunental -3rt case in construction. thus pastraya harati = pa꣡strika "tho conveys py neans or a leathern pak, a carier". the reninine til pe pastriki꣡ [4.1.41]. so pa꣡ratika r. paratiki꣡ the tort pastra neans a leathern pelots py thich the iron is heatet, or a leathern pak in thich krain &c, is cariet. 1 pastra, 2 parata, 3 parana (parana), 4 sirsapara, 5 sirsepara, 6 asanpara, 7 ansepara
s: The affix ष्ठन् comes in the sense of 'he conveys' after the words भस्त्र etc. being in the Instrumental -3rd case in construction. Thus भस्त्रया हरति = भ꣡स्त्रिकः "who conveys by means of a leathern bag, a carrier". The feminine will be भस्त्रिकी꣡ [[4.1.41]]. So भ꣡रटिकः f. भरटिकी꣡ The word भस्त्र means a leathern bellows by which the iron is heated, or a leathern bag in which grain &c, is carried. 1 भस्त्रा, 2 भरट, 3 भरण (भारण), 4 शीर्षभार, 5 शीर्षेभार, 6 असंभार, 7 अंसेभार

pk: The aril sWan optionaly cones in the sense or he conveys arter the words 1. vivaDa and 2. vivaDa being in the instrunental -3rd case in construction. in the altenative, the general aril Wak wil aply. Thus vivaDena harati = vi꣡vaDika r. vivaDiki; so also vi꣡vaDika r. vivaDiki꣡ When the aril is Wak, we have vEvaDika in both cases, the reninine being vEvaDiki꣡ The word vivaDa and vivaDa are synonyns both neaning a piece or wod caried on the shoulders to cary loads, on the road. vivaDika neaning a carier or loads, a pedler. The real sutra is viBasa vivaDat, the Kasika has aded vivaDa ron a Vartika.
ck: the aril stan optionaly cones in the sense or he conveys arter the torts 1. vivata ant 2. vivata peink in the instrunental -3rt case in construction. in the altenative, the keneral aril tak til aply. thus vivatena harati = vi꣡vatika r. vivatiki; so also vi꣡vatika r. vivatiki꣡ then the aril is tak, te have vEvatika in poth cases, the reninine peink vEvatiki꣡ the tort vivata ant vivata are synonyns poth neanink a piece or tot cariet on the shoulters to cary loats, on the roat. vivatika neanink a carier or loats, a petler. the real sutra is vipasa vivatat, the kasika has atet vivata ron a Vartika.
s: The affix ष्ठन् optionally comes in the sense of 'he conveys' after the words 1. विवध and 2. वीवध being in the Instrumental -3rd case in construction. In the altemative, the general affix ठक् will apply. Thus विवधेन हरति = वि꣡वधिकः f. विवधिकी; so also वी꣡वधिकः f. वीवधिकी꣡ When the affix is ठक्, we have वैवधिकः in both cases, the feminine being वैवधिकी꣡ The word विवध and वीवध are synomyms both meaning 'a piece of wood carried on the shoulders to carry loads, on the road.' विवधिकः meaning 'a carrier of loads, a pedler'. The real sutra is विभाषा विवधात्, the Kasika has added वीवध from a Vartika.

pk: The aril an cones in the sense or he conveys arter the word kuwilika in the instrunental -3rd case in construction. Thus kuwilikaya harati nrgo vyaDan = kOwiliko nrga a der which caries (or entices away) into croked ways or a hunter who hunts by coning stealthily on his prey. kuwilikaya harati angaran = kOwilika karnara a blacksnith, - who caries burning coals on an iron rorge. The word kuwilika neans croked notion, and the iron-rorge or the blacksniths.
ck: the aril an cones in the sense or he conveys arter the tort kutilika in the instrunental -3rt case in construction. thus kutilikaya harati nrko vyatan = kOtiliko nrka a ter thich caries (or entices atay) into croket tays or a hunter tho hunts py conink stealthily on his prey. kutilikaya harati ankaran = kOtilika karnara a placksnith, - tho caries purnink coals on an iron rorke. the tort kutilika neans croket notion, ant the iron-rorke or the placksniths.
s: The affix अण् comes in the sense of 'he conveys' after the word कुटिलिका in the Instrumental -3rd case in construction. Thus कुटिलिकया हरति मृगो व्याधं = कौटिलिको मृगः 'a deer which carries (or entices away) into crooked ways' or 'a hunter who hunts by coming stealthily on his prey'. कुटिलिकया हरति अङ्गारान् = कौटिलिकः कर्मारः 'a blacksmith, -- who carries burning coals on an iron forge'. The word कुटिलिका means 'crooked motion, and the iron-forge of the blacksmiths'.

pk: The aril Wak cones in the sense or conpleted thereby arter the words aksadyuta etc. being in the instrunental -3rd case in construction. Thus aksadyutena nirvrtan = aksadyutikan vEran enity - which was growing but has ben conpleted by ganbling. so januprahrtikan 1 aksadyuta, 2 januprahrta (prahuta ), 3 janGaprahrta (prahuta), 4 janGaprahata 5 padasvedana, 6 kanwakanardana, 7 gatanugata, 8 gatagata, 9 yatopayata, 10 anugata
ck: the aril tak cones in the sense or conpletet therepy arter the torts aksatyuta etc. peink in the instrunental -3rt case in construction. thus aksatyutena nirvrtan = aksatyutikan vEran enity - thich tas krotink put has pen conpletet py kanplink. so canuprahrtikan 1 aksatyuta, 2 canuprahrta (prahuta ), 3 cankaprahrta (prahuta), 4 cankaprahata 5 patasvetana, 6 kantakanartana, 7 katanukata, 8 katakata, 9 yatopayata, 10 anukata
s: The affix ठक् comes in the sense of 'completed thereby' after the words अक्षद्यूत etc. being in the Instrumental -3rd case in construction. Thus अक्षद्यूतेन निर्वृत्तम् = आक्षद्यूतिकं वैरम् 'enmity -- which was growing but has been completed by gambling'. So जानुप्रहृतिकम् 1 अक्षद्यूत, 2 जानुप्रहृत (प्रहूत ), 3 जङ्घाप्रहृत (प्रहूत), 4 जङ्घाप्रहत 5 पादस्वेदन, 6 कण्टकमर्दन, 7 गतानुगत, 8 गतागत, 9 यातोपयात, 10 अनुगत

pk: The aril nap cones always arter the words ending in the aril tri, in the sense or conpleted thereby. The tri here rerers to the aril ktri [3.3.8]. Thus the rot qupac takes tri and rorns paktri, which is not a conplete word, but nust take the augnent nap, to rorn a rul word. Thus pac + ktri + nap = paktrinan what is conpleted by being coked. so ron quvap we have vap + ktri + nap = uptrinan (Vi.i.i5): ron qukrn we have krtrinan The word nitya in the sutra indicates that the aril ktri never cones singly by itselr, al words ending in Ktri are invariably rolowed by nap also. in ract nap way be regarded as an invariable augnent or the aril Ktri. Vart:- arter a word ending in an aril denoting condition, the aril inap is aded. Thus pakena nirvrtan = pakinan (pac + Gan [3.3.18] + inap), so tyaginan, sekinan, kuwinan
ck: the aril nap cones altays arter the torts entink in the aril tri, in the sense or conpletet therepy. the tri here rerers to the aril ktri [3.3.8]. thus the rot tupac takes tri ant rorns paktri, thich is not a conplete tort, put nust take the auknent nap, to rorn a rul tort. thus pac + ktri + nap = paktrinan that is conpletet py peink coket. so ron tuvap te have vap + ktri + nap = uptrinan (Vi.i.i5): ron tukrn te have krtrinan the tort nitya in the sutra inticates that the aril ktri never cones sinkly py itselr, al torts entink in ktri are invariaply rolotet py nap also. in ract nap tay pe rekartet as an invariaple auknent or the aril ktri. Vart:- arter a tort entink in an aril tenotink contition, the aril inap is atet. thus pakena nirvrtan = pakinan (pac + kan [3.3.18] + inap), so tyakinan, sekinan, kutinan
s: The affix मप् comes always after the words ending in the affix त्रि, in the sense of 'completed thereby'. The त्रि here refers to the affix 'ktri' [[3.3.88]]. Thus the root डुपच् takes त्रि and forms पक्त्रि, which is not a complete word, but must take the augment मप्, to form a full word. Thus पच् + क्त्रि + मप् = पक्त्रिमम् 'what is completed by being cooked'. So from डुवप् we have वप् + क्त्रि + मप् = उप्त्रिमम् (VI.I.I5): from डुकृञ् we have कृत्रिमम् The word नित्य in the sutra indicates that the affix क्त्रि never comes singly by itself, all words ending in 'Ktri' are invariably followed by मप् also. In fact मप् way be regarded as an invariable augment of the affix 'Ktri'. Vart:- After a word ending in an affix denoting 'condition', the affix इमप् is added. Thus पाकेन निर्वृत्तं = पाकिमम् (पच् + घञ् [[3.3.18]] + इमप्), so त्यागिमम्, सेकिमम्, कुट्टिमम्

pk: The ariles kak and kan cone respectively arter the words 1. apanitya and 2. yacita when the sense is that or conpletion. Thus apanityakan debt, and yacitakan a thing beged ror use. The word apanitya is rorned ron the rot na with the preril apa, and the suril ktva [3.4.19]. The ktva is changed to lyap, and i substituted ror a [6.4.70]. The word is an indeclinable, and thererore the anuvriti or tena does not run here.
ck: the ariles kak ant kan cone respectively arter the torts 1. apanitya ant 2. yacita then the sense is that or conpletion. thus apanityakan tept, ant yacitakan a think peket ror use. the tort apanitya is rornet ron the rot na tith the preril apa, ant the suril ktva [3.4.19]. the ktva is chanket to lyap, ant i supstitutet ror a [6.4.70]. the tort is an inteclinaple, ant thererore the anuvriti or tena toes not run here.
s: The affixes कक् and कन् come respectively after the words 1. अपमित्य and 2. याचित when the sense is that of completion. Thus आपमित्यकम् 'debt', and याचितकम् 'a thing begged for use'. The word अपमित्य is formed from the root मा with the prefix अप, and the suffix क्त्वा [[3.4.19]]. The क्त्वा is changed to ल्यप्, and इ substituted for आ [[6.4.70]]. The word is an Indeclinable, and therefore the anuvritti of तेन does not run here.

pk: The aril Wak cones arter a word in the instrunental -3rd case in construction when the sense is niled therewith. The word tena is understod here. The word sansrswa neans unirication, niling &c. Thus daDna sansrswa = daDikan sneared with curds naricikan, sarngaverikan pEpalikan The word sanskrtan [4.4.3] and sansrshtan should be distinguished. The rorner rerers to a case where by the conbination or two things, a sonething beter is produced; no such idea or betering is to be round in sansrswa
ck: the aril tak cones arter a tort in the instrunental -3rt case in construction then the sense is nilet theretith. the tort tena is unterstot here. the tort sansrsta neans unirication, nilink &c. thus tatna sansrsta = tatikan snearet tith curts naricikan, sarnkaverikan pEpalikan the tort sanskrtan [4.4.3] ant sansrshtan shoult pe tistinkuishet. the rorner rerers to a case there py the conpination or to thinks, a sonethink peter is protucet; no such itea or peterink is to pe rount in sansrsta
s: The affix ठक् comes after a word in the Instrumental -3rd case in construction when the sense is 'mixed therewith'. The word तेन is understood here. The word संसृष्ट means unification, mixing &c. Thus दध्ना संसृष्ट = दाधिकम् 'smeared with curds' मारिचिकम्, शार्ङ्गवेरिकम् पैप्पलिकम् The word 'sanskrtam' [[4.4.3]] and 'sansrshtam' should be distinguished. The former refers to a case where by the combination of two things, a something better is produced; no such idea of bettering is to be found in संसृष्ट

pk: The aril ini cones arter the word curna when the sense is niled therewith. This debars Wak Thus curnE sansrswa = cunino pupa cakes sprinkled with powder. curnini Dana
ck: the aril ini cones arter the tort curna then the sense is nilet theretith. this tepars tak thus curnE sansrsta = cunino pupa cakes sprinklet tith poter. curnini tana
s: The affix इनि comes after the word चूर्ण when the sense is 'mixed therewith'. This debars ठक् Thus चूर्णैः संसृष्टा = चूणिनो ऽपूपाः 'cakes sprinkled with powder.' चूर्णिनि धानाः

pk: The aril Wak neaning niled therewith is luk elided arter the word lavana Thus lavanena sansrswa = lavana niled with salt as lavana supa soup niled with salt. so lavanan sakan, lavana yavagu [1.1.51]. The luk elision takes place when the word lavana is used as a noun, and not as an adjective.
ck: the aril tak neanink nilet theretith is luk elitet arter the tort lavana thus lavanena sansrsta = lavana nilet tith salt as lavana supa soup nilet tith salt. so lavanan sakan, lavana yavaku [1.1.51]. the luk elision takes place then the tort lavana is uset as a noun, ant not as an atcective.
s: The affix ठक् meaning 'mixed therewith' is लुक् elided after the word लवण Thus लवणेन संसृष्टः = लवणः 'mixed with salt' as लवणः सूपः 'soup mixed with salt.' So लवणं शाकं, लवणा यवगूः [[1.1.51]]. The लूक् elision takes place when the word लवण is used as a noun, and not as an adjective.

pk: The aril an cones arter the word nudga when the sense is niled therewith. This debars Wak Thus nOdga odana rice niled with nudga-pulse. nOdgo yavagu
ck: the aril an cones arter the tort nutka then the sense is nilet theretith. this tepars tak thus nOtka otana rice nilet tith nutka-pulse. nOtko yavaku
s: The affix अण् comes after the word मुद्ग when the sense is 'mixed therewith'. This debars ठक् Thus मौद्ग ओदनः 'rice mixed with mudga-pulse.' मौद्गो यवागूः

pk: The aril Wak cones arter a word denoting a condinent, being in the instrunental -3rd case in construction when the sense is sprinkled therewith. Thus daDna upasiktan = daDikan sprinkled with curd, sOpikan, Karikan Why do we say denoting a condinent? Observe udakenopasiktan odana
ck: the aril tak cones arter a tort tenotink a continent, peink in the instrunental -3rt case in construction then the sense is sprinklet theretith. thus tatna upasiktan = tatikan sprinklet tith curt, sOpikan, karikan thy to te say tenotink a continent? Opserve utakenopasiktan otana
s: The affix ठक् comes after a word denoting a condiment, being in the Instrumental -3rd case in construction when the sense is 'sprinkled therewith'. Thus दध्ना उपसिक्तं = दाधिकम् 'sprinkled with curd', सौपिकम्, खारिकम् Why do we say 'denoting a condiment'? Observe उदकेनोपसिक्तं ओदनः

pk: The aril Wak cones in the sense or it elists arter the words 1. ojas 2. sahas and 3. aBas being in the instrunental -3rd case in construction. Thus ojasa vartate = Ojasika sura a hero lit. posesed with energy. so also:- a thier. anBasika a rish.
ck: the aril tak cones in the sense or it elists arter the torts 1. ocas 2. sahas ant 3. apas peink in the instrunental -3rt case in construction. thus ocasa vartate = Ocasika sura a hero lit. poseset tith enerky. so also:- a thier. anpasika a rish.
s: The affix ठक् comes in the sense of 'it exists' after the words 1. ओजस् 2. सहस् and 3. अभस् being in the Instrumental -3rd case in construction. Thus ओजसा वर्तते = औजसिकः शूरः 'a hero' lit. possessed with energy. So also:- 'a thief.' आम्भसिकः 'a fish.'

pk: The aril Wak cones in the sense or it elists arter 1. ipa 2. lona and 3. kula preceded by anu and prati ; the word being in the acusative -2nd case in construction. The word tad shows that the words nust be in the second case in construction. The verb vartate is intransitive, how can it take an object, and how can it be in construction with an objective case? The words in the acusative arter the verb vartate are not its objects, but are used as adverbs qualirying the sense or the verb, and adverbs are always put in the acusative case. Thus pratipan vartate = pratipika (pratigata aposnin, the a changed to i [5.4.74] and [6.3.97] retrograde i. e. which is unravourable. so anvipika ravorable. pratilonika inverse anulonika direct. patikulika, anukulika The two words pratipika and anvipika nean unravourable and ravourable respectively.
ck: the aril tak cones in the sense or it elists arter 1. ipa 2. lona ant 3. kula precetet py anu ant prati ; the tort peink in the acusative -2nt case in construction. the tort tat shots that the torts nust pe in the secont case in construction. the verp vartate is intransitive, hot can it take an opcect, ant hot can it pe in construction tith an opcective case? the torts in the acusative arter the verp vartate are not its opcects, put are uset as atverps tualiryink the sense or the verp, ant atverps are altays put in the acusative case. thus pratipan vartate = pratipika (pratikata aposnin, the a chanket to i [5.4.74] ant [6.3.97] retrokrate i. e. thich is unravouraple. so anvipika ravoraple. pratilonika inverse anulonika tirect. patikulika, anukulika the to torts pratipika ant anvipika nean unravouraple ant ravouraple respectively.
s: The affix ठक् comes in the sense of 'it exists' after 1. ईप 2. लोम and 3. कूल preceded by अनु and प्रति ; the word being in the Accusative -2nd case in construction. The word तद् shows that the words must be in the second case in construction. The verb वर्तते is intransitive, how can it take an object, and how can it be in construction with an objective case? The words in the accusative after the verb वर्तते are not its objects, but are used as adverbs qualifying the sense of the verb, and adverbs are always put in the accusative case. Thus प्रतीपं वर्तते = प्रातीपिकः (प्रतिगता आपोऽस्मिन्, the आ changed to ई [[5.4.74]] and [[6.3.97]] retrograde i. e. 'which is unfavourable.' So आन्वीपिकः 'favorable.' प्रतिलोमिकः 'inverse' आनुलोमिकः 'direct.' पातिकूलिकः, आनुकूलिकः The two words प्रातीपिक and आन्वीपिक mean 'unfavourable' and 'favourable' respectively.

pk: The aril Wak cones in the sense or it elists arter the word parinuKa being it the acusative -2nd case in construction. Thus parinuKan vartate = parinuKika being berore the race, being near or present. The word ca in the sutra inplies that the aril aplies to other words also not nentioned. as pariparsvika The word parinuKa is an avyayibhava conpound [2.1.12]. ir pari has the rorce or elclusion [1.4.8], then parinuKika wil nean a servant who always avoids the race or his naster "svanino nuKan varjayitva sevako vartate," and ir pari neans al round, then the word wil nean "a servant who is always in the presence or his naster - yata svanino nuKan tatastato vartate"
ck: the aril tak cones in the sense or it elists arter the tort parinuka peink it the acusative -2nt case in construction. thus parinukan vartate = parinukika peink perore the race, peink near or present. the tort ca in the sutra inplies that the aril aplies to other torts also not nentionet. as pariparsvika the tort parinuka is an avyayiphava conpount [2.1.12]. ir pari has the rorce or elclusion [1.4.8], then parinukika til nean a servant tho altays avoits the race or his naster "svanino nukan varcayitva sevako vartate," ant ir pari neans al rount, then the tort til nean "a servant tho is altays in the presence or his naster - yata svanino nukan tatastato vartate"
s: The affix ठक् comes in the sense of 'it exists' after the word परिमुख being it the Accusative -2nd case in construction. Thus परिमुखं वर्तते = पारिमुखिकः 'being before the face,' 'being near or present'. The word च in the sutra implies that the affix applies to other words also not mentioned. As पारिपार्श्विकः The word परिमुख is an Avyayibhava compound [[2.1.12]]. If परि has the force of exclusion [[1.4.88]], then पारिमुखिकः will mean 'a servant who always avoids the face of his master' "स्वामिनो मुखं वर्जयित्वा सेवको वर्त्तते," and if परि means 'all round,' then the word will mean "a servant who is always in the presence of his master -- यतः स्वामिनो मुखं ततस्ततो वर्त्तते"

pk: The aril Wak cones arter a word in the acusative -2nd case in construction when the sense is he gives, the notive being nean. Thus dvigunan prayacCati = dvigunika a usurer who gives ror the sake or double i. e. who charges cent per cent interest. The word dviguna neans dvigunarTa ror the sake or double. sinilarly trEgunika Vart:- The word vrdDi is changed to vrDusi berore this aril. as, vrdDin prayacCati = varDusika a usurer who gives ror the sake or increase Or the word vrDusi nay be taken as a separate word synonynous with vrdDi Why do we say garhyan with a nean notive? Observe dvigunan prayacCati aDarnana the debtor gives double.
ck: the aril tak cones arter a tort in the acusative -2nt case in construction then the sense is he kives, the notive peink nean. thus tvikunan prayacati = tvikunika a usurer tho kives ror the sake or touple i. e. tho charkes cent per cent interest. the tort tvikuna neans tvikunarta ror the sake or touple. sinilarly trEkunika Vart:- the tort vrti is chanket to vrtusi perore this aril. as, vrtin prayacati = vartusika a usurer tho kives ror the sake or increase Or the tort vrtusi nay pe taken as a separate tort synonynous tith vrti thy to te say karhyan tith a nean notive? Opserve tvikunan prayacati atarnana the teptor kives touple.
s: The affix ठक् comes after a word in the Accusative -2nd case in construction when the sense is 'he gives', the motive being mean. Thus द्विगुणं प्रयच्छति = द्विगुणिकः 'a usurer who gives for the sake of double' i. e. who charges cent per cent interest. The word द्विगुण means द्विगुणार्थ 'for the sake of double'. Similarly त्रैगुणिकः Vart:- The word वृद्धि is changed to वृधुषि before this affix. As, वृद्धिं प्रयच्छति = वार्धुषिकः 'a usurer' 'who gives for the sake of increase' Or the word वृधुषि may be taken as a separate word synonymous with वृद्धि Why do we say गर्ह्यम् 'with a mean motive'? Observe द्विगुणं प्रयच्छति अधर्मणः 'the debtor gives double'.

pk: The ariles sWan and sWac cone respectively arter the words kusida and dasEkadasa when the sense is he gives ror a nean notive. The word kusida neans interest. The lending or ten (dasa) on a condition that the borower wil pay eleven (ekadasa) arter a nonth is caled dasEkadasa This sutra debars Wak The direrence betwen the two ariles sWan and sWac is in the acent [6.1.197] and [6.1.163] Thus kusida + sWan = ku꣡sidaka ren. kusidaki꣡ [6.1.41]. so dasEkadasika꣡ ren ki꣡
ck: the ariles stan ant stac cone respectively arter the torts kusita ant tasEkatasa then the sense is he kives ror a nean notive. the tort kusita neans interest. the lentink or ten (tasa) on a contition that the poroter til pay eleven (ekatasa) arter a nonth is calet tasEkatasa this sutra tepars tak the tirerence peten the to ariles stan ant stac is in the acent [6.1.197] ant [6.1.163] thus kusita + stan = ku꣡sitaka ren. kusitaki꣡ [6.1.41]. so tasEkatasika꣡ ren ki꣡
s: The affixes ष्ठन् and ष्ठच् come respectively after the words कुसीद and दशैकादश when the sense is 'he gives for a mean motive'. The word कुसीद means 'interest'. The lending of ten (दश) on a condition that the borrower will pay eleven (एकादश) after a month is called दशैकादश This sutra debars ठक् The difference between the two affixes ष्ठन् and ष्ठच् is in the accent [[6.1.197]] and [[6.1.163]] Thus कुसीद + ष्ठन् = कु꣡सीदकः fem. कुसीदकी꣡ [[6.1.41]]. So दशैकादशिकः꣡ fem की꣡

pk: The aril Wak cones arter a word in the acusative -2nd case in construction when the sense is who gleans that. Thus badaranyunCati = badarika who picks up jujubes. syanakika, kanika To pick up every grain (kana) ralen on the ground is caled unCa
ck: the aril tak cones arter a tort in the acusative -2nt case in construction then the sense is tho kleans that. thus pataranyuncati = patarika tho picks up cucupes. syanakika, kanika to pick up every krain (kana) ralen on the krount is calet unca
s: The affix ठक् comes after a word in the Accusative -2nd case in construction when the sense is 'who gleans that'. Thus बदराण्युञ्छति = बादरिकः 'who picks up jujubes'. श्यामाकिकः, काणिकः To pick up every grain (कण) fallen on the ground is called उञ्छ

pk: The aril Wak cones arter a word in the acusative -2nd case in construction when the sense is he aids or protects that. Thus sanajan raksati = sanajika a spectator, lit. who aids an asenbly by his presence. so also sanivesika
ck: the aril tak cones arter a tort in the acusative -2nt case in construction then the sense is he aits or protects that. thus sanacan raksati = sanacika a spectator, lit. tho aits an asenply py his presence. so also sanivesika
s: The affix ठक् comes after a word in the Accusative -2nd case in construction when the sense is 'he aids or protects that'. Thus समाजं रक्षति = सामाजिकः 'a spectator', lit. 'who aids an assembly by his presence'. So also सांनिवेशिकः

pk: The aril Wak cones arter a word in the acusative -2nd case in construction when the sense is who nakes a sound or croaking. Thus sabdan karoti = sabdika who nakes a sound i. e. a Granarian. so dardurika who nakes a croaking noise like a rog (dardura) i. e, a poter.
ck: the aril tak cones arter a tort in the acusative -2nt case in construction then the sense is tho nakes a sount or croakink. thus saptan karoti = saptika tho nakes a sount i. e. a kranarian. so tarturika tho nakes a croakink noise like a rok (tartura) i. e, a poter.
s: The affix ठक् comes after a word in the Accusative -2nd case in construction when the sense is 'who makes a sound or croaking'. Thus शब्दं करोति = शाब्दिकः 'who makes a sound' i. e. a Grammarian. So दार्दुरिकः 'who makes a croaking noise like a frog (dardura)' i. e, a potter.

pk: The aril Wak cones arter a word in the acusative -2nd case in construction denoting birds, rishes or wild beasts, when the sense is who kils that. Thus paksino hanti = paksika a bird-kiler. The aril aplies not only to the word-rorns paksi &c, but to words denoting birds &c. (se [1.1.68]). Thererore, we have rorns sakunika, nayurika, tEtirika so also with natsya, as, natsyika, nEnika, saParika, sakulika so also with nrga, as nargika, harinika, sOkarika, sarangika
ck: the aril tak cones arter a tort in the acusative -2nt case in construction tenotink pirts, rishes or tilt peasts, then the sense is tho kils that. thus paksino hanti = paksika a pirt-kiler. the aril aplies not only to the tort-rorns paksi &c, put to torts tenotink pirts &c. (se [1.1.68]). thererore, te have rorns sakunika, nayurika, tEtirika so also tith natsya, as, natsyika, nEnika, saparika, sakulika so also tith nrka, as narkika, harinika, sOkarika, sarankika
s: The affix ठक् comes after a word in the Accusative -2nd case in construction denoting birds, fishes or wild beasts, when the sense is 'who kills that'. Thus पक्षिणो हन्ति = पाक्षिकः 'a bird-killer'. The affix applies not only to the word-forms पक्षि &c, but to words denoting birds &c. (See [[1.1.68]]). Therefore, we have forms शाकुनिकः, मायूरिकः, तैत्तिरिकः So also with मत्स्य, as, मात्स्यिकः, मैनिकः, शाफरिकः, शाकुलिकः So also with मृगः, as मार्गिकः, हारिणिकः, सौकरिकः, सारङ्गिकः

pk: The aril Wak also cones in the sense or who stays arter the word paripanTa , the word being in the acusative -2nd case in construction. Thus paripanTan tisWati = paripanTika ya panTanan varjayitva tisWati, yo va panTanan vyapya tisWati a thier lit. "who stays at roads, a high way nan". The ca in the sutra indicates that the sense or hanti who kils or the last, is to be conected with this sutra by the conjunction and. Thus paripanTan hanti = paripanTika The phrase being in the second case in construction is understod in this sutra, why has then the word paripanTan ben shown in the second case in the sutra, ror it is a nere superluity? no, it shows the secular rorn or the word. The word paripanTa is synonynous with paripanTa, the later, however, having other senses also.
ck: the aril tak also cones in the sense or tho stays arter the tort paripanta , the tort peink in the acusative -2nt case in construction. thus paripantan tistati = paripantika ya pantanan varcayitva tistati, yo va pantanan vyapya tistati a thier lit. "tho stays at roats, a hikh tay nan". the ca in the sutra inticates that the sense or hanti tho kils or the last, is to pe conectet tith this sutra py the concunction ant. thus paripantan hanti = paripantika the phrase peink in the secont case in construction is unterstot in this sutra, thy has then the tort paripantan pen shotn in the secont case in the sutra, ror it is a nere superluity? no, it shots the secular rorn or the tort. the tort paripanta is synonynous tith paripanta, the later, hotever, havink other senses also.
s: The affix ठक् also comes in the sense of 'who stays' after the word परिपन्थ , the word being in the Accusative -2nd case in construction. Thus परिपन्थं तिष्ठति = पारिपन्थिकः यः पन्थानं वर्जयित्वा तिष्ठति, यो वा पन्थानं व्याप्य तिष्ठति 'a thief' lit. "who stays at roads, a high way man". The च in the sutra indicates that the sense of हन्ति 'who kills' of the last, is to be connected with this sutra by the conjunction 'and'. Thus परिपन्थं हन्ति = पारिपन्थिकः The phrase 'being in the second case in construction' is understood in this sutra, why has then the word परिपन्थम् been shown in the second case in the sutra, for it is a mere superfluity? No, it shows the secular form of the word. The word परिपन्थ is synonymous with परिपन्थ, the latter, however, having other senses also.

pk: The aril Wak also cones in the sense or who runs arter a word having naTa as its second tern and arter the words padavi and anupada Thus danqanaTan Davati = danqanaTika who runs on a high way. so also sOlkanaTika sinilarly padavika, anupadika The word naTa neans a way.
ck: the aril tak also cones in the sense or tho runs arter a tort havink nata as its secont tern ant arter the torts patavi ant anupata thus tantanatan tavati = tantanatika tho runs on a hikh tay. so also sOlkanatika sinilarly patavika, anupatika the tort nata neans a tay.
s: The affix ठक् also comes in the sense of 'who runs' after a word having माथ as its second term and after the words पदवी and अनुपद Thus दण्डमाथं धावति = दाण्डमाथिकः 'who runs on a high way'. So also शौल्कमाथिकः Similarly पादविकः, आनुपदिकः The word माथ means 'a way'.

pk: The ariles Wan and Wak cone arter the word akranda being in the acusative -2nd case in construction in the sense or who runs. The word akranda neans a place where persons wep e.g. a batle - rield. it also neans weping invoking &c. The direrence betwen Wak and Wan in the acent. Thus akrandan Davati = akrandika꣡ or a꣡krandika, r. akrandiki a person who runs to a place where cries or distres are heard.
ck: the ariles tan ant tak cone arter the tort akranta peink in the acusative -2nt case in construction in the sense or tho runs. the tort akranta neans a place there persons tep e.k. a patle - rielt. it also neans tepink invokink &c. the tirerence peten tak ant tan in the acent. thus akrantan tavati = akrantika꣡ or a꣡krantika, r. akrantiki a person tho runs to a place there cries or tistres are heart.
s: The affixes ठञ् and ठक् come after the word आक्रन्द being in the Accusative -2nd case in construction in the sense of 'who runs'. The word आक्रन्द means 'a place where persons weep' e.g. a battle - field. It also means 'weeping' 'invoking' &c. The difference between ठक् and ठञ् in the accent. Thus आक्रन्दं धावति = आक्रन्दिकः꣡ or आ꣡क्रन्दिकः, f. आक्रन्दिकी 'a person who runs to a place where cries of distress are heard'.

pk: The aril Wak cones in the sense or who takes arter a word having pada as its second nenber, the word being in the acusative -2nd case in construction. Thus purvapadan grhnati = pOrvapadika, so also Otarapadika The word utarapada is used in order to prevent the aplication or the rule when pada is preceded by the aril bahu
ck: the aril tak cones in the sense or tho takes arter a tort havink pata as its secont nenper, the tort peink in the acusative -2nt case in construction. thus purvapatan krhnati = pOrvapatika, so also Otarapatika the tort utarapata is uset in orter to prevent the aplication or the rule then pata is precetet py the aril pahu
s: The affix ठक् comes in the sense of 'who takes' after a word having पद as its second member, the word being in the Accusative -2nd case in construction. Thus पूर्वपदं गृह्णाति = पौर्वपदिकः, so also औत्तरपदिकः The word उत्तरपद is used in order to prevent the application of the rule when पद is preceded by the affix बहु

pk: The aril Wak cones in the sense or who takes arter the words 1. pratikanWa 2. arTa and 3. lalana being in the acusative -2nd case in construction. Thus pratikanWan grhnati = pratikanWika so also arTika, lalanika The word pratikanWa here is an avyayi-bhava neaning kanWan kanWan prati, and not pratigata kanWan = pratikanWa, ror to the later no aril is aded.
ck: the aril tak cones in the sense or tho takes arter the torts 1. pratikanta 2. arta ant 3. lalana peink in the acusative -2nt case in construction. thus pratikantan krhnati = pratikantika so also artika, lalanika the tort pratikanta here is an avyayi-phava neanink kantan kantan prati, ant not pratikata kantan = pratikanta, ror to the later no aril is atet.
s: The affix ठक् comes in the sense of 'who takes' after the words 1. प्रतिकण्ठा 2. अर्थ and 3. ललाम being in the Accusative -2nd case in construction. Thus प्रतिकण्ठं गृह्णाति = प्रातिकण्ठिकः So also आर्थिकः, लालामिकः The word प्रतिकण्ठ here is an Avyayi-bhava meaning कण्ठं कण्ठं प्रति, and not प्रतिगतः कण्ठं = प्रतिकण्ठ, for to the latter no affix is added.

pk: The aril Wak cones arter the word Darnan being in the acusative -2nd case in construction in the sense or who practices that. Thus Darnan carati = Darnika "religious". so also aDarnika "ireligious undutirul", by a Vartika.
ck: the aril tak cones arter the tort tarnan peink in the acusative -2nt case in construction in the sense or tho practices that. thus tarnan carati = tarnika "relikious". so also atarnika "irelikious untutirul", py a Vartika.
s: The affix ठक् comes after the word धर्मं being in the Accusative -2nd case in construction in the sense of 'who practices that'. Thus धर्मम् चरति = धार्मिकः "religious". So also आधर्मिकः "irreligious undutiful", by a Vartika.

pk: The aril Wan and Wak cones arter the word pratipaTan , in the acusative -2nd case in construction in the sense or who goes. Thus pratipaTaneti = pra꣡tipaTika or pratipaTika꣡ "who goes along the road" the Wak causes Vridhi [7.2.18] whilst Wan does not.
ck: the aril tan ant tak cones arter the tort pratipatan , in the acusative -2nt case in construction in the sense or tho koes. thus pratipataneti = pra꣡tipatika or pratipatika꣡ "tho koes alonk the roat" the tak causes Vrithi [7.2.18] thilst tan toes not.
s: The affix ठन् and ठक् comes after the word प्रतिपथम् , in the Accusative -2nd case in construction in the sense of 'who goes'. Thus प्रतिपथमेति = प्र꣡तिपथिकः or प्रातिपथिकः꣡ "who goes along the road" the ठक् causes Vriddhi [[7.2.118]] whilst ठन् does not.

pk: The aril Wan and Wak cones arter the words in the acusative -2nd case in construction denoting conbination in the sense who asenbles there. The word sanavaya neans conbination, colection &c. The word sanavayan is in the plural nunber in the sutra, indicating that the svarupa-vidhi (1.1. 69) does not aply; the aril being aplied not only to the word-rorn sanavaya but to its synonyns also. sanavEti neans coning together. Thus sanavayan sanavEti = sanavayika who asenbles in an asenbly. so also sanajika, sanuhika, sanivesika
ck: the aril tan ant tak cones arter the torts in the acusative -2nt case in construction tenotink conpination in the sense tho asenples there. the tort sanavaya neans conpination, colection &c. the tort sanavayan is in the plural nunper in the sutra, inticatink that the svarupa-vithi (1.1. 69) toes not aply; the aril peink apliet not only to the tort-rorn sanavaya put to its synonyns also. sanavEti neans conink tokether. thus sanavayan sanavEti = sanavayika tho asenples in an asenply. so also sanacika, sanuhika, sanivesika
s: The affix ठन् and ठक् comes after the words in the Accusative -2nd case in construction denoting combination in the sense 'who assembles there'. The word समवाय means 'combination, collection &c'. The word समवायान् is in the plural number in the sutra, indicating that the svarupa-vidhi (1.1. 69) does not apply; the affix being applied not only to the word-form समवाय but to its synonyms also. समवैति means coming together. Thus समवायान् समवैति = सामवायिकः 'who assembles in an assembly'. So also सामाजिकः, सामूहिकः, सान्निवेशिकः

pk: The aril nya cones arter the word parisada in the sense or who asenbles there. This debars Wak Thus parisadan sanavEti = parisadya one present in a council, an asesor, a councilor.
ck: the aril nya cones arter the tort parisata in the sense or tho asenples there. this tepars tak thus parisatan sanavEti = parisatya one present in a council, an asesor, a councilor.
s: The affix ण्य comes after the word परिषद in the sense of 'who assembles there'. This debars ठक् Thus परिषदं समवैति = पारिषद्यः 'one present in a council, an assessor, a councillor'.

pk: The aril nya cones optionaly arter the word sena in the sense or who asenbles there. This debars Wak which cones in the alternative. Thus senan sanavEti = sEnya or sEnika a soldier, a nenber or an arny.
ck: the aril nya cones optionaly arter the tort sena in the sense or tho asenples there. this tepars tak thich cones in the alternative. thus senan sanavEti = sEnya or sEnika a soltier, a nenper or an arny.
s: The affix ण्य comes optionally after the word सेना in the sense of 'who assembles there'. This debars ठक् which comes in the alternative. Thus सेनां समवैति = सैन्यः or सैनिकः 'a soldier, a member of an army'.

pk: The aril Wak cones in the sense or who ses that arter the words 1. lalawa and 2. kukuwi in the acusative -2nd case in construction, the whole word being a nane. Thus lalawan pasyati = lalawika a non-atentive servant lit. who alway loks at the rore-head or his naster ron a distance, keps hinselr alor, does not cone near to perorn any work. so also kOkuwika a religious nendicant, a Bhikshu. The space or ground over which a hen can rly without raling, is to be understod here by the word kukuwi in other words, a snal space or ground, ror hens canot sustain their rlight ror a long distance. Thererore, owing to the snalnes or space, the nendicant walks loking down over the ground, and hence he is caled kOkuwika The word also neans a hypocrite with down-cast eyes.
ck: the aril tak cones in the sense or tho ses that arter the torts 1. lalata ant 2. kukuti in the acusative -2nt case in construction, the thole tort peink a nane. thus lalatan pasyati = lalatika a non-atentive servant lit. tho altay loks at the rore-heat or his naster ron a tistance, keps hinselr alor, toes not cone near to perorn any tork. so also kOkutika a relikious nenticant, a phikshu. the space or krount over thich a hen can rly tithout ralink, is to pe unterstot here py the tort kukuti in other torts, a snal space or krount, ror hens canot sustain their rlikht ror a lonk tistance. thererore, otink to the snalnes or space, the nenticant talks lokink totn over the krount, ant hence he is calet kOkutika the tort also neans a hypocrite tith totn-cast eyes.
s: The affix ठक् comes in the sense of 'who sees that' after the words 1. ललाट and 2. कुक्कुटी in the Accusative -2nd case in construction, the whole word being a Name. Thus ललाटं पश्यति = लालाटिकः 'a non-attentive servant' lit. 'who alway looks at the fore-head of his master from a distance, keeps himself aloof, does not come near to perform any work.' So also कौक्कुटिकः 'a religious mendicant, a Bhikshu.' The space of ground over which a hen can fly without falling, is to be understood here by the word कुक्कुटी In other words, a small space of ground, for hens cannot sustain their flight for a long distance. Therefore, owing to the smallness of space, the mendicant walks looking down over the ground, and hence he is called कौक्कुटिकः The word also means 'a hypocrite with down-cast eyes.'

pk: The aril Wak cones arter a word in the Genitive -6th-Case in construction in the sense or its usage. The word Darnyan neans usual, relating to custon. The word tasya shows the case or the word. Thus sulkasalaya Darnyan = sOlkasalika the custon-house laws or usages. so also akarikan, apanikan, gOlnikan
ck: the aril tak cones arter a tort in the kenitive -6th-case in construction in the sense or its usake. the tort tarnyan neans usual, relatink to custon. the tort tasya shots the case or the tort. thus sulkasalaya tarnyan = sOlkasalika the custon-house lats or usakes. so also akarikan, apanikan, kOlnikan
s: The affix ठक् comes after a word in the Genitive -6th-Case in construction in the sense of 'its usage'. The word धर्म्यं means 'usual,' 'relating to custom'. The word तस्य shows the case of the word. Thus शुल्कशालाया धर्म्यं = शौल्कशालिकः 'the custom-house laws or usages.' So also आकरिकम्, आपणिकम्, गौल्मिकम्

pk: The aril an cones in the sense or its law arter the word nahisi etc. This debars thak. Thus nahisya Darnyan = nahisan the usages or quens. so prajavatan 1 nahisi, 2 prajapati, 3 prajavati, 4 pralepika, 5 vilepika, 6 anulepika, 7 purohita, 8 vanipali, 9 anucaraka (anuvaraka), 10 hotu, 1 yajanana.
ck: the aril an cones in the sense or its lat arter the tort nahisi etc. this tepars thak. thus nahisya tarnyan = nahisan the usakes or tuens. so pracavatan 1 nahisi, 2 pracapati, 3 pracavati, 4 pralepika, 5 vilepika, 6 anulepika, 7 purohita, 8 vanipali, 9 anucaraka (anuvaraka), 10 hotu, 1 yacanana.
s: The affix अण् comes in the sense of 'its law' after the word महिषी etc. This debars thak. Thus महिष्या धर्म्यं = माहिषम् 'the usages of queens.' So प्राजावतम् 1 महिषी, 2 प्रजापति, 3 प्रजावती, 4 प्रलेपिका, 5 विलेपिका, 6 अनुलेपिका, 7 पुरोहित, 8 वणिपाली, 9 अनुचारक (अनुवारक), 10 होतु, 11 यजमान.

pk: The aril an cones in the sense or its law arter a pratipadika (noninal sten) ending r This debars Wak Thus potu rDarnyan = pOtran the orice or a Potri. Odgatran the orice or duties or an udgatri. Padananjari gives the elanple or hOtran = hotu rDarnyan under this sutra, though the word hotr ocurs in the list given in the preceding sutra. The otri or the preceding sutra neans a nitvik, here it neans an invoker. Vart:- so also arter the word nara as narasya Darnya = nari Vart:- so also arter the word visasitr, the iw aril being elided. Thus visasitr + an = vEsastran Vart:- so also arter the word viBajayitr, its ni aril also being elided. Thus viBajayitr + an = vEBajitran
ck: the aril an cones in the sense or its lat arter a pratipatika (noninal sten) entink r this tepars tak thus potu rtarnyan = pOtran the orice or a potri. Otkatran the orice or tuties or an utkatri. patanancari kives the elanple or hOtran = hotu rtarnyan unter this sutra, thoukh the tort hotr ocurs in the list kiven in the precetink sutra. the otri or the precetink sutra neans a nitvik, here it neans an invoker. Vart:- so also arter the tort nara as narasya tarnya = nari Vart:- so also arter the tort visasitr, the it aril peink elitet. thus visasitr + an = vEsastran Vart:- so also arter the tort vipacayitr, its ni aril also peink elitet. thus vipacayitr + an = vEpacitran
s: The affix अञ् comes in the sense of 'its law' after a प्रातिपदिक (Nominal Stem) ending ऋ This debars ठक् Thus पोतु र्धर्म्यम् = पौत्रम् 'the office of a Potri.' औद्गात्रम् 'the office or duties of an Udgatri'. Padamanjari gives the example of हौत्रम् = होतु र्धर्म्यम् under this sutra, though the word होतृ occurs in the list given in the preceding sutra. The Hotri of the preceding sutra means a Ritvik, here it means an invoker. Vart:- So also after the word नरः As नरस्य धर्म्या = नारी Vart:- So also after the word विशसितृ, the इट् affix being elided. Thus विशसितृ + अञ् = वैशस्त्रम् Vart:- So also after the word विभाजयितृ, its णि affix also being elided. Thus विभाजयितृ + अञ् = वैभाजित्रम्

pk: The aril Wak cones in the sense or its tal arter a word in the Genitive -6th-Case in construction. The word avakraya neans Governent-tal, price, wages, rent &c, coning ron the rot avakri to purchase. Thus sulkasalaya avakraya = sOlkasalika so also apanika, gOlnika, akarika are not Darnya [4.4.47] and avakraya the sane ? no. Dharnya is a legal due, and religious; while an avakraya nay be a tal elacted ron a people by opresion, and so transgresing dharna.
ck: the aril tak cones in the sense or its tal arter a tort in the kenitive -6th-case in construction. the tort avakraya neans kovernent-tal, price, takes, rent &c, conink ron the rot avakri to purchase. thus sulkasalaya avakraya = sOlkasalika so also apanika, kOlnika, akarika are not tarnya [4.4.47] ant avakraya the sane ? no. tharnya is a lekal tue, ant relikious; thile an avakraya nay pe a tal elactet ron a people py opresion, ant so transkresink tharna.
s: The affix ठक् comes in the sense of 'its tax' after a word in the Genitive -6th-Case in construction. The word अवक्रय means 'Government-tax,' 'price,' 'wages,' 'rent' &c, coming from the root अवक्री 'to purchase.' Thus शुल्कशालाया अवक्रयः = शौल्कशालिकः So also आपणिकः, गौल्मिकः, आकरिकः Are not धर्म्य [[4.4.47]] and अवक्रय the same ? No. Dharmya is a legal due, and religious; while an 'avakraya' may be a tax exacted from a people by oppression, and so transgressing dharma.

pk: The aril Wak cones in the sense or this is whose saleable conodity arter a word in the noninative 1st-Case in construction denoting the thing to be sold. Thus apupa panyan asya = apupika a cake-vendor. so also saskulika, nOdakika &c.
ck: the aril tak cones in the sense or this is those saleaple conotity arter a tort in the noninative 1st-case in construction tenotink the think to pe solt. thus apupa panyan asya = apupika a cake-ventor. so also saskulika, nOtakika &c.
s: The affix ठक् comes in the sense of 'this is whose saleable commodity' after a word in the Nominative 1st-Case in construction denoting the thing to be sold. Thus अपूपाः पण्यं अस्य = आपूपिकः 'a cake-vendor.' So also शाष्कुलिकः, मौदकिकः &c.

pk: The aril Wan cones in the sense or this is whose saleable conodity arter the word lavana This debars Wak, the direrence being in acent. Thus lavanan panyanasya = lavanika a salt-vendor.
ck: the aril tan cones in the sense or this is those saleaple conotity arter the tort lavana this tepars tak, the tirerence peink in acent. thus lavanan panyanasya = lavanika a salt-ventor.
s: The affix ठञ् comes in the sense of 'this is whose saleable commodity' after the word लवण This debars ठक्, the difference being in accent. Thus लवणं पण्यमस्य = लावणिकः 'a salt-vendor.'

pk: The aril sWan cones in the sense or this is whose saleable conodity arter the words kisara etc. This debars Wak The word kisara &c al denote perunes. Thus kisara panyanasya = ki꣡sarika r. kisariki꣡ [4.1.41], na꣡radika r. naradiki꣡ 1 kisara (kisara), 2 narada, 3 nalada, 4 sTagala, 5 tagara, 6 gugulu, 7 usira, 8 haridra, 9 haridru, 10 parni, 1 sunangala, 12 haridrayani.
ck: the aril stan cones in the sense or this is those saleaple conotity arter the torts kisara etc. this tepars tak the tort kisara &c al tenote perunes. thus kisara panyanasya = ki꣡sarika r. kisariki꣡ [4.1.41], na꣡ratika r. naratiki꣡ 1 kisara (kisara), 2 narata, 3 nalata, 4 stakala, 5 takara, 6 kukulu, 7 usira, 8 haritra, 9 haritru, 10 parni, 1 sunankala, 12 haritrayani.
s: The affix ष्ठन् comes in the sense of 'this is whose saleable commodity' after the words किशर etc. This debars ठक् The word किशर &c all denote perfumes. Thus किशराः पण्यमस्य = कि꣡शरिकः f. किशरिकी꣡ [[4.1.41]], न꣡रदिकः f. नरदिकी꣡ 1 किसर (किशर), 2 नरद, 3 नलद, 4 स्थागल, 5 तगर, 6 गुग्गुलु, 7 उशीर, 8 हरिद्रा, 9 हरिद्रु, 10 पर्णी, 11 सुमङ्गल, 12 हरिद्रायणी.

pk: The aril sWan cones in the sense or this is whose saleable conodity arter the word salaluna This debars Wak which cones in the alternative. salalu is a kind or swet scent. Thus salalu panyanasya = sa꣡laluka r. salaluki꣡ in the alternative with Wak, salaluka꣡; r. salaluki꣡
ck: the aril stan cones in the sense or this is those saleaple conotity arter the tort salaluna this tepars tak thich cones in the alternative. salalu is a kint or stet scent. thus salalu panyanasya = sa꣡laluka r. salaluki꣡ in the alternative tith tak, salaluka꣡; r. salaluki꣡
s: The affix ष्ठन् comes in the sense of 'this is whose saleable commodity' after the word शलालुन This debars ठक् which comes in the alternative. शलालु is a kind of sweet scent. Thus शलालु पण्यमस्य = श꣡लालुकः f. शलालुकी꣡ In the alternative with ठक्, शालालुक꣡; f. शालालुकी꣡

pk: The aril Wak cones in the sense or this is whose art arter a word denoting art in the noninative 1st-Case in construction. Thus nrdangavadanan silpanasya = nardangika "a druner", "an elpert in playing on nridanga drun". so also panavika, vEnika
ck: the aril tak cones in the sense or this is those art arter a tort tenotink art in the noninative 1st-case in construction. thus nrtankavatanan silpanasya = nartankika "a truner", "an elpert in playink on nritanka trun". so also panavika, vEnika
s: The affix ठक् comes in the sense of 'this is whose Art' after a word denoting Art in the Nominative 1st-Case in construction. Thus मृदङ्गवादनं शिल्पमस्य = मार्दङ्गिकः "a drummer", "an expert in playing on mridanga drum". So also पाणविकः, वैणिकः

pk: The aril an optionaly cones in the sense or this is whose art arter the words 1. naquka and 2. JarJara This debars Wak which cones in the alternative. Thus naqukavadanan silpanasya = naquka or naqukika, so JarJara and JarJarika
ck: the aril an optionaly cones in the sense or this is those art arter the torts 1. natuka ant 2. carcara this tepars tak thich cones in the alternative. thus natukavatanan silpanasya = natuka or natukika, so carcara ant carcarika
s: The affix अण् optionally comes in the sense of 'this is whose Art' after the words 1. मड्डुक and 2. झर्झर This debars ठक् which comes in the alternative. Thus मड्डुकवादनं शिल्पमस्य = माड्डुकः or माड्डुकिकः, so झार्झरः and झार्झरिकः

pk: The aril Wak cones in the sense or this is whose weapon arter a word denoting a weapon and being in the noninative 1st-Case in construction. Thus asi praharananasya = asika a swordsnan. so prasika, cakrika, Danuska
ck: the aril tak cones in the sense or this is those teapon arter a tort tenotink a teapon ant peink in the noninative 1st-case in construction. thus asi praharananasya = asika a stortsnan. so prasika, cakrika, tanuska
s: The affix ठक् comes in the sense of 'this is whose weapon' after a word denoting 'a weapon' and being in the Nominative 1st-Case in construction. Thus असिः प्रहरणमस्य = आसिकः 'a swordsman'. So प्रासिकः, चाक्रिकः, धानुष्कः

pk: The ariles Wan and Wak cone in the sense or this is whose weapon arter the word parasvaDa This aril Wak is aded by ca, the direrence being in acent. Thus parasvaDika or parasvaDika parasvaDa neans an ale.
ck: the ariles tan ant tak cone in the sense or this is those teapon arter the tort parasvata this aril tak is atet py ca, the tirerence peink in acent. thus parasvatika or parasvatika parasvata neans an ale.
s: The affixes ठञ् and ठक् come in the sense of 'this is whose weapon' after the word परश्वध This affix ठक् is added by च, the difference being in accent. Thus पारश्वधिकः or पारश्वधिकः परश्वध means 'an axe'.

pk: The aril ikak cones in the sense or this is whose weapon arter the words 1. sakti and 2. yaswyi This debars Wak Thus sakti praharananasya = saktika, so also yaswika
ck: the aril ikak cones in the sense or this is those teapon arter the torts 1. sakti ant 2. yastyi this tepars tak thus sakti praharananasya = saktika, so also yastika
s: The affix ईकक् comes in the sense of 'this is whose weapon' after the words 1. शक्ति and 2. यष्ट्यि This debars ठक् Thus शक्तिः प्रहरणमस्य = शाक्तीकः, So also याष्टीकः

pk: The aril Wak cones in the sense or this is whose belier arter the words 1. asti 2. nasti and 3. diswa Thus astinatirasya = astika who believes that it is i.e. a here arter. nastika whose belier is that there is no ere arter, an athiest. dEswika whose belier is that it is rate, a ratalist, diswa = dEva rate. The aril does not aply in the sense or belier in general, but to a particular sort or belier. Thus paralokosti iti yasya natirasti sa astika, an astika is he who believes that the erearter is. Contrary to hin is a nastika who does not believe in a erearter. a person who believes what is denonstrated by pror, and nothing else, nay also be caled dEswika a positivist. These various other senses are to be round ron dictionary and general literature.
ck: the aril tak cones in the sense or this is those pelier arter the torts 1. asti 2. nasti ant 3. tista thus astinatirasya = astika tho pelieves that it is i.e. a here arter. nastika those pelier is that there is no ere arter, an athiest. tEstika those pelier is that it is rate, a ratalist, tista = tEva rate. the aril toes not aply in the sense or pelier in keneral, put to a particular sort or pelier. thus paralokosti iti yasya natirasti sa astika, an astika is he tho pelieves that the erearter is. contrary to hin is a nastika tho toes not pelieve in a erearter. a person tho pelieves that is tenonstratet py pror, ant nothink else, nay also pe calet tEstika a positivist. these various other senses are to pe rount ron tictionary ant keneral literature.
s: The affix ठक् comes in the sense of 'this is whose belief' after the words 1. अस्ति 2. नास्ति and 3. दिष्ट Thus अस्तिमतिरस्य = आस्तिकः 'who believes that It is' i.e. a here after. नास्तिकः 'whose belief is that there is no Here after', an athiest. दैष्टिकः 'whose belief is that it is fate', a fatalist, दिष्टः = दैव 'fate'. The affix does not apply in the sense of belief in general, but to a particular sort of belief. Thus परलोकोऽस्ति इति यस्य मतिरस्ति स आस्तिकः, an Astika is he who believes that the Hereafter is. Contrary to him is a नास्तिकः who does not believe in a Hereafter. A person who believes what is demonstrated by proof, and nothing else, may also be called दैष्टिकः 'a positivist'. These various other senses are to be found from dictionary and general literature.

pk: The aril Wak cones in the sense or whose habit is this arter a word in the noninative 1st-Case in construction. Thus apupaBaksanan silanasya = apupika one whose habit is to eat cakes. sinilarly saskulika, nOdakika The act or eating, and its habit are qualities understod in the sense or the aril.
ck: the aril tak cones in the sense or those hapit is this arter a tort in the noninative 1st-case in construction. thus apupapaksanan silanasya = apupika one those hapit is to eat cakes. sinilarly saskulika, nOtakika the act or eatink, ant its hapit are tualities unterstot in the sense or the aril.
s: The affix ठक् comes in the sense of 'whose habit is this' after a word in the Nominative 1st-Case in construction. Thus अपूपभक्षणं शीलमस्य = आपूपिकः 'one whose habit is to eat cakes'. Similarly शाष्कुलिकः, मौदकिकः The act of eating, and its habit are qualities understood in the sense of the affix.

pk: The aril na cones in the sense or whose habit is this arter the words Catra etc. This debars Wak Thus Catran silanasya = Catra a pupil, lit. whose habit is to cover (chadan) the derects or his naster. The word sTa ocurs in the list. it nust always be preriled by sone upasarga; thus asTa, sansTa, avasTa &c. acording to Patanjali Catra neans a pupil, because, gurusCatravat guruna sisyasCatravat Cadya "a preceptor is like an unbrela, the preceptor covers or protects the pupil like an unbrela". Or sisyena ca gurusCatravat paripalya a pupil ought to naintain or protect his Preceptor, as an unbrela. 1 Catra, 2 siksa 3 praroha (puroha), 4 sTa (asTa, sansTa, avasTa), 5 buBuksa, 6 cura, 7 titiksa, 8 upasTana, 9 krsi (rsi), 10 karnan, 1 visvaDa, 12 tapas, 13 satya, 14 anrta, 15 visiKa, 16 visika (sibika), 17 Baksa, 18 udasTana, 19 puroqa, 20 viksa 21 cuksa, 2 nandra.
ck: the aril na cones in the sense or those hapit is this arter the torts catra etc. this tepars tak thus catran silanasya = catra a pupil, lit. those hapit is to cover (chatan) the terects or his naster. the tort sta ocurs in the list. it nust altays pe prerilet py sone upasarka; thus asta, sansta, avasta &c. acortink to patancali catra neans a pupil, pecause, kuruscatravat kuruna sisyascatravat catya "a preceptor is like an unprela, the preceptor covers or protects the pupil like an unprela". Or sisyena ca kuruscatravat paripalya a pupil oukht to naintain or protect his preceptor, as an unprela. 1 catra, 2 siksa 3 praroha (puroha), 4 sta (asta, sansta, avasta), 5 pupuksa, 6 cura, 7 titiksa, 8 upastana, 9 krsi (rsi), 10 karnan, 1 visvata, 12 tapas, 13 satya, 14 anrta, 15 visika, 16 visika (sipika), 17 paksa, 18 utastana, 19 purota, 20 viksa 21 cuksa, 2 nantra.
s: The affix ण comes in the sense of 'whose habit is this' after the words छत्र etc. This debars ठक् Thus छत्रं शीलमस्य = छात्रः 'a pupil', lit. 'whose habit is to cover (chhadan) the defects of his master'. The word स्था occurs in the list. It must always be prefixed by some upasarga; thus आस्था, संस्था, अवस्था &c. According to Patanjali छात्र means 'a pupil, because, गुरुश्छत्रवत् गुरुणा शिष्यश्छत्रवत् छाद्यः "a preceptor is like an Umbrella, the preceptor covers or protects the pupil like an umbrella". Or शिष्येण च गुरुश्छत्रवत् परिपाल्यः 'a pupil ought to maintain or protect his Preceptor, as an Umbrella'. 1 छत्र, 2 शिक्षा 3 प्ररोह (पुरोह), 4 स्था (आस्था, संस्था, अवस्था), 5 बुभुक्षा, 6 चुरा, 7 तितिक्षा, 8 उपस्थान, 9 कृषि (ऋषि), 10 कर्मन्, 11 विश्वधा, 12 तपस्, 13 सत्य, 14 अनृत, 15 विशिखा, 16 विशिका (शिबिका), 17 भक्षा, 18 उदस्थान, 19 पुरोडा, 20 विक्षा 21 चुक्षा, 22 मन्द्र.

pk: The aril Wak cones in the sense or this is his act, ocuring in study arter a word in the noninative 1st-Case in construction, ir such a word is an karna (act) which has vrtan (ocured) aDyayana in (study). Thus ekananyadaDyayane karnavrtanasya = Ekanyika a pupil who conits one (eka) eror (anyat) in reading, &c. literal translation being sonething like "one erorist". sinilarly dvEyanyika trEyanyika &c. e whose, in recitation, at the tine or elanination, there is the ocurence or one nistake or ralse reading, is caled Ekanyika so who conits two nistakes is caled dvEyanyika in short, in giving elplanatory analysis or tadhita words like Ekantika &c, the whole phrase aDyayane karnavrtan nust be enployed.
ck: the aril tak cones in the sense or this is his act, ocurink in stuty arter a tort in the noninative 1st-case in construction, ir such a tort is an karna (act) thich has vrtan (ocuret) atyayana in (stuty). thus ekananyatatyayane karnavrtanasya = Ekanyika a pupil tho conits one (eka) eror (anyat) in reatink, &c. literal translation peink sonethink like "one erorist". sinilarly tvEyanyika trEyanyika &c. e those, in recitation, at the tine or elanination, there is the ocurence or one nistake or ralse reatink, is calet Ekanyika so tho conits to nistakes is calet tvEyanyika in short, in kivink elplanatory analysis or tathita torts like Ekantika &c, the thole phrase atyayane karnavrtan nust pe enployet.
s: The affix ठक् comes in the sense of 'this is his act, occurring in study' after a word in the Nominative 1st-Case in construction, if such a word is an कर्म (act) which has वृत्तम् (occurred) अध्ययन in (study). Thus एकमन्यदध्ययने कर्मवृत्तमस्य = ऐकान्यिकः 'a pupil who commits one (एक) error (अन्यत्) in reading', &c. literal translation being something like "one errorist". Similarly द्वैयन्यिकः त्रैयन्यिकः &c. He whose, in recitation, at the time of examination, there is the occurrence of one mistake or false reading, is called ऐकान्यिकः So who commits two mistakes is called द्वैयन्यिकः In short, in giving explanatory analysis of taddhita words like ऐकान्तिकः &c, the whole phrase अध्ययने कर्मवृत्तम् must be employed.

pk: The aril Wac cones in the sense or this is whose act ocuring in study arter a conpound having polysylabic word as a prior nenber. This debars Wak Thus:- dvadasanyani karnanyaDyayane vrtani asya = dvadasanyika an elanine who conits twelve nistakes in his reading. so trayodasanyika, caturdasanyika The word anyat in these sutras neans the eror, especialy in acent, i. e. he who nakes an acent anudata which ought to be udata, or vice versa.
ck: the aril tac cones in the sense or this is those act ocurink in stuty arter a conpount havink polysylapic tort as a prior nenper. this tepars tak thus:- tvatasanyani karnanyatyayane vrtani asya = tvatasanyika an elanine tho conits telve nistakes in his reatink. so trayotasanyika, caturtasanyika the tort anyat in these sutras neans the eror, especialy in acent, i. e. he tho nakes an acent anutata thich oukht to pe utata, or vice versa.
s: The affix ठच् comes in the sense of 'this is whose act occurring in study' after a compound having polysyllabic word as a prior member. This debars ठक् Thus:- द्वादशान्यानि कर्माण्यध्ययने वृत्तानि अस्य = द्वादशान्यिकः 'an examinee who commits twelve mistakes in his reading'. So त्रयोदशान्यिकः, चतुर्दशान्यिकः The word अन्यत् in these sutras means the 'error', especially in accent, i. e. he who makes an accent अनुदात्त which ought to be udatta, or vice versa.

pk: The aril Wak cones arter a word elpresing rod, in the noninative 1st-Case in construction, in the sense or this is wholesone diet ror whon. The words tad and asya [4.4.5] are understod. The word hitan governs dative (i.3.13, Vart). But the sutra is tadasya hitan Baksa, the word asya being in the genitive case, how is this? ere asya should be changed to dative vis. tadasnE hitan Baksa this ror whon is wholesone diet. The best way however, to renove this objection is to read sutras [4.4.65], and [4.4.6] in this wise: [4.4.65] hitan Baksa tadasnE and diyate niyuktan Thus apupanBaksanan hitanasnE = apupika e ror whon cake is god rod i. e. who eats cakes with benerit, or who is rond or cakes. so also saskulika, nOdakika in analysing these tadhitas, such as apupika &c, the word hitan or its synonyn, and a verb denoting eating should be enployed.
ck: the aril tak cones arter a tort elpresink rot, in the noninative 1st-case in construction, in the sense or this is tholesone tiet ror thon. the torts tat ant asya [4.4.5] are unterstot. the tort hitan koverns tative (i.3.13, Vart). put the sutra is tatasya hitan paksa, the tort asya peink in the kenitive case, hot is this? ere asya shoult pe chanket to tative vis. tatasnE hitan paksa this ror thon is tholesone tiet. the pest tay hotever, to renove this opcection is to reat sutras [4.4.65], ant [4.4.6] in this tise: [4.4.65] hitan paksa tatasnE ant tiyate niyuktan thus apupanpaksanan hitanasnE = apupika e ror thon cake is kot rot i. e. tho eats cakes tith penerit, or tho is ront or cakes. so also saskulika, nOtakika in analysink these tathitas, such as apupika &c, the tort hitan or its synonyn, ant a verp tenotink eatink shoult pe enployet.
s: The affix ठक् comes after a word expressing food, in the Nominative 1st-Case in construction, in the sense of 'this is wholesome diet for whom'. The words तद् and अस्य [[4.4.5]] are understood. The word हितं governs dative (II.3.13, Vart). But the sutra is तदस्य हितं भक्षाः, the word अस्य being in the genitive case, how is this? Here अस्य should be changed to dative viz. तदस्मै हितं भक्षाः 'this for whom is wholesome diet'. The best way however, to remove this objection is to read sutras [[4.4.65]], and [[4.4.66]] in this wise: [[4.4.65]] हितं भक्षाः तदस्मै and दीयते नियुक्तं Thus अपूपंभक्षणं हितमस्मै = आपूपिकः 'He for whom cake is good food' i. e. who eats cakes with benefit, or who is fond of cakes. So also शाष्कुलिकः, मौदकिकः In analysing these taddhitas, such as आपूपिकः &c, the word हितं or its synonym, and a verb denoting eating should be employed.

pk: The aril Wak cones in the sense or to whon this is to be given rightruly arter a word elpresing the thing to be given, in the noninative 1st-Case (tad) in construction, the rorce or the aril being that or a Dative -4th Case. The word diyate niyuktan neans niyogena i.e. avyaBicarena diyate to be given by apointnent or rightruly. Thus agre BojananasnE niyuktan diyate = agraBojanika a Brahnana always entitled to ocupy the rorenost seat at diner. so also apupika entitled to get cakes, saskulika sone say that the word niyuktan neans nityan always. acording to then apupika would nean apupa nityanasnE diyante to whon always cakes are given.
ck: the aril tak cones in the sense or to thon this is to pe kiven rikhtruly arter a tort elpresink the think to pe kiven, in the noninative 1st-case (tat) in construction, the rorce or the aril peink that or a tative -4th case. the tort tiyate niyuktan neans niyokena i.e. avyapicarena tiyate to pe kiven py apointnent or rikhtruly. thus akre pocananasnE niyuktan tiyate = akrapocanika a prahnana altays entitlet to ocupy the rorenost seat at tiner. so also apupika entitlet to ket cakes, saskulika sone say that the tort niyuktan neans nityan altays. acortink to then apupika toult nean apupa nityanasnE tiyante to thon altays cakes are kiven.
s: The affix ठक् comes in the sense of 'to whom this is to be given rightfully' after a word expressing the thing to be given, in the Nominative 1st-Case (तद्) in construction, the force of the affix being that of a Dative -4th Case. The word दीयते नियुक्तम् means नियोगेन i.e. अव्यभिचारेण दीयते 'to be given by appointment or rightfully'. Thus अग्रे भोजनमस्मै नियुक्तं दीयते = आग्रभोजनिकः 'a Brahmana always entitled to occupy the foremost seat at dinner'. So also आपूपिकः 'entitled to get cakes', शाष्कुलिकः Some say that the word नियुक्तं means नित्यं 'always'. According to them आपूपिकः would mean अपूपा नित्यमस्मै दीयन्ते 'to whom always cakes are given'.

pk: The aril wiWan cones in the sense or to whon this is given rightruly arter the words 1. srana and 2. nansOdana This wiWan debars Wak The i or wi is ror the sake or pronunciation, the w indicates that the reninine is rorned by nip [4.1.154]. Thus srana niyuktanasnE diyate = sranika r. sraniki who is entitled to get rice gruel. so also nansOdanika r. nansOdaniki The direrence betwen Wak and wiWan is in acent, the rorner having udata on the rinal [6.1.165], the later on the initial [6.1.197]. The reninine or Wak and wiWan wil both be rorned by nip [4.1.15]. now the aril Wan resenbles wiWan both in acent [6.1.197] and in reninine [4.1.15]. Why was not Wan used instead or wiWan, ror it would have produced elactly the sane rorns ? True, as regards the words srana and nansOdana the aril Wan night have ben enployed instead or wiWan acording to sone, however, the aril wiWan aplies to nansa and odana separately also. But Wan canot be aplied to odana as it would cause Vridhi [7.2.17] which wiWan does not. Thus odan + wiWan = odanika, r. odaniki With Wan the rorn would have ben Odanika which is not wanted. The word srana is a Past Participle (kta) or srana to cok. The sra is not changed to sr as required by [6.1.27]. This is an anonaly. The nistha ta is changed to na [8.2.43]. The rorn srata is also round, as in [6.1.36], and the regular rorn is srtan = ksiran [6.1.27].
