Opserve satan parinananasya = satakan nitanan a pant those neasure is huntret. the tort asate tualiries the sense or the aril, ant not that or the pase, the later not peink posiple; ror the tort sata as a pase nust altays nean a huntret. the rolotink elanples til ilustrate the neanink; satanatyaya parinananasya krantasya = sataka a pok consistink or huntret athyayas. in this case there is esentialy no tirerence peten the pase (prakriti) ant the sense or the aril (pratyayartha), thoukh there is aparent tirerence, ror the sake or aplyink the aril. ror sataka is a pok esentialy consistink or huntret: thile satyan a cariake purchaset ror a huntret coins, toes not contain huntret as its esential part. sinilarly satako kosanka a hert or cots huntret in nunper. ere the sanka esentialy consists or sata ant so there is the aril kan ant not tan or yat [5.1.58]. put not so in the case or satyan satakasatan, satikan satakasatan, ror here the sense or the aril is rornet py the sentence, ant not tiscoveret nerely ron the tort. ence the rolotink Vartika satapratisetenyasatatvepratiseta the tort ca in the sutra trats in the tort asanase ron the previous sutra. thus tvO ca satan ca = tvisatan, tvisatena kritan = tvisatakan purchaset ror a huntret ant to coins. ere the aril is kan [5.1.2]. so trisatakan acortink to the ishti kiven in the last sutra, the tatanta vithi aplies here.
s: The affixes ठन् (-/- इक) and यत् (-/य) come in the senses taught up to [[5.1.63]] after the word शत् , when it is not part of a compound and when it does not mean merely 'hundred'. The word आर्हात् [[5.1.19]] is understood here also. These affixes ठन् and यत् debar the affix कन् [[5.1.22]]. Thus शतेन क्रीतम् = शत्यम् or शतिकम् 'purchased for a hundred gold coins'. Why do we say अशते when not meaning 'merely a hundred'? Observe शतं परिमाणमस्य = शतकं निदानम् 'a band whose measure is hundred'. The word अशते qualifies the sense of the affix, and not that of the base, the latter not being possible; for the word शत as a base must always mean 'a hundred'. The following examples will illustrate the meaning; शतमध्यायाः परिमाणमस्य ग्रन्थस्य = शतकः 'a book consisting of hundred Adhyayas'. In this case there is essentially no difference between the base (prakriti) and the sense of the affix (pratyayartha), though there is apparent difference, for the sake of applying the affix. For शतकः is a book essentially consisting of hundred: while शत्यं 'a carriage purchased for a hundred coins', does not contain hundred as its essential part. Similarly शतको गोसंघः 'a herd of cows hundred in number'. Here the संघः essentially consists of शत and so there is the affix कन् and not ठन् or यत् [[5.1.58]]. But not so in the case of शत्यं शाटकशतं, शतिकं शाटकशतं, for here the sense of the affix is formed by the sentence, and not discovered merely from the word. Hence the following Vartika शतप्रतिषेधेऽन्यशतत्वेऽप्रतिषेधः The word च in the sutra draws in the word असमासे from the previous sutra. Thus द्वौ च शतं च = द्विशतं, द्विशतेन क्रीतं = द्विशतकम् 'purchased for a hundred and two coins'. Here the affix is कन् [[5.1.22]]. So त्रिशतकम् According to the Ishti given in the last Sutra, the tadanta vidhi applies here.

pk: The aril (-/- -ka) cones arter a nuneral, when it does not end with ti or sat , in the sense or the aril being that taught herearter up to [5.1.63] The word arhat is to be read into this sutra also. The word sanKya is derined in (l. 1.23). This kan debars Wan Thus pancaBi krita = pancaka, bahuka, ganaka Why do we say when it does not end in ti or sat? Observe sa꣡ptatika ca꣡tvarisataka rorned by Wan But why katika is rorned by kan and not by Wan or Wak, as the word kati also ends in ti? The word kati is rorned by ading the aril qati, while the rule aplies to the nunerals which in their prinitive state end with ti such as saptati, asiti, vinsati &c. ere aply the two nalins arTavadgrahane nanarTakasya a conbination or leters capable or elpresing a neaning denotes whenever it is enployed in Granar, that conbination or leters in so rar as it poseses that neaning, but it does not denote the sane conbination or leters void or a neaning; and niranubanDaka grahane na sanubanDakasya when a tern void or anubandhas is enployed in Granar, it does not denote that which has an anubandha atached to it. Thererore when ti is taken, it does not nean qati
ck: the aril (-/- -ka) cones arter a nuneral, then it toes not ent tith ti or sat , in the sense or the aril peink that taukht herearter up to [5.1.63] the tort arhat is to pe reat into this sutra also. the tort sankya is terinet in (l. 1.23). this kan tepars tan thus pancapi krita = pancaka, pahuka, kanaka thy to te say then it toes not ent in ti or sat? Opserve sa꣡ptatika ca꣡tvarisataka rornet py tan put thy katika is rornet py kan ant not py tan or tak, as the tort kati also ents in ti? the tort kati is rornet py atink the aril tati, thile the rule aplies to the nunerals thich in their prinitive state ent tith ti such as saptati, asiti, vinsati &c. ere aply the to nalins artavatkrahane nanartakasya a conpination or leters capaple or elpresink a neanink tenotes thenever it is enployet in kranar, that conpination or leters in so rar as it poseses that neanink, put it toes not tenote the sane conpination or leters voit or a neanink; ant niranupantaka krahane na sanupantakasya then a tern voit or anupanthas is enployet in kranar, it toes not tenote that thich has an anupantha atachet to it. thererore then ti is taken, it toes not nean tati
s: The affix (-/- -क) comes after a Numeral, when it does not end with ति or शत् , in the sense of the affix being that taught hereafter up to [[5.1.63]] The word आर्हात् is to be read into this sutra also. The word संख्या is defined in (l. 1.23). This कन् debars ठञ् Thus पंचभिः क्रीतः = पंचकः, बहुकः, गणकः Why do we say 'when it does not end in ति or शत्'? Observe सा꣡प्ततिकः चा꣡त्वारिशतकः formed by ठञ् But why कतिकः is formed by कन् and not by ठञ् or ठक्, as the word कति also ends in ति? The word कति is formed by adding the affix डति, while the rule applies to the numerals which in their primitive state end with ति such as सप्ततिः, अशीतिः, विंशति &c. Here apply the two maxims अर्थवद्ग्रहणे नानर्थकस्य 'a combination of letters capable of expressing a meaning denotes whenever it is employed in Grammar, that combination of letters in so far as it possesses that meaning, but it does not denote the same combination of letters void of a meaning;' and निरनुबन्धक ग्रहणे न सानुबन्धकस्य 'when a term void of Anubandhas is employed in Grammar, it does not denote that which has an Anubandha attached to it'. Therefore when ति is taken, it does not mean डति

pk: The aril kan coning arter a nuneral ending with vat, takes optionaly the augnent id , the sense or the aril being those given up to [5.1.63] The words ending in vat are sanKya; se [1.1.23]: and would consequently take kan by [5.1.2]. The present sutra ordains the optional ariling or iw to this kan Thus tavatka or tavatika, yavatika or yavatka
ck: the aril kan conink arter a nuneral entink tith vat, takes optionaly the auknent it , the sense or the aril peink those kiven up to [5.1.63] the torts entink in vat are sankya; se [1.1.23]: ant toult consetuently take kan py [5.1.2]. the present sutra ortains the optional arilink or it to this kan thus tavatka or tavatika, yavatika or yavatka
s: The affix कन् coming after a Numeral ending with वत्, takes optionally the augment इद् , the sense of the affix being those given up to [[5.1.63]] The words ending in वत् are संख्या; see [[1.1.23]]: and would consequently take कन् by [[5.1.22]]. The present sutra ordains the optional affixing of इट् to this कन् Thus तावत्कः or तावतिकः, यावतिकः or यावत्कः

pk: The aril quvan (-/- -aka) cones in the senses taught up to [5.1.63] arter the words vinsati and trinsat , when it does not denote a nane: the ti and at or the base being droped berore this aril. Thus vinsati + qvun = vinsa + aka [6.4.142] = vinsaka; trinsat + qvun = trins + aka [6.4.143] = trinsaka Why do we say asanjnayan when not denoting a nane? Observe, vinsatika, trinsatka rorned by aril kan [5.1.2]. Q. Why do you aril kan, when it is prohibited by the phrase atisadantaya; ror vinsati ends in ti and trisat ends in sat ? The aril kan wil be aded by dividing the sutra into two: vis: (1) vinsatitrinsadByan (2) qvunasanjnayan; the neanings being (1) The aril Kan is aded to vinsati and trinsat; (2) The aril dvun is aded to the sane words, when not denoting a nane.
ck: the aril tuvan (-/- -aka) cones in the senses taukht up to [5.1.63] arter the torts vinsati ant trinsat , then it toes not tenote a nane: the ti ant at or the pase peink tropet perore this aril. thus vinsati + tvun = vinsa + aka [6.4.142] = vinsaka; trinsat + tvun = trins + aka [6.4.143] = trinsaka thy to te say asancnayan then not tenotink a nane? Opserve, vinsatika, trinsatka rornet py aril kan [5.1.2]. t. thy to you aril kan, then it is prohipitet py the phrase atisatantaya; ror vinsati ents in ti ant trisat ents in sat ? the aril kan til pe atet py tivitink the sutra into to: vis: (1) vinsatitrinsatpyan (2) tvunasancnayan; the neaninks peink (1) the aril kan is atet to vinsati ant trinsat; (2) the aril tvun is atet to the sane torts, then not tenotink a nane.
s: The affix डुवन् (-/- -अक) comes in the senses taught up to [[5.1.63]] after the words विंशति and त्रिंशत् , when it does not denote a Name: the ति and अत् of the base being dropped before this affix. Thus विंशति + ड्वुन् = विंश + अक [[6.4.142]] = विंशक; त्रिंशत् + ड्वुन् = त्रिंश् + अक [[6.4.143]] = त्रिंशकः Why do we say असंज्ञायाम् 'when not denoting a Name'? Observe, विंशतिकः, त्रिंशत्कः formed by affix कन् [[5.1.22]]. Q. Why do you affix कन्, when it is prohibited by the phrase अतिशदन्तायाः; for विंशति ends in ति and त्रीशत् ends in शत् ? The affix कन् will be added by dividing the sutra into two: viz: (1) विंशतित्रिंशद्भ्यां (2) ड्वुनसंज्ञायाम्; the meanings being (1) The affix 'Kan' is added to vinsati and trinsat; (2) The affix dvun is added to the same words, when not denoting a name.

pk: The aril wiWan (-/- -ika) cones in the senses taught up to [5.1.63] arter the word kansa This debars Wan; the anubandha wi or wiWan shows that the reninine or the word wil be rorned by nip [4.1.15], the i or wi is ror the sake or pronunciation, the n or wiWan is ror acent [6.1.197]. Thus kansika ren. kansiki Vart:- so also it nust be stated arter the word arDa; e. g. ardDika, arDiki Vart:- so also arter the word karsapana, e. g. karsapanika ren. karsapaniki sonetines the word prati is substituted ror karsapana berore this aril, as, pratika ren. pratiki
ck: the aril titan (-/- -ika) cones in the senses taukht up to [5.1.63] arter the tort kansa this tepars tan; the anupantha ti or titan shots that the reninine or the tort til pe rornet py nip [4.1.15], the i or ti is ror the sake or pronunciation, the n or titan is ror acent [6.1.197]. thus kansika ren. kansiki Vart:- so also it nust pe statet arter the tort arta; e. k. artika, artiki Vart:- so also arter the tort karsapana, e. k. karsapanika ren. karsapaniki sonetines the tort prati is supstitutet ror karsapana perore this aril, as, pratika ren. pratiki
s: The affix टिठन् (-/- -इक) comes in the senses taught up to [[5.1.63]] after the word कंस This debars ठञ्; the anubandha टि of टिठन् shows that the feminine of the word will be formed by ङीप् [[4.1.15]], the इ of टि is for the sake of pronunciation, the न् of टिठन् is for accent [[6.1.197]]. Thus कंसिकः fem. कंसिकी Vart:- So also it must be stated after the word अर्ध; e. g. अर्द्धिकः, अर्धिकी Vart:- So also after the word कार्षापण, e. g. कार्षापणिकः fem. कार्षापणिकी Sometimes the word प्रति is substituted for कार्षापण before this affix, as, प्रतिकः fem. प्रतिकी

pk: The aril an (+/- a) cones optionaly in the senses taught up to [5.1.63] arter the word surpa This debars Wan which cones in the alternative. as, surpena kritan = sOrpan or sOrpikan
ck: the aril an (+/- a) cones optionaly in the senses taukht up to [5.1.63] arter the tort surpa this tepars tan thich cones in the alternative. as, surpena kritan = sOrpan or sOrpikan
s: The affix अञ् (+/- अ) comes optionally in the senses taught up to [[5.1.63]] after the word शूर्पा This debars ठञ् which comes in the alternative. As, शूर्पेण क्रीतं = शौर्पम् or शौर्पिकम्

pk: The aril an (-/- -a) cones in the senses taught up to [5.1.63] arter the words satanana , vinsatika , sahasra and vasana This debars Wan, Wak and kan Thus satananena kritan = satananan so also vEnsatikan sahasran and vasanan
ck: the aril an (-/- -a) cones in the senses taukht up to [5.1.63] arter the torts satanana , vinsatika , sahasra ant vasana this tepars tan, tak ant kan thus satananena kritan = satananan so also vEnsatikan sahasran ant vasanan
s: The affix अण् (-/- -अ) comes in the senses taught up to [[5.1.63]] after the words शतमान , विंशतिक , सहस्र and वसन This debars ठञ्, ठक् and कन् Thus शतमानेन क्रीतं = शातमानं so also वैंशतिकम् साहस्रम् and वासनम्

pk: The aril having the senses taught up to [5.1.63], is elided by luk arter a sten begining with the word aDyarDa , and arter a dvigu conpound, when it is not in a nane. The word arhat is understod here also. Thus aDyardDakansan, dvikansan, aDyardDasurpan, dvisurpan, trikansan , trisurpan ere the ariles wiWan and an are elided. Though in the words dvisurpan &c. the aril is elided, it is only so when the ariling or the tadhita ocasions a Dvigu conpounding [2.1.51] such as in dvaByan surpaByan kritan = dvisurpan ere the resultant is a Dvigu conpound. But in rorning tertiary derivatives the aril is not elided, as dvisurpena kritan = dvisOrpikan ence the rolowing rule: dvigorluki taninitagrahanan se [4.1.8], [5.1.20] Why do we say asanjnayan when not a nane? Observe pancalohitikan or pancalOhitikan and pancakalayikan being nanes or certain neasures. The reninine word lohini is changed into the nasculine by the Vartika BasyaQe tadDite given under [6.3.35]. The word aDyardDa is a sankhya (se [1.1.23]), and a word begining with it wil be a Dvigu conpound. its separate nention in this sutra nay apear superluous. it is however so nentioned, in order to indicate (jnapaka) that this word is not always a sankhya. Thus ror the purposes or the aplication or the aril krtvasuc [5.4.17], this word is not a sankhya.
ck: the aril havink the senses taukht up to [5.1.63], is elitet py luk arter a sten pekinink tith the tort atyarta , ant arter a tviku conpount, then it is not in a nane. the tort arhat is unterstot here also. thus atyartakansan, tvikansan, atyartasurpan, tvisurpan, trikansan , trisurpan ere the ariles titan ant an are elitet. thoukh in the torts tvisurpan &c. the aril is elitet, it is only so then the arilink or the tathita ocasions a tviku conpountink [2.1.51] such as in tvapyan surpapyan kritan = tvisurpan ere the resultant is a tviku conpount. put in rornink tertiary terivatives the aril is not elitet, as tvisurpena kritan = tvisOrpikan ence the rolotink rule: tvikorluki taninitakrahanan se [4.1.8], [5.1.20] thy to te say asancnayan then not a nane? Opserve pancalohitikan or pancalOhitikan ant pancakalayikan peink nanes or certain neasures. the reninine tort lohini is chanket into the nasculine py the Vartika pasyate tatite kiven unter [6.3.35]. the tort atyarta is a sankhya (se [1.1.23]), ant a tort pekinink tith it til pe a tviku conpount. its separate nention in this sutra nay apear superluous. it is hotever so nentionet, in orter to inticate (cnapaka) that this tort is not altays a sankhya. thus ror the purposes or the aplication or the aril krtvasuc [5.4.17], this tort is not a sankhya.
s: The affix having the senses taught up to [[5.1.63]], is elided by लुक् after a stem beginning with the word अध्यर्ध , and after a द्विगु compound, when it is not in a name. The word आर्हात् is understood here also. Thus अध्यर्द्धकंसम्, द्विकंसम्, अध्यर्द्धशूर्पम्, द्विशूर्पम्, त्रिकंसम् , त्रिशूर्पम् Here the affixes टिठन् and अञ् are elided. Though in the words द्विशूर्पम् &c. the affix is elided, it is only so when the affixing of the taddhita occasions a Dvigu compounding [[2.1.51]] such as in द्वाभ्यां शूर्पाभ्यां क्रीतं = द्विशूर्पम् Here the resultant is a Dvigu compound. But in forming tertiary derivatives the affix is not elided, as द्विशूर्पेण क्रीतं = द्विशौर्पिकम् Hence the following rule: द्विगोर्लुकि तन्निमित्तग्रहणम् See [[4.1.88]], [[5.1.20]] Why do we say असंज्ञायाम् 'when not a Name'? Observe पांचलोहितिकम् or पंचलौहितिकम् and पांचकलायिकम् being names of certain measures. The feminine word लोहिनी is changed into the masculine by the Vartika भस्याढे तद्धिते given under [[6.3.35]]. The word अध्यर्द्ध is a Sankhya (See [[1.1.23]]), and a word beginning with it will be a Dvigu compound. Its separate mention in this sutra may appear superfluous. It is however so mentioned, in order to indicate (jnapaka) that this word is not always a Sankhya. Thus for the purposes of the application of the affix कृत्वसूच् [[5.4.17]], this word is not a sankhya.

pk: The aril having the senses taught up to [5.1.63], is not always sanKya Thus ror the purpose or aplication or the aril krtvasuc [5.4.17], this word is not a sanKya This sutra nakes the elision optional, when it was conpulsory by the last sutra. Thus aDyardDakarsapanan or aDyardDakarsapanikan, dvikarsapanan or dvikarsapanikan, here the aril wiWan [5.1.25] is elided in one case, and not elided in the other. When it is not elided, prati nay be substituted ror karsapana [5.1.25]. aDyardDapratikan, dvipratikan so also arter the word sahasra, e.g. aDyardDasahasran or aDyardDasahasran, dvisahasran or dvisahasran When the aril is not elided, the rorns above shown with iregular Vridhi or the second sten, are evolved by sutra [7.3.15]. Vart:- The words suvarna and satanana should also be enunerated. as, aDyardDasuvarnan or aDyardDasOvarnikan, dvisuvarnan, dvisOvarnikan, aDyardDasatananan, aDyardDasatananan, dvisatananan or dvisatananan The iregular Vridhi or the second tern takes place by [7.3.17].
ck: the aril havink the senses taukht up to [5.1.63], is not altays sankya thus ror the purpose or aplication or the aril krtvasuc [5.4.17], this tort is not a sankya this sutra nakes the elision optional, then it tas conpulsory py the last sutra. thus atyartakarsapanan or atyartakarsapanikan, tvikarsapanan or tvikarsapanikan, here the aril titan [5.1.25] is elitet in one case, ant not elitet in the other. then it is not elitet, prati nay pe supstitutet ror karsapana [5.1.25]. atyartapratikan, tvipratikan so also arter the tort sahasra, e.k. atyartasahasran or atyartasahasran, tvisahasran or tvisahasran then the aril is not elitet, the rorns apove shotn tith irekular Vrithi or the secont sten, are evolvet py sutra [7.3.15]. Vart:- the torts suvarna ant satanana shoult also pe enuneratet. as, atyartasuvarnan or atyartasOvarnikan, tvisuvarnan, tvisOvarnikan, atyartasatananan, atyartasatananan, tvisatananan or tvisatananan the irekular Vrithi or the secont tern takes place py [7.3.17].
s: The affix having the senses taught up to [[5.1.63]], is not always संख्या Thus for the purpose of application of the affix कृत्वसूच् [[5.4.17]], this word is not a संख्या This sutra makes the elision optional, when it was compulsory by the last sutra. Thus अध्यर्द्धकार्षापणम् or अध्यर्द्धकार्षापणिकं, द्विकार्षापणम् or द्विकार्षापणिकम्, here the affix टिठन् [[5.1.25]] is elided in one case, and not elided in the other. When it is not elided, प्रति may be substituted for कार्षापण [[5.1.25]]. अध्यर्द्धप्रतिकम्, द्विप्रतिकम् So also after the word सहस्र, e.g. अध्यर्द्धसहस्रम् or अध्यर्द्धसाहस्रम्, द्विसहस्रम् or द्विसाहस्रम् When the affix is not elided, the forms above shown with irregular Vriddhi of the second stem, are evolved by sutra [[7.3.15]]. Vart:- The words सुवर्ण and शतमान should also be enumerated. As, अध्यर्द्धसुवर्णम् or अध्यर्द्धसौवर्णिकम्, द्विसुवर्णम्, द्विसौवर्णिकम्, अध्यर्द्धशतमानम्, अध्यर्द्धशातमानम्, द्विशतमानम् or द्विशातमानम् The irregular Vriddhi of the second term takes place by [[7.3.17]].

pk: The arhiya aril [5.1.63] is optionaly elided arter a dvigu ocasioning conpound, or the word niska preceded by dvi and tri The word dvigo a tadhita ocasioning a Dvigu conpound or [5.1.28] is to be read into this sutra. Thus dviniskan or dvinEskikan, triniskan or trinEskikan [7.3.17]. Vart:- so also when nishka is preceded by bahu e.g. bahuniskan or bahunEskikan The iregular Vridhi or the second tern is caused by [7.3.17].
ck: the arhiya aril [5.1.63] is optionaly elitet arter a tviku ocasionink conpount, or the tort niska precetet py tvi ant tri the tort tviko a tathita ocasionink a tviku conpount or [5.1.28] is to pe reat into this sutra. thus tviniskan or tvinEskikan, triniskan or trinEskikan [7.3.17]. Vart:- so also then nishka is precetet py pahu e.k. pahuniskan or pahunEskikan the irekular Vrithi or the secont tern is causet py [7.3.17].
s: The आर्हीय affix [[5.1.63]] is optionally elided after a द्विगु occasioning compound, of the word निष्क preceded by द्वि and त्रि The word द्विगोः 'a taddhita occasioning a Dvigu compound' of [[5.1.28]] is to be read into this sutra. Thus द्विनिष्कम् or द्विनैष्किकम्, त्रिनिष्कम् or त्रिनैष्किकम् [[7.3.17]]. Vart:- So also when nishka is preceded by बहु e.g. बहुनिष्कम् or बहुनैष्किकम् The irregular Vriddhi of the second term is caused by [[7.3.17]].

pk: The arhiya aril [5.1.37]-63 ocasioning a dvigu conpound, is optionaly elided arter the word bista preceded by dvi and tri The word ca in the sutra draws in the words dvitripurvat Thus dvibistan or dvibEstikan, tribistan or tribEstikan, bahubistan, bahubEstikan The separation or this sutra is ror the sake or the subsequent sutra.
ck: the arhiya aril [5.1.37]-63 ocasionink a tviku conpount, is optionaly elitet arter the tort pista precetet py tvi ant tri the tort ca in the sutra trats in the torts tvitripurvat thus tvipistan or tvipEstikan, tripistan or tripEstikan, pahupistan, pahupEstikan the separation or this sutra is ror the sake or the supsetuent sutra.
s: The आर्हीय affix [[5.1.37]]-63 occasioning a द्विगु compound, is optionally elided after the word बिस्त preceded by द्वि and त्रि The word च in the sutra draws in the words द्वित्रिपूर्वात् Thus द्विबिस्तम् or द्विबैस्तिकम्, त्रिबिस्तम् or त्रिबैस्तिकम्, बहुबिस्तम्, बहुबैस्तिकम् The separation of this sutra is for the sake of the subsequent sutra.

pk: The aril Ka (ina) cones in the arhiya senses [5.1.37]-63 arter the word vinsatika , when preceded by the word aDyardDa or a nuneral, ocasioning a dvigu Thus aDyardDavinsatikinan, dvivinsatikinan and trivinsatikinan Being especialy ordained, this aril Ka is not elided by [5.1.28].
ck: the aril ka (ina) cones in the arhiya senses [5.1.37]-63 arter the tort vinsatika , then precetet py the tort atyarta or a nuneral, ocasionink a tviku thus atyartavinsatikinan, tvivinsatikinan ant trivinsatikinan peink especialy ortainet, this aril ka is not elitet py [5.1.28].
s: The affix ख (ईन) comes in the आर्हीय senses [[5.1.37]]-63 after the word विंशतिक , when preceded by the word अध्यर्द्ध or a Numeral, occasioning a द्विगु Thus अध्यर्द्धविंशतिकीनम्, द्विविंशतिकीनम् and त्रिविंशतिकीनम् Being especially ordained, this affix ख is not elided by [[5.1.28]].

pk: The aril ikan (-/- -ika) cones in the arhiya senses [5.1.37]-63 arter the word Kari , when preceded by the word aDyarDa or a nuneral ocasioning a dvigu Thus aDyardDaKarikan, dviKarikan Vart:- so also arter the word Kari alone, as Karikan Vart:- so also arter the word kakini, as, aDyardDakakinikan, dvikakinikan, trikakinikan so also when the word is alone: as, kakinikan
ck: the aril ikan (-/- -ika) cones in the arhiya senses [5.1.37]-63 arter the tort kari , then precetet py the tort atyarta or a nuneral ocasionink a tviku thus atyartakarikan, tvikarikan Vart:- so also arter the tort kari alone, as karikan Vart:- so also arter the tort kakini, as, atyartakakinikan, tvikakinikan, trikakinikan so also then the tort is alone: as, kakinikan
s: The affix ईकन् (-/- -ईक) comes in the आर्हीय senses [[5.1.37]]-63 after the word खारी , when preceded by the word अध्यर्ध or a Numeral occasioning a द्विगु Thus अध्यर्द्धखारीकम्, द्विखारीकम् Vart:- So also after the word खारी alone, as खारीकम् Vart:- So also after the word काकिणी, as, अध्यर्द्धकाकिणीकम्, द्विकाकिणीकम्, त्रिकाकिणीकम् So also when the word is alone: as, काकिणीकम्

pk: The aril yat (ya) cones in the arhiya senses [5.1.37]-63 arter the words pana, nasa and sata , when preceded by the word aDyarDa or a nuneral ocasioning a dvigu Thus aDyardDapanyan, dvipanyan, tripanyan so also aDyardDapadyan, dvipadyan, tripadyan ere pada is not changed into pada, by [6.3.53]. The substitution enjoined by [6.3.53] takes place when pada neans the rot or a living being, while here it neans a neasure or capacity. so also aDyardDanasyan, dvinasyan, trinasyan, aDyardDasatyan, dvisatyan, trisatyan
ck: the aril yat (ya) cones in the arhiya senses [5.1.37]-63 arter the torts pana, nasa ant sata , then precetet py the tort atyarta or a nuneral ocasionink a tviku thus atyartapanyan, tvipanyan, tripanyan so also atyartapatyan, tvipatyan, tripatyan ere pata is not chanket into pata, py [6.3.53]. the supstitution encoinet py [6.3.53] takes place then pata neans the rot or a livink peink, thile here it neans a neasure or capacity. so also atyartanasyan, tvinasyan, trinasyan, atyartasatyan, tvisatyan, trisatyan
s: The affix यत् (य) comes in the आर्हीय senses [[5.1.37]]-63 after the words पण, माष and शत , when preceded by the word अध्यर्ध or a Numeral occasioning a द्विगु Thus अध्यर्द्धपण्यम्, द्विपण्यम्, त्रिपण्यम् so also अध्यर्द्धपाद्यम्, द्विपाद्यम्, त्रिपाद्यम् Here पाद is not changed into पद, by [[6.3.53]]. The substitution enjoined by [[6.3.53]] takes place when पाद means the foot of a living being, while here it means a measure of capacity. So also अध्यर्द्धमाष्यम्, द्विमाष्यम्, त्रिमाष्यम्, अध्यर्द्धशत्यम्, द्विशत्यम्, त्रिशत्यम्

pk: The aril yat cones optionaly arter the word sana, in the arhiya-senses [5.1.63], when it is preceded by the word aDyarDa or a nuneral ocasioning a dvigu This debars Wan which also cones in the alternative, and is then elided by [5.1.28]. Thus aDyardDasanyan or aDyardDasanan, dvisanyan or dvisanan, trisanyan or trisanan Vart:- so also optionaly arter the word sata, as, aDyardDasatyan or satan, dvisatyan or satan, trisatyan or satan
ck: the aril yat cones optionaly arter the tort sana, in the arhiya-senses [5.1.63], then it is precetet py the tort atyarta or a nuneral ocasionink a tviku this tepars tan thich also cones in the alternative, ant is then elitet py [5.1.28]. thus atyartasanyan or atyartasanan, tvisanyan or tvisanan, trisanyan or trisanan Vart:- so also optionaly arter the tort sata, as, atyartasatyan or satan, tvisatyan or satan, trisatyan or satan
s: The affix यत् comes optionally after the word शन, in the आर्हीय-senses [[5.1.63]], when it is preceded by the word अध्यर्ध or a Numeral occasioning a द्विगु This debars ठञ् which also comes in the alternative, and is then elided by [[5.1.28]]. Thus अध्यर्द्धशाण्यम् or अध्यर्द्धशाणम्, द्विशाण्यम् or द्विशाणम्, त्रिशाण्यम् or त्रिशाणम् Vart:- So also optionally after the word शत, as, अध्यर्द्धशत्यम् or शतम्, द्विशत्यम् or शतम्, त्रिशत्यम् or शतम्

pk: The aril an (-/- -a) as wel as yat optionaly also cones arter the word sana , in the arhiya-senses [5.1.37]-63, when preceded by the words dvi and tri The yat cones optionaly by the last sutra and is also drawn into this by the word ca. Thus we have thre rorns, dvisanyan, dvEsanan, and dvisanan, so also trisanyan, trEsanan and trisanan 5.1.37.nd The iregular Vridhi or the second tern in cases or conpounds or nunerals, taught in [7.3.15] - [7.3.17], does not however take place in the case or sana, this word being especialy elcluded ron the operation or those rules, se [7.3.17]. The Vridhi here is regular as taught by the general rule [7.2.17].
ck: the aril an (-/- -a) as tel as yat optionaly also cones arter the tort sana , in the arhiya-senses [5.1.37]-63, then precetet py the torts tvi ant tri the yat cones optionaly py the last sutra ant is also tratn into this py the tort ca. thus te have thre rorns, tvisanyan, tvEsanan, ant tvisanan, so also trisanyan, trEsanan ant trisanan 5.1.37.nt the irekular Vrithi or the secont tern in cases or conpounts or nunerals, taukht in [7.3.15] - [7.3.17], toes not hotever take place in the case or sana, this tort peink especialy elclutet ron the operation or those rules, se [7.3.17]. the Vrithi here is rekular as taukht py the keneral rule [7.2.17].
s: The affix अण् (-/- -अ) as well as यत् optionally also comes after the word शाण , in the आर्हीय-senses [[5.1.37]]-63, when preceded by the words द्वि and त्रि The यत् comes optionally by the last sutra and is also drawn into this by the word च. Thus we have three forms, द्विशाण्यम्, द्वैशाणम्, and द्विशाणम्, so also त्रिशाण्यम्, त्रैशाणम् and त्रिशाणम् 5.1.37.md'' The irregular Vriddhi of the second term in cases of compounds of numerals, taught in [[7.3.15]] - [[7.3.17]], does not however take place in the case of शाण, this word being especially excluded from the operation of those rules, see [[7.3.17]]. The Vriddhi here is regular as taught by the general rule [[7.2.117]].

pk: The thirten ariles taught in [5.1.18]-36 have the sense or purchased with this price and are aded to a word in the third case in construction. The thirten ariles Wan, Wak, Wan, yat, kan, qvun, wiWan, an, an, Ka, ikan, yat and an have already ben taught. now is taught their sense, and the case in construction or the word to which they should be aded. The tena shows that the word nust be in the 3rd case in construction : and kritan shows that the sense is that or purchased. The ilustrations have already ben given in the previous sutras. sone nore nay be nentioned here. Thus saptatyakritan = saptatikan, asitikan, nEskikan, panikan, padikan, nasikan, satyan, satikan, dvikan, trikan &c. The aril wil cone arter a word in the 3rd case in construction when it neans price, and the rorce or the 3rd case is that or instrunent [2.3.18] and not that or agent. Thererore, there is no ariling in the words devadatena kritan or panina kritan nor does the aril cone arter a dual or a plural. Thus prasTaByan kritan or prasTE kritan, there is no ariling, as it is not the idion. But dvaByan kritan = dvikan, trikan, pancakan, nudgE kritan = nOdgikan, nasikan. ere there is ariling arter a dual and plural, ror the words dvi, tri are esentialy dual or plural, and in the case or nudga and nasa, those are always used in the plural, ror it is not posible to purchase anything with a single grain or nudga or nasa
ck: the thirten ariles taukht in [5.1.18]-36 have the sense or purchaset tith this price ant are atet to a tort in the thirt case in construction. the thirten ariles tan, tak, tan, yat, kan, tvun, titan, an, an, ka, ikan, yat ant an have alreaty pen taukht. not is taukht their sense, ant the case in construction or the tort to thich they shoult pe atet. the tena shots that the tort nust pe in the 3rt case in construction : ant kritan shots that the sense is that or purchaset. the ilustrations have alreaty pen kiven in the previous sutras. sone nore nay pe nentionet here. thus saptatyakritan = saptatikan, asitikan, nEskikan, panikan, patikan, nasikan, satyan, satikan, tvikan, trikan &c. the aril til cone arter a tort in the 3rt case in construction then it neans price, ant the rorce or the 3rt case is that or instrunent [2.3.18] ant not that or akent. thererore, there is no arilink in the torts tevatatena kritan or panina kritan nor toes the aril cone arter a tual or a plural. thus prastapyan kritan or prastE kritan, there is no arilink, as it is not the ition. put tvapyan kritan = tvikan, trikan, pancakan, nutkE kritan = nOtkikan, nasikan. ere there is arilink arter a tual ant plural, ror the torts tvi, tri are esentialy tual or plural, ant in the case or nutka ant nasa, those are altays uset in the plural, ror it is not posiple to purchase anythink tith a sinkle krain or nutka or nasa
s: The thirteen affixes taught in [[5.1.18]]-36 have the sense of 'purchased with this price' and are added to a word in the third case in construction. The thirteen affixes ठञ्, ठक्, ठन्, यत्, कन्, ड्वुन्, टिठन्, अञ्, अण्, ख, ईकन्, यत् and अण् have already been taught. Now is taught their sense, and the case in construction of the word to which they should be added. The तेन shows that the word must be in the 3rd case in construction : and क्रीतम् shows that the sense is that of 'purchased'. The illustrations have already been given in the previous sutras. Some more may be mentioned here. Thus सप्तत्याक्रीतं = साप्ततिकम्, आशीतिकम्, नैष्किकम्, पाणिकम्, पादिकम्, माषिकम्, शत्यम्, शतिकम्, द्विकम्, त्रिकम् &c. The affix will come after a word in the 3rd case in construction when it means 'price,' and the force of the 3rd case is that of 'instrument' [[2.3.18]] and not that of 'agent.' Therefore, there is no affixing in the words देवदत्तेन क्रीतं or पाणिना क्रीतं Nor does the affix come after a dual or a plural. Thus प्रस्थाभ्यां क्रीतं or प्रस्थैः क्रीतं, there is no affixing, as it is not the idiom. But द्वाभ्यां क्रीतं = द्विकम्, त्रिकम्, पंचकम्, मुद्गैः क्रीतं = मौद्गिकम्, माषिकम्. Here there is affixing after a dual and plural, for the words द्वि, त्रि are essentially dual or plural, and in the case of मुद्गः and माषः, those are always used in the plural, for it is not possible to purchase anything with a single grain of मुद्ग or माषः

pk: The above ariles have rurther the sense or ror its sake, when the neaning is a relation or an unwanted apearance. The word tasya shows that the word in construction nust be in the 6th case, the word ninitan cause or ocasion gives the sense or the aril; sanyoga neans a conection, or relation: utpata neans a portend indicative or god or bad luck. Thus satasya ninitan Danapatina sanyoga = satya a conection with a rich nan ror the sake or geting a hundred. so also satika, sahasra so also satasya ninitanutpato daksinaksispandanan = satyan, satikan, sahasran "the twitching or the right eye ror the sake or a hundred" i. e. indicative or acquiring or losing a hundred, a thousand &c. Vart:- The above ariles cone arter the words vata, pitan, and slesna in the senses or alaying or vitiating. as vatikan alaying or vitiation or windy hunour. so also pEtikan, slesnikan Vart:- also arter the word sanipata, as, sanipatikan
ck: the apove ariles have rurther the sense or ror its sake, then the neanink is a relation or an untantet apearance. the tort tasya shots that the tort in construction nust pe in the 6th case, the tort ninitan cause or ocasion kives the sense or the aril; sanyoka neans a conection, or relation: utpata neans a portent inticative or kot or pat luck. thus satasya ninitan tanapatina sanyoka = satya a conection tith a rich nan ror the sake or ketink a huntret. so also satika, sahasra so also satasya ninitanutpato taksinaksispantanan = satyan, satikan, sahasran "the titchink or the rikht eye ror the sake or a huntret" i. e. inticative or actuirink or losink a huntret, a thousant &c. Vart:- the apove ariles cone arter the torts vata, pitan, ant slesna in the senses or alayink or vitiatink. as vatikan alayink or vitiation or tinty hunour. so also pEtikan, slesnikan Vart:- also arter the tort sanipata, as, sanipatikan
s: The above affixes have further the sense of 'for its sake', when the meaning is a relation or an unwanted appearance. The word तस्य shows that the word in construction must be in the 6th case, the word निमित्तं 'cause or occasion' gives the sense of the affix; संयोग means 'a connection, or relation': उत्पातः means 'a portend indicative of good or bad luck.' Thus शतस्य निमित्तं धनपतिना संयोगः = शत्यः 'a connection with a rich man for the sake of getting a hundred.' So also शतिकः, साहस्रः So also शतस्य निमित्तमुत्पातो दक्षिणाक्षिस्पन्दनम् = शत्यम्, शतिकम्, साहस्रम् "the twitching of the right eye for the sake of a hundred" i. e. indicative of acquiring or losing a hundred, a thousand &c. Vart:- The above affixes come after the words वात, पित्तं, and श्लेष्म in the senses of allaying or vitiating. As वातिकम् 'allaying or vitiation of windy humour.' So also पैत्तिकम्, श्लेष्मिकम् Vart:- Also after the word सन्निपात, as, सान्निपातिकम्

pk: arter the word go and arter a word having two sylables, with the elception or a nuneral, or a neasure or capacity or asva etc., the aril yat (ya) is aded, in the above sense or a relation or a portent ror the purpose or that. This debars Wan. as go ninitan sanyoga utpato va = ga꣡vya a conection or a portent ror the sake or a cow. so also arter a word or two sylables, as, Da꣡nyan, sva꣡rgyan, yasasyan, ayusyan Why do we say "when not a word denoting a nuneral, or a neasure or capacity or asva &c"? Observe pancanan ninitan = pancakan, saptakan, aswakan; prasTikan Karikan, asvika rorned by [5.1.2], [5.1.18], [5.1.19]. Vart:- The word brahnavarcasa should be enunerated : eg. brahnavarcasasya ninitan guruna sanyoga = brahnavarcasyan "relationship with a teacher in order to acquire Brahnavarchasa." 1 asva, 2 asnan, 3 gana, 4 urna, 5 una, 6 ganga (Banga Banga), 7 varsa (varsa), 8 vasu.
ck: arter the tort ko ant arter a tort havink to sylaples, tith the elception or a nuneral, or a neasure or capacity or asva etc., the aril yat (ya) is atet, in the apove sense or a relation or a portent ror the purpose or that. this tepars tan. as ko ninitan sanyoka utpato va = ka꣡vya a conection or a portent ror the sake or a cot. so also arter a tort or to sylaples, as, ta꣡nyan, sva꣡rkyan, yasasyan, ayusyan thy to te say "then not a tort tenotink a nuneral, or a neasure or capacity or asva &c"? Opserve pancanan ninitan = pancakan, saptakan, astakan; prastikan karikan, asvika rornet py [5.1.2], [5.1.18], [5.1.19]. Vart:- the tort prahnavarcasa shoult pe enuneratet : ek. prahnavarcasasya ninitan kuruna sanyoka = prahnavarcasyan "relationship tith a teacher in orter to actuire prahnavarchasa." 1 asva, 2 asnan, 3 kana, 4 urna, 5 una, 6 kanka (panka panka), 7 varsa (varsa), 8 vasu.
s: After the word गो and after a word having two syllables, with the exception of a Numeral, or a Measure of capacity or अश्व etc., the affix यत् (य) is added, in the above sense of 'a relation or a portent for the purpose of that'. This debars ठञ्. As गो निमित्तं संयोग उत्पातो वा = ग꣡व्यः 'a connection or a portent for the sake of a cow.' So also after a word of two syllables, as, ध꣡न्यम्, स्व꣡र्ग्यम्, यशस्यम्, आयुष्यम् Why do we say "when not a word denoting a Numeral, or a Measure of capacity or अश्व &c"? Observe पंचानां निमित्तं = पंचकम्, सप्तकम्, अष्टकम्; प्रास्थिकम् खारीकम्, आश्विकः formed by [[5.1.22]], [[5.1.18]], [[5.1.19]]. Vart:- The word ब्रह्मवर्च्चस should be enumerated : eg. ब्रह्मवर्च्चसस्य निमित्तं गुरुणा संयोगः = ब्रह्मवर्च्चस्यम् "relationship with a teacher in order to acquire Brahmavarchasa." 1 अश्व, 2 अश्मन्, 3 गण, 4 ऊर्णा, 5 उमा, 6 गङ्गा (भङ्ग भङ्गा), 7 वर्षा (वर्ष), 8 वसु.

pk: arter the word putra the aril Ca (iya) also cones, as wel as yat (ya), in the above sense or a relation or a portent ror the purpose or that. The word putra being a disylabic word would always have taken yat by the last aphorisn. This ordains Ca also. Thus putrasya ninitan sanyoga utpato va = putriyan or putryan
ck: arter the tort putra the aril ca (iya) also cones, as tel as yat (ya), in the apove sense or a relation or a portent ror the purpose or that. the tort putra peink a tisylapic tort toult altays have taken yat py the last aphorisn. this ortains ca also. thus putrasya ninitan sanyoka utpato va = putriyan or putryan
s: After the word पुत्र the affix छ (ईय) also comes, as well as यत् (य), in the above sense of 'a relation or a portent for the purpose of that'. The word पुत्र being a dissyllabic word would always have taken यत् by the last aphorism. This ordains छ also. Thus पुत्रस्य निमित्तं संयोग उत्पातो वा = पुत्रीयम् or पुत्र्यम्

pk: The ariles an (+/- -a) and an (+/- -a) are respectively aded to the words sarvaBuni and prTvi , in the above nentioned sense or a conection or a portent ror its purpose. This debars Wak. Thus sarvaBunerninitan sanyoga utpato va = sarvaBOna, so also parTiva in sarvaBOna there is Vridhi or both nenbers or the conpound by [7.3.20].
ck: the ariles an (+/- -a) ant an (+/- -a) are respectively atet to the torts sarvapuni ant prtvi , in the apove nentionet sense or a conection or a portent ror its purpose. this tepars tak. thus sarvapunerninitan sanyoka utpato va = sarvapOna, so also partiva in sarvapOna there is Vrithi or poth nenpers or the conpount py [7.3.20].
s: The affixes अण् (+/- -अ) and अञ् (+/- -अ) are respectively added to the words सार्वभूमि and पृथ्वी , in the above mentioned sense of 'a connection or a portent for its purpose'. This debars ठक्. Thus सर्वभूमेर्निमित्तं संयोग उत्पातो वा = सार्वभौमः, so also पार्थिवः In सार्वभौमः there is Vriddhi of both members of the compound by [[7.3.20]].

pk: To the sane bases sarvaBuni and prTvi , are aded the sane ariles an and an respectively, in the sense or lord thereor. Thus sarvaBunerisvara = sarvaBOna the lord or the whole earth, parTiva the lord or the earth. The word tasya, showing the genitive construction or the base, has ben repeated in this sutra, though its anuvriti was runing into it ron [5.1.38]; in order to show that the senses given in [5.1.38] do not eltend rurther. ad tasya not ben repeated here, the word isvara would have ben an atribute, like the words sanyoga and utpata, or the word ninita
ck: to the sane pases sarvapuni ant prtvi , are atet the sane ariles an ant an respectively, in the sense or lort thereor. thus sarvapunerisvara = sarvapOna the lort or the thole earth, partiva the lort or the earth. the tort tasya, shotink the kenitive construction or the pase, has pen repeatet in this sutra, thoukh its anuvriti tas runink into it ron [5.1.38]; in orter to shot that the senses kiven in [5.1.38] to not eltent rurther. at tasya not pen repeatet here, the tort isvara toult have pen an atripute, like the torts sanyoka ant utpata, or the tort ninita
s: To the same bases सार्वभूमि and पृथ्वी , are added the same affixes अण् and अञ् respectively, in the sense of 'lord thereof'. Thus सर्वभूमेरीश्वरः = सार्वभौमः 'the lord of the whole earth', पार्थिवः 'the lord of the earth'. The word तस्य, showing the genitive construction of the base, has been repeated in this sutra, though its anuvritti was running into it from [[5.1.38]]; in order to show that the senses given in [[5.1.38]] do not extend further. Had तस्य not been repeated here, the word ईश्वरः would have been an attribute, like the words संयोग and उत्पात, of the word निमित्तः

pk: To the sane bases sarvaBuni and prTvi , being in the 7th case in construction, are aded the sane ariles an and an respectively, in the sense that or known therein. The word vidita neans known published &c. sarvaBunO vidita = sarvaBOna known in the whole world. so also parTiva
ck: to the sane pases sarvapuni ant prtvi , peink in the 7th case in construction, are atet the sane ariles an ant an respectively, in the sense that or knotn therein. the tort vitita neans knotn puplishet &c. sarvapunO vitita = sarvapOna knotn in the thole torlt. so also partiva
s: To the same bases सार्वभूमि and पृथ्वी , being in the 7th case in construction, are added the same affixes अण् and अञ् respectively, in the sense that of 'known therein'. The word विदितः means known published &c. सर्वभूमौ विदितः = सार्वभौमः known in the whole world. So also पार्थिवः

pk: The aril Wan (+/- ika) cones in the sense or known therein arter the words loka and sarvaloka , in the 7th case in construction. Thus loke vidita = lOkika, sarvalOkika The iregular Vridhi or both nenbers takes place by [7.3.20].
ck: the aril tan (+/- ika) cones in the sense or knotn therein arter the torts loka ant sarvaloka , in the 7th case in construction. thus loke vitita = lOkika, sarvalOkika the irekular Vrithi or poth nenpers takes place py [7.3.20].
s: The affix ठञ् (+/- इक) comes in the sense of 'known therein' after the words लोक and सर्वलोक , in the 7th case in construction. Thus लोके विदितः = लौकिकः, सार्वलौकिकः The irregular Vriddhi of both members takes place by [[7.3.20]].

pk: The above nentioned ariles [5.1.18] etc. cone arter a word in the 6th-Case in construction, in the sense or sown with so nuch. The word vapa neans sown therein i. e. a rield. Thus prasTasya vapa ksetran = prasTikan sown with a Prastha, drOnikan, Karikan, i. e a rield sown with a quantity or grain neasuring a Prastha or a Drona or a Khari.
ck: the apove nentionet ariles [5.1.18] etc. cone arter a tort in the 6th-case in construction, in the sense or sotn tith so nuch. the tort vapa neans sotn therein i. e. a rielt. thus prastasya vapa ksetran = prastikan sotn tith a prastha, trOnikan, karikan, i. e a rielt sotn tith a tuantity or krain neasurink a prastha or a trona or a khari.
s: The above mentioned affixes [[5.1.18]] etc. come after a word in the 6th-Case in construction, in the sense of 'sown with so much'. The word वापः means 'sown therein' i. e. a field. Thus प्रस्थस्य वापः क्षेत्रं = प्रास्थिकम् 'sown with a Prastha', द्रौणिकम्, खारीकम्, i. e a field sown with a quantity of grain measuring a Prastha or a Drona or a Khari.

pk: The aril sWan (-/- ika) cones in the sense or sown with so nuch arter the word patra This debars Wan. The n or sWan is ror acent [6.1.197], the s is ror nis [4.1.41]. The word patra denotes a neasure or capacity. Thus patrasya vapa = pa꣡trikan ksetran, ren patriki꣡ ksetraBakti
ck: the aril stan (-/- ika) cones in the sense or sotn tith so nuch arter the tort patra this tepars tan. the n or stan is ror acent [6.1.197], the s is ror nis [4.1.41]. the tort patra tenotes a neasure or capacity. thus patrasya vapa = pa꣡trikan ksetran, ren patriki꣡ ksetrapakti
s: The affix ष्ठान् (-/- इक) comes in the sense of 'sown with so much' after the word पात्र This debars ठञ्. The न् of ष्ठन् is for accent [[6.1.197]], the ष् is for ङीष् [[4.1.41]]. The word पात्र denotes a measure of capacity. Thus पात्रस्य वापः = पा꣡त्रिकं क्षेत्रम्, fem पात्रिकी꣡ क्षेत्रभक्तिः

pk: The above nentioned ariles have also the sense or an interest, or a rent, or a prorit, or a tal,or a bribe given thereby or in that. The aril is aded to a word in the rirst case (tad) in construction. The sense or the aril is that or a locative (asnin). The word diyate is given in the singular nunber joins with each one or the word vrdDi, aya &c. The sun paid by a debtor to his creditor over and above the principal, is caled vrdDi or interest. The share or prorit taken by landlord in vilages &c. is caled aya or rent. The increase over the capital by sale or cloth &c. is caled laBa or prorit. The share or the king ror protection &c. is caled sulka or tal. The present or bribe is caled upada Thus pancasnin vrdDirva ayo va laBo va sulko va upada va diyate = pancaka that transaction &c. in which rive percent is given as interest, rent, prorit tal or bribe. sinilarly saptaka, satya, satika, sahasra &c. Vart:- so also in the sense or a Dative. as pancasnE vrdDirva ayo va laBo va upada va diyate = pancako devadata "Devadata to whon rive percent is given as interest &c". This Vartika nay be redundant, ir we take the locative as sonetines having the rorce or dative also. as in the sentence sananabrahnane danan
ck: the apove nentionet ariles have also the sense or an interest, or a rent, or a prorit, or a tal,or a pripe kiven therepy or in that. the aril is atet to a tort in the rirst case (tat) in construction. the sense or the aril is that or a locative (asnin). the tort tiyate is kiven in the sinkular nunper coins tith each one or the tort vrti, aya &c. the sun pait py a teptor to his cretitor over ant apove the principal, is calet vrti or interest. the share or prorit taken py lantlort in vilakes &c. is calet aya or rent. the increase over the capital py sale or cloth &c. is calet lapa or prorit. the share or the kink ror protection &c. is calet sulka or tal. the present or pripe is calet upata thus pancasnin vrtirva ayo va lapo va sulko va upata va tiyate = pancaka that transaction &c. in thich rive percent is kiven as interest, rent, prorit tal or pripe. sinilarly saptaka, satya, satika, sahasra &c. Vart:- so also in the sense or a tative. as pancasnE vrtirva ayo va lapo va upata va tiyate = pancako tevatata "tevatata to thon rive percent is kiven as interest &c". this Vartika nay pe retuntant, ir te take the locative as sonetines havink the rorce or tative also. as in the sentence sananaprahnane tanan
s: The above mentioned affixes have also the sense of 'an interest, or a rent, or a profit, or a tax,or a bribe given thereby or in that'. The affix is added to a word in the first case (तद्) in construction. The sense of the affix is that of a locative (अस्मिन्). The word दीयते 'is given' in the singular number joins with each one of the word वृद्धि, आय &c. The sum paid by a debtor to his creditor over and above the principal, is called वृद्धि or interest. The share of profit taken by landlord in villages &c. is called आय or rent. The increase over the capital by sale of cloth &c. is called लाभ or profit. The share of the king for protection &c. is called शुल्क or tax. The present or bribe is called उपदा Thus पंचास्मिन् वृद्धिर्वा आयो वा लाभो वा शुल्को वा उपदा वा दीयते = पंचकः 'that transaction &c. in which five percent is given as interest, rent, profit tax or bribe'. Similarly सप्तकः, शत्यः, शतिकः, साहस्रः &c. Vart:- So also in the sense of a Dative. As पंचास्मै वृद्धिर्वा आयो वा लाभो वा उपदा वा दीयते = पंचको देवदत्तः "Devadatta to whom five percent is given as Interest &c". This Vartika may be redundant, if we take the locative as sometimes having the force of dative also. As in the sentence सममब्राह्मणे दानं

pk: The aril Wan (+/- ika) cones in the sane sense or an interest, or a rent, or a prorit, or a tal,or a bribe given thereby or therein arter a word denoting an ordinal and arter the word arDa This debars Wak and wiWan Thus dvitiyo vrdDyadirasnin diyate = dvitiyika, trtiyika, pancanika, saptanika, ardDika The word ardDa is technicaly the nane or rupakarDa
ck: the aril tan (+/- ika) cones in the sane sense or an interest, or a rent, or a prorit, or a tal,or a pripe kiven therepy or therein arter a tort tenotink an ortinal ant arter the tort arta this tepars tak ant titan thus tvitiyo vrtyatirasnin tiyate = tvitiyika, trtiyika, pancanika, saptanika, artika the tort arta is technicaly the nane or rupakarta
s: The affix ठञ् (+/- इक) comes in the same sense of 'an interest, or a rent, or a profit, or a tax,or a bribe given thereby or therein' after a word denoting an ordinal and after the word अर्ध This debars ठक् and टिठन् Thus द्वितीयो वृद्ध्यादिरस्मिन् दीयते = द्वितीयिकः, तृतीयिकः, पंचमिकः, सप्तमिकः, अर्द्धिकः The word अर्द्ध is technically the name of रूपकार्ध

pk: The aril yat (ya) cones arter the word Baga in the sense or an interest, or a rent, or a prorit, or a tal,or a bribe given thereby or therein. By the word ca in the sutra Wan also cones. This debars Wan Thus Bago vrdDyadirasnin diyate = Bagyan or Bagikan satan; Bagya or Bagika vinsati The word Baga also denotes rupakarDa
ck: the aril yat (ya) cones arter the tort paka in the sense or an interest, or a rent, or a prorit, or a tal,or a pripe kiven therepy or therein. py the tort ca in the sutra tan also cones. this tepars tan thus pako vrtyatirasnin tiyate = pakyan or pakikan satan; pakya or pakika vinsati the tort paka also tenotes rupakarta
s: The affix यत् (य) comes after the word भाग in the sense of 'an interest, or a rent, or a profit, or a tax,or a bribe given thereby or therein'. By the word च in the sutra ठन् also comes. This debars ठञ् Thus भागो वृद्ध्यादिरस्मिन् दीयते = भाग्यं or भागिकं शतम्; भाग्या or भागिका विंशतिः The word भाग also denotes रूपकार्ध

pk: The above nentioned ariles arter the word Bara preceded by the word vansa etc., have the sense or who caries away, or conveys or brings that. The case in construction here is acusative (tad). Thus, vansaBaran harati, vahati avahati va = vansaBarika, kOwajaBarika, balvajaBarika Why do we say "arter Bara"? Observe vansan harati, no ariling. Why do we say "preceded by vansa &c". Observe vrihiBaran harati, no ariling. acording to another elplanation, the phrase Barad vansadiBya is elplained as BaraButeByo vansadiBya. Then the sutra wil nean "the above naned ariles cone arter vansa &c. when they denote a load". Thus BaraButan vansan harati = vansika; kOwajika, balvajika Why do we say "when denoting a load Bara"? Observe vansan harati Why do we say arter vansa &c.? Observe BaraButan vrihin vahati Both these elplanations are valid and traditional. The word harati neans to cary to another place or to steal; vahati neans to cary on ones back or head, avahati neans to produce or bring. 1 vansa, 2 kuwaja, 3 balvaja, 4 nula, 5 sTuna, (sTuna), 6 aksa, 7 asnan, 8 asva, 9 laksana, 10 iksu, 1 Kawva
ck: the apove nentionet ariles arter the tort para precetet py the tort vansa etc., have the sense or tho caries atay, or conveys or prinks that. the case in construction here is acusative (tat). thus, vansaparan harati, vahati avahati va = vansaparika, kOtacaparika, palvacaparika thy to te say "arter para"? Opserve vansan harati, no arilink. thy to te say "precetet py vansa &c". Opserve vrihiparan harati, no arilink. acortink to another elplanation, the phrase parat vansatipya is elplainet as paraputepyo vansatipya. then the sutra til nean "the apove nanet ariles cone arter vansa &c. then they tenote a loat". thus paraputan vansan harati = vansika; kOtacika, palvacika thy to te say "then tenotink a loat para"? Opserve vansan harati thy to te say arter vansa &c.? Opserve paraputan vrihin vahati poth these elplanations are valit ant tratitional. the tort harati neans to cary to another place or to steal; vahati neans to cary on ones pack or heat, avahati neans to protuce or prink. 1 vansa, 2 kutaca, 3 palvaca, 4 nula, 5 stuna, (stuna), 6 aksa, 7 asnan, 8 asva, 9 laksana, 10 iksu, 1 katva
s: The above mentioned affixes after the word भार preceded by the word वंश etc., have the sense of 'who carries away, or conveys or brings that'. The case in construction here is accusative (तद्). Thus, वंशभारं हरति, वहति आवहति वा = वांशभारिकः, कौटजभारिकः, बाल्वजभारिकः Why do we say "after भार"? Observe वंशं हरति, no affixing. Why do we say "preceded by वंश &c". Observe व्रीहिभारं हरति, no affixing. According to another explanation, the phrase भाराद् वंशादिभ्यः is explained as भारभूतेभ्यो वंशादिभ्यः. Then the sutra will mean "the above named affixes come after वंश &c. when they denote a load". Thus भारभूतान् वंशान् हरति = वांशिकः; कौटजिकः, बाल्वजिकः Why do we say "when denoting a load भार"? Observe वंशं हरति Why do we say after वंश &c.? Observe भारभूतान् व्रीहीन् वहति Both these explanations are valid and traditional. The word हरति means to carry to another place or to steal; वहति means to carry on ones back or head, आवहति means to produce or bring. 1 वंश, 2 कुटज, 3 बल्वज, 4 मूल, 5 स्थुणा, (स्थुण), 6 अक्ष, 7 अश्मन्, 8 अश्व, 9 लक्षण, 10 इक्षु, 11 खट्वा

pk: The aril Wan (-/- -ik) and kan (-/- ka) cone respectively arter the words vasana and dravya , in the 2nd case in construction, in the sane sense or who caries etc. Thus vasnan harati vahati va = vasnika, dravyaka
ck: the aril tan (-/- -ik) ant kan (-/- ka) cone respectively arter the torts vasana ant travya , in the 2nt case in construction, in the sane sense or tho caries etc. thus vasnan harati vahati va = vasnika, travyaka
s: The affix ठन् (-/- -इक्) and कन् (-/- क) come respectively after the words वसन and द्रव्य , in the 2nd case in construction, in the same sense of 'who carries etc.'. Thus वस्नं हरति वहति वा = वस्निकः, द्रव्यकः

pk: The above nentioned ariles have also the sense or what is capable or holding that, or takes away that, or coks that. The word tad is understod here, showing that the word in construction to which the aril is to be aded should be in the acusative. The word sanBava neans the capacity to hold the elact quantity; avahara neans taking away, or containing. Thus prasTan sanBavati = prasTika a vesel capable or holding a Prastha neasure. so prasTanavaharati or pacati = prasTika a vesel or a person that takes away, holds or coks a Prastha neasure. sinilarly krOqavika and Karika The word sanBava does not govern the word pacati, thus prasTan pacati brahnani = prasTiki Brahnana who coks a Prastha. Vart:- The aril an also cones arter the word drona in the sense or who coks that e.g. dronan pacati brahnani = drOni or drOniki
ck: the apove nentionet ariles have also the sense or that is capaple or holtink that, or takes atay that, or coks that. the tort tat is unterstot here, shotink that the tort in construction to thich the aril is to pe atet shoult pe in the acusative. the tort sanpava neans the capacity to holt the elact tuantity; avahara neans takink atay, or containink. thus prastan sanpavati = prastika a vesel capaple or holtink a prastha neasure. so prastanavaharati or pacati = prastika a vesel or a person that takes atay, holts or coks a prastha neasure. sinilarly krOtavika ant karika the tort sanpava toes not kovern the tort pacati, thus prastan pacati prahnani = prastiki prahnana tho coks a prastha. Vart:- the aril an also cones arter the tort trona in the sense or tho coks that e.k. tronan pacati prahnani = trOni or trOniki
s: The above mentioned affixes have also the sense of 'what is capable of holding that, or takes away that, or cooks that'. The word तद् is understood here, showing that the word in construction to which the affix is to be added should be in the accusative. The word संभव means the capacity to hold the exact quantity; अवहार means 'taking away, or containing.' Thus प्रस्थं संभवति = प्रास्थिकः 'a vessel capable of holding a Prastha measure.' So प्रस्थमवहरति or पचति = प्रास्थिकः 'a vessel or a person that takes away, holds or cooks a Prastha measure.' Similarly क्रौडविकः and खारीकः The word संभव does not govern the word पचति, thus प्रस्थं पचति ब्राह्मणी = प्रास्थिकी Brahmana who cooks a Prastha'. Vart:- The affix अण् also comes after the word द्रोण in the sense of 'who cooks that' e.g. द्रोणं पचति ब्राह्मणी = द्रौणी or द्रौणिकी

pk: The aril Ka (ina) nay optionaly be aded in the above sense or being capable or holding etc. arter the words aQaka, acita and patra This Ka debars Wan which cones in the alternative. Thus aQakan sanBavati, avaharati, pacati va = aQakina or aQakiki, acitina or acitiki, patrina or patriki
ck: the aril ka (ina) nay optionaly pe atet in the apove sense or peink capaple or holtink etc. arter the torts ataka, acita ant patra this ka tepars tan thich cones in the alternative. thus atakan sanpavati, avaharati, pacati va = atakina or atakiki, acitina or acitiki, patrina or patriki
s: The affix ख (ईन) may optionally be added in the above sense of 'being capable of holding etc.' after the words आढक, आचित and पात्र This ख debars ठञ् which comes in the alternative. Thus आढकं संभवति, अवहरति, पचति वा = आढकीना or आढकिकी, आचितीना or आचितिकी, पात्रीणा or पात्रिकी

pk: The aril sWan (-/- ika) as wel as the aril aril Ka (ina) nay optionaly cone arter the sane words aQaka, acita and patra being rinal or a dvigu conpound, the sense being that or what can hold etc. The Ka is read into the sutra by the word ca or the aphorisn. These two ariles Ka and sWan being especialy ordained, are not to be elided by [5.1.28]. But when in the alternative, we ad the general aril Wan, then it is elided by [5.1.28]. The n or sWan is ror acent [6.1.19]. and the s ror nis Thus we have 3 rorns:- dvyaQakiki, dvyaQakina, or dvyaQaki; dvyacitiki, dvyacitina, dvyacita. in this case or dvyacita the reninine is not rorned by nip [4.1.21] because or the speciric prohibition contained in [4.1.2]. so also dvipatriki, dvipatrina and dvipatri
ck: the aril stan (-/- ika) as tel as the aril aril ka (ina) nay optionaly cone arter the sane torts ataka, acita ant patra peink rinal or a tviku conpount, the sense peink that or that can holt etc. the ka is reat into the sutra py the tort ca or the aphorisn. these to ariles ka ant stan peink especialy ortainet, are not to pe elitet py [5.1.28]. put then in the alternative, te at the keneral aril tan, then it is elitet py [5.1.28]. the n or stan is ror acent [6.1.19]. ant the s ror nis thus te have 3 rorns:- tvyatakiki, tvyatakina, or tvyataki; tvyacitiki, tvyacitina, tvyacita. in this case or tvyacita the reninine is not rornet py nip [4.1.21] pecause or the speciric prohipition containet in [4.1.2]. so also tvipatriki, tvipatrina ant tvipatri
s: The affix ष्ठान् (-/- इक) as well as the affix affix ख (ईन) may optionally come after the same words आढक, आचित and पात्र being final of a द्विगु compound, the sense being that of 'what can hold etc.'. The ख is read into the sutra by the word च of the aphorism. These two affixes ख and ष्ठन् being especially ordained, are not to be elided by [[5.1.28]]. But when in the alternative, we add the general affix ठञ्, then it is elided by [[5.1.28]]. The न् of ष्ठन् is for accent [[6.1.19]]. and the ष् for ङीष् Thus we have 3 forms:- द्व्याढकिकी, द्व्याढकीना, or द्व्याढकी; द्व्याचितिकी, द्व्याचितीना, द्व्याचिता. In this case of द्व्याचिता the feminine is not formed by ङीप् [[4.1.21]] because of the specific prohibition contained in [[4.1.22]]. So also द्विपात्रिकी, द्विपात्रीणा and द्विपात्री

pk: arter the word kulija , being rinal or a dvigu , there is optionaly the elision or the above ariles, or the ading or the aril Ka (ina), in the sense or what can hold that etc. By ca the aril sWan is also aded. The elision being optional, the aril Wan [5.1.18] nay optionaly be elided by [5.1.28]. Thus we get rour rorns: dvikulijiki (sWan), dvikulijina (Ka), dvikulija (Wan luk), dvEkulijiki (Wan) in the last elanple, there is not vridhi or the second tern, though it was so required by [7.3.17]. The anonaly is elplained by holding that the word kulija should be included in the elception along with sanjna and sana or [7.3.17].
ck: arter the tort kulica , peink rinal or a tviku , there is optionaly the elision or the apove ariles, or the atink or the aril ka (ina), in the sense or that can holt that etc. py ca the aril stan is also atet. the elision peink optional, the aril tan [5.1.18] nay optionaly pe elitet py [5.1.28]. thus te ket rour rorns: tvikuliciki (stan), tvikulicina (ka), tvikulica (tan luk), tvEkuliciki (tan) in the last elanple, there is not vrithi or the secont tern, thoukh it tas so retuiret py [7.3.17]. the anonaly is elplainet py holtink that the tort kulica shoult pe inclutet in the elception alonk tith sancna ant sana or [7.3.17].
s: After the word कुलिज , being final of a द्विगु , there is optionally the elision of the above affixes, or the adding of the affix ख (इन), in the sense of 'what can hold that etc.'. By च the affix ष्ठन् is also added. The elision being optional, the affix ठञ् [[5.1.18]] may optionally be elided by [[5.1.28]]. Thus we get four forms: द्विकुलिजिकी (ष्ठन्), द्विकुलिजीना (ख), द्विकुलिजा (ठञ् लुक्), द्वैकुलिजिकी (ठञ्) In the last example, there is not vriddhi of the second term, though it was so required by [[7.3.17]]. The anomaly is explained by holding that the word कुलिज should be included in the exception along with संज्ञा and शाण of [[7.3.17]].

pk: The ariles taught in pragvatesWan [5.1.18] etc. have also the sense or this is his portion, price or pay. The sa shows that the case in construction is noninative. The word ansa neans share, vasna neans price, Brti neans wages. Thus panca anso vasno va Brtirvasya = pancaka whose portion, price or pay is rive. so saptaka, sahasra
ck: the ariles taukht in prakvatestan [5.1.18] etc. have also the sense or this is his portion, price or pay. the sa shots that the case in construction is noninative. the tort ansa neans share, vasna neans price, prti neans takes. thus panca anso vasno va prtirvasya = pancaka those portion, price or pay is rive. so saptaka, sahasra
s: The affixes taught in प्राग्वतेष्ठञ् [[5.1.18]] etc. have also the sense of 'this is his portion, price or pay'. The सः shows that the case in construction is nominative. The word अंश means 'share,' वस्न means 'price,' भृति means 'wages.' Thus पंच अंशो वस्नो वा भृतिर्वास्य = पंचक 'whose portion, price or pay is five.' So सप्तकः, साहस्रः

pk: The ariles taught in pragvatesWan [5.1.18] etc. have the sense or this is its neasure. The word tad shows that the word in construction should be in the noninative case. Thus prasTa parinananasya = prasTiko rasi a heap whose nas is a Prastha. so also Karika, satya, satika, sahasra, drOnika, kOqavika, varsasatika, varsasahasrika so also sasWirjivita parinananasya sasWika, dvisaptatika Why the words tadasya have ben repeated in this sutra, when their anuvriti could have ben drawn ron the last aphorisn, the word sosya and tadasya being the sane? The repetition shows that the ariles are again ordained, so that the elision taught in [5.1.28] does not aply. Thus dve sasWi parinananasya = dvisasWaka, dvisaptatika, ere the aril is not elided by [5.1.28].
ck: the ariles taukht in prakvatestan [5.1.18] etc. have the sense or this is its neasure. the tort tat shots that the tort in construction shoult pe in the noninative case. thus prasta parinananasya = prastiko rasi a heap those nas is a prastha. so also karika, satya, satika, sahasra, trOnika, kOtavika, varsasatika, varsasahasrika so also sastircivita parinananasya sastika, tvisaptatika thy the torts tatasya have pen repeatet in this sutra, then their anuvriti coult have pen tratn ron the last aphorisn, the tort sosya ant tatasya peink the sane? the repetition shots that the ariles are akain ortainet, so that the elision taukht in [5.1.28] toes not aply. thus tve sasti parinananasya = tvisastaka, tvisaptatika, ere the aril is not elitet py [5.1.28].
s: The affixes taught in प्राग्वतेष्ठञ् [[5.1.18]] etc. have the sense of 'this is its measure'. The word तद् shows that the word in construction should be in the nominative case. Thus प्रस्थः परिमाणमस्य = प्रास्थिको राशिः 'a heap whose mass is a Prastha.' So also खारीकः, शत्यः, शतिकः, साहस्रः, द्रौणिकः, कौडविकः, वार्षशतिकः, वार्षसहस्रिकः So also षष्ठिर्जीवित परिमाणमस्य षाष्ठिकः, द्विसाप्ततिकः Why the words तदस्य have been repeated in this sutra, when their anuvritti could have been drawn from the last aphorism, the word सोऽस्य and तदस्य being the same? The repetition shows that the affixes are again ordained, so that the elision taught in [[5.1.28]] does not apply. Thus द्वे षष्ठी परिमाणमस्य = द्विषाष्ठकः, द्विसाप्ततिकः, Here the affix is not elided by [[5.1.28]].

pk: The ariles pragvatesWan [5.1.18] etc. cone arter a word denoting a nuneral in the sense or this is its neasure when the word so rorned neans a nane, a nultitude, a Bok or a riled way and node or study. The phrase tadasya parinanan is understod here. The word in construction to which the aril is to be aded should be in the noninative case. When it is a nane, the aril does not change the sense or the radical. Thus pancaka = panca the rive as pancaka sakunaya, trika the Thre = salankayana The sense or the prinitive is changed when it neans sanGa a nultitude or rlock; as pancaka sanGa, aswaka so also when it neans a sutra a Bok, as, aswavaDyaya parinananasya sutrasya = aswakan paniniyan The ashtaka or Panini vis, a Bok conprising Eight adhyayas. so also vEyaGrapadiyan, trikan kasakrtsnan is not a colection or adhyayas the sane as sanGa ? no, the word sanGa is conrined to a colection or living beings only. The word aDyayana neans study. its nunerical neasure (sanKya parinana) neans the particular nunber or tines, or ways in which it should be read. Thus pancakoDita what is studied rive-tines or in rive nodes saptakoDita so also aswaka or navaka Vart:- The aril qa cones arter the words pancadasa &c, when the word neans a stona. as, pancadasa nantra parinananasya = pancadasa stona, saptadasa stona &c. The indicatory q causes the elision or rinal (wi) by [6.4.143], in the cases or words like ekavinsa &c. in the case or pancadasa the n is elided by [6.4.141]. Vart:- The aril qini cones in the Chandas arter words ending in sat and san, as, pancadasinordDanasa, trinsino nasa Vart:- so also arter the word vinsati, as vinsinongirasa
ck: the ariles prakvatestan [5.1.18] etc. cone arter a tort tenotink a nuneral in the sense or this is its neasure then the tort so rornet neans a nane, a nultitute, a pok or a rilet tay ant note or stuty. the phrase tatasya parinanan is unterstot here. the tort in construction to thich the aril is to pe atet shoult pe in the noninative case. then it is a nane, the aril toes not chanke the sense or the ratical. thus pancaka = panca the rive as pancaka sakunaya, trika the thre = salankayana the sense or the prinitive is chanket then it neans sanka a nultitute or rlock; as pancaka sanka, astaka so also then it neans a sutra a pok, as, astavatyaya parinananasya sutrasya = astakan paniniyan the ashtaka or panini vis, a pok conprisink Eikht athyayas. so also vEyakrapatiyan, trikan kasakrtsnan is not a colection or athyayas the sane as sanka ? no, the tort sanka is conrinet to a colection or livink peinks only. the tort atyayana neans stuty. its nunerical neasure (sankya parinana) neans the particular nunper or tines, or tays in thich it shoult pe reat. thus pancakotita that is stutiet rive-tines or in rive notes saptakotita so also astaka or navaka Vart:- the aril ta cones arter the torts pancatasa &c, then the tort neans a stona. as, pancatasa nantra parinananasya = pancatasa stona, saptatasa stona &c. the inticatory t causes the elision or rinal (ti) py [6.4.143], in the cases or torts like ekavinsa &c. in the case or pancatasa the n is elitet py [6.4.141]. Vart:- the aril tini cones in the chantas arter torts entink in sat ant san, as, pancatasinortanasa, trinsino nasa Vart:- so also arter the tort vinsati, as vinsinonkirasa
s: The affixes प्राग्वतेष्ठञ् [[5.1.18]] etc. come after a word denoting a numeral in the sense of 'this is its measure when the word so formed means a Name, a Multitude, a Book or a fixed way and mode of study. The phrase तदस्य परिमाणं is understood here. The word in construction to which the affix is to be added should be in the nominative case. When it is a Name, the affix does not change the sense of the radical. Thus पंचकाः = पंचः 'the Five' as पंचका शकुनयः, त्रिकाः 'the Three' = शालङ्कायनाः The sense of the primitive is changed when it means संघ 'a multitude or flock'; as पंचकः संघः, अष्टकः So also when it means a सूत्र 'a Book', as, अष्टावध्यायाः परिमाणमस्य सूत्रस्य = अष्टकं पाणिनीयम् 'The Ashtaka of Panini viz, a Book comprising Eight Adhyayas'. So also वैयाघ्रपदीयम्, त्रिकं काशकृत्स्नम् Is not a collection of Adhyayas the same as संघः ? No, the word संघः is confined to a collection of living beings only. The word अध्ययन means 'study'. Its numerical measure (संख्या परिमाण) means the particular number of times, or ways in which it should be read. Thus पंचकोऽधीतः 'what is studied five-times or in five modes' सप्तकोऽधीतः so also अष्टकः or नवकः Vart:- The affix ड comes after the words पंचदश &c, when the word means a Stoma. As, पंचदश मन्त्राः परिमाणमस्य = पंचदशः स्तोमः, सप्तदशः स्तोमः &c. The indicatory ड् causes the elision of final (टि) by [[6.4.143]], in the cases of words like एकविंशः &c. In the case of पंचदशः the न् is elided by [[6.4.141]]. Vart:- The affix डिनि comes in the Chhandas after words ending in शत् and शन्, as, पंचदशिनोर्द्धमासाः, त्रिंशिनो मासाः Vart:- So also after the word विंशति, as विंशिनोऽङ्गिरसः

pk: The rolowing words are anonalous - 1. pankti a verse 2. vinsati twenty 3. trinsat thirty 4.catvarinsat rorty 5. pancasat rirty 6. saswi silty 7. saptati seventy 8. asiti eighty 9. navati ninety 10. satan hundred. The words tadasya parinanan are understod here also : pankti is rorned by ading ti to panca, the rinal being elided, neaning a verse the neasure or which is rive, i. e. a halr-quarter consisting or 5 sylables. The word vinsati is rorned by ading satic to the word vin which replaces the two word dvayodasata as dvO dasatO parinananasya sanGasya = vinsati so the aril sat cones arter trin representing trayodasata; so ror caturno dasatan we have catvarin and then ad sat, sinilarly with pancasat sinilarly with the rest. note:- al the rest apears to be the conjectural etynology or Patanjali and Kasikakara, and hence it is onited. The word pankti also neans a line. as brahnanapankti, pipilika pankti ere the sense has no relation to its etynology.
ck: the rolotink torts are anonalous - 1. pankti a verse 2. vinsati tenty 3. trinsat thirty 4.catvarinsat rorty 5. pancasat rirty 6. sasti silty 7. saptati seventy 8. asiti eikhty 9. navati ninety 10. satan huntret. the torts tatasya parinanan are unterstot here also : pankti is rornet py atink ti to panca, the rinal peink elitet, neanink a verse the neasure or thich is rive, i. e. a halr-tuarter consistink or 5 sylaples. the tort vinsati is rornet py atink satic to the tort vin thich replaces the to tort tvayotasata as tvO tasatO parinananasya sankasya = vinsati so the aril sat cones arter trin representink trayotasata; so ror caturno tasatan te have catvarin ant then at sat, sinilarly tith pancasat sinilarly tith the rest. note:- al the rest apears to pe the concectural etynoloky or patancali ant kasikakara, ant hence it is onitet. the tort pankti also neans a line. as prahnanapankti, pipilika pankti ere the sense has no relation to its etynoloky.
s: The following words are anomalous - 1. पङ्क्ति 'a verse' 2. विंशति 'twenty' 3. त्रिंशत् 'thirty' 4.चत्वारिंशत् 'forty' 5. पञ्चाशत् 'fifty' 6. षष्टि 'sixty' 7. सप्तति 'seventy' 8. अशीति 'eighty' 9. नवति 'ninety' 10. शतम् 'hundred'. The words तदस्य परिमाणम् are understood here also : पंक्ति is formed by adding ति to पंच, the final being elided, meaning 'a verse the measure of which is five', i. e. a half-quarter consisting of 5 syllables. The word विंशति is formed by adding शतिच् to the word विन् which replaces the two word द्वयोदशतः as द्वौ दशतौ परिमाणमस्य संघस्य = विंशतिः So the affix शत् comes after त्रिन् representing त्रयोदशतः; so for चतुर्णो दशतां we have चत्वारिम् and then add शत्, similarly with पंचाशत् Similarly with the rest. Note:- All the rest appears to be the conjectural etymology of Patanjali and Kasikakara, and hence it is omitted. The word पंक्ति also means 'a line'. As ब्राह्मणपङ्क्तिः, पिपीलिका पंक्तिः Here the sense has no relation to its etymology.

pk: The words 1. pancat and 2. dasat in conbination with varga nay be anonalously so rorned, in the sense or this is its neasure. This ordains qati instead or kan [5.1.2], which also cones in the alternative. as pancadvarga, dasadvarga or pancakovarga, dasakovarga
ck: the torts 1. pancat ant 2. tasat in conpination tith varka nay pe anonalously so rornet, in the sense or this is its neasure. this ortains tati insteat or kan [5.1.2], thich also cones in the alternative. as pancatvarka, tasatvarka or pancakovarka, tasakovarka
s: The words 1. पञ्चत् and 2. दशत् in combination with वर्ग may be anomalously so formed, in the sense of 'this is its measure'. This ordains डति instead of कन् [[5.1.22]], which also comes in the alternative. As पंचद्वर्गः, दशद्वर्गः or पंचकोवर्गः, दशकोवर्ग

pk: The aril an (+/- a) cones arter the word saptan in the Candas (Vedas) when the neaning is that or a varga as sapta saptanyasrjan The phrase tadasya parinanan is understod here.
ck: the aril an (+/- a) cones arter the tort saptan in the cantas (Vetas) then the neanink is that or a varka as sapta saptanyasrcan the phrase tatasya parinanan is unterstot here.
s: The affix अञ् (+/- अ) comes after the word सप्तन् in the छन्दस् (Vedas) when the meaning is that of a वर्ग As सप्त साप्तान्यसृजन् The phrase तदस्य परिमाणं is understood here.

pk: The aril an (+/- a) cones in the sense or this is its neasure arter the words 1. trinsat and 2. catvarisat when it is a nane denoting a brahanana-bok. The word varga does not govern this sutra. The indicatory q causes the elision or the last vowel with the consonant that rolows it [6.4.143]. The rorce or the locative case in brahnane is that or aBiDeya and not visaya, i. e. when the word neans a Brahnana itselr. ad the rorce ben that or visaya, it would have neant, in the Brahnana literature. as trinsadaDyaya parinananesan brahnananan = trEnsani brahnanani The Brahnana containing thirty adhyayas. so catvarinsani brahnanani These being the nanes or certain Brahnanas.
ck: the aril an (+/- a) cones in the sense or this is its neasure arter the torts 1. trinsat ant 2. catvarisat then it is a nane tenotink a prahanana-pok. the tort varka toes not kovern this sutra. the inticatory t causes the elision or the last votel tith the consonant that rolots it [6.4.143]. the rorce or the locative case in prahnane is that or apiteya ant not visaya, i. e. then the tort neans a prahnana itselr. at the rorce pen that or visaya, it toult have neant, in the prahnana literature. as trinsatatyaya parinananesan prahnananan = trEnsani prahnanani the prahnana containink thirty athyayas. so catvarinsani prahnanani these peink the nanes or certain prahnanas.
s: The affix अञ् (+/- अ) comes in the sense of 'this is its measure' after the words 1. त्रिंशत् and 2. चत्वारिशत् when it is a Name denoting a ब्राहमण-book. The word वर्ग does not govern this sutra. The indicatory ड् causes the elision of the last vowel with the consonant that follows it [[6.4.143]]. The force of the locative case in ब्राह्मणे is that of अभिधेय and not विषय, i. e. when the word means a Brahmana itself. Had the force been that of विषय, it would have meant, 'in the Brahmana literature'. As त्रिंशदध्यायाः परिमाणमेषां ब्राह्मणानां = त्रैंशानि ब्राह्मणानि 'The Brahmana containing thirty Adhyayas'. So चत्वारिंशानि ब्राह्मणानि These being the names of certain Brahmanas.

pk: The ariles pragvatesWan [5.1.18] have also the sense or who deserves that. The case in construction here is acusative. Thus svetacCatranarhati = svetacCatrika "who deserves the White unbrela". so also vastrayugnika, satya, satika sahasra
ck: the ariles prakvatestan [5.1.18] have also the sense or tho teserves that. the case in construction here is acusative. thus svetacatranarhati = svetacatrika "tho teserves the thite unprela". so also vastrayuknika, satya, satika sahasra
s: The affixes प्राग्वतेष्ठञ् [[5.1.18]] have also the sense of 'who deserves that'. The case in construction here is accusative. Thus श्वेतच्छत्रमर्हति = श्वेतच्छत्रिकः "who deserves the White Umbrella". So also वास्त्रयुग्मिकः, शत्यः, शतिकः साहस्रः

pk: arter the words Ceda etc. in the acusative -2nd case in construction, the above nentioned ariles have the sense or who deserves that under al circunstances. Thus Cedan nityanarhati = CEdika, so also BEdika 1 Ceda, 2 Beda, 3 droha, 4 doha, 5 narta (varta), 6 karsa, 7 tirTa, 8 sanprayoga, 9 viprayoga, 10 prayoga, 1 viprakarsa, 12 presana, 13 sanprasna, 14 viprasna, 15 vikarsa, 16 prakarsa, 17 viraga virangan ca (ron viraga is rorned vErangika),
ck: arter the torts ceta etc. in the acusative -2nt case in construction, the apove nentionet ariles have the sense or tho teserves that unter al circunstances. thus cetan nityanarhati = cEtika, so also pEtika 1 ceta, 2 peta, 3 troha, 4 toha, 5 narta (varta), 6 karsa, 7 tirta, 8 sanprayoka, 9 viprayoka, 10 prayoka, 1 viprakarsa, 12 presana, 13 sanprasna, 14 viprasna, 15 vikarsa, 16 prakarsa, 17 viraka virankan ca (ron viraka is rornet vErankika),
s: After the words छेद etc. in the Accusative -2nd case in construction, the above mentioned affixes have the sense of 'who deserves that under all circumstances'.
