Thus छेदं नित्यमर्हति = छैदिकः, so also भैदिकः 1 छेद, 2 भेद, 3 द्रोह, 4 दोह, 5 मर्त (वर्त), 6 कर्ष, 7 तीर्थ, 8 संप्रयोग, 9 विप्रयोग, 10 प्रयोग, 11 विप्रकर्ष, 12 प्रेषण, 13 संप्रश्न, 14 विप्रश्न, 15 विकर्ष, 16 प्रकर्ष, 17 विराग विरङ्गं च (from विराग is formed वैरङ्गिक),

pk: The aril yat as wel as the above ariles cone arter the word sirsacCeda in the acusative -2nd case in the sense who deserves that under al circunstances. Thus sirasCedan nityanarhati = sirsacCedya, or sErsacCedika The word siras is changed iregularly into sirsa berore the aril.
ck: the aril yat as tel as the apove ariles cone arter the tort sirsaceta in the acusative -2nt case in the sense tho teserves that unter al circunstances. thus sirascetan nityanarhati = sirsacetya, or sErsacetika the tort siras is chanket irekularly into sirsa perore the aril.
s: The affix यत् as well as the above affixes come after the word शीर्षच्छेद in the Accusative -2nd case in the sense 'who deserves that under all circumstances'. Thus शिरश्छेदं नित्यमर्हति = शीर्षच्छेद्यः, or शैर्षच्छेदिकः The word शिरस् is changed irregularly into शीर्ष before the affix.

pk: arter the words danqa etc. in the acusative -2nd case the aril ya cones in the sense or who deserves that. The word nitya does not govern this sutra. This ya debars Wak [5.1.19]. Thus danqanarhati = danqya deserving to be kiled. nusalya &c. 1 danqa, 2 nusala, 3 naDuparka, 4 kasa, 5 arGa, 6 neGa, 7 neDa, 8 suvarna, 9 udaka, 10 vaDa, 1 yuga, 12 guha, 13 Baga, 14 iBa, 15 Banga, note.- The sidhanta-Kaunudi gives the sutra as danqadiByo yat; another version gives the sutra as danqadiBya only drawing the aril yat ron the last sutra.
ck: arter the torts tanta etc. in the acusative -2nt case the aril ya cones in the sense or tho teserves that. the tort nitya toes not kovern this sutra. this ya tepars tak [5.1.19]. thus tantanarhati = tantya teservink to pe kilet. nusalya &c. 1 tanta, 2 nusala, 3 natuparka, 4 kasa, 5 arka, 6 neka, 7 neta, 8 suvarna, 9 utaka, 10 vata, 1 yuka, 12 kuha, 13 paka, 14 ipa, 15 panka, note.- the sithanta-kaunuti kives the sutra as tantatipyo yat; another version kives the sutra as tantatipya only tratink the aril yat ron the last sutra.
s: After the words दण्ड etc. in the Accusative -2nd case the affix य comes in the sense of 'who deserves that'. The word नित्य does not govern this sutra. This य debars ठक् [[5.1.19]]. Thus दण्डमर्हति = दण्ड्यः 'deserving to be killed'. मुसल्यः &c. 1 दण्ड, 2 मुसल, 3 मधुपर्क, 4 कशा, 5 अर्घ, 6 मेघ, 7 मेधा, 8 सुवर्ण, 9 उदक, 10 वध, 11 युग, 12 गुहा, 13 भाग, 14 इभ, 15 भङ्ग, Note.- The Sidhanta-Kaumudi gives the sutra as दण्डादिभ्यो यत्; another version gives the sutra as दण्डादिभ्यः only drawing the affix यत् from the last sutra.

pk: The aril yat (ya) cones in the sense or deserving that arter a pratipadika (noninal sten), in the Candas (Vedas). This debars Wan &c. Thus udakya vrtaya, yupya palasa, gartyo desa se [6.1.213].
ck: the aril yat (ya) cones in the sense or teservink that arter a pratipatika (noninal sten), in the cantas (Vetas). this tepars tan &c. thus utakya vrtaya, yupya palasa, kartyo tesa se [6.1.213].
s: The affix यत् (य) comes in the sense of 'deserving that' after a प्रातिपदिक (Nominal Stem), in the छन्दस् (Vedas). This debars ठञ् &c. Thus उदक्या वृत्तयः, यूप्यः पलाशः, गर्त्यो देशः See [[6.1.213]].

pk: The aril Gan (-/- iyan) together with yat (yan) cones in the sense or deserving that arter the word patra This debars Wak and Wan The word patra denotes neasure also. Thus patranarhati = patrya or patriya
ck: the aril kan (-/- iyan) tokether tith yat (yan) cones in the sense or teservink that arter the tort patra this tepars tak ant tan the tort patra tenotes neasure also. thus patranarhati = patrya or patriya
s: The affix घञ् (-/- इयं) together with यत् (यं) comes in the sense of 'deserving that' after the word पात्र This debars ठक् and ठञ् The word पात्र denotes measure also. Thus पात्रमर्हति = पात्र्यः or पात्रियः

pk: The ariles Ca (iyan) and yat (yan) cones in the sense or deserving that arter the words 1. kaqangara and 2. daksina This debars Wak Thus kaqankaranarhati = kaqankariya or kaqankaya one deserving straw such as a cow. so also daksiniya or daksinyo brahnana a Brahnana deserving alns.
ck: the ariles ca (iyan) ant yat (yan) cones in the sense or teservink that arter the torts 1. katankara ant 2. taksina this tepars tak thus katankaranarhati = katankariya or katankaya one teservink strat such as a cot. so also taksiniya or taksinyo prahnana a prahnana teservink alns.
s: The affixes छ (ईयं) and यत् (यं) comes in the sense of 'deserving that' after the words 1. कडङ्गर and 2. दक्षिणा This debars ठक् Thus कडङ्करमर्हति = कडङ्करीयः or कडङ्कयः 'one deserving straw' such as a cow. So also दक्षिणीयः or दक्षिण्यो ब्राह्मणः 'a Brahmana deserving alms.'

pk: The ariles Ca (iyan) and yat (yan) cones in the sense or deserving that arter the word sTalibila This debars Wak Thus sTalibiliyastanqula or sTalibilya rice deserving the pot i. e. cokable rice.
ck: the ariles ca (iyan) ant yat (yan) cones in the sense or teservink that arter the tort stalipila this tepars tak thus stalipiliyastantula or stalipilya rice teservink the pot i. e. cokaple rice.
s: The affixes छ (ईयं) and यत् (यं) comes in the sense of 'deserving that' after the word स्थालीबिल This debars ठक् Thus स्थालीबिलीयास्तण्डुलाः or स्थालीबिल्याः 'rice deserving the pot' i. e. cookable rice.

pk: The ariles Ga (i ya) and Kan (+/- -ina) cone respectively arter the words 1. yajna and 2. rtvija in the sense or deserving that This debars Wak Thus yajniyo brahnana a Brahnana worthy or honor at a sacririce. artvijino brahnana Vart:- arter the words yajna and ritvija, these ariles have also the sense or "deserving the perornance thereor". Thus yajnakarnarhati = yajniyo desa a place rit ror the perornance or sacririce. rtvik karnarhati = artvajina brahnanakulan ere ends the governing power or Wak [5.1.19]: hence rorward is the governent or Wan [5.1.18].
ck: the ariles ka (i ya) ant kan (+/- -ina) cone respectively arter the torts 1. yacna ant 2. rtvica in the sense or teservink that this tepars tak thus yacniyo prahnana a prahnana torthy or honor at a sacririce. artvicino prahnana Vart:- arter the torts yacna ant ritvica, these ariles have also the sense or "teservink the perornance thereor". thus yacnakarnarhati = yacniyo tesa a place rit ror the perornance or sacririce. rtvik karnarhati = artvacina prahnanakulan ere ents the kovernink poter or tak [5.1.19]: hence rortart is the kovernent or tan [5.1.18].
s: The affixes घ (इ य) and खञ् (+/- --ईन) come respectively after the words 1. यज्ञ and 2. ऋत्विज in the sense of 'deserving that' This debars ठक् Thus यज्ञियो ब्राह्मणः 'a Brahmana worthy of honor at a sacrifice.' आर्त्विजीनो ब्राह्मणः Vart:- After the words yajna and ritvija, these affixes have also the sense of "deserving the performance thereof". Thus यज्ञकर्मार्हति = यज्ञियो देशः 'a place fit for the performance of sacrifice.' ऋत्विक् कर्मार्हति = आर्त्वजीन ब्राह्मणकुलम् Here ends the governing power of ठक् [[5.1.19]]: hence forward is the government of ठञ् [[5.1.18]].

pk: The aril Wan (+/- - ika , pragvatesWan [5.1.18]) cones in the sense or who perorns this arter the words 1. parayana 2. turayana and 3. candrayana being in the acusative -2nd case in construction. The rorce or arhati ceases. Thus parayanika sCatra a pupil, who reads under a teacher: tOrayaniko yajanana, candrayanikastapasvi The word parayana neans a teacher (parasya karoti)
ck: the aril tan (+/- - ika , prakvatestan [5.1.18]) cones in the sense or tho perorns this arter the torts 1. parayana 2. turayana ant 3. cantrayana peink in the acusative -2nt case in construction. the rorce or arhati ceases. thus parayanika scatra a pupil, tho reats unter a teacher: tOrayaniko yacanana, cantrayanikastapasvi the tort parayana neans a teacher (parasya karoti)
s: The affix ठञ् (+/- -- इक , प्राग्वतेष्ठञ् [[5.1.18]]) comes in the sense of 'who performs this' after the words 1. पारायण 2. तुरायण and 3. चान्द्रायण being in the Accusative -2nd case in construction. The force of अर्हति ceases. Thus पारायणिक श्छात्र 'a pupil, who reads under a teacher': तौरायणिको यजमानः, चान्द्रायणिकस्तपस्वी The word पारायण means a 'teacher' (परस्य करोति)

pk: The aril Wan (+/- - ika) cones in the sense or being ralen into this or thrown into it arter the word sansaya in the acusative -2nd case in construction. Thus sansayanapana prapta = sansayika sTaswa "a doubtrul pilar", i.e. in a precarious state.
ck: the aril tan (+/- - ika) cones in the sense or peink ralen into this or throtn into it arter the tort sansaya in the acusative -2nt case in construction. thus sansayanapana prapta = sansayika stasta "a touptrul pilar", i.e. in a precarious state.
s: The affix ठञ् (+/- -- इक) comes in the sense of 'being fallen into this or thrown into it' after the word संशय in the Accusative -2nd case in construction. Thus संशयमापन्नः प्राप्तः = सांशयिकः स्थाष्टः "a doubtful pillar", i.e. in a precarious state.

pk: The aril Wan cones in the sense or who goes arter the word yojana in the acusative -2nd case construction. Thus yojanan gacCati = yOjanika Vart:- so also arter the words krosasata and yojanasata. as krOsasatika, yOjanasatika Vart:- The aril arter these two words neans also "who is worthy to be aproached ron so rar". as krosasatadaBiganananarhati = krOsasatiko Biksu, yOjanasatika acarya
ck: the aril tan cones in the sense or tho koes arter the tort yocana in the acusative -2nt case construction. thus yocanan kacati = yOcanika Vart:- so also arter the torts krosasata ant yocanasata. as krOsasatika, yOcanasatika Vart:- the aril arter these to torts neans also "tho is torthy to pe aproachet ron so rar". as krosasatatapikanananarhati = krOsasatiko piksu, yOcanasatika acarya
s: The affix ठञ् comes in the sense of 'who goes' after the word योजन in the Accusative -2nd case construction. Thus योजनं गच्छति = यौजनिकः Vart:- So also after the words क्रोशशत and योजनशत. As क्रौशशतिकः, यौजनशतिकः Vart:- The affix after these two words means also "who is worthy to be approached from so far". As क्रोशशतादभिगमनमर्हति = क्रौशशतिको भिक्षुः, यौजनशतिक आचार्यः

pk: The aril skan cones in the sense or who goes there arter the word paTa being in the acusative -2nd case in construction. Or the aril skan, s is ror nis [4.1.41], and n ror acent [6.1.197] as panTanan gacCati = pa꣡Tika ren. paTiki꣡
ck: the aril skan cones in the sense or tho koes there arter the tort pata peink in the acusative -2nt case in construction. Or the aril skan, s is ror nis [4.1.41], ant n ror acent [6.1.197] as pantanan kacati = pa꣡tika ren. patiki꣡
s: The affix ष्कन् comes in the sense of 'who goes there' after the word पथ being in the Accusative -2nd case in construction. Of the affix ष्कन्, ष् is for ङीष् [[4.1.41]], and न् for accent [[6.1.197]] As पन्थानं गच्छति = प꣡थिकः fem. पथिकी꣡

pk: The aril na cones arter the word panTa which becones the substitute or paTin, the sense or the aril being who always goes. The word nitya qualiries the sense or the aril. Thus panTanan nityan gacCati = panTa as panTo Biksan yacate Why nityan ? se paTika
ck: the aril na cones arter the tort panta thich pecones the supstitute or patin, the sense or the aril peink tho altays koes. the tort nitya tualiries the sense or the aril. thus pantanan nityan kacati = panta as panto piksan yacate thy nityan ? se patika
s: The affix ण comes after the word पन्थ which becomes the substitute of पथिन्, the sense of the affix being 'who always goes'. The word नित्य qualifies the sense of the affix. Thus पन्थानं नित्यं गच्छति = पान्थः as पान्थो भिक्षां याचते Why नित्यं ? See पथिकः

pk: The aril Wan cones in the sense or who pases by that way and what is conveyed by that way arter the word utarapaTa in the instrunental -3rd case in construction. The construction or the sutra shows that the base nust be in the 3rd case. The word ca shows that the word gacCati who pases by that way should also be read into the aphorisn. Thus utarapaTenahrtan = OtarapaTikan or utarapaTena gacCati = OtarapaTika Vart :- so also arter the word paTa preceded by the words vari, jangala, sTala, kantara the aril has the sense or conveyed by that way or pasing by that way. as varipaTenahrta = varipaTikan, varipaTena gacCati = varipaTika, so also jangalapaTika, sTalapaTika, kantarapaTika, nasculine or neuter acording as the aril neans conveyed or pasing. Vart:- so also arter the words ajapaTa and sankupaTa as, ajapaTenahrtan gacCati va = ajapaTika, sankupaTika Vart:- The aril an cones arter the word sTalapaTa when the thing conveyed or brought neans honey or peper. as sTalapaTan naDukan, sTalapaTan narican
ck: the aril tan cones in the sense or tho pases py that tay ant that is conveyet py that tay arter the tort utarapata in the instrunental -3rt case in construction. the construction or the sutra shots that the pase nust pe in the 3rt case. the tort ca shots that the tort kacati tho pases py that tay shoult also pe reat into the aphorisn. thus utarapatenahrtan = Otarapatikan or utarapatena kacati = Otarapatika Vart :- so also arter the tort pata precetet py the torts vari, cankala, stala, kantara the aril has the sense or conveyet py that tay or pasink py that tay. as varipatenahrta = varipatikan, varipatena kacati = varipatika, so also cankalapatika, stalapatika, kantarapatika, nasculine or neuter acortink as the aril neans conveyet or pasink. Vart:- so also arter the torts acapata ant sankupata as, acapatenahrtan kacati va = acapatika, sankupatika Vart:- the aril an cones arter the tort stalapata then the think conveyet or proukht neans honey or peper. as stalapatan natukan, stalapatan narican
s: The affix ठञ् comes in the sense of 'who passes by that way' and 'what is conveyed by that way' after the word उत्तरपथ in the Instrumental -3rd case in construction. The construction of the sutra shows that the base must be in the 3rd case. The word च shows that the word गच्छति 'who passes by that way' should also be read into the aphorism. Thus उत्तरपथेनाहृतं = औत्तरपथिकम् or उत्तरपथेन गच्छति = औत्तरपथिकः Vart :- So also after the word पथ preceded by the words वारि, जङ्गल, स्थल, कान्तार the affix has the sense of 'conveyed by that way' or 'passing by that way'. As वारिपथेनाहृतः = वारिपथिकम्, वारिपथेन गच्छति = वारिपथिकः, so also जाङ्गलपथिक, स्थालपथिक, कान्तारपथिक, masculine or neuter according as the affix means conveyed or passing. Vart:- So also after the words अजपथ and शंकुपथ as, अजपथेनाहृतं गच्छति वा = आजपथिकः, शांकुपथिकः Vart:- The affix अण् comes after the word स्थलपथ when the thing conveyed or brought means 'honey' or 'pepper'. As स्थालपथं मधुकं, स्थालपथं मरिचम्

pk: in the rolowing sūtras the phrase arter a word denoting tine should be suplied to conplete the sense. The word kalat bears rule in the rolowing aphorisns upto [5.1.96] inclusive. Thus the nelt sutra tena nirvrtan neans aconplished by neans thereor. We nust read the word kala into it. as nasena nirvrtan = nasikan &c.
ck: in the rolotink sūtras the phrase arter a tort tenotink tine shoult pe supliet to conplete the sense. the tort kalat pears rule in the rolotink aphorisns upto [5.1.96] inclusive. thus the nelt sutra tena nirvrtan neans aconplishet py neans thereor. te nust reat the tort kala into it. as nasena nirvrtan = nasikan &c.
s: In the following sūtras the phrase 'after a word denoting time' should be supplied to complete the sense. The word कालात् bears rule in the following aphorisms upto [[5.1.96]] inclusive. Thus the next sutra तेन निर्वृत्तम् means 'accomplished by means thereof'. We must read the word काल into it. As मासेन निर्वृत्तम् = मासिकम् &c.

pk: The aril Wan cones arter a word denoting tine in the instrunental -3rd case in construction in the sense or to be aconplished by that tine. Thus ahna nirvrtan = ahnikan "to be aconplished in a day" i. e. a certain portion or reading &c, arDanasikan, sanvatsarikan
ck: the aril tan cones arter a tort tenotink tine in the instrunental -3rt case in construction in the sense or to pe aconplishet py that tine. thus ahna nirvrtan = ahnikan "to pe aconplishet in a tay" i. e. a certain portion or reatink &c, artanasikan, sanvatsarikan
s: The affix ठञ् comes after a word denoting time in the Instrumental -3rd case in construction in the sense of 'to be accomplished by that time'. Thus अह्ना निर्वृत्तं = आह्निकम् "to be accomplished in a day" i. e. a certain portion of reading &c, आर्धमासिकम्, सांवत्सरिकम्

pk: The above ariles cone arter a word elpresing tine in the acusative -2nd case in construction in the senses or solicited to instruct ror such a period or which wil last so long. The word aDiswa neans "honorary orice", thererore one solicited to teach, but who acepts no pay [3.3.161], Brta neans "engaged on wages", Buta neans the tine pervaded or ocupied by its elistence, and Bavi the sane as last in the ruture. The word denoting tine wil be in the second case by [2.3.5]. Thus nasanaDiswa = nasikoDyapaka, so also nasanBrta = nasika karnakara, nasanButa = nasiko vyaDi, nasanBavi = nasika utsava Q. The solicitation (aDyesana) and hiring (Barana) only take a short tine, how can these acts eltend over a nonth ? a. it is not these acts, but their results which eltend over a nonth, such as, teaching and serving.
ck: the apove ariles cone arter a tort elpresink tine in the acusative -2nt case in construction in the senses or solicitet to instruct ror such a periot or thich til last so lonk. the tort atista neans "honorary orice", thererore one solicitet to teach, put tho acepts no pay [3.3.161], prta neans "enkaket on takes", puta neans the tine pervatet or ocupiet py its elistence, ant pavi the sane as last in the ruture. the tort tenotink tine til pe in the secont case py [2.3.5]. thus nasanatista = nasikotyapaka, so also nasanprta = nasika karnakara, nasanputa = nasiko vyati, nasanpavi = nasika utsava t. the solicitation (atyesana) ant hirink (parana) only take a short tine, hot can these acts eltent over a nonth ? a. it is not these acts, put their results thich eltent over a nonth, such as, teachink ant servink.
s: The above affixes come after a word expressing time in the Accusative -2nd case in construction in the senses of 'solicited to instruct for such a period or which will last so long'. The word अधीष्ट means "honorary office", therefore 'one solicited to teach, but who accepts no pay' [[3.3.161]], भृतः means "engaged on wages", भूतः means 'the time pervaded or occupied by its existence', and भावी the same as last in the future. The word denoting time will be in the second case by [[2.3.5]]. Thus मासमधीष्टः = मासिकोऽध्यापकः, so also मासंभृतः = मासिकः कर्मकरः, मासंभूतः = मासिको व्याधिः, मासंभावी = मासिक उत्सवः Q. The solicitation (अध्येषण) and hiring (भरण) only take a short time, how can these acts extend over a month ? A. It is not these acts, but their results which extend over a month, such as, teaching and serving.

pk: The ariles yat and Kan cone arter the word nasa in denoting age. This debars Wan The word Buta or the previous sutra should be read into this. Thus nasanButa = nasya or nasina a nonth old. Why do we say when denoting age? Observe nasika
ck: the ariles yat ant kan cone arter the tort nasa in tenotink ake. this tepars tan the tort puta or the previous sutra shoult pe reat into this. thus nasanputa = nasya or nasina a nonth olt. thy to te say then tenotink ake? Opserve nasika
s: The affixes यत् and खञ् come after the word मास in denoting 'age'. This debars ठञ् The word भूतः of the previous sutra should be read into this. Thus मासंभूतः = मास्यः or मासीनः 'a month old'. Why do we say when denoting 'age'? Observe मासिकः

pk: The aril yap cones arter the word nasa when rorning a dvigu sanasa (nuneral Deterninative Conpound) and neaning age. Thus dvO nasO Buta = dvinasya, trinasya
ck: the aril yap cones arter the tort nasa then rornink a tviku sanasa (nuneral teterninative conpount) ant neanink ake. thus tvO nasO puta = tvinasya, trinasya
s: The affix यप् comes after the word मास when forming a द्विगु समास (Numeral Determinative Compound) and meaning 'age'. Thus द्वौ मासौ भूतः = द्विमास्यः, त्रिमास्यः

pk: The ariles nt , yap and Wan cones in the sense or age arter the word sanasa Thus sanasya, sanasya, and sanasika
ck: the ariles nt , yap ant tan cones in the sense or ake arter the tort sanasa thus sanasya, sanasya, ant sanasika
s: The affixes ण्त् , यप् and ठञ् comes in the sense of 'age' after the word षण्मास Thus षाण्मास्यः, षण्मास्यः, and षाण्मासिकः

pk: The aril Wan cones arter the word sanasa when age is not neant. The ca draws in the aril nyat also. Thus sanasika or sanasyo roga a disease lasting sil nonths.
ck: the aril tan cones arter the tort sanasa then ake is not neant. the ca trats in the aril nyat also. thus sanasika or sanasyo roka a tisease lastink sil nonths.
s: The affix ठन् comes after the word षण्मास when 'age' is Not meant. The च draws in the affix ण्यत् also. Thus षण्मासिकः or षाण्मास्यो रोगः 'a disease lasting six months'.

pk: The aril Ka (ina) cones in the rour-rold senses or solicited, hired, lasted and wil last, arter the word sana This debars Wan Thus sananaDiswo, Brto Buto Bavi va = sanina sone say, the sense or the aril is tena nirvrtan [5.1.79], as sanaya nirvrta = sanina
ck: the aril ka (ina) cones in the rour-rolt senses or solicitet, hiret, lastet ant til last, arter the tort sana this tepars tan thus sananatisto, prto puto pavi va = sanina sone say, the sense or the aril is tena nirvrtan [5.1.79], as sanaya nirvrta = sanina
s: The affix ख (ईन) comes in the four-fold senses of 'solicited', 'hired', 'lasted' and 'will last', after the word समा This debars ठञ् Thus समामधीष्टो, भृतो भूतो भावी वा = समीनः Some say, the sense of the affix is तेन निर्वृत्तम् [[5.1.79]], as समया निर्वृत्तः = समीनः

pk: The aril Ka (ina) cones optionaly in the senses taught in panTo na nityan [5.1.76], tanaDiswo Brto Buto Bavi [5.1.80] arter the word sana , rorning a dvigu sanasa (nuneral Deterninative Conpound). in the alternative Wan wil also aply. The Vartika taught in [5.1.20] (pragvate sanKyapurvapadanan tadantagrahananaluki) aplies here also. Thus dvinasina or dvEnasika, trinasina or trEnasika
ck: the aril ka (ina) cones optionaly in the senses taukht in panto na nityan [5.1.76], tanatisto prto puto pavi [5.1.80] arter the tort sana , rornink a tviku sanasa (nuneral teterninative conpount). in the alternative tan til also aply. the Vartika taukht in [5.1.20] (prakvate sankyapurvapatanan tatantakrahananaluki) aplies here also. thus tvinasina or tvEnasika, trinasina or trEnasika
s: The affix ख (ईन) comes optionally in the senses taught in पन्थो ण नित्यम् [[5.1.76]], तमधीष्टो भृतो भूतो भावी [[5.1.80]] after the word समा , forming a द्विगु समास (Numeral Determinative Compound). In the alternative ठञ् will also apply. The Vartika taught in [[5.1.20]] (प्राग्वतेः संख्यापूर्वपदानां तदन्तग्रहणमलुकि) applies here also. Thus द्विमासीनः or द्वैमासिकः, त्रिमासीनः or त्रैमासिकः

pk: The aril Ka optionaly in the senses taught in tena nirvrtan [5.1.79], dvigoryap [5.1.82], arter the words 1. ratri 2. ahan and 3. sanvatsara , ocasioning a dvigu sanasa (nuneral Deterninative Conpound). in the alternative Wan wil also cone. Thus dviratrina, dvEratrika, dvyahina [6.4.145] or dvEyahnika, dvisanvatsarina, dvisanvatsarika [7.3.15].
ck: the aril ka optionaly in the senses taukht in tena nirvrtan [5.1.79], tvikoryap [5.1.82], arter the torts 1. ratri 2. ahan ant 3. sanvatsara , ocasionink a tviku sanasa (nuneral teterninative conpount). in the alternative tan til also cone. thus tviratrina, tvEratrika, tvyahina [6.4.145] or tvEyahnika, tvisanvatsarina, tvisanvatsarika [7.3.15].
s: The affix ख optionally in the senses taught in तेन निर्वृत्तम् [[5.1.79]], द्विगोर्यप् [[5.1.82]], after the words 1. रात्री 2. अहन् and 3. सम्वत्सर , occasioning a द्विगु समास (Numeral Determinative Compound). In the alternative ठञ् will also come. Thus द्विरात्रीणः, द्वैरात्रिकः, द्व्यहीनः [[6.4.145]] or द्वैयह्निकः, द्विसंवत्सरीणः, द्विसांवत्सरिकः [[7.3.15]].

pk: The above ariles and Ka and Win nay also be elided arter a dvigu sanasa (nuneral Deterninative Conpound) ending in varsa The aril Ka as wel as Wan cone in the rive rold senses [5.1.79], [5.1.80], arter the word varsa rorning a Dvigu; and these two ariles nay also be elided optionaly. Thus we have thre rorns; dvivarsino, dvivarsiki or dvivarso vyaDi a disease that lasted two years. Conpare [7.3.16]; but when the sense is that or Bavi, the rorn wil be dvEvarsika
ck: the apove ariles ant ka ant tin nay also pe elitet arter a tviku sanasa (nuneral teterninative conpount) entink in varsa the aril ka as tel as tan cone in the rive rolt senses [5.1.79], [5.1.80], arter the tort varsa rornink a tviku; ant these to ariles nay also pe elitet optionaly. thus te have thre rorns; tvivarsino, tvivarsiki or tvivarso vyati a tisease that lastet to years. conpare [7.3.16]; put then the sense is that or pavi, the rorn til pe tvEvarsika
s: The above affixes and ख and ठिञ् may also be elided after a द्विगु समास (Numeral Determinative Compound) ending in वर्षा The affix ख as well as ठञ् come in the five fold senses [[5.1.79]], [[5.1.80]], after the word वर्षा forming a Dvigu; and these two affixes may also be elided optionally. Thus we have three forms; द्विवर्षीणो, द्विवार्षिकी or द्विवर्षो व्याधिः 'a disease that lasted two years'. Compare [[7.3.16]]; but when the sense is that of भावी, the form will be द्वैवर्षिकः

pk: The ariles neaning aconplished etc. panTo na nityan [5.1.76], tanaDiswo Brto Buto Bavi [5.1.80] are necesarily elided arter the word varsa rorning a dvigu sanasa (nuneral Deterninative Conpound) when it rerers to being endowed with reason. ere the elision is conpulsory and not optional as in the last. Thus dvivarso daraka a boy two years old. Why do we say citavati "when neaning endowed with reason" ? Observe dvivarsino vyaDi
ck: the ariles neanink aconplishet etc. panto na nityan [5.1.76], tanatisto prto puto pavi [5.1.80] are necesarily elitet arter the tort varsa rornink a tviku sanasa (nuneral teterninative conpount) then it rerers to peink entotet tith reason. ere the elision is conpulsory ant not optional as in the last. thus tvivarso taraka a poy to years olt. thy to te say citavati "then neanink entotet tith reason" ? Opserve tvivarsino vyati
s: The affixes meaning 'accomplished' etc. पन्थो ण नित्यम् [[5.1.76]], तमधीष्टो भृतो भूतो भावी [[5.1.80]] are necessarily elided after the word वर्षा forming a द्विगु समास (Numeral Determinative Compound) when it refers to being endowed with reason. Here the elision is compulsory and not optional as in the last. Thus द्विवर्षो दारकः 'a boy two years old'. Why do we say चित्तवति "when meaning endowed with reason" ? Observe द्विवर्षीणो व्याधिः

pk: The anonalously rorned word saswika has the neaning or what are natured in sil nights. The word saswika nay be said to be rorned by ading kan to saswiratri in the 3rd case in construction, then eliding the word ratri, the rorce or the aril being natured. Thus saswiratrena pacyante = saswika a kind or barley. it is a nane or barley and thererore does not aply to pulse, beans &c, though they nay also ripen in sil days.
ck: the anonalously rornet tort sastika has the neanink or that are naturet in sil nikhts. the tort sastika nay pe sait to pe rornet py atink kan to sastiratri in the 3rt case in construction, then elitink the tort ratri, the rorce or the aril peink naturet. thus sastiratrena pacyante = sastika a kint or parley. it is a nane or parley ant thererore toes not aply to pulse, peans &c, thoukh they nay also ripen in sil tays.
s: The anomalously formed word षष्टिकाः has the meaning of 'what are matured in six nights'. The word षष्टिकाः may be said to be formed by adding कन् to षष्टिरात्रि in the 3rd case in construction, then eliding the word रात्रि, the force of the affix being 'matured'. Thus षष्टिरात्रेण पच्यन्ते = षष्टिकाः 'a kind of barley'. It is a name of barley and therefore does not apply to pulse, beans &c, though they may also ripen in six days.

pk: The aril Ca cones in the Candas (Vedas) in the rive-rold senses taught in panTo na nityan [5.1.76], tanaDiswo Brto Buto Bavi [5.1.80], arter a sten ending in vatsara This debars Wan Thus idvatsariya, idavatsariya
ck: the aril ca cones in the cantas (Vetas) in the rive-rolt senses taukht in panto na nityan [5.1.76], tanatisto prto puto pavi [5.1.80], arter a sten entink in vatsara this tepars tan thus itvatsariya, itavatsariya
s: The affix छ comes in the छन्दस् (Vedas) in the five-fold senses taught in पन्थो ण नित्यम् [[5.1.76]], तमधीष्टो भृतो भूतो भावी [[5.1.80]], after a stem ending in वत्सर This debars ठञ् Thus इद्वत्सरीयः, इदावत्सरीयः

pk: When the ariles Ka (ina) and Ca (iya) cone in the Candas (Vedas) in the rive-rold senses taught in panTo na nityan [5.1.76], tanaDiswo Brto Buto Bavi [5.1.80], arter the word vatsara , when preceded by san and pari Thus sanvatsarina and sanvatsariya, parivatsarina and parivatsariya
ck: then the ariles ka (ina) ant ca (iya) cone in the cantas (Vetas) in the rive-rolt senses taukht in panto na nityan [5.1.76], tanatisto prto puto pavi [5.1.80], arter the tort vatsara , then precetet py san ant pari thus sanvatsarina ant sanvatsariya, parivatsarina ant parivatsariya
s: When the affixes ख (ईन) and छ (ईय) come in the छन्दस् (Vedas) in the five-fold senses taught in पन्थो ण नित्यम् [[5.1.76]], तमधीष्टो भृतो भूतो भावी [[5.1.80]], after the word वत्सर , when preceded by सम् and परि Thus संवत्सरीणः and संवत्सरीयः, परिवत्सरीणः and परिवत्सरीयः

pk: The aril Wan cones arter a word denoting tine in the instrunental -3rd case in construction in the sense to be subdued, to be gained or atained, to be conpleted and to be easily conpleted in that tine. Thus nasena parijaya (sakyate jetun) = nasiko vyaDi, sanvatsariko vyaDi, nasena laBya = nasika pawa, nasena karyan = nasikan candrayanan, nasena sukaro = nasika prasada
ck: the aril tan cones arter a tort tenotink tine in the instrunental -3rt case in construction in the sense to pe suptuet, to pe kainet or atainet, to pe conpletet ant to pe easily conpletet in that tine. thus nasena paricaya (sakyate cetun) = nasiko vyati, sanvatsariko vyati, nasena lapya = nasika pata, nasena karyan = nasikan cantrayanan, nasena sukaro = nasika prasata
s: The affix ठञ् comes after a word denoting time in the Instrumental -3rd case in construction in the sense 'to be subdued, to be gained or attained, to be completed and to be easily completed in that time'. Thus मासेन परिजय्यः (शक्यते जेतुं) = मासिको व्याधिः, सांवत्सरिको व्याधिः, मासेन लभ्यः = मासिकः पटः, मासेन कार्यं = मासिकं चान्द्रायणं, मासेन सुकरो = मासिकः प्रासादः

pk: The aril Wan cones arter a word or tine in the sense or an abstinence that lasts so long or who practises abstinence so long. The word tad shows that the word nust be in the acusative case. asya shows the rorce or the aril, brahnacarya joins both. Thus nasan brahnacaryanasya = nasiko brahnacari "who practises abstinence ror a nonth". so also arDanasika, sanvatsarika another elplanation is, the aril than cones arter a word in the rirst case in construction, when the sense is that or an abstinence which lasts ror such a period. as nasosya brahnacaryasya = nasikan brahnacaryan "an abstinence lasting ror a nonth". arDanasikan, sanvatsarikan in the rirst case the aril relates to a person, in the second, to the vow itselr. Both these elplanations are valid, as the structure or the aphorisn is open to both constructions. Vart:- so also arter the words nahanani &c in the genitive construction. as nahananikan, gOdanikan, adityavratikan Vart:- arter those words, the aril neans also who practises that. as nahananiscarati = nahananika, adityavratika, gOdanika nahanani + Wan = nahananan + Wan ([6.3.35] Vart) = nahananika [6.4.14]. nahananya rca, tat sahacaritan vratan Vart:- The aril qini cones arter the words adantaradiksa &c, in the sense or who practices. as avantaradiksancarati = avantaradiksi, tilavratin Vart:- The ariles qvun and qini cone arter the word aswacatvarinsat, as aswacatvarinsadvarsani vratan carati = aswacatvarinsaka or aswacatvarinsin Vart:- The sane ariles cone arter the words caturnasya &c, the rinal ya being elided. as caturnasyani carati = caturnasaka or caturnasin Vart:- The aril nya cones arter caturnasa, in the sense or produced there. as catursu nasesu Bavani = caturnasyani it rerers to a sacririce. Vart:- The aril an cones, when it is a nane, as, catursu nasesu Bava = caturnasi pOrnanasi so also asaQi, kartiki, Palguni
ck: the aril tan cones arter a tort or tine in the sense or an apstinence that lasts so lonk or tho practises apstinence so lonk. the tort tat shots that the tort nust pe in the acusative case. asya shots the rorce or the aril, prahnacarya coins poth. thus nasan prahnacaryanasya = nasiko prahnacari "tho practises apstinence ror a nonth". so also artanasika, sanvatsarika another elplanation is, the aril than cones arter a tort in the rirst case in construction, then the sense is that or an apstinence thich lasts ror such a periot. as nasosya prahnacaryasya = nasikan prahnacaryan "an apstinence lastink ror a nonth". artanasikan, sanvatsarikan in the rirst case the aril relates to a person, in the secont, to the vot itselr. poth these elplanations are valit, as the structure or the aphorisn is open to poth constructions. Vart:- so also arter the torts nahanani &c in the kenitive construction. as nahananikan, kOtanikan, atityavratikan Vart:- arter those torts, the aril neans also tho practises that. as nahananiscarati = nahananika, atityavratika, kOtanika nahanani + tan = nahananan + tan ([6.3.35] Vart) = nahananika [6.4.14]. nahananya rca, tat sahacaritan vratan Vart:- the aril tini cones arter the torts atantaratiksa &c, in the sense or tho practices. as avantaratiksancarati = avantaratiksi, tilavratin Vart:- the ariles tvun ant tini cone arter the tort astacatvarinsat, as astacatvarinsatvarsani vratan carati = astacatvarinsaka or astacatvarinsin Vart:- the sane ariles cone arter the torts caturnasya &c, the rinal ya peink elitet. as caturnasyani carati = caturnasaka or caturnasin Vart:- the aril nya cones arter caturnasa, in the sense or protucet there. as catursu nasesu pavani = caturnasyani it rerers to a sacririce. Vart:- the aril an cones, then it is a nane, as, catursu nasesu pava = caturnasi pOrnanasi so also asati, kartiki, palkuni
s: The affix ठञ् comes after a word of time in the sense of 'an abstinence that lasts so long' or 'who practises abstinence so long'. The word तद् shows that the word must be in the accusative case. अस्य shows the force of the affix, ब्रह्मचर्य्यः joins both. Thus मासं ब्रह्मचर्य्यमस्य = मासिको ब्रह्मचारी "who practises abstinence for a month". So also आर्धमासिकः, सांवत्सरिकः Another explanation is, the affix than comes after a word in the first case in construction, when the sense is that of an abstinence which lasts for such a period. As मासोऽस्य ब्रह्मचर्यस्य = मासिकं ब्रह्मचर्यम् "an abstinence lasting for a month". आर्धमासिकं, सांवत्सरिकं In the first case the affix relates to a person, in the second, to the vow itself. Both these explanations are valid, as the structure of the aphorism is open to both constructions. Vart:- So also after the words महानाम्नी &c in the genitive construction. As महानामिकम्, गौदानिकम्, आदित्यव्रतिकम् Vart:- After those words, the affix means also 'who practises that'. As महानाम्नीश्चरति = माहानामिकः, आदित्यव्रतिकः, गौदानिकः महानाम्नी + ठञ् = महानामन् + ठञ् ([[6.3.35]] Vart) = माहानामिकः [[6.4.144]]. महनाम्न्य ऋचः, तत् सहचरितं व्रतं Vart:- The affix डिनि comes after the words अदान्तरदीक्षा &c, in the sense of 'who practices'. As अवान्तरदीक्षांचरति = अवान्तरदीक्षी, तिलव्रतिन् Vart:- The affixes ड्वुन् and डिनि come after the word अष्टचत्वारिंशत्, as अष्टचत्वारिंशद्वर्षाणि व्रतं चरति = अष्टचत्वारिंशकः or अष्टचत्वारिंशिन् Vart:- The same affixes come after the words चतुर्मास्य &c, the final य being elided. As चतुर्मास्यानि चरति = चातुर्मासकः or चातुर्मासिन् Vart:- The affix ण्य comes after चतुर्मास, in the sense of 'produced there'. As चतुर्षु मासेषु भवानि = चातुर्मास्यानि It refers to a sacrifice. Vart:- The affix अण् comes, when it is a Name, as, चतुर्षु मासेषु भवा = चातुर्मासी पौर्णमासी So also आषाढी, कार्तिकी, फाल्गुनी

pk: The aril Wan cones arter a word being the nane or sacririce, in the sense or the re thereor. as agniswonasya daksina = agniswoniki, vajapeyiki, rajasuyiki The word aKya in the sutra inplies that the aril cones even arter those sacririce-denoting words which do not elpres tine [5.1.78]; had it not ben used, the sutra would have aplied only to such sacririce-denoting words as ekaha, dvadasaha, which are tine-denoting words as wel. The Vartika in [5.1.20] would aply to dvadasaha &c. sone telts do not read ca in the sutra.
ck: the aril tan cones arter a tort peink the nane or sacririce, in the sense or the re thereor. as aknistonasya taksina = aknistoniki, vacapeyiki, racasuyiki the tort akya in the sutra inplies that the aril cones even arter those sacririce-tenotink torts thich to not elpres tine [5.1.78]; hat it not pen uset, the sutra toult have apliet only to such sacririce-tenotink torts as ekaha, tvatasaha, thich are tine-tenotink torts as tel. the Vartika in [5.1.20] toult aply to tvatasaha &c. sone telts to not reat ca in the sutra.
s: The affix ठञ् comes after a word being the name of sacrifice, in the sense of 'the fee thereof'. As अग्निष्टोमस्य दक्षिणा = आग्निष्टोमिकी, वाजपेयिकी, राजसूयिकी The word आख्या in the sutra implies that the affix comes even after those sacrifice-denoting words which do not express time [[5.1.78]]; had it not been used, the sutra would have applied only to such sacrifice-denoting words as एकाहः, द्वादशाह, which are time-denoting words as well. The Vartika in [[5.1.20]] would apply to द्वादशाह &c. Some texts do not read च in the sutra.

pk: The ariles having the sense or Bava tatra Bava [4.3.53] , kalawWan [4.3.1] , cone arter a tine-denoting word in the sense or what is given in that, and what is done in that. as nase Bavan = nasikan [4.3.1]. This word also neans nase diyate and nase karyan sinilarly sanvatsarikan, pravrsenyan [4.3.17], vasantikan [4.3.20], vasantan [4.3.16], hEnanan [4.3.2], hEnantan [4.3.16], hEnantikan [4.3.21], saradan [4.3.16]. al these words nean also what is given or done in those seasons. The word vat in Bavavat neans that al the rules or tatraBava [4.3.53] aply here. This sutra should be divided into two parts, one joining with the previous sutra, as tatra ca diyate, yajnanyeBya, as agniswonikan Baktan, rajasuyikan, vajapeyikan so rar does the word kala [5.1.78], bear rule. erearter general ariles wil be taught.
ck: the ariles havink the sense or pava tatra pava [4.3.53] , kalatan [4.3.1] , cone arter a tine-tenotink tort in the sense or that is kiven in that, ant that is tone in that. as nase pavan = nasikan [4.3.1]. this tort also neans nase tiyate ant nase karyan sinilarly sanvatsarikan, pravrsenyan [4.3.17], vasantikan [4.3.20], vasantan [4.3.16], hEnanan [4.3.2], hEnantan [4.3.16], hEnantikan [4.3.21], saratan [4.3.16]. al these torts nean also that is kiven or tone in those seasons. the tort vat in pavavat neans that al the rules or tatrapava [4.3.53] aply here. this sutra shoult pe tivitet into to parts, one coinink tith the previous sutra, as tatra ca tiyate, yacnanyepya, as aknistonikan paktan, racasuyikan, vacapeyikan so rar toes the tort kala [5.1.78], pear rule. erearter keneral ariles til pe taukht.
s: The affixes having the sense of भव तत्र भवः [[4.3.53]] , कालाट्ठञ् [[4.3.11]] , come after a time-denoting word in the sense of 'what is given in that, and what is done in that'. As मासे भवम् = मासिकं [[4.3.11]]. This word also means मासे दीयते and मासे कार्यं Similarly सांवत्सरिकं, प्रावृषेण्यं [[4.3.17]], वासन्तिकम् [[4.3.20]], वासन्तम् [[4.3.16]], हैमनम् [[4.3.22]], हैमन्तम् [[4.3.16]], हैमन्तिकम् [[4.3.21]], शारदम् [[4.3.16]]. All these words mean also what is given or done in those seasons. The word वत् in भववत् means that all the rules of तत्रभवः [[4.3.53]] apply here. This sutra should be divided into two parts, one joining with the previous sutra, as तत्र च दीयते, यज्ञाण्येभ्यः, as आग्निष्टोमिकं भक्तं, राजसूयिकम्, वाजपेयिकम् So far does the word काल [[5.1.78]], bear rule. Hereafter general affixes will be taught.

pk: The aril an cones arter the words vyuswa etc. in the Locative -7th case in construction, the sense or being given therein or done therein. Thus vyuswe diyate karyan va = vEyuswan, nEtyan Vart:- so also arter the words agnipada &c. as, agnipadan, pElanulan This Vartika can be dispensed with, as the word agnipada &c can be included in the vyuswadi list or words. 1 vyuswa, 2 nitya, 3 niskranana, 4 pravesana, 5 upasankranana, 6 tirTa, 7 astarana (astarana), 8 sangrana, 9 sanGata, 10 agnipada, 1 pilunula (pilu, nula), 12 pravasa, 13 upavasa, 14 sanBrana, 15 dirGa.
ck: the aril an cones arter the torts vyusta etc. in the Locative -7th case in construction, the sense or peink kiven therein or tone therein. thus vyuste tiyate karyan va = vEyustan, nEtyan Vart:- so also arter the torts aknipata &c. as, aknipatan, pElanulan this Vartika can pe tispenset tith, as the tort aknipata &c can pe inclutet in the vyustati list or torts. 1 vyusta, 2 nitya, 3 niskranana, 4 pravesana, 5 upasankranana, 6 tirta, 7 astarana (astarana), 8 sankrana, 9 sankata, 10 aknipata, 1 pilunula (pilu, nula), 12 pravasa, 13 upavasa, 14 sanprana, 15 tirka.
s: The affix अण् comes after the words व्युष्ट etc. in the Locative -7th case in construction, the sense of 'being given therein or done therein'. Thus व्युष्टे दीयते कार्यं वा = वैयुष्टम्, नैत्यम् Vart:- So also after the words अग्निपद &c. As, आग्निपदम्, पैलमूलम् This Vartika can be dispensed with, as the word अग्निपद &c can be included in the व्युष्टादि list of words. 1 व्युष्ट, 2 नित्य, 3 निष्क्रमण, 4 प्रवेशन, 5 उपसंक्रमण, 6 तीर्थ, 7 अस्तरण (आस्तरण), 8 संग्राम, 9 संघात, 10 अग्निपद, 11 पीलुमूल (पीलु, मूल), 12 प्रवास, 13 उपवास, 14 संभ्रम, 15 दीर्घ.

pk: The ariles na and yat cone respectively arter the words yaTa-kaTa-ca and hasta being in the instrunental -3rd case in construction having the sense or what is given or is done in this way. The words diyate and karya aply to both; the rule or yaTasanKya (1.3. 10) not aplying to it. The word yaTakaTaca is an indeclinable, neaning contenpt. Or course this word canot take any case-aril, it thererore only gives the sense or third case. as yaTakaTaca diyate karyan va = yaTakaTacan, hastena diyate karyan va = hastyan
ck: the ariles na ant yat cone respectively arter the torts yata-kata-ca ant hasta peink in the instrunental -3rt case in construction havink the sense or that is kiven or is tone in this tay. the torts tiyate ant karya aply to poth; the rule or yatasankya (1.3. 10) not aplyink to it. the tort yatakataca is an inteclinaple, neanink contenpt. Or course this tort canot take any case-aril, it thererore only kives the sense or thirt case. as yatakataca tiyate karyan va = yatakatacan, hastena tiyate karyan va = hastyan
s: The affixes ण and यत् come respectively after the words यथा-कथा-च and हस्त being in the Instrumental -3rd case in construction having the sense of what is 'given or is done in this way'. The words दीयते and कार्य apply to both; the rule of यथासंख्यः (1.3. 10) not applying to it. The word यथाकथाच is an Indeclinable, meaning contempt. Of course this word cannot take any case-affix, it therefore only gives the sense of third case. As यथाकथाच दीयते कार्यं वा = याथाकथाचम्, हस्तेन दीयते कार्यं वा = हस्त्यम्

pk: The aril Wan cones arter a word in the instrunental -3rd case in construction in the sense or rited ror that. The word sanpati neans suitable, proper, it. The word sanpadin is rorned by ading nini to sanpad, the rorce or the aril being that or necesity [3.3.170]. as karnaviswakaByan sanpadi nuKan = karnayeswakikan nuKan a race rit ror earings. vastrayugikan sariran i. e. vastrayugena visesata soBate
ck: the aril tan cones arter a tort in the instrunental -3rt case in construction in the sense or ritet ror that. the tort sanpati neans suitaple, proper, it. the tort sanpatin is rornet py atink nini to sanpat, the rorce or the aril peink that or necesity [3.3.170]. as karnavistakapyan sanpati nukan = karnayestakikan nukan a race rit ror earinks. vastrayukikan sariran i. e. vastrayukena visesata sopate
s: The affix ठञ् comes after a word in the Instrumental -3rd case in construction in the sense of 'fitted for that'. The word संपत्तिः means 'suitable, proper, it'. The word संपादिन् is formed by adding णिनि to संपद्, the force of the affix being that of necessity [[3.3.170]]. As कर्णविष्टकाभ्यां संपादि मुखं = कार्णयेष्टकिकं मुखं 'a face fit for earrings'. वास्त्रयुगिकम् शरीरम् i. e. वस्त्रयुगेन विशेषतः शोभते

pk: The aril yat (yan) cones in the sense or being rited with that, arter the words 1. karna and 2. vesa being in the instrunental -3rd case in construction. This debars than. karnana sanpadyate = karnanyan sariran, vesena sanpadyate = vesyo nawa ror acent se [6.1.213].
ck: the aril yat (yan) cones in the sense or peink ritet tith that, arter the torts 1. karna ant 2. vesa peink in the instrunental -3rt case in construction. this tepars than. karnana sanpatyate = karnanyan sariran, vesena sanpatyate = vesyo nata ror acent se [6.1.213].
s: The affix यत् (यं) comes in the sense of 'being fitted with that', after the words 1. कर्म and 2. वेष being in the Instrumental -3rd case in construction. This debars than. कर्मणा संपद्यते = कर्मण्यं शरीरम्, वेषेण संपद्यते = वेष्यो नटः For accent see [[6.1.213]].

pk: The aril Wan cones arter the words santapa etc. in the Dative -4th Case in construction in the sense or what is able to erect that. The word praBavati neans able, capable. The dative here has the rorce or alan [2.3.16]. as, santapaya praBavati = santapika, sanahika 1 santapa, 2 sanaha, 3 sangrana, 4 sanyoga, 5 sanparaya, 6 sanvesana, 7 sanpesa, 8 nispesa, 9 sarga, 10 nisarga, 1 visarga, 12 upasarga, 13 pravasa, 14 upavasa, 15 sanGata, 16 sanvesa, 17 sanvasa, 18 sanodana, 19 saktu, 20 nansOdanadvigrhitadapi, 21 asarga.
ck: the aril tan cones arter the torts santapa etc. in the tative -4th case in construction in the sense or that is aple to erect that. the tort prapavati neans aple, capaple. the tative here has the rorce or alan [2.3.16]. as, santapaya prapavati = santapika, sanahika 1 santapa, 2 sanaha, 3 sankrana, 4 sanyoka, 5 sanparaya, 6 sanvesana, 7 sanpesa, 8 nispesa, 9 sarka, 10 nisarka, 1 visarka, 12 upasarka, 13 pravasa, 14 upavasa, 15 sankata, 16 sanvesa, 17 sanvasa, 18 sanotana, 19 saktu, 20 nansOtanatvikrhitatapi, 21 asarka.
s: The affix ठञ् comes after the words संताप etc. in the Dative -4th Case in construction in the sense of 'what is able to effect that'. The word प्रभवति means 'able, capable'. The dative here has the force of अलम् [[2.3.16]]. As, संतापाय प्रभवति = सांतापिकः, सान्नाहिकः 1 संताप, 2 संनाह, 3 संग्राम, 4 संयोग, 5 संपराय, 6 संवेशन, 7 संपेष, 8 निष्पेष, 9 सर्ग, 10 निसर्ग, 11 विसर्ग, 12 उपसर्ग, 13 प्रवास, 14 उपवास, 15 संघात, 16 संवेष, 17 संवास, 18 संमोदन, 19 सक्तु, 20 मांसौदनाद्विगृहीतादपि, 21 असर्ग.

pk: The aril yat (yan) is also aded in the sense or able to erect that arter the word yoga Thus yogaya praBavati = yogya or yOgika
ck: the aril yat (yan) is also atet in the sense or aple to erect that arter the tort yoka thus yokaya prapavati = yokya or yOkika
s: The affix यत् (यं) is also added in the sense of 'able to effect that' after the word योग Thus योगाय प्रभवति = योग्यः or यौगिकः

pk: The aril ukan cones arter the word karnana in the sane sense or able to erect that. This debars Wan. as karnano praBavati = karnukan Danu This word karnukan neans always a bow, and is never enployed to designate anything else.
ck: the aril ukan cones arter the tort karnana in the sane sense or aple to erect that. this tepars tan. as karnano prapavati = karnukan tanu this tort karnukan neans altays a pot, ant is never enployet to tesiknate anythink else.
s: The affix उकञ् comes after the word कर्मण in the same sense of 'able to effect that'. This debars ठञ्. As कर्मणो प्रभवति = कार्मुकं धनुः This word कार्मुकम् means always a 'bow', and is never employed to designate anything else.

pk: The aril Wan cones in the sense or that has arived ror it arter the word sanaya in the noninative 1st-Case in construction. Thus sanayikan karna = a work ror which the tine has cone.
ck: the aril tan cones in the sense or that has arivet ror it arter the tort sanaya in the noninative 1st-case in construction. thus sanayikan karna = a tork ror thich the tine has cone.
s: The affix ठञ् comes in the sense of 'that has arrived for it' after the word समय in the Nominative 1st-Case in construction. Thus सामयिकं कर्म = 'a work for which the time has come'.

pk: The aril an cones in the sense or that has cone ror it arter the word rtu as rtupraptosya = artavan puspan (Guna by [6.4.146]) "the rlower ror which the season has arived". Vart:- so also arter the words upavastra &c. as Opavastran, prasitran
ck: the aril an cones in the sense or that has cone ror it arter the tort rtu as rtupraptosya = artavan puspan (kuna py [6.4.146]) "the rloter ror thich the season has arivet". Vart:- so also arter the torts upavastra &c. as Opavastran, prasitran
s: The affix अण् comes in the sense of 'that has come for it' after the word ऋतु As ऋतुःप्राप्तोऽस्य = आर्त्तवं पुष्पम् (Guna by [[6.4.146]]) "the flower for which the season has arrived". Vart:- So also after the words उपवस्त्र &c. As औपवस्त्रम्, प्राशित्रम्

pk: The aril an cones in the sense or that whose purpose is this arter the words 1. visaKa and 2. asaQa when the derivative or the rirst is conbined with nanya and that or the second with danqa as vEsaKo nanTa, asaQo danqa Vart:- so also arter the words caqa &c. as caqa prayojananasya = cOqan, sradDa prayojananasya = sradDan

As चडा प्रयोजनमस्य = चौडम्, श्रद्धा प्रयोजनमस्य = श्राद्धम्

pk: The aril Ca (iya) cones in the sane sense or that whose purpose is this arter The aril words anupravacana etc. This debars Wan Thus anupravacanan prayojananasya = anupravacaniyan, utTapaniyan Vart:- so also arter the derivatives rorned by the aril ana (yu) ron the radicals vis, to enter, pura, to ril, pat to ral, and ruha to nount, when preceded by a word. as grhapravesaniyan, prapapuraniyan, asvaprapataniyan, prasadarohaniyan Vart:- The aril yat cones arter the words svarga &c. svargan prayojananasya = svargyan, yasasyan, ayusyan, kanyan, Danyan Vart:- The aril is elided arter the words punyahavacana &c. as, punyahavacanan prayojananasya = punyahavacanan, svastivacanan, santivacanan 1 anupravacana, 2 utTapana, 3 upasTapana, 4 sanvesana, 5 pravesana, 6 anupravesana, 7 anuvasana, 8 anuvacana, 9 anuvacana, i0 anvarohana, 1 praranBana, 12 aranBana, 13 arohana, 14 anuvesana, 15 anuvadana, 16 prarohana
ck: the aril ca (iya) cones in the sane sense or that those purpose is this arter the aril torts anupravacana etc. this tepars tan thus anupravacanan prayocananasya = anupravacaniyan, utapaniyan Vart:- so also arter the terivatives rornet py the aril ana (yu) ron the raticals vis, to enter, pura, to ril, pat to ral, ant ruha to nount, then precetet py a tort. as krhapravesaniyan, prapapuraniyan, asvaprapataniyan, prasatarohaniyan Vart:- the aril yat cones arter the torts svarka &c. svarkan prayocananasya = svarkyan, yasasyan, ayusyan, kanyan, tanyan Vart:- the aril is elitet arter the torts punyahavacana &c. as, punyahavacanan prayocananasya = punyahavacanan, svastivacanan, santivacanan 1 anupravacana, 2 utapana, 3 upastapana, 4 sanvesana, 5 pravesana, 6 anupravesana, 7 anuvasana, 8 anuvacana, 9 anuvacana, i0 anvarohana, 1 praranpana, 12 aranpana, 13 arohana, 14 anuvesana, 15 anuvatana, 16 prarohana
s: The affix छ (ईय) comes in the same sense of 'that whose purpose is this' after The affix words अनुप्रवचन etc. This debars ठञ् Thus अनुप्रवचनं प्रयोजनमस्य = अनुप्रवचनीयम्, उत्थापनीयम् Vart:- So also after the derivatives formed by the affix अन (यु) from the radicals विश्, 'to enter', पूर, 'to fill', पत् 'to fall', and रुह 'to mount', when preceded by a word. As गृहप्रवेशनीयम्, प्रपापूरणीयम्, अश्वप्रपतनीयम्, प्रासादारोहणीयम् Vart:- The affix यत् comes after the words स्वर्ग &c. स्वर्गं प्रयोजनमस्य = स्वर्ग्यम्, यशष्यम्, आयुष्यम्, काम्यम्, धन्यम् Vart:- The affix is elided after the words पुण्याहवाचन &c. As, पुण्याहवाचनं प्रयोजनमस्य = पुण्याहवाचनं, स्वस्तिवाचनं, शान्तिवाचनम् 1 अनुप्रवचन, 2 उत्थापन, 3 उपस्थापन, 4 संवेशन, 5 प्रवेशन, 6 अनुप्रवेशन, 7 अनुवासन, 8 अनुवचन, 9 अनुवाचन, I0 अन्वारोहण, 11 प्रारम्भण, 12 आरम्भण, 13 आरोहण, 14 अनुवेशन, 15 अनुवादन, 16 प्ररोहण

pk: The aril Ca (iya) cones in the sane sense or that whose purpose is this arter the word sanapana when it has a word in conposition preceding it. This debars Wan Thus Canda sanapanan prayojananasya = Canda sanapaniyan, vyakarana sanapaniyan The speciric nention or the word pada in the aphorisn indicates that the rule wil not aply when a word other than a pada, such as the aril bahuch, [5.3.68] precedes the word sanapana.
ck: the aril ca (iya) cones in the sane sense or that those purpose is this arter the tort sanapana then it has a tort in conposition precetink it. this tepars tan thus canta sanapanan prayocananasya = canta sanapaniyan, vyakarana sanapaniyan the speciric nention or the tort pata in the aphorisn inticates that the rule til not aply then a tort other than a pata, such as the aril pahuch, [5.3.68] precetes the tort sanapana.
s: The affix छ (ईय) comes in the same sense of 'that whose purpose is this' after the word समापन when it has a word in composition preceding it. This debars ठञ् Thus छन्दः समापनं प्रयोजनमस्य = छन्दः समापनीयम्, व्याकरण समापनीयम् The specific mention of the word पद in the aphorism indicates that the rule will not apply when a word other than a 'pada,' such as the affix 'bahuch,' [[5.3.68]] precedes the word Samapana.

pk: The word Ekagarikaw is iregularly rorned in the sense or thier. The reninine wil be in nip. Thus ekagaran prayojananasya = Ekagarika ren. °ki This word can be regularly rorned by Wan, but it wil always be restricted to nean a thier. When any other thing is designated, it wil not take this aril. Thus ekagaran prayojananasya Biksa, here there wil be no ariling. The reninine noreover wil be in nip sone say the word is rorned by ading the aril ikaw with the iregular Vridhi or the rirst sylable.
ck: the tort Ekakarikat is irekularly rornet in the sense or thier. the reninine til pe in nip. thus ekakaran prayocananasya = Ekakarika ren. °ki this tort can pe rekularly rornet py tan, put it til altays pe restrictet to nean a thier. then any other think is tesiknatet, it til not take this aril. thus ekakaran prayocananasya piksa, here there til pe no arilink. the reninine noreover til pe in nip sone say the tort is rornet py atink the aril ikat tith the irekular Vrithi or the rirst sylaple.
s: The word ऐकागारिकट् is irregularly formed in the sense of 'thief'. The feminine will be in ङीप्. Thus एकागारं प्रयोजनमस्य = ऐकागारिकः fem. °की This word can be regularly formed by ठञ्, but it will always be restricted to mean a thief. When any other thing is designated, it will not take this affix. Thus एकागारं प्रयोजनमस्य भिक्षाः, here there will be no affixing. The feminine moreover will be in ङीप् Some say the word is formed by adding the affix इकट् with the irregular Vriddhi of the first syllable.

pk: The word akalikaw is iregularly rorned in the sense or what coincides with the begining and the end i.e. what lasts only an instant. The word akala is substituted ror sananakala. Thus akalika stanayitnu a thunder lasting ror an instant. akaliki vidyut "a lightening lasting a twinkle". i. e. whose death is equal to its tine or birth or dying as son as born. Vart:- The ariles Wan and Wan also cone arter akala; as akalika vidyut so rar is the governing power or the aril Wan [5.1.18].
ck: the tort akalikat is irekularly rornet in the sense or that coincites tith the pekinink ant the ent i.e. that lasts only an instant. the tort akala is supstitutet ror sananakala. thus akalika stanayitnu a thunter lastink ror an instant. akaliki vityut "a likhtenink lastink a tinkle". i. e. those teath is etual to its tine or pirth or tyink as son as porn. Vart:- the ariles tan ant tan also cone arter akala; as akalika vityut so rar is the kovernink poter or the aril tan [5.1.18].
s: The word आकालिकट् is irregularly formed in the sense of 'what coincides with the beginning and the end i.e. what lasts only an instant'. The word आकाल is substituted for समानकाल. Thus आकालिकः स्तनयित्नुः 'a thunder lasting for an instant'. आकालिकी विद्युत् "a lightening lasting a twinkle". i. e. whose death is equal to its time of birth or dying as soon as born. Vart:- The affixes ठन् and ठञ् also come after आकाल; as आकालिका विद्युत् So far is the governing power of the affix ठञ् [[5.1.18]].

pk: The aril vati (vat) cones arter a word in the instrunental -3rd case in construction, in the sense or like that when the neaning is sinilarity or action. as brahnanena tulyan vartate = brahnanavat, rajavat Why do we say "action"? The aril wil not be joined when the sinilarity is in quality. as putrenasaha sTula "as big as the son", putrena tulya pingala
ck: the aril vati (vat) cones arter a tort in the instrunental -3rt case in construction, in the sense or like that then the neanink is sinilarity or action. as prahnanena tulyan vartate = prahnanavat, racavat thy to te say "action"? the aril til not pe coinet then the sinilarity is in tuality. as putrenasaha stula "as pik as the son", putrena tulya pinkala
s: The affix वति (वत्) comes after a word in the Instrumental -3rd case in construction, in the sense of 'like that' when the meaning is 'similarity of action'. As ब्राह्मणेन तुल्यं वर्तते = ब्राह्मणवत्, राजवत् Why do we say "action"? The affix will not be joined when the similarity is in 'quality'. As पुत्रेणसह स्थूलः "as big as the son", पुत्रेण तुल्यः पिङ्गलः

pk: The aril vati (vat) also cones in the sense or like what is therein or thereor. as naTurayaniva = naTuravat like that in nathura. as naTuravat sruGne prakara, pawaliputravat sakete pariKa; devadatasyeva devadatavad yajnadatasya gava &c.
ck: the aril vati (vat) also cones in the sense or like that is therein or thereor. as naturayaniva = naturavat like that in nathura. as naturavat srukne prakara, pataliputravat sakete parika; tevatatasyeva tevatatavat yacnatatasya kava &c.
s: The affix वति (वत्) also comes in the sense of 'like what is therein or thereof'. As मथुरायामिव = मथुरावत् 'like that in Mathura'. as मथुरावत् स्रुघ्ने प्राकारः, पाटलिपुत्रवत् साकेते परिखा; देवदत्तस्येव देवदत्तवद् यज्ञदत्तस्य गावः &c.

pk: The aril vati (vat) cones arter a word in the acusative -2nd case in construction in the sense or beriting that or suited to that. as rajananarhati = rajavat palanan "the protection as berits a king i.e. as a king should protect". brahnanavat, rsivat, ksatriyavat
ck: the aril vati (vat) cones arter a tort in the acusative -2nt case in construction in the sense or peritink that or suitet to that. as racananarhati = racavat palanan "the protection as perits a kink i.e. as a kink shoult protect". prahnanavat, rsivat, ksatriyavat
s: The affix वति (वत्) comes after a word in the Accusative -2nd case in construction in the sense of 'befitting that or suited to that'. As राजानमर्हति = राजवत् पालनम् "the protection as befits a king i.e. as a king should protect". ब्राह्मणवत्, ऋषिवत्, क्षत्रियवत्

pk: in the Candas (Vedas) the aril vati (vat) is aded to an upasarga (Preposition) in the sense or a verbal rot. as the word udvata and nivata in the rolowing nik (l. 142.4). yadudvato nivato yasi vapsat prTagesi pragarDiniva sena "When thou O rire ! goest burning high (udvata = udgatan) and low (nivata = nigatan) tres &c.
ck: in the cantas (Vetas) the aril vati (vat) is atet to an upasarka (preposition) in the sense or a verpal rot. as the tort utvata ant nivata in the rolotink nik (l. 142.4). yatutvato nivato yasi vapsat prtakesi prakartiniva sena "then thou O rire ! koest purnink hikh (utvata = utkatan) ant lot (nivata = nikatan) tres &c.
s: In the छन्दस् (Vedas) the affix वति (वत्) is added to an उपसर्ग (Preposition) in the sense of a verbal root. As the word उद्वतः and निवतः in the following Rik (X. 142.4). यदुद्वतो निवतो यासि वप्सत् पृथगेषि प्रगर्धिनीव सेना "When thou O Fire ! goest burning high (उद्वतः = उद्गतान्) and low (निवतः = निगतान्) trees &c.

pk: The ariles tva and tal cone in the sense or the nature thereor arter a word in the Genitive 6th-Case. as asvasya Bava = asvatvan or asvata, gotvan or gota
ck: the ariles tva ant tal cone in the sense or the nature thereor arter a tort in the kenitive 6th-case. as asvasya pava = asvatvan or asvata, kotvan or kota
s: The affixes त्व and तल् come in the sense of 'the nature thereof' after a word in the Genitive 6th-Case. As अश्वस्य भावः = अश्वत्वम् or अश्वता, गोत्वम् or गोता

pk: ron this rorward as rar as the sūtra brahnanastva [5.1.136], the ariles tva and tal bear the rule. Thus in [5.1.12], tva and tal are read, giving the rorns prTutvan and prTuta &c. This rule is intended to secure adnision ror these two ariles notwithstanding the bars in the shape or subsequent aphorisns directing the enploynent or other ariles. These ariles signiry, in adition to Bava (nature), karna (action) also, in [5.1.124]. The word ca in the aphorisn is intended to secure their adnision notwithstanding the ariles nan and sran [6.1.87]. Thus striya Bava = strEnan, stritvan, strita the nature or a renale. punstan, punsta, pOnstan
ck: ron this rortart as rar as the sūtra prahnanastva [5.1.136], the ariles tva ant tal pear the rule. thus in [5.1.12], tva ant tal are reat, kivink the rorns prtutvan ant prtuta &c. this rule is intentet to secure atnision ror these to ariles notithstantink the pars in the shape or supsetuent aphorisns tirectink the enploynent or other ariles. these ariles sikniry, in atition to pava (nature), karna (action) also, in [5.1.124]. the tort ca in the aphorisn is intentet to secure their atnision notithstantink the ariles nan ant sran [6.1.87]. thus striya pava = strEnan, stritvan, strita the nature or a renale. punstan, punsta, pOnstan
s: From this forward as far as the sūtra ब्रह्मणस्त्वः [[5.1.136]], the affixes त्व and तल् bear the rule. Thus in [[5.1.122]], त्व and तल् are read, giving the forms पृथुत्वम् and पृथुता &c. This rule is intended to secure admission for these two affixes notwithstanding the bars in the shape of subsequent aphorisms directing the employment of other affixes. These affixes signify, in addition to भाव (nature), कर्म (action) also, in [[5.1.124]]. The word च in the aphorism is intended to secure their admission notwithstanding the affixes नञ् and स्रञ् [[6.1.87]]. Thus स्त्रियाः भावः = स्त्रैणम्, स्त्रीत्वम्, स्त्रीता 'the nature of a female'. पुंस्तम्, पुंस्ता, पौंस्तम्

pk: The ariles denoting nature taught herearter do not cone arter a tat-purusa conpound rorned by the negative particle nan with the elception or the the rolowing - 1. catura 2. sangata 3. lavana 4. vawa 5. buDa 6. kata 7. rasa and 8. lasa Thus the words apati, apawu and arananiya wil have two rorns only i.e. apatitvan or apatita, apawutvan or apawuta, arananiyatvan or arananiyata While by [5.1.128], other conpounds wil have yak also, as sEnapatyan an elception to this is avidurya [7.2.25], as used by the author hinselr. Why do we say nan purvat "a Tatpurusha whose rirst nenber is nan"? Observe barhaspatyan, prajapatyan Why do we say arter a Tatpurusha? Observe, when the word apawu is a Bahuvrihi conpound neaning nasya pawava santi, its derivative wil be apawavan. so also, alaGavan so also the conpounds or catura &c, with nan, e.g. acaturyan, asangatyan, alavanyan, avawyan, abuDyan, akatyan, arasyan, alasyan in sone telts, there is yuDa instead or buDa
ck: the ariles tenotink nature taukht herearter to not cone arter a tat-purusa conpount rornet py the nekative particle nan tith the elception or the the rolotink - 1. catura 2. sankata 3. lavana 4. vata 5. puta 6. kata 7. rasa ant 8. lasa thus the torts apati, apatu ant arananiya til have to rorns only i.e. apatitvan or apatita, apatutvan or apatuta, arananiyatvan or arananiyata thile py [5.1.128], other conpounts til have yak also, as sEnapatyan an elception to this is aviturya [7.2.25], as uset py the author hinselr. thy to te say nan purvat "a tatpurusha those rirst nenper is nan"? Opserve parhaspatyan, pracapatyan thy to te say arter a tatpurusha? Opserve, then the tort apatu is a pahuvrihi conpount neanink nasya patava santi, its terivative til pe apatavan. so also, alakavan so also the conpounts or catura &c, tith nan, e.k. acaturyan, asankatyan, alavanyan, avatyan, aputyan, akatyan, arasyan, alasyan in sone telts, there is yuta insteat or puta
s: The affixes denoting 'nature' taught hereafter do not come after a तत्-पुरुष compound formed by the negative particle नञ् with the exception of the the following - 1. चतुर 2. संगत 3. लवण 4. वट 5. बुध 6. कत 7. रस and 8. लस Thus the words अपति, अपटु and अरमणीय will have two forms only i.e. अपतित्वम् or अपतिता, अपटुत्वम् or अपटुता, अरमणीयत्वम् or अरमणीयता While by [[5.1.128]], other compounds will have यक् also, as सैनापत्यम् An exception to this is आविदूर्य [[7.2.25]], as used by the author himself. Why do we say नञ् पूर्वात् "a Tatpurusha whose first member is नञ्"? Observe बार्हस्पत्यम्, प्राजापत्यम् Why do we say 'after a Tatpurusha?' Observe, when the word अपटु is a Bahuvrihi compound meaning नास्य पटवः सन्ति, its derivative will be आपटवम्. So also, आलाघवम् So also the compounds of चतुर &c, with नञ्, e.g. आचतुर्यम्, आसंगत्यम्, आलवण्यम्, आवट्यम्, आबुध्यम्, आकत्यम्, आरस्यम्, आलस्यम् In some texts, there is युध instead of बुध

s: The affix इमनिच् (इमन्) comes optionally in the sense of 'nature thereof' after the words पृथु etc. The word वा 'optionally' is employed with the intention of securing admission for the affixes अण् &c. Thus पृथोर्भावः = प्रथिमन् nom. प्रथिमा (पृथु + इमन् = पृथ् + इमन् [[6.4.155]] = प्रथ् + इमन् [[6.4.161]] = प्रथिमा), or पार्थवम् by [[5.1.131]]. So also म्रदिमा or मार्दवम् The उ of पृथु and मृदु is elided by [[6.4.115]], and र is substituted for ऋ by [[6.4.161]]. Of course, the affixes त्व and तल् come here also as, पृथुत्वम्, मृदुत्वम्, पृथुता, मृदुता 1 पृथु, 2 मृदु, 3 महत्, 4 पटु, 5 तनु, 6 लघु, 7 बहु, 8 साधु, 9 आशु (आसु !), 10 उरु (ऊरु), 11 गुरु, 12 बहुल, 13 खण्ड, 14 दण्ड, 15 चण्ड, 16 अकिंचन, 17 बाल, 18 होड, 19 पाक, 20 वत्स, 21 मन्द, 22 स्वादु, 23 हृस्व, 24 दीर्घ, 25 प्रिय, 26 वृष, 27 ऋजु, 28 क्षिप्र, 29 क्षुद्र, 30 अणु, 31 वेणु (!).

pk: The aril an cones in the sense or nature or action or thereor arter clas nanes or aninals and words elpresing age as wel as arter udgatri etc. Thus asvasya Bava karna va = asvan, Oswran, kOnaran, kEsoran, Odgatran, Onetran 1 udgatr, 2 unetr, 3 pratihartr, 4 prasastr, 5 hotr, 6 potr, 7 hartr (kartr), 8 raTaganaka 9 patiganaka (paksiganaka patriganaka), 10 susWu, dusWu, 12 aDvaryu, 13 vaDu, 14 suBaga nantre in the nantra literature subhaga takes an, as nahate sEBagaya; sonetines there is no an, as sOBagya nasnE datvaya
ck: the aril an cones in the sense or nature or action or thereor arter clas nanes or aninals ant torts elpresink ake as tel as arter utkatri etc. thus asvasya pava karna va = asvan, Ostran, kOnaran, kEsoran, Otkatran, Onetran 1 utkatr, 2 unetr, 3 pratihartr, 4 prasastr, 5 hotr, 6 potr, 7 hartr (kartr), 8 ratakanaka 9 patikanaka (paksikanaka patrikanaka), 10 sustu, tustu, 12 atvaryu, 13 vatu, 14 supaka nantre in the nantra literature suphaka takes an, as nahate sEpakaya; sonetines there is no an, as sOpakya nasnE tatvaya
s: The affix अञ् comes in the sense of 'nature or action or thereof' after class names of animals and words expressing age as well as after उद्गात्रि etc. Thus अश्वस्य भावः कर्म वा = आश्वम्, औष्ट्रम्, कौमारम्, कैशोरम्, औद्गात्रम्, औन्नेत्रम् 1 उद्गातृ, 2 उन्नेतृ, 3 प्रतिहर्तृ, 4 प्रशास्तृ, 5 होतृ, 6 पोतृ, 7 हर्तृ (कर्तृ), 8 रथगणक 9 पत्तिगणक (पक्षिगणक पत्रिगणक), 10 सुष्ठु, दुष्ठु, 12 अध्वर्यु, 13 वधू, 14 सुभग मन्त्रे In the Mantra literature subhaga takes अञ्, as महते सैभगाय; sometimes there is no अञ्, as सौभाग्य मस्मै दत्वाय

ck: the aril an cones in the sense or nature or action thereor arter conpounts entink in hayana ant arter yuvana etc. thus tvihayanasya pava karna va = tvEhayanan, trEhayanan; yOvanan, staviran Vart:- the ya or srotriya is elitet, as srotriyasya pava karna va = srOtran 1 yuvan, 2 stavira, 3 hotr, 4 yacanana, 5 purusase (purusa asanase), 6 pratr (panr), 7 kutuka (kataka), 8 sranana (sranana), 9 katuka, 10 kanantalu, 1 kustri, 12 sustri, 13 tustri, 14 suhrtaya 15 turhrtaya, 16 suhrt, 17 turhrt, 18 supratr, 19 turpratr, 20 vrsala, 21 parivracaka, 2 saprahnacarin, 23 anrsansa, 24 hrtayase (hrtaya asanase), 25 kusala, 26 capala, 27 nipuna, 28 pisuna, 29 kutuhala, 30 ksetracna, 31 srotriyasya yalopasca, 32 yatr, 3 krtaka, 34 kucuka, 35 kantuka, 36 nituna, 37 kulali, 38 nantana, 39 kitava, 40 pota.
s: The affix अण् comes in the sense of 'nature or action thereof' after compounds ending in हायन and after युवन etc. Thus द्विहायनस्य भावः कर्म वा = द्वैहायनम्, त्रैहायनम्; यौवनम्, स्थाविरम् Vart:- The य of श्रोत्रिय is elided, as श्रोत्रियस्य भावः कर्म वा = श्रौत्रम् 1 युवन्, 2 स्थविर, 3 होतृ, 4 यजमान, 5 पुरुषासे (पुरुष असमासे), 6 भ्रातृ (भानृ), 7 कुतुक (कतक), 8 श्रमण (श्रणम), 9 कटुक, 10 कमण्डलु, 11 कुस्त्री, 12 सुस्त्री, 13 दुःस्त्री, 14 सुहृदय 15 दुर्हृदय, 16 सुहृद्, 17 दुर्हृद्, 18 सुभ्रातृ, 19 दुर्भ्रातृ, 20 वृषल, 21 परिव्राजक, 22 सब्रह्मचारिन्, 23 अनृशंस, 24 हृदयासे (हृदय असमासे), 25 कुशल, 26 चपल, 27 निपुण, 28 पिशुन, 29 कुतूहल, 30 क्षेत्रज्ञ, 31 श्रोत्रियस्य यलोपश्च, 32 यातृ, 33 कृतक, 34 कुचुक, 35 कन्दुक, 36 मिथुन, 37 कुलली, 38 मण्डण, 39 कितव, 40 पोत.

pk: The aril an cones in the sense or nature or action thereor arter a sten ending in ik (i i u u r or l) when the preceding sylable is prosodialy light. Thus sucerBava karna va = sOcan, nOnan (nuni), nagaran (nagara), haritakan (haritaki) pawavan (pawu), laGavan (laGu). Why do we say laGupurvat the preceding sylable being light? Observe kanqutvan, panqutvan Why kavyan ron kavi? The word kavi takes syan as belonging to Brahnanadi clas [5.1.124]. n. B. The word anta in the sutra nay wil be dispensed with. The aphorisn laghupurvad ikah wil give the sane neaning.
ck: the aril an cones in the sense or nature or action thereor arter a sten entink in ik (i i u u r or l) then the precetink sylaple is prosotialy likht. thus sucerpava karna va = sOcan, nOnan (nuni), nakaran (nakara), haritakan (haritaki) patavan (patu), lakavan (laku). thy to te say lakupurvat the precetink sylaple peink likht? Opserve kantutvan, pantutvan thy kavyan ron kavi? the tort kavi takes syan as pelonkink to prahnanati clas [5.1.124]. n. p. the tort anta in the sutra nay til pe tispenset tith. the aphorisn lakhupurvat ikah til kive the sane neanink.
s: The affix अण् comes in the sense of 'nature or action thereof' after a stem ending in इक् (इ ई उ ऊ ऋ or ऌ) when the preceding syllable is prosodially light. Thus शुचेर्भावः कर्म वा = शौचम्, मौनम् (मुनि), नागरम् (नगर), हारितकम् (हरीतकी) पाटवम् (पटु), लाघवम् (लघु). Why do we say लघुपूर्वात् 'the preceding syllable being light'? Observe कण्डूत्वम्, पाण्डुत्वम् Why काव्यम् from कवि? The word कवि takes ष्यञ् as belonging to Brahmanadi class [[5.1.124]]. N. B. The word anta in the Sutra may will be dispensed with. The aphorism laghupurvad ikah will give the same meaning.

pk: The aril vun cones in the sense or nature or action thereor arter a polysylabic sten whose penultinate leter is y and whose penultinate sylable is prosodialy heavy. The word upotanan neans the last sylable but one in a word or thre sylables or nore. That word whose penultinate sylable is guru heavy, is caled gurupotanan : the yopaDa neans having penultinate y. Thus rananiyakan ron rananiya, vasaniyakan ron vasaniya Why do we say "the penultinate leter being y"? Observe vinanatvan ron vinana Why do say gurupatina "the penultinate sylable being heavy"? Witnes ksatriyatvan Vart:- Optionaly so arter the word sahaya, as, sahayakan and sahayan The words upotan and upaDa should be distinguished: the rirst neans penultinate sylable (inplying thereby the word is or nore than two sylables), and the second neans penultinate leter.
ck: the aril vun cones in the sense or nature or action thereor arter a polysylapic sten those penultinate leter is y ant those penultinate sylaple is prosotialy heavy. the tort upotanan neans the last sylaple put one in a tort or thre sylaples or nore. that tort those penultinate sylaple is kuru heavy, is calet kurupotanan : the yopata neans havink penultinate y. thus rananiyakan ron rananiya, vasaniyakan ron vasaniya thy to te say "the penultinate leter peink y"? Opserve vinanatvan ron vinana thy to say kurupatina "the penultinate sylaple peink heavy"? titnes ksatriyatvan Vart:- Optionaly so arter the tort sahaya, as, sahayakan ant sahayan the torts upotan ant upata shoult pe tistinkuishet: the rirst neans penultinate sylaple (inplyink therepy the tort is or nore than to sylaples), ant the secont neans penultinate leter.
s: The affix वुञ् comes in the sense of 'nature or action thereof' after a polysyllabic stem whose penultimate letter is य् and whose penultimate syllable is prosodially heavy. The word उपोत्तमं means the last syllable but one in a word of three syllables or more. That word whose penultimate syllable is गुरू 'heavy', is called गुरूपोत्तमम् : the योपधा means 'having penultimate य्'. Thus रामणीयकम् from रमणीय, वासनीयकं from वसनीय Why do we say "the penultimate letter being य्"? Observe विमानत्वं from विमान Why do say गुरूपत्तिम "the penultimate syllable being heavy"? Witness क्षत्रियत्वम् Vart:- Optionally so after the word सहाय, as, साहायकम् and साहाय्यम् The words उपोत्तम् and उपधा should be distinguished: the first means penultimate syllable (implying thereby the word is of more than two syllables), and the second means penultimate letter.
