Or the tort rasa &c, nust tenote tualities, perceivaple py the orkans or taste, touch &c, i. e. rasa shoult nean taste, rupa rorn. thererore the rorns rupini ant rupika are valit, neanink sopayokyata so also rasiko tata = pavayoka, here rupa ant rasa to not nean rorn ant taste. ant al torts or tuality havink one sylaple are kovernet py this sutra, ant rorn their terivative in natup se [5.2.15]. 1 rasa, 2 rupa, 3 varna, 4 kanta, 5 sparsa, 6 sapta, 7 sneha, 8 pava, 9 kunat, (kunakrahanan rasatinan visesanan), 10 ekaca (svavat)
s: The affix मतुप् comes in the sense of 'whose it is' or 'in whom it is' after the प्रातिपदिक (Nominal Stem) रस etc. As रसवान्, रूपवान्, गन्धवान् Why this special sutra with regard to रसादि words, when they would have taken मतुप् by the last sutra? This prevents the application to these words of other affixes having the sense of मतुप् How do you form then रूपिणी कन्या, रूपिको दारकः These are rare forms. According to Patanjali this sutra is useless. Or the word रस &c, must denote qualities, perceivable by the organs of taste, touch &c, i. e. रस should mean taste, रूप form. Therefore the forms रूपिणी and रूपिकः are valid, meaning शोभायोग्यता So also रसिको तटः = भावयोगः, here रूप and रस do not mean 'form' and 'taste'. And all words of quality having one syllable are governed by this sutra, and form their derivative in मतुप् See [[5.2.115]]. 1 रस, 2 रूप, 3 वर्ण, 4 गन्ध, 5 स्पर्श, 6 शब्द, 7 स्नेह, 8 भाव, 9 गुणात्, (गुणग्रहणं रसादीनां विशेषणम्), 10 एकाचः (स्ववत्)

pk: The aril lac cones optionaly in the sense or natup arter a sten ending in long a the word elpresing sonething which is round only in a living being. Thus ron cuqa a crest, we have cuqala or cuqavan. so also karnikala or karnikavan Why do we say which is round in a living being? Observe siKavan pradipa the crested rlane or a lanp. Why do we say "ending in a"? Observe hastavan, padavan Vart:- it should be stated that the aril lac cones only arter what denotes nenber or linb or a living being, (and not anything like love, pasion, inteligence &c, that are also round in living being). ence there is no ariling or lac here : cikirsasyasti = cikirsavan, jihirsavan Every aril is udata [3.1.3], unles contrary is indicated by sone anubandha. The lac would have ben udata by [3.1.3], even without the indicatory c (V1.1. 163). The enploynent or this anubandha, however indicates that this udata wil never be changed into svarita, as other udatas are by rule [8.2.6], as cuqalosi
ck: the aril lac cones optionaly in the sense or natup arter a sten entink in lonk a the tort elpresink sonethink thich is rount only in a livink peink. thus ron cuta a crest, te have cutala or cutavan. so also karnikala or karnikavan thy to te say thich is rount in a livink peink? Opserve sikavan pratipa the crestet rlane or a lanp. thy to te say "entink in a"? Opserve hastavan, patavan Vart:- it shoult pe statet that the aril lac cones only arter that tenotes nenper or linp or a livink peink, (ant not anythink like love, pasion, intelikence &c, that are also rount in livink peink). ence there is no arilink or lac here : cikirsasyasti = cikirsavan, cihirsavan Every aril is utata [3.1.3], unles contrary is inticatet py sone anupantha. the lac toult have pen utata py [3.1.3], even tithout the inticatory c (V1.1. 163). the enploynent or this anupantha, hotever inticates that this utata til never pe chanket into svarita, as other utatas are py rule [8.2.6], as cutalosi
s: The affix लच् comes optionally in the sense of मतुप् after a stem ending in long आ the word expressing something which is found only in a living being. Thus from चूडा 'a crest', we have चूडालः or चूडावान्. So also कर्णिकालः or कर्णिकावान् Why do we say 'which is found in a living being'? Observe शिखावान् प्रदीपः 'the crested flame of a lamp'. Why do we say "ending in आ"? Observe हस्तवान्, पादवान् Vart:- It should be stated that the affix लच् comes only after what denotes member or limb of a living being, (and not anything like love, passion, intelligence &c, that are also found in living being). Hence there is no affixing of लच् here : चिकीर्षाऽस्यास्ति = चिकीर्षावान्, जिहीर्षावान् Every affix is udatta [[3.1.3]], unless contrary is indicated by some anubandha. The लच् would have been udatta by [[3.1.3]], even without the indicatory च् (V1.1. 163). The employment of this anubandha, however indicates that this udatta will never be changed into svarita, as other udattas are by rule [[8.2.6]], as चूडालोऽसि

pk: The aril lac cones in the sense or natup arter the words siDna etc. and optionaly arter natup also. Thus siDnala or siDnavan, gaqula or gaquvan The word anyatarasyan understod in this sutra, causes the enploynent or the aril natup in the alternative. it does not nean that the aril lac is optional. ror were lac optional, then the aril ini and Wan would cone by [5.2.15] arter those words or siDnadi clas which end in a. But that is not the case. Vart:- The words parsni and Danani lengthen the vowel berore la, as parsnila, Dananila Vart:- The words vata, danta, bala, lalawa and gala take the augnent un berore lac, as vatula, dantula, balula, lalawula, galula Vart:- The word jawa, Gawa, kawa and kala take lac, when censure is neant, as jawala, Gawala, kalala and kawala, but jawavanstapasa when no censure is neant. Vart:- This aril cones arter words denoting lower organisns, and word denoting disease: as yukala naksikala, vicarcikala, vipadikala, nurCala 1 siDna, 2 gaqu, 3 nani, 4 naBi, 5 bija (jiva), 6 vina, 7 krsna, 8 nispava, 9 pansu, 10 parsva, 1 parsu (parasu), 12 hanu, 13 saktu, 14 nansa, 15 parsniDananyo dirGasca 16 vatadantabalalawananun ca 17 jawaGawakawakala (kawa) ksepe, 18 parna, 19 udaka, 20 prajna, 21 saski, (sakTi) 2 karna, 23 sneha, 24 sita, 25 syana, 26 pinga, 27 pita, 28 puska (suska), 29 prTu, 30 nrdu, 31 nanju, 32 nanqa, 3 patra, 34 cawu, 35 kapi, 36 ganqu (kanqu), 37 granTi, 38 sri, 39 kusa, 40 Dara, 41 varsnan, 42 paksnan, 43 slesnan, 4 pesa, 45 nispad, 46 kunqa, 47 ksudrajantupatapayosca 48 ganqa, 49 sanjna
ck: the aril lac cones in the sense or natup arter the torts sitna etc. ant optionaly arter natup also. thus sitnala or sitnavan, katula or katuvan the tort anyatarasyan unterstot in this sutra, causes the enploynent or the aril natup in the alternative. it toes not nean that the aril lac is optional. ror tere lac optional, then the aril ini ant tan toult cone py [5.2.15] arter those torts or sitnati clas thich ent in a. put that is not the case. Vart:- the torts parsni ant tanani lenkthen the votel perore la, as parsnila, tananila Vart:- the torts vata, tanta, pala, lalata ant kala take the auknent un perore lac, as vatula, tantula, palula, lalatula, kalula Vart:- the tort cata, kata, kata ant kala take lac, then censure is neant, as catala, katala, kalala ant katala, put catavanstapasa then no censure is neant. Vart:- this aril cones arter torts tenotink loter orkanisns, ant tort tenotink tisease: as yukala naksikala, vicarcikala, vipatikala, nurcala 1 sitna, 2 katu, 3 nani, 4 napi, 5 pica (civa), 6 vina, 7 krsna, 8 nispava, 9 pansu, 10 parsva, 1 parsu (parasu), 12 hanu, 13 saktu, 14 nansa, 15 parsnitananyo tirkasca 16 vatatantapalalatananun ca 17 catakatakatakala (kata) ksepe, 18 parna, 19 utaka, 20 pracna, 21 saski, (sakti) 2 karna, 23 sneha, 24 sita, 25 syana, 26 pinka, 27 pita, 28 puska (suska), 29 prtu, 30 nrtu, 31 nancu, 32 nanta, 3 patra, 34 catu, 35 kapi, 36 kantu (kantu), 37 kranti, 38 sri, 39 kusa, 40 tara, 41 varsnan, 42 paksnan, 43 slesnan, 4 pesa, 45 nispat, 46 kunta, 47 ksutracantupatapayosca 48 kanta, 49 sancna
s: The affix लच् comes in the sense of मतुप् after the words सिध्म etc. and optionally after मतुप् also. Thus सिध्मलः or सिध्मवान्, गडुलः or गडुवान् The word अन्यतरस्याम् understood in this sutra, causes the employment of the affix मतुप् in the alternative. It does not mean that the affix लच् is optional. For were लच् optional, then the affix इनि and ठन् would come by [[5.2.115]] after those words of सिध्मादि class which end in अ. But that is not the case. Vart:- The words पार्ष्णि and धमनि lengthen the vowel before ल, as पार्ष्णीलः, धमनीलः Vart:- The words वात, दन्त, बल, ललाट and गल take the augment ऊङ् before लच्, as वातूलः, दन्तूलः, बलूलः, ललाटूलः, गलूलः Vart:- The word जटा, घटा, कटा and कला take लच्, when censure is meant, as जटालः, घटालः, कलालः and कटालः, but जटावांस्तापसः when no censure is meant. Vart:- This affix comes after words denoting lower organisms, and word denoting disease: as यूकालः मक्षिकालः, विचर्चिकालः, विपादिकालः, मूर्छालः 1 सिध्म, 2 गडु, 3 मणि, 4 नाभि, 5 बीज (जीव), 6 वीणा, 7 कृष्ण, 8 निष्पाव, 9 पांसु, 10 पार्श्व, 11 पर्शू (परशु), 12 हनु, 13 सक्तु, 14 मांस, 15 पार्ष्णिधमन्यो दीर्घश्च 16 वातदन्तबललाटानामूङ् च 17 जटाघटाकटाकलाः (कटा) क्षेपे, 18 पर्ण, 19 उदक, 20 प्रज्ञा, 21 सष्कि, (सक्थि) 22 कर्ण, 23 स्नेह, 24 शीत, 25 श्याम, 26 पिङ्ग, 27 पित्त, 28 पुष्क (शुष्क), 29 पृथु, 30 मृदु, 31 मञ्जु, 32 मण्ड, 33 पत्र, 34 चटु, 35 कपि, 36 गण्डु (कण्डु), 37 ग्रन्थि, 38 श्री, 39 कुश, 40 धारा, 41 वर्ष्मन्, 42 पक्ष्मन्, 43 श्लेष्मन्, 44 पेश, 45 निष्पाद्, 46 कुण्ड, 47 क्षुद्रजन्तूपतापयोश्च 48 गण्ड, 49 संज्ञा

pk: The aril lac cones in the senses or love and strength respectively arter the words vatsa and ansa Thus vatsala loving the calr, loving, tender. ansala strong, lusty. The word vatsa neans calr; in vatsala there is no trace or its origin, ror it is aplied to rather, naster &c, as vatsala svani, vatsala pita &c. The word ansa neans shoulder: but ansala neans strong. The aril lac in these cases is not optional, but necesary and debars natup in other senses, the natup only is aded as ansavati gO, ansavan durbala
ck: the aril lac cones in the senses or love ant strenkth respectively arter the torts vatsa ant ansa thus vatsala lovink the calr, lovink, tenter. ansala stronk, lusty. the tort vatsa neans calr; in vatsala there is no trace or its orikin, ror it is apliet to rather, naster &c, as vatsala svani, vatsala pita &c. the tort ansa neans shoulter: put ansala neans stronk. the aril lac in these cases is not optional, put necesary ant tepars natup in other senses, the natup only is atet as ansavati kO, ansavan turpala
s: The affix लच् comes in the senses of 'love' and 'strength' respectively after the words वत्स and अंस Thus वत्सलः 'loving the calf, loving, tender'. अंसलः 'strong, lusty'. The word वत्स means 'calf'; in वत्सल there is no trace of its origin, for it is applied to father, master &c, as वत्सलः स्वामी, वत्सलः पिता &c. The word अंस means 'shoulder': but अंसल means 'strong'. The affix लच् in these cases is not optional, but necessary and debars मतुप् In other senses, the matup only is added as अंसवती गौः, अंसवान् दुर्बलः

pk: The ariles ilac and lac cone in the sense or natup arter the word Pena and optionaly arter the aril natup also. The word c draws in lac; and the word anyatarasyan understod in the sutra ads natup in the alternative. as Penila, Penala and Penavan
ck: the ariles ilac ant lac cone in the sense or natup arter the tort pena ant optionaly arter the aril natup also. the tort c trats in lac; ant the tort anyatarasyan unterstot in the sutra ats natup in the alternative. as penila, penala ant penavan
s: The affixes इलच् and लच् come in the sense of मतुप् after the word फेन and optionally after the affix मतुप् also. The word च् draws in लच्; and the word अन्यतरस्याम् understood in the sutra adds मतुप् in the alternative. As फेनिलः, फेनलः and फेनवान्

pk: The thre ariles sa , na and ilac cone in the sense or natup respectively arter the words or the thre clases i.e. 1. lonadi 2. panadi and 3. picCadi and the aril natup also cones in the alternative. The aril sa cones arter lonadi words as, lonasa or lonavan hairy. The aril na cones arter panadi words, as, panana or panavan scaby. The aril ilac cones arter picCadi words, as, picCila or picCivan broth. Vart:- The aril na cones arter the word anga in the sense or beautirul; as angana the rair one i.e. a wonan. Vart:- The words saki, palali and dadru shorten their rinal vowel berore na, as sakinan a rield, palalinan, dadrunan Vart:- The word visvak (visu + anc) loses its second nenber, berore na, and the change caused by sandhi (u in to v) is undone. Otherwise the rorn would be visna (vak being elided), as visvanjitani santi asya = visunan noving variously. Vart:- The aril na cones arter laksni, berore which i is changed to a, as laksnirasyasti = laksnana Vart:- The aril ilach cones arter jata, ghata, and kala, when censure is neant, as jawila, Gawila kalila but jawavan when no censure is neant. 1 lonan, 2 ronan, 3 baBru, 4 hari, 5 giri, 6 karka, 7 kapi, 8 nuni, 9 taru 1 panan, 2 vanan, 3 venan, 4 henan, 5 slesnan, 6 kadra (kadru), 7 vala, 8 sanan, 9 usnan, 10 krni, 1 angat kalyana, 12 sakipalalidadrunan (sakipalalidruvan), hrsvatvan ca, 13 visvagityutarapadalopascakrtasanDe (visuna), 14 laksnya aca (laksnana), 15 sresWa, 16 palala 1 picCa (picCa), 2 urasa, 3 Guvaka (ksuvaka), 4 Druvaka (Druvaka), 5 jawaGawakala (jawaGawakalan), ksepe, 6 varna, 7 udaka, 8 panka, 9 prajna
ck: the thre ariles sa , na ant ilac cone in the sense or natup respectively arter the torts or the thre clases i.e. 1. lonati 2. panati ant 3. picati ant the aril natup also cones in the alternative. the aril sa cones arter lonati torts as, lonasa or lonavan hairy. the aril na cones arter panati torts, as, panana or panavan scapy. the aril ilac cones arter picati torts, as, picila or picivan proth. Vart:- the aril na cones arter the tort anka in the sense or peautirul; as ankana the rair one i.e. a tonan. Vart:- the torts saki, palali ant tatru shorten their rinal votel perore na, as sakinan a rielt, palalinan, tatrunan Vart:- the tort visvak (visu + anc) loses its secont nenper, perore na, ant the chanke causet py santhi (u in to v) is untone. Othertise the rorn toult pe visna (vak peink elitet), as visvancitani santi asya = visunan novink variously. Vart:- the aril na cones arter laksni, perore thich i is chanket to a, as laksnirasyasti = laksnana Vart:- the aril ilach cones arter cata, khata, ant kala, then censure is neant, as catila, katila kalila put catavan then no censure is neant. 1 lonan, 2 ronan, 3 papru, 4 hari, 5 kiri, 6 karka, 7 kapi, 8 nuni, 9 taru 1 panan, 2 vanan, 3 venan, 4 henan, 5 slesnan, 6 katra (katru), 7 vala, 8 sanan, 9 usnan, 10 krni, 1 ankat kalyana, 12 sakipalalitatrunan (sakipalalitruvan), hrsvatvan ca, 13 visvakityutarapatalopascakrtasante (visuna), 14 laksnya aca (laksnana), 15 sresta, 16 palala 1 pica (pica), 2 urasa, 3 kuvaka (ksuvaka), 4 truvaka (truvaka), 5 catakatakala (catakatakalan), ksepe, 6 varna, 7 utaka, 8 panka, 9 pracna
s: The three affixes श , न and इलच् come in the sense of मतुप् respectively after the words of the three classes i.e. 1. लोमदि 2. पामादि and 3. पिच्छादि and the affix मतुप् also comes in the alternative. The affix श comes after लोमादि words as, लोमशः or लोमवान् 'hairy'. The affix न comes after पामादि words, as, पामनः or पामवान् 'scabby'. The affix इलच् comes after पिच्छादि words, as, पिच्छिलः or पिच्छिवान् 'broth'. Vart:- The affix न comes after the word अङ्ग in the sense of beautiful; as अङ्गना 'the fair one' i.e. a woman. Vart:- The words शाकी, पलाली and दद्रू shorten their final vowel before न, as शाकिनम् 'a field', पलालिनम्, दद्रुणम् Vart:- The word विष्वक् (विषु + अंच्) loses its second member, before न, and the change caused by sandhi (उ in to व्) is undone. Otherwise the form would be विष्णः (वक् being elided), as विष्वञ्जितानि सन्ति अस्य = विषुणम् 'moving variously'. Vart:- The affix न comes after लक्ष्मी, before which ई is changed to अ, as लक्ष्मीरस्यास्ति = लक्ष्मणः Vart:- The affix ilach comes after jata, ghata, and kala, when censure is meant, as जटिलः, घटिलः कलिलः but जटावान् when no censure is meant. 1 लोमन्, 2 रोमन्, 3 बभ्रु, 4 हरि, 5 गिरि, 6 कर्क, 7 कपि, 8 मुनि, 9 तरु 1 पामन्, 2 वामन्, 3 वेमन्, 4 हेमन्, 5 श्लेष्मन्, 6 कद्र (कद्रु), 7 वाल, 8 सामन्, 9 ऊष्मन्, 10 कृमि, 11 अङ्गात् कल्याण, 12 शाकीपलालीदद्रूणां (शाकीपलालीद्द्रूवां), हृस्वत्वं च, 13 विष्वगित्युत्तरपदलोपश्चाकृतसंधेः (विषुण), 14 लक्ष्म्या अच्च (लक्ष्मणः), 15 श्रेष्ठ, 16 पलल 1 पिच्छा (पिच्छ), 2 उरस, 3 घुवक (क्षुवक), 4 ध्रुवक (ध्रुवका), 5 जटाघटाकलः (जटाघटाकलान्), क्षेपे, 6 वर्ण, 7 उदक, 8 पङ्क, 9 प्रज्ञा

pk: The aril n cones in the sense or natup arter the words 1. prajna 2. sradDa and 3. arca as wel as the aril natup as prajna or prajnavan, sradDa or sradDavan, arca or arcavan The Kasika has introduced the word vrti into the sutra ron the vartika vrtesca Vart:- so also arter vrti, as varta or vrtinan
ck: the aril n cones in the sense or natup arter the torts 1. pracna 2. srata ant 3. arca as tel as the aril natup as pracna or pracnavan, srata or sratavan, arca or arcavan the kasika has introtucet the tort vrti into the sutra ron the vartika vrtesca Vart:- so also arter vrti, as varta or vrtinan
s: The affix ण् comes in the sense of मतुप् after the words 1. प्रज्ञा 2. श्रद्धा and 3. अर्चा as well as the affix मतुप् As प्राज्ञः or प्रज्ञावान्, श्राद्धः or श्रद्धावान्, आर्चः or अर्चावान् The Kasika has introduced the word वृत्ति into the sutra from the vartika वृत्तेश्च Vart:- So also after वृत्ति, as वर्त्तः or वृत्तिमान्

pk: The ariles vini and ini cone with the rorce or natup arter the words tapas and sahara respectively. The word tapas ends in as, and thererore by [5.2.121], it would have taken vini; sinilarly sahasra ends in a, and by [5.2.15], it would have taken ini; it nay, thererore, be objected, where is the necesity ror the present sutra? To this it is replied, that by the nelt sutra, these words take the aril an also; so that, had there not ben this present sutra, the an would have debared the aplication or ini and vini or [5.2.15] and [5.2.121]. The aril Wan [5.1.15] is also debared arter the word sahasra, though it ends in a Thus taposyasnin va vidyate = tapasvin non. tapasvi sinilarly sahasrin non. sahasra
ck: the ariles vini ant ini cone tith the rorce or natup arter the torts tapas ant sahara respectively. the tort tapas ents in as, ant thererore py [5.2.121], it toult have taken vini; sinilarly sahasra ents in a, ant py [5.2.15], it toult have taken ini; it nay, thererore, pe opcectet, there is the necesity ror the present sutra? to this it is repliet, that py the nelt sutra, these torts take the aril an also; so that, hat there not pen this present sutra, the an toult have teparet the aplication or ini ant vini or [5.2.15] ant [5.2.121]. the aril tan [5.1.15] is also teparet arter the tort sahasra, thoukh it ents in a thus taposyasnin va vityate = tapasvin non. tapasvi sinilarly sahasrin non. sahasra
s: The affixes विनि and इनि come with the force of मतुप् after the words तपस् and सहर respectively. The word तपस् ends in अस्, and therefore by [[5.2.121]], it would have taken विनि; similarly सहस्र ends in अ, and by [[5.2.115]], it would have taken इनि; it may, therefore, be objected, where is the necessity for the present sutra? To this it is replied, that by the next sutra, these words take the affix अण् also; so that, had there not been this present sutra, the अण् would have debarred the application of इनि and विनि of [[5.2.115]] and [[5.2.121]]. The affix ठन् [[5.1.115]] is also debarred after the word सहस्र, though it ends in अ Thus तपोऽस्यास्मिन् वा विद्यते = तपस्विन् nom. तपस्वी Similarly सहस्रिन् nom. सहस्रा

pk: and also an cones arter tapas and sahara Thus tapasa, sahasra The separation or this sutra ron the last is ror two purposes, ist the anuvriti or an runs in the subsequent sutras, which could not have ben done had it ben included in the last sutra, 2nd the rule or yathasankhya (1.3. 10) would not have aplied in the last sutra, had an ben read along with vini and ini Vart:- The words jyotsna &c, are governed by this rule and take an. as jyotsna vidyatesnin pakse = jyOtsna paksa sinilarly tanisra (a kind or hel) kOnqala, kOtapa, vEsarpa, and vEpadika
ck: ant also an cones arter tapas ant sahara thus tapasa, sahasra the separation or this sutra ron the last is ror to purposes, ist the anuvriti or an runs in the supsetuent sutras, thich coult not have pen tone hat it pen inclutet in the last sutra, 2nt the rule or yathasankhya (1.3. 10) toult not have apliet in the last sutra, hat an pen reat alonk tith vini ant ini Vart:- the torts cyotsna &c, are kovernet py this rule ant take an. as cyotsna vityatesnin pakse = cyOtsna paksa sinilarly tanisra (a kint or hel) kOntala, kOtapa, vEsarpa, ant vEpatika
s: And also अण् comes after तपस् and सहर Thus तापसः, साहस्रः The separation of this sutra from the last is for two purposes, Ist the anuvritti of अण् runs in the subsequent sutras, which could not have been done had it been included in the last sutra, 2nd the rule of yathasankhya (1.3. 10) would not have applied in the last sutra, had अण् been read along with विनि and इनि Vart:- The words ज्योत्स्ना &c, are governed by this rule and take अण्. As ज्योत्स्ना विद्यतेऽस्मिन् पक्षे = ज्यौत्स्नः पक्षः Similarly तामिस्रः (a kind of hell) कौण्डलः, कौतपः, वैसर्पः, and वैपादिकः

pk: The aril an cones in the sense or natup arter sikata and sarkara Thus sEkawo Gawa, sarkaran naDu These are the elanples, when they do not denote a place. in denoting a place they wil take il and lup or the nelt sutra.
ck: the aril an cones in the sense or natup arter sikata ant sarkara thus sEkato kata, sarkaran natu these are the elanples, then they to not tenote a place. in tenotink a place they til take il ant lup or the nelt sutra.
s: The affix अण् comes in the sense of मतुप् after सिकता and शर्करा Thus सैकटो घटः, शार्करं मधु These are the examples, when they do not denote a place. In denoting a place they will take इल् and लुप् of the next sutra.

pk: When the sense ir or locality there nay take place lup elision or the ariles denoting natup (with the preservation or the gender and nunber or the word) or there nay be the ariles ilac , an and natup arter the words sikata and sarkara By ca in the sutra, an and natup are introduced. The lup rerers to natup and every aril in general. Thus sikata asnin vidyante = sikata desa or sikatila, sakata or sikatavan a sandy country. so also sarkara desa or sarkarila or sarkara or sarkaravan a stony locality. Why do we say when neaning a locality? Observe sEkata a vesel or sand, sarkan "honey or sugar". in the case or the elision or the aril, the gender and nunber are preserved by (1.2. 51).
ck: then the sense ir or locality there nay take place lup elision or the ariles tenotink natup (tith the preservation or the kenter ant nunper or the tort) or there nay pe the ariles ilac , an ant natup arter the torts sikata ant sarkara py ca in the sutra, an ant natup are introtucet. the lup rerers to natup ant every aril in keneral. thus sikata asnin vityante = sikata tesa or sikatila, sakata or sikatavan a santy country. so also sarkara tesa or sarkarila or sarkara or sarkaravan a stony locality. thy to te say then neanink a locality? Opserve sEkata a vesel or sant, sarkan "honey or sukar". in the case or the elision or the aril, the kenter ant nunper are preservet py (1.2. 51).
s: When the sense if of 'locality' there may take place लुप् elision of the affixes denoting मतुप् (with the preservation of the gender and number of the word) or there may be the affixes इलच् , अण् and मतुप् after the words सिकता and शर्करा By च in the sutra, अण् and मतुप् are introduced. The लुप् refers to मतुप् and every affix in general. Thus सिकता अस्मिन् विद्यन्ते = सिकता देशः or सिकतिलः, सकतः or सिकतावान् 'a sandy country'. So also शर्करा देशः or शर्करिलः or शार्करः or शर्करावान् 'a stony locality'. Why do we say when meaning a 'locality'? Observe सैकतः 'a vessel of sand', शार्कां "honey or sugar". In the case of the elision of the affix, the gender and number are preserved by (1.2. 51).

pk: The aril urac cones in the sense or having projecting teth arter the word danta Thus danta unata asya santi = dantura The words in the sutra are either in the noninative or the locative case, but have the rorce or ablative. Why do we say when the neaning is that or projecting? Observe dantavan having teth.
ck: the aril urac cones in the sense or havink procectink teth arter the tort tanta thus tanta unata asya santi = tantura the torts in the sutra are either in the noninative or the locative case, put have the rorce or aplative. thy to te say then the neanink is that or procectink? Opserve tantavan havink teth.
s: The affix उरच् comes in the sense of 'having projecting teeth' after the word दन्त Thus दन्ता उन्नता अस्य सन्ति = दन्तुरः The words in the sutra are either in the nominative or the locative case, but have the force of ablative. Why do we say when the meaning is that of 'projecting'? Observe दन्तवान् 'having teeth'.

pk: The aril ra cones arter the words 1. usa 2. susi 3. nuska and 4. naDu with the rorce or natup Thus usaran ksetran a baren soil, inpregnated with usha or salt. susiran kasWan a perorated wod i. e. containing susi or hole. nuskara vasu a beast having testicles or nushka. naDuro guqa swet sugar. The word iti shows that the words rorned with ra are nanes or certain things. Thererore it wil not aply here usosnin Gawe vidyate there is salt in this pot, we canot say usaro Gawa, nor naDuro Gawa ror naDvasnin Gawe vidyate Vart:- The aril ra cones arter Ka, nuKa and kunja, as Kanasyasti kanqavivaran nahat = Kara an as, lit. having a wide throat. nuKanasyasti iti sarvasnin vaktavye = nuKara talkative, kunjavasya sta = kunjara an elephant having tusks. The word kunja neans the tusk or an elephant or the lower jaw or an elephant. The word kunjara is a conon nane ror al elephants. Vart:- The aril ra cones arter naga, pansu and panqu, as nagaran a city, lit. having tres (naga = tre), pansuran, panquran Vart:- so also arter kacCu, the vowel being shortened: as kacCuran
ck: the aril ra cones arter the torts 1. usa 2. susi 3. nuska ant 4. natu tith the rorce or natup thus usaran ksetran a paren soil, inpreknatet tith usha or salt. susiran kastan a peroratet tot i. e. containink susi or hole. nuskara vasu a peast havink testicles or nushka. naturo kuta stet sukar. the tort iti shots that the torts rornet tith ra are nanes or certain thinks. thererore it til not aply here usosnin kate vityate there is salt in this pot, te canot say usaro kata, nor naturo kata ror natvasnin kate vityate Vart:- the aril ra cones arter ka, nuka ant kunca, as kanasyasti kantavivaran nahat = kara an as, lit. havink a tite throat. nukanasyasti iti sarvasnin vaktavye = nukara talkative, kuncavasya sta = kuncara an elephant havink tusks. the tort kunca neans the tusk or an elephant or the loter cat or an elephant. the tort kuncara is a conon nane ror al elephants. Vart:- the aril ra cones arter naka, pansu ant pantu, as nakaran a city, lit. havink tres (naka = tre), pansuran, panturan Vart:- so also arter kacu, the votel peink shortenet: as kacuran
s: The affix र comes after the words 1. ऊष 2. सुषि 3. मुष्क and 4. मधु with the force of मतुप् Thus ऊषरं क्षेत्रम् 'a barren soil, impregnated with usha or salt'. सुषिरं काष्ठं 'a perforated wood i. e. containing सुषि or hole'. मुष्करः वशुः 'a beast having testicles or mushka'. मधुरो गुडः 'sweet sugar'. The word इति shows that the words formed with र are names of certain things. Therefore it will not apply here ऊषोऽस्मिन् घटे विद्यते 'there is salt in this pot', we cannot say ऊषरो घटः, nor मधुरो घटः for मध्वस्मिन् घटे विद्यते Vart:- The affix र comes after ख, मुख and कुञ्ज, as खमस्यास्ति कण्डविवरं महत् = खरः 'an ass, lit. having a wide throat'. मुखमस्यास्ति इति सर्वस्मिन् वक्तव्ये = मुखरः 'talkative', कुञ्जावस्य स्तः = कुञ्जरः 'an elephant having tusks'. The word कुञ्ज means the tusk of an elephant or the lower jaw of an elephant. The word कुञ्जर is a common name for all elephants. Vart:- The affix र comes after नग, पांसु and पाण्डु, as नगरम् 'a city, lit. having trees (naga = tree)', पांसुरम्, पाण्डुरम् Vart:- So also after कच्छू, the vowel being shortened: as कच्छुरम्

pk: The aril na cones in the sense or natup arter 1. dyu and 2. dru Thus dyuna and druna These are prinitive words, and thererore do not take natup in the alternative.
ck: the aril na cones in the sense or natup arter 1. tyu ant 2. tru thus tyuna ant truna these are prinitive torts, ant thererore to not take natup in the alternative.
s: The affix म comes in the sense of मतुप् after 1. द्यु and 2. द्रु Thus द्युमः and द्रुमः These are primitive words, and therefore do not take मतुप् in the alternative.

pk: The aril va cones optionaly with the rorce or natup Though the word anyatarasyan was understod here ron [5.2.96] (se sutra [5.2.97]; its repetition shows that in the alternative we have not only natup but the ariles ini and Wan [5.2.15] also. Thus we have rour rorns: kesava, kesi, kesika and kesavan Vart:- The aril va is sen arter other words also. as naniva a kind or serpent, hiranyava a kind or gen, kararava, kunarava, rajivan, kunjava, iswakava Vart:- The rinal or arnas is elided berore va, as arnava Vart:- in the Chandas, the ariles i, vanip, va and natup cone in the sense or natup Thus i- raTiraBun nudgalani gaviswO (raTi), sunangaliriyan vaDu; vanip :- naGavananinahe; va and natup, as udva or udvati Vart:- The ariles iran and irac cone respectively arter neDa and raTa as, ne꣡Dira, raTira
ck: the aril va cones optionaly tith the rorce or natup thoukh the tort anyatarasyan tas unterstot here ron [5.2.96] (se sutra [5.2.97]; its repetition shots that in the alternative te have not only natup put the ariles ini ant tan [5.2.15] also. thus te have rour rorns: kesava, kesi, kesika ant kesavan Vart:- the aril va is sen arter other torts also. as naniva a kint or serpent, hiranyava a kint or ken, kararava, kunarava, racivan, kuncava, istakava Vart:- the rinal or arnas is elitet perore va, as arnava Vart:- in the chantas, the ariles i, vanip, va ant natup cone in the sense or natup thus i- ratirapun nutkalani kavistO (rati), sunankaliriyan vatu; vanip :- nakavananinahe; va ant natup, as utva or utvati Vart:- the ariles iran ant irac cone respectively arter neta ant rata as, ne꣡tira, ratira
s: The affix व comes optionally with the force of मतुप् Though the word अन्यतरस्याम् was understood here from [[5.2.96]] (see sutra [[5.2.97]]; its repetition shows that in the alternative we have not only मतुप् but the affixes इनि and ठन् [[5.2.115]] also. Thus we have four forms: केशवः, केशी, केशिकः and केशवान् Vart:- The affix व is seen after other words also. As मणिवः 'a kind of serpent', हिरण्यवः 'a kind of gem', कररावः, कुमारवः, राजीवम्, कुञ्जावः, इष्टकावः Vart:- The final of अर्णस् is elided before व, as अर्णवः Vart:- In the Chhandas, the affixes ई, वनिप्, व and मतुप् come in the sense of मतुप् Thus ईः- रथीरभून् मुद्गलानी गविष्टौ (रथीः), सुमङ्गलीरियं वधूः; वनिप् :- मघवानमीमहे; व and मतुप्, as उद्वा or उद्वती Vart:- The affixes इरन् and इरच् come respectively after मेधा and रथः as, मे꣡धिरः, रथिरः

pk: The aril va cones in the sense or natup arter 1. ganqi and 2. ajaga when the word is a nane. as ganqivan the bow Gandiva or arjuna ajagavan the bow ajagava or siva. There is shortening also, as ganqivan The sutra is so raned, that the word ganqi and ganqi are both included.
ck: the aril va cones in the sense or natup arter 1. kanti ant 2. acaka then the tort is a nane. as kantivan the pot kantiva or arcuna acakavan the pot acakava or siva. there is shortenink also, as kantivan the sutra is so ranet, that the tort kanti ant kanti are poth inclutet.
s: The affix व comes in the sense of मतुप् after 1. गाण्डी and 2. अजग when the word is a Name. As गाण्डीवं 'the bow Gandiva of Arjuna' अजगवं 'the bow Ajagava of Siva'. There is shortening also, as गाण्डिवं The sutra is so framed, that the word गाण्डी and गाण्डि are both included.

pk: The ariles iran and irac cone in the sense or natup arter the words 1. kanja and 2. anqa respectively. Thus ka꣡nqira and anqira꣡ another reading has anqa and anqira
ck: the ariles iran ant irac cone in the sense or natup arter the torts 1. kanca ant 2. anta respectively. thus ka꣡ntira ant antira꣡ another reatink has anta ant antira
s: The affixes ईरन् and ईरच् come in the sense of मतुप् after the words 1. काण्ज and 2. अण्ड respectively. Thus का꣡ण्डीरः and अण्डीरः꣡ Another reading has आण्ड and आण्डीरः

pk: The aril valac cones in the sense or natup arter 1. rajas 2. krsi 3. asuti and 3. parisad as rajasvala stri, krsivala kuwunbi, asutivala sOnqika, parisadvalo raja The lengthening or vowel in krsi and asuti takes place by [6.3.18]. The aril valac cones only under certain senses and conditions, as shown in the above elanples. Thus in rajosnin grane vidyate, there is no ariling. Vart:- The aril valach is sen arter other words also. as Bratrvala, putravala, pitrvala, utsahavala
ck: the aril valac cones in the sense or natup arter 1. racas 2. krsi 3. asuti ant 3. parisat as racasvala stri, krsivala kutunpi, asutivala sOntika, parisatvalo raca the lenkthenink or votel in krsi ant asuti takes place py [6.3.18]. the aril valac cones only unter certain senses ant contitions, as shotn in the apove elanples. thus in racosnin krane vityate, there is no arilink. Vart:- the aril valach is sen arter other torts also. as pratrvala, putravala, pitrvala, utsahavala
s: The affix वलच् comes in the sense of मतुप् after 1. रजस् 2. कृषि 3. आसुति and 3. परिषद् As रजस्वला स्त्री, कृषीवलः कुटुम्बी, आसुतीवलः शौण्डिकः, परिषद्वलो राजा The lengthening of vowel in कृषि and आसुति takes place by [[6.3.118]]. The affix वलच् comes only under certain senses and conditions, as shown in the above examples. Thus in रजोऽस्मिन् ग्रामे विद्यते, there is no affixing. Vart:- The affix valach is seen after other words also. As भ्रातृवलः, पुत्रवलः, पितृवलः, उत्साहवलः

pk: The aril valac cones in the sense or natup arter 1. danta and 2. siKa when a nane is rorned. Thus dantavala sEnya, dantavalo gaja, siKavalan nagaran, siKavalo sTuna The rinal vowel or danta is lengthened berore vala by [6.3.18].
ck: the aril valac cones in the sense or natup arter 1. tanta ant 2. sika then a nane is rornet. thus tantavala sEnya, tantavalo kaca, sikavalan nakaran, sikavalo stuna the rinal votel or tanta is lenkthenet perore vala py [6.3.18].
s: The affix वलच् comes in the sense of मतुप् after 1. दन्त and 2. शिखा when a Name is formed. Thus दन्तावलः सैन्यः, दन्तावलो गजः, शिखावलं नगरम्, शिखावलो स्थूणा The final vowel of दन्त is lengthened before वल by [[6.3.118]].

pk: The words 1. jyotsna 2. tanisra 3. srngina 4. urjasvin 5. urjasvala 6. gonin 7. nalina and 8. nalinasa are iregularly rorned in the sense or natup and are nanes. They are thus rorned. jyotis + na = jyotsna non-light (the i being elided). tanas + ra = tanisra night. (i being aded ): it has other genders than reninine as tanisran naBa dark sky. srnga + inac = srngina The augnent asuk is aded to urj, and then the aril vini and valac; as urj + as + vin = urjsvin; urjsvala go + nini = gonin; nala + inac = nalina; nala + inasac = nalinasa
ck: the torts 1. cyotsna 2. tanisra 3. srnkina 4. urcasvin 5. urcasvala 6. konin 7. nalina ant 8. nalinasa are irekularly rornet in the sense or natup ant are nanes. they are thus rornet. cyotis + na = cyotsna non-likht (the i peink elitet). tanas + ra = tanisra nikht. (i peink atet ): it has other kenters than reninine as tanisran napa tark sky. srnka + inac = srnkina the auknent asuk is atet to urc, ant then the aril vini ant valac; as urc + as + vin = urcsvin; urcsvala ko + nini = konin; nala + inac = nalina; nala + inasac = nalinasa
s: The words 1. ज्योत्स्न 2. तमिस्रा 3. शृङ्गिण 4. ऊर्जस्विन् 5. ऊर्जस्वल 6. गोमिन् 7. मलिन and 8. मलीमस are irregularly formed in the sense of मतुप् and are Names. They are thus formed. ज्योतिष् + न = ज्योत्स्ना 'moon-light' (the इ being elided). तमस् + र = तमिस्रा 'night'. (इ being added ): it has other genders than feminine as तमिस्रं नभः 'dark sky'. शृङ्ग + इमच् = शृङ्गिणः The augment असुक् is added to ऊर्ज्, and then the affix विनि and वलच्; as ऊर्ज् + अस् + विन् = ऊर्ज्स्विन्; ऊर्ज्स्वलः गो + मिनि = गोमिन्; मल + इनच् = मलिनः; मल + ईमसच् = मलीमसः

pk: The ariles ini and Wan cone in the sense or natup arter the pratipadika (noninal stens) ending in short a and in the alternative natup also cones. Thus danqin, danqika, Catrin non. Catri, Catrika The word anyatarasyan [5.2.96] is understod here also, so we have natup, as danqavan, Catravan Why do we say short a? Observe Kawvavan. ere there is neither in nor Wan These two ariles ini and Wan do not cone arter words or one sylable, arter words ending in krit-ariles, arter words denoting genus (jati), and when the construction is that or locative. as sva and Ka rorn only svavan, Kavan Krit: as, karakavan Genus, as, vyaGravan, sinhavan Locative; as danqa asyan santi = danqavati sala There are, however, sone elceptions to this, as krit :- karyin, karyika haryin, haryika Genus (jati) :- tanqulin, tanqulika
ck: the ariles ini ant tan cone in the sense or natup arter the pratipatika (noninal stens) entink in short a ant in the alternative natup also cones. thus tantin, tantika, catrin non. catri, catrika the tort anyatarasyan [5.2.96] is unterstot here also, so te have natup, as tantavan, catravan thy to te say short a? Opserve katvavan. ere there is neither in nor tan these to ariles ini ant tan to not cone arter torts or one sylaple, arter torts entink in krit-ariles, arter torts tenotink kenus (cati), ant then the construction is that or locative. as sva ant ka rorn only svavan, kavan krit: as, karakavan kenus, as, vyakravan, sinhavan Locative; as tanta asyan santi = tantavati sala there are, hotever, sone elceptions to this, as krit :- karyin, karyika haryin, haryika kenus (cati) :- tantulin, tantulika
s: The affixes इनि and ठन् come in the sense of मतुप् after the प्रातिपदिक (Nominal Stems) ending in short अ and in the alternative मतुप् also comes. Thus दण्डिन्, दण्डिकः, छत्रिन् nom. छत्री, छत्रिकः The word अन्यतरस्याम् [[5.2.96]] is understood here also, so we have मतुप्, as दण्डवान्, छत्रवान् Why do we say 'short अ'? Observe खट्वावान्. Here there is neither इन् nor ठन् These two affixes इनि and ठन् do not come after words of one syllable, after words ending in krit-affixes, after words denoting genus (jati), and when the construction is that of locative. As स्व and ख form only स्वावान्, खवान् Krit: as, कारकवान् Genus, as, व्याघ्रवान्, सिंहवान् Locative; as दण्डा अस्यां सन्ति = दण्डवती शाला There are, however, some exceptions to this, as krit :-- कार्यिन्, कार्यिकः हार्यिन्, हार्यिकः Genus (jati) :-- तण्डुलिन्, तण्डुलिकः

pk: The ariles ini and Wan cone in the sense or natup arter the words vrihi etc. as wel as the aril natup Thus vrihin (non. vrihi), vrihika, vrihinan, nayi, nayika, nayavan These two ariles, however, do not cone arter al vrihyadi words. acording to Patanjali, the aril ini cones arter siKadi sub-division, and the aril ikan arter yavaKadadi sub-division, arter the renaining words, both ini and Wan (= ikan) cone. The siKadi arter which ini only cones are:- 1 siKa, 2 neKala, 3 sanjna, 4 balaka, 5 nala, 6 vina, 7 vaqava, 8 aswaka, 9 pataka, 10 karnan, 1 carnan, 12 hansa, The yavaKada &c. are the rolowing 1 yavaKada, 2 kunari, 3 nO; they take ikan only. The rest take both. The word vrihi wil get these ariles by the nelt sutra also, why is it then read in this clas? The word vrihi in the Tundadi clas [5.2.17], does not nean the word-rorn vrihi, but words synonyn with it. Thus salayosya santi = salila, sali, salika, salinan The word sirsa preceded by the negative particle, takes these ariles, as asirsi and asirsika The renaining words are vrihi, naya, sala, keka, varnan, danswra, sanjna
ck: the ariles ini ant tan cone in the sense or natup arter the torts vrihi etc. as tel as the aril natup thus vrihin (non. vrihi), vrihika, vrihinan, nayi, nayika, nayavan these to ariles, hotever, to not cone arter al vrihyati torts. acortink to patancali, the aril ini cones arter sikati sup-tivision, ant the aril ikan arter yavakatati sup-tivision, arter the renainink torts, poth ini ant tan (= ikan) cone. the sikati arter thich ini only cones are:- 1 sika, 2 nekala, 3 sancna, 4 palaka, 5 nala, 6 vina, 7 vatava, 8 astaka, 9 pataka, 10 karnan, 1 carnan, 12 hansa, the yavakata &c. are the rolotink 1 yavakata, 2 kunari, 3 nO; they take ikan only. the rest take poth. the tort vrihi til ket these ariles py the nelt sutra also, thy is it then reat in this clas? the tort vrihi in the tuntati clas [5.2.17], toes not nean the tort-rorn vrihi, put torts synonyn tith it. thus salayosya santi = salila, sali, salika, salinan the tort sirsa precetet py the nekative particle, takes these ariles, as asirsi ant asirsika the renainink torts are vrihi, naya, sala, keka, varnan, tanstra, sancna
s: The affixes इनि and ठन् come in the sense of मतुप् after the words व्रीहि etc. as well as the affix मतुप् Thus व्रीहिन् (nom. व्रीही), व्रीहिकः, व्रीहिमान्, मायी, मायिकः, मायावान् These two affixes, however, do not come after all व्रीह्यादि words. According to Patanjali, the affix इनि comes after शिखादि sub-division, and the affix इकन् after यवखदादि sub-division, after the remaining words, both इनि and ठन् (= इकन्) come. The शिखादि after which इनि only comes are:- 1 शिखा, 2 मेखला, 3 संज्ञा, 4 बलाका, 5 माला, 6 वीणा, 7 वडवा, 8 अष्टका, 9 पताका, 10 कर्मन्, 11 चर्मन्, 12 हंसा, The यवखद &c. are the following 1 यवखद, 2 कुमारी, 3 मौ; they take इकन् only. The rest take both. The word व्रीहि will get these affixes by the next sutra also, why is it then read in this class? The word व्रीहि in the Tundadi class [[5.2.117]], does not mean the word-form व्रीहि, but words synonym with it. Thus शालयोऽस्य सन्ति = शालिलः, शाली, शालिकः, शालिमान् The word शीर्ष preceded by the negative particle, takes these affixes, as आशीर्षी and अशीर्षिकः The remaining words are व्रीहि, माया, शाला, केका, वर्मन्, दंष्ट्रा, संज्ञा

pk: The aril ilac also cones in the sense or natup arter the pratipadika (noninal stens) tunda etc. The rorce or ca is that ini, Wan and natup also cone. as tundila, tundi, tundika, tundavan. sinilarly udarila, udari, udarika, udaravan The rolowing is the list or tundadi words 1 tunda, 2 udara, 3 picanqa, 4 Gawa, 5 yava, 6 vrihi, 7 svangadvivrdDO ca That is to say, the aril ilac cones arter words denoting parts or ones body, when the largenes (vivrdDi) or those organs is inplied : as vivrdDO karnO yasya sa = karnala, karni, karnika, karnavan
ck: the aril ilac also cones in the sense or natup arter the pratipatika (noninal stens) tunta etc. the rorce or ca is that ini, tan ant natup also cone. as tuntila, tunti, tuntika, tuntavan. sinilarly utarila, utari, utarika, utaravan the rolotink is the list or tuntati torts 1 tunta, 2 utara, 3 picanta, 4 kata, 5 yava, 6 vrihi, 7 svankatvivrtO ca that is to say, the aril ilac cones arter torts tenotink parts or ones poty, then the larkenes (vivrti) or those orkans is inpliet : as vivrtO karnO yasya sa = karnala, karni, karnika, karnavan
s: The affix इलच् also comes in the sense of मतुप् after the प्रातिपदिक (Nominal Stems) तुन्द etc. The force of च is that इनि, ठन् and मतुप् also come. As तुन्दिलः, तुन्दी, तुन्दिकः, तुन्दवान्. Similarly उदरिलः, उदरी, उदरिकः, उदरवान् The following is the list of तुन्दादि words 1 तुन्द, 2 उदर, 3 पिचण्ड, 4 घट, 5 यव, 6 व्रीहि, 7 स्वाङ्गाद्विवृद्धौ च That is to say, the affix इलच् comes after words denoting parts of one's body, when the largeness (विवृद्धि) of those organs is implied : as विवृद्धौ कर्णौ यस्य स = कार्णलः, कर्णी, कर्णिकः, कर्णवान्

pk: The aril Wan always cones in the sense or natup arter a sten which in conposition is preceded by eka or go Thus ekasatanasyasti = Ekasatika; gOsatika, gOsahasrika The word ata or [5.2.15], is understod here also; so that, stens not ending in a are not governed by this rule, such as ekavinsatirasyasti, no ariling. The word Ekagavika is an aparent elception, it being rorned by ading Wan to the sanasanta word ekagava [5.4.92]. ow do you elplain gOsakawika rorned by Wan ron gosakawi ? ere sakawan is taken ror sakawi, both being synonyns (n. B. This opinion or the Kasika-author is not in harnony with that or Patanjali, who does not read the anuvriti or ata into this sutra. acording to hin gOsakawika is rorned ron gosakawi; and ekavinsati &c, do not take this aril, because it is against usage. But the author or Kasika says—avasyan cata ityanuvartyan; dvandvapatopagarhyat ityevanadyarTan - the anuvriti or ata nust surely be read, ror the sake or sutras like [5.2.128], though in the sutras, like vatatisaraByan &c there is no necesity or reading the anuvriti or ata) The word nityan always, is used in the sutra to indicate that natup does not cone in the alternative. in al the previous sutras natup cane in the alternative. ow do you rorn ekadravyavat in ekadravyavatvad ? This is not a corect rorn; or it nay be said to be a conpound or eka and dravyavatvat
ck: the aril tan altays cones in the sense or natup arter a sten thich in conposition is precetet py eka or ko thus ekasatanasyasti = Ekasatika; kOsatika, kOsahasrika the tort ata or [5.2.15], is unterstot here also; so that, stens not entink in a are not kovernet py this rule, such as ekavinsatirasyasti, no arilink. the tort Ekakavika is an aparent elception, it peink rornet py atink tan to the sanasanta tort ekakava [5.4.92]. ot to you elplain kOsakatika rornet py tan ron kosakati ? ere sakatan is taken ror sakati, poth peink synonyns (n. p. this opinion or the kasika-author is not in harnony tith that or patancali, tho toes not reat the anuvriti or ata into this sutra. acortink to hin kOsakatika is rornet ron kosakati; ant ekavinsati &c, to not take this aril, pecause it is akainst usake. put the author or kasika says—avasyan cata ityanuvartyan; tvantvapatopakarhyat ityevanatyartan - the anuvriti or ata nust surely pe reat, ror the sake or sutras like [5.2.128], thoukh in the sutras, like vatatisarapyan &c there is no necesity or reatink the anuvriti or ata) the tort nityan altays, is uset in the sutra to inticate that natup toes not cone in the alternative. in al the previous sutras natup cane in the alternative. ot to you rorn ekatravyavat in ekatravyavatvat ? this is not a corect rorn; or it nay pe sait to pe a conpount or eka ant travyavatvat
s: The affix ठञ् always comes in the sense of मतुप् after a stem which in composition is preceded by एक or गो Thus एकशतमस्यास्ति = ऐकशतिकः; गौशतिकः, गौसहस्रिकः The word अतः of [[5.2.115]], is understood here also; so that, stems not ending in अ are not governed by this rule, such as एकविंशतिरस्यास्ति, no affixing. The word ऐकगविकः is an apparent exception, it being formed by adding ठञ् to the samasanta word एकगव [[5.4.92]]. How do you explain गौशकटिकः formed by ठञ् from गोशकटी ? Here शकटं is taken for शकटी, both being synonyms (N. B. This opinion of the Kasika-author is not in harmony with that of Patanjali, who does not read the anuvritti of अतः into this sutra. According to him गौशकटिक is formed from गोशकटी; and एकविंशति &c, do not take this affix, because it is against usage. But the author of Kasika says—अवश्यं चात इत्यनुवर्त्यम्; द्वन्द्वापतोपगर्ह्यात् इत्येवमाद्यर्थम् -- the anuvritti of अतः must surely be read, for the sake of sutras like [[5.2.128]], though in the sutras, like वातातिसाराभ्यां &c there is no necessity of reading the anuvritti of अतः) The word नित्यम् 'always', is used in the sutra to indicate that मतुप् does not come in the alternative. In all the previous sutras मतुप् came in the alternative. How do you form एकद्रव्यवत् in एकद्रव्यवत्वाद् ? This is not a correct form; or it may be said to be a compound of एक and द्रव्यवत्वात्

pk: The aril Wan cones in the sense or natup arter the words 1. sata and 2. sahasra when they rolow arter niska Thus niskasatanasyasti = nEskasatika, nEskasahasrika But not so arter suvarnaniskasatan, it being never so round in usage.
ck: the aril tan cones in the sense or natup arter the torts 1. sata ant 2. sahasra then they rolot arter niska thus niskasatanasyasti = nEskasatika, nEskasahasrika put not so arter suvarnaniskasatan, it peink never so rount in usake.
s: The affix ठञ् comes in the sense of मतुप् after the words 1. शत and 2. सहस्र when they follow after निष्क Thus निष्कशतमस्यास्ति = नैष्कशतिकः, नैष्कसहस्रिकः But not so after सुवर्णनिष्कशतं, it being never so found in usage.

pk: The aril yap cones in the sense or natup arter the word rupa when stanping (coining) or praise is denoted. Thus ahatan rupanasya = rupyo dinara a Dinara having stanped on it the rorn or sone king &c. rupya kedara, rupyan karsapanan. sinilarly prasastan rupanasyasti = rupya purusa a lovely person. The rorn inpresed on a dinar &c by hanering &c, is caled ahata or stanping. Why do we say when stanping or praise is denoted ? Observe rupavan having rorn. Vart:- The aril yap is sen arter other words also, as hinya parvata, gunya brahnana
ck: the aril yap cones in the sense or natup arter the tort rupa then stanpink (coinink) or praise is tenotet. thus ahatan rupanasya = rupyo tinara a tinara havink stanpet on it the rorn or sone kink &c. rupya ketara, rupyan karsapanan. sinilarly prasastan rupanasyasti = rupya purusa a lovely person. the rorn inpreset on a tinar &c py hanerink &c, is calet ahata or stanpink. thy to te say then stanpink or praise is tenotet ? Opserve rupavan havink rorn. Vart:- the aril yap is sen arter other torts also, as hinya parvata, kunya prahnana
s: The affix यप् comes in the sense of मतुप् after the word रूप when 'stamping (coining)' or 'praise' is denoted. Thus आहतं रूपमस्य = रूप्यो दीनारः 'a Dinara having stamped on it the form of some king &c'. रूप्यः केदारः, रूप्यं कार्षापणम्. Similarly प्रशस्तं रूपमस्यास्ति = रूप्यः पुरुषः 'a lovely person'. The form impressed on a dinar &c by hammering &c, is called आहत or stamping. Why do we say 'when stamping or praise is denoted ?' Observe रूपवान् 'having form'. Vart:- The affix यप् is seen after other words also, as हिम्याः पर्वताः, गुण्या ब्राह्मणाः

pk: arter a sten ending in as and arter naya , neDa and sraj cones the aril vini in the sense or natup Thus payas-payasvin, yasas-yasasvin nayavin, neDavin, sragvin The word naya being included in vrihyadi clas, wil take ini, and Wan also [5.2.16]. as nayi, nayika
ck: arter a sten entink in as ant arter naya , neta ant srac cones the aril vini in the sense or natup thus payas-payasvin, yasas-yasasvin nayavin, netavin, srakvin the tort naya peink inclutet in vrihyati clas, til take ini, ant tan also [5.2.16]. as nayi, nayika
s: After a stem ending in अस् and after माया , मेधा and स्रज् comes the affix विनि in the sense of मतुप् Thus पयस्-पयस्विन्, यशस्-यशस्विन् मायाविन्, मेधाविन्, स्रग्विन् The word माया being included in व्रीह्यादि class, will take इनि, and ठञ् also [[5.2.116]]. As मायी, मायिकः

pk: in the Candas (Vedas) the aril vini is aded diversely in the sense or natup as agne tejasvin sonetines it is not aded, as suryo varcasvan Vart:- in the Chandas, the rinals a or iya, uBaya and hrdaya is lengthened optionaly berore vini; and it cones arter aswra, neKala and ruja also : as aswravi, neKalavi, iyavi, uBayavi, rujavi, hrdayavi Vart:- so also arter narna, as narnavi Vart:- always arter anaya, in the sacred as wel as secular literature. as anayavi Vart:- The aril arakan cones arter srnga and vrnda; as sr꣡ngaraka, vr꣡ndaraka Vart:- The aril inac cones arter Pala and barha, as Palina꣡ and barhina꣡ Vart:- so also arter hrdaya; the aril calu cones optionaly: as, hrdayalu, hrdayi, hrdayika, hrdayavan The c is it by [1.3.7]. Vart:- The aril aluc cones arter sita, usna, and trpa, in the sense or not being able to bear that. as sitan na sahate = sitalu shivering ron cold. usnalu, trpalu Vart:- so also arter hina cones the aril elu in the above sense: as hinan na sahate = hinelu Vart:- The aril uluc in the sane sense arter bala; as balan na sahate = balula Vart:- so also arter vata; as vatanan sanuha, or vatan na sahate = vatula Vart:- The aril tan cones arter parva and narut. as pa꣡rvata and na꣡ruta Vart:- The aril ini cones arter arTa in the sense or not having that as arTi a begar, who has not artha or wealth. Otherwise arTavan rich. al these are obtained by bahula
ck: in the cantas (Vetas) the aril vini is atet tiversely in the sense or natup as akne tecasvin sonetines it is not atet, as suryo varcasvan Vart:- in the chantas, the rinals a or iya, upaya ant hrtaya is lenkthenet optionaly perore vini; ant it cones arter astra, nekala ant ruca also : as astravi, nekalavi, iyavi, upayavi, rucavi, hrtayavi Vart:- so also arter narna, as narnavi Vart:- altays arter anaya, in the sacret as tel as secular literature. as anayavi Vart:- the aril arakan cones arter srnka ant vrnta; as sr꣡nkaraka, vr꣡ntaraka Vart:- the aril inac cones arter pala ant parha, as palina꣡ ant parhina꣡ Vart:- so also arter hrtaya; the aril calu cones optionaly: as, hrtayalu, hrtayi, hrtayika, hrtayavan the c is it py [1.3.7]. Vart:- the aril aluc cones arter sita, usna, ant trpa, in the sense or not peink aple to pear that. as sitan na sahate = sitalu shiverink ron colt. usnalu, trpalu Vart:- so also arter hina cones the aril elu in the apove sense: as hinan na sahate = hinelu Vart:- the aril uluc in the sane sense arter pala; as palan na sahate = palula Vart:- so also arter vata; as vatanan sanuha, or vatan na sahate = vatula Vart:- the aril tan cones arter parva ant narut. as pa꣡rvata ant na꣡ruta Vart:- the aril ini cones arter arta in the sense or not havink that as arti a pekar, tho has not artha or tealth. Othertise artavan rich. al these are optainet py pahula
s: In the छन्दस् (Vedas) the affix विनि is added diversely in the sense of मतुप् As अग्ने तेजस्विन् Sometimes it is not added, as सूर्यो वर्चस्वान् Vart:- In the Chhandas, the finals अ of इय, उभय and हृदय is lengthened optionally before विनि; and it comes after अष्ट्रा, मेखला and रुजा also : as अष्ट्रावी, मेखलावी, इयावी, उभयावी, रुजावी, हृदयावी Vart:- So also after मर्म, as मर्मावी Vart:- Always after आमय, in the sacred as well as secular literature. As आमयावी Vart:- The affix आरकन् comes after शृङ्ग and वृन्द; as शृ꣡ङ्गारकः, वृ꣡न्दारकः Vart:- The affix इनच् comes after फल and बर्ह, as फलिनः꣡ and बर्हिणः꣡ Vart:- So also after हृदय; the affix चालु comes optionally: as, हृदयालुः, हृदयी, हृदयिकः, हृदयवान् The च् is इत् by [[1.3.7]]. Vart:- The affix आलुच् comes after शीत, उष्ण, and तृप, in the sense of not being able to bear that. As शीतं न सहते = शीतालुः 'shivering from cold'. उष्णालुः, तृपालुः Vart:- So also after हिम comes the affix एलु in the above sense: as हिमं न सहते = हिमेलुः Vart:- The affix ऊलुच् in the same sense after बल; as बलं न सहते = बलूलः Vart:- So also after वात; as वातानां समूहः, or वातं न सहते = वातूलः Vart:- The affix तन् comes after पर्व and मरुत्. As प꣡र्वतः and म꣡रुत्तः Vart:- The affix इनि comes after अर्थ in the sense of 'not having that' as अर्थी 'a beggar, who has not artha or wealth'. Otherwise अर्थवान् 'rich'. All these are obtained by बहुलः

pk: The aril yus is aded to urna in the sense or natup in the Candas (Vedas). The s or yus nakes the word urna a pada [1.4.16]; the result or which is that rules aplicable to Ba Bha do not aply; e. g. [6.1.148], by which the rinal i or i, a or a is elided. Thus urnayu acording to sone; Candasi is to be read in this sutra. The author or sidhanta Kaunudi says that this is reasonable; ror ir yus is aded to urna in secular literature also, then there was no necesity or this sutra. The word urna could have ben read along with ahan and subhan in [5.2.140].
ck: the aril yus is atet to urna in the sense or natup in the cantas (Vetas). the s or yus nakes the tort urna a pata [1.4.16]; the result or thich is that rules aplicaple to pa pha to not aply; e. k. [6.1.148], py thich the rinal i or i, a or a is elitet. thus urnayu acortink to sone; cantasi is to pe reat in this sutra. the author or sithanta kaunuti says that this is reasonaple; ror ir yus is atet to urna in secular literature also, then there tas no necesity or this sutra. the tort urna coult have pen reat alonk tith ahan ant suphan in [5.2.140].
s: The affix युस् is added to ऊर्णा in the sense of मतुप् in the छन्दस् (Vedas). The स् of युस् makes the word ऊर्णा a पद [[1.4.16]]; the result of which is that rules applicable to भ Bha do not apply; e. g. [[6.1.148]], by which the final इ or ई, अ or आ is elided. Thus ऊर्णायुः According to some; छन्दसि is to be read in this sutra. The author of Siddhanta Kaumudi says that this is reasonable; for if yus is added to urna in secular literature also, then there was no necessity of this sutra. The word urna could have been read along with aham and subham in [[5.2.140]].

pk: The aril gnini cone in the sense or natup arter the word vac Thus vagni, vagninO, vagnina. The aril is not nin, ror had it ben so, the rorn would have ben vanin by [8.4.45] Vart.
ck: the aril knini cone in the sense or natup arter the tort vac thus vakni, vakninO, vaknina. the aril is not nin, ror hat it pen so, the rorn toult have pen vanin py [8.4.45] Vart.
s: The affix ग्मिनि come in the sense of मतुप् after the word वाच् Thus वाग्मी, वाग्मिनौ, वाग्मिनः. The affix is not मिन्, for had it been so, the form would have been वाङ्मिन् by [[8.4.45]] Vart.

pk: The ariles alac and awac cone in the sense or natup arter vac , the word denoting a talkative. This debars gnin Thus vacala garulous, vacawa Vart:- These ariles cone when contenpt is elpresed. an orator (vagni) also talks nuch, but to the purpose. e wil not be caled vacala or vacawa
ck: the ariles alac ant atac cone in the sense or natup arter vac , the tort tenotink a talkative. this tepars knin thus vacala karulous, vacata Vart:- these ariles cone then contenpt is elpreset. an orator (vakni) also talks nuch, put to the purpose. e til not pe calet vacala or vacata
s: The affixes आलच् and आटच् come in the sense of मतुप् after वाच् , the word denoting 'a talkative'. This debars ग्मिन् Thus वाचालः 'garrulous', वाचाटः Vart:- These affixes come when contempt is expressed. An orator (वाग्मी) also talks much, but to the purpose. He will not be called वाचालः or वाचाटः

pk: The iregularly rorned word svanin denotes sir or Lord. The aril anin cones in the sense or lordship arter the word sva Thus svanasyasti = Esvaryanasyasti = svanin Why do we say when neaning sir. Observe, svavan
ck: the irekularly rornet tort svanin tenotes sir or Lort. the aril anin cones in the sense or lortship arter the tort sva thus svanasyasti = Esvaryanasyasti = svanin thy to te say then neanink sir. Opserve, svavan
s: The irregularly formed word स्वामिन् denotes 'Sir or Lord'. The affix आमिन् comes in the sense of lordship after the word स्व Thus स्वमस्यास्ति = ऐश्वर्यमस्यास्ति = स्वामिन् Why do we say when meaning 'Sir'. Observe, स्ववान्

pk: The aril ac cones in the sense or natup arter the words arsa etc. Thus arsosi asya vidyante = arsasa urasa &c. arter a word denoting a nenber or the body cones the aril ac, when derect is neant. as Kanja padosyasti = Kanja, kana so also arter words denoting color, as suklosyasti = sukla pawa 1 arsas, 2 uras, 3 tunda, 4 catura, 5 palita, 6 jawa, 7 Gawa, 8 Gawa, 9 aGa (aBra), 10 kardana, 1 anla (ana), 12 lavana, 13 svangadDinat, 14 varnat akrtigana
ck: the aril ac cones in the sense or natup arter the torts arsa etc. thus arsosi asya vityante = arsasa urasa &c. arter a tort tenotink a nenper or the poty cones the aril ac, then terect is neant. as kanca patosyasti = kanca, kana so also arter torts tenotink color, as suklosyasti = sukla pata 1 arsas, 2 uras, 3 tunta, 4 catura, 5 palita, 6 cata, 7 kata, 8 kata, 9 aka (apra), 10 kartana, 1 anla (ana), 12 lavana, 13 svankatinat, 14 varnat akrtikana
s: The affix अच् comes in the sense of मतुप् after the words अर्श etc. Thus अर्शोसि अस्य विद्यन्ते = अर्शसः उरसः &c. After a word denoting a member of the body comes the affix अच्, when defect is meant. As खञ्जः पादोस्यास्ति = खञ्जः, काणः So also after words denoting color, as शुक्लोऽस्यास्ति = शुक्लः पटः 1 अर्शस्, 2 उरस्, 3 तुन्द, 4 चतुर, 5 पलित, 6 जटा, 7 घटा, 8 घाटा, 9 अघ (अभ्र), 10 कर्दम, 11 अम्ल (आम), 12 लवण, 13 स्वाङ्गाद्धीनात्, 14 वर्णात् आकृतिगण

pk: The aril ini (in) cones in the sense or natup arter a dvanda conpound arter the nane or a disease and arter anything denoting rault when the thing is round in a living being. Thus Dvandva:- kawakavalayini a wonan having a bracelet and a sone, sanKanupurini a wonan having sankha and nupur ornanents. so arter diseases: kusWi a leper, kilasi a white leper. so arter nanes or raults:- kakudavarti, kakataluki Why do we say when round in a living being ? Observe puspaPalavan vrksa The aril, acording to a Vartika, does not cone arter words denoting nenbers or a living body: as, panipadavati The word ata [5.2.15], is understod in this sutra, so that the aril does not cone arter words not ending in a; as citrakalalawikavati Though Dvandva conpounds &c. ending in a, would have taken ini by [5.2.15], the repetition or this aril in the present sutra shows that Dvandva conpounds &c, take only ini, and not Wan &c.
ck: the aril ini (in) cones in the sense or natup arter a tvanta conpount arter the nane or a tisease ant arter anythink tenotink rault then the think is rount in a livink peink. thus tvantva:- katakavalayini a tonan havink a pracelet ant a sone, sankanupurini a tonan havink sankha ant nupur ornanents. so arter tiseases: kusti a leper, kilasi a thite leper. so arter nanes or raults:- kakutavarti, kakataluki thy to te say then rount in a livink peink ? Opserve puspapalavan vrksa the aril, acortink to a Vartika, toes not cone arter torts tenotink nenpers or a livink poty: as, panipatavati the tort ata [5.2.15], is unterstot in this sutra, so that the aril toes not cone arter torts not entink in a; as citrakalalatikavati thoukh tvantva conpounts &c. entink in a, toult have taken ini py [5.2.15], the repetition or this aril in the present sutra shots that tvantva conpounts &c, take only ini, ant not tan &c.
s: The affix इनि (इन्) comes in the sense of मतुप् after a द्वन्द compound after the name of a disease and after anything denoting fault when the thing is found in a living being. Thus Dvandva:-- कटकवलयिनी 'a woman having a bracelet and a zone', शङ्खनूपुरिणी 'a woman having sankha and nupur ornaments'. So after diseases: कुष्ठी 'a leper', किलासी 'a white leper'. So after names of faults:- ककुदावर्ती, काकतालुकी Why do we say 'when found in a living being ?' Observe पुष्पफलवान् वृक्षः The affix, according to a Vartika, does not come after words denoting members of a living body: as, पाणिपादवती The word अतः [[5.2.115]], is understood in this sutra, so that the affix does not come after words not ending in अ; as चित्रकललाटिकावती Though Dvandva compounds &c. ending in अ, would have taken इनि by [[5.2.115]], the repetition of this affix in the present sutra shows that Dvandva compounds &c, take only इनि, and not ठन् &c.

pk: The augnent kuk cones berore ini (in) arter the words 1. vata and 2. atisara The words vata and atisara being nanes or diseases, wil take ini by the rore-going sutra; the present aphorisn only teaches the ariling or the augnent. Thus vataki, atisaraki another reading is atisaraki Vart:- so also arter pisaca, as pisacaki vEsravana the Kubera. This is when the words vata and atisara denote diseases. Otherwise, vatavati guha
ck: the auknent kuk cones perore ini (in) arter the torts 1. vata ant 2. atisara the torts vata ant atisara peink nanes or tiseases, til take ini py the rore-koink sutra; the present aphorisn only teaches the arilink or the auknent. thus vataki, atisaraki another reatink is atisaraki Vart:- so also arter pisaca, as pisacaki vEsravana the kupera. this is then the torts vata ant atisara tenote tiseases. Othertise, vatavati kuha
s: The augment कुक् comes before इनि (इन्) after the words 1. वात and 2. अतिसार The words वात and अतिसार being names of diseases, will take इनि by the fore-going sutra; the present aphorism only teaches the affixing of the augment. Thus वातकी, अतिसारकी Another reading is अतीसारकी Vart:- So also after पिशाच, as पिशाचकी वैश्रवणः 'the Kubera'. This is when the words वात and अतिसार denote diseases. Otherwise, वातवती गुहा

pk: The aril ini (in) cones in the sense or natup arter an ordinal nuneral when age is denoted. Thus pancanosyasti nasa sanvatsaro va = pancanin rive nonths or years old, as pancani uswra sinilarly navani, dasani &c. By [5.2.15] the aril ini would have cone arter these words; the present sutra is a restrictive rule teaching that Wan does not cone in this sense. Why do we say vayasi when age is denoted? Observe, pancanavan granaraga
ck: the aril ini (in) cones in the sense or natup arter an ortinal nuneral then ake is tenotet. thus pancanosyasti nasa sanvatsaro va = pancanin rive nonths or years olt, as pancani ustra sinilarly navani, tasani &c. py [5.2.15] the aril ini toult have cone arter these torts; the present sutra is a restrictive rule teachink that tan toes not cone in this sense. thy to te say vayasi then ake is tenotet? Opserve, pancanavan kranaraka
s: The affix इनि (इन्) comes in the sense of मतुप् after an ordinal numeral when age is denoted. Thus पञ्चमोऽस्यास्ति मासः संवत्सरो वा = पंचमिन् 'five months or years old', as पंचमी उष्ट्रः Similarly नवमी, दशमी &c. By [[5.2.115]] the affix इनि would have come after these words; the present sutra is a restrictive rule teaching that ठन् does not come in this sense. Why do we say वयसि 'when age is denoted'? Observe, पंचमवान् ग्रामरागः

pk: The aril ini (in) cones (to the elclusion or other ariles) in the sense or natup arter the words suKa etc. Thus suKin non. suKi; duKin &c. When censure is inplied, then in cones arter nala, to the elclusion or natup, as nali The rolowing is the list or suKadi word:- 1 suKa, 2 duKa, 3 trpta, 4 krcCa, 5 asra (anra), 6 asra, 7 alika, 8 karuna (karuna) 9 soQa, 10 pratipa (pranipa), 1 sila,12 hala, 13 nala ksepe, 14 krpana, 15 pranaya (pranaya) 16 vala, 17 kaksa
ck: the aril ini (in) cones (to the elclusion or other ariles) in the sense or natup arter the torts suka etc. thus sukin non. suki; tukin &c. then censure is inpliet, then in cones arter nala, to the elclusion or natup, as nali the rolotink is the list or sukati tort:- 1 suka, 2 tuka, 3 trpta, 4 krca, 5 asra (anra), 6 asra, 7 alika, 8 karuna (karuna) 9 sota, 10 pratipa (pranipa), 1 sila,12 hala, 13 nala ksepe, 14 krpana, 15 pranaya (pranaya) 16 vala, 17 kaksa
s: The affix इनि (इन्) comes (to the exclusion of other affixes) in the sense of मतुप् after the words सुख etc. Thus सुखिन् nom. सुखी; दुःखिन् &c. When censure is implied, then इन् comes after माला, to the exclusion of मतुप्, as माली The following is the list of सुखादि word:- 1 सुख, 2 दुःख, 3 तृप्त, 4 कृच्छ, 5 आश्र (आम्र), 6 अस्र, 7 अलीक, 8 करुण (करुणा) 9 सोढ, 10 प्रतीप (प्रमीप), 11 शील,12 हल, 13 माला क्षेपे, 14 कृपण, 15 प्रणय (प्रणाय) 16 वल, 17 कक्ष

pk: The aril ini (in) cones in the sense or natup (to the elclusion or others) arter noninal steps ending in 1. Darna 2. sila 3. varna Thus brahnananan Darna = brahnanaDarna, sosyasti = brahnanaDarni brahnanasilin, brahnanavarnin
ck: the aril ini (in) cones in the sense or natup (to the elclusion or others) arter noninal steps entink in 1. tarna 2. sila 3. varna thus prahnananan tarna = prahnanatarna, sosyasti = prahnanatarni prahnanasilin, prahnanavarnin
s: The affix इनि (इन्) comes in the sense of मतुप् (to the exclusion of others) after nominal steps ending in 1. धर्म 2. शील 3. वर्ण Thus ब्राह्मणानां धर्मः = ब्राह्मणधर्मः, सोऽस्यास्ति = ब्राह्मणधर्मी ब्राह्मणशीलिन्, ब्राह्मणवर्णिन्

pk: The aril ini (in) cones in the sense or natup arter the word hasta when a genus is denoted by the word so rorned. Thus hastosyasti = hastin elephant. Why do we say when neaning a jati a genus ? Observe hastavan purusa
ck: the aril ini (in) cones in the sense or natup arter the tort hasta then a kenus is tenotet py the tort so rornet. thus hastosyasti = hastin elephant. thy to te say then neanink a cati a kenus ? Opserve hastavan purusa
s: The affix इनि (इन्) comes in the sense of मतुप् after the word हस्त when a genus is denoted by the word so formed. Thus हस्तोऽस्यास्ति = हस्तिन् 'elephant'. Why do we say when meaning a जाति 'a genus' ? Observe हस्तवान् पुरुषः

pk: The aril ini (in) cones in the sense or natup arter the word varna when the word so rorned neans a brahnacarin Thus varnin a Brahnachari. The rirst thre varna or castes, who are entitled to the investiture with sacred thread, and lead the lire or a Brahna student are so caled. When the neaning is not or Brahnachari we have varnavan
ck: the aril ini (in) cones in the sense or natup arter the tort varna then the tort so rornet neans a prahnacarin thus varnin a prahnachari. the rirst thre varna or castes, tho are entitlet to the investiture tith sacret threat, ant leat the lire or a prahna stutent are so calet. then the neanink is not or prahnachari te have varnavan
s: The affix इनि (इन्) comes in the sense of मतुप् after the word वर्ण when the word so formed means a ब्रह्मचारिण् Thus वर्णिन् 'a Brahmachari'. The first three वर्ण or castes, who are entitled to the investiture with sacred thread, and lead the life of a Brahma student are so called. When the meaning is not of Brahmachari we have वर्णवान्

pk: The aril ini (in) cones in the sense or natup arter the words puskara etc. when the word so rorned denotes a locality. Thus puskarini a tank", padnini &c. Why do we say when locality is elpresed? Observe puskaravan hasti Vart:- The aril in cones arter bala preceded by bahu or uru, as bahubalin urubalin Vart:- so also arter words preceded by sarva; as, sarvaDanin, sarvabijin, sarvakesi nawa Vart:- so also arter arTa when neaning not near; as arTin neaning arTosanihitosya distant ron wealth. Otherwise arTavan having wealth. Vart:- so also arter a conpound ending in arTa, as DanyarTi, hiranyarTi 1 puskara, 2 padna, 3 utpala, 4 tanala, 5 kunuda, 6 naqa, 7 kapitTa, 8 bisa, 9 nrnala, 10 kardana, 1 saluka, 12 vigarha, 13 karisa, 14 sirisa, 15 yavasa, 16 pravaha (pravasa), 17 hiranya, 18 kErava, 19 kalola, 20 tawa, 21 taranga, 2 pankaja, 23 saroja, 24 rajiva, 25 nalika, 26 saroruha, 27 puwaka, 28 aravinda, 29 anBoja, 30 abja, 31 kanala, 32 payas, 3 vayasa
ck: the aril ini (in) cones in the sense or natup arter the torts puskara etc. then the tort so rornet tenotes a locality. thus puskarini a tank", patnini &c. thy to te say then locality is elpreset? Opserve puskaravan hasti Vart:- the aril in cones arter pala precetet py pahu or uru, as pahupalin urupalin Vart:- so also arter torts precetet py sarva; as, sarvatanin, sarvapicin, sarvakesi nata Vart:- so also arter arta then neanink not near; as artin neanink artosanihitosya tistant ron tealth. Othertise artavan havink tealth. Vart:- so also arter a conpount entink in arta, as tanyarti, hiranyarti 1 puskara, 2 patna, 3 utpala, 4 tanala, 5 kunuta, 6 nata, 7 kapita, 8 pisa, 9 nrnala, 10 kartana, 1 saluka, 12 vikarha, 13 karisa, 14 sirisa, 15 yavasa, 16 pravaha (pravasa), 17 hiranya, 18 kErava, 19 kalola, 20 tata, 21 taranka, 2 pankaca, 23 saroca, 24 raciva, 25 nalika, 26 saroruha, 27 putaka, 28 aravinta, 29 anpoca, 30 apca, 31 kanala, 32 payas, 3 vayasa
s: The affix इनि (इन्) comes in the sense of मतुप् after the words पुष्कर etc. when the word so formed denotes a locality. Thus पुष्करिणी 'a tank", पद्मिनी &c. Why do we say when 'locality' is expressed? Observe पुष्करवान् हस्ती Vart:- The affix इन् comes after बल preceded by बाहु or ऊरु, as बहुबलिन् ऊरुबलिन् Vart:- So also after words preceded by सर्व; as, सर्वधनिन्, सर्वबीजिन्, सर्वकेशी नटः Vart:- So also after अर्थ when meaning 'not near'; as अर्थिन् meaning अर्थोऽसंनिहितोऽस्य 'distant from wealth'. Otherwise अर्थवान् 'having wealth'. Vart:- So also after a compound ending in अर्थ, as धान्यार्थी, हिरण्यार्थी 1 पुष्कर, 2 पद्म, 3 उत्पल, 4 तमाल, 5 कुमुद, 6 नड, 7 कपित्थ, 8 बिस, 9 मृणाल, 10 कर्दम, 11 शालूक, 12 विगर्ह, 13 करीष, 14 शिरीष, 15 यवास, 16 प्रवाह (प्रवास), 17 हिरण्य, 18 कैरव, 19 कल्लोल, 20 तट, 21 तरंग, 22 पङ्कज, 23 सरोज, 24 राजीव, 25 नालीक, 26 सरोरुह, 27 पुटक, 28 अरविन्द, 29 अम्भोज, 30 अब्ज, 31 कमल, 32 पयस्, 33 वयस

pk: The ariles natup and ini cone arter the pratipadika (noninal stens) bala etc. The aril ini wil cone in the alternative. Thus balavan or bali (v.balin); utsahavan or utsahi (v. utsahin) 1 bala, 2 utsaha, 3 udBasa (udBava), 4 udvasa, 5 udasa, 6 siKa, 7 kula, 8 cuqa, 9 sula, 10 kula, 1 ayana, 12 vyayana, 13 upayana, 14 aroha, 15 avaroha, 16 parinaha, 17 yudDa, 18 udvana, 19 siKabala, 20 vuganula, 21 vansa
ck: the ariles natup ant ini cone arter the pratipatika (noninal stens) pala etc. the aril ini til cone in the alternative. thus palavan or pali (v.palin); utsahavan or utsahi (v. utsahin) 1 pala, 2 utsaha, 3 utpasa (utpava), 4 utvasa, 5 utasa, 6 sika, 7 kula, 8 cuta, 9 sula, 10 kula, 1 ayana, 12 vyayana, 13 upayana, 14 aroha, 15 avaroha, 16 parinaha, 17 yuta, 18 utvana, 19 sikapala, 20 vukanula, 21 vansa
s: The affixes मतुप् and इनि come after the प्रातिपदिक (Nominal Stems) बल etc. The affix इनि will come in the alternative. Thus बलवान् or बली (v.बलिन्); उत्साहवान् or उत्साही (v. उत्साहिन्) 1 बल, 2 उत्साह, 3 उद्भास (उद्भाव), 4 उद्वास, 5 उद्दास, 6 शिखा, 7 कुल, 8 चूडा, 9 सुल, 10 कूल, 11 आयाम, 12 व्यायाम, 13 उपयाम, 14 आरोह, 15 अवरोह, 16 परिणाह, 17 युद्ध, 18 उद्वाम, 19 शिखाबल, 20 वूगमूल, 21 वंश

pk: The aril ini (in) cones in the sense or natup arter a pratipadika (noninal sten) ending in nan or na when the whole word so rorned neans a nane. Thus praTinan + ini = praTin + in [6.4.14] = praTinin ren. praTinini so also danini sinilarly hona, honini, sonini Why do we say, when neaning a nane? Observe, sonavan, honavan
ck: the aril ini (in) cones in the sense or natup arter a pratipatika (noninal sten) entink in nan or na then the thole tort so rornet neans a nane. thus pratinan + ini = pratin + in [6.4.14] = pratinin ren. pratinini so also tanini sinilarly hona, honini, sonini thy to te say, then neanink a nane? Opserve, sonavan, honavan
s: The affix इनि (इन्) comes in the sense of मतुप् after a प्रातिपदिक (Nominal Stem) ending in मन् or म when the whole word so formed means a Name. Thus प्रथिमन् + इनि = प्रथिम् + इन् [[6.4.144]] = प्रथिमिन् fem. प्रथिमिनी So also दामिनी Similarly होम, होमिनी, सोमिनी Why do we say, 'when meaning a name'? Observe, सोमवान्, होमवान्

pk: The seven ariles 1. ba 2. Ba 3. yus 4. ti 5. tu 6. ta and 7. yas cones in the sense or natup arter kan water and hapines and san hapines. Thus kanba, kanBa, kanyu, kanti, kantu, kanta, kanya, sanba, sanBa, sanyu, santi, santu, santa, sanya The s in yus and yas, nake the sten, a Pada (1.4.16), the result or which is that n or kan and san is changed into anusvara berore these two ariles by [8.3.23]. When denoting a nane, the rorns wil be kanya and sanya
ck: the seven ariles 1. pa 2. pa 3. yus 4. ti 5. tu 6. ta ant 7. yas cones in the sense or natup arter kan tater ant hapines ant san hapines. thus kanpa, kanpa, kanyu, kanti, kantu, kanta, kanya, sanpa, sanpa, sanyu, santi, santu, santa, sanya the s in yus ant yas, nake the sten, a pata (1.4.16), the result or thich is that n or kan ant san is chanket into anusvara perore these to ariles py [8.3.23]. then tenotink a nane, the rorns til pe kanya ant sanya
s: The seven affixes 1. ब 2. भ 3. युस् 4. ति 5. तु 6. त and 7. यस् comes in the sense of मतुप् after कम् 'water and happiness' and शम् 'happiness'. Thus कम्बः, कम्भः, कंयुः, कन्तिः, कन्तुः, कन्तः, कंयः, शम्बः, शम्भः, शंयुः, शन्तिः, शन्तुः, शन्तः, शंयः The स् in युस् and यस्, make the stem, a Pada (1.4.16), the result of which is that म् of कम् and शम् is changed into Anusvara before these two affixes by [[8.3.23]]. When denoting a Name, the forms will be कम्यः and शम्यः

pk: The aril Ba cones in the sense or natup arter 1. tundi 2. vali and 3. vawi Thus tundina having a protuberent bely. baliBa and vawiBa another rorn is baliBa, because bali is included in the Panadi clas [5.2.10]. The rorns tundila &c, are valid by [5.2.17].
ck: the aril pa cones in the sense or natup arter 1. tunti 2. vali ant 3. vati thus tuntina havink a protuperent pely. palipa ant vatipa another rorn is palipa, pecause pali is inclutet in the panati clas [5.2.10]. the rorns tuntila &c, are valit py [5.2.17].
s: The affix भ comes in the sense of मतुप् after 1. तुन्दि 2. वलि and 3. वटि Thus तुन्दिनः 'having a protuberent belly'. बलिभः and वटिभः Another form is बलिभः, because बलि is included in the Pamadi class [[5.2.100]]. The forms तुन्दिलः &c, are valid by [[5.2.117]].

pk: The sūtra taught ron this rorward up to diksabdeBya saptanipancanipraTanaByo digdesakalesvastati [5.3.27] (elclusive) are caled viBakti The ariles herein taught do not change the sense or the word, i.e. they are svarDa ariles which leave to the word their own denotation. The rule [4.1.82], eltends no rurther than this, hence the words rorned by these ariles do not produce epithets conoting the sense or the prinitive and denoting sonething else. Thus [5.3.7] declares, that arter the words kin in the ablative there is the aril tasil, as kuta, tata, yata The purpose served by designating these ariles as Vibhakti is (a) to debar the elision or rinal s and n or the ariles as it (1.3. 4). Thus in the aril danin [5.3.18], n is not it, had it ben so, rule [1.1.47] would have aplied: (b) to regulate the acent or idan, thus idan + tasil = ita here by [6.1.171], the aril tasil becones udata by virtue or its being Vibhakti, othewise the acent would have ben regulated by the indicatory l [6.1.193]; (c) to nake aplicable to these words the rules or tyadadi, that is, the rules given in the sutras [7.2.102], and those that rolow. Thus tyad + tasil = tyata, the da being replaced by a by [7.2.102]. The ariles now to be taught being svarTika, the anuvriti or sanarTanan and praTanad or [4.1.82], does not aply to then. The word va or [4.1.82] however aplies here, so that these ariles are optional, thus we nay have kuta or kasnat, kutra or kasnin
ck: the sūtra taukht ron this rortart up to tiksaptepya saptanipancanipratanapyo tiktesakalesvastati [5.3.27] (elclusive) are calet vipakti the ariles herein taukht to not chanke the sense or the tort, i.e. they are svarta ariles thich leave to the tort their otn tenotation. the rule [4.1.82], eltents no rurther than this, hence the torts rornet py these ariles to not protuce epithets conotink the sense or the prinitive ant tenotink sonethink else. thus [5.3.7] teclares, that arter the torts kin in the aplative there is the aril tasil, as kuta, tata, yata the purpose servet py tesiknatink these ariles as Viphakti is (a) to tepar the elision or rinal s ant n or the ariles as it (1.3. 4). thus in the aril tanin [5.3.18], n is not it, hat it pen so, rule [1.1.47] toult have apliet: (p) to rekulate the acent or itan, thus itan + tasil = ita here py [6.1.171], the aril tasil pecones utata py virtue or its peink Viphakti, othetise the acent toult have pen rekulatet py the inticatory l [6.1.193]; (c) to nake aplicaple to these torts the rules or tyatati, that is, the rules kiven in the sutras [7.2.102], ant those that rolot. thus tyat + tasil = tyata, the ta peink replacet py a py [7.2.102]. the ariles not to pe taukht peink svartika, the anuvriti or sanartanan ant pratanat or [4.1.82], toes not aply to then. the tort va or [4.1.82] hotever aplies here, so that these ariles are optional, thus te nay have kuta or kasnat, kutra or kasnin
s: The sūtra taught from this forward up to दिक्शब्देभ्यः सप्तमीपञ्चमीप्रथमाभ्यो दिग्देशकालेष्वस्तातिः [[5.3.27]] (exclusive) are called विभक्ति The affixes herein taught do not change the sense of the word, i.e. they are स्वार्ध affixes which leave to the word their own denotation. The rule [[4.1.82]], extends no further than this, hence the words formed by these affixes do not produce epithets connoting the sense of the primitive and denoting something else.
