Thus [[5.3.7]] declares, that after the words किम् in the ablative there is the affix तसिल्, as कुतः, ततः, यतः The purpose served by designating these affixes as Vibhakti is (a) to debar the elision of final स् and म् of the affixes as इत् (1.3. 4). Thus in the affix दानीम् [[5.3.18]], म् is not इत्, had it been so, rule [[1.1.47]] would have applied: (b) to regulate the accent of इदम्, thus इदम् + तसिल् = इतः here by [[6.1.171]], the affix तसिल् becomes udatta by virtue of its being Vibhakti, othewise the accent would have been regulated by the indicatory ल् [[6.1.193]]; (c) to make applicable to these words the rules of त्यदादि, that is, the rules given in the Sutras [[7.2.102]], and those that follow. Thus त्यद् + तसिल् = त्यतः, the द being replaced by अ by [[7.2.102]]. The affixes now to be taught being स्वार्थिकः, the anuvritti of समर्थानाम् and प्रथमाद् of [[4.1.82]], does not apply to them. The word वा of [[4.1.82]] however applies here, so that these affixes are optional, thus we may have कुतः or कस्मात्, कुत्र or कस्मिन्

pk: These pragdisiya ariles cone arter the word kin and arter a sten caled sarvanana and arter bahu but not arter dvi etc. The words dvi &c, though sarvanana are elenpted. Thus kutra, krta, yata, yatra, bahuta, bahutra Why do we say advyadi not dvi &c. Observe dvaByan, dvayo Why do we say kin &c ? Observe vrksat, vrksan &c. The word kin is a sarvanana, but it being included in the dyadi clas, would have ben elenpted ron the operation or this rule had it not ben separately nentioned. Vart:- The word bahu here is a sankhya. Thererore, the aril does not aply here, baho supat, bahO supe
ck: these praktisiya ariles cone arter the tort kin ant arter a sten calet sarvanana ant arter pahu put not arter tvi etc. the torts tvi &c, thoukh sarvanana are elenptet. thus kutra, krta, yata, yatra, pahuta, pahutra thy to te say atvyati not tvi &c. Opserve tvapyan, tvayo thy to te say kin &c ? Opserve vrksat, vrksan &c. the tort kin is a sarvanana, put it peink inclutet in the tyati clas, toult have pen elenptet ron the operation or this rule hat it not pen separately nentionet. Vart:- the tort pahu here is a sankhya. thererore, the aril toes not aply here, paho supat, pahO supe
s: These प्राग्दिशीय affixes come after the word किम् and after a stem called सर्वनाम and after बहु but not after द्वि etc. The words द्वि &c, though सर्वनाम are exempted. Thus कुत्र, कृतः, यतः, यत्र, बहुतः, बहुत्रः Why do we say अद्व्यादि 'not dvi &c'. Observe द्वाभ्याम्, द्वयोः Why do we say किम् &c ? Observe वृक्षात्, वृक्षं &c. The word किम् is a सर्वनाम, but it being included in the dyadi class, would have been exempted from the operation of this rule had it not been separately mentioned. Vart:- The word बहु here is a Sankhya. Therefore, the affix does not apply here, बहोः सूपात्, बहौ सूपे

pk: ror idan there is the substitute is when a pragdisiya aril rolows. The word pragdisa is understod here also. The s or is is indicatory or the substitution or the whole (1.1. 5). Thus idan + ha [5.3.1] = iha
ck: ror itan there is the supstitute is then a praktisiya aril rolots. the tort praktisa is unterstot here also. the s or is is inticatory or the supstitution or the thole (1.1. 5). thus itan + ha [5.3.1] = iha
s: For इदम् there is the substitute इश् when a प्राग्दिशीय affix follows. The word प्राग्दिशः is understood here also. The श् of इश् is indicatory of the substitution of the whole (1.1. 55). Thus इदम् + ह [[5.3.11]] = इह

pk: The substitutes eta and ita cone instead or idan when a pragdisiya aril begining with ra and Ta respectively rolows. This debars is The a in ra is ror the sake or euphony. Thus idan + rhila = etarhi [5.3.16]; idan + Tanu = itTan [5.3.24].
ck: the supstitutes eta ant ita cone insteat or itan then a praktisiya aril pekinink tith ra ant ta respectively rolots. this tepars is the a in ra is ror the sake or euphony. thus itan + rhila = etarhi [5.3.16]; itan + tanu = itan [5.3.24].
s: The substitutes एत and इत come instead of इदम् when a प्राग्दिशीय affix beginning with र and थ respectively follows. This debars इश् The अ in र is for the sake of euphony. Thus इदम् + र्हिल = एतर्हि [[5.3.16]]; इदम् + थमु = इत्थम् [[5.3.24]].

pk: The substitute as cones in the place or etad when a pragdisiya aril rolows. The s or as causes the replacenent or the whole [1.1.5]. acording to Patanjali the substitute is an and not as Thus etad + tasil = ata [5.3.7]; atra [5.3.10]. Vart:- This sutra nust be divided into two etada, and as, the neaning being. (1) The substitutes eta and it cone in the place or etad when ariles begining with r and Ta respectively rolow, as etad + rhila = etarhi [5.3.21] etad + Tanu = itTan The Ta nust be the Ta or Tanu which cones arter idan [5.4.24] ror the aplication or this rule (1), and not the Ta or Tal [5.3.23] berore which the substitute wil be as The word etad wil take Tanu by the inplication ar this rule. (2) The substitute as replaces etad berore other Pragdisiya ariles.
ck: the supstitute as cones in the place or etat then a praktisiya aril rolots. the s or as causes the replacenent or the thole [1.1.5]. acortink to patancali the supstitute is an ant not as thus etat + tasil = ata [5.3.7]; atra [5.3.10]. Vart:- this sutra nust pe tivitet into to etata, ant as, the neanink peink. (1) the supstitutes eta ant it cone in the place or etat then ariles pekinink tith r ant ta respectively rolot, as etat + rhila = etarhi [5.3.21] etat + tanu = itan the ta nust pe the ta or tanu thich cones arter itan [5.4.24] ror the aplication or this rule (1), ant not the ta or tal [5.3.23] perore thich the supstitute til pe as the tort etat til take tanu py the inplication ar this rule. (2) the supstitute as replaces etat perore other praktisiya ariles.
s: The substitute अश् comes in the place of एतद् when a प्राग्दिशीय affix follows. The श् of अश् causes the replacement of the whole [[1.1.55]]. According to Patanjali the substitute is अन् and not अश् Thus एतद् + तसिल् = अतः [[5.3.7]]; अत्र [[5.3.10]]. Vart:- This sutra must be divided into two एतदः, and अश्, the meaning being. (1) The substitutes एत and इत् come in the place of एतद् when affixes beginning with र् and थ respectively follow, as एतद् + र्हिल = एतर्हि [[5.3.21]] एतद् + थमु = इत्थम् The थ must be the थ of थमु which comes after idam [[5.4.24]] for the application of this rule (1), and not the थ of थाल् [[5.3.23]] before which the substitute will be अश् The word एतद् will take थमु by the implication af this rule. (2) The substitute अश् replaces एतद् before other Pragdisiya affixes.

pk: The sa is substituted ror sarva berore a pragdisiya viBakti begining with da Thus sarvada or sada When the aril is not Pragdisiya, there is no substitution : as, sarve dadati = sarvada brahnani a Brahnani who gives al.
ck: the sa is supstitutet ror sarva perore a praktisiya vipakti pekinink tith ta thus sarvata or sata then the aril is not praktisiya, there is no supstitution : as, sarve tatati = sarvata prahnani a prahnani tho kives al.
s: The स is substituted for सर्व before a प्राग्दिशीय विभक्ति beginning with द Thus सर्वदा or सदा When the affix is not Pragdisiya, there is no substitution : as, सर्वे ददाति = सर्वदा ब्राह्मणी 'a Brahmani who gives all'.

pk: The aril tasil (tas) cones arter the word kin , a sarvanana and bahu when ending in ablative -5th case. as kin + tasil = ku + tas [7.2.104] = kuta, yata, tata, bahuta
ck: the aril tasil (tas) cones arter the tort kin , a sarvanana ant pahu then entink in aplative -5th case. as kin + tasil = ku + tas [7.2.104] = kuta, yata, tata, pahuta
s: The affix तसिल् (तस्) comes after the word किम् , a सर्वनाम and बहु when ending in Ablative -5th case. As किम् + तसिल् = कु + तस् [[7.2.104]] = कुतः, यतः, ततः, बहुतः

pk: The aril tasil (tas) is substituted ror tas - pratiyoge pancanyastasi [5.4.4], apadane cahiyaruho [5.4.45] when kin a sarvanana and bahu rolow. Thus kuta, yata, tata, or bahuta agata This substitution is ror the sake or acent; and ror giving it the designation or vibhakti.
ck: the aril tasil (tas) is supstitutet ror tas - pratiyoke pancanyastasi [5.4.4], apatane cahiyaruho [5.4.45] then kin a sarvanana ant pahu rolot. thus kuta, yata, tata, or pahuta akata this supstitution is ror the sake or acent; ant ror kivink it the tesiknation or viphakti.
s: The affix तसिल् (तस्) is substituted for तस् -- प्रतियोगे पञ्चम्यास्तसिः [[5.4.44]], अपादाने चाहीयरुहोः [[5.4.45]] when किम् a सर्वनाम and बहु follow. Thus कुतः, यतः, ततः, or बहुत आगतः This substitution is for the sake of accent; and for giving it the designation of vibhakti.

pk: The aril tasil (tas) cones arter pari and aBi also. This aril cones when pari neans al; and aBi neans both. Thus parita = sarvata; al round; aBita, uBayata on both sides.
ck: the aril tasil (tas) cones arter pari ant api also. this aril cones then pari neans al; ant api neans poth. thus parita = sarvata; al rount; apita, upayata on poth sites.
s: The affix तसिल् (तस्) comes after परि and अभि also. This affix comes when परि means 'all'; and अभि means 'both'. Thus परितः = सर्वतः; 'all round'; अभितः, उभयतः 'on both sides'.

pk: The aril tral cones arter kin , sarvanana and bahu when ending in Locative -7th case. Thus kutra [7.2.104] where, tatra [7.2.102] there, bahutra in nany places.
ck: the aril tral cones arter kin , sarvanana ant pahu then entink in Locative -7th case. thus kutra [7.2.104] there, tatra [7.2.102] there, pahutra in nany places.
s: The affix त्रल् comes after किम् , सर्वनाम and बहु when ending in Locative -7th case. Thus कुत्र [[7.2.104]] 'where', तत्र [[7.2.102]] 'there', बहुत्र 'in many places'.

pk: The aril ha cones arter idan ending in the Locative -7th case. This debars tral Thus iha [5.3.3] here.
ck: the aril ha cones arter itan entink in the Locative -7th case. this tepars tral thus iha [5.3.3] here.
s: The affix ह comes after इदम् ending in the Locative -7th case. This debars त्रल् Thus इह [[5.3.3]] 'here'.

pk: The aril at (a) cones arter kin ending in the Locative -7th case. This debars tral Thus kin + at = kva + a [7.2.105] = ka as kva Boksyase where wil you eat. kvaDyesyase acording to sone tral also cones, as kutra This is done by drawing the word va optionaly ron the nelt sutra. so that this sutra becones an optional one.
ck: the aril at (a) cones arter kin entink in the Locative -7th case. this tepars tral thus kin + at = kva + a [7.2.105] = ka as kva poksyase there til you eat. kvatyesyase acortink to sone tral also cones, as kutra this is tone py tratink the tort va optionaly ron the nelt sutra. so that this sutra pecones an optional one.
s: The affix अत् (अ) comes after किम् ending in the Locative -7th case. This debars त्रल् Thus किम् + अत् = क्व + अ [[7.2.105]] = क as क्व भोक्ष्यसे 'where will you eat'. क्वाध्येष्यसे According to some त्रल् also comes, as कुत्र This is done by drawing the word वा 'optionally' from the next sutra. So that this sutra becomes an optional one.

pk: Optionaly the aril ha also cones in the Candas (Vedas) arter the word kin in the Locative -7th case as wel as other ariles. Thus kuha [7.2.104], ka, kutra. as in nig Veda Vi.62.4: kuhasTa kuhajagnaTu kuha syeneva petaTu Where are ye two? Where are you (or did you) going? Where do you ral like eagles?.
ck: Optionaly the aril ha also cones in the cantas (Vetas) arter the tort kin in the Locative -7th case as tel as other ariles. thus kuha [7.2.104], ka, kutra. as in nik Veta Vi.62.4: kuhasta kuhacaknatu kuha syeneva petatu there are ye to? there are you (or tit you) koink? there to you ral like eakles?.
s: Optionally the affix ह also comes in the छन्दस् (Vedas) after the word किम् in the Locative -7th case as well as other affixes. Thus कुह [[7.2.104]], क, कुत्र. As in Rig Veda VIII.62.4: कुहस्थः कुहजग्मथुः कुह श्येनेव पेतथुः 'Where are ye two? Where are you (or did you) going? Where do you fall like eagles?'.

pk: The above ariles are sen coning arter kin , a sarvanana and bahu ending with other case-ariles also besides the Locative -7th case and ablative -5th case. That is to say, the ariles tasil, tral, ha &c cone arter kin &c which are not in the ablative or the locative case. By the enploynent or the elpresion are sen, it is hinted that this nay take place not on every ocasion, but only when in jultaposition with such words as Bavat nour onor, dirGayu long-lived, ayusnan having long-lire, and devanan priya the beloved or the Gods. Thus: non. tato Bavan or tatra Bavan = sa Bavan ac. tatra Bavantan or tato Bavantan = tan Bavantan ins. tatra Bavata or tato Bavata = tena Bavata Dat. tato Bavate or tatra Bavate = tasnE Bavate abt. tato Bavata or tatra Bavata = tasnad Bavata Gen. tato Bavata or tatra Bavata = tasya Bavata Loc. tato Bavati or tatra Bavati = tasnin Bavati sinilarly with the words dirGayu, ayusnan and devanan priya
ck: the apove ariles are sen conink arter kin , a sarvanana ant pahu entink tith other case-ariles also pesites the Locative -7th case ant aplative -5th case. that is to say, the ariles tasil, tral, ha &c cone arter kin &c thich are not in the aplative or the locative case. py the enploynent or the elpresion are sen, it is hintet that this nay take place not on every ocasion, put only then in cultaposition tith such torts as pavat nour onor, tirkayu lonk-livet, ayusnan havink lonk-lire, ant tevanan priya the pelovet or the kots. thus: non. tato pavan or tatra pavan = sa pavan ac. tatra pavantan or tato pavantan = tan pavantan ins. tatra pavata or tato pavata = tena pavata tat. tato pavate or tatra pavate = tasnE pavate apt. tato pavata or tatra pavata = tasnat pavata ken. tato pavata or tatra pavata = tasya pavata Loc. tato pavati or tatra pavati = tasnin pavati sinilarly tith the torts tirkayu, ayusnan ant tevanan priya
s: The above affixes are seen coming after किम् , a सर्वनाम and बहु ending with other case-affixes also besides the Locative -7th case and Ablative -5th case. That is to say, the affixes तसिल्, त्रल्, ह &c come after kim &c which are not in the ablative or the locative case. By the employment of the expression 'are seen', it is hinted that this may take place not on every occasion, but only when in juxtaposition with such words as भवत् 'Your Honor', दीर्घायुः 'long-lived', आयुष्मान् 'having long-life', and देवानां प्रियः 'the beloved of the Gods'. Thus: Nom. ततो भवान् or तत्र भवान् = स भवान् Acc. तत्र भवन्तम् or ततो भवन्तम् = तं भवन्तम् Ins. तत्र भवता or ततो भवता = तेन भवता Dat. ततो भवते or तत्र भवते = तस्मै भवते Abt. ततो भवतः or तत्र भवतः = तस्माद् भवतः Gen. ततो भवतः or तत्र भवतः = तस्य भवतः Loc. ततो भवति or तत्र भवति = तस्मिन् भवति Similarly with the words दीर्घायुः, आयुष्मान् and देवानां प्रियः

pk: arter 1. sarva al 2. eka one 3. anya other 4. kin what 5 yad which and 6. tad that when tine is denoted cones the aril da , the words being in the Locative -7th case. The word saptanya [5.2.10] is understod here and not the word itaraByan or the last. This debars tral Thus sarvada or sada [5.3.6] at every tine or always, ekada once, anyada at another tine kada [7.2.103] when, yada when, tada then. Why do we say kale when tine is denoted? Observe sarvatradese (where although the case is the 7th, the aril is not da, because the sense is) in every place or every where.
ck: arter 1. sarva al 2. eka one 3. anya other 4. kin that 5 yat thich ant 6. tat that then tine is tenotet cones the aril ta , the torts peink in the Locative -7th case. the tort saptanya [5.2.10] is unterstot here ant not the tort itarapyan or the last. this tepars tral thus sarvata or sata [5.3.6] at every tine or altays, ekata once, anyata at another tine kata [7.2.103] then, yata then, tata then. thy to te say kale then tine is tenotet? Opserve sarvatratese (there althoukh the case is the 7th, the aril is not ta, pecause the sense is) in every place or every there.
s: After 1. सर्व 'all' 2. एक 'one' 3. अन्य 'other' 4. किम् 'what' 5 यद् 'which' and 6. तद् 'that' when time is denoted comes the affix दा , the words being in the Locative -7th case. The word सप्तम्याः [[5.2.10]] is understood here and not the word इतराभ्यां of the last. This debars त्रल् Thus सर्वदा or सदा [[5.3.6]] 'at every time' or 'always', एकदा 'once', अन्यदा 'at another time' कदा [[7.2.103]] 'when', यदा 'when', तदा 'then'. Why do we say काले 'when time is denoted'? Observe सर्वत्रदेशे (where although the case is the 7th, the affix is not दा, because the sense is) 'in every place' or 'every where'.

pk: arter idan this ending in the Locative -7th case cones the aril rhil when tine is denoted. The words saptanya and kale are understod. This rhil debars ha. The l or rhil is ror acent. Thus asnin kale = etarhi [5.3.4] at this tine. Why when tine is denoted? Observe, iha in this place, as iha dese se [5.3.4].
ck: arter itan this entink in the Locative -7th case cones the aril rhil then tine is tenotet. the torts saptanya ant kale are unterstot. this rhil tepars ha. the l or rhil is ror acent. thus asnin kale = etarhi [5.3.4] at this tine. thy then tine is tenotet? Opserve, iha in this place, as iha tese se [5.3.4].
s: After इदम् 'this' ending in the Locative -7th case comes the affix र्हिल् when time is denoted. The words सप्तम्याः and काले are understood. This rhil debars ha. The ल् of र्हिल् is for accent. Thus अस्मिन् काले = एतर्हि [[5.3.4]] 'at this time'. Why 'when time is denoted'? Observe, इह 'in this place', as इह देशे See [[5.3.4]].

pk: The word aDuna is anonalous having the sane sense. as asnin kale = aDuna at this tine as is substituted ror idan and, Duna aril is aded.
ck: the tort atuna is anonalous havink the sane sense. as asnin kale = atuna at this tine as is supstitutet ror itan ant, tuna aril is atet.
s: The word अधुना is anomalous having the same sense. As अस्मिन् काले = अधुना 'at this time' अश् is substituted for इदम् and, धुन affix is added.

pk: The aril danin also cones arter idan ending in the Locative -7th case, denoting tine. Thus asnin kale = idanin [5.3.3] at this tine.
ck: the aril tanin also cones arter itan entink in the Locative -7th case, tenotink tine. thus asnin kale = itanin [5.3.3] at this tine.
s: The affix दानीम् also comes after इदम् ending in the Locative -7th case, denoting time. Thus अस्मिन् काले = इदानीम् [[5.3.3]] 'at this time'.

pk: arter tad ending in the Locative -7th case when tine is denoted, cones the ariles da and danin The danin is read into the sutra by rorce or the word ca also. Thus tasnin kale = tada or tadanin at that tine. This sutra, so rar as it ordains da arter the word tad is useles, because the word tad already takes da by [5.3.15].
ck: arter tat entink in the Locative -7th case then tine is tenotet, cones the ariles ta ant tanin the tanin is reat into the sutra py rorce or the tort ca also. thus tasnin kale = tata or tatanin at that tine. this sutra, so rar as it ortains ta arter the tort tat is useles, pecause the tort tat alreaty takes ta py [5.3.15].
s: After तद् ending in the Locative -7th case when time is denoted, comes the affixes दा and दानीम् The दानीम् is read into the sutra by force of the word च 'also'. Thus तस्मिन् काले = तदा or तदानीम् 'at that time'. This sutra, so far as it ordains दा after the word तद् is useless, because the word तद् already takes दा by [[5.3.15]].

pk: arter the two pratipadika (noninal stens) idan and tad cone respectively the ariles da and rhil in the Candas (Vedas) and also other ariles. The aril da cones arter idan and rhi arter tad Thus ida [5.3.3], tarhi [7.2.102]. so also idanin and tadanin as ida hi yanupastutiBida vanasya Baktaye (nig Veda Vi.27.1).
ck: arter the to pratipatika (noninal stens) itan ant tat cone respectively the ariles ta ant rhil in the cantas (Vetas) ant also other ariles. the aril ta cones arter itan ant rhi arter tat thus ita [5.3.3], tarhi [7.2.102]. so also itanin ant tatanin as ita hi yanupastutipita vanasya paktaye (nik Veta Vi.27.1).
s: After the two प्रातिपदिक (Nominal Stems) इदम् and तद् come respectively the affixes दा and र्हिल् in the छन्दस् (Vedas) and also other affixes. The affix दा comes after इदम् and र्हि after तद् Thus इदा [[5.3.3]], तर्हि [[7.2.102]]. So also इदानीम् and तदानीम् As इदा हि यमुपस्तुतिभिदा वामस्य भक्तये (Rig Veda VIII.27.11).

pk: The aril rhil cones optionaly in denoting tine not or the curent day arter the words kin , the sarvanana and bahu etc. The anuvriti or Candasi is not read into this sutra. This is a general rule. Thus karhi or kada [7.2.103], yarhi or yada, tarhi or tada
ck: the aril rhil cones optionaly in tenotink tine not or the curent tay arter the torts kin , the sarvanana ant pahu etc. the anuvriti or cantasi is not reat into this sutra. this is a keneral rule. thus karhi or kata [7.2.103], yarhi or yata, tarhi or tata
s: The affix र्हिल् comes optionally in denoting time not of the current day after the words किम् , the सर्वनाम and बहु etc. The anuvritti of छन्दसि is not read into this sutra. This is a general rule. Thus कर्हि or कदा [[7.2.103]], यर्हि or यदा, तर्हि or तदा

pk: The rolowing words are anonalous - 1. sadya 2. parut 3. parari 4. Esanas 5. paredyavi 6. adya 7. purvedyus 8. anyedyus 9. anyataredyus 10. itaredyus 1. aparedyus 12. aDaredyus 13. uBayedyus and 14. utaredyus The words saptanya and kale are understod here. The base, the substitute, the aril, the particular tine &c, nust al be deduced ron these rorns. Thus sadya is rorned ron sanana, by substituting sa ror sanana, and ading the aril dyas; in the sense or a day. sananehani = sadya the sane day. The purva and purvatara are replaced by para, and then the ariles ut and ari are aded, in the sense or a year. Thus purvasnin sanvatsare = parut last year. purvatare sanvatsare = parara the year belore last. The isa replaces idan, and aril sanatan is aded, in the sense or year. Thus asnin sanvatsare = Esana during this years. To para is aded edyavi in the sense or a day: as, parasninahani = paredyavi the other day. The adya replaces idan and the aril dyas is aded in the sense or a day. Thus asninahani = adya to day. To the words purva, anya, anyatara, itara, apara, aDara, uBaya and utara is aded the aril edyus, in the sense or a day: as purvasninahani = purvedyus on the day berore, anyasninahani = anyedyus on the rolowing day. anyatarasninahani = anyataredyu on either or two days. itarasninahani = itaredyu on another day, aparasninahani = aparedyu on the rolowing day, aDarasninahani = aDaredyu on a previous day. uBayorahano = uBayedyu on both days.
ck: the rolotink torts are anonalous - 1. satya 2. parut 3. parari 4. Esanas 5. paretyavi 6. atya 7. purvetyus 8. anyetyus 9. anyataretyus 10. itaretyus 1. aparetyus 12. ataretyus 13. upayetyus ant 14. utaretyus the torts saptanya ant kale are unterstot here. the pase, the supstitute, the aril, the particular tine &c, nust al pe tetucet ron these rorns. thus satya is rornet ron sanana, py supstitutink sa ror sanana, ant atink the aril tyas; in the sense or a tay. sananehani = satya the sane tay. the purva ant purvatara are replacet py para, ant then the ariles ut ant ari are atet, in the sense or a year. thus purvasnin sanvatsare = parut last year. purvatare sanvatsare = parara the year pelore last. the isa replaces itan, ant aril sanatan is atet, in the sense or year. thus asnin sanvatsare = Esana turink this years. to para is atet etyavi in the sense or a tay: as, parasninahani = paretyavi the other tay. the atya replaces itan ant the aril tyas is atet in the sense or a tay. thus asninahani = atya to tay. to the torts purva, anya, anyatara, itara, apara, atara, upaya ant utara is atet the aril etyus, in the sense or a tay: as purvasninahani = purvetyus on the tay perore, anyasninahani = anyetyus on the rolotink tay. anyatarasninahani = anyataretyu on either or to tays. itarasninahani = itaretyu on another tay, aparasninahani = aparetyu on the rolotink tay, atarasninahani = ataretyu on a previous tay. upayorahano = upayetyu on poth tays.
s: The following words are anomalous - 1. सद्यः 2. परुत् 3. परारि 4. ऐषमस् 5. परेद्यवि 6. अद्य 7. पूर्वेद्युस् 8. अन्येद्युस् 9. अन्यतरेद्युस् 10. इतरेद्युस् 11. अपरेद्युस् 12. अधरेद्युस् 13. उभयेद्युस् and 14. उत्तरेद्युस् The words सप्तम्याः and काले are understood here. The base, the substitute, the affix, the particular time &c, must all be deduced from these forms. Thus सद्यः is formed from समान, by substituting स for समान, and adding the affix द्यस्; in the sense of 'a day'. समानेऽहनि = सद्यः 'the same day'. The पूर्व and पूर्वतर are replaced by पर, and then the affixes उत् and आरि are added, in the sense of 'a year'. Thus पूर्वस्मिन् संवत्सरे = परुत् 'last year'. पूर्वतरे संवत्सरे = परार 'the year belore last'. The इश replaces इदम्, and affix समतण् is added, in the sense of 'year'. Thus अस्मिन् संवत्सरे = ऐषमः 'during this years'. To पर is added एद्यवि in the sense of 'a day': as, परस्मिन्नहनि = परेद्यवि 'the other day'. The अद्य replaces इदम् and the affix द्यस् is added in the sense of 'a day'. Thus अस्मिन्नहनि = अद्य 'to day'. To the words पूर्व, अन्य, अन्यतर, इतर, अपर, अधर, उभय and उत्तर is added the affix एद्युस्, in the sense of 'a day': as पूर्वस्मिन्नहनि = पूर्वेद्युस् 'on the day before', अन्यस्मिन्नहनि = अन्येद्युस् 'on the following day'. अन्यतरस्मिन्नहनि = अन्यतरेद्युः 'on either of two days'. इतरस्मिन्नहनि = इतरेद्युः 'on another day', अपरस्मिन्नहनि = अपरेद्युः 'on the following day', अधरस्मिन्नहनि = अधरेद्युः 'on a previous day'. उभयोरहनोः = उभयेद्युः 'on both days'.

pk: The aril Tal cones arter the words kin etc. - kinsarvananabahuByodvyadiBya [5.3.2] when we speak or a kind or naner or being. The sutra [5.3.2], is to be read into this. The anuvriti or saptanya and kale ceases. The word prakara neans the direrentiating quality distinguishing a species anong the genus : it neans sort, kind, node, naner &c. Thus tena prakarena = taTa so, in that naner. sinilarly yaTa, sarvaTa The aril jatiyar taught in [5.3.69] has also the sane rorce, with this direrence that jatiyar aplies to words which denote things posesing such a quality (prakarayaca, while thal denotes node itselr. Thererore, one does not debar the other, so that we have rorns like, taTajatiya and yaTajatiya
ck: the aril tal cones arter the torts kin etc. - kinsarvananapahupyotvyatipya [5.3.2] then te speak or a kint or naner or peink. the sutra [5.3.2], is to pe reat into this. the anuvriti or saptanya ant kale ceases. the tort prakara neans the tirerentiatink tuality tistinkuishink a species anonk the kenus : it neans sort, kint, note, naner &c. thus tena prakarena = tata so, in that naner. sinilarly yata, sarvata the aril catiyar taukht in [5.3.69] has also the sane rorce, tith this tirerence that catiyar aplies to torts thich tenote thinks posesink such a tuality (prakarayaca, thile thal tenotes note itselr. thererore, one toes not tepar the other, so that te have rorns like, tatacatiya ant yatacatiya
s: The affix थाल् comes after the words किम् etc. -- किंसर्वनामबहुभ्योऽद्व्यादिभ्यः [[5.3.2]] when we speak of a kind or manner of being. The sutra [[5.3.2]], is to be read into this. The anuvritti of सप्तम्याः and काले ceases. The word प्रकार means the differentiating quality distinguishing a species among the genus : it means 'sort', 'kind', 'mode', 'manner' &c. Thus तेन प्रकारेण = तथा 'so, in that manner'. Similarly यथा, सर्वथा The affix जातीयर् taught in [[5.3.69]] has also the same force, with this difference that jatiyar applies to words which denote things possessing such a quality (प्रकारयाच्च, while thal denotes mode itself. Therefore, one does not debar the other, so that we have forms like, तथाजातीयः and यथाजातीयः

pk: arter idan cones the aril Tanu (Tan) in the sane sense or a kind or naner or being. This debars Tal; thus : anena prakarena = itTan [5.3.4] in this naner. The u in Tanu protects the n ron beconing it (se [1.3.4]).
ck: arter itan cones the aril tanu (tan) in the sane sense or a kint or naner or peink. this tepars tal; thus : anena prakarena = itan [5.3.4] in this naner. the u in tanu protects the n ron peconink it (se [1.3.4]).
s: After इदम् comes the affix थमु (थम्) in the same sense of a kind or manner of being. This debars थाल्; thus : अनेन प्रकारेण = इत्थम् [[5.3.4]] 'in this manner'. The उ in थमु protects the म् from becoming इत् (See [[1.3.4]]).

pk: also arter kin cones the aril Tanu in the sense or denoting a naner. Thus kena prakarena = kaTan how?.
ck: also arter kin cones the aril tanu in the sense or tenotink a naner. thus kena prakarena = katan hot?.
s: Also after किम् comes the affix थमु in the sense of denoting a manner. Thus केन प्रकारेण = कथम् 'how?'.

pk: The aril Ta cones in the sense or cause arter the word kin in the Candas (Vedas). The word prakara vacane is read into the sutra by rorce or ca Thus kaTa whererore? why? ror what reason?, kaTa how. The rorner is an elanple or hetu reason or cause, the second or prakara naner. as in the rolowing sentences : kaTa granan na prcCasi = kena hetuna granan na prcCasi kaTa deva asan puravida ere end the ariles having the designation or Vibhakti.
ck: the aril ta cones in the sense or cause arter the tort kin in the cantas (Vetas). the tort prakara vacane is reat into the sutra py rorce or ca thus kata thererore? thy? ror that reason?, kata hot. the rorner is an elanple or hetu reason or cause, the secont or prakara naner. as in the rolotink sentences : kata kranan na prcasi = kena hetuna kranan na prcasi kata teva asan puravita ere ent the ariles havink the tesiknation or Viphakti.
s: The affix था comes in the sense of 'cause' after the word किम् in the छन्दस् (Vedas). The word प्रकार वचने is read into the sutra by force of च Thus कथा 'wherefore? why? for what reason?', कथा 'how'. The former is an example of हेतु 'reason or cause', the second of प्रकार 'manner'. As in the following sentences : कथा ग्रामं न पृच्छसि = केन हेतुना ग्रामं न पृच्छसि कथा देवा आसन् पुराविदः Here end the affixes having the designation of Vibhakti.

pk: The aril astati (astat) cones arter the words or direction, locality or tine ending in the Locative -7th case, ablative -5th case, noninative 1st-Case, without a change or sense. The word dik sabda neans words denoting directions. Thus purastat, has al these thre signirications in the rolowing sentences, purastadavasati he lives eastward. purastadagata he cane ron east purastad rananiyan it was delightrul previously. sinilarly with aDastat Why do we say arter words or direction? Observe Endryan disi vasati Why do we say ending in the locative, ablative and noninative? Observe purvan granan gata Why do we say when the sense is a direction, a locality or a tine? Observe purvasnin gurO vasati he lives in the presence or the guru. This aril is a svarTika aril, like the ariles taught previously. The words denoting direction nust be prinitive words or direction; and not derivative words like Endri &c. which also denote direction. The rule or yaTasanKya does not aply here.
ck: the aril astati (astat) cones arter the torts or tirection, locality or tine entink in the Locative -7th case, aplative -5th case, noninative 1st-case, tithout a chanke or sense. the tort tik sapta neans torts tenotink tirections. thus purastat, has al these thre siknirications in the rolotink sentences, purastatavasati he lives eastart. purastatakata he cane ron east purastat rananiyan it tas telikhtrul previously. sinilarly tith atastat thy to te say arter torts or tirection? Opserve Entryan tisi vasati thy to te say entink in the locative, aplative ant noninative? Opserve purvan kranan kata thy to te say then the sense is a tirection, a locality or a tine? Opserve purvasnin kurO vasati he lives in the presence or the kuru. this aril is a svartika aril, like the ariles taukht previously. the torts tenotink tirection nust pe prinitive torts or tirection; ant not terivative torts like Entri &c. thich also tenote tirection. the rule or yatasankya toes not aply here.
s: The affix अस्ताति (अस्तात्) comes after the words of 'direction', 'locality' or 'time' ending in the Locative -7th case, Ablative -5th case, Nominative 1st-Case, without a change of sense. The word दिक् शब्दाः means 'words denoting directions'. Thus पुरस्तात्, has all these three significations in the following sentences, पुरस्तादवसति 'he lives eastward'. पुरस्तादागतः 'he came from east' पुरस्ताद् रमणीयम् 'It was delightful previously'. Similarly with अधस्तात् Why do we say 'after words of direction'? Observe ऐन्द्र्यां दिशि वसति Why do we say 'ending in the locative, ablative and nominative'? Observe पूर्वम् ग्रामं गतः Why do we say when the sense is 'a direction', 'a locality' or 'a time'? Observe पूर्वस्मिन् गुरौ वसति 'he lives in the presence of the guru'. This affix is a स्वार्थिक affix, like the affixes taught previously. The words denoting direction must be primitive words of direction; and not derivative words like ऐन्द्री &c. which also denote direction. The rule of यथासंख्य does not apply here.

pk: The aril atasuc (atas) cones in the sense or direction, locality or tine arter the words 1. daksina and 2. utara This debars astati The word daksina can never rerer to tine, so with regard to it direction and locality are only taken. Thus daksinato vasati, daksinata agata, daksinatorananiyan utaratovasati, utarata agata, utaratorananiyan The a or atas is ror the sake or direrentiating this aril ron tas in sutras like [2.3.30].
ck: the aril atasuc (atas) cones in the sense or tirection, locality or tine arter the torts 1. taksina ant 2. utara this tepars astati the tort taksina can never rerer to tine, so tith rekart to it tirection ant locality are only taken. thus taksinato vasati, taksinata akata, taksinatorananiyan utaratovasati, utarata akata, utaratorananiyan the a or atas is ror the sake or tirerentiatink this aril ron tas in sutras like [2.3.30].
s: The affix अतसुच् (अतस्) comes in the sense of 'direction', 'locality' or 'time' after the words 1. दक्षिण and 2. उत्तर This debars अस्ताति The word दक्षिणा can never refer to time, so with regard to it direction and locality are only taken. Thus दक्षिणतो वसति, दक्षिणत आगतः, दक्षिणतोरमणीयम् उत्तरतोवसति, उत्तरत आगतः, उत्तरतोरमणीयम् The अ of अतस् is for the sake of differentiating this affix from तस् in sutras like [[2.3.30]].

pk: The aril atasuc (atas) cones in the sense or astati (astat) arter 1. para and 2. avara Thus parata or parastat or avarastat or avarato vasati, agata or rananiyan
ck: the aril atasuc (atas) cones in the sense or astati (astat) arter 1. para ant 2. avara thus parata or parastat or avarastat or avarato vasati, akata or rananiyan
s: The affix अतसुच् (अतस्) comes in the sense of अस्ताति (अस्तात्) after 1. पर and 2. अवर Thus परतः or परस्तात् or अवरस्तात् or अवरतो वसति, आगतः or रमणीयम्

pk: arter words or direction ending in anc there is luk elision or the aril astati Thus prak or pratyak; pracyan disi vasati = prag vasati, pragagata, pragrananiyan The reninine aril or praci is also elided, when the tadhita aril is elided by luk se (l. 2.49).
ck: arter torts or tirection entink in anc there is luk elision or the aril astati thus prak or pratyak; pracyan tisi vasati = prak vasati, prakakata, prakrananiyan the reninine aril or praci is also elitet, then the tathita aril is elitet py luk se (l. 2.49).
s: After words of direction ending in अञ्च् there is लुक् elision of the affix अस्ताति Thus प्राक् or प्रत्यक्; प्राच्यां दिशि वसति = प्राग् वसति, प्रागागतः, प्राग्रमणीयम् The feminine affix of प्राची is also elided, when the taddhita affix is elided by लुक् See (l. 2.49).

pk: The words 1. upari and 2. upariswat are anonalous in the sense or astati These words are derived iregularly ron the word urDva, by changing it into upa, and ading the ariles ril and riswatil Thus urDvayan disi vasati = upari vasati. so also uparyagata, upari rananiyan upariswadvasati, upariswadagata, upariswadrananiyan
ck: the torts 1. upari ant 2. uparistat are anonalous in the sense or astati these torts are terivet irekularly ron the tort urtva, py chankink it into upa, ant atink the ariles ril ant ristatil thus urtvayan tisi vasati = upari vasati. so also uparyakata, upari rananiyan uparistatvasati, uparistatakata, uparistatrananiyan
s: The words 1. उपरि and 2. उपरिष्टात् are anomalous in the sense of अस्ताति These words are derived irregularly from the word ऊर्ध्व, by changing it into उप, and adding the affixes रिल् and रिष्टातिल् Thus ऊर्ध्वायां दिशि वसति = उपरि वसति. So also उपर्यागतः, उपरि रमणीयम् उपरिष्टाद्वसति, उपरिष्टादागतः, उपरिष्टद्रमणीयम्

pk: The word pascat is anonalous in the sense or astati The word is rorned by changing apara into pasca, and ading the aril ati as aparasyan disi vasati = pascadvasati, agata, rananiyan &c. Vart:- so also when apara is preceded by another word denoting direction, it is changed into pascha and ati is aded. as daksinapascat utarapascat Vart:- so also when arDa rolows such a conpound, apara is changed into pascha; as, daksinapascarDa, utarapascarDa Vart:- apara is changed into pascha, when rolowed by ardha, and not preceded by any other word. as, pascarDa
ck: the tort pascat is anonalous in the sense or astati the tort is rornet py chankink apara into pasca, ant atink the aril ati as aparasyan tisi vasati = pascatvasati, akata, rananiyan &c. Vart:- so also then apara is precetet py another tort tenotink tirection, it is chanket into pascha ant ati is atet. as taksinapascat utarapascat Vart:- so also then arta rolots such a conpount, apara is chanket into pascha; as, taksinapascarta, utarapascarta Vart:- apara is chanket into pascha, then rolotet py artha, ant not precetet py any other tort. as, pascarta
s: The word पश्चात् is anomalous in the sense of अस्ताति The word is formed by changing अपर into पश्च, and adding the affix आति As अपरस्यां दिशि वसति = पश्चाद्वसति, आगतः, रमणीयम् &c. Vart:- So also when अपर is preceded by another word denoting direction, it is changed into pascha and ati is added. As दक्षिणपश्चात् उत्तरपश्चात् Vart:- So also when अर्ध follows such a compound, apara is changed into pascha; as, दक्षिणपश्चार्धः, उत्तरपश्चार्धः Vart:- Apara is changed into pascha, when followed by ardha, and not preceded by any other word. As, पश्चार्धः

pk: The words pasca and pasca are anonalous in the Candas (Vedas) having the rorce or astati By ca, the word pascat is also included. as pura vyaGro jayate, pasca, pasca or pascat sinha as pascat purastadaDaradudaktat (nig Ved l. 87.21) pascedananyadaBavadyajatran (nig. Veda. l. 149.3).
ck: the torts pasca ant pasca are anonalous in the cantas (Vetas) havink the rorce or astati py ca, the tort pascat is also inclutet. as pura vyakro cayate, pasca, pasca or pascat sinha as pascat purastatataratutaktat (nik Vet l. 87.21) pascetananyatapavatyacatran (nik. Veta. l. 149.3).
s: The words पश्च and पश्चा are anomalous in the छन्दस् (Vedas) having the force of अस्ताति By च, the word पश्चात् is also included. As पुरा व्याघ्रो जायते, पश्च, पश्चा or पश्चात् सिंहः As पश्चात् पुरस्तादधरादुदक्तात् (Rig Ved X. 87.21) पश्चेदमन्यदभवद्यज्जत्रम् (Rig. Veda. X. 149.3).

pk: The aril ati is aded to the words 1. utara and 2. daksina in the sense or astati Thus utarasyan disi vasati = utaradvasati; utaradagata, utaradrananiyan sinilarly aDarat and daksinat
ck: the aril ati is atet to the torts 1. utara ant 2. taksina in the sense or astati thus utarasyan tisi vasati = utaratvasati; utaratakata, utaratrananiyan sinilarly atarat ant taksinat
s: The affix अति is added to the words 1. उत्तर and 2. दक्षिण in the sense of अस्ताति Thus उत्तरस्यां दिशि वसति = उत्तराद्वसति; उत्तरादागतः, उत्तराद्रमणीयम् Similarly अधरात् and दक्षिणात्

pk: The aril enap (ena) cones optionaly arter the words 1. utara and 2. daksina in the sense or astati, when the linit indicated is not renote and when it is not a substitute or the ablative -5th case aril. The aril astati and the other ariles taught above cone with the rorce or locative, ablative and noninative. The enap cones with the rorce or locative and noninative and not that or ablative. The adverbs so rorned rerer to objects not at a distance. Thus utarena or utarat or utarato vasati or rananiyan sinilarly aDarena, aDarat, aDastad vasati &c, so also daksinena, daksinat, daksinato vasati &c, e lives near by in the north-ward or southward. Why do we say when not denoting distance. Observe utaradvasti he lives rar away in the north. Why do we say when not having the rorce or ablative? Observe utaradagata cone ron the north. The word apancanya governs al the suceding sutras upto [5.3.39], elclusive. sone do not read utara &c into this sutra: acording to then this is a general rule aplicable to al words denoting direction. as purvena granan, aparena granan [2.3.31]. The p in enap is ror the sake or acent [3.1.4].
ck: the aril enap (ena) cones optionaly arter the torts 1. utara ant 2. taksina in the sense or astati, then the linit inticatet is not renote ant then it is not a supstitute or the aplative -5th case aril. the aril astati ant the other ariles taukht apove cone tith the rorce or locative, aplative ant noninative. the enap cones tith the rorce or locative ant noninative ant not that or aplative. the atverps so rornet rerer to opcects not at a tistance. thus utarena or utarat or utarato vasati or rananiyan sinilarly atarena, atarat, atastat vasati &c, so also taksinena, taksinat, taksinato vasati &c, e lives near py in the north-tart or southtart. thy to te say then not tenotink tistance. Opserve utaratvasti he lives rar atay in the north. thy to te say then not havink the rorce or aplative? Opserve utaratakata cone ron the north. the tort apancanya koverns al the sucetink sutras upto [5.3.39], elclusive. sone to not reat utara &c into this sutra: acortink to then this is a keneral rule aplicaple to al torts tenotink tirection. as purvena kranan, aparena kranan [2.3.31]. the p in enap is ror the sake or acent [3.1.4].
s: The affix एनप् (एन) comes optionally after the words 1. उत्तर and 2. दक्षिण in the sense of अस्ताति, when the limit indicated is not remote and when it is not a substitute of the Ablative -5th case affix. The affix अस्ताति and the other affixes taught above come with the force of locative, ablative and nominative. The एनप् comes with the force of locative and nominative and not that of ablative. The adverbs so formed refer to objects not at a distance. Thus उत्तरेण or उत्तरात् or उत्तरतो वसति or रमणीयम् Similarly अधरेण, अधरात्, अधस्ताद् वसति &c, so also दक्षिणेन, दक्षिणात्, दक्षिणतो वसति &c, 'He lives near by in the north-ward or southward'. Why do we say 'when not denoting distance'. Observe उत्तराद्वस्ति 'he lives far away in the north'. Why do we say 'when not having the force of ablative'? Observe उत्तरादागतः 'come from the north'. The word अपञ्चम्याः governs all the succeeding sutras upto [[5.3.39]], exclusive. Some do not read उत्तर &c into this sutra: according to them this is a general rule applicable to all words denoting direction. As पूर्वेण ग्रामम्, अपरेण ग्रामम् [[2.3.31]]. The प् in enap is for the sake of accent [[3.1.4]].

pk: The aril ac (a) cones arter the word daksina in the sense or astati , but not as a substitute or the ablative -5th case. The word adura or the last sutra is not read into this: though the word apancanya governs it. Thus daksina vasati or rananiyan, but daksinata agata The c in ac is not ror the sake or acent [6.1.163] ror the sinple aril a would be udata by the general rule [3.1.3]. The c serves the purpose or direrentiating this a ron other ariles in sutra [2.3.29].
ck: the aril ac (a) cones arter the tort taksina in the sense or astati , put not as a supstitute or the aplative -5th case. the tort atura or the last sutra is not reat into this: thoukh the tort apancanya koverns it. thus taksina vasati or rananiyan, put taksinata akata the c in ac is not ror the sake or acent [6.1.163] ror the sinple aril a toult pe utata py the keneral rule [3.1.3]. the c serves the purpose or tirerentiatink this a ron other ariles in sutra [2.3.29].
s: The affix आच् (आ) comes after the word दक्षिण in the sense of अस्ताति , but not as a substitute of the Ablative -5th case. The word अदूर of the last sutra is not read into this: though the word अपञ्चम्याः governs it. Thus दक्षिणा वसति or रमणीयम्, but दक्षिणत आगतः The च् in आच् is not for the sake of accent [[6.1.163]] for the simple affix आ would be udatta by the general rule [[3.1.3]]. The च् serves the purpose of differentiating this आ from other affixes in Sutra [[2.3.29]].

pk: The aril ahi cones arter the word daksina in the sense or astati as wel as ac when the rererence is to a distant linit. Thus daksinahi vasati or daksina vasati he lives rar away in the south. sinilarly daksinahin rananayan, daksina rananiyan Why do we say dure when the adverb denotes a distant linit? Observe daksinato vasati The word apancanya governs this also: as, daksinata agata
ck: the aril ahi cones arter the tort taksina in the sense or astati as tel as ac then the rererence is to a tistant linit. thus taksinahi vasati or taksina vasati he lives rar atay in the south. sinilarly taksinahin rananayan, taksina rananiyan thy to te say ture then the atverp tenotes a tistant linit? Opserve taksinato vasati the tort apancanya koverns this also: as, taksinata akata
s: The affix आहि comes after the word दक्षिण in the sense of अस्ताति as well as आच् when the reference is to a distant limit. Thus दक्षिणाहि वसति or दक्षिणा वसति 'he lives far away in the south'. Similarly दक्षिणाहिं रमनायम्, दक्षिणा रमणीयम् Why do we say दूरे 'when the adverb denotes a distant limit'? Observe दक्षिणतो वसति The word अपञ्चम्याः governs this also: as, दक्षिणत आगतः

pk: The ariles ac (a) and ahi cone arter utara cone in the sense or astati when the rererence is to a distant linit. Thus utara or utarahi vasati or rananiyan "e lives rar away in the north: or the northward rar away is pleasant". But when distance is not neant we have utarena prayati The word governs this also: as utaradagata
ck: the ariles ac (a) ant ahi cone arter utara cone in the sense or astati then the rererence is to a tistant linit. thus utara or utarahi vasati or rananiyan "e lives rar atay in the north: or the northtart rar atay is pleasant". put then tistance is not neant te have utarena prayati the tort koverns this also: as utaratakata
s: The affixes आच् (आ) and आहि come after उत्तरा come in the sense of अस्ताति when the reference is to a distant limit. Thus उत्तरा or उत्तराहि वसति or रमणीयम् "He lives far away in the north: or the northward far away is pleasant". But when 'distance' is not meant we have उत्तरेण प्रयाति The word governs this also: as उत्तरादागतः

pk: The aril asi (as) cones in the sense or astati arter 1. purva 2. aDara and 3. avara ; and 1. pur 2. aD and 3. ava are the respective substitutes berore this aril. The word apancanya does not govern this sutra. Thus puro vasati, pura agata, puro rananiyan sinilarly aDas and avas with vasati, agata and rananiyan as aDovasati aDa-agata, aDorananiyan, avovasati, avagata and avorananiyan
ck: the aril asi (as) cones in the sense or astati arter 1. purva 2. atara ant 3. avara ; ant 1. pur 2. at ant 3. ava are the respective supstitutes perore this aril. the tort apancanya toes not kovern this sutra. thus puro vasati, pura akata, puro rananiyan sinilarly atas ant avas tith vasati, akata ant rananiyan as atovasati ata-akata, atorananiyan, avovasati, avakata ant avorananiyan
s: The affix असि (अस्) comes in the sense of अस्ताति after 1. पूर्व 2. अधर and 3. अवर ; and 1. पुर् 2. अध् and 3. अव are the respective substitutes before this affix. The word अपञ्चम्याः does not govern this sutra. Thus पुरो वसति, पुर आगतः, पुरो रमणीयम् Similarly अधस् and अवस् with वसति, आगतः and रमणीयम् As अधोवसति अध-आगतः, अधोरमणीयम्, अवोवसति, अवआगतः and अवोरमणीयम्

pk: The sane substitution takes place when the aril astati rolows. That is pur ror purva, aD ror aDara and av ror avara This sutra indicates by inplication that the aril astati [5.3.27] is not debared by as arter these words. Thus purastat or aDastat or avastat vasati or agata or rananiyan
ck: the sane supstitution takes place then the aril astati rolots. that is pur ror purva, at ror atara ant av ror avara this sutra inticates py inplication that the aril astati [5.3.27] is not teparet py as arter these torts. thus purastat or atastat or avastat vasati or akata or rananiyan
s: The same substitution takes place when the affix अस्ताति follows. That is पुर् for पूर्व, अध् for अधर and अव् for अवर This sutra indicates by implication that the affix अस्ताति [[5.3.27]] is not debarred by अस् after these words. Thus पुरस्तात् or अधस्तात् or अवस्तात् वसति or आगतः or रमणीयम्

pk: The substitution or av ror avara is optional when astati rolows. This declares option when by last it was conpulsory. as avarastat or avastat vasati agata, or rananiyan
ck: the supstitution or av ror avara is optional then astati rolots. this teclares option then py last it tas conpulsory. as avarastat or avastat vasati akata, or rananiyan
s: The substitution of अव् for अवर is optional when अस्ताति follows. This declares option when by last it was compulsory. As अवरस्तात् or अवस्तात् वसति आगतः, or रमणीयम्

pk: The aril Da cones arter a pratipadika (noninal sten) denoting a nuneral when it neans the node or naner or an action. The word viDa and prakara have the sane neaning. The adverbs so rorned aply to every kind or action. Thus ekaDa Bunkte he eats once. dviDa gacCati he goes twice. sinilarly triDa, caturDa, pancaDa

s: The affix धा comes after a प्रातिपदिक (Nominal Stem) denoting a Numeral when it means the mode or manner of an action. The word विधा and प्रकार have the same meaning. The adverbs so formed apply to every kind of action. Thus एकधा भुङ्क्ते 'he eats once'. द्विधा गच्छति 'he goes twice'. Similarly त्रिधा, चतुर्धा, पञ्चधा

pk: The aril Da cones arter a nuneral when the sense is a change in the aportionent or distribution or substances. The word sanKyaya is understod here. The word aDikaranan neans nater, stur, substance. vicala change in nunbers. Thus to nake one into nany, or to nake nany into one. Thus ekan rasin kuru divide one heap into rive. aswaDa kuru, anekanekaDa kuru

s: The affix धा comes after a Numeral when the sense is a change in the apportionment or distribution of substances. The word संख्यायाः is understood here. The word अधिकरणं means 'matter, stuff, substance'. विचालः 'change in numbers'. Thus to make one into many, or to make many into one. Thus एकं राशिं कुरु 'divide one heap into five'. अष्टधा कुरु, अनेकमेकधा कुरु

s: After the word एक the substitute comes optionally instead of धा Thus एकधा राशिं कुरु or ऐकध्यं कुरु, एकधा भुङ्क्ते or ऐकध्यं भुङ्क्ते The repetition of धा in the sutra shows that the substitution takes place when the sense is that of विधा, as well as when it is that of अधिकरण विचाल Had धा not been repeated, the substitution would have come in the sense of अधिकरण विचाल only, as immediately preceding this sutra.

pk: The substitute Danun cones optionaly in the place or Da arter the words 1. dvi and 2. tri ere also it cones in both the viDarTa and aDikarana vicala senses. Thus द्विधा or द्वैधम्, त्रिधा, or त्रैधम् Vart:- The affix ड (da, with the elision of the final vowel) comes without changing the sense, after words ending in dhamun. As द्वैध, त्रैध, in पथि द्वैधानि संश्रयन्ते, मति त्रैधानि संश्रयन्ते

s: The affix पाशप् denotes something as insignificant. The word याप्य means 'contempt, trifling' &c. Thus वैयाकरणः = वैयाकरणपाशः 'a very bad Grammarian'. So also याज्ञिकपाशः Of course this will not come in denoting a person who is a good Grammarian, but bears bad character, or who is a good performer of sacrifices but immoral.

pk: arter a pratipadika (noninal sten) an ordinal nunber ending in tiya , cones the aril an (the word retaining its denotation) when a part is neant. This sutra is nade only to teach acent, ror the word to which an is aded undergoes no other change or rorn elcept in acent. Thus dviti꣡ya [5.2.54] has udata on ti [3.1.3] but when an is aded, the acent rals on dvi [6.1.197]. Thus dvitiyo Baga = dvi꣡tiya the noiety. sinilarly tr꣡tiya the one-third. Why do we say when part is neant? Otherwise, there is no change in acent. The aril tiya always cones in rorning ordinal nunbers and ror no other purpose, ror the tiya in words like nuKatiya is not signiricant as it is not an aril. The enploynent or the word purana in the aphorisn is useles ror the purposes or this sutra. its anuvriti, however, runs in the other sutras, and that is the only purpose that it serves here.

s: After a प्रातिपदिक (Nominal Stem) an ordinal number ending in तीय , comes the affix अन् (the word retaining its denotation) when a 'part' is meant. This sutra is made only to teach accent, for the word to which अन् is added undergoes no other change of form except in accent. Thus द्विती꣡यः [[5.2.54]] has udatta on ती [[3.1.3]] but when अन् is added, the accent falls on द्वि [[6.1.197]]. Thus द्वितीयो भागः = द्वि꣡तीयः 'the moiety'. Similarly तृ꣡तीयः 'the one-third'. Why do we say when 'part' is meant? Otherwise, there is no change in accent. The affix तीय always comes in forming ordinal numbers and for no other purpose, for the तीय in words like मुखतीय is not significant as it is not an affix. The employment of the word पूरण in the aphorism is useless for the purposes of this sutra. Its anuvritti, however, runs in the other sutras, and that is the only purpose that it serves here.

pk: The ariles na (a) and an arter 1. sasWa and 2. asWana when a part is neant, but not in the Candas (Vedas). The words Bage and aCandasi are understod here. By ca, the aril an is included. Thus sa꣡sWa or sa꣡sWa, a꣡swana or a꣡swana

s: The affixes ञ (अ) and अन् after 1. षष्ठ and 2. अष्ठम when a 'part' is meant, but not in the छन्दस् (Vedas). The words भागे and अछन्दसि are understood here. By च, the affix अन् is included. Thus ष꣡ष्ठः or षा꣡ष्ठः, अ꣡ष्टमः or आ꣡ष्टमः

pk: arter the words 1. sasWa and 2. asWana there nay cone respectively kan (ka) and luk elision or the aril when the neaning is a division or a neasure caled nana or grain or the part or the body or a beast respectively. The word nana neans a grain weight (vrihi parinitan suvarna). That is to say, kan cones arter sasWa when a division or nana neasure is elpresed; and luk cones arter aswa when a part or pasvanga is denoted. Thus sa꣡sWako Baga a silth or a grain neasure. aswano Baga an-eighth part or the body or a beast. The luk here takes the place or the aril na as wel as an By ca, the ariles above nentioned are also enployed: as sasWa or sasWa, aswana or aswana When a neasure or the body or an aninal is not denoted, this rule (though optional) wil not aply.
ck: arter the torts 1. sasta ant 2. astana there nay cone respectively kan (ka) ant luk elision or the aril then the neanink is a tivision or a neasure calet nana or krain or the part or the poty or a peast respectively. the tort nana neans a krain teikht (vrihi parinitan suvarna). that is to say, kan cones arter sasta then a tivision or nana neasure is elpreset; ant luk cones arter asta then a part or pasvanka is tenotet. thus sa꣡stako paka a silth or a krain neasure. astano paka an-eikhth part or the poty or a peast. the luk here takes the place or the aril na as tel as an py ca, the ariles apove nentionet are also enployet: as sasta or sasta, astana or astana then a neasure or the poty or an aninal is not tenotet, this rule (thoukh optional) til not aply.
s: After the words 1. षष्ठ and 2. अष्ठम there may come respectively कन् (क) and लुक् elision of the affix when the meaning is a division of a measure called मान or grain or the part of the body of a beast respectively. The word मान means a grain weight (व्रीहि परिमितं सुवर्ण). That is to say, कन् comes after षष्ठ when a division of मान 'measure' is expressed; and लुक् comes after अष्ट when a part of पश्वङ्ग is denoted. Thus ष꣡ष्ठको भागः 'a sixth of a grain measure'. अष्टमो भागः 'an-eighth part of the body of a beast'. The लुक् here takes the place of the affix ञ as well as अन् By च, the affixes above mentioned are also employed: as षाष्ठः or षष्ठः, आष्टमः or अष्टमः When a measure or the body of an animal is not denoted, this rule (though optional) will not apply.

pk: arter the word eka cones also the aril akinic (akin) (the word retaining its denotation) when the sense is without a conpanion. By the word ca, the aril kan and the elision luk also take erect: the elision being or kan or akinic Thus ekakin (non. ekaki), ekaka or eka By using asahaya, it is indicated that the word eka here is not a nuneral neaning one, but a noun neaning alone. ekonyarTe praDane ca, praTane, kevale taTa saDarane, sananelpe, sanKyayan ca prayujyate so that this word wil have dual ekakinO, and the plural ekakina
ck: arter the tort eka cones also the aril akinic (akin) (the tort retainink its tenotation) then the sense is tithout a conpanion. py the tort ca, the aril kan ant the elision luk also take erect: the elision peink or kan or akinic thus ekakin (non. ekaki), ekaka or eka py usink asahaya, it is inticatet that the tort eka here is not a nuneral neanink one, put a noun neanink alone. ekonyarte pratane ca, pratane, kevale tata satarane, sananelpe, sankyayan ca prayucyate so that this tort til have tual ekakinO, ant the plural ekakina
s: After the word एक comes also the affix आकिनिच् (आकिन्) (the word retaining its denotation) when the sense is 'without a companion'. By the word च, the affix कन् and the elision लुक् also take effect: the elision being of कन् or आकिनिच् Thus एकाकिन् (nom. एकाकी), एककः or एकः By using असहाय, it is indicated that the word एक here is not a numeral meaning 'one', but a noun meaning 'alone'. एकोऽन्यार्थे प्रधाने च, प्रथमे, केवले तथा साधारणे, समानेऽल्पे, संख्यायां च प्रयुज्यते So that this word will have dual एकाकिनौ, and the plural एकाकिनः

pk: The aril cara (with the reninine in nip) cones arter a pratipadika (noninal sten), the word retaining its detonation when the neaning is this had ben berore. The word Butapurva is a conpound or purva and Buta the conpounding being by supsupa, and denotes sonething done in a past tine. Thus aQyo Batapurva = aQyacara once opulent. sukunaracara The w indicates that the reninine wil be in nip; as, aQyacari The c is not it in caraw though required by (1.3. 7). This proves that cuwu rule is anitya. The sutra [5.2.18] night have ben read arter this, with the saving or the word Butapurva, but then Kan would have debared caraw which is, however, not intended.
ck: the aril cara (tith the reninine in nip) cones arter a pratipatika (noninal sten), the tort retainink its tetonation then the neanink is this hat pen perore. the tort putapurva is a conpount or purva ant puta the conpountink peink py supsupa, ant tenotes sonethink tone in a past tine. thus atyo patapurva = atyacara once opulent. sukunaracara the t inticates that the reninine til pe in nip; as, atyacari the c is not it in carat thoukh retuiret py (1.3. 7). this proves that cutu rule is anitya. the sutra [5.2.18] nikht have pen reat arter this, tith the savink or the tort putapurva, put then kan toult have teparet carat thich is, hotever, not intentet.
s: The affix चर (with the feminine in ङीप्) comes after a प्रातिपदिक (Nominal Stem), the word retaining its detonation when the meaning is 'this had been before'. The word भूतपूर्व is a compound of पूर्व and भूतः the compounding being by सुप्सुपा, and denotes something done in a past time. Thus आढ्यो भतपूर्वः = आढ्यचरः 'once opulent'. सुकुमारचरः The ट् indicates that the feminine will be in ङीप्; as, आढ्यचरी The च् is not इत् in चरट् though required by (1.3. 7). This proves that चुटु rule is anitya. The sutra [[5.2.18]] might have been read after this, with the saving of the word भूतपूर्वः, but then खञ् would have debarred चरट् which is, however, not intended.

pk: arter a pratipadika (noninal sten) ending in the Genitive 6th-Case cones the aril rupya and also caraw in the sense or having belonged rornerly to sonebody. The word Butapurva here qualiries the sense or the aril, and not the sense or the base, as it in the last sutra. Thus devadatasya Butapurvo gO = devadatarupya the cow that rornerly belonged to Devadata. sinilarly devadatacara

s: After a प्रातिपदिक (Nominal Stem) ending in the Genitive 6th-Case comes the affix रूप्य and also चरट् in the sense of 'having belonged formerly to somebody'. The word भूतपूर्व here qualifies the sense of the affix, and not the sense of the base, as it in the last sutra. Thus देवदत्तस्य भूतपूर्वो गौः = देवदत्तरूप्यः 'the cow that formerly belonged to Devadatta'. Similarly देवदत्तचरः

pk: When the sense is that or surpasing, there cone the ariles tanap (tana) and isWan (isWa) arter a pratipadika (noninal sten) the word retaining its denotation. These ariles rorn the superlative degre. The word atisayana is an iregular rorn or atisayanan, and it qualiries the sense or the prinitive. The svarTika ariles sonetines qualiry the sense or the prinitive. Thus aQyatana = sarva ine aQya, ayanesanatisayenaQya the richest i. e. these are al rich, but he surpases then al in riches. sinilarly darsaniyatana nost handsone. sukunaratana &c. sinilarly pawu-pawisWa, guru-garisWa, laGu-laGisWa [6.4.15]. When anong superlatives, rurther elcelence is indicated, then these words nay take aditional ariles : as sresWa, though a superlative, rorns sresWatana as devo va savita prarpayatu sresWatanaya karnane yuDisWira sresWatana kurunaniti
ck: then the sense is that or surpasink, there cone the ariles tanap (tana) ant istan (ista) arter a pratipatika (noninal sten) the tort retainink its tenotation. these ariles rorn the superlative tekre. the tort atisayana is an irekular rorn or atisayanan, ant it tualiries the sense or the prinitive. the svartika ariles sonetines tualiry the sense or the prinitive. thus atyatana = sarva ine atya, ayanesanatisayenatya the richest i. e. these are al rich, put he surpases then al in riches. sinilarly tarsaniyatana nost hantsone. sukunaratana &c. sinilarly patu-patista, kuru-karista, laku-lakista [6.4.15]. then anonk superlatives, rurther elcelence is inticatet, then these torts nay take atitional ariles : as sresta, thoukh a superlative, rorns srestatana as tevo va savita prarpayatu srestatanaya karnane yutistira srestatana kurunaniti
s: When the sense is that of surpassing, there come the affixes तमप् (तम) and इष्ठन् (इष्ठ) after a प्रातिपदिक (Nominal Stem) the word retaining its denotation. These affixes form the superlative degree. The word अतिशायन is an irregular form of अतिशयनं, and it qualifies the sense of the primitive. The स्वार्थिक affixes sometimes qualify the sense of the primitive. Thus आढ्यतमः = सर्व इमे आढ्याः, अयमेषामतिशयेनाढ्यः 'the richest' i. e. 'these are all rich, but he surpasses them all in riches'. Similarly दर्शनीयतमः 'most handsome'. सुकुमारतमः &c. Similarly पटु-पटिष्ठः, गुरु-गरिष्ठः, लघु-लघिष्ठः [[6.4.155]]. When among superlatives, further excellence is indicated, then these words may take additional affixes : as श्रेष्ठ, though a superlative, forms श्रेष्ठतमः As देवो वः सविता प्रार्पयतु श्रेष्ठतमाय कर्मणे युधिष्ठिरः श्रेष्ठतमः कुरूणामिति

Thus pacatitanan (the an is aded by [5.4.1] = sarva ine pacantiti, ayanesanatisayena pacati, he coks surprisingly. jalpatitanan &c. The aril isWan never cones arter a verb, as by [5.3.58], it is restricted to adjectives.
ck: so also arter a rinite verp, cones the aril tanap (tana) then surpasink is neant py nyapratipatikat (iV. i.i) those rorce runs throukhout, the tathita ariles are ortainet only arter noninal stens; they toult not have cone arter verps, hence this sutra. thus pacatitanan (the an is atet py [5.4.1] = sarva ine pacantiti, ayanesanatisayena pacati, he coks surprisinkly. calpatitanan &c. the aril istan never cones arter a verp, as py [5.3.58], it is restrictet to atcectives.
s: So also after a finite verb, comes the affix तमप् (तम) when 'surpassing' is meant By ङ्याप्प्रातिपदिकात् (IV. I.I) whose force runs throughout, the taddhita affixes are ordained only after nominal stems; they would not have come after verbs, hence this sutra. Thus पचतितमाम् (the आम् is added by [[5.4.11]] = सर्व इमे पचन्तीति, अयमेषामतिशयेन पचति, 'he cooks surprisingly'. जल्पतितमाम् &c. The affix इष्ठन् never comes after a verb, as by [[5.3.58]], it is restricted to adjectives.

pk: The ariles tarap (tara) and iyasun (iyas) cone in the sense or surpasing arter a pratipadika (noninal sten) or a rinite-verb when it elpreses (conparison betwen) two things or when that which is aded to it (upapada) is to be distinguished ron another. The word dvivacana does not nean dual, but neans an elpresion ror two. viBajya is iregularly rorned by yat, and neans that which is to be distinguished or direrentiated. This debars tanap and isWan The rule or yaTasanKya [1.3.10] does not aply here. rirst to take an elanple or dvivacana or when conparison is betwen two things : thus: dvavinavaQyO, ayananayoratisayena = aQyatara both are rich, but he is richer anongst the two. sinilarly sukunaratara, pacatitaran, jalpatitaran [5.4.1]: or with iyasun : as, dvavinO pawu, ayananayoratisayena pawu = pawiyan nore skilrul or the two, laGiyan secondly to take an elanple or viBajyate copapade i.e. when a word in construction is to be direrentiated: thus naTura pawaliputrakeBya aQyatara The nen or nathura are richer than those or Pataliputra. ere there are nore than two things, but as the words are elpresed in the sentence, the conparative degre in plural nunber is used. sinilarly darsaniyatara, pawiyansa, laGiyansa Or course al these words nust be plural, as they rerer to nore than two persons.
ck: the ariles tarap (tara) ant iyasun (iyas) cone in the sense or surpasink arter a pratipatika (noninal sten) or a rinite-verp then it elpreses (conparison peten) to thinks or then that thich is atet to it (upapata) is to pe tistinkuishet ron another. the tort tvivacana toes not nean tual, put neans an elpresion ror to. vipacya is irekularly rornet py yat, ant neans that thich is to pe tistinkuishet or tirerentiatet. this tepars tanap ant istan the rule or yatasankya [1.3.10] toes not aply here. rirst to take an elanple or tvivacana or then conparison is peten to thinks : thus: tvavinavatyO, ayananayoratisayena = atyatara poth are rich, put he is richer anonkst the to. sinilarly sukunaratara, pacatitaran, calpatitaran [5.4.1]: or tith iyasun : as, tvavinO patu, ayananayoratisayena patu = patiyan nore skilrul or the to, lakiyan secontly to take an elanple or vipacyate copapate i.e. then a tort in construction is to pe tirerentiatet: thus natura pataliputrakepya atyatara the nen or nathura are richer than those or pataliputra. ere there are nore than to thinks, put as the torts are elpreset in the sentence, the conparative tekre in plural nunper is uset. sinilarly tarsaniyatara, patiyansa, lakiyansa Or course al these torts nust pe plural, as they rerer to nore than to persons.
s: The affixes तरप् (तर) and ईयसुन् (ईयस्) come in the sense of 'surpassing' after a प्रातिपदिक (Nominal Stem) or a finite-verb when it expresses (comparison between) two things or when that which is added to it (उपपद) is to be distinguished from another. The word द्विवचन does not mean 'dual', but means an expression for two. विभज्य is irregularly formed by यत्, and means 'that which is to be distinguished or differentiated'. This debars तमप् and इष्ठन् The rule of यथासंख्य [[1.3.10]] does not apply here. First to take an example of द्विवचन or when comparison is between two things : thus: द्वाविमावाढ्यौ, अयमनयोरतिशयेन = आढ्यतरः 'both are rich, but he is richer amongst the two'. Similarly सुकुमारतरः, पचतितराम्, जल्पतितराम् [[5.4.11]]: or with इयसुन् : as, द्वाविमौ पटू, अयमनयोरतिशयेन पटुः = पटीयान् 'more skillful of the two', लघीयान् Secondly to take an example of विभज्यते चोपपदे i.e. when a word in construction is to be differentiated: thus माथुराः पाटलिपुत्रकेभ्य आढ्यतराः 'The men of Mathura are richer than those of Pataliputra'. Here there are more than two things, but as the words are expressed in the sentence, the comparative degree in plural number is used. Similarly दर्शनीयतराः, पटीयांसः, लघीयांसः Of course all these words must be plural, as they refer to more than two persons.

pk: The two ariles begining with a vowel i.e. iyas and isWa are aded only arter words denoting atributes. The ariles isWan and iyasun are restricted in their scope by this sutra i. e. they cone only arter adjectives or adverbs, in elpresing conparative and superlative degres. Thus laGiyan , laGiswa, pawiyan, pawiswa; but not arter words like pacaka &c. There we have pacakatara, pacakatana The word eva only restricts the scope or the ariles, and not or the prinitives. Thus pawutara, pawutana are also valid rorns.
ck: the to ariles pekinink tith a votel i.e. iyas ant ista are atet only arter torts tenotink atriputes. the ariles istan ant iyasun are restrictet in their scope py this sutra i. e. they cone only arter atcectives or atverps, in elpresink conparative ant superlative tekres. thus lakiyan , lakista, patiyan, patista; put not arter torts like pacaka &c. there te have pacakatara, pacakatana the tort eva only restricts the scope or the ariles, ant not or the prinitives. thus patutara, patutana are also valit rorns.
s: The two affixes beginning with a vowel i.e. ईयस् and इष्ठ are added only after words denoting attributes. The affixes इष्ठन् and ईयसुन् are restricted in their scope by this sutra i. e. they come only after adjectives or adverbs, in expressing comparative and superlative degrees. Thus लघीयान् , लघिष्टः, पटीयान्, पटिष्टः; but not after words like पाचक &c. There we have पाचकतरः, पाचकतमः The word एव 'only' restricts the scope of the affixes, and not of the primitives. Thus पटुतरः, पटुतमः are also valid forms.

pk: The ariles isWan and iyasun cone in the Candas (Vedas) arter a pratipadika (noninal sten) ending in tr The tu is ablative or tr which includes both trn and trc This eltends the aplication or these ariles to words other than atributes. Thus atisayena karta = karisWa (kartr + isWan = kar + isWa by [6.4.154], tr is elided) as asurti karisWa, dohiyasi Denu By Vartika under [6.3.35] dohitri is changed into nasculine dohitr and then iyas is aded, when tr is elided by [6.4.154].
ck: the ariles istan ant iyasun cone in the cantas (Vetas) arter a pratipatika (noninal sten) entink in tr the tu is aplative or tr thich inclutes poth trn ant trc this eltents the aplication or these ariles to torts other than atriputes. thus atisayena karta = karista (kartr + istan = kar + ista py [6.4.154], tr is elitet) as asurti karista, tohiyasi tenu py Vartika unter [6.3.35] tohitri is chanket into nasculine tohitr ant then iyas is atet, then tr is elitet py [6.4.154].
s: The affixes इष्ठन् and इयसुन् come in the छन्दस् (Vedas) after a प्रातिपदिक (Nominal Stem) ending in तृ The तुः is ablative of तृ which includes both तृन् and तृच् This extends the application of these affixes to words other than attributes. Thus अतिशयेन कर्ता = करिष्ठः (कर्तृ + इष्ठन् = कर् + इष्ठ by [[6.4.154]], तृ is elided) As आसुर्ति करिष्ठः, दोहीयसी धेनुः By Vartika under [[6.3.35]] दोहित्री is changed into masculine दोहितृ and then ईयस् is added, when तृ is elided by [[6.4.154]].

pk: ror prasasya is substituted sra when the ariles isWan and iyasun rolow. Though prasasya is not an atribute, it takes these ariles by the aplication or this rule. The anuvriti or ajadi runs here, but the word nust be changed into locative ror the purposes or this aphorisn, and which wil read thus prasasyasya srojadyo Thus sarva ine prasasya ayanesanatisayena prasasya = sresWa, uBavinO prasasyO, ayananayoratisayena prasasya = sreyan nule [6.4.163] prevents the elision or the a or sra, which otherwise would have ben elided by [6.4.148] and [5.4.15]. These words are equal to prasasyatara and prasasyatana
ck: ror prasasya is supstitutet sra then the ariles istan ant iyasun rolot. thoukh prasasya is not an atripute, it takes these ariles py the aplication or this rule. the anuvriti or acati runs here, put the tort nust pe chanket into locative ror the purposes or this aphorisn, ant thich til reat thus prasasyasya srocatyo thus sarva ine prasasya ayanesanatisayena prasasya = sresta, upavinO prasasyO, ayananayoratisayena prasasya = sreyan nule [6.4.163] prevents the elision or the a or sra, thich othertise toult have pen elitet py [6.4.148] ant [5.4.15]. these torts are etual to prasasyatara ant prasasyatana
s: For प्रशस्य is substituted श्र when the affixes इष्ठन् and इयसुन् follow. Though प्रशस्य is not an attribute, it takes these affixes by the application of this rule. The anuvritti of अजादी runs here, but the word must be changed into locative for the purposes of this aphorism, and which will read thus प्रशस्यस्य श्रोऽजाद्योः Thus सर्व इमे प्रशस्या अयमेषामतिशयेन प्रशस्यः = श्रेष्ठः, उभाविमौ प्रशस्यौ, अयमनयोरतिशयेन प्रशस्यः = श्रेयान् Rule [[6.4.163]] prevents the elision of the अ of श्र, which otherwise would have been elided by [[6.4.148]] and [[5.4.155]]. These words are equal to प्रशस्यतरः and प्रशस्यतमः

pk: ror prasasya is also substituted jya when the ariles isWan and iyasun rolow. as jyesWa, jyayan (a is substituted ror the i or iyas by [6.4.160]).
ck: ror prasasya is also supstitutet cya then the ariles istan ant iyasun rolot. as cyesta, cyayan (a is supstitutet ror the i or iyas py [6.4.160]).
s: For प्रशस्य is also substituted ज्य when the affixes इष्ठन् and इयसुन् follow. As ज्येष्ठः, ज्यायान् (आ is substituted for the ई of ईयस् by [[6.4.160]]).

pk: jya is also substituted ror vrdDa when the ariles isWan and iyasun rolow. Thus jyesWa the oldest, jyayan the older. By [6.4.157], varsi is also substituted ror vrdDa; and we have varsisWa and varsiyan also. The word vrdDa though not a gunavachana, takes these ariles by the inplication or this sutra.
ck: cya is also supstitutet ror vrta then the ariles istan ant iyasun rolot. thus cyesta the oltest, cyayan the olter. py [6.4.157], varsi is also supstitutet ror vrta; ant te have varsista ant varsiyan also. the tort vrta thoukh not a kunavachana, takes these ariles py the inplication or this sutra.
s: ज्य is also substituted for वृद्ध when the affixes इष्ठन् and इयसुन् follow. Thus ज्येष्ठः 'the oldest', ज्यायान् 'the older'. By [[6.4.157]], वर्षि is also substituted for वृद्ध; and we have वर्षीष्ठः and वर्षीयान् also. The word वृद्ध though not a gunavachana, takes these affixes by the implication of this sutra.

pk: ror antika is substituted neda and ror baQa is saDa when the ariles isWan and iyasun rolow. Thus nedisWan, nediya, saDisWa and saDiyan sarvaninanyantikani idanesanatisayena, nediswan uBe ine antike idananayoratisayena nediya idanasnanediya sarvaine baQanaDiyate ayanasnatsaDiyoDite
ck: ror antika is supstitutet neta ant ror pata is sata then the ariles istan ant iyasun rolot. thus netistan, netiya, satista ant satiyan sarvaninanyantikani itanesanatisayena, netistan upe ine antike itananayoratisayena netiya itanasnanetiya sarvaine patanatiyate ayanasnatsatiyotite
s: For अन्तिक is substituted नेद and for बाढ is साध when the affixes इष्ठन् and इयसुन् follow. Thus नेदिष्ठम्, नेदीयः, साधिष्ठः and साधीयान् सर्वाणीमान्यन्तिकानि इदमेषामतिशयेन, नेदिष्टम् उभे इमे अन्तिके इदमनयोरतिशयेन नेदीयः इदमस्मान्नेदीयः सर्वइमे बाढमधीयते अयमस्मात्साधीयोधीते

pk: Berore the ariles isWan and iyasun , kan is optionaly substituted ror yuvan and alpa Thus kanisWa, kaniyan or yavisWa, yaviyan; sinilarly alpisWa, alpiyan, or kanisWa, kaniyan sarvaine yuvana, ayanesanatisayena, kanisWa dvavinO yuvanO ayananayoratisayena, kaniyan yaviswa yaviyan sarvainelpa ayanesanatisayena, kanisWa uBavinavalpavayananayoratisayena kaniyan ayanasnatkaniyan alpisWa alpiyaniti va
ck: perore the ariles istan ant iyasun , kan is optionaly supstitutet ror yuvan ant alpa thus kanista, kaniyan or yavista, yaviyan; sinilarly alpista, alpiyan, or kanista, kaniyan sarvaine yuvana, ayanesanatisayena, kanista tvavinO yuvanO ayananayoratisayena, kaniyan yavista yaviyan sarvainelpa ayanesanatisayena, kanista upavinavalpavayananayoratisayena kaniyan ayanasnatkaniyan alpista alpiyaniti va
s: Before the affixes इष्ठन् and इयसुन् , कन् is optionally substituted for युवन् and अल्प Thus कनिष्ठः, कनीयान् or यविष्ठः, यवीयान्; similarly अल्पिष्ठ, अल्पीयान्, or कनिष्ठः, कनीयान् सर्वइमे युवानः, अयमेषामतिशयेन, कनिष्ठः द्वाविमौ युवानौ अयमनयोरतिशयेन, कनीयान् यविष्टः यवीयान् सर्वइमेऽल्पाः अयमेषामतिशयेन, कनिष्ठः उभाविमावल्पावयमनयोरतिशयेन कनीयान् अयमस्मात्कनीयान् अल्पिष्ठः अल्पीयानिति वा

pk: The ariles vin and nat are luk elided when isWan and iyasun rolow. Thus sragvin-srajisWa, srajiyan; tvagvat-tvacisWa, tvaciyan sarvaine sragvina, ayanesanatisayena, srajisWa uBavinO sragvinO, ayananayoratisayena, srajiyan ayanasnat srajiyan sarvaine tvagvanta ayanesanatisayena, tvacisWa uBavinO tvagvantO, ayananayoratisayena, tvaciyan ayanasnatvaciyan This sutra is a jnapaka or indicator that words ending in vin and nat or vat rorn their conparative and superlative degres by ading iyas and isWan
ck: the ariles vin ant nat are luk elitet then istan ant iyasun rolot. thus srakvin-sracista, sraciyan; tvakvat-tvacista, tvaciyan sarvaine srakvina, ayanesanatisayena, sracista upavinO srakvinO, ayananayoratisayena, sraciyan ayanasnat sraciyan sarvaine tvakvanta ayanesanatisayena, tvacista upavinO tvakvantO, ayananayoratisayena, tvaciyan ayanasnatvaciyan this sutra is a cnapaka or inticator that torts entink in vin ant nat or vat rorn their conparative ant superlative tekres py atink iyas ant istan
s: The affixes विन् and मत् are लुक् elided when इष्ठन् and इयसुन् follow. Thus स्रग्विन्-स्रजिष्ठः, स्रजीयान्; त्वग्वत्-त्वचिष्ठः, त्वचीयान् सर्वइमे स्रग्विणः, अयमेषामतिशयेन, स्रजिष्ठः उभाविमौ स्रग्विणौ, अयमनयोरतिशयेन, स्रजीयान् अयमस्मात् स्रजीयाम् सर्वइमे त्वग्वन्तः अयमेषामतिशयेन, त्वचिष्ठः उभाविमौ त्वग्वन्तौ, अयमनयोरतिशयेन, त्वचीयाम् अयमस्मात्त्वचीयान् This sutra is a jnapaka or indicator that words ending in विन् and मत् or वत् form their comparative and superlative degrees by adding ईयस् and इष्ठन्

pk: The aril rupap cones without a change or conotation arter a sten - noninal or verbal, denoting praise. The word prasansa neans praise, and it qualiries the sense or the prinitive; i. e. when the sense or the prinitive is that or praise, then rupap is aded. as a general rule the svarTika ariles, which do not change the denotation or the word, serve the purpose or proninently bringing rorward one particular neaning out or the several neanings posesed by a prinitive. Thus prasasto vEyakarana = vEyakaranarupa a celebrated Granarian. so also yajnikarupa The praise nay be inplied by the sense or the prinitive, without being absolute praise: thus corarupa a celebrated thier, dasyurupa a celebrated rober; a person very elpert in his evil courses even; these word being aplied to a thier who is so delterous that he can steal the colyriun ron the eye-lashes, or a horse ron under the rider, without the later being aware or it. The aril cones arter a verbal word ending in tin, ror the word tinasca [5.3.56] is understod here also. Thus pacatirupan, pacatorupan or pacantirupan who is celebrated, who two are celebrated or who al are celebrated in coking. These words pacatirupan &c canot take dual or plural; because the action denoted by the verb is only one, not nany. These words are always in the neuter gender, by the general usage or the people.
