s: There is vocalisation of the semi-vowel य् of the affix ष्यङ् [[4.1.78]] when followed in a तत्-पुरुष compound, by the words पुत्र and पति When the words पुत्र and पति are the second members; forming a Tatpurusha compound, there is samprasarana (vocalising the semi-vowels) of the affix ष्यङ् of the preceding. That is य् is changed into इ Thus करीषस्येव गन्धोऽस्य = करीषगन्धिः (a Bahuvrihi compound taking the samasanta affix or rather substitute इ by [[5.4.137]] करीषगन्धैरपत्यम् = करीषगन्धि + अण् [[4.1.92]] = करीषगन्धः The feminine of this will be formed by adding ष्यङ् [[4.1.78]]. Thus we have कारीषगन्ध्या (see [[4.1.78]]). Now in forming the Tatpurusha compound of this word with पुत्र or पति, the final य् will be changed into इ and we have कारीषगन्धीपुत्रः, कारीषगन्धीपतिः The आ of या becomes merged into इ [[6.1.108]], and the short इ is lengthened [[6.3.139]]. So also कौमुदगन्धीपुत्रः or कौमुदगन्धीपतिः Why do we say "of the affix ष्यङ्"? Observe इभ्यापुत्रः, क्षत्रियापुत्रः Why do we say "when followed by पुत्र or पति"? Observe कारीषगन्ध्याकुलम्, कौमुदगन्ध्याकुलम् Why do we say "when forming a Tatpurusha compound"? Observe कारीषगन्ध्यापतिरस्य ग्रामस्य = कारीषगन्ध्यापतिरयं ग्रामः It is a Bahuvrihi compound. The affix ष्यङ् is here the feminine affix य followed by चाप् (आ) (see [[4.1.77]] and [[4.1.74]]. A general maxim relating to all affixes is "an affix denotes whenever it is employed in Grammar, a word-form which begins with that to which that affix has been added, and ends with the affix itself: प्रत्ययग्रहणे यस्मात् स विहितस्तदादेस्तदन्तस्य ग्रहणम्" This maxim, however, does not apply in case of feminine affixes, where we have this rule "a feminine affix denotes whenever it is employed in a rule, a word-form which ends with that affix, but which need not necessarily begin with that to which the affix has been added, but where the word form is subordinate: "स्त्रीप्रत्यये चानुपसर्जने न" Thus we have परमकारीषगन्ध्यायाः पुत्रः = परमकारीषगन्धीपुत्रः and so also परमकारीषगन्धीपतिः Not so when the word is an upasarjana or subordinate in a compound. As अतिक्रान्ता कारीषगन्ध्याम् = अतिकारीषगन्ध्या, तस्य पुत्रः = अतिकारीषगन्ध्यापुत्रः, अतिकारीषगन्ध्यापतिः This vocalisation takes place when पुत्र and पति alone, not compounded with any other word, stand at the end : not so when a word beginning or ending with these words follows. Thus कारीषगन्ध्यापुत्रकुलं, कारीषगन्ध्यापरमपुत्रः &c. Though a word ending in ष्यङ् may have many semi-vowels, yet the vocalisation takes place of the affix य (ष्यङ्) only, according to the maxim निर्दिश्यमानस्यादेशा भवन्ति "substitutes take the place of that which is actually enunciated". The word संप्रसारण has regulating influence upto [[6.1.44]] inclusive. The rules of vocalisation (change of semi-vowels into vowels) is contained in these sutras. Vart:- Prohibition must be stated when पति and पुत्र follow the word गौकाक्ष्य As गौकाक्ष्यापुत्रः, गौकाक्ष्यायातः instead of गौकाक्षीपुत्रः &c.

pk: There is vocalisation or the aril syan [4.1.78] when the word banDu rolows in a bahuvrihi conpound. Thus karisaganDyabanDurasya = karisaganDibanDu so also kOnudaganDibanDu Why do we say "when the conpound is a Bahuvrihi"? Observe karisaganDyaya banDu = karisaganDyabanDu, which is a Tatpurusha conpound. Like the last sutra, we have here also paranakarisaganDabanDu, but atikarisaganDyabanDu, karisaganDyabanDuDana, karisaganDyaparanabanDu Though the word banDuni is elhibited in the sutra in the neuter gender, it is in ract a nasculine word. Vart:- There is vocalisation or syan in a Bahuvrihi conpound with natac, natrka and natr optionaly: as karisaganDinata꣡ or karisaganDyanata꣡, karisaganDinatrka or karisaganDyanatrka, karisaganDinata, karisaganDyanata The indicatory ca or natac nakes the word take the udata on the last sylable [6.1.163], thus debaring the especial acent or the Bahuvrihi (Vi.2. i). al Bahuvrihi conpounds ending in r take the sanasanta aril kap, so natr would have becone natrka by rorce or [5.4.153], so the separate enuneration or natr and natrka here shows that kap is also optional.
ck: there is vocalisation or the aril syan [4.1.78] then the tort pantu rolots in a pahuvrihi conpount. thus karisakantyapanturasya = karisakantipantu so also kOnutakantipantu thy to te say "then the conpount is a pahuvrihi"? Opserve karisakantyaya pantu = karisakantyapantu, thich is a tatpurusha conpount. Like the last sutra, te have here also paranakarisakantapantu, put atikarisakantyapantu, karisakantyapantutana, karisakantyaparanapantu thoukh the tort pantuni is elhipitet in the sutra in the neuter kenter, it is in ract a nasculine tort. Vart:- there is vocalisation or syan in a pahuvrihi conpount tith natac, natrka ant natr optionaly: as karisakantinata꣡ or karisakantyanata꣡, karisakantinatrka or karisakantyanatrka, karisakantinata, karisakantyanata the inticatory ca or natac nakes the tort take the utata on the last sylaple [6.1.163], thus teparink the especial acent or the pahuvrihi (Vi.2. i). al pahuvrihi conpounts entink in r take the sanasanta aril kap, so natr toult have pecone natrka py rorce or [5.4.153], so the separate enuneration or natr ant natrka here shots that kap is also optional.
s: There is vocalisation of the affix ष्यङ् [[4.1.78]] when the word बन्धु follows in a बहुव्रीही compound. Thus कारीषगन्ध्याबन्धुरस्य = कारीषगन्धीबन्धुः So also कौमुदगन्धीबन्धुः Why do we say "when the compound is a Bahuvrihi"? Observe कारीषगन्ध्याया बन्धुः = कारीषगन्ध्याबन्धुः, which is a Tatpurusha compound. Like the last sutra, we have here also परमकारीषगन्धबन्धुः, but अतिकारीषगन्ध्याबन्धुः, कारीषगन्ध्याबन्धुधनः, कारीषगन्ध्यापरमबन्धुः Though the word बन्धुनि is exhibited in the sutra in the neuter gender, it is in fact a masculine word. Vart:- There is vocalisation of ष्यङ् in a Bahuvrihi compound with मातच्, मातृक and मातृ optionally: as कारीषगन्धीमातः꣡ or कारीषगन्ध्यामातः꣡, कारीषगन्धीमातृकः or कारीषगन्ध्यामातृकः, कारीषगन्धीमाता, कारीषगन्ध्यामाता The indicatory च of मातच् makes the word take the udatta on the last syllable [[6.1.163]], thus debarring the especial accent of the Bahuvrihi (VI.2. I). All Bahuvrihi compounds ending in ऋ take the samasanta affix कप्, so मातृ would have become मातृक by force of [[5.4.153]], so the separate enumeration of मातृ and मातृक here shows that कप् is also optional.

pk: The seni-vowels or the rots vac , svap , and yajadi verbs are vocalised when rolowed by an aril having an indicatory ka The anuvriti or syan does not run into this sutra. The rot vaca includes the vaca pariBasane or the adadi clas (i.54) and the vac substitute or bru [2.4.53] svap is the rot nisvap saye or the adadi clas (i 59). The yajadi verbs are the last nine rots or the Bhvadi clas vis. yaj, vap, vaha, vas, ven, syen, hven, vad and svi The senivowels or these eleven verbs are changed into the coresponding vowel, when an aril having an indicatory ka is aded to then. Thus with the Past Participle ariles kta and ktavatu third we have the rolowing rorns:- vac -ukta, uktavan , [8.2.30]. 2 svap - supta, suptavan 3 yaj - iswa, iswavan. [8.2.36] 4 vap -upta, uptavan, 5 vah - uQa, uQavan [8.2.31], [8.2.40], [8.3.13] and [6.3.1] 6 vas - usita usitavan, [7.2.56] [8.3.60] 7 ven - uta, utavan, 8 vyen - sanvita, sanvitavan, 9 hven - huta, hutavan, 10 vad - udita, uditavan , 1 duosvi - suna, sunavan Dato svarupagrahane tatpratyaya karye vijnayate- When in a Granatical rule, an operation (dependant on an aril) is taught with regard to a rot (dhatu) by nentioning particular verbs (dhatu) speciricaly, and not by using the word "dhatu", generaly, then the operation takes place only when the rot is rolowed by such an aril as can be aded to rots by enunciating the word Dato The elistence or this nalin is inrered in the rornation or the word BrOnahatyan in [6.4.174], which se. Thererore, there is no vocalisation or vac in the rolowing vacyati, vacika ere vacyati is rorned by ading kyac to vac (vacanicCati) vac is rorned by kvip aded to vac, the vowel being lengthened and sanprasarana being elpresly prevented by unadi i.57. now, it is a general rule that a rot taking the aril kvip, viw, or vic does not lose its character or a dhatu. Thererore vac is a rot (Datu), and it ought to take vocalisation berore the aril kyac But kyac is not enunciated to cone arter a dhatu, but arter a subanta (supatnana kyac [3.1.8]) in the rule ordaining its ariling. so also vacika rorned by ading Wak to vac (se Vartika V. 3.83).
ck: the seni-votels or the rots vac , svap , ant yacati verps are vocaliset then rolotet py an aril havink an inticatory ka the anuvriti or syan toes not run into this sutra. the rot vaca inclutes the vaca paripasane or the atati clas (i.54) ant the vac supstitute or pru [2.4.53] svap is the rot nisvap saye or the atati clas (i 59). the yacati verps are the last nine rots or the phvati clas vis. yac, vap, vaha, vas, ven, syen, hven, vat ant svi the senivotels or these eleven verps are chanket into the corespontink votel, then an aril havink an inticatory ka is atet to then. thus tith the past participle ariles kta ant ktavatu thirt te have the rolotink rorns:- vac -ukta, uktavan , [8.2.30]. 2 svap - supta, suptavan 3 yac - ista, istavan. [8.2.36] 4 vap -upta, uptavan, 5 vah - uta, utavan [8.2.31], [8.2.40], [8.3.13] ant [6.3.1] 6 vas - usita usitavan, [7.2.56] [8.3.60] 7 ven - uta, utavan, 8 vyen - sanvita, sanvitavan, 9 hven - huta, hutavan, 10 vat - utita, utitavan , 1 tuosvi - suna, sunavan tato svarupakrahane tatpratyaya karye vicnayate- then in a kranatical rule, an operation (tepentant on an aril) is taukht tith rekart to a rot (thatu) py nentionink particular verps (thatu) speciricaly, ant not py usink the tort "thatu", keneraly, then the operation takes place only then the rot is rolotet py such an aril as can pe atet to rots py enunciatink the tort tato the elistence or this nalin is inreret in the rornation or the tort prOnahatyan in [6.4.174], thich se. thererore, there is no vocalisation or vac in the rolotink vacyati, vacika ere vacyati is rornet py atink kyac to vac (vacanicati) vac is rornet py kvip atet to vac, the votel peink lenkthenet ant sanprasarana peink elpresly preventet py unati i.57. not, it is a keneral rule that a rot takink the aril kvip, vit, or vic toes not lose its character or a thatu. thererore vac is a rot (tatu), ant it oukht to take vocalisation perore the aril kyac put kyac is not enunciatet to cone arter a thatu, put arter a supanta (supatnana kyac [3.1.8]) in the rule ortainink its arilink. so also vacika rornet py atink tak to vac (se Vartika V. 3.83).
s: The semi-vowels of the roots वच् , स्वप् , and यजादि verbs are vocalised when followed by an affix having an indicatory क The anuvritti of ष्यङ् does not run into this sutra. The root वच includes the वच परिभाषने of the Adadi class (II.54) and the वच् substitute of ब्रू [[2.4.53]] स्वप् is the root ञिष्वप् शये of the Adadi class (II 59). The यजादि verbs are the last nine roots of the Bhvadi class viz. यज्, वप्, वह, वस्, वेञ्, ष्येञ्, ह्वेञ्, वद् and श्वि The semivowels of these eleven verbs are changed into the corresponding vowel, when an affix having an indicatory क is added to them. Thus with the Past Participle affixes क्त and क्तवतु third we have the following forms:- वच् -उक्तः, उक्तवान् , [[8.2.30]]. 2 स्वप् - सुप्तः, सुप्तवान् 3 यज् - इष्टः, इष्टवान्. [[8.2.36]] 4 वप् -उप्तः, उप्तवान्, 5 वह् - ऊढः, ऊढवान् [[8.2.31]], [[8.2.40]], [[8.3.13]] and [[6.3.111]] 6 वस् - ऊषितः ऊषितवान्, [[7.2.56]] [[8.3.60]] 7 वेञ् - उतः, उतवान्, 8 व्येञ् - संवीतः, संवीतवान्, 9 ह्वेञ् - हूतः, हूतवान्, 10 वद् - उदितः, उदितवान् , 11 दुओश्वि - शूनः, शूनवान् धातो स्वरुपग्रहणे तत्प्रत्यय कार्ये विज्ञायतेः- When in a Grammatical rule, an operation (dependant on an affix) is taught with regard to a root (dhatu) by mentioning particular verbs (dhatu) specifically, and not by using the word "dhatu", generally, then the operation takes place only when the root is followed by such an affix as can be added to roots by emunciating the word धातोः The existence of this maxim is inferred in the formation of the word भ्रौणहत्यम् in [[6.4.174]], which see. Therefore, there is no vocalisation of वच् in the following वाच्यति, वाचिकः Here वाच्यति is formed by adding क्यच् to वाच् (वाचमिच्छति) वाच् is formed by क्विप् added to वच्, the vowel being lengthened and samprasarana being expressly prevented by Unadi II.57. Now, it is a general rule that a root taking the affix क्विप्, विट्, or विच् does not lose its character of a dhatu. Therefore वाच् is a root (धातु), and it ought to take vocalisation before the affix क्यच् But क्यच् is not enunciated to come after a dhatu, but after a सुबन्त (सुपआत्मनः क्यच् [[3.1.8]]) in the rule ordaining its affixing. So also वाचिकः formed by adding ठक् to वाच् (See Vartika V. 3.83).

pk: There is vocalisation or the seni-vowels or the rolowing verbs, when an aril having an indicatory k or n rolows - graha to take, jya to becone old, ven to weave, vyaDa to strike, vasa to shine, vyaca to deceive, vrasca to cut, pracCa to ask and Brasja to cok, to ry. By rorce or the word ca and, the anuvriti or kiti is read into this sutra. Thus 1. graha — grhita, grhitavan (by kta and ktavatu), grhnati (1.2. 4), jarigrhyate (by yana or the intensive). 2. jya - jina, jinavan [8.2.4] ta changed to na), jinati (1.2. 4), the short i is lengthened by [6.4.2] and is shortened again by [7.3.80]. jejiyate (yan), 3. vayi - The rot ven is replaced by vaya when liw rolows [2.4.41]. This vayi can have no nit aril arter it, it takes only liw terninations, which as we know are kit [1.2.5]. The elanples, thererore given wil be or kit ariles only. Thus uyatu, uyatu now arises this question why do you enunerate vayi, ror is not ven (ror which vayi is substituted) already included in yajadi clas or verbs given in the last sutra, and by rorce or that sutra, vayi wil get sanprasarana berore kit ariles". The reply is "vayi is nunerated here in order to show that the prohibition or sanprasarana with regard to ven as taught in [6.1.40], does not aply to its substitute vayi in the Perect Tense". Thus while the Perect or ven is vavO, vavatu, vavu, the Perect or its substitute vayi is uvaya, uyatu and uyu nore over [6.1.38] teaches that the ya or vaya is not vocalised in liw ariles, which thererore, inplies jnapaka) that the other senivowel i. e. va or vaya wil be vocalised. 4. vyaDa - vidDa, vidDavan, and with nit ariles viDyati, veviDyate 5. vasa - usita, usitavan, and with nit ariles uswa, usanti 6. vyaca - vicita, vicitavan vicati, vevicyate By a Vartika under [1.2.1], the word vyaca is considered to belong to kuwadi clas, and thererore al ariles arter it, other than those having an indicatory n, n or the aril as, are considered as nit, and thererore, there wil be sanprasarana berore these ariles : as, udvicita, udvicitun, udvicitavyan 7. vrsca — vrkana, vrkanavan ow is the rinal c or vrasca changed into k, ror by [8.2.36] ca ought to have ben changed into sa berore the Jaladi aril kta ? To this we reply the aril kta is replaced by na [7.2.42] and as this na is not a Jaladi aril, nule [8.2.36] does not aply. This is done on the rolowing nalin: "The substitute or the nishtha should be considered to be sidha or erective when aplying the rules relating to the change or a leter
ck: there is vocalisation or the seni-votels or the rolotink verps, then an aril havink an inticatory k or n rolots - kraha to take, cya to pecone olt, ven to teave, vyata to strike, vasa to shine, vyaca to teceive, vrasca to cut, praca to ask ant prasca to cok, to ry. py rorce or the tort ca ant, the anuvriti or kiti is reat into this sutra. thus 1. kraha — krhita, krhitavan (py kta ant ktavatu), krhnati (1.2. 4), carikrhyate (py yana or the intensive). 2. cya - cina, cinavan [8.2.4] ta chanket to na), cinati (1.2. 4), the short i is lenkthenet py [6.4.2] ant is shortenet akain py [7.3.80]. ceciyate (yan), 3. vayi - the rot ven is replacet py vaya then lit rolots [2.4.41]. this vayi can have no nit aril arter it, it takes only lit terninations, thich as te knot are kit [1.2.5]. the elanples, thererore kiven til pe or kit ariles only. thus uyatu, uyatu not arises this tuestion thy to you enunerate vayi, ror is not ven (ror thich vayi is supstitutet) alreaty inclutet in yacati clas or verps kiven in the last sutra, ant py rorce or that sutra, vayi til ket sanprasarana perore kit ariles". the reply is "vayi is nuneratet here in orter to shot that the prohipition or sanprasarana tith rekart to ven as taukht in [6.1.40], toes not aply to its supstitute vayi in the perect tense". thus thile the perect or ven is vavO, vavatu, vavu, the perect or its supstitute vayi is uvaya, uyatu ant uyu nore over [6.1.38] teaches that the ya or vaya is not vocaliset in lit ariles, thich thererore, inplies cnapaka) that the other senivotel i. e. va or vaya til pe vocaliset. 4. vyata - vita, vitavan, ant tith nit ariles vityati, vevityate 5. vasa - usita, usitavan, ant tith nit ariles usta, usanti 6. vyaca - vicita, vicitavan vicati, vevicyate py a Vartika unter [1.2.1], the tort vyaca is consiteret to pelonk to kutati clas, ant thererore al ariles arter it, other than those havink an inticatory n, n or the aril as, are consiteret as nit, ant thererore, there til pe sanprasarana perore these ariles : as, utvicita, utvicitun, utvicitavyan 7. vrsca — vrkana, vrkanavan ot is the rinal c or vrasca chanket into k, ror py [8.2.36] ca oukht to have pen chanket into sa perore the calati aril kta ? to this te reply the aril kta is replacet py na [7.2.42] ant as this na is not a calati aril, nule [8.2.36] toes not aply. this is tone on the rolotink nalin: "the supstitute or the nishtha shoult pe consiteret to pe sitha or erective then aplyink the rules relatink to the chanke or a leter into s
s: There is vocalisation of the semi-vowels of the following verbs, when an affix having an indicatory क् or ङ् follows - ग्रह 'to take', ज्या 'to become old', वेञ् 'to weave', व्यध 'to strike', वश 'to shine', व्यच 'to deceive', व्रश्च 'to cut', प्रच्छ 'to ask' and भ्रस्ज 'to cook, to fry'. By force of the word 'च' 'and', the anuvritti of किति is read into this sutra. Thus 1. ग्रह — गृहीतः, गृहीतवान् (by क्त and क्तवतु), गृह्णाति (1.2. 4), जरीगृह्यते (by यङ of the Intensive). 2. ज्या - जीनः, जीनवान् [[8.2.44]] त changed to न), जिनाति (1.2. 4), the short इ is lengthened by [[6.4.2]] and is shortened again by [[7.3.80]]. जेजीयते (यङ्), 3. वयि - The root वेञ् is replaced by वय when लिट् follows [[2.4.41]]. This वयि can have no ङित् affix after it, it takes only लिट् terminations, which as we know are कित् [[1.2.5]]. The examples, therefore given will be of कित् affixes only. Thus ऊयतुः, ऊयतुः Now arises this question 'why do you enumerate वयि, for is not वेञ् (for which वयि is substituted) already included in यजादि class of verbs given in the last sutra, and by force of that sutra, वयि will get samprasarana before कित् affixes". The reply is "वयि is numerated here in order to show that the prohibition of samprasarana with regard to वेञ् as taught in [[6.1.40]], does not apply to its substitute वयि in the Perfect Tense". Thus while the Perfect of वेञ् is ववौ, ववतुः, ववुः, the Perfect of its substitute वयि is ऊवाय, ऊयतुः and ऊयुः More over [[6.1.38]] teaches that the य of वय is not vocalised in लिट् affixes, which therefore, implies jnapaka) that the other semivowel i. e. व of वय will be vocalised. 4. व्यध - विद्धः, विद्धवान्, and with ङित् affixes विध्यति, वेविध्यते 5. वश - उशितः, उशितवान्, and with ङित् affixes उष्टः, उशन्ति 6. व्यचः - विचितः, विचितवान् विचति, वेविच्यते By a Vartika under [[1.2.1]], the word व्यच is considered to belong to कुटादि class, and therefore all affixes after it, other than those having an indicatory ण्, ञ् or the affix अस्, are considered as ङित्, and therefore, there will be samprasarana before these affixes : as, उद्विचिता, उद्विचितुम्, उद्विचितव्यम् 7. वृश्च — वृकणः, वृकणवान् How is the final च् of व्रश्च changed into क्, for by [[8.2.36]] च ought to have been changed into ष before the झलादि affix क्त ? To this we reply the affix क्त is replaced by न [[7.2.42]] and as this न is not a झलादि affix, Rule [[8.2.36]] does not apply. This is done on the following maxim: "The substitute of the Nishtha should be considered to be siddha or effective when applying the rules relating to the change of a letter into ष, to accent, to affix, and to the addition of the augment इट्". But when च is to be changed into क, the substitute is considered asiddha (not to have taken place). Thus we have the forms वृकणः &c. Before ङित् affixes we have वृश्चति, वरीवृश्च्यते 8. प्रच्छ - पृष्टः [[8.2.36]], पृष्टवान्, ङित् -पृच्छति, परीपृच्छ्यते The forms पप्रच्छ and बभ्रञ्ज would have been evolved by the simple rules of Reduplication even, without the application of this rule. But प्रच्छ+ नङ् [[3.3.90]] प्रश्नः Here there is no vocalisation, because Panini himself uses the word प्रश्नः in sutra [[3.2.117]] showing that this is the proper form though irregular. 9. भ्रस्ज - भृष्टः [[7.2.36]], भृष्टवान्, ङित् — भृञ्जति, बरीभृञ्ज्यते The स of भ्रस्ज is changed first into द by झलां जश् झशि [[8.4.53]], and then द is changed into ज by स्तोः श्चुना श्चुः [[8.4.40]].

pk: There takes place a vocalisation or the seni-vowels or the reduplicate (aByasa) or both vacyadi [6.1.15] and grahadi [6.1.16] words, when ariles or liw rolow. Thus vaca — uvaca, uvaciTa, svap — susvapa, susvapiTa, yaja — iyaja, iyajiya, wuvap — uvap, uvapiTa as regards grahadi verbs; graha — jagraha, jagrahiTa (there is no speciality in case or this verb, as these rorns would have ben evolved without even this rule). jya — jijyO, jijyaTa, vayi — uvaya, and uvayiTa; vyaDa — vivyaDa, vivyaDiTa, vasa — uvasa, uvasiTa, vyac — vivyaca, vivyaciTa, vrasca — vavrasca and vavrasciTa sone say that with regard to vrasca, it is equal whether there elisted this present rule or not. ror they argue thus, vrasca + nal = vras + vrasc + a = va + vrasc + a (haladi sesa [7.4.60]) = vavrasca To this we reply, this rorn would be evolved no doubt had this rule not elisted. But when this rule is aplied, and you nake reduplication without rirst vocalising the ra, then you wil have to vocalise va by rorce or this rule. ence the necesity or this rule with regard to vrasca also, ror having changed ra into r, we have vrvrasc and then change r into a by [7.4.6]. Then this a substitute becones sthanivat to r [1.1.59], and thererore there is no vocalisation or this va, ror rule [6.1.37], prevents the vocalisation or a leter standing berore one which has already ben vocalised. There is no speciality with regards to pracCa and Brasja verbs. This vocalisation or the reduplicate is taught with regard to those ariles which are not kit With regard to kit ariles, the nule [6.1.15] wil aply. and as the rule or vocalisation is subsequent to that or reduplication in order, thererore by the nalin or paratva [1.4.2], vocalisation wil take place rirst and then reduplication, acording to the nalin puna prasanga vijnanatsidDan "ocasionaly the rornation or a particular rorn is acounted ror by the ract that a preceding rule is alowed to aply again, arter it had previously ben superseded by a subsequent rule". Thus vac + atu (which is kit [1.2.5]) = uc + atu = uc + uc + atu = ucatu, ucu Though the phrase uBayesan could have ben suplied into this sutra by the contelt and the governing scope or the preceding sutras, its elpres nention in this sutra is ror the sake or indicating, that the rule or vocalisation supersedes even the rule or haladi sesa [7.4.60], the vocalisation nust take place at al events. Thus vyaDa + nal = vya + vyaDa + a ere by [7.4.60], the second consonant ya or vya ought to have ben
ck: there takes place a vocalisation or the seni-votels or the retuplicate (apyasa) or poth vacyati [6.1.15] ant krahati [6.1.16] torts, then ariles or lit rolot. thus vaca — uvaca, uvacita, svap — susvapa, susvapita, yaca — iyaca, iyaciya, tuvap — uvap, uvapita as rekarts krahati verps; kraha — cakraha, cakrahita (there is no speciality in case or this verp, as these rorns toult have pen evolvet tithout even this rule). cya — cicyO, cicyata, vayi — uvaya, ant uvayita; vyata — vivyata, vivyatita, vasa — uvasa, uvasita, vyac — vivyaca, vivyacita, vrasca — vavrasca ant vavrascita sone say that tith rekart to vrasca, it is etual thether there elistet this present rule or not. ror they arkue thus, vrasca + nal = vras + vrasc + a = va + vrasc + a (halati sesa [7.4.60]) = vavrasca to this te reply, this rorn toult pe evolvet no toupt hat this rule not elistet. put then this rule is apliet, ant you nake retuplication tithout rirst vocalisink the ra, then you til have to vocalise va py rorce or this rule. ence the necesity or this rule tith rekart to vrasca also, ror havink chanket ra into r, te have vrvrasc ant then chanke r into a py [7.4.6]. then this a supstitute pecones sthanivat to r [1.1.59], ant thererore there is no vocalisation or this va, ror rule [6.1.37], prevents the vocalisation or a leter stantink perore one thich has alreaty pen vocaliset. there is no speciality tith rekarts to praca ant prasca verps. this vocalisation or the retuplicate is taukht tith rekart to those ariles thich are not kit tith rekart to kit ariles, the nule [6.1.15] til aply. ant as the rule or vocalisation is supsetuent to that or retuplication in orter, thererore py the nalin or paratva [1.4.2], vocalisation til take place rirst ant then retuplication, acortink to the nalin puna prasanka vicnanatsitan "ocasionaly the rornation or a particular rorn is acountet ror py the ract that a precetink rule is alotet to aply akain, arter it hat previously pen supersetet py a supsetuent rule". thus vac + atu (thich is kit [1.2.5]) = uc + atu = uc + uc + atu = ucatu, ucu thoukh the phrase upayesan coult have pen supliet into this sutra py the contelt ant the kovernink scope or the precetink sutras, its elpres nention in this sutra is ror the sake or inticatink, that the rule or vocalisation supersetes even the rule or halati sesa [7.4.60], the vocalisation nust take place at al events. thus vyata + nal = vya + vyata + a ere py [7.4.60], the secont consonant ya or vya oukht to have pen elitet
s: There takes place a vocalisation of the semi-vowels of the reduplicate (अभ्यास) of both वाच्यादि [[6.1.15]] and ग्रहादि [[6.1.16]] words, when affixes of लिट् follow. Thus वच — उवाच, उवचिथ, स्वप् — सुष्वाप, सुष्वपिथ, यज — इयाज, इयजिय, टुवप् — उवाप्, उवपिथ As regards ग्रहादि verbs; ग्रह — जग्राह, जग्रहिथ (there is no speciality in case of this verb, as these forms would have been evolved without even this rule). ज्या — जिज्यौ, जिज्यथ, वयि — उवाय, and उवयिथ; व्यध — विव्याध, विव्यधिथ, वश — उवाश, उवशिथ, व्यच् — विव्याच, विव्यचिथ, व्रश्च — वव्रश्च and वव्रश्चिथ Some say that with regard to व्रश्च, it is equal whether there existed this present rule or not. For they argue thus, व्रश्च + णल् = व्रश् + व्रश्च् + अ = व + व्रश्च् + अ (हलादि शेषः [[7.4.60]]) = वव्रश्च To this we reply, this form would be evolved no doubt had this rule not existed. But when this rule is applied, and you make reduplication without first vocalising the र, then you will have to vocalise व by force of this rule. Hence the necessity of this rule with regard to व्रश्च also, for having changed र into ॠ, we have वृव्रश्च् and then change ॠ into अ by [[7.4.66]]. Then this अ substitute becomes sthanivat to ॠ [[1.1.59]], and therefore there is no vocalisation of this व, for rule [[6.1.37]], prevents the vocalisation of a letter standing before one which has already been vocalised. There is no speciality with regards to प्रच्छ and भ्रस्ज verbs. This vocalisation of the reduplicate is taught with regard to those affixes which are not कित् With regard to कित् affixes, the Rule [[6.1.15]] will apply. And as the rule of vocalisation is subsequent to that of reduplication in order, therefore by the maxim of परत्व [[1.4.2]], vocalisation will take place first and then reduplication, according to the maxim पुनः प्रसङ्ग विज्ञानात्सिद्धम् "occasionally the formation of a particular form is accounted for by the fact that a preceding rule is allowed to apply again, after it had previously been superseded by a subsequent rule". Thus वच् + अतुः (which is कित् [[1.2.5]]) = उच् + अतुः = उच् + उच् + अतुः = ऊचतुः, ऊचुः Though the phrase उभयेषाम् could have been supplied into this sutra by the context and the governing scope of the preceding sutras, its express mention in this sutra is for the sake of indicating, that the rule of vocalisation supersedes even the rule of हलादिः शेषः [[7.4.60]], the vocalisation must take place at all events. Thus व्यध + णल् = व्य + व्यध + अ Here by [[7.4.60]], the second consonant य of व्य ought to have been elided, and the equation would have stood व + व्यध् + अ, and there would have been vocalisation of व by this rule. But that is not intended; there is vocalisation of य and we have विव्याध In fact, the universal maxim of vocalisation is :-"The samprasarana and the operations dependent on it possess greater force than other operations which are simultaneously applicable". संप्रसारणं तदाश्रयं च कार्यम् बलवत्

pk: Or the causative verb svapi to cause one to slep, there is vocalisation or the seni-vowel, when the aril can or the neduplicated aorist rolows. Thus the aorist or svapi is asusupat, asusupatan, asusupan The vocalisation takes place berore reduplication, then there is guna or the penultinate short vowel, then this is again shortened by [7.4.1], then there is reduplication, and then lengthening or the vowel or the reduplicate by [7.4.94]. Thus svapi + can = supi + can = sup [6.4.51] + can [7.3.86] = sop + can = sup + can [7.4.1] = su + sup + can [6.1.1] = susupat [7.4.94] which with the augnent a becones asusupat Why do we say when can rolows? Observe svapyate, svapita The anuvriti or kiti has ceased, that or niti however is here.
ck: Or the causative verp svapi to cause one to slep, there is vocalisation or the seni-votel, then the aril can or the netuplicatet aorist rolots. thus the aorist or svapi is asusupat, asusupatan, asusupan the vocalisation takes place perore retuplication, then there is kuna or the penultinate short votel, then this is akain shortenet py [7.4.1], then there is retuplication, ant then lenkthenink or the votel or the retuplicate py [7.4.94]. thus svapi + can = supi + can = sup [6.4.51] + can [7.3.86] = sop + can = sup + can [7.4.1] = su + sup + can [6.1.1] = susupat [7.4.94] thich tith the auknent a pecones asusupat thy to te say then can rolots? Opserve svapyate, svapita the anuvriti or kiti has ceaset, that or niti hotever is here.
s: Of the causative verb स्वपि 'to cause one to sleep', there is vocalisation of the semi-vowel, when the affix चङ् of the Reduplicated Aorist follows. Thus the Aorist of स्वपि is असूषुपत्, असूषुपताम्, असूषुपन् The vocalisation takes place before reduplication, then there is guna of the penultimate short vowel, then this is again shortened by [[7.4.1]], then there is reduplication, and then lengthening of the vowel of the reduplicate by [[7.4.94]]. Thus स्वापि + चङ् = सुपि + चङ् = सुप् [[6.4.51]] + चङ् [[7.3.86]] = सोप् + चङ् = सुप् + चङ् [[7.4.1]] = सु + सुप् + चङ् [[6.1.11]] = सूषुपत् [[7.4.94]] which with the augment अ becomes असूषुपत् Why do we say 'when चङ् follows'? Observe स्वाप्यते, स्वापितः The anuvritti of किति has ceased, that of ङिति however is here.

pk: There is vocalisation or the seni-vowel, or the verbs svap to slep, syan to shout and vye to cover, when rolowed by the aril yan or the intensive. Thus sosupyate, sesinyate, veviyate [7.4.25] the short i is lengthened). Why do we say when yan rolows? Observe svapnak rorned by najin [3.2.172].
ck: there is vocalisation or the seni-votel, or the verps svap to slep, syan to shout ant vye to cover, then rolotet py the aril yan or the intensive. thus sosupyate, sesinyate, veviyate [7.4.25] the short i is lenkthenet). thy to te say then yan rolots? Opserve svapnak rornet py nacin [3.2.172].
s: There is vocalisation of the semi-vowel, of the verbs स्वप् 'to sleep', स्यम् 'to shout' and व्ये 'to cover', when followed by the affix यङ् of the Intensive. Thus सोषुप्यते, सेसिम्यते, वेवीयते [[7.4.25]] the short इ is lengthened). Why do we say 'when यङ् follows'? Observe स्वप्नक् formed by नजिङ् [[3.2.172]].

pk: There is not vocalisation or the seni-vowel or vas, when the aril yan rolows. The word yani is understod here. as vavasyate, vavasyete, vavasyante Why do we say "when yan rolows"? Observe uswa, usanti se [6.1.16] to which this rule is an elception.
ck: there is not vocalisation or the seni-votel or vas, then the aril yan rolots. the tort yani is unterstot here. as vavasyate, vavasyete, vavasyante thy to te say "then yan rolots"? Opserve usta, usanti se [6.1.16] to thich this rule is an elception.
s: There is not vocalisation of the semi-vowel of वश्, when the affix यङ् follows. The word यङि is understood here. As वावश्यते, वावश्येते, वावश्यन्ते Why do we say "when यङ् follows"? Observe उष्टः, उशन्ति See [[6.1.16]] to which this rule is an exception.

pk: The verb ki is substituted ror the verb cayr to worship, to observe, when the intensive aril yan rolows. The phrase yani is understod here. Thus cekiyate, cekiyete, cekiyante The elhibition or ki in the sutra with a long i indicates that there is long vowel even in tenses where yan is elided, as cekita ror ir the sutra had enunciated ki with a short i as the substitute or cay, the rorns cekiyate &c would have ben stil valid. Thus ki + yan = ci + ki + ya = ce + ki + ya = ce + ki + ya [7.4.25] causing the lengthening or the short i). But then the nishtha would have ben cekita which is wrong.
ck: the verp ki is supstitutet ror the verp cayr to torship, to opserve, then the intensive aril yan rolots. the phrase yani is unterstot here. thus cekiyate, cekiyete, cekiyante the elhipition or ki in the sutra tith a lonk i inticates that there is lonk votel even in tenses there yan is elitet, as cekita ror ir the sutra hat enunciatet ki tith a short i as the supstitute or cay, the rorns cekiyate &c toult have pen stil valit. thus ki + yan = ci + ki + ya = ce + ki + ya = ce + ki + ya [7.4.25] causink the lenkthenink or the short i). put then the nishtha toult have pen cekita thich is tronk.
s: The verb की is substituted for the verb चायृ 'to worship, to observe', when the Intensive affix यङ् follows. The phrase यङि is understood here. Thus चेकीयते, चेकीयेते, चेकीयन्ते The exhibition of की in the sutra with a long ई indicates that there is long vowel even in tenses where यङ् is elided, as चेकीतः For if the sutra had enunciated कि with a short इ as the substitute of चाय्, the forms चेकीयते &c would have been still valid. Thus कि + यङ् = चि + कि + य = चे + कि + य = चे + की + य [[7.4.25]] causing the lengthening of the short इ). But then the Nishtha would have been चेकितः which is wrong.

pk: The sPi is the substitute or sPaya to swel, the nisWa ariles rolow. Thus sPita, sPitavan Why do we say "when the nishtha ariles rolow"? Observe sPati rorned by ktin in the phrase sPati Bavati, the word sPati is the reninine or the word sPati rorned by ktin The phrase nisWayan "when the nishtha rolows" governs al the subsequent sutras up to [6.1.29].
ck: the spi is the supstitute or spaya to stel, the nista ariles rolot. thus spita, spitavan thy to te say "then the nishtha ariles rolot"? Opserve spati rornet py ktin in the phrase spati pavati, the tort spati is the reninine or the tort spati rornet py ktin the phrase nistayan "then the nishtha rolots" koverns al the supsetuent sutras up to [6.1.29].
s: The स्फी is the substitute of स्फाय 'to swell', the निष्ठा affixes follow. Thus स्फीतः, स्फीतवान् Why do we say "when the Nishtha affixes follow"? Observe स्फातिः formed by क्तिन् In the phrase स्फाती भवति, the word स्फाती is the feminine of the word स्फाति formed by क्तिन् The phrase निष्ठायाम् "when the Nishtha follows" governs all the subsequent sutras up to [[6.1.29]].

pk: The verb stya (styE and sWyE) when preceded by pra changes its seni-vowel to a vowel, when a nisWa aril rolows. The phrases "when the nishtha rolows", and "there is vocalisation" are understod here. The anuvriti or sPi does not run here. The rots styE and sWyE both asune the rorn stya and are included here. Thus pra + stya + kta = pra + sti + ta [6.1.108] = prastita [6.4.2], and prastitavan The ta or nishtha aril would have ben changed into n by [8.2.43] in as nuch as the rot stya has a senivowel and ends in long a But by the vocalisation or ya, the condition or yanvat ror the aplication or [8.2.43], no longer elisting, the aril ta is not changed to na But ta is optionaly changed to na by [8.2.54] as prastina and prastinavan Why do we say "when preceded by pra?" Observe sanstyana [8.2.43], sanstyanavan ir it was intended that vocalisation should take place when pra singly stod berore, then the sutra could wel have run thus prastya The use or the word purvasya inplies that the rule aplies when pra stands rirst, though other upasargas nay intervene betwen it and the rot. Thus prasanstita, prasanstitavan The conpound prapurvasya should be elplained as a Bahuvrihi= pra purvo yasya Datupasargasanudayasya sa prapurva (that which consisting or rot and upasarga is preceded by pra is caled prapurva). Thererore the rule is nade aplicable to prasanstita &c.
ck: the verp stya (styE ant styE) then precetet py pra chankes its seni-votel to a votel, then a nista aril rolots. the phrases "then the nishtha rolots", ant "there is vocalisation" are unterstot here. the anuvriti or spi toes not run here. the rots styE ant styE poth asune the rorn stya ant are inclutet here. thus pra + stya + kta = pra + sti + ta [6.1.108] = prastita [6.4.2], ant prastitavan the ta or nishtha aril toult have pen chanket into n py [8.2.43] in as nuch as the rot stya has a senivotel ant ents in lonk a put py the vocalisation or ya, the contition or yanvat ror the aplication or [8.2.43], no lonker elistink, the aril ta is not chanket to na put ta is optionaly chanket to na py [8.2.54] as prastina ant prastinavan thy to te say "then precetet py pra?" Opserve sanstyana [8.2.43], sanstyanavan ir it tas intentet that vocalisation shoult take place then pra sinkly stot perore, then the sutra coult tel have run thus prastya the use or the tort purvasya inplies that the rule aplies then pra stants rirst, thoukh other upasarkas nay intervene peten it ant the rot. thus prasanstita, prasanstitavan the conpount prapurvasya shoult pe elplainet as a pahuvrihi= pra purvo yasya tatupasarkasanutayasya sa prapurva (that thich consistink or rot ant upasarka is precetet py pra is calet prapurva). thererore the rule is nate aplicaple to prasanstita &c.
s: The verb स्त्या (स्त्यै and ष्ठ्यै) when preceded by प्र changes its semi-vowel to a vowel, when a निष्ठ affix follows. The phrases "when the nishtha follows", and "there is vocalisation" are understood here. The anuvritti of स्फी does not run here. The roots स्त्यै and ष्ठ्यै both assume the form स्त्या and are included here. Thus प्र + स्त्या + क्त = प्र + स्ति + त [[6.1.108]] = प्रस्तीतः [[6.4.2]], and प्रस्तीतवान् The त of nishtha affix would have been changed into न् by [[8.2.43]] in as much as the root स्त्या has a semivowel and ends in long आ But by the vocalisation of य, the condition of यण्वत् for the application of [[8.2.43]], no longer existing, the affix त is not changed to न But त is optionally changed to म by [[8.2.54]] as प्रस्तीमः and प्रस्तीमवान् Why do we say "when preceded by प्र?" Observe संस्त्यानः [[8.2.43]], संस्त्यानवान् If it was intended that vocalisation should take place when प्र singly stood before, then the sutra could well have run thus प्रस्त्यः The use of the word पुर्वस्य implies that the rule applies when प्र stands first, though other upasargas may intervene between it and the root. Thus प्रसंस्तीतः, प्रसंस्तीतवान् The compound प्रपूर्वस्य should be explained as a Bahuvrihi= प्रः पूर्वो यस्य धातूपसर्गसमुदायस्य स प्रपूर्व (that which consisting of root and upasarga is preceded by प्र is called प्रपूर्व). Therefore the rule is made applicable to प्रसंस्तीतः &c.

pk: There is vocalisation or the seni-vowel or the rot sya (syE) to go when the nisWa aril rolows, when the sense is coagulation or cold to touch. The word dravanurti neans hardening or a rluid, by coagulation &c. Thus sinan Grtan, sina vasa, sinan neda "a coagulated buter, grease &c". The ta or nishtha is changed to na by [8.2.47]. But when the sense is that or cold, the ta is not changed; as sitan vartate, sito vayu, sitanudakan The word sita is here used both as a noun neaning cold weather &c, and an adjective denoting cold. There is no vocalisation when the sense is not that or coagulation or cold, as sansyano vrscika the roled up scorpion. The short i is lengthened in sina &c, by [6.4.2].
ck: there is vocalisation or the seni-votel or the rot sya (syE) to ko then the nista aril rolots, then the sense is coakulation or colt to touch. the tort travanurti neans hartenink or a rluit, py coakulation &c. thus sinan krtan, sina vasa, sinan neta "a coakulatet puter, krease &c". the ta or nishtha is chanket to na py [8.2.47]. put then the sense is that or colt, the ta is not chanket; as sitan vartate, sito vayu, sitanutakan the tort sita is here uset poth as a noun neanink colt teather &c, ant an atcective tenotink colt. there is no vocalisation then the sense is not that or coakulation or colt, as sansyano vrscika the rolet up scorpion. the short i is lenkthenet in sina &c, py [6.4.2].
s: There is vocalisation of the semi-vowel of the root श्या (श्यै) 'to go' when the निष्ठा affix follows, when the sense is 'coagulation' or 'cold to touch'. The word द्रवमूर्त्ति means hardening of a fluid, by coagulation &c. Thus शीनं घृतं, शीना वसा, शीनं मेदः "a coagulated butter, grease &c". The त of nishtha is changed to न by [[8.2.47]]. But when the sense is that of 'cold', the त is not changed; as शीतं वर्त्तते, शीतो वायुः, शीतमुदकम् The word शीत is here used both as a noun meaning 'cold weather &c', and an adjective denoting 'cold'. There is no vocalisation when the sense is not that of 'coagulation' or 'cold', as संश्यानो वृश्चिकः 'the rolled up scorpion'. The short इ is lengthened in शीन &c, by [[6.4.2]].

pk: There is vocalisation or sya preceded by the upasarga prati , when the nisWa ariles rolow. Thus pratisina pratisinavan This sutra aplies to cases where the words ned not have the neaning or "coagulation" or "cold".
ck: there is vocalisation or sya precetet py the upasarka prati , then the nista ariles rolot. thus pratisina pratisinavan this sutra aplies to cases there the torts net not have the neanink or "coakulation" or "colt".
s: There is vocalisation of श्या preceded by the उपसर्ग प्रति , when the निष्ठा affixes follow. Thus प्रतिशीनः प्रतिशीनवान् This sutra applies to cases where the words need not have the meaning of "coagulation" or "cold".

pk: There is optionaly the vocalisation or the sya rolowed by nisWa ariles, when the upasargas aBi and ava precede it. Thus aBisinan or aBisyanan Grtan, avasinan or avasyanan vrscika This option aplies even when the word neans "coagulation" and "cold". as avasinan or avasyanan Grtan, neda avasito or avasyano vayu, &c. avasitan or avasyananudakan The purva in this sutra serves the sane purpose as in [6.1.23]. Thus aBisansinan or aBisansyanan, avasansinan, avasansyanan acording to the author or sidhanta Kaunudi, the word purva shows that it is a vyavasthita vibhasha, hence there is no option alowed when aBi and ava are in the nidle, as, sanaBisyanan, sanavasyanan ere we canot have the alternative rorns sanaBisinan &c.
ck: there is optionaly the vocalisation or the sya rolotet py nista ariles, then the upasarkas api ant ava precete it. thus apisinan or apisyanan krtan, avasinan or avasyanan vrscika this option aplies even then the tort neans "coakulation" ant "colt". as avasinan or avasyanan krtan, neta avasito or avasyano vayu, &c. avasitan or avasyananutakan the purva in this sutra serves the sane purpose as in [6.1.23]. thus apisansinan or apisansyanan, avasansinan, avasansyanan acortink to the author or sithanta kaunuti, the tort purva shots that it is a vyavasthita viphasha, hence there is no option alotet then api ant ava are in the nitle, as, sanapisyanan, sanavasyanan ere te canot have the alternative rorns sanapisinan &c.
s: There is optionally the vocalisation of the श्या followed by निष्ठा affixes, when the उपसर्गs अभि and अव precede it. Thus अभिशीनम् or अभिश्यानम् घृतं, अवशीनम् or अवश्यानम् वृश्चिकः This option applies even when the word means "coagulation" and "cold". As अवशीनं or अवश्यानं घृतं, मेदः अवशीतो or अवश्यानो वायुः, &c. अवशीतं or अवश्यानमुदकं The पूर्व in this sutra serves the same purpose as in [[6.1.23]]. Thus अभिसंशीनं or अभिसंश्यानं, अवसंशीनं, अवसंश्यानं According to the author of Siddhanta Kaumudi, the word पूर्व shows that it is a vyavasthita vibhasha, hence there is no option allowed when अभि and अव are in the middle, as, समभिश्यानं, समवश्यानं Here we cannot have the alternative forms समभिशीनं &c.

pk: Optionaly srta is rorned in the sense or coked, by the vocalisation or the seni-vowel or a berore the nisWa aril kta The word viBasa is understod here. The rots srE to cok or the Bhvadi clas, and sra to cok or the adadi clas, and sra to cok or the Bhvadi sub-clas Ghatadi, are neant here. in al these, sr replaces sra, whether causative or not. Thus srtan ksiran, srtan havi This is a vyavasthita vibhasha; so that sra is invariably changed to sr when rerering to ksira and havi, but not anywhere else. Thus srana yavagu, srapita yavagu [7.3.36] and [6.4.92]. This word does not take double causative though the sense nay require it. as srapitan ksiran devadatena yajnadatena "Devadata through najnadata has caused the nilk to be coked". The sra is intransitive. When the sense is that or nerlelive, or Causative, there the rorn srta is to be used. as srtan ksiran svayaneva, srtan ksiran devadatena
ck: Optionaly srta is rornet in the sense or coket, py the vocalisation or the seni-votel or a perore the nista aril kta the tort vipasa is unterstot here. the rots srE to cok or the phvati clas, ant sra to cok or the atati clas, ant sra to cok or the phvati sup-clas khatati, are neant here. in al these, sr replaces sra, thether causative or not. thus srtan ksiran, srtan havi this is a vyavasthita viphasha; so that sra is invariaply chanket to sr then rererink to ksira ant havi, put not anythere else. thus srana yavaku, srapita yavaku [7.3.36] ant [6.4.92]. this tort toes not take touple causative thoukh the sense nay retuire it. as srapitan ksiran tevatatena yacnatatena "tevatata throukh nacnatata has causet the nilk to pe coket". the sra is intransitive. then the sense is that or nerlelive, or causative, there the rorn srta is to pe uset. as srtan ksiran svayaneva, srtan ksiran tevatatena
s: Optionally शृत is formed in the sense of 'cooked', by the vocalisation of the semi-vowel of आ before the निष्ठा affix क्त The word विभाषा is understood here. The roots श्रै 'to cook' of the Bhvadi class, and श्रा 'to cook' of the Adadi class, and श्रा 'to cook' of the Bhvadi sub-class Ghatadi, are meant here. In all these, शृ replaces श्रा, whether causative or not. Thus शृतं क्षीरं, शृतं हविः This is a vyavasthita vibhasha; so that श्रा is invariably changed to शृ when referring to क्षीर and हवि, but not anywhere else. Thus श्राणा यवागूः, श्रपिता यवागूः [[7.3.36]] and [[6.4.92]]. This word does not take double causative though the sense may require it. As श्रपितं क्षीरं देवदत्तेन यज्ञदत्तेन "Devadatta through Yajnadatta has caused the milk to be cooked". The श्रा is intransitive. When the sense is that of Reflexive, or Causative, there the form शृत is to be used. As शृतं क्षीरं स्वयमेव, शृतं क्षीरं देवदत्तेन

pk: pi is optionaly the substitute or the rot pyay to increase berore the nisWa ariles. The rot opyayi vrdDO belongs to Bhvadi clas. The indicatory a shows that the ariles ta and tavat are changed into na and navat [8.2.45]. Thus pinan nuKan, pinO bahu, pinasura The option here is also a regulated option (vyavasthita-vibhasha). The substitution takes place invariably when the rot is without upasarga, and never when it is preceded by an upasarga. Thus prapyana apyanascandraga The substitution, however, nust take place when the preposition an precedes the rot, and the words anDu and uDas are in conposition : as apinonDu, apinanuDa
ck: pi is optionaly the supstitute or the rot pyay to increase perore the nista ariles. the rot opyayi vrtO pelonks to phvati clas. the inticatory a shots that the ariles ta ant tavat are chanket into na ant navat [8.2.45]. thus pinan nukan, pinO pahu, pinasura the option here is also a rekulatet option (vyavasthita-viphasha). the supstitution takes place invariaply then the rot is tithout upasarka, ant never then it is precetet py an upasarka. thus prapyana apyanascantraka the supstitution, hotever, nust take place then the preposition an precetes the rot, ant the torts antu ant utas are in conposition : as apinontu, apinanuta
s: पी is optionally the substitute of the root प्याय् 'to increase' before the निष्ठा affixes. The root ओप्यायी वृद्धौ belongs to Bhvadi class. The indicatory आ shows that the affixes त and तवत् are changed into न and नवत् [[8.2.45]]. Thus पीनं मुखम्, पीनौ बाहू, पीनसुरः The option here is also a regulated option (vyavasthita-vibhasha). The substitution takes place invariably when the root is without upasarga, and never when it is preceded by an upasarga. Thus प्रप्यानः आप्यानश्चन्द्रगाः The substitution, however, must take place when the preposition आङ् precedes the root, and the words अन्धुः and ऊधस् are in composition : as आपीनोन्धुः, आपीनमूधः

pk: There is substitution or pi ror pyay when the ariles or the Perect (liw) and the intensive (yan) rolow. The anuvriti or the word viBasa ceases. The phrase pyaya pi or the last sutra is drawn into this by rorce or the word ca and; thus apipye, apipyate, apipyire The substitution or pi a subsequent rule, would have debared reduplication which precedes it in order. The reduplication, however, takes place arter the substitution, by rorce or the nalin or puna prasanga &c nentioned in [6.1.17]. Thus pi + liw = pi + pi + ta = pi + pya + e [6.4.82] the ya being substituted) = apipye with the aril a. so also in the intensive, as, apepiyate, apepiyete, apepiyante
ck: there is supstitution or pi ror pyay then the ariles or the perect (lit) ant the intensive (yan) rolot. the anuvriti or the tort vipasa ceases. the phrase pyaya pi or the last sutra is tratn into this py rorce or the tort ca ant; thus apipye, apipyate, apipyire the supstitution or pi a supsetuent rule, toult have teparet retuplication thich precetes it in orter. the retuplication, hotever, takes place arter the supstitution, py rorce or the nalin or puna prasanka &c nentionet in [6.1.17]. thus pi + lit = pi + pi + ta = pi + pya + e [6.4.82] the ya peink supstitutet) = apipye tith the aril a. so also in the intensive, as, apepiyate, apepiyete, apepiyante
s: There is substitution of पी for प्याय् when the affixes of the Perfect (लिट्) and the Intensive (यङ्) follow. The anuvritti of the word विभाषा ceases. The phrase प्यायः पी of the last sutra is drawn into this by force of the word च 'and'; thus आपिप्ये, आपिप्याते, आपिप्यिरे The substitution of पी a subsequent rule, would have debarred reduplication which precedes it in order. The reduplication, however, takes place after the substitution, by force of the maxim of पुनः प्रसङ्ग &c mentioned in [[6.1.17]]. Thus पी + लिट् = पि + पी + त = पि + प्य + ए [[6.4.82]] the य being substituted) = आपिप्ये with the affix आ. So also in the Intensive, as, आपेपीयते, आपेपीयेते, आपेपीयन्ते

pk: There is optionaly the vocalisation or the seni-vowel svi berore the ariles or the Perect and the intensive. The phrases liq yano and sanprasaranan are to be read into this sutra. Thus susave or sisvaya, susuvatu or sisviyatu so also in the intensive as sisryate or sasviyate The rot svi would not have taken vocalisation berore yan by any previous rule, this sutra teaches optional vocalisation. The rot would have taken vocalisation berore liw, which is a kit aril, invariably by [6.1.15], this sutra nodiries that by naking the substitution optional. in the alternative, when the rot does becone vocalised, the reduplicate is also not vocalised in spite or [6.1.17]. This elplains the rorn sisvaya, which by [6.1.17] would have ben susvaya svi + nal = (s udva + nal [6.1.30]) = su + nal [6.1.108] = su + su + a [6.1.8] = susava
ck: there is optionaly the vocalisation or the seni-votel svi perore the ariles or the perect ant the intensive. the phrases lit yano ant sanprasaranan are to pe reat into this sutra. thus susave or sisvaya, susuvatu or sisviyatu so also in the intensive as sisryate or sasviyate the rot svi toult not have taken vocalisation perore yan py any previous rule, this sutra teaches optional vocalisation. the rot toult have taken vocalisation perore lit, thich is a kit aril, invariaply py [6.1.15], this sutra notiries that py nakink the supstitution optional. in the alternative, then the rot toes pecone vocaliset, the retuplicate is also not vocaliset in spite or [6.1.17]. this elplains the rorn sisvaya, thich py [6.1.17] toult have pen susvaya svi + nal = (s utva + nal [6.1.30]) = su + nal [6.1.108] = su + su + a [6.1.8] = susava
s: There is optionally the vocalisation of the semi-vowel श्वि before the affixes of the Perfect and the Intensive. The phrases लिड् यङोः and सम्प्रसारणं are to be read Into this sutra. Thus शुशावे or शिश्वाय, शुशुवतुः or शिश्वियतुः So also in the Intensive as शीशृयते or शश्वीयते The root श्वि would not have taken vocalisation before यङ् by any previous rule, this sutra teaches optional vocalisation. The root would have taken vocalisation before लिट्, which is a कित् affix, invariably by [[6.1.15]], this sutra modifies that by making the substitution optional. In the alternative, when the root does become vocalised, the reduplicate is also not vocalised in spite of [[6.1.17]]. This explains the form शिश्वाय, which by [[6.1.17]] would have been शुश्वाय श्वि + णल् = (श् उद्व + णल् [[6.1.30]]) = शु + णल् [[6.1.108]] = शु + शु + अ [[6.1.8]] = शुशाव

pk: There is optionaly the vocalisation or the seni-vowel, in the causative or svi , when rolowed by the Desiderative san and the aorist can aril. The phrase viBasa sve is understod here. in rorning the Desiderative and the neduplicated aorist rorns or the Causative or svi, there is optional vocalisation. Thus susavayisati or sisvayayisati so also in the neduplicated aorist can, as asrsavat or asisvayat By the nalin sanprasaranan sanprasaranasrayan ca baliyo Bavati (se sutra [6.1.17]), the antaranga substitution or Vridhi &c is superseded by the sanprasarana and the subsidiary operations relating to it here. The vridhi and the substitution or ava take place arter the sanprasarana has taken place. The sutra [7.4.80] teaching the substitution or i ror the u or the reduplicate, when san rolows, shows by inplication that the substitution caused by ni is sthanivat though it itselr does not cause reduplication [1.1.59]. Thus svi + ni = svE + i = svay + i = svayi in reduplicating svayi we canot rorn svasvaya, but nust consider the substitute equal to the original i or svi and nust reduplicate it. We thus get sisvayayisati in the case or vocalisation, the rules or Vridhi &c are postponed. Thus svi + ni + san [6.1.108] = su + ni + san = sO + i + san = sav + i + iw + san = save + iw + san = savayi + san ere we require reduplication. ere the substitute av in sav though not caused by san, is treated sthanivat under [1.1.59] to u, which is caried in reduplication. sinilarly the aorist. svi + ni + can = su + i + a = su + su + i + a = su + sO + i + a = su + sav + i + a = su + sav + i + a [7.4.1] = su + sav + 0 + a [6.4.51] = asusavat [7.4.94]
ck: there is optionaly the vocalisation or the seni-votel, in the causative or svi , then rolotet py the tesiterative san ant the aorist can aril. the phrase vipasa sve is unterstot here. in rornink the tesiterative ant the netuplicatet aorist rorns or the causative or svi, there is optional vocalisation. thus susavayisati or sisvayayisati so also in the netuplicatet aorist can, as asrsavat or asisvayat py the nalin sanprasaranan sanprasaranasrayan ca paliyo pavati (se sutra [6.1.17]), the antaranka supstitution or Vrithi &c is supersetet py the sanprasarana ant the supsitiary operations relatink to it here. the vrithi ant the supstitution or ava take place arter the sanprasarana has taken place. the sutra [7.4.80] teachink the supstitution or i ror the u or the retuplicate, then san rolots, shots py inplication that the supstitution causet py ni is sthanivat thoukh it itselr toes not cause retuplication [1.1.59]. thus svi + ni = svE + i = svay + i = svayi in retuplicatink svayi te canot rorn svasvaya, put nust consiter the supstitute etual to the orikinal i or svi ant nust retuplicate it. te thus ket sisvayayisati in the case or vocalisation, the rules or Vrithi &c are postponet. thus svi + ni + san [6.1.108] = su + ni + san = sO + i + san = sav + i + it + san = save + it + san = savayi + san ere te retuire retuplication. ere the supstitute av in sav thoukh not causet py san, is treatet sthanivat unter [1.1.59] to u, thich is cariet in retuplication. sinilarly the aorist. svi + ni + can = su + i + a = su + su + i + a = su + sO + i + a = su + sav + i + a = su + sav + i + a [7.4.1] = su + sav + 0 + a [6.4.51] = asusavat [7.4.94]
s: There is optionally the vocalisation of the semi-vowel, in the causative of श्वि , when followed by the Desiderative सन् and the Aorist चङ् affix. The phrase विभाषा श्वेः is understood here. In forming the Desiderative and the Reduplicated Aorist forms of the Causative of श्वि, there is optional vocalisation. Thus शुशावयिषति or शिश्वाययिषति So also in the Reduplicated Aorist चङ्, as अशृशवत् or अशिश्वयत् By the maxim संप्रसारणं संप्रसारणाश्रयं च बलीयो भवति (see sutra [[6.1.17]]), the antaranga substitution of Vriddhi &c is superseded by the samprasarana and the subsidiary operations relating to it here. The vriddhi and the substitution of आव take place after the samprasarana has taken place. The sutra [[7.4.80]] teaching the substitution of ई for the उ of the reduplicate, when सन् follows, shows by implication that the substitution caused by णि is sthanivat though it itself does not cause reduplication [[1.1.59]]. Thus श्वि + णि = श्वै + इ = श्वाय् + इ = श्वायि In reduplicating श्वायि we cannot form श्वाश्वाय, but must consider the substitute equal to the original इ of श्वि and must reduplicate it. We thus get शिश्वाययिषति In the case of vocalisation, the rules of Vriddhi &c are postponed. Thus श्वि + णि + सन् [[6.1.108]] = शु + णि + सन् = शौ + इ + सन् = शाव् + इ + इट् + सन् = शावे + इट् + सन् = शावयि + सन् Here we require reduplication. Here the substitute आव् in शाव् though not caused by सन्, is treated sthanivat under [[1.1.59]] to उ, which is carried in reduplication. Similarly the Aorist. श्वि + णि + चङ् = शु + इ + अ = शु + शु + इ + अ = शु + शौ + इ + अ = शु + शाव् + इ + अ = शु + शव् + इ + अ [[7.4.1]] = शु + शव् + ० + अ [[6.4.51]] = अशूशवत् [[7.4.94]]

pk: There is the vocalisation or the seni-vowel or the causative or hve berore the Desiderative and the neduplicated aorist ariles. The whole or the last sutra is to be read into this sutra. Thus juhavayisati and juhavayisata; juhavayisanti; ajuhavat, ajuhavatan and ajuhavan The rot hva does not take the augnent ya required by [7.3.37] berore the aril ni, because the sanprasarana rule is stronger. The repetition or the word sanprasarana in this sutra, though its anuvriti was present, indicates that the rorce or the word viBasa has ceased. Though this and the nelt sutra could wel have ben nade one, their separation shows that the sanprasarana does not take place when another aril, not causing reduplication, intervenes. as hvayakanicCati = hvayakiyati; the Desiderative or this verb is jihvayakiyisati
ck: there is the vocalisation or the seni-votel or the causative or hve perore the tesiterative ant the netuplicatet aorist ariles. the thole or the last sutra is to pe reat into this sutra. thus cuhavayisati ant cuhavayisata; cuhavayisanti; acuhavat, acuhavatan ant acuhavan the rot hva toes not take the auknent ya retuiret py [7.3.37] perore the aril ni, pecause the sanprasarana rule is stronker. the repetition or the tort sanprasarana in this sutra, thoukh its anuvriti tas present, inticates that the rorce or the tort vipasa has ceaset. thoukh this ant the nelt sutra coult tel have pen nate one, their separation shots that the sanprasarana toes not take place then another aril, not causink retuplication, intervenes. as hvayakanicati = hvayakiyati; the tesiterative or this verp is cihvayakiyisati
s: There is the vocalisation of the semi-vowel of the causative of ह्वे before the Desiderative and the Reduplicated Aorist affixes. The whole of the last sutra is to be read into this sutra. Thus जुहावयिषति and जुहावयिषतः; जुहावयिषन्ति; अजूहवत्, अजूहवताम् and अजूहवन् The root ह्वा does not take the augment य required by [[7.3.37]] before the affix णि, because the Samprasarana rule is stronger. The repetition of the word संप्रसारण in this sutra, though its anuvritti was present, indicates that the force of the word विभाषा has ceased. Though this and the next sutra could well have been made one, their separation shows that the samprasarana does not take place when another affix, not causing reduplication, intervenes. As ह्वायकमिच्छति = ह्वायकीयति; the Desiderative of this verb is जिह्वायकीयिषति

pk: There is vocalisation or the seni-vowel or hva in the reduplicated rorn, in both the sylables. The abhyasta neans the reduplicate and the reduplicated, both the sylables. The vocalisation takes place berore reduplication. Thus juhava, johuyate, and juhusati This and the last sutra are one, in the original or Panini, they have ben divided into two by the authority or a Vartika.
ck: there is vocalisation or the seni-votel or hva in the retuplicatet rorn, in poth the sylaples. the aphyasta neans the retuplicate ant the retuplicatet, poth the sylaples. the vocalisation takes place perore retuplication. thus cuhava, cohuyate, ant cuhusati this ant the last sutra are one, in the orikinal or panini, they have pen tivitet into to py the authority or a Vartika.
s: There is vocalisation of the semi-vowel of ह्वा in the reduplicated form, in both the syllables. The abhyasta means the reduplicate and the reduplicated, both the syllables. The vocalisation takes place before reduplication. Thus जुहाव, जोहूयते, and जुहुषति This and the last sutra are one, in the original of Panini, they have been divided into two by the authority of a Vartika.

pk: in the Candas , the seni-vowel or this rot is diversely vocalised. Thus huve or hvayani, as indragni huve invoke indra and agni. devin sarasvatin huve The rorn huve is atnanepada, Present tense, ist Person singular the vikarana sap is elided, then there is vocalisation and substitution or uvan so also hvayani naruta sivan, hvayani visvan devan so also hava as sruDihavan (nig i.2.1.) hear the invocation.
ck: in the cantas , the seni-votel or this rot is tiversely vocaliset. thus huve or hvayani, as intrakni huve invoke intra ant akni. tevin sarasvatin huve the rorn huve is atnanepata, present tense, ist person sinkular the vikarana sap is elitet, then there is vocalisation ant supstitution or uvan so also hvayani naruta sivan, hvayani visvan tevan so also hava as srutihavan (nik i.2.1.) hear the invocation.
s: In the छन्दस् , the semi-vowel of this root is diversely vocalised. Thus हुवे or ह्वयामि, as इन्द्राग्नी हुवे 'Invoke Indra and Agni'. देवीं सरस्वतीं हुवे The form हुवे is Atmanepada, Present tense, Ist Person singular the vikarana शप् is elided, then there is vocalisation and substitution of उवङ् So also ह्वयामि मरुतः शिवान्, ह्वयामि विश्वान् देवान् So also हवः as श्रुधीहवम् (Rig I.2.1.) 'hear the invocation'.

pk: ror cay is diversely substituted ki in the Candas Thus viDuna nicikyu, nanyan cikyurna nicikyuranyan These are rorns ending in the aril us or the Perect. sonetines there is no substitution. as agnirjyotirnicaya
ck: ror cay is tiversely supstitutet ki in the cantas thus vituna nicikyu, nanyan cikyurna nicikyuranyan these are rorns entink in the aril us or the perect. sonetines there is no supstitution. as aknircyotirnicaya
s: For चाय् is diversely substituted की in the छन्दस् Thus विधुना निचिक्युः, नान्यं चिक्युर्न निचिक्युरन्यम् These are forms ending in the affix उस् of the Perfect. Sometimes there is no substitution. As अग्निर्ज्योतिर्निचाय्यः

pk: in the Candas the rolowing iregular rorns are net with - asprDeTan , anrcu , anrhu , cicyuse , tityaja , srata , sritan , asi , asirta The word Candasi is understod here. ron the rot spardDa to chalenge, is rorned apasprDeTan being the inperect (lan), 2nd Person Dual, atnanepada : there is reduplication or the rot, vocalisation or r, and the elision or a iregularly. as, indrasca visno yadapasprDeTan in secular language the rorn is asparDeTan sone say, it is derived ron spardDa with the preposition apa, the vocalisation or ra, the elision or a, and the non-preriling or the augnent aw in the inperect [6.4.75]. The counter-elanple or this wil be apaspardDeTan ron arca and arha to respect, to worship, are derived anrcu and anrhu in the Perect berore the 3rd person plural us, there being vocalisation or ra and the elision or a iregularly. Then there is reduplication, then r changed to a, then the lengthening or this a, then the adition or the augnent na, as : arc + us = rc + us = r + rc + us + a + rc + us [7.4.6] = a + rc + us [7.4.70] = a + n + rc + us [7.4.71] = anrcu The iregularity consists in the sanprasarana with the elision or a Thus yavagra arkananrcu, na vasunyanrhu The secular rorns wil be anarcu, anarhu The rorn cicyuse is the Perect 2nd person singular or the rot cyun to go: there is vocalisation or the reduplicate, and the non-adition or the augnent iw berore the aril se This is the iregularity. The regular rorn is cucyuvise The rorn tityaja is the Perect or tyaj, the vocalisation or the reduplicate is the iregularity. The regular rorn is tatyaja ron the rot srin to cok, is derived srata berore the nishtha aril, sri changed to sra iregularly. as sratasta indrasona The rorn sritan is also derived ron the sane rot by shortening the vowel with the sane aril. as sono gOri aDisrita, srita no grha sone say the sra substitution or sri takes place when the word rerers to sona, in the plural, and sri when it rerers to other than sona sonetines the word srata is sen in the singular, rerering to objects other than sona Thus yadi srato juhotana in ract, the elhibition or the word srata in the plural in the sutra is not absolutely necesary. The words asir and asirta are ron the sane rot sri, with the preril an and taking the ariles kvip and kta respectively. Berore these sri is replaced by sir, and the non-adition or na in the nishtha is iregular. as, tanasira duhanti asirta urjan, ksirErnaDyata asirta

yatapasprtetan in secular lankuake the rorn is aspartetan sone say, it is terivet ron sparta tith the preposition apa, the vocalisation or ra, the elision or a, ant the non-prerilink or the auknent at in the inperect [6.4.75]. the counter-elanple or this til pe apaspartetan ron arca ant arha to respect, to torship, are terivet anrcu ant anrhu in the perect perore the 3rt person plural us, there s: In the छन्दस् the following irregular forms are met with - अस्पृधेथाम् , आनृचुः , आनृहुः , चिच्युषे , तित्याज , श्राताः , श्रितम् , आशीः , आशीर्त्तः The word छन्दसि is understood here. From the root स्पर्द्ध 'to challenge', is formed अपस्पृधेथाम् being the Imperfect (लङ्), 2nd Person Dual, Atmanepada : there is reduplication of the root, vocalisation of र्, and the elision of अ irregularly. As, इन्द्रश्च विष्णो यदपस्पृधेथाम् In secular language the form is अस्पर्धेथाम् Some say, it is derived from स्पर्द्ध with the preposition अप, the vocalisation of र, the elision of अ, and the non-prefixing of the augment अट् in the Imperfect [[6.4.75]]. The counter-example of this will be अपास्पर्द्धेथाम् From अर्च and अर्ह 'to respect, to worship', are derived आनृचुः and आनृहुः in the Perfect before the 3rd person plural उस्, there being vocalisation of र and the elision of अ irregularly. Then there is reduplication, then ॠ changed to अ, then the lengthening of this अ, then the addition of the augment म, as : अर्च् + उस् = ॠच् + उस् = ॠ + ॠच् + उस् + अ + ॠच् + उस् [[7.4.66]] = आ + ॠच् + उस् [[7.4.70]] = आ + न् + ॠच् + उस् [[7.4.71]] = आनृचुः The irregularity consists in the samprasarana with the elision of अ Thus यवग्रा अर्कमानृचुः, न वसून्यानृहुः The secular forms will be अनर्चुः, आनर्हुः The form चिच्युषे is the Perfect 2nd person singular of the root च्युङ् 'to go': there is vocalisation of the reduplicate, and the non-addition of the augment इट् before the affix से This is the irregularity. The regular form is चुच्युविषे The form तित्याज is the Perfect of त्यज्, the vocalisation of the reduplicate is the irregularity. The regular form is तत्याज From the root श्रीञ् 'to cook', is derived श्राता before the Nishtha affix, श्री changed to श्रा irregularly. As श्रातास्त इन्द्रसोमाः The form श्रितं is also derived from the same root by shortening the vowel with the same affix. As सोमो गौरी अधिश्रितः, श्रिता नो गृहाः Some say the श्रा substitution of श्री takes place when the word refers to सोम, in the plural, and श्रि when it refers to other than सोम Sometimes the word श्रातः is seen in the singular, referring to objects other than सोम Thus यदि श्रातो जुहोतन In fact, the exhibition of the word श्राताः in the plural in the sutra is not absolutely necessary. The words आशीर् and आशीर्त्तः are from the same root श्री, with the prefix आङ् and taking the affixes क्विप् and क्त respectively. Before these श्री is replaced by शीर्, and the non-addition of न in the Nishtha is irregular. As, तामाशीरा दुहन्ति आशीर्त्त ऊर्ज्जम्, क्षीरैर्मध्यत आशीर्त्तः

pk: When a seni-vowel base has ben vocalised, there is no vocalisation or the other seni-vowel that nay precede it in the sane word. Thus vyaD; has two seni-vowels v and y; when y is once vocalised into i, the preceding va wil not be vocalised into u Thus we have vidDa ron vyac — vicita, vyen — sanvita Though the rule or vocalisation does not speciry what particular senivowel is to be vocalised, yet acording to the nalin that the operation is to be perorned on the leter nearest to the operator, the second senivowel in the above cases is vocalised and the rirst is not, by rorce or this rule. ad the rirst seni-vowel ben vocalised, then there would be no scope ror this sutra, because then no seni-vowel wil be round preceding a vocalised leter. This sutra is a jnapaka that the vocalisation conences with the second or the conjunct seni-vowels. Though the anuvriti or sanprasarana was understod here, the repetition or this word shows that the prohibition or double vocalisation in the sane word aplies even when the senivowels are not contiguous. Thus by [6.1.13] there is vocalisation or the word yuvan, the va being changed to u, the ya is not changed as yuna it night be objected that when the u or yu, and u the sanprasarana or va coalesce into one by sandhi rules, then there being the substitution or one long u ror the two us and this is sthanivat to the original, the ya and v or yuvan should be considered in ract as contiguous and not separated by an intervening leter, and thererore, the elplanation given above does not hold god; we reply. The substitution or one long vowel ror two vowels, is not considered sthanivat (se (l. 1.58). Even though it be considered as sthanivat, it is stil a separating leter. Vart:- There is vocalisation or the senivowel or tri when rolowed by rc, and there is elision or the r or rc, when it rerers to netres. as tisra rco yasnin = trcan suktan trcan sana The word trc takes the sanasanta aril a by [5.4.74]. Why do we say when rerering to a netre? Observe tyrcan karna Vart:- in the Chandas there is diversely vocalisation or the seni-vowel or rayi rolowed by the aril natup as rayi + nat = rai + nat = ra + i + nat = ra + i + vat [8.2.15] = ravet; as, a revanetu no visa sonetines it does not take place, as rayinan puswivardDana The na here is not changed to va as required by [8.2.15]. Vart:- There is vocalisation or kaksya berore nat when a nane is neant: as kaksivantan ya Osija This Vartika is unecesary. se [8.2.12] where the rorn kaksivat
ck: then a seni-votel pase has pen vocaliset, there is no vocalisation or the other seni-votel that nay precete it in the sane tort. thus vyat; has to seni-votels v ant y; then y is once vocaliset into i, the precetink va til not pe vocaliset into u thus te have vita ron vyac — vicita, vyen — sanvita thoukh the rule or vocalisation toes not speciry that particular senivotel is to pe vocaliset, yet acortink to the nalin that the operation is to pe perornet on the leter nearest to the operator, the secont senivotel in the apove cases is vocaliset ant the rirst is not, py rorce or this rule. at the rirst seni-votel pen vocaliset, then there toult pe no scope ror this sutra, pecause then no seni-votel til pe rount precetink a vocaliset leter. this sutra is a cnapaka that the vocalisation conences tith the secont or the concunct seni-votels. thoukh the anuvriti or sanprasarana tas unterstot here, the repetition or this tort shots that the prohipition or touple vocalisation in the sane tort aplies even then the senivotels are not contikuous. thus py [6.1.13] there is vocalisation or the tort yuvan, the va peink chanket to u, the ya is not chanket as yuna it nikht pe opcectet that then the u or yu, ant u the sanprasarana or va coalesce into one py santhi rules, then there peink the supstitution or one lonk u ror the to us ant this is sthanivat to the orikinal, the ya ant v or yuvan shoult pe consiteret in ract as contikuous ant not separatet py an intervenink leter, ant thererore, the elplanation kiven apove toes not holt kot; te reply. the supstitution or one lonk votel ror to votels, is not consiteret sthanivat (se (l. 1.58). Even thoukh it pe consiteret as sthanivat, it is stil a separatink leter. Vart:- there is vocalisation or the senivotel or tri then rolotet py rc, ant there is elision or the r or rc, then it rerers to netres. as tisra rco yasnin = trcan suktan trcan sana the tort trc takes the sanasanta aril a py [5.4.74]. thy to te say then rererink to a netre? Opserve tyrcan karna Vart:- in the chantas there is tiversely vocalisation or the seni-votel or rayi rolotet py the aril natup as rayi + nat = rai + nat = ra + i + nat = ra + i + vat [8.2.15] = ravet; as, a revanetu no visa sonetines it toes not take place, as rayinan pustivartana the na here is not chanket to va as retuiret py [8.2.15]. Vart:- there is vocalisation or kaksya perore nat then a nane is neant: as kaksivantan ya Osica this Vartika is unecesary. se [8.2.12] there the rorn kaksivat is kive
s: When a semi-vowel base has been vocalised, there is no vocalisation of the other semi-vowel that may precede it in the same word. Thus व्यध्; has two semi-vowels व् and य्; when य् is once vocalised into इ, the preceding व will not be vocalised into उ Thus we have विद्धः From व्यच् — विचितः, व्येञ् — संवीतः Though the rule of vocalisation does not specify what particular semivowel is to be vocalised, yet according to the maxim that the operation is to be performed on the letter nearest to the operator, the second semivowel in the above cases is vocalised and the first is not, by force of this rule. Had the first semi-vowel been vocalised, then there would be no scope for this sutra, because then no semi-vowel will be found preceding a vocalised letter. This sutra is a jnapaka that the vocalisation commences with the second of the conjunct semi-vowels. Though the anuvritti of संप्रसारण was understood here, the repetition of this word shows that the prohibition of double vocalisation in the same word applies even when the semivowels are not contiguous. Thus by [[6.1.133]] there is vocalisation of the word युवन्, the व being changed to उ, the य is not changed as यूना It might be objected that when the उ of यु, and उ the samprasarana of व coalesce into one by sandhi rules, then there being the substitution of one long ऊ for the two उ's and this is sthanivat to the original, the य and व् of युवन् should be considered in fact as contiguous and not separated by an intervening letter, and therefore, the explanation given above does not hold good; we reply. The substitution of one long vowel for two vowels, is not considered sthanivat (See (l. 1.58)). Even though it be considered as sthanivat, it is still a separating letter. Vart:- There is vocalisation of the semivowel of त्रि when followed by ऋच्, and there is elision of the ऋ of ऋच्, when it refers to Metres. As तिस्र ॠचो यस्मिन् = तृचं सुक्तं तृचं साम The word तृच् takes the samasanta affix अ by [[5.4.74]]. Why do we say when referring to a metre? Observe त्यृचं कर्म Vart:- In the Chhandas there is diversely vocalisation of the semi-vowel of रयि followed by the affix मतुप् as रयि + मत् = रइ + मत् = र + इ + मत् = र + इ + वत् [[8.2.15]] = रवेत्; as, आ रेवानेतु नो विशः Sometimes it does not take place, as रयिमान् पुष्टिवर्द्धनः The म here is not changed to व as required by [[8.2.15]]. Vart:- There is vocalisation of कक्ष्या before मत् when a Name is meant: as कक्षीवन्तं य औशिजः This Vartika is unnecessary. See [[8.2.12]] where the form कक्षीवत् is given.

pk: in the substituted rot vaya [2.4.41], the ya in the Perect is not vocalised. The phrase na sanprasaranan is understod here. Thus uvaya, uyatu, uyu The word liw is enployed in this aphorisn ror the sake or subsequent sutras, this one could have done wel without it even.
ck: in the supstitutet rot vaya [2.4.41], the ya in the perect is not vocaliset. the phrase na sanprasaranan is unterstot here. thus uvaya, uyatu, uyu the tort lit is enployet in this aphorisn ror the sake or supsetuent sutras, this one coult have tone tel tithout it even.
s: In the substituted root वय [[2.4.41]], the य in the Perfect is not vocalised. The phrase न संप्रसारणं is understood here. Thus उवाय, ऊयतुः, ऊयुः The word लिट् is employed in this aphorism for the sake of subsequent sutras, this one could have done well without it even.

pk: Berore the tense-ariles or the Perect that have an indicatory ka [1.2.5], ror the y or vay nay optionaly be substituted a v Thus uyatu or uvatu, uvu or uyu acording to Patanjali, the phrase vascasya or this sutra could have ben dispensed with; this nuch would have ben enough:- anyatarasya kiti vena Thus ve + atun = va + va + atus = vavatu and vavu (the vocalisation being prohibited). in the alternative:-va + atus = u +atus = u + uvan + atus [6.1.7] = uvatu, uvu ere there is vocalisation. in the case or vay substitute, the ya is never vocalised, so we have uyatu, uyu Thus al the thre rorns have ben evolved without using vascasya
ck: perore the tense-ariles or the perect that have an inticatory ka [1.2.5], ror the y or vay nay optionaly pe supstitutet a v thus uyatu or uvatu, uvu or uyu acortink to patancali, the phrase vascasya or this sutra coult have pen tispenset tith; this nuch toult have pen enoukh:- anyatarasya kiti vena thus ve + atun = va + va + atus = vavatu ant vavu (the vocalisation peink prohipitet). in the alternative:-va + atus = u +atus = u + uvan + atus [6.1.7] = uvatu, uvu ere there is vocalisation. in the case or vay supstitute, the ya is never vocaliset, so te have uyatu, uyu thus al the thre rorns have pen evolvet tithout usink vascasya
