ck: the rinal a or a pa anka (sten) is elitet then it ents in a rot. thus kilalapa pasya, kilalapa, kilalape, supanya pasya, supanya, ant supanye ron kilalapa ant supanya thy to te say the a or a rot? Opserve katva pasya, nala pasya this sutra shoult pe tivitet into to (1) ata (2) tato; so that the lonk a in keneral nay pe elitet. ror panini hinselr has teclinet ktva ant sna py the elision or a, se [7.1.37], (ktvo lyap) ant [3.1.83], (sna sanac)
s: The final आ of a भ अङ्ग (stem) is elided when it ends in a root. Thus कीलालपः पश्य, कीलालपा, कीलालपे, शुभंयः पश्य, शुभंया, and शुभंये from कीलालपा and शुभंया Why do we say 'the आ of a root'? Observe खट्वाः पश्य, मालाः पश्य This sutra should be divided into two (1) आतः (2) धातोः; so that the long आ in general may be elided. For Panini himself has declined क्त्वा and श्ना by the elision of आ, see [[7.1.37]], (क्त्वो ल्यप्) and [[3.1.83]], (श्नः शानच्)

pk: in the nantra-s , the begining or atnan is elided when the aril or the instrunental -3rd case singular rolows. an is the nane or the instrunental singular aril, given by ancient Granarians. Thus tnana deveBya, tnana sonesu Why in the nantras? Observe atnano krtan Why in the instrunental singular? yadatnana stano varisWa Vart:- The elision or a or atnan is round in other cases also, but not so requently as in the instrunental, as tnanyasananjata nahyan
ck: in the nantra-s , the pekinink or atnan is elitet then the aril or the instrunental -3rt case sinkular rolots. an is the nane or the instrunental sinkular aril, kiven py ancient kranarians. thus tnana tevepya, tnana sonesu thy in the nantras? Opserve atnano krtan thy in the instrunental sinkular? yatatnana stano varista Vart:- the elision or a or atnan is rount in other cases also, put not so retuently as in the instrunental, as tnanyasanancata nahyan
s: In the मन्त्र-s , the beginning of आत्मन् is elided when the affix of the Instrumental -3rd case singular follows. आङ् is the name of the Instrumental singular affix, given by ancient Grammarians. Thus त्मना देवेभ्यः, त्मना सोमेषु Why in the Mantras? Observe आत्मनो कृतम् Why in the Instrumental Singular? यदात्मन स्तन्नो वरिष्ठा Vart:- The elision of आ of 'atman' is found in other cases also, but not so frequently as in the Instrumental, as त्मन्यासमञ्जत मह्यम्

pk: Or the Ba anga (sten) vinsati , berore an aril having an indicatory q the ti is elided. Thus vinsaka = vinsatya krita (with qvun [5.1.24]), vinsan satan, (vinsate purano vinsa, with qawa aril [5.2.43], ekavinsa Why do we say having al indicatory qa? Observe vinsatya
ck: Or the pa anka (sten) vinsati , perore an aril havink an inticatory t the ti is elitet. thus vinsaka = vinsatya krita (tith tvun [5.1.24]), vinsan satan, (vinsate purano vinsa, tith tata aril [5.2.43], ekavinsa thy to te say havink al inticatory ta? Opserve vinsatya
s: Of the भ अङ्ग (stem) विंशति , before an affix having an indicatory ड् the ति is elided. Thus विंशकः = विंशत्या क्रीतः (with ड्वुन् [[5.1.24]]), विंशं शतम्, (विंशतेः पूरणो विंशः, with डट affix [[5.2.43]], एकविंशः Why do we say 'having all indicatory ड'? Observe विंशत्या

pk: Berore an aril having an indicatory q , the last vowel, with the consonant, ir any, that rolows it, is elided. Thus kunudvat, naqvat and vetasvat with qnatup [4.2.87]. so also trinsata krita = trinsaka with qvun or [5.1.24]. The rule aplies even to non-bha bases, ror erect nust be given to the indicatory qa Thus upasaraja, nanduraja [3.2.97] with the krit aril u)
ck: perore an aril havink an inticatory t , the last votel, tith the consonant, ir any, that rolots it, is elitet. thus kunutvat, natvat ant vetasvat tith tnatup [4.2.87]. so also trinsata krita = trinsaka tith tvun or [5.1.24]. the rule aplies even to non-pha pases, ror erect nust pe kiven to the inticatory ta thus upasaraca, nanturaca [3.2.97] tith the krit aril u)
s: Before an affix having an indicatory ड् , the last vowel, with the consonant, if any, that follows it, is elided. Thus कुमुद्वत्, नड्वत् and वेतस्वत् with ड्मतुप् [[4.2.87]]. So also त्रिंशता क्रीतः = त्रिंशकः with ड्वुन् of [[5.1.24]]. The rule applies even to non-bha bases, for effect must be given to the indicatory ड Thus उपसरजः, मन्दुरजः [[3.2.97]] with the krit affix उ)

pk: Or the Ba anga (sten) the rinal n with the vowel that precedes it, is elided berore a tadDita aril. Thus agnisarni, Oquloni, saraloni ron agnisarnan, uqulonan, and saralonan with the Tadhita aril in [4.1.96]. Why do we say ending in n? Observe satvata Why berore a Tadhita aril? Observe sarnana, sarnane Vart:- The rinal n with the vowel that precedes it, is droped berore a Tadhita in the rolowing : 1. sabrahnacarin - sabrahnacara [4.3.120], 2. piWasarpin - pEWasarpa [4.3.120], 3. kalapin - kalapa [4.3.108] and [4.2.59], 4. kuTunin - kOTuna [4.3.101], 5. tEtilin - tEtila [4.3.16], 6. jajalin -jajala [4.2.59], 7. langalin — langala, 8. silalin - sElala, 9. siKanqin - sEKanqa, 10. sukarasadnan - sOkara sadna, 1. suparvan - sOparva in the above those which end in in, elide the in in spite or [6.4.164], and those in an contradict [6.4.167]. Vart:- asnan loses its an berore a Tadhita aril neaning prepared there with : as, asna, otherwise asnana Vart:- Or carnan, the an is elided when neaning a sheath or purse: as, carna kosa [4.3.134], otherwise carnana Vart:- The an or svan is elided when the sense is to contract, as sOva sankoca [4.3.120], otherwise sOvana Vart:- The indeclinables like sayanpratika &c are rorned by the wi elision : as sayanpratika, pOna punika, bahya, kOtaskuta (rorned by Wan [4.3.1]). But not berore the ariles vyu and vyul, as aratiya, sasvatika Panini hinselr has shown the elception, in the case or svasvatika, by using it in [2.4.9]. so also sasvatan
ck: Or the pa anka (sten) the rinal n tith the votel that precetes it, is elitet perore a tatita aril. thus aknisarni, Otuloni, saraloni ron aknisarnan, utulonan, ant saralonan tith the tathita aril in [4.1.96]. thy to te say entink in n? Opserve satvata thy perore a tathita aril? Opserve sarnana, sarnane Vart:- the rinal n tith the votel that precetes it, is tropet perore a tathita in the rolotink : 1. saprahnacarin - saprahnacara [4.3.120], 2. pitasarpin - pEtasarpa [4.3.120], 3. kalapin - kalapa [4.3.108] ant [4.2.59], 4. kutunin - kOtuna [4.3.101], 5. tEtilin - tEtila [4.3.16], 6. cacalin -cacala [4.2.59], 7. lankalin — lankala, 8. silalin - sElala, 9. sikantin - sEkanta, 10. sukarasatnan - sOkara satna, 1. suparvan - sOparva in the apove those thich ent in in, elite the in in spite or [6.4.164], ant those in an contratict [6.4.167]. Vart:- asnan loses its an perore a tathita aril neanink preparet there tith : as, asna, othertise asnana Vart:- Or carnan, the an is elitet then neanink a sheath or purse: as, carna kosa [4.3.134], othertise carnana Vart:- the an or svan is elitet then the sense is to contract, as sOva sankoca [4.3.120], othertise sOvana Vart:- the inteclinaples like sayanpratika &c are rornet py the ti elision : as sayanpratika, pOna punika, pahya, kOtaskuta (rornet py tan [4.3.1]). put not perore the ariles vyu ant vyul, as aratiya, sasvatika panini hinselr has shotn the elception, in the case or svasvatika, py usink it in [2.4.9]. so also sasvatan
s: Of the भ अङ्ग (stem) the final न् with the vowel that precedes it, is elided before a तद्धित affix. Thus आग्निशर्म्मिः, औडुलोमिः, सारलोमिः from अग्निशर्मन्, उडुलोमन्, and सरलोमन् with the Taddhita affix इञ् [[4.1.96]]. Why do we say 'ending in म्'? Observe सात्वतः Why 'before a Taddhita affix'? Observe शर्मणा, शर्मणे Vart:- The final न् with the vowel that precedes it, is dropped before a Taddhita in the following : 1. सब्रह्मचारिन् - साब्रह्मचाराः [[4.3.120]], 2. पीठसर्पिन् - पैठसर्पाः [[4.3.120]], 3. कलापिन् - कालापाः [[4.3.108]] and [[4.2.59]], 4. कुथुमिन् - कौथुमाः [[4.3.101]], 5. तैतिलिन् - तैतिलाः [[4.3.116]], 6. जाजलिन् -जाजलाः [[4.2.59]], 7. लाङ्गलिन् — लाङ्गलाः, 8. शिलालिन् - शैलालाः, 9. शिखण्डिन् - शैखण्डाः, 10. सुकरसद्मन् - सौकर सद्माः, 11. सुपर्वन् - सौपर्वाः In the above those which end in इन्, elide the इन् in spite of [[6.4.164]], and those in अन् contradict [[6.4.167]]. Vart:- अश्मन् loses its अन् before a Taddhita affix meaning 'prepared there with' : as, आश्मः, otherwise आश्मनः Vart:- Of चर्मन्, the अन् is elided when meaning 'a sheath or purse': as, चार्म कोशः [[4.3.134]], otherwise चार्मणः Vart:- The अन् of श्वन् is elided when the sense is 'to contract', as शौवः संकोचः [[4.3.120]], otherwise शौवनः Vart:- The Indeclinables like सायंप्रातिकः &c are formed by the टि elision : as सायंप्रातिकः, पौनः पुनिकः, बाह्यः, कौतस्कुतः (formed by ठञ् [[4.3.11]]). But not before the affixes व्यु and व्युल्, as आरातीयः, शाश्वतिकः Panini himself has shown the exception, in the case of श्वाश्वतिक, by using it in [[2.4.9]]. So also शाश्वतम्

pk: The a or ahan is elided only berore the ariles wa and Ka Thus dve ahani sanahute = dvyaha, tryaha ([5.4.91] with wac), dve ahani aDiswo Brto Buto Bavi va = dvyahina, tryahina (with Ka [5.1.87]). Vart:- Ka is aded to ahan in the sense or tasya sanuha, when rerering to a sacririce. ahnan sanuha kratu = ahina [4.2.42]. Though the an or ahan would have ben elided by the last aphorisn also, berore the ariles wa and Ka, the present sutra nakes a restrictive rule : ahan does not lose its rinal an berore any other Tadhita aril, thus ahna nirvrtan = ahnikan (with Wan [5.1.79]). The word eva only is ror the sake or perspicuity. ahan alone does not lose its rinal an berore wa and Ka, other stens also do the sane. This we inrer, ron the elception nade in the case or atnan and adhvan, berore Ka in [7.4.169].
ck: the a or ahan is elitet only perore the ariles ta ant ka thus tve ahani sanahute = tvyaha, tryaha ([5.4.91] tith tac), tve ahani atisto prto puto pavi va = tvyahina, tryahina (tith ka [5.1.87]). Vart:- ka is atet to ahan in the sense or tasya sanuha, then rererink to a sacririce. ahnan sanuha kratu = ahina [4.2.42]. thoukh the an or ahan toult have pen elitet py the last aphorisn also, perore the ariles ta ant ka, the present sutra nakes a restrictive rule : ahan toes not lose its rinal an perore any other tathita aril, thus ahna nirvrtan = ahnikan (tith tan [5.1.79]). the tort eva only is ror the sake or perspicuity. ahan alone toes not lose its rinal an perore ta ant ka, other stens also to the sane. this te inrer, ron the elception nate in the case or atnan ant athvan, perore ka in [7.4.169].
s: The अ of अहन् is elided only before the affixes ट and ख Thus द्वे अहनी समाहूते = द्व्यहः, त्र्यहः ([[5.4.91]] with टच्), द्वे अहनी अधीष्टो भृतो भूतो भावी वा = द्व्यहीनः, त्र्यहीनः (with ख [[5.1.87]]). Vart:- ख is added to अहन् in the sense of तस्य समूहः, when referring to a sacrifice. अह्नां समूहः क्रतुः = अहीनः [[4.2.42]]. Though the अन् of अहन् would have been elided by the last aphorism also, before the affixes ट and ख, the present sutra makes a restrictive rule : अहन् does not lose its final अन् before any other Taddhita affix, thus अह्ना निर्वृत्तम् = आह्निकम् (with ठञ् [[5.1.79]]). The word एव 'only' is for the sake of perspicuity. अहन् alone does not lose its final अन् before ट and ख, other stems also do the same. This we infer, from the exception made in the case of atman and adhvan, before ख in [[7.4.169]].

pk: ror u or u or a Ba anga (sten) there is substituted guna berore a tadDita aril. Thus baBravya ron baBru, nanqavya ron nanqu, sankavyan daru (ron sanku), picavya karpasa, (ron picu) kananqalavya nrtika (ron kananqalu), parasavyanaya, Opagava, kapawava &c. instead or naking the sutra sinpler by saying orot let o be substituted ror u or u, the enploynent or the technical phrase guna in the aphorisn indicates the elistence or the rolowing nalin sanjna purvako viDiranitya "a rule is not universaly valid, when that which is taught in it, is denoted by a technical tern". The present sutra is, thererore, anitya, and we have rorns like svayanBuva ron svayanBu without guna. se [7.4.30] also.
ck: ror u or u or a pa anka (sten) there is supstitutet kuna perore a tatita aril. thus papravya ron papru, nantavya ron nantu, sankavyan taru (ron sanku), picavya karpasa, (ron picu) kanantalavya nrtika (ron kanantalu), parasavyanaya, Opakava, kapatava &c. insteat or nakink the sutra sinpler py sayink orot let o pe supstitutet ror u or u, the enploynent or the technical phrase kuna in the aphorisn inticates the elistence or the rolotink nalin sancna purvako vitiranitya "a rule is not universaly valit, then that thich is taukht in it, is tenotet py a technical tern". the present sutra is, thererore, anitya, ant te have rorns like svayanpuva ron svayanpu tithout kuna. se [7.4.30] also.
s: For उ of ऊ of a भ अङ्ग (stem) there is substituted गुण before a तद्धित affix. Thus बाभ्रव्यः from बभ्रू, माण्डव्यः from मण्डु, शङ्कव्यं दारु (from शंकु), पिचव्यः कार्पासः, (from पिचु) कमण्डलव्या मृत्तिका (from कमण्डलू), परशव्यमयः, औपगवः, कापटवः &c. Instead of making the sutra simpler by saying ओरोत् 'let ओ be substituted for उ or ऊ', the employment of the technical phrase गुणः in the aphorism indicates the existence of the following maxim संज्ञा पूर्वको विधिरनित्यः "A rule is not universally valid, when that which is taught in it, is denoted by a technical term". The present sutra is, therefore, anitya, and we have forms like स्वायंभुवः from स्वयंभू without guna. See [[7.4.30]] also.

pk: ror u or u or a Ba anga (sten) is elided berore the aril eya (Qa) but not or the anga (sten) kawru Thus kananqaleya, sEtivaheya, janbeya, nadravaheya, but kawraveyo nantranapasyat
ck: ror u or u or a pa anka (sten) is elitet perore the aril eya (ta) put not or the anka (sten) katru thus kanantaleya, sEtivaheya, canpeya, natravaheya, put katraveyo nantranapasyat
s: For उ of ऊ of a भ अङ्ग (stem) is elided before the affix एय (ढ) but not of the अङ्ग (stem) कट्रू Thus कामण्डलेयः, शैतिवाहेयः, जाम्बेयः, माद्रवाहेयः, but काट्रवेयो मन्त्रमपश्यत्

pk: The rinal a and i (both long and short) or a Ba anga (sten) are elided berore a tadDita aril. Thus daksi, plaksi, saKi ron daksi, plaksi and saKi with the reninine aril i [4.1.65] The above rorns could also have ben evolved by the sinple rules or sandhi, as daksi + i = daksi it night be asked, where was then the necesity or eliding i? There would arise diriculty in the rorns like ati saKi ron the word saKi rorned by nis under [4.1.62], we rorn the conpound saKinatikranta = atisaKi, the rinal beconing short by [1.2.48] (the sanasanta aril wac is not aded here as required by [5.4.91], that rule aplying to the nasculine rorn saKi and not to the reninine saKi). now ir in rorning saKi + i = saKi, had we not elided the leter i or Ki, then the long i being the single substitute ror both i + i, would be considered as like the rinal i or saKi by [6.1.85]. That being so, the word atisaKi would be considered a non-Gi word by (i .4.7), ror saKi has ben speciricaly elcluded rorn Gi clas. not being a Gi, we canot have the rorn atisaKe in the ablative and Genitive singular. ence the necesity or eliding i berore the reninine i, so that the ekadesa rule [6.1.85], should not aply. The short i is elided berore Tadhita ariles:- duli — dOleya, vali — valeya, atri — atreya a is elided berore i as :- kunara — kunari, gOra — gOri, sarngarava — sarngaravi a and a are elided berore the Tadhita :- daksa - daksi, plaksa — plaksi, cuqa — cOqi, balaka — balaki, sunitra — sOnitri Vart:- Prohibition nust be stated in the case or i (si), when it is the substitute or O [7.1.18], being the case-aril or the noninative, and acusative dual in the neuter, and or certain reninine in long a Berore this i, the preceding vowel, i and a are not elided. The sten berore this i is also bha by (i .4.18) in the case or neuter nouns. Thus kanqa + i = kanqe; kuqye sOrya + i = sOrye (the ya would have ben elided by [6.4.149]. it is owing to this Vartika, that we have inserted the word reninine in the translation or the sutra. This nay also be done by reading the anuvriti or syan [6.4.136], and na [6.4.137] into this sutra. Vart:- iyan and uvan are superseded, when they would aply sinultaneously with this lopa. Thus iyan and uvan have uninpeded scope in sri or Bru + O or as (jas), as sriyO, sriya, BruvO, Bruva Lopa has uninpeded scope in kananqalu — kananqaleya (with Qan [4.1.135]), and Badravaheya But in vatsapri + Qan [4.1.135], both the rules [6.4.7] and [6.4.148], present thenselves. The rorner is
ck: the rinal a ant i (poth lonk ant short) or a pa anka (sten) are elitet perore a tatita aril. thus taksi, plaksi, saki ron taksi, plaksi ant saki tith the reninine aril i [4.1.65] the apove rorns coult also have pen evolvet py the sinple rules or santhi, as taksi + i = taksi it nikht pe asket, there tas then the necesity or elitink i? there toult arise tiriculty in the rorns like ati saki ron the tort saki rornet py nis unter [4.1.62], te rorn the conpount sakinatikranta = atisaki, the rinal peconink short py [1.2.48] (the sanasanta aril tac is not atet here as retuiret py [5.4.91], that rule aplyink to the nasculine rorn saki ant not to the reninine saki). not ir in rornink saki + i = saki, hat te not elitet the leter i or ki, then the lonk i peink the sinkle supstitute ror poth i + i, toult pe consiteret as like the rinal i or saki py [6.1.85]. that peink so, the tort atisaki toult pe consiteret a non-ki tort py (i .4.7), ror saki has pen speciricaly elclutet rorn ki clas. not peink a ki, te canot have the rorn atisake in the aplative ant kenitive sinkular. ence the necesity or elitink i perore the reninine i, so that the ekatesa rule [6.1.85], shoult not aply. the short i is elitet perore tathita ariles:- tuli — tOleya, vali — valeya, atri — atreya a is elitet perore i as :- kunara — kunari, kOra — kOri, sarnkarava — sarnkaravi a ant a are elitet perore the tathita :- taksa - taksi, plaksa — plaksi, cuta — cOti, palaka — palaki, sunitra — sOnitri Vart:- prohipition nust pe statet in the case or i (si), then it is the supstitute or O [7.1.18], peink the case-aril or the noninative, ant acusative tual in the neuter, ant or certain reninine in lonk a perore this i, the precetink votel, i ant a are not elitet. the sten perore this i is also pha py (i .4.18) in the case or neuter nouns. thus kanta + i = kante; kutye sOrya + i = sOrye (the ya toult have pen elitet py [6.4.149]. it is otink to this Vartika, that te have insertet the tort reninine in the translation or the sutra. this nay also pe tone py reatink the anuvriti or syan [6.4.136], ant na [6.4.137] into this sutra. Vart:- iyan ant uvan are supersetet, then they toult aply sinultaneously tith this lopa. thus iyan ant uvan have uninpetet scope in sri or pru + O or as (cas), as sriyO, sriya, pruvO, pruva Lopa has uninpetet scope in kanantalu — kanantaleya (tith tan [4.1.135]), ant patravaheya put in vatsapri + tan [4.1.135], poth the rules [6.4.7] ant [6.4.148], present thenselves. the rorner is superse
s: The final अ and इ (both long and short) of a भ अङ्ग (stem) are elided before a तद्धित affix. Thus दाक्षी, प्लाक्षी, सखी from दाक्षि, प्लाक्षि and सखि with the feminine affix ई [[4.1.65]] The above forms could also have been evolved by the simple rules of sandhi, as दाक्षि + ई = दाक्षी It might be asked, where was then the necessity of eliding इ? There would arise difficulty in the forms like अति सखि From the word सखी formed by ङीष् under [[4.1.62]], we form the compound सखीमतिक्रान्तः = अतिसखि, the final becoming short by [[1.2.48]] (the samasanta affix टच् is not added here as required by [[5.4.91]], that rule applying to the masculine form सखि and not to the feminine सखी). Now if in forming सखि + ई = सखी, had we not elided the letter इ of खि, then the long ई being the single substitute for both इ + ई, would be considered as like the final इ of सखि by [[6.1.85]]. That being so, the word अतिसखि would be considered a non-घि word by (I .4.7), for सखि has been specifically excluded form घि class. Not being a घि, we cannot have the form अतिसखेः in the Ablative and Genitive singular. Hence the necessity of eliding इ before the feminine ई, so that the ekadesa rule [[6.1.85]], should not apply. The short इ is elided before Taddhita affixes:- दुलि — दौलेयः, वलि — वालेयः, अत्रि — आत्रेयः अ is elided before ई as :- कुमार — कुमारी, गौर — गौरी, शार्ङ्गरव — शार्ङ्गरवी अ and आ are elided before the Taddhita :- दक्ष - दाक्षि, प्लक्ष — प्लाक्षिः, चूड — चौडिः, बलाका — बालाकिः, सुमित्रा — सौमित्रिः Vart:- Prohibition must be stated in the case of ई (शी), when it is the substitute of औ [[7.1.18]], being the case-affix of the nominative, and accusative dual in the neuter, and of certain feminine in long आ Before this ई, the preceding vowel, इ and अ are not elided. The stem before this ई is also bha by (I .4.18) in the case of Neuter nouns. Thus काण्ड + ई = काण्डे; कुड्ये सौर्य + ई = सौर्ये (the य would have been elided by [[6.4.149]]. It is owing to this Vartika, that we have inserted the word 'feminine' in the translation of the sutra. This may also be done by reading the anuvritti of श्यां [[6.4.136]], and न [[6.4.137]] into this sutra. Vart:- इयङ् and उवङ् are superseded, when they would apply simultaneously with this lopa. Thus इयङ् and उवङ् have unimpeded scope in श्री or भ्रू + औ or अस् (जस्), as श्रियौ, श्रियः, भ्रुवौ, भ्रुवः Lopa has unimpeded scope in कमण्डलू — कामण्डलेयः (with ढञ् [[4.1.135]]), and भाद्रवाहेयः But in वत्सप्री + ढञ् [[4.1.135]], both the rules [[6.4.77]] and [[6.4.148]], present themselves. The former is superseded, and we have वात्सप्रेयः (वत्सं प्रीणाति = वत्सप्रीः, तस्यापत्यं); so also लैखाभ्रेयः with the ढक् affix, this word belonging to Subhradi class [[4.1.123]].

pk: Or the Ba anga (stens) 1. surya 2. tisya 3. agastya and 4. natsya (and their derivatives when they are Ba) the penultinate y is also is also elided berore a tadDita aril. Thus suryenEkadik = sOri (surya + an under [4.3.12] = sOrya, then i or nip = sOri), as sOri balaka so also tisya — tEsanaha, tEsi ratri so also agastyasyapatyan stri = agasti [4.1.14], agastiya; so also natsya — natsi with nis as it belongs to Gauradi clas [4.1.40]. ir the words surya &c, were to be qualiried by the word Ba, then the sutra would nean suryadinan Basanjnanan "or surya &c, when they get the designation or Ba"; and the result or this interpretation would be, that the rule would aply to cases like suryasya stri = suri, agastyasya stri = agasti &c, only, where the rorns surya &c, are Bha, and not to their derivatives, as sOrya &c: and there would not have ben the rorns like sOri balaka; because, here the word surya is not Bha berore the aril i, but the word sOrya is Bha. ence we have introduced the words "and their derivatives" in the translation, so as to cover the cases like sOri balaka in the last elanple, we again have an ilustration, or the rule [6.4.2], which says that ror purposes or asidha the asraya nust be the sane. Thus sOrya + i = sOry + a lopa + i = sOri But sOrya itselr was rorned by the elision or a or surya berore the aril an, thus, surya + an = sOry + 0 + sOry (last sutra) = sOrya But ir this lopa be considered as asidha by [6.4.2], then we have the rolowing equation sOry + 0 + a (or an) + i = sOry + 0 + 0 (a or an being elided by [6.4.148] + i ere y canot be elided, as it is not upadha or penultinate: because the rirst lopa is considered asidha. But it is not to be so considered, as their scopes (asraya) are direrent. ence we have the elision or y by this sutra. it should not be objected that the y here is not penultinate, but ultinate: as sOrya + i = sOry + 0 + i (a elided by the last sutra), and thus y is ultinate. ere, however, rule [6.4.2], aplies. This elision or a wil be considered asidha ror the purposes or the elision or y, their scope being the sane. so being considered asidha, y stil retains its designation or upadha and is elided by the present sutra. it should be renenbered here, that we could not take help or the rule or sthanivat-bhava, because ror purposes or yalopa, that rule is set aside. se [1.1.58]. Why do we say the penultinate y? Observe natsyacari This word is thus rorned. The aril caraw is aded to natsi by [5.3.53], in the sense or
ck: Or the pa anka (stens) 1. surya 2. tisya 3. akastya ant 4. natsya (ant their terivatives then they are pa) the penultinate y is also is also elitet perore a tatita aril. thus suryenEkatik = sOri (surya + an unter [4.3.12] = sOrya, then i or nip = sOri), as sOri palaka so also tisya — tEsanaha, tEsi ratri so also akastyasyapatyan stri = akasti [4.1.14], akastiya; so also natsya — natsi tith nis as it pelonks to kaurati clas [4.1.40]. ir the torts surya &c, tere to pe tualiriet py the tort pa, then the sutra toult nean suryatinan pasancnanan "or surya &c, then they ket the tesiknation or pa"; ant the result or this interpretation toult pe, that the rule toult aply to cases like suryasya stri = suri, akastyasya stri = akasti &c, only, there the rorns surya &c, are pha, ant not to their terivatives, as sOrya &c: ant there toult not have pen the rorns like sOri palaka; pecause, here the tort surya is not pha perore the aril i, put the tort sOrya is pha. ence te have introtucet the torts "ant their terivatives" in the translation, so as to cover the cases like sOri palaka in the last elanple, te akain have an ilustration, or the rule [6.4.2], thich says that ror purposes or asitha the asraya nust pe the sane. thus sOrya + i = sOry + a lopa + i = sOri put sOrya itselr tas rornet py the elision or a or surya perore the aril an, thus, surya + an = sOry + 0 + sOry (last sutra) = sOrya put ir this lopa pe consiteret as asitha py [6.4.2], then te have the rolotink etuation sOry + 0 + a (or an) + i = sOry + 0 + 0 (a or an peink elitet py [6.4.148] + i ere y canot pe elitet, as it is not upatha or penultinate: pecause the rirst lopa is consiteret asitha. put it is not to pe so consiteret, as their scopes (asraya) are tirerent. ence te have the elision or y py this sutra. it shoult not pe opcectet that the y here is not penultinate, put ultinate: as sOrya + i = sOry + 0 + i (a elitet py the last sutra), ant thus y is ultinate. ere, hotever, rule [6.4.2], aplies. this elision or a til pe consiteret asitha ror the purposes or the elision or y, their scope peink the sane. so peink consiteret asitha, y stil retains its tesiknation or upatha ant is elitet py the present sutra. it shoult pe renenperet here, that te coult not take help or the rule or sthanivat-phava, pecause ror purposes or yalopa, that rule is set asite. se [1.1.58]. thy to te say the penultinate y? Opserve natsyacari this tort is thus rornet. the aril carat is atet to natsi py [5.3.53], in the sense or natsi
s: Of the भ अङ्ग (stems) 1. सूर्य 2. तिष्य 3. अगस्त्य and 4. मत्स्य (and their derivatives when they are भ) the penultimate य् is also is also elided before a तद्धित affix. Thus सूर्येणैकादिक् = सौरी (सूर्य + अण् under [[4.3.112]] = सौर्य, then ई of ङीप् = सौरी), as सौरी बलाका So also तिष्य — तैषमहः, तैषी रात्रिः So also अगस्त्यस्यापत्यं स्त्री = आगस्ती [[4.1.114]], आगस्तीयः; So also मत्स्य — मत्सी with ङीष् as it belongs to Gauradi class [[4.1.40]]. If the words सूर्य &c, were to be qualified by the word भ, then the sutra would mean सूर्यादीनां भसंज्ञानां "of सूर्य &c, when they get the designation of भ"; and the result of this interpretation would be, that the rule would apply to cases like सूर्यस्य स्त्री = सूरी, आगस्त्यस्य स्त्री = आगस्ती &c, only, where the forms सूर्य &c, are Bha, and not to their derivatives, as सौर्य &c: and there would not have been the forms like सौरी बलाका; because, here the word सूर्य is not Bha before the affix ई, but the word सौर्य is Bha. Hence we have introduced the words "and their derivatives" in the translation, so as to cover the cases like सौरी बलाका In the last example, we again have an illustration, of the rule [[6.4.22]], which says that for purposes of asiddha the आश्रय must be the same. Thus सौर्य + ई = सौर्य् + अ lopa + ई = सौरी But सौर्य itself was formed by the elision of अ of सूर्य before the affix अण्, thus, सूर्य + अण् = सौर्य् + ० + सौर्य् (last sutra) = सौर्य But if this lopa be considered as asiddha by [[6.4.22]], then we have the following equation सौर्य् + ० + अ (of अण्) + ई = सौर्य् + ० + ० (अ of अण् being elided by [[6.4.148]] + ई Here य् cannot be elided, as it is not upadha or penultimate: because the first lopa is considered asiddha. But it is not to be so considered, as their scopes (आश्रय) are different. Hence we have the elision of य् by this sutra. It should not be objected that the य् here is not penultimate, but ultimate: as सौर्य + ई = सौर्य् + ० + ई (अ elided by the last sutra), and thus य् is ultimate. Here, however, rule [[6.4.22]], applies. This elision of अ will be considered asiddha for the purposes of the elision of य्, their scope being the same. So being considered asiddha, य् still retains its designation of upadha and is elided by the present sutra. It should be remembered here, that we could not take help of the rule of sthanivat-bhava, because for purposes of यलोप, that rule is set aside. See [[1.1.58]]. Why do we say the penultimate य्? Observe मत्स्यचरी This word is thus formed. The affix चरट् is added to मत्सी by [[5.3.53]], in the sense of मत्सी भूतपूर्वा Then the मत्सी becomes masculine मत्स्य by [[6.4.35]], and we have मत्स्यचर This word takes ङीप् by [[4.1.15]], because it is formed by an affix having an indicatory ट् Thus मत्स्यचर + ई, and the word is भ, but the य is not elided, because it is not penultimate. The य has been read for the sake of the subsequent sutras : उपधायाः alone would have been enough for the purposes of this aphorism. The rule contained in this sutra is rather too general; it is limited by the following vartikas, which enumerate the conditions under which the elision takes place. Vart:- The य of मत्स्य is elided before the feminine ई only: therefore not here मत्स्यस्येदं मांसं = मात्स्यम् Vart:- Of सूर्य and अगस्त्य before the affixes छ, and ई (of the feminine): as सौरीयः, सौरी, आगस्तीयः, आगस्ती But not here सौर्यं चरुं निर्वपेत्, आगस्त्य formed with the Patronymic अण् [[4.1.114]] Vart:- Of तिष्य and पुष्य when referring to asterisms, as, तिष्येण नक्षत्रेण युक्तः कालः = तैषः, पौषः [[4.2.3]]. Vart:- Of अन्तिक before the affix तसि, the क is elided, and the word has acute on the first syllable : as, अन्तितः in अन्तितो न दूरात्[[5.4.45]]. Vart:- Before the affix तम, it loses the syllable तिक as well as क, as अन्तमः or अन्तितमः, in अग्रे त्वं नो अन्तिमः अन्तितमे अवरोहति Vart:- The elision of क of अन्तिक takes place diversely, before the second member also, as अन्तिके सीदति = अन्तिषत् (स changed to ष by [[8.3.106]]) Vart:- The el

pk: The y or a tadDita aril when preceded by a consonant and penultinate in a anga (sten), is elided berore the reninine i The anuvriti or "tadhita" ceases, because or its nention in the nelt sutra. ence this sutra aplies to reninine i only. as gargi, vatsi ron gargya and vatsya Why do we say when preceded by a consonant? Observe karikeyi Why do we say or a Tadhita. Observe vEdyasya Barya = vEdyi
ck: the y or a tatita aril then precetet py a consonant ant penultinate in a anka (sten), is elitet perore the reninine i the anuvriti or "tathita" ceases, pecause or its nention in the nelt sutra. ence this sutra aplies to reninine i only. as karki, vatsi ron karkya ant vatsya thy to te say then precetet py a consonant? Opserve karikeyi thy to te say or a tathita. Opserve vEtyasya parya = vEtyi
s: The य् of a तद्धित affix when preceded by a consonant and penultimate in a अङ्ग (stem), is elided before the feminine ई The anuvritti of "taddhita" ceases, because of its mention in the next sutra. Hence this sutra applies to feminine ई only. As गार्गी, वात्सी from गार्ग्य and वात्स्य Why do we say 'when preceded by a consonant'? Observe कारिकेयी Why do we say 'of a Taddhita'. Observe वैद्यस्य भार्या = वैद्यी

pk: The y or a Patronynic aril, preceded by a consonant, is elided berore a tadDita when it does not begin with an a Thus garganan sanuha = gargakan ron gargya, vatsakan ron vatsya [4.2.37] — [4.2.40]. Why do we say a Patronynic ya? Observe sankasyaka, kanpilyaka [4.2.80]. The repetition or the word Tadhita indicates that the elision takes place sone-tines or the non-patronynic ya also, as sani iswi Why do we say not begining with a long a? Observe gargyayana, vatsyayana The ya should be preceded by a consonant, otherwise we have karikeyasyapatyan = karikeyi Why do we say when rolowed by a Tadhita aril? Observe gargyayo, vatsyayo (berore the Genitive and Locative dual ariles).
ck: the y or a patronynic aril, precetet py a consonant, is elitet perore a tatita then it toes not pekin tith an a thus karkanan sanuha = karkakan ron karkya, vatsakan ron vatsya [4.2.37] — [4.2.40]. thy to te say a patronynic ya? Opserve sankasyaka, kanpilyaka [4.2.80]. the repetition or the tort tathita inticates that the elision takes place sone-tines or the non-patronynic ya also, as sani isti thy to te say not pekinink tith a lonk a? Opserve karkyayana, vatsyayana the ya shoult pe precetet py a consonant, othertise te have karikeyasyapatyan = karikeyi thy to te say then rolotet py a tathita aril? Opserve karkyayo, vatsyayo (perore the kenitive ant Locative tual ariles).
s: The य् of a Patronymic affix, preceded by a consonant, is elided before a तद्धित when it does not begin with an आ Thus गर्गाणां समूहः = गार्गकम् from गार्ग्य, वात्सकम् from वात्स्य [[4.2.37]] — [[4.2.40]]. Why do we say 'a Patronymic य'? Observe सांकाश्यकः, काम्पिल्यकः [[4.2.80]]. The repetition of the word Taddhita indicates that the elision takes place some-times of the non-patronymic य also, as सामी इष्टिः Why do we say 'not beginning with a long आ'? Observe गार्ग्यायणः, वात्स्यायनः The य should be preceded by a consonant, otherwise we have कारिकेयस्यापत्यं = कारिकेयिः Why do we say 'when followed by a Taddhita affix'? Observe गार्ग्ययोः, वात्स्ययोः (before the Genitive and Locative dual affixes).

pk: The y or a Patronynic aril, preceded by a consonant, is elided berore the Denoninative aril kya and the adverbial aril cvi Thus vatsiyati or vatsiyate gargiyati, or gargiyate so also gargiButa, vatsiButa But sankasyayate (where ya is not Patronynic) and so also sankasyiButa; and not also in karikeyiyati, karikeyiButa, the ya not being preceded by a consonant.
ck: the y or a patronynic aril, precetet py a consonant, is elitet perore the tenoninative aril kya ant the atverpial aril cvi thus vatsiyati or vatsiyate karkiyati, or karkiyate so also karkiputa, vatsiputa put sankasyayate (there ya is not patronynic) ant so also sankasyiputa; ant not also in karikeyiyati, karikeyiputa, the ya not peink precetet py a consonant.
s: The य् of a Patronymic affix, preceded by a consonant, is elided before the Denominative affix क्य and the adverbial affix च्वि Thus वात्सीयति or वात्सीयते गार्गीयति, or गार्गीयते So also गार्गीभूतः, वात्सीभूतः But सांकाश्यायते (where य is not Patronymic) and so also सांकाश्यीभूतः; and not also in कारिकेयीयति, कारिकेयीभूतः, the य not being preceded by a consonant.

pk: The aril Ca or the Ba anga (stens) bilvaka etc. is elided berore a tadDita aril. The bilva &c are a subdivision or nadadi clas [4.2.91], and the augnent ka is aded to then by [4.2.91]. arter these words, with the augnent ka, the aril Ca is elided. Thus bilva yasyan santi = bilvakiya; tasyan Bava [4.3.53] = bElvaka sinilarly venukiya - vEnuka, vEtrakiya, vEtraka, vetasakiya, vEtasaka, trnakiya, tarnaka iksukiya, Eksuka, kasWakiya, kasWaka, kapotakiya, kapotaka There is shortening or the rinal or krunca by the Vartika krunca hrasvatvan ca kruncakiya, krOncaka Cagrahanan kin, Canatrasya lugyaTa syat kuko nivrtirna Buditi, anyaTa hi saniyogasiswanananyatapaye uBayorapyaBava iti kugapi nivarteta lugrahanan sarvalopo yaTa syad yakaranatrasya na But The aril Ca is speciricaly nentioned in order to show that the aril only should be elided and not the augnent ka Otherwise k would also have ben elided on the strength or the nalin :- saniyogasiswanananyatarapaye (or aBave) uBayorapyaBava (or apaya), "When or the two things which are taught together, one disapears, then the other disapears likewise". The luk indicates the elision or the whole aril iya, and not nerely or ya
ck: the aril ca or the pa anka (stens) pilvaka etc. is elitet perore a tatita aril. the pilva &c are a suptivision or natati clas [4.2.91], ant the auknent ka is atet to then py [4.2.91]. arter these torts, tith the auknent ka, the aril ca is elitet. thus pilva yasyan santi = pilvakiya; tasyan pava [4.3.53] = pElvaka sinilarly venukiya - vEnuka, vEtrakiya, vEtraka, vetasakiya, vEtasaka, trnakiya, tarnaka iksukiya, Eksuka, kastakiya, kastaka, kapotakiya, kapotaka there is shortenink or the rinal or krunca py the Vartika krunca hrasvatvan ca kruncakiya, krOncaka cakrahanan kin, canatrasya lukyata syat kuko nivrtirna putiti, anyata hi saniyokasistanananyatapaye upayorapyapava iti kukapi nivarteta lukrahanan sarvalopo yata syat yakaranatrasya na put the aril ca is speciricaly nentionet in orter to shot that the aril only shoult pe elitet ant not the auknent ka Othertise k toult also have pen elitet on the strenkth or the nalin :- saniyokasistanananyatarapaye (or apave) upayorapyapava (or apaya), "then or the to thinks thich are taukht tokether, one tisapears, then the other tisapears liketise". the luk inticates the elision or the thole aril iya, ant not nerely or ya
s: The affix छ of the भ अङ्ग (stems) बिल्वक etc. is elided before a तद्धित affix. The बिल्व &c are a subdivision of Nadadi class [[4.2.91]], and the augment क is added to them by [[4.2.91]]. After these words, with the augment क, the affix छ is elided. Thus बिल्वा यस्यां सन्ति = बिल्वकीयाः; तस्यां भवाः [[4.3.53]] = बैल्वकाः Similarly वेणुकीयाः - वैणुकाः, वैत्रकीयाः, वैत्रकाः, वेतसकीयाः, वैतसकाः, तृणकीयाः, तार्णकाः इक्षुकीयाः, ऐक्षुकाः, काष्ठकीयाः, काष्ठकाः, कपोतकीयाः, कापोतकाः There is shortening of the final of क्रुंचा by the Vartika क्रुञ्चा ह्रस्वत्वं च क्रुञ्चकीयाः, क्रौञ्चकाः छग्रहणं किम्, छमात्रस्य लुग्यथा स्यात् कुको निवृत्तिर्मा भूदिति, अन्यथा हि संनियोगशिष्टानामन्यतापाये उभयोरप्यभाव इति कुगपि निवर्त्तेत लुग्ग्रहणं सर्वलोपो यथा स्याद् यकारमात्रस्य मा भूत् The affix छ is specifically mentioned in order to show that the affix only should be elided and not the augment क Otherwise क् would also have been elided on the strength of the maxim :- संनियोगशिष्टानामन्यतरापाये (or अभावे) उभयोरप्यभावः (or अपायः), "When of the two things which are taught together, one disappears, then the other disappears likewise". The लुक् indicates the elision of the whole affix ईय, and not merely of य

pk: The aril tr is elided berore the ariles 1. isWan 2. inaniv and 3. iyasun Thus karisWa, vijayisWa, vahisWa, dohiyasi Denu The whole aril tr is elided; otherwise only the last vowel (wi) with the rolowing consonant would have ben elided by the rolowing rules. The anuvriti or luk or the last aphorisn should not be read into this, ror had the elision taken place by luk, then the nark or the aril would also have disapeared likewise [1.1.63], and there would have renained no guna in vijayisWa and karisWa se [5.1.12], and [5.3.59]; ror these ariles. The aril inan has ben read into this aphorisn ror the sake or the subsequent sutra, there being no elanple or tr rolowed by inan; tr is rolowed by isWa and iyas by [5.3.59].
ck: the aril tr is elitet perore the ariles 1. istan 2. inaniv ant 3. iyasun thus karista, vicayista, vahista, tohiyasi tenu the thole aril tr is elitet; othertise only the last votel (ti) tith the rolotink consonant toult have pen elitet py the rolotink rules. the anuvriti or luk or the last aphorisn shoult not pe reat into this, ror hat the elision taken place py luk, then the nark or the aril toult also have tisapearet liketise [1.1.63], ant there toult have renainet no kuna in vicayista ant karista se [5.1.12], ant [5.3.59]; ror these ariles. the aril inan has pen reat into this aphorisn ror the sake or the supsetuent sutra, there peink no elanple or tr rolotet py inan; tr is rolotet py ista ant iyas py [5.3.59].
s: The affix तृ is elided before the affixes 1. इष्ठन् 2. इमनिव् and 3. ईयसुन् Thus करिष्ठः, विजयिष्ठः, वहिष्ठः, दोहीयसी धेनुः The whole affix तृ is elided; otherwise only the last vowel (टि) with the following consonant would have been elided by the following rules. The anuvritti of लुक् of the last aphorism should not be read into this, for had the elision taken place by लुक्, then the mark of the affix would also have disappeared likewise [[1.1.63]], and there would have remained no guna in विजयिष्ठ and करिष्ठ See [[5.1.122]], and [[5.3.59]]; for these affixes. The affix इमन् has been read into this aphorism for the sake of the subsequent sutra, there being no example of तृ followed by इमन्; तृ is followed by इष्ठ and ईयस् by [[5.3.59]].

pk: The last vowel, with the consonant, ir any, that rolows it, is elided when the ariles 1. isWa 2. inan and iyas rolow. Thus pawisWa, pawina, and pawiyan ron pawu, and laGisWa, laGina and laGiyan ron laGu Vart:- The Pratipadika rolowed by the causative ni, undergoes al the changes, as it would have undergone, had the aril isWa rolowed it. Those changes are (1) punvadBava the reninine noun becones nasculine: as, eninacaswe - etayati, syetayati isWa belongs to tasiladi ariles and causes nasculation by [6.3.35], (2) raBava - the change or r to ra, as prTunacaswe - praTayati, nradayati, se [6.4.161]. (3) wilopa - as, pawunacaswe = pawayati, laGayati by this sutra, (4) yanadiparan i.e. the aplication or nule [6.4.156], as, sTulanacaswa - sTavayati acording to the schol or Bharadvaja, thre nore purposes are served : (5) vin natolrk - as sragvinanacaswe = srajayati, vasunantanacaswe = vasayati, se [5.3.65]. (6) kanviDi - the substitution or kan ror yuvan and alpa. [5.3.64] - as yuvananacaswe or alpanacaswe - kanayati (7) pradi substitution, as required by [6.4.157]: as, priyanacaswe — prapayati
ck: the last votel, tith the consonant, ir any, that rolots it, is elitet then the ariles 1. ista 2. inan ant iyas rolot. thus patista, patina, ant patiyan ron patu, ant lakista, lakina ant lakiyan ron laku Vart:- the pratipatika rolotet py the causative ni, unterkoes al the chankes, as it toult have unterkone, hat the aril ista rolotet it. those chankes are (1) punvatpava the reninine noun pecones nasculine: as, eninacaste - etayati, syetayati ista pelonks to tasilati ariles ant causes nasculation py [6.3.35], (2) rapava - the chanke or r to ra, as prtunacaste - pratayati, nratayati, se [6.4.161]. (3) tilopa - as, patunacaste = patayati, lakayati py this sutra, (4) yanatiparan i.e. the aplication or nule [6.4.156], as, stulanacasta - stavayati acortink to the schol or pharatvaca, thre nore purposes are servet : (5) vin natolrk - as srakvinanacaste = sracayati, vasunantanacaste = vasayati, se [5.3.65]. (6) kanviti - the supstitution or kan ror yuvan ant alpa. [5.3.64] - as yuvananacaste or alpanacaste - kanayati (7) prati supstitution, as retuiret py [6.4.157]: as, priyanacaste — prapayati
s: The last vowel, with the consonant, if any, that follows it, is elided when the affixes 1. इष्ठ 2. इमन् and ईयस् follow. Thus पटिष्ठः, पटिमा, and पटीयान् from पटु, and लघिष्ठः, लघिमा and लघीयान् from लघु Vart:- The Pratipadika followed by the causative णि, undergoes all the changes, as it would have undergone, had the affix इष्ठ followed it. Those changes are (1) पुंवद्भावः the feminine noun becomes masculine: as, एमीमाचष्टे - एतयति, श्येतयति इष्ठ belongs to तसिलादि affixes and causes masculation by [[6.3.35]], (2) रभावः - the change of ऋ to र, as पृथुमाचष्टे - प्रथयति, म्रदयति, see [[6.4.161]]. (3) टिलोपः - as, पटुमाचष्टे = पटयति, लघयति by this sutra, (4) यणादिपरम् i.e. the application of Rule [[6.4.156]], as, स्थूलमाचष्ट - स्थवयति According to the school of Bharadvaja, three more purposes are served : (5) विन् मतोलृक् - as स्रग्विणमाचष्टे = स्रजयति, वसुमन्तंमाचष्टे = वसयति, see [[5.3.65]]. (6) कन्विधिः - the substitution of कन् for युवन् and अल्प. [[5.3.64]] - as युवानमाचष्टेः or अल्पमाचष्टे - कनयति (7) प्रादि substitution, as required by [[6.4.157]]: as, प्रियमाचष्टे — प्रापयति

pk: Berore the ariles 1. isWa 2. inan and 3. iyas the last seni-vowel is elided with that which rolows it and ror the rirst vowel, a guna is substituted in 1. sTula 2. dura 3. yuvan 4. hrasva 5. ksipra and 6. ksudra That is la, ra, van, va, ra, and ra are elided. Thus sTavisWa, sTaviyan; davisWa daviyan; yavisWa, yaviyan; hrasisWa, hrasiyan, hrasina; ksepisWa, ksapiyan, ksepina The words hrasva, ksipra, and ksudra are read in Prithvadi clas and take inan aril [5.1.12]. ksodisWa, ksodayan, ksodina Why do we say paran in yanadiparan i.e. the last seni vowel? The rirst seni-vowel or yuvan and hrasva i.e. ya or yu and ra or hra should not be elided. The word purva is enployed ror the sake or distinctnes.
ck: perore the ariles 1. ista 2. inan ant 3. iyas the last seni-votel is elitet tith that thich rolots it ant ror the rirst votel, a kuna is supstitutet in 1. stula 2. tura 3. yuvan 4. hrasva 5. ksipra ant 6. ksutra that is la, ra, van, va, ra, ant ra are elitet. thus stavista, staviyan; tavista taviyan; yavista, yaviyan; hrasista, hrasiyan, hrasina; ksepista, ksapiyan, ksepina the torts hrasva, ksipra, ant ksutra are reat in prithvati clas ant take inan aril [5.1.12]. ksotista, ksotayan, ksotina thy to te say paran in yanatiparan i.e. the last seni votel? the rirst seni-votel or yuvan ant hrasva i.e. ya or yu ant ra or hra shoult not pe elitet. the tort purva is enployet ror the sake or tistinctnes.
s: Before the affixes 1. इष्ठ 2. इमन् and 3. ईयस् the last semi-vowel is elided with that which follows it and for the first vowel, a गुण is substituted in 1. स्थूल 2. दूर 3. युवन् 4. ह्रस्व 5. क्षिप्र and 6. क्षुद्र That is ल, र, वन्, व, र, and र are elided. Thus स्थविष्ठः, स्थवीयान्; दविष्ठः दवीयान्; यविष्ठ, यवीयान्; ह्रसिष्ठः, ह्रसीयान्, ह्रसिमा; क्षेपिष्ठः, क्षपीयान्, क्षेपिमा The words ह्रस्व, क्षिप्र, and क्षुद्र are read in Prithvadi class and take 'iman' affix [[5.1.122]]. क्षोदिष्ठः, क्षोदायान्, क्षोदिमा Why do we say परं in यणादिपरं i.e. 'the last semi vowel'? The first semi-vowel of युवन् and ह्रस्व i.e. य of यु and र of ह्र should not be elided. The word पूर्व is employed for the sake of distinctness.

pk: Berore the ariles 1. isWa 2. inan and iyas the rolowing substitutions take place 1. pra ror priya 2. sTa ror sTira 3. sPa ror sPira 4. var ror uru 5. baha ror bahula 6. gar ror guru 7. varsa ror vrdDa 8. trap ror trp 9. draGa ror dirGa and 10. vrnda ror vrndaraka Thus presWa, prena, preyan; sTira, sTesWa, sTeyan, sTena; sPira, sPesWa, sPeyan; uru, varisWa, varina, variyan; bahula, banhisWa, banhiyan, banhina; guru, garisWa, gariyan, garina; vrdDa, varsisWa, varsiyan; trpa, trapisWa, trapiyan; dirGa, draGisWa, draGiyan, draGina; vrndaraka, vrndisWa, vrndiyan; priyorugurubahuladirGa prTvadisu paWyante, tenanyesaninanij na Bavatiti nodahriyate Or the above, priya, uru, guru and bahula are read in Prithvadi clas and take inan [5.1.12], others do not.
ck: perore the ariles 1. ista 2. inan ant iyas the rolotink supstitutions take place 1. pra ror priya 2. sta ror stira 3. spa ror spira 4. var ror uru 5. paha ror pahula 6. kar ror kuru 7. varsa ror vrta 8. trap ror trp 9. traka ror tirka ant 10. vrnta ror vrntaraka thus presta, prena, preyan; stira, stesta, steyan, stena; spira, spesta, speyan; uru, varista, varina, variyan; pahula, panhista, panhiyan, panhina; kuru, karista, kariyan, karina; vrta, varsista, varsiyan; trpa, trapista, trapiyan; tirka, trakista, trakiyan, trakina; vrntaraka, vrntista, vrntiyan; priyorukurupahulatirka prtvatisu patyante, tenanyesaninanic na pavatiti notahriyate Or the apove, priya, uru, kuru ant pahula are reat in prithvati clas ant take inan [5.1.12], others to not.
s: Before the affixes 1. इष्ठ 2. इमन् and ईयस् the following substitutions take place 1. प्र for प्रिय 2. स्थ for स्थिर 3. स्फ for स्फिर 4. वर् for उरु 5. बह for बहुल 6. गर् for गुरु 7. वर्ष for वृद्ध 8. त्रप् for तृप् 9. द्राघ for दीर्घ and 10. वृन्द for वृन्दारक Thus प्रेष्ठः, प्रेमा, प्रेयान्; स्थिर, स्थेष्ठः, स्थेयान्, स्थेमा; स्फिर, स्फेष्ठः, स्फेयान्; उरु, वरिष्ठः, वरिमा, वरीयान्; बहुल, बंहिष्ठः, बंहीयान्, बंहिमा; गुरु, गरिष्ठः, गरीयान्, गरिमा; वृद्ध, वर्षिष्ठः, वर्षीयान्; तृप, त्रपिष्ठः, त्रपीयान्; दीर्घ, द्राघिष्ठः, द्राघीयान्, द्राघिमा; वृन्दारक, वृन्दिष्ठः, वृन्दीयान्; प्रियोरुगुरुबहुलदीर्घाः पृथ्वादिषु पठ्यन्ते, तेनान्येषामिमनिज् न भवतीति नोदाह्रियते Of the above, priya, uru, guru and bahula are read in Prithvadi class and take इमन् [[5.1.122]], others do not.

pk: The i and i or these ariles (inan and iyas) are elided arter bahu , and ror bahu is substituted Bu Thus Buyan, Buna in the case or isWa, the rolowing rule 159 wil aply. under [1.1.54] and [1.1.67], baho being in the ablative, the rirst leter or the suceding tern is elided, vis. i or i; in this case. bahu belongs to Prithvadi clas and takes inan aril. [5.1.12] The repetition or baho is ror the sake or pointing out the sthani, ror which the word Bu is to be substituted : otherwise Bu would have replaced these ariles.
ck: the i ant i or these ariles (inan ant iyas) are elitet arter pahu , ant ror pahu is supstitutet pu thus puyan, puna in the case or ista, the rolotink rule 159 til aply. unter [1.1.54] ant [1.1.67], paho peink in the aplative, the rirst leter or the sucetink tern is elitet, vis. i or i; in this case. pahu pelonks to prithvati clas ant takes inan aril. [5.1.12] the repetition or paho is ror the sake or pointink out the sthani, ror thich the tort pu is to pe supstitutet : othertise pu toult have replacet these ariles.
s: The इ and ई of these affixes (इमन् and ईयस्) are elided after बहु , and for बहु is substituted भू Thus भूयान्, भूमा In the case of इष्ठ, the following rule 159 will apply. Under [[1.1.54]] and [[1.1.67]], बहोः being in the Ablative, the first letter of the succeeding term is elided, viz. इ or ई; in this case. बहु belongs to Prithvadi class and takes इमन् affix. [[5.1.122]] The repetition of बहोः is for the sake of pointing out the sthani, for which the word भू is to be substituted : otherwise भू would have replaced these affixes.

pk: arter bahu , the augnent yiw is aded to isWa and Bu is the substitute or bahu as BuyisWa This augnent yiw debars the lopa substitution, or the last sutra, in the case or isWa The i in yiw is ror the sake or pronunciative, the augnent being ya Or isWa nay be taken to have lost its i by the roregoing sutra, and to the sWa, the augnent yi nay be aded.
ck: arter pahu , the auknent yit is atet to ista ant pu is the supstitute or pahu as puyista this auknent yit tepars the lopa supstitution, or the last sutra, in the case or ista the i in yit is ror the sake or pronunciative, the auknent peink ya Or ista nay pe taken to have lost its i py the rorekoink sutra, ant to the sta, the auknent yi nay pe atet.
s: After बहु , the augment यिट् is added to इष्ठ and भू is the substitute of बहु As भूयिष्ठः This augment यिट् debars the lopa substitution, of the last sutra, in the case of इष्ठ The इ in यिट् is for the sake of pronunciative, the augment being य Or इष्ठ may be taken to have lost its इ by the foregoing sutra, and to the ष्ठ, the augment यि may be added.

pk: a is substituted ror the rirst leter or iyas arter jya as jyayan jya is substituted ror prasasya by [5.3.61]. Lopa being shut out by the intervening yiw [6.4.159], the at is read in this sutra. ir the anuvriti or lopa were present here, then the a or jya would be lengthened berore yas by [7.4.25], and we would get the rorn jyayan The peculiar construction or this sutra indicates the elistence or the rolowing nalin:- angavrte punarvrtavaviDi "when an operation which is taught in the angadhikara (Vi.4, end-Vi.4, end) has taken place, and another operation or the angadhikara is subsequently aplicable, this later operation is not alowed to take place." in [7.4.25], however, knit is understod, and lengthening could not have taken place by that rule.
ck: a is supstitutet ror the rirst leter or iyas arter cya as cyayan cya is supstitutet ror prasasya py [5.3.61]. Lopa peink shut out py the intervenink yit [6.4.159], the at is reat in this sutra. ir the anuvriti or lopa tere present here, then the a or cya toult pe lenkthenet perore yas py [7.4.25], ant te toult ket the rorn cyayan the peculiar construction or this sutra inticates the elistence or the rolotink nalin:- ankavrte punarvrtavaviti "then an operation thich is taukht in the ankathikara (Vi.4, ent-Vi.4, ent) has taken place, ant another operation or the ankathikara is supsetuently aplicaple, this later operation is not alotet to take place." in [7.4.25], hotever, knit is unterstot, ant lenkthenink coult not have taken place py that rule.
s: आ is substituted for the first letter of ईयस् after ज्य As ज्यायान् ज्य is substituted for प्रशस्य by [[5.3.61]]. 'Lopa' being shut out by the intervening यिट् [[6.4.159]], the आत् is read in this sutra. If the anuvritti of 'lopa' were present here, then the अ of ज्य would be lengthened before यस् by [[7.4.25]], and we would get the form ज्यायान् The peculiar construction of this sutra indicates the existence of the following maxim:- अङ्गवृत्ते पुनर्वृत्तावविधिः "when an operation which is taught in the angadhikara (VI.4, end-VII.4, end) has taken place, and another operation of the angadhikara is subsequently applicable, this latter operation is not allowed to take place." In [[7.4.25]], however, क्ङित् is understood, and lengthening could not have taken place by that rule.

pk: Berore the ariles 1. isWa 2. inan and 3. iyas , r is substituted ror r in a anga (sten), when this r is preceded by a consonant and is not prosodialy long (on acount or being rolowed by a double consonant). Karika prTun nrdun Brsan cEva krsan ca drQaneva ca paripurvan vrQan cEva saqetan raviDO snaret Thus praTisWa, praTiyan and praTina ron prTu [5.1.12], nradiswa, nradiyan and nradina Why do we say the r? Observe pawisWa &c. Why do we say preceded by a consonant? Observe rjisWa, rjiyan Why do we say when prosodialy short? Observe krsnisWa, krsniyan, krsnina The rolowing are the sil words to which this rule aplies and to none else:- prTu, nrdu, Brsa, krsa, drQa, parivrQa it thererore, does not aply to words like krta, natr, Bratr, &c, as krtanacaswe = krtayati, nataranacaswe = natayati, Brataranacaswe = Bratayati
ck: perore the ariles 1. ista 2. inan ant 3. iyas , r is supstitutet ror r in a anka (sten), then this r is precetet py a consonant ant is not prosotialy lonk (on acount or peink rolotet py a touple consonant). karika prtun nrtun prsan cEva krsan ca trtaneva ca paripurvan vrtan cEva satetan ravitO snaret thus pratista, pratiyan ant pratina ron prtu [5.1.12], nratista, nratiyan ant nratina thy to te say the r? Opserve patista &c. thy to te say precetet py a consonant? Opserve rcista, rciyan thy to te say then prosotialy short? Opserve krsnista, krsniyan, krsnina the rolotink are the sil torts to thich this rule aplies ant to none else:- prtu, nrtu, prsa, krsa, trta, parivrta it thererore, toes not aply to torts like krta, natr, pratr, &c, as krtanacaste = krtayati, nataranacaste = natayati, prataranacaste = pratayati
s: Before the affixes 1. इष्ठ 2. इमन् and 3. ईयस् , र् is substituted for ऋ in a अङ्ग (stem), when this ऋ is preceded by a consonant and is not prosodially long (on account of being followed by a double consonant). Karika पृथुं मृदुं भृशं चैव कृशं च दृढमेव च परिपूर्वं वृढं चैव षडेतान् रविधौ स्मरेत् Thus प्रथिष्ठः, प्रथीयान् and प्रथिमा from पृथु [[5.1.122]], म्रदिष्टः, म्रदीयान् and म्रदिमा Why do we say 'the ऋ'? Observe पटिष्ठः &c. Why do we say 'preceded by a consonant'? Observe ऋजिष्ठः, ऋजीयान् Why do we say 'when prosodially short'? Observe कृष्णिष्ठः, कृष्णीयान्, कृष्णिमा The following are the six words to which this rule applies and to none else:- पृथु, मृदु, भृश, कृश, दृढ, परिवृढ It therefore, does not apply to words like कृत, मातृ, भ्रातृ, &c, as कृतमाचष्टे = कृतयति, मातरमाचष्टे = मातयति, भ्रातरमाचष्टे = भ्रातयति

pk: Berore the ariles 1. isWa 2. inan and 3. iyas , the r or rju nay optionaly be changed to r , in the Candas (Vedas). as rajisWa and rjisWa, in rajisWaneti panTanan, tvanrjisWa
ck: perore the ariles 1. ista 2. inan ant 3. iyas , the r or rcu nay optionaly pe chanket to r , in the cantas (Vetas). as racista ant rcista, in racistaneti pantanan, tvanrcista
s: Before the affixes 1. इष्ठ 2. इमन् and 3. ईयस् , the ऋ of ऋजु may optionally be changed to र् , in the छन्दस् (Vedas). As रजिष्ठः and ऋजिष्ठः, in रजिष्ठमेति पन्थानम्, त्वमृजिष्ठः

pk: a nonosylabic Ba anga (sten) retains its original rorn without undergoing any change berore the ariles 1. isWa 2. inan and 3. iyas Thus srajisWa, srajiyan, srajayati ron sragvin, the vin being elided by [5.3.65], the sten thus beconing nonosylabic. srajayati is the causative, rorned on the nodel or isWa by the Vartika under [6.4.15]. so also sruciswa, sruciyan and srucayati ron srugvat, the natup being elided as berore. Why do we say a nono-sylabic sten? Observe vasisWa ron vasunat This rule is an elception to [6.4.15]. Vart:- rajanya, nanusya and yuvan retain their original rorn unchanged, berore the aril aka as, rajanyanan sanuha = rajanyakan, nanusyakan This debars the elision or ya required by [6.4.15]. so yuno Bava = yOvanika with vun aril [5.1.13], in supersesion or [6.4.14].
ck: a nonosylapic pa anka (sten) retains its orikinal rorn tithout unterkoink any chanke perore the ariles 1. ista 2. inan ant 3. iyas thus sracista, sraciyan, sracayati ron srakvin, the vin peink elitet py [5.3.65], the sten thus peconink nonosylapic. sracayati is the causative, rornet on the notel or ista py the Vartika unter [6.4.15]. so also srucista, sruciyan ant srucayati ron srukvat, the natup peink elitet as perore. thy to te say a nono-sylapic sten? Opserve vasista ron vasunat this rule is an elception to [6.4.15]. Vart:- racanya, nanusya ant yuvan retain their orikinal rorn unchanket, perore the aril aka as, racanyanan sanuha = racanyakan, nanusyakan this tepars the elision or ya retuiret py [6.4.15]. so yuno pava = yOvanika tith vun aril [5.1.13], in supersesion or [6.4.14].
s: A monosyllabic भ अङ्ग (stem) retains its original form without undergoing any change before the affixes 1. इष्ठ 2. इमन् and 3. ईयस् Thus स्रजिष्ठः, स्रजीयान्, स्रजयति from स्रग्विन्, the विन् being elided by [[5.3.65]], the stem thus becoming monosyllabic. स्रजयति is the causative, formed on the model of इष्ठ by the Vartika under [[6.4.155]]. So also स्रुचिष्टः, स्रुचीयान् and स्रुचयति from स्रुग्वत्, the मतुप् being elided as before. Why do we say 'a mono-syllabic stem? Observe वसिष्ठः from वसुमत् This rule is an exception to [[6.4.155]]. Vart:- राजन्य, मनुष्य and युवन् retain their original form unchanged, before the affix अक As, राजन्यानां समूहः = राजन्यकम्, मानुष्यकम् This debars the elision of य required by [[6.4.15]]. So यूनो भावः = यौवनिकः with वुञ् affix [[5.1.133]], in supersession of [[6.4.144]].

pk: The rinal in or a Ba anga (sten) renains unaltered berore the non-Patronynic an aril. Thus sankuwinan, sanravinan, sanarjinan [3.3.4] and [5.4.15]. These are rorned by the Krit-aril inun [3.3.4], and then an is aded in svarTa by [5.4.15]. so also sragvinan ron sragvin Why when an rolows? Observe danqinan sanaha = danqan it is rorned by an [4.2.4]. Why do we say non-Patronynic? Observe neDavinopatyan = nEDava
ck: the rinal in or a pa anka (sten) renains unalteret perore the non-patronynic an aril. thus sankutinan, sanravinan, sanarcinan [3.3.4] ant [5.4.15]. these are rornet py the krit-aril inun [3.3.4], ant then an is atet in svarta py [5.4.15]. so also srakvinan ron srakvin thy then an rolots? Opserve tantinan sanaha = tantan it is rornet py an [4.2.4]. thy to te say non-patronynic? Opserve netavinopatyan = nEtava
s: The final इन् of a भ अङ्ग (stem) remains unaltered before the non-Patronymic अण् affix. Thus सांकुटिनम्, सांराविणम्, सांमार्जिनम् [[3.3.44]] and [[5.4.15]]. These are formed by the Krit-affix इनुण् [[3.3.44]], and then अण् is added in स्वार्थ by [[5.4.15]]. So also स्राग्विणम् from स्रग्विन् Why 'when अण् follows'? Observe दण्डिनां समहः = दाण्डम् It is formed by अञ् [[4.2.44]]. Why do we say 'non-Patronymic'? Observe मेधाविनोऽपत्यं = मैधावः

pk: 1. gaTin 2. vidaTin 3. kesin 4. ganin and 5. panin renain unchanged berore the Patronynic also. Thus gaTinopatyan = gaTina, vEdaTina, kEsina, ganina, and panina This sutra aplies to Patronynics.
ck: 1. katin 2. vitatin 3. kesin 4. kanin ant 5. panin renain unchanket perore the patronynic also. thus katinopatyan = katina, vEtatina, kEsina, kanina, ant panina this sutra aplies to patronynics.
s: 1. गाथिन् 2. विदथिन् 3. केशिन् 4. गणिन् and 5. पणिन् remain unchanged before the Patronymic also. Thus गाथिनोऽपत्यं = गाथिनः, वैदथिनः, कैशिनः, गाणिनः, and पाणिनः This sutra applies to Patronymics.

pk: The sylable in or a anga (sten) ending in in renains unchanged berore an when a conjunct consonant precedes it. Thus sankinepatyan = sankina, yadrina, vajina
ck: the sylaple in or a anka (sten) entink in in renains unchanket perore an then a concunct consonant precetes it. thus sankinepatyan = sankina, yatrina, vacina
s: The syllable इन् of a अङ्ग (stem) ending in इन् remains unchanged before अण् when a conjunct consonant precedes it. Thus शाङ्किनेऽपत्यं = शाङ्किनः, याद्रिणः, वाज्जिणः

pk: The sylable an or a anga (sten) ending in an renains unchanged berore an aril whether Patronynic or otherwise. as sanana, vEnana, sOtvana, jEtvana, ron sanan, venan, sutvan and jitvan
ck: the sylaple an or a anka (sten) entink in an renains unchanket perore an aril thether patronynic or othertise. as sanana, vEnana, sOtvana, cEtvana, ron sanan, venan, sutvan ant citvan
s: The syllable अन् of a अङ्ग (stem) ending in अन् remains unchanged before अण् affix whether Patronymic or otherwise. As सामानः, वैमनः, सौत्वनः, जैत्वनः, from सामन्, वेमन्, सुत्वन् and जित्वन्

pk: The sylable an or a anga (sten) ending in an renains unchanged berore a tadDita aril begining with y when it does not denote elistence in abstract or the avocation or soneone. Thus sanasu saDu = sananya, brahnanya But rajno Bava karna va = rajyan rajan belongs to Purohitadi clas and takes yak [5.1.128].
ck: the sylaple an or a anka (sten) entink in an renains unchanket perore a tatita aril pekinink tith y then it toes not tenote elistence in apstract or the avocation or soneone. thus sanasu satu = sananya, prahnanya put racno pava karna va = racyan racan pelonks to purohitati clas ant takes yak [5.1.128].
s: The syllable अन् of a अङ्ग (stem) ending in अन् remains unchanged before a तद्धित affix beginning with य् when it does not denote existence in abstract of the avocation of someone. Thus सामसु साधुः = सामन्यः, ब्राह्मण्यः But राज्ञो भावः कर्म वा = राज्यम् राजन् belongs to Purohitadi class and takes यक् [[5.1.128]].

pk: The rinals or the anga (stens) atnan and aDvan renain unchanged berore the aril Ka Thus atnane hitan = atnanina [5.1.9], aDvananalangani [5.2.16] = aDvanina But pratyatnan and praDvan The rirst is rorned by the sanasanta aril wac aded to the avyayibhava [5.4.108], and the later by ac [5.4.85].
ck: the rinals or the anka (stens) atnan ant atvan renain unchanket perore the aril ka thus atnane hitan = atnanina [5.1.9], atvananalankani [5.2.16] = atvanina put pratyatnan ant pratvan the rirst is rornet py the sanasanta aril tac atet to the avyayiphava [5.4.108], ant the later py ac [5.4.85].
s: The finals of the अङ्ग (stems) आत्मन् and अध्वन् remain unchanged before the affix ख Thus आत्मने हितं = आत्मनीनः [[5.1.9]], अध्वानमलङ्गामी [[5.2.16]] = अध्वनीनः But प्रत्यात्मम् and प्राध्वम् The first is formed by the samasanta affix टच् added to the avyayibhava [[5.4.108]], and the latter by अच् [[5.4.85]].

pk: in a anga (sten) in an with a preceding n with the elception or varnan , the ending an does not renain unchanged berore the Patronynic aril an Thus susanopatyan = sOsana, candrasana ron candrasanan Why do we say preceded by n? Observe sotvana, preceded by va Why do we use Patronynic? Observe carnana parivrto raTa = canarna, the an not being changed by [6.4.167]. Why do we say with the elception or varnana? Observe cakravarnanopatyan = cakavarnana Vart:- Optionaly so in hitananan, as hitananopatyan = hEtanana or hEtananana
ck: in a anka (sten) in an tith a precetink n tith the elception or varnan , the entink an toes not renain unchanket perore the patronynic aril an thus susanopatyan = sOsana, cantrasana ron cantrasanan thy to te say precetet py n? Opserve sotvana, precetet py va thy to te use patronynic? Opserve carnana parivrto rata = canarna, the an not peink chanket py [6.4.167]. thy to te say tith the elception or varnana? Opserve cakravarnanopatyan = cakavarnana Vart:- Optionaly so in hitananan, as hitananopatyan = hEtanana or hEtananana
s: In a अङ्ग (stem) in अन् with a preceding म् with the exception of वर्मन् , the ending अन् does not remain unchanged before the Patronymic affix अण् Thus सुषाम्णोऽपत्यं = सौषामः, चान्द्रसामः from चन्द्रसामन् Why do we say 'preceded by म्'? Observe सोत्वनः, preceded by व Why do we use 'Patronymic'? Observe चर्मणा परिवृतो रथः = चामर्णः, the अन् not being changed by [[6.4.167]]. Why do we say 'with the exception of वर्मन'? Observe चक्रवर्मणोऽपत्यं = चाकवर्मणः Vart:- Optionally so in हितनामन्, as हितनाम्नोऽपत्यं = हैतनामः or हैतनामनः

pk: brahna is iregularly rorned ron brahnan when not neaning a kind or jati. This sutra should be divided into two (1) brahna, the rinal an or brahnan is elided, when the an aril with the rorce or the Patronynic, as wel as with any other rorce, cones arter it. Thus brahno garBa, brahnan havi, brahnanastran; brahno narada (2) ajatO, but not so, when the Patronynic denotes a jati; ror then the an or brahnan is not elided berore the an aril : as brahnanopatyan = brahnana a Brahnana. When jati is elpresed, but an has not the rorce or the Patronynic, the an or brahnan is elided. as brahni OsaDi
ck: prahna is irekularly rornet ron prahnan then not neanink a kint or cati. this sutra shoult pe tivitet into to (1) prahna, the rinal an or prahnan is elitet, then the an aril tith the rorce or the patronynic, as tel as tith any other rorce, cones arter it. thus prahno karpa, prahnan havi, prahnanastran; prahno narata (2) acatO, put not so, then the patronynic tenotes a cati; ror then the an or prahnan is not elitet perore the an aril : as prahnanopatyan = prahnana a prahnana. then cati is elpreset, put an has not the rorce or the patronynic, the an or prahnan is elitet. as prahni Osati
s: ब्राह्म is irregularly formed from ब्रह्मन् when not meaning 'a kind of जाति'. This sutra should be divided into two (1) ब्राह्मः, the final अन् of ब्रह्मन् is elided, when the अण् affix with the force of the Patronymic, as well as with any other force, comes after it. Thus ब्राह्मो गर्भः, ब्राह्मं हविः, ब्राह्ममस्त्रम्; ब्राह्मो नारदः (2) अजातौ, but not so, when the Patronymic denotes a jati; for then the अन् of ब्रह्मन् is not elided before the अण् affix : as ब्रह्मणोऽपत्यं = ब्राह्मणः 'a Brahmana'. When jati is expressed, but अण् has not the force of the Patronymic, the अन् of ब्रह्मन् is elided. As ब्राह्मी औषधिः

pk: karna is iregularly rorned ron karnan by the elision or the rinal an when the sense is acustoned to such ocupation or pronpt therein. This is rorned by na aril [4.4.62]. ir this is the case, then by [6.4.14], the rorn karna is regularly evolved. The ract is, that n and an ariles, in the sense or tachchilika are considered as one, and thererore [6.4.167], would have prevented the elision or the rinal an sylable. in ract this proves the elistence or the roloving nalin :- tacCilike nen krtani Bavanti "The sane operations which are ocasioned by the adition or the aril an, take place, whenever the aril na is aded in the sense or one acustoned to that." Thus though nip is aded, to an - rorned words, it is also aded to na - rorned words, in the reninine: as cOri; tapasi &c. The na taught in [5.2.101], and [3.1.140], is elcepted. Why do we say, having the sense or acustoned to that? Observe karnana idan = karnanan
ck: karna is irekularly rornet ron karnan py the elision or the rinal an then the sense is acustonet to such ocupation or pronpt therein. this is rornet py na aril [4.4.62]. ir this is the case, then py [6.4.14], the rorn karna is rekularly evolvet. the ract is, that n ant an ariles, in the sense or tachchilika are consiteret as one, ant thererore [6.4.167], toult have preventet the elision or the rinal an sylaple. in ract this proves the elistence or the rolovink nalin :- tacilike nen krtani pavanti "the sane operations thich are ocasionet py the atition or the aril an, take place, thenever the aril na is atet in the sense or one acustonet to that." thus thoukh nip is atet, to an - rornet torts, it is also atet to na - rornet torts, in the reninine: as cOri; tapasi &c. the na taukht in [5.2.101], ant [3.1.140], is elceptet. thy to te say, havink the sense or acustonet to that? Opserve karnana itan = karnanan
s: कार्म is irregularly formed from कर्मन् by the elision of the final अन् when the sense is 'accustomed to such occupation or prompt therein'. This is formed by ण affix [[4.4.62]]. If this is the case, then by [[6.4.144]], the form कार्म is regularly evolved. The fact is, that ण् and अण् affixes, in the sense of tachchhilika are considered as one, and therefore [[6.4.167]], would have prevented the elision of the final अन् syllable. In fact this proves the existence of the folloving maxim :- ताच्छीलिके णेऽण् कृतानि भवन्ति "The same operations which are occasioned by the addition of the affix अण्, take place, whenever the affix ण is added in the sense of one accustomed to that." Thus though ङीप् is added, to अण् - formed words, it is also added to ण - formed words, in the feminine: as चौरी; तापसी &c. The ण taught in [[5.2.101]], and [[3.1.140]], is excepted. Why do we say, having the sense of accustomed to that? Observe कर्मणः इदम् = कार्मणम्

pk: ron uksan is rorned Oksa when not neaning a descendant. as Oksan pawan but Oksna = uksnopatyan, the a is elided in the later elanple by [6.4.135].
ck: ron uksan is rornet Oksa then not neanink a tescentant. as Oksan patan put Oksna = uksnopatyan, the a is elitet in the later elanple py [6.4.135].
s: From उक्षन् is formed औक्ष when not meaning a descendant. As औक्षं पटम् but औक्ष्णः = उक्ष्णोऽपत्यम्, the अ is elided in the latter example by [[6.4.135]].

pk: The rolowing are iregularly rorned - 1. danqinayana 2. hastinayana 3. aTarvanika 4. jEhnasineya 5. vasinayani 6. BrOnahatya 7. DEvatya 8. saravE 9. aksvaka 10. nEtreya and 1. hiranaya These words are thus derived (1 and 2) danqinayana and hastinayana ron danqin and hastin belonging to naqadi clas. The aril is Pak [4.2.91]. ir they do not belong to that clas, the aril is aded iregularly : danqinopatyan = danqinayana &c. The rinal in is not elided. (3) aTarvan belongs to Vasantadi clas [4.2.63]. The science or work or atharvan nishi is also caled atharvan. e who studies that work is caled atharvanika: the rinal is not elided berore the ik aril. (4 and 5) The descendants or jihnasin and vasin are Jaihnasineya and Vasinayani, the rorner with the aril Qak or the subhradi clas [4.1.123], and the later with the aril Pin or [4.1.157]. The rinals or the stens are not droped. (6 and 7) These are derived ron Brunahan and Divan with the aril syan, and n being replaced by ta = BrunaGno Bava, Divno Bava han takes ta berore ariles having an indicatory na or n by [7.3.32]: it night be said ta would be aded to Brunahan berore syan by that rule. That rule is, however, conrined to ariles which cone arter rots only, and not to Tadhita ariles. That rule does not aply to cases like BrOnaGni, vartraGna The ta in Bhraunhatya is thererore, an iregularity. (8) sarava is ron sarayu with the aril an, the rinal ayu being elided, sarayvan Bava = saravanudakan (9) The son or iksvaku, with an aril [4.1.168], the rinal u is elided, or iksvakusu janapades Bava = Eksaka with an aril [4.2.132]. acent on the rirst or the rinal. The iregularity consists in the elision or rinal u as one word is Eksvaka and the other Eksvaka, the sutra ought to have read this word twice, strictly speaking. The single reading nay be justiried on the ground, that the sutra gives Eksvaka without any acent (eka-sruti), and consequently includes both (ekasruti svara sarvanana) (10) nEtreya is ron nitrayu or Grishtyadi clas [4.1.136], and takes Qan as nitrayu + eya, here [6.4.146], requires Guna, but [6.4.146], prevents it, and requires lopa or u, but [7.3.2], required the substitution or iya ror yu The iregularity consists in eliding yu altogether as nEtreya, the a canot be elided by [6.4.148], berore eya, as the lopa or yu is considered asidha [6.4.2]; however the result is the sane, ror a + e = e by [6.1.97]; the single substitute being the rorn or the subsequent. The plural or nEtreya wil be nitrayava (the plural
ck: the rolotink are irekularly rornet - 1. tantinayana 2. hastinayana 3. atarvanika 4. cEhnasineya 5. vasinayani 6. prOnahatya 7. tEvatya 8. saravE 9. aksvaka 10. nEtreya ant 1. hiranaya these torts are thus terivet (1 ant 2) tantinayana ant hastinayana ron tantin ant hastin pelonkink to natati clas. the aril is pak [4.2.91]. ir they to not pelonk to that clas, the aril is atet irekularly : tantinopatyan = tantinayana &c. the rinal in is not elitet. (3) atarvan pelonks to Vasantati clas [4.2.63]. the science or tork or atharvan nishi is also calet atharvan. e tho stuties that tork is calet atharvanika: the rinal is not elitet perore the ik aril. (4 ant 5) the tescentants or cihnasin ant vasin are caihnasineya ant Vasinayani, the rorner tith the aril tak or the suphrati clas [4.1.123], ant the later tith the aril pin or [4.1.157]. the rinals or the stens are not tropet. (6 ant 7) these are terivet ron prunahan ant tivan tith the aril syan, ant n peink replacet py ta = prunakno pava, tivno pava han takes ta perore ariles havink an inticatory na or n py [7.3.32]: it nikht pe sait ta toult pe atet to prunahan perore syan py that rule. that rule is, hotever, conrinet to ariles thich cone arter rots only, ant not to tathita ariles. that rule toes not aply to cases like prOnakni, vartrakna the ta in phraunhatya is thererore, an irekularity. (8) sarava is ron sarayu tith the aril an, the rinal ayu peink elitet, sarayvan pava = saravanutakan (9) the son or iksvaku, tith an aril [4.1.168], the rinal u is elitet, or iksvakusu canapates pava = Eksaka tith an aril [4.2.132]. acent on the rirst or the rinal. the irekularity consists in the elision or rinal u as one tort is Eksvaka ant the other Eksvaka, the sutra oukht to have reat this tort tice, strictly speakink. the sinkle reatink nay pe custiriet on the krount, that the sutra kives Eksvaka tithout any acent (eka-sruti), ant consetuently inclutes poth (ekasruti svara sarvanana) (10) nEtreya is ron nitrayu or krishtyati clas [4.1.136], ant takes tan as nitrayu + eya, here [6.4.146], retuires kuna, put [6.4.146], prevents it, ant retuires lopa or u, put [7.3.2], retuiret the supstitution or iya ror yu the irekularity consists in elitink yu altokether as nEtreya, the a canot pe elitet py [6.4.148], perore eya, as the lopa or yu is consiteret asitha [6.4.2]; hotever the result is the sane, ror a + e = e py [6.1.97]; the sinkle supstitute peink the rorn or the supsetuent. the plural or nEtreya til pe nitrayava (the plural o
s: The following are irregularly formed - 1. दाण्डिनायन 2. हास्तिनायन 3. अथर्वणिक 4. जैह्माशिनेय 5. वाशिनायनि 6. भ्रौणहत्य 7. धैवत्य 8. सरवै 9. अक्ष्वाक 10. मैत्रेय and 11. हिरण्मया These words are thus derived (1 and 2) दाण्डिनायन and हास्तिनायन from दण्डिन् and हस्तिन् belonging to नडादि class. The affix is फक् [[4.2.91]]. If they do not belong to that class, the affix is added irregularly : दण्डिनोऽपत्यं = दाण्डिनायनः &c. The final इन् is not elided. (3) अथर्वन् belongs to Vasantadi class [[4.2.63]]. The science or work of Atharvan Rishi is also called Atharvan. He who studies that work is called Atharvanika: the final is not elided before the इक् affix. (4 and 5) The descendants of जिह्माशिन् and वासिन् are Jaihmasineya and Vasinayani, the former with the affix ढक् of the Subhradi class [[4.1.123]], and the latter with the affix फिञ् of [[4.1.157]]. The finals of the stems are not dropped. (6 and 7) These are derived from भ्रूणहन् and धीवन् with the affix ष्यञ्, and न् being replaced by त = भ्रूणघ्नो भावः, धीव्नो भावः हन् takes त before affixes having an indicatory ण or ञ् by [[7.3.32]]: it might be said त would be added to भ्रूणहन् before ष्यञ् by that rule. That rule is, however, confined to affixes which come after roots only, and not to Taddhita affixes. That rule does not apply to cases like भ्रौणघ्नी, वार्त्रघ्नः The त in Bhraunhatya is therefore, an irregularity. (8) सारव is from सरयू with the affix अण्, the final अयू being elided, सरय्वां भवः = सारवमुदकं (9) The son of इक्ष्वाकु, with अञ् affix [[4.1.168]], the final उ is elided, or ईक्ष्वाकुषु जनपदेष् भवः = ऐक्षाकः with अण् affix [[4.2.132]]. Accent on the first or the final. The irregularity consists in the elision of final उ As one word is ऐक्ष्वाकः and the other ऐक्ष्वाकः, the sutra ought to have read this word twice, strictly speaking. The single reading may be justified on the ground, that the sutra gives ऐक्ष्वाक without any accent (eka-sruti), and consequently includes both (एकश्रुतिः स्वर सर्वनाम) (10) मैत्रेय is from मित्रयु of Grishtyadi class [[4.1.136]], and takes ढञ् as मित्रयु + एय, here [[6.4.146]], requires Guna, but [[6.4.146]], prevents it, and requires lopa of उ, but [[7.3.2]], required the substitution of इय for यु The irregularity consists in eliding यु altogether as मैत्रेय, the अ cannot be elided by [[6.4.148]], before एय, as the lopa of यु is considered asiddha [[6.4.22]]; however the result is the same, for अ + ए = ए by [[6.1.97]]; the single substitute being the form of the subsequent. The plural of मैत्रेय will be मित्रयवः (the plural of मित्रयु); as it belongs or Yaskadi class and loses the affix in the plural [[2.4.63]]. Another form of this word is मैत्रेयिक formed under [[7.3.2]]. It might be objected that had मित्रयु been read in Bidadi class [[4.1.104]], it would have taken the affix अञ्, and the form मैत्रेय would have been evolved regularly: as मित्रयु + अञ् = मित्र + इय [[7.3.2]] + अ = मैत्रेयः This would have prevented also the necessity of including this word in the Yaskadi class [[2.4.63]], for then by [[2.4.63]], अञ् formed words would lose the affix in the plural and we would have got the form मित्रयवः in the plural. So far it would have been all right, but if मैत्रेय were to be formed with अञ् affix, as proposed, then the संघ derivative of this word would have required to be formed with अण् affix under [[4.3.127]], and not with वुञ् under [[4.3.126]]; but we require वुञ्, as मैत्रेयकः संघः (11) हिरण्मय from हिरण्य with मयट् with the elision of य, हिरण्यस्य विकारः = हिरण्मयः

pk: in the Candas (Vedas) the rolowing are iregularly rorned 1. rtvya 2. vastvya 3.4. vastva 5. naDvi and 6. hiranyaya The word rtvya is derived ron rtu, and vastvya ron vastu with the aril yat, u being changed to va rtO Bavan = rtvyan, vastO Bavan = vastvyan vastva is ron vastu, as vastuni Bava = vatsva with the aril an naDvi ron naDu with the aril an in the reninine, as naDvirna santvosaDi hiranyaya is ron hiranya with the aril nayaw, there na being elided.
ck: in the cantas (Vetas) the rolotink are irekularly rornet 1. rtvya 2. vastvya 3.4. vastva 5. natvi ant 6. hiranyaya the tort rtvya is terivet ron rtu, ant vastvya ron vastu tith the aril yat, u peink chanket to va rtO pavan = rtvyan, vastO pavan = vastvyan vastva is ron vastu, as vastuni pava = vatsva tith the aril an natvi ron natu tith the aril an in the reninine, as natvirna santvosati hiranyaya is ron hiranya tith the aril nayat, there na peink elitet.
