s: अय् is substituted for the इद् of इदम् in the Nominative 1st-Case singular masculine. As अयम् In the Feminine इयम् As अयं ब्राह्मणः, and इयं ब्राह्मणी

pk: ana is substituted ror the id or idan in the instrunental -3rd case singular and the cases that rolow, provided that the augnent akac is not aded. as anena, anayo Why do we say "not when ka is aded by [5.3.71]"? Observe inakena, inakayo The word ap (api) in the sutra is a pratyahara, rorned with the a or wa (instrunental singular), and p or sup (Locative Plural).
ck: ana is supstitutet ror the it or itan in the instrunental -3rt case sinkular ant the cases that rolot, provitet that the auknent akac is not atet. as anena, anayo thy to te say "not then ka is atet py [5.3.71]"? Opserve inakena, inakayo the tort ap (api) in the sutra is a pratyahara, rornet tith the a or ta (instrunental sinkular), ant p or sup (Locative plural).
s: अन is substituted for the इद् of इदम् in the Instrumental -3rd case singular and the cases that follow, provided that the augment अकच् is not added. As अनेन, अनयोः Why do we say "not when क is added by [[5.3.71]]"? Observe इमकेन, इमकयोः The word आप् (आपि) in the sutra is a pratyahara, formed with the आ of टा (Instrumental Singular), and प् of सुप् (Locative Plural).

pk: The id or idan is elided berore a viBakti aril begining with a consonant. as aByan, eBi, [7.1.1] eBya esan, esu ror n is substituted a by [7.2.102], and ror a + a = a by [6.1.97]. The rule: [1.1.52] by which a substitute replaces only the rinal leter, does not aply here, on the nalin nanarTake alontyaviDi ror no purpose is served by eliding nerely the rinal n or idan ence id is elided. Or it nay be said that the sutra does not teach the elision or id, but or an which was substituted ror id by the preceding sutra.
ck: the it or itan is elitet perore a vipakti aril pekinink tith a consonant. as apyan, epi, [7.1.1] epya esan, esu ror n is supstitutet a py [7.2.102], ant ror a + a = a py [6.1.97]. the rule: [1.1.52] py thich a supstitute replaces only the rinal leter, toes not aply here, on the nalin nanartake alontyaviti ror no purpose is servet py elitink nerely the rinal n or itan ence it is elitet. Or it nay pe sait that the sutra toes not teach the elision or it, put or an thich tas supstitutet ror it py the precetink sutra.
s: The इद् of इदम् is elided before a विभक्ति affix beginning with a consonant. As आभ्याम्, एभिः, [[7.1.11]] एभ्यः एषाम्, एषु For म् is substituted अ by [[7.2.102]], and for अ + अ = अ by [[6.1.97]]. The rule: [[1.1.52]] by which a substitute replaces only the final letter, does not apply here, on the maxim मानर्थके अलोऽन्त्यविधिः For no purpose is served by eliding merely the final म् of इदम् Hence इद् is elided. Or it may be said that the sutra does not teach the elision of इद्, but of अन् which was substituted for इद् by the preceding sutra.

pk: The vrdDi (ar) is substituted ror the rot vowel (r) or the anga (sten) nrj berore an aril. as narswa, narswun, narswavyan The nrj here is a rot, and the ariles berore which this Vridhi takes place are those which cone arter rots, and not which cone arter Pratipadikas. Thererore, not berore the ariles Byan &c, as kansaparinrqByan, nrqBi The anuvriti or the word vibhakti has ceased. This sutra debars guna or [7.3.84].
ck: the vrti (ar) is supstitutet ror the rot votel (r) or the anka (sten) nrc perore an aril. as narsta, narstun, narstavyan the nrc here is a rot, ant the ariles perore thich this Vrithi takes place are those thich cone arter rots, ant not thich cone arter pratipatikas. thererore, not perore the ariles pyan &c, as kansaparinrtpyan, nrtpi the anuvriti or the tort viphakti has ceaset. this sutra tepars kuna or [7.3.84].
s: The वृद्धि (आर्) is substituted for the root vowel (ऋ) of the अङ्ग (stem) मृज् before an affix. As मार्ष्टा, मार्ष्टुम्, मार्ष्टव्यम् The मृज् here is a root, and the affixes before which this Vriddhi takes place are those which come after roots, and not which come after Pratipadikas. Therefore, not before the affixes भ्यां &c, as कंसपरिमृड्भ्याम्, मृड्भिः The anuvritti of the word vibhakti has ceased. This sutra debars guna of [[7.3.84]].

pk: Berore the ariles having an indicatory n or n , vrdDi is substituted ror the end-vowel or a anga (sten). Thus ekastanqulanicaya, [3.3.20] dvO surpanispavO, kara and hara (with Dan); gO, gavO, gava, saKayO, saKaya where the case-endings are nit by [7.1.90], [7.1.92]. jEtran, yOtran with the unadi swran ron ji and yu cyOtna with tnan and neans strength. it is an obsolete Vedic word.
ck: perore the ariles havink an inticatory n or n , vrti is supstitutet ror the ent-votel or a anka (sten). thus ekastantulanicaya, [3.3.20] tvO surpanispavO, kara ant hara (tith tan); kO, kavO, kava, sakayO, sakaya there the case-entinks are nit py [7.1.90], [7.1.92]. cEtran, yOtran tith the unati stran ron ci ant yu cyOtna tith tnan ant neans strenkth. it is an opsolete Vetic tort.
s: Before the affixes having an indicatory ञ् or ण् , वृद्धि is substituted for the end-vowel of a अङ्ग (stem). Thus एकस्तण्डुलनिचायः, [[3.3.20]] द्वौ शूर्पनिष्पावौ, कारः and हारः (with धञ्); गौः, गावौ, गावः, सखायौ, सखायः where the case-endings are णित् by [[7.1.90]], [[7.1.92]]. जैत्रम्, यौत्रम् with the Unadi ष्ट्रण् from जि and यु च्यौत्नः with त्नण् and means 'strength'. It is an obsolete Vedic word.

pk: in a anga (sten) ending in a consonant with an a inediately preceding it, the vrdDi is substituted ror such a when rolowed by an indicatory n or n as paka, tyaga, yaga with Gan, paci with the causative ni, pacaka with nvul Why do we say a? Observe Bedayati, Bedaka with guna only ron Bid where i is penultinate and not a Why do we say penultinate? Observe cakasayati, taksaka
ck: in a anka (sten) entink in a consonant tith an a inetiately precetink it, the vrti is supstitutet ror such a then rolotet py an inticatory n or n as paka, tyaka, yaka tith kan, paci tith the causative ni, pacaka tith nvul thy to te say a? Opserve petayati, petaka tith kuna only ron pit there i is penultinate ant not a thy to te say penultinate? Opserve cakasayati, taksaka
s: In a अङ्ग (stem) ending in a consonant with an अ immediately preceding it, the वृद्धि is substituted for such अ when followed by an indicatory ञ् or ण् As पाकः, त्यागः, यागः with घञ्, पाचि with the causative णि, पाचकः with ण्वुल् Why do we say 'अ'? Observe भेदयति, भेदकः with guna only from भिद् where इ is penultimate and not अ Why do we say 'penultimate'? Observe चकासयति, तक्षकः

pk: The vrdDi is substituted ror the rirst vowel or the anga (sten) when a tadDita aril having an indicatory n or n rolows. as gargya ron garga + yan, so also vatsya daksi (daksa + in), plaksi, Opagava (with an ron upagu), kapaWava &c. This debars the Vridhi or [7.2.15] and [7.2.16] as tvaswra ron tvasw, and jagata ron jagat
ck: the vrti is supstitutet ror the rirst votel or the anka (sten) then a tatita aril havink an inticatory n or n rolots. as karkya ron karka + yan, so also vatsya taksi (taksa + in), plaksi, Opakava (tith an ron upaku), kapatava &c. this tepars the Vrithi or [7.2.15] ant [7.2.16] as tvastra ron tvast, ant cakata ron cakat
s: The वृद्धि is substituted for the first vowel of the अङ्ग (stem) when a तद्धित affix having an indicatory ञ् or ण् follows. As गार्ग्यः from गर्ग + यञ्, so also वात्स्यः दाक्षिः (दक्ष + इञ्), प्लाक्षिः, औपगवः (with अण् from उपगु), कापठवः &c. This debars the Vriddhi of [[7.2.115]] and [[7.2.116]] as त्वाष्ट्रः from त्वष्ट्, and जागतः from जगत्

pk: The vrdDi is substituted ror the rirst vowel or the anga (sten) when a tadDita aril with an indicatory k rolows. as naqayan with Pak, so also carayana [4.1.9], aksika and salakika with Wak [4.4.1].
ck: the vrti is supstitutet ror the rirst votel or the anka (sten) then a tatita aril tith an inticatory k rolots. as natayan tith pak, so also carayana [4.1.9], aksika ant salakika tith tak [4.4.1].
s: The वृद्धि is substituted for the first vowel of the अङ्ग (stem) when a तद्धित affix with an indicatory क् follows. As नाडायन् with फक्, so also चारायणः [[4.1.99]], आक्षिकः and शालाकिकः with ठक् [[4.4.1]].

pk: When a tadDita aril having an indicatory n , n or k rolows, a is substituted instead or vrdDi ror the rirst vowels or the rolowing - 1. devika 2. sinsapa 3. dityavaw 4. dirGasatra and 5. sreyasa Thus davikan (= devikayan Bavan) in davikanudakan; davikakula salaya (= devikakule Bava), purvadavika ron purvadevika the nane or a vilage or the Eastern people. ere the vridhi or the second nenber ordained by [7.3.14], becones a sinilarly sansapacanasa (= sinsapayavikara) The word belongs to the Palasadi clas [4.3.141], and takes an or an, the direrence being in acent. so also sansapasTala (= sinsapasTale Bava), and purvasansapa ron purvasinsapa the nane or a vilage se [7.3.14]. sinilarly datyOhan ron dityavah, (dityOha idan) and darGasatran (darGasatre Bavan) and srayasan (sreyasi Bavan) Vart:- The Vridhi or vahinara under sinilar circunstances is with an E as ir va was vi, as vahinarasyapatyan = vEhinari sone say the original word itselr is vihinara (vihinonara), and so its tadhita derivative is regular.
ck: then a tatita aril havink an inticatory n , n or k rolots, a is supstitutet insteat or vrti ror the rirst votels or the rolotink - 1. tevika 2. sinsapa 3. tityavat 4. tirkasatra ant 5. sreyasa thus tavikan (= tevikayan pavan) in tavikanutakan; tavikakula salaya (= tevikakule pava), purvatavika ron purvatevika the nane or a vilake or the Eastern people. ere the vrithi or the secont nenper ortainet py [7.3.14], pecones a sinilarly sansapacanasa (= sinsapayavikara) the tort pelonks to the palasati clas [4.3.141], ant takes an or an, the tirerence peink in acent. so also sansapastala (= sinsapastale pava), ant purvasansapa ron purvasinsapa the nane or a vilake se [7.3.14]. sinilarly tatyOhan ron tityavah, (tityOha itan) ant tarkasatran (tarkasatre pavan) ant srayasan (sreyasi pavan) Vart:- the Vrithi or vahinara unter sinilar circunstances is tith an E as ir va tas vi, as vahinarasyapatyan = vEhinari sone say the orikinal tort itselr is vihinara (vihinonara), ant so its tathita terivative is rekular.
s: When a तद्धित affix having an indicatory ञ् , ण् or क् follows, आ is substituted instead of वृद्धि for the first vowels of the following - 1. देविका 2. शिंशपा 3. दित्यवाट् 4. दीर्घसत्र and 5. श्रेयस Thus दाविकम् (= देविकायां भवम्) in दाविकमुदकम्; दाविकाकूलाः शालयः (= देविकाकूले भवाः), पूर्वदाविकः from पूर्वदेविका 'the name of a village of the Eastern people'. Here the vriddhi of the second member ordained by [[7.3.14]], becomes आ Similarly शांशपचमसः (= शिंशपायाविकारः) The word belongs to the Palasadi class [[4.3.141]], and takes अण् or अञ्, the difference being in accent. So also शांशपास्थलाः (= शिंशपास्थले भवाः), and पूर्वशांशप from पूर्वशिंशपः 'the name of a village' See [[7.3.14]]. Similarly दात्यौहम् from दित्यवाह्, (दित्यौह इदं) and दार्घसत्रम् (दार्घसत्रे भवं) and श्रायसम् (श्रेयसि भवं) Vart:- The Vriddhi of वहीनर under similar circumstances is with an ऐ as if व was वि, as वहीनरस्यापत्यं = वैहीनरिः Some say the original word itself is विहीनर (विहीनोनरः), and so its taddhita derivative is regular.

pk: Berore a tadDita aril having an indicatory n , n or k the vrdDi is not substituted ror the rirst vowel in a conpound when it rolows a word ending in y or v but E and O are respectively placed berore the seni-vowels. as kEkeya (= kekayasyapatyan), with the aril an [4.1.168]: sinilarly nEtreyika rorned with vun [5.1.134] in the sentence nEtreyikaya slaGate The word Gotra in that sutra [5.1.134] neans a nishi nane, ror in ordinary parlance the nane or a nishi is caled Gotra. sinilarly praleyan (= pralayadagata). as praleyanudakan
ck: perore a tatita aril havink an inticatory n , n or k the vrti is not supstitutet ror the rirst votel in a conpount then it rolots a tort entink in y or v put E ant O are respectively placet perore the seni-votels. as kEkeya (= kekayasyapatyan), tith the aril an [4.1.168]: sinilarly nEtreyika rornet tith vun [5.1.134] in the sentence nEtreyikaya slakate the tort kotra in that sutra [5.1.134] neans a nishi nane, ror in ortinary parlance the nane or a nishi is calet kotra. sinilarly praleyan (= pralayatakata). as praleyanutakan
s: Before a तद्धित affix having an indicatory ञ् , ण् or क् the वृद्धि is not substituted for the first vowel in a compound when it follows a word ending in य् or व् but ऐ and औ are respectively placed before the semi-vowels. As कैकेयः (= केकयस्यापत्यं), with the affix अञ् [[4.1.168]]: similarly मैत्रेयिका formed with वुञ् [[5.1.134]] in the sentence मैत्रेयिकया श्लाघते The word Gotra in that sutra [[5.1.134]] means a Rishi name, for in ordinary parlance the name of a Rishi is called Gotra. Similarly प्रालेयम् (= प्रलयादागत). As प्रालेयमुदकं

pk: Berore a tadDita aril with an indicatory n , n or k the vrdDi is not substituted ror the rirst vowel in a conpound when it rolows a word ending in y or v but E and O are respectively placed berore the seni-vowels. That is E is placed berore y, and O berore v as vEyasanan ron vyasana; (vyasane Bavan) vEyakarana ron vyakaranan (vyakarananaDite) sOvasva ron svasva (svasvasyapatyan) Why arter y or v only? Observe trarTi son or trarTa Why do we say y or v rinal or a pada or word? Observe yaswika ron yaswi, (yaswi praharananasya) [4.4.59] yata ron yati (yatesCatra or yata ine Catra) The rule does not aply to daDyasvi and naDvasvi, ror no rule ordains the Vridhi or Dya the Dva, and so no ocasion ror the prohibition or this rule arises. These are Patronyns rorned by in [4.1.95] ron daDyasva and naDvasva (daDi priyosvoyasya &c). The present rule aplies to that Vridhi also which takes place in the second nenber or the conpound by [7.3.10] &c. as purvatrEyalinda ron purvatryalinda (purvatryalinde Bava) But this prohibition does not aply where the y or v are not the parts or the second nenber, as dvyasitika (= dve asiti Buto, Buto Bavi va)
ck: perore a tatita aril tith an inticatory n , n or k the vrti is not supstitutet ror the rirst votel in a conpount then it rolots a tort entink in y or v put E ant O are respectively placet perore the seni-votels. that is E is placet perore y, ant O perore v as vEyasanan ron vyasana; (vyasane pavan) vEyakarana ron vyakaranan (vyakarananatite) sOvasva ron svasva (svasvasyapatyan) thy arter y or v only? Opserve trarti son or trarta thy to te say y or v rinal or a pata or tort? Opserve yastika ron yasti, (yasti praharananasya) [4.4.59] yata ron yati (yatescatra or yata ine catra) the rule toes not aply to tatyasvi ant natvasvi, ror no rule ortains the Vrithi or tya the tva, ant so no ocasion ror the prohipition or this rule arises. these are patronyns rornet py in [4.1.95] ron tatyasva ant natvasva (tati priyosvoyasya &c). the present rule aplies to that Vrithi also thich takes place in the secont nenper or the conpount py [7.3.10] &c. as purvatrEyalinta ron purvatryalinta (purvatryalinte pava) put this prohipition toes not aply there the y or v are not the parts or the secont nenper, as tvyasitika (= tve asiti puto, puto pavi va)
s: Before a तद्धित affix with an indicatory ञ् , ण् or क् the वृद्धि is not substituted for the first vowel in a compound when it follows a word ending in य् or व् but ऐ and औ are respectively placed before the semi-vowels. That is ऐ is placed before य्, and औ before व् As वैयसनम् from व्यसन; (व्यसने भवं) वैयाकरणः from व्याकरणं (व्याकरणमधीते) सौवश्वः from स्वश्वः (स्वश्वस्यापत्यं) Why after य् or व् only? Observe त्रार्थिः son of त्रर्थः Why do we say 'य् or व् final of a pada or word'? Observe याष्टीकः from यष्टिः, (यष्टिः प्रहरणमस्य) [[4.4.59]] याता from यति (यतेश्छात्राः or यत इमे छात्राः) The rule does not apply to दाध्यश्वि and माध्वश्वि, for no rule ordains the Vriddhi of ध्य the ध्व, and so no occasion for the prohibition of this rule arises. These are Patronyms formed by इञ् [[4.1.95]] from दध्यश्व and मध्वश्व (दधि प्रियोऽश्वोयस्य &c). The present rule applies to that Vriddhi also which takes place in the second member of the compound by [[7.3.10]] &c. As पूर्वत्रैयालिन्दः from पूर्वत्र्यलिन्द (पूर्वत्र्यलिन्दे भवः) But this prohibition does not apply where the य् or व् are not the parts of the second member, as द्व्याशीतिकः (= द्वे अशीती भूतो, भूतो भावी वा)

pk: Berore a tadDita aril with an indicatory n , n or k the vrdDi is not substituted ror the rirst vowel arter y or v but E and O are respectively placed berore the seni-vowels in dvara etc. as dvare niyukta = dOvarika, dOvarapalan ron dvarapala The Tadadi rule aplies here. sOvara ron svara, (svaranaDikrtya krto granTa) so also sOvaroDyaya, sOvarTa saptanya vEyalkasa ron vyalkasa, (vyalkase Bava) sOvastika ron svasti, (svastiti aha) sOva ron svar (svarBava) Vart:- The last vowel, with the consonant, ir any, which rolows it, is elided in the indeclinables : as sOvarganika (= svarganananaha) sone read the word svaDyaya also in this list, but it is unecesary, as it would be governed by the last rule, because it is a conpound or su + aDyaya (soBanoDyaya), or it nay be a conpound or sva + aDyaya, then also it is unecesary, as sva is separately nentioned, in this list, and thererore when sva begins a word it would get this peculiar substitution then also. sinilarly sPEyakrta ron sPyakrta; sOvadunrdun ron svadunrdu, sOvanan ron svan the prakriti-bhava is by [6.4.167] while sOvan ron svan where there is no prakritibhava (by an [4.3.154]): sOvadanswra (svadanswryan Bava). sinilarly sOvan ron sva (= svasyedan); sOvagranika ron svagrana with the aril Wan (aDyatnaditvaw Wan). This sutra is nade because the y and v here are not rinals or a pada or word, as they were in the preceding sutra. The rolowing is a list or Dvaradi words. 1 dvara, 2 svara, 3 svaDyaya, 4 vyalkasa, 5 svasti, 6 svar (svara), 7 sPyakrta, 8 svadunrdu, 9 svas, 10 svan, 1 sva
ck: perore a tatita aril tith an inticatory n , n or k the vrti is not supstitutet ror the rirst votel arter y or v put E ant O are respectively placet perore the seni-votels in tvara etc. as tvare niyukta = tOvarika, tOvarapalan ron tvarapala the tatati rule aplies here. sOvara ron svara, (svaranatikrtya krto kranta) so also sOvarotyaya, sOvarta saptanya vEyalkasa ron vyalkasa, (vyalkase pava) sOvastika ron svasti, (svastiti aha) sOva ron svar (svarpava) Vart:- the last votel, tith the consonant, ir any, thich rolots it, is elitet in the inteclinaples : as sOvarkanika (= svarkanananaha) sone reat the tort svatyaya also in this list, put it is unecesary, as it toult pe kovernet py the last rule, pecause it is a conpount or su + atyaya (sopanotyaya), or it nay pe a conpount or sva + atyaya, then also it is unecesary, as sva is separately nentionet, in this list, ant thererore then sva pekins a tort it toult ket this peculiar supstitution then also. sinilarly spEyakrta ron spyakrta; sOvatunrtun ron svatunrtu, sOvanan ron svan the prakriti-phava is py [6.4.167] thile sOvan ron svan there there is no prakritiphava (py an [4.3.154]): sOvatanstra (svatanstryan pava). sinilarly sOvan ron sva (= svasyetan); sOvakranika ron svakrana tith the aril tan (atyatnatitvat tan). this sutra is nate pecause the y ant v here are not rinals or a pata or tort, as they tere in the precetink sutra. the rolotink is a list or tvarati torts. 1 tvara, 2 svara, 3 svatyaya, 4 vyalkasa, 5 svasti, 6 svar (svara), 7 spyakrta, 8 svatunrtu, 9 svas, 10 svan, 1 sva
s: Before a तद्धित affix with an indicatory ञ् , ण् or क् the वृद्धि is not substituted for the first vowel after य् or व् but ऐ and औ are respectively placed before the semi-vowels in द्वार etc. As द्वारे नियुक्तः = दौवारिकः, दौवारपालम् from द्वारपाल The Tadadi rule applies here. सौवरः from स्वर, (स्वरमधिकृत्य कृतो ग्रन्थः) So also सौवरोऽध्यायः, सौवर्थः सप्तम्यः वैयल्कशः from व्यल्कश, (व्यल्कशे भवः) सौवस्तिकः from स्वस्ति, (स्वस्तीति आह) सौवः from स्वर् (स्वर्भवः) Vart:- The last vowel, with the consonant, if any, which follows it, is elided in the Indeclinables : as सौवर्गमिकः (= स्वर्गमनमाह) Some read the word स्वाध्याय also in this list, but it is unnecessary, as it would be governed by the last rule, because it is a compound of सु + अध्याय (शोभनोऽध्याय), or it may be a compound of स्व + अध्याय, then also it is unnecessary, as स्व is separately mentioned, in this list, and therefore when स्व begins a word it would get this peculiar substitution then also. Similarly स्फैयकृतः from स्फ्यकृत; सौवादुमृदुम् from स्वादुमृदु, शौवनम् from श्वन् the prakriti-bhava is by [[6.4.167]] while शौवम् from श्वन् where there is no prakritibhava (by अञ् [[4.3.154]]): शौवादंष्ट्रः (श्वादंष्ट्र्यां भवः). Similarly सौवम् from स्व (= स्वस्येदं); सौवग्रामिकः from स्वग्राम with the affix ठञ् (अध्यात्मदित्वाट् ठञ्). This sutra is made because the य् and व् here are not finals of a पद or word, as they were in the preceding sutra. The following is a list of Dvaradi words. 1 द्वार, 2 स्वर, 3 स्वाध्याय, 4 व्यल्कश, 5 स्वस्ति, 6 स्वर् (स्वर), 7 स्फ्यकृत, 8 स्वादुमृदु, 9 श्वस्, 10 श्वन्, 11 स्व

pk: E is placed berore the y or nyagroDa instead or vrdDi when the word stands alone and is not a nenber or a conpound and is rolowed by a tadDita aril with the indicatory n , n or k as nEyagroDascanasa (= nyagroDasya vikara). Why do we say when it is alone? Observe nyagroDanule Bava salaya = nyagroDanula nyagroDa is a derivative word (ron nyagrohayati = nicErgatO parohErvaDate), then it would have ben governed by [7.3.3], this separate, sutra is then ror the sake or naking a restrictive rule (niyana) with regard to this word. ir it is a prinary word, then this sutra nakes a Vidhi rule. The word kevala is a jnapaka that the rule or Tadadi aplies in this section. se [7.3.8], also.
ck: E is placet perore the y or nyakrota insteat or vrti then the tort stants alone ant is not a nenper or a conpount ant is rolotet py a tatita aril tith the inticatory n , n or k as nEyakrotascanasa (= nyakrotasya vikara). thy to te say then it is alone? Opserve nyakrotanule pava salaya = nyakrotanula nyakrota is a terivative tort (ron nyakrohayati = nicErkatO parohErvatate), then it toult have pen kovernet py [7.3.3], this separate, sutra is then ror the sake or nakink a restrictive rule (niyana) tith rekart to this tort. ir it is a prinary tort, then this sutra nakes a Vithi rule. the tort kevala is a cnapaka that the rule or tatati aplies in this section. se [7.3.8], also.
s: ऐ is placed before the य् of न्यग्रोध instead of वृद्धि when the word stands alone and is not a member of a compound and is followed by a तद्धित affix with the indicatory ञ् , ण् or क् As नैयग्रोधश्चमसः (= न्यग्रोधस्य विकारः). Why do we say 'when it is alone'? Observe न्यग्रोधमूले भवाः शालयः = न्यग्रोधमूलाः न्यग्रोध is a derivative word (from न्यग्रोहयति = नीचैर्गतौ परोहैर्वधते), then it would have been governed by [[7.3.3]], this separate, sutra is then for the sake of making a restrictive rule (niyama) with regard to this word. If it is a primary word, then this sutra makes a Vidhi rule. The word केवल is a jnapaka that the rule of Tadadi applies in this section. See [[7.3.8]], also.

pk: The prohibition and the augnent ordained by na yvaByan padantaByan purvO tu taByanEc [7.3.3], do not aply to a word which elpreses the reciprocity or an action. as vyavakrosi, vyavaleKi, vyavavarti, vyavahasi se [3.3.43] and [5.4.14].
ck: the prohipition ant the auknent ortainet py na yvapyan patantapyan purvO tu tapyanEc [7.3.3], to not aply to a tort thich elpreses the reciprocity or an action. as vyavakrosi, vyavaleki, vyavavarti, vyavahasi se [3.3.43] ant [5.4.14].
s: The prohibition and the augment ordained by न य्वाभ्यां पदान्ताभ्याम् पूर्वौ तु ताभ्यामैच् [[7.3.3]], do not apply to a word which expresses the reciprocity of an action. As व्यावक्रोशी, व्यावलेखी, व्याववर्त्ती, व्यावहासी See [[3.3.43]] and [[5.4.14]].

pk: The prohibition and the augnent ordained by na yvaByan padantaByan purvO tu taByanEc [7.3.3], do not aply also to svagata etc. as svagatika, (= svagataniti aha) svaDvarika, (= svaDarena carati) svangi, vyangi, vyaqi (sons or svanga, Vyanga and Vyada). vyavaharika and svapateya (= svapatO saDu) The word vyavahara does not nean reciprocity or action, ror then it would have ben governed by the last sutra. svapata being a conpound with sva, would have ben governed by [7.3.4] as it is included in the Dvaradi list, hence its speciric nention here. The rolowing is the list or svagatadi words. 1 svagata, 2 svaDvara, 3 svanga, 4 vyanga, 5 vyaqa, 6 vyavahara, 7 svapati
ck: the prohipition ant the auknent ortainet py na yvapyan patantapyan purvO tu tapyanEc [7.3.3], to not aply also to svakata etc. as svakatika, (= svakataniti aha) svatvarika, (= svatarena carati) svanki, vyanki, vyati (sons or svanka, Vyanka ant Vyata). vyavaharika ant svapateya (= svapatO satu) the tort vyavahara toes not nean reciprocity or action, ror then it toult have pen kovernet py the last sutra. svapata peink a conpount tith sva, toult have pen kovernet py [7.3.4] as it is inclutet in the tvarati list, hence its speciric nention here. the rolotink is the list or svakatati torts. 1 svakata, 2 svatvara, 3 svanka, 4 vyanka, 5 vyata, 6 vyavahara, 7 svapati
s: The prohibition and the augment ordained by न य्वाभ्यां पदान्ताभ्याम् पूर्वौ तु ताभ्यामैच् [[7.3.3]], do not apply also to स्वागत etc. As स्वागतिकः, (= स्वागतमिति आह) स्वाध्वरिकः, (= स्वधरेण चरति) स्वाङ्गिः, व्याङ्गिः, व्याडिः (sons of Svanga, Vyanga and Vyada). व्यावहारिकः and स्वापतेयः (= स्वपतौ साधुः) The word व्यवहार does not mean reciprocity of action, for then it would have been governed by the last sutra. स्वपत being a compound with स्व, would have been governed by [[7.3.4]] as it is included in the Dvaradi list, hence its specific mention here. The following is the list of svagatadi words. 1 स्वागत, 2 स्वध्वर, 3 स्वङ्ग, 4 व्यङ्ग, 5 व्यड, 6 व्यवहार, 7 स्वपति

pk: a conpound begining with svan and rolowed by the tadDita aril in is not governed by the prohibition nor takes the augnent taught in dvaradinan ca [7.3.4]. Thus the descendant or svaBastra is svaBastri, so also svadanswri The word svan is included in the list or Dvaradi words [7.3.4]., the present sutra inplies that the rule [7.3.4] aplies not only to those words, but to conpounds begining with those words. Vart:- This rule aplies when any Tadhita aril begining with i rolows; as svaganena carati = svaganika, svayuTika [4.4.1]. The prohibition aplies, when other Tadhita ariles rolow such a word ending with in (an aril begining with i) : as ron svaBastri we have svaBastran (svaBastreridan)
ck: a conpount pekinink tith svan ant rolotet py the tatita aril in is not kovernet py the prohipition nor takes the auknent taukht in tvaratinan ca [7.3.4]. thus the tescentant or svapastra is svapastri, so also svatanstri the tort svan is inclutet in the list or tvarati torts [7.3.4]., the present sutra inplies that the rule [7.3.4] aplies not only to those torts, put to conpounts pekinink tith those torts. Vart:- this rule aplies then any tathita aril pekinink tith i rolots; as svakanena carati = svakanika, svayutika [4.4.1]. the prohipition aplies, then other tathita ariles rolot such a tort entink tith in (an aril pekinink tith i) : as ron svapastri te have svapastran (svapastreritan)
s: A compound beginning with श्वन् and followed by the तद्धित affix इञ् is not governed by the prohibition nor takes the augment taught in द्वारादीनां च [[7.3.4]]. Thus the descendant of श्वभस्त्र is श्वाभस्त्रिः, so also श्वादंष्ट्रिः The word श्वन् is included in the list of Dvaradi words [[7.3.4]]., the present sutra implies that the rule [[7.3.4]] applies not only to those words, but to compounds beginning with those words. Vart:- This rule applies when any Taddhita affix beginning with इ follows; as श्वगणेन चरति = श्वागणिकः, श्वायूथिकः [[4.4.11]]. The prohibition applies, when other Taddhita affixes follow such a word ending with इञ् (an affix beginning with इ) : as from श्वाभस्त्रि we have श्वाभस्त्रम् (श्वाभस्त्रेरिदं)

s: Up to यथातथयथापुरयोः पर्यायेण [[7.3.31]] inclusive, the substitution of वृद्धि will take place for the first vowel of the second member in a compound. This is an adhikara sutra, and exerts governing influence upto [[7.3.32]] exclusive. The phrase "of the second member of the compound" should be supplied in all those sutras, to complete the sense. Thus in [[7.3.11]], the word उत्तरपदस्य should be supplied. As पूर्ववार्षिकं, अपरवार्षिकम्, पूर्वहैमनम्, अपरहैमनम् In those sutras, where the word denoting the first member is not exhibited in the Ablative case, as in [[7.3.18]], [[7.3.19]], [[7.3.20]], [[7.3.21]], the present sutra is absolutely necessary for causing the vriddhi of the second member. But in those sutras, where the first member is exhibited in the ablative case, as in [[7.3.11]] (अवयवात्), there this sutra is only explanatory (and not absolutely necessary), and serves also the purpose of placing such vriddhis under the category of 'uttarapada-vriddhi'. This peculiar vriddhi is liable to certain rules of accent, as in [[6.2.105]]. Hence the importance of the present aphorism in those sutras also, where the word is exhibited in the fifth case.

s: Before a तद्धित affix having an indicatory ञ् , ण् or क् वृद्धि is substituted for the first vowel of a word denoting season when it is preceded by a word denoting a part. As पूर्ववार्षिकम्, पूर्वहैमनम्, अपरवार्षिकम्, अपरहैमनम् The composition with पूर्व and अपर &c takes place by [[2.2.1]]. and then by [[4.3.18]] there is ठक् after वर्ष, and अण् after हेमन्त with the elision of त by [[4.3.22]]. The Tadanta-viddhi, as a general rule, does not apply to compounds, so that a rule made applicable to a particular word, will not apply to a compound which ends with that word: but tadanta-viddhi applies to a word denoting season when it takes an affix causing Vriddhi, and is preceded by a word denoting a portion. We draw this rule from the present sutra, for हैमनं being formed from हेमन्त by a vriddhi-causing affix [[4.3.22]], the affix अण् will be applied to हेमन्त even when it is the second member of a compound, the first member of which denotes a part. (ऋतोर्वृद्धिमद्विधाववयवात् ( I.1.72) Vartika Mahabhashya). Why do we say 'denoting a portion'? Observe पूर्वासु वर्षासु भवं पौर्ववर्षिकम् with ठञ् [[4.3.11]]. The tadanta-vidhi applies only when the first member denotes a portion.

s: After a word denoting direction, the first vowel of the name of a village or city in the land of the Eastern people, gets the वृद्धि before a तद्धित affix having an indicatory ञ् , ण् or क् Thus पूर्वैषुकामशमः, अपरैषुकामशमः, पूर्वकार्ष्णमृत्तिकः, अपरकार्ष्णमृत्तिकः [[4.2.107]]. These are village names. पूर्वपाटलिपुत्रकः, अपरपाटलिपुत्रकः, पूर्वकान्यकुब्जः, अपरकान्यकुब्जः The word प्राचां in this sutra, as well as in [[7.3.24]], does not here mean 'the eastern grammarians', but 'the eastern countries', because of the context. पूर्वैषुकामशमः is this formed. पूर्वा च असौ इषुकामशमी = पूर्वेषुकामशमी The compounding takes place by [[2.1.50]]. Then the affix ञ is added to it, in the sense of ततो भवः by [[4.2.107]]. In पूर्वपाटलिपुत्रकः the affix वुञ् is added by [[4.2.123]]. Though Pataliputra is the name of one city, Purva-pataliputra means the Eastern portion of the city Pataliputra. That place is called 'grama', where people reside, and a 'nagara' is also a 'grama' in this sense. Therefore, the rules which good men observe with regard to 'grama', are observed by them in 'nagara' also. Thus the rule is अभक्ष्यो ग्रामकुक्कुटः, therefore, the नागर cock is also not eaten. So also ग्रामे नाध्ययम् is applied to nagara also. In this grammar also, we see that 'grama' includes 'nagara' also, as in [[4.2.109]], [[4.2.117]], [[6.2.103]]. Therefore, where is the necessity of employing the word नगर separately in this aphorism? The two words are separately used, in order to indicate the separate nature and relation of the two kinds of words. The full word पूर्वेषुकामशमी is the name of a 'grama', and not the portion इषुकामशमी But in पूर्वपाटलिपुत्र, the word पाटलिपुत्र itself is the name of the 'nagara'. In the present sutra, there is the adhikara of अङ्गस्य and of उत्तरपदस्य We apply these separately to these two classes of words: namely ग्रामवाचिनाम् अङ्गानाम् and नगरवाचिनाम् उत्तरपदानाम् This we could not have done without employing these words in the sutra. Therefore, in the case of 'grama' word, the vriddhi takes place in that portion of it which follows a direction denoting word (ग्रामवाचिनामङ्गानामवयवस्य दिकशब्दादुत्तरस्य वृद्धिर्भवति). While a nagara word itself gets vriddhi when it is preceded by a direction denoting word (दिशः उत्तरेषां नगराणाम्) In पूर्वैषुकामशमः, the vriddhi of इषुकामशमी takes place first, and then the combination by sandhi. See on this point [[7.3.22]].

Thererore, with other tine-words than sanvatsara, the Vridhi takes place in the regular way: as dvEsanika, trEsanika sinilarly in sutra [4.1.2], the word parinana does not nean the neasure or tine or nunerals, as trivarsa, dvivarsa nanavika in short, the word parinana in these sutras (and elsewhere [3.2.23], [2.3.46] &c.) neans "nas or bulk", and not a neasure in general.

s: After a numeral, the first vowel of संवत्सर and of a numeral, gets वृद्धि before a तद्धित affix having an indicatory ञ् , ण् or क् Thus द्विसांवत्सरिकः = द्वौ संवत्सरावधीष्टो भृतो भूतो or भावी [[5.1.80]], त्रिसांवत्सरिकः, द्विषाष्ठिकः = द्वे षष्टी अधीष्टो भृतो भूतो भावी वा The words द्वि, षष्टी &c when applied to वर्ष [[7.3.16]] and Numerals give rise to the affixes taught under kaladhikara [[5.1.78]] — [[5.1.97]]. The special mention of संवत्सर here, (though this is a परिमाण word and would have been included in the sutra [[7.3.17]]) implies that the word परिमाण in that sutra does not mean the measure of time, but a measure of any other thing than time. Therefore, with other time-words than samvatsara, the Vriddhi takes place in the regular way: as द्वैसमिकः, त्रैसमिकः Similarly in sutra [[4.1.22]], the word परिमाण does not mean the measure of time or numerals, as त्रिवर्षा, द्विवर्षा माणविका In short, the word परिमाण in these sutras (and elsewhere [[3.2.23]], [[2.3.46]] &c.) means "mass or bulk", and not a measure in general.

s: After a numeral, the first vowel of वर्ष gets वृद्धि before a तद्धित affix having an indicatory ञ् , ण् or क् when the affix does not refer to a Future time. As द्विवर्षे अधीष्टो भृतो भूतो वा = द्विवार्षिकः, त्रिवार्षिकः But when denoting future time, we have द्वैवर्षिकः, त्रैवर्षिकः "calculated to last two or three years" as in the sentence यस्य त्रैवर्षिकं धान्यं निहितं भृत्यवृत्तये अधिकं वापि विद्येत स सोमं पातुमर्हति (= त्रीणि वर्षाणि भावी). The word अभविष्यत् does not qualify the words अधीष्ट and भृत [[5.1.80]], the sense of futurity is there denoted by the sentence and not by the taddhita-affix: as द्वे वर्षे अधीष्टो भृतो वा कर्म करिष्यति = द्विवार्षिको मनुष्यः

s: After a numeral, the first vowel of a word denoting mass in its widest sense (with the exception of शाण) gets the वृद्धि before a तद्धित affix having an indicatory ञ् , ण् or क् when the word so formed does not mean a Name. As द्वौ कुडवौ प्रयोजनमस्य = द्विकौडविकः [[5.1.109]] द्वाभ्यां सुवर्णाभ्यां क्रीतं = द्विसौवर्णिकम् [[5.1.37]], त्रिसौवर्णिकम् The taddhita affix is optionally elided, see vartika to [[5.1.29]]. When the affix is elided there can be no Vriddhi, as द्विसुवर्णम् Similarly द्विनैष्किकम्, त्रिनैष्किकम् [[5.1.30]]. Why 'when it is not a name'? Observe पाञ्चलोहितिकम्, पाञ्चकपालिकम् (= पञ्चलोहित्यः or कपलानि परिमाणमस्य [[5.1.30]] The whole word is a Name here. Why with the exception of शाण? Observe द्वैशाणम्, त्रैशाणम् formed with अण् [[5.1.35]] and [[5.1.36]]. Some read the sutra as असंज्ञाशाणकुलिजानाम् so that कुलिज is also excepted, as द्वैकुलिजिकः ([[5.1.55]] द्वेकुलिजे प्रयोजनमस्य)

pk: in prosWapada and its synonyns, the rirst vowel or the second nenber gets the vrdDi berore a tadDita aril neaning born in that tine and having an indicatory n , n or k The word ja neans born, the ariles denoting born under that asterisn are neant here. prosWapada is the nane or an asterisn, the tine apertaining there to is also caled prosWapada (the aril an or [4.3.3], is elided by iV.2.4). prosWapadasu jata = prosWapado nanavaka (with an [4.3.16]). Why do we say born in that tine? Observe yada prOsWapadoneGa (= prosWapadasu Bava) DaraninaBivarsati The plural nunber prosWapadanan indicates that the synonyns or prosWapada such as Badrapada are also to be included.
ck: in prostapata ant its synonyns, the rirst votel or the secont nenper kets the vrti perore a tatita aril neanink porn in that tine ant havink an inticatory n , n or k the tort ca neans porn, the ariles tenotink porn unter that asterisn are neant here. prostapata is the nane or an asterisn, the tine apertainink there to is also calet prostapata (the aril an or [4.3.3], is elitet py iV.2.4). prostapatasu cata = prostapato nanavaka (tith an [4.3.16]). thy to te say porn in that tine? Opserve yata prOstapatoneka (= prostapatasu pava) taraninapivarsati the plural nunper prostapatanan inticates that the synonyns or prostapata such as patrapata are also to pe inclutet.
s: In प्रोष्ठपद and its synonyms, the first vowel of the second member gets the वृद्धि before a तद्धित affix meaning 'born in that time' and having an indicatory ञ् , ण् or क् The word ज means 'born', the affixes denoting 'born under that asterism' are meant here. प्रोष्ठपद is the name of an asterism, the time appertaining there to is also called प्रोष्ठपद (the affix अण् of [[4.3.3]], is elided by IV.2.4). प्रोष्ठपदासु जातः = प्रोष्ठपादो माणवकः (with अण् [[4.3.16]]). Why do we say 'born in that time'? Observe यदा प्रौष्ठपदोमेघः (= प्रोष्ठपदासु भवः) धरणीमभिवर्षति The plural number प्रोष्ठपदानां indicates that the synonyms of प्रोष्ठपद such as भद्रपाद are also to be included.

pk: The vrdDi is substituted ror the rirst vowels or both (the rirst and second) nenbers in a conpound ending with 1. hrd 2. Baga and 3. sinDu berore a tadDita aril having an indicatory n , n or k as suhrdayasyedan = sOhardan, sOBagyan, dOrBagyan sOBagineya (= suBagaya apatyan), dOrBagineya [4.1.126]. The words suBaga and durBaga ocur in the Kalyanadi clas [4.1.126], and the aril Qak and in augnent are aded. suBaga also ocurs in udgatri clas [5.1.129]. That word, however, does not get the Vridhi in the second nenber, as nahate sOBagaya This is a Vedic anonaly. sinilarly ron saktusinDava (= saktupraDana sinDava) we have saktusEnDava (= saktusinDusu Bava) so also panasinDava The word sinDu ocurs in Kachchadi clas, and sEnDava is rorned by an The Tadanta-rule aplies to words rorned there-under. The words suhrd and durhrd are anonalously rorned by [5.4.150]. But the reading adopted by Kasika is suhrdayasyedan; so the word hridaya is changed to hrid by [6.3.50] or [6.3.51]. The word sindhu neans a country, a river or an ocean.
ck: the vrti is supstitutet ror the rirst votels or poth (the rirst ant secont) nenpers in a conpount entink tith 1. hrt 2. paka ant 3. sintu perore a tatita aril havink an inticatory n , n or k as suhrtayasyetan = sOhartan, sOpakyan, tOrpakyan sOpakineya (= supakaya apatyan), tOrpakineya [4.1.126]. the torts supaka ant turpaka ocur in the kalyanati clas [4.1.126], ant the aril tak ant in auknent are atet. supaka also ocurs in utkatri clas [5.1.129]. that tort, hotever, toes not ket the Vrithi in the secont nenper, as nahate sOpakaya this is a Vetic anonaly. sinilarly ron saktusintava (= saktupratana sintava) te have saktusEntava (= saktusintusu pava) so also panasintava the tort sintu ocurs in kachchati clas, ant sEntava is rornet py an the tatanta-rule aplies to torts rornet there-unter. the torts suhrt ant turhrt are anonalously rornet py [5.4.150]. put the reatink atoptet py kasika is suhrtayasyetan; so the tort hritaya is chanket to hrit py [6.3.50] or [6.3.51]. the tort sinthu neans a country, a river or an ocean.
s: The वृद्धि is substituted for the first vowels of both (the first and second) members in a compound ending with 1. हृद् 2. भग and 3. सिन्धु before a तद्धित affix having an indicatory ञ् , ण् or क् As सुहृदयस्येदं = सौहार्दम्, सौभाग्यम्, दौर्भाग्यम् सौभागिनेयः (= सुभगाया अपत्यं), दौर्भागिनेयः [[4.1.126]]. The words सुभगा and दुर्भगा occur in the Kalyanadi class [[4.1.126]], and the affix ढक् and इन् augment are added. सुभग also occurs in Udgatri class [[5.1.129]]. That word, however, does not get the Vriddhi in the second member, As महते सौभगाय This is a Vedic anomaly. Similarly from सक्तुसिन्धवः (= सक्तुप्रधानाः सिन्धवः) we have साक्तुसैन्धवः (= सक्तुसिन्धुषु भवः) so also पानसिन्धवः The word सिन्धु occurs in Kachchhadi class, and सैन्धवः is formed by अण् The Tadanta-rule applies to words formed there-under. The words सुहृद् and दुर्हृद् are anomalously formed by [[5.4.150]]. But the reading adopted by Kasika is सुहृदयस्येदम्; so the word hridaya is changed to hrid by [[6.3.50]] or [[6.3.51]]. The word sindhu means 'a country', 'a river' or 'an ocean'.

pk: Berore a tadDita aril having an indicatory n , n or k , the vrdDi is substituted ror the rirst vowel or both nenbers or the conpounds anusatika etc. Thus (1) anusatikan (= anusatikasyedan) [5.1.21] and [4.3.120]; (2) anuhOqika (= anuhoqena carati [4.4.8]). (3) anusanvaranan (= anusanvarane diyate [5.1.96]. (4) anusanvatsarika [4.3.60] rorned by Wan ron anusanvatsarena diyate) (5) angaravEnava (son or angaravenu). (6) asihatyan (= asihatye Bavan). sone read this word as asyahatya; this wil also take an as belonging to vinuktadi clas. as asyahatya (= asyahatyasabdosninaDyayesti) Others read this as asyaheti, as asyahEtika (= asyaheti prayojananasya). The word asya in these is treated like a Pratipadika, its case-aril is not elided. (7) vaDyOga (= vaDyogasya apatyan). it belongs to Bidadi clas. (8) puskarasadopatyan = pOskarasadi This belongs to Bahvadi clas. (9) anuharata ron anuharat The sane as above. (10) kurukata belongs to Gargadi clas. its partonynic is kOrukatya (1) kOrupancala (kurupancalesu Bava) The aril vun is not aded here, because janapadasanudayo janapadagrahanena grhyate (12) OdukasodDi (son or udakasudDi) (13.14) EhalOkika, paralOkika, ron ihaloka and paraloka by ading Wan in the sense or tatra Bava (lokotarapadasya ca) (15) sarvalOkika ron sarvaloka by Wan under [5.1.4]. (16) sarvapOrusan ron sarvapurusa in the sense or tasyedan (17) sarvaBOna (= sarvaBunerninitan sanyogo or utpato va [5.1.41] (18) prayoga -prayOgika (tatra Bava, prayogaDidevaDiButetyaDyatnadaya) (19) parastri - parastrEneya rorned by ineya [4.1.126]. (20) so also or rajapurusa berore the aril syan, as rajapOrusyan Why do we say berore syan only? Observe rajapurusasyapatyan = rajapurusayani; rorned by Pin [4.1.157]. (21) satakunBe Bava = satakOnBa, (21 a) sOKasayanika ron suKasayana (21 b) paradarika ron paradara (2) sOtranaqi = sutranaqasyapatyan This is an akritigana clas; thererore, we have rorns like these, aBiganika (aBigananarhati), aDidEvikan (aDideveBava), aDiBOtikan; caturvEdyan (catasra eva vidya) The aril syan is aded in svartha. 1 anusatika, 2 anuhoqa, 3 anusanvarana (anusancarana), 4 anusanvatsara, 5 angaravenu, 6 asihatya (asyahatya), 7 asyaheti, 8 vaDyoga, 9 puskarasad, 10 anuharat, 1 kurukat, 12 kurupancala, 13 udakasudDa, 14 ihaloka, 15 paraloka, 16 sarvaloka, 17 sarvapurusa, 18 sarvaBuni, 19 prayoga, 20 parastri, 21 rajapurusat syani; 2 sutranaqa akrtigana, 23 aBigana, 24 aDiButa, 25 aDideva 26 caturvidya, 27 suKasayana 28 satakunBa 29 paradara
